tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsung mgur mdzod nag ma zhes pa karma pa rang byung rdo rjes phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bzhugs so
༄༅/ /rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsung mgur mdzod nag ma zhes pa karma pa rang byung rdo rjes phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bzhugs so

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i gsung mgur mdzod nag ma zhes pa karma pa rang byung rdo rjes phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo gu ru/ gangs can khrod du sku 'khrungs shing*// 'jig rten chos kyis ma gos la// nā ro brgyud pas byin brlabs pa'i// dka' ba spyad pa'i ngo mtshar can// 'gro ba'i nad gso sman pa'i mchog /nyi zla ltar grags phyag gi gnas// mi la zhes byar yongs grags pa'i// ras pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor bar snying po med par thugs la shar// zas gos 'dun pa bral bas ri khrod 'grim// bde drod ngo 'phrod srog rtsol gnad du tshud// rje btsun mi la'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud// rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba legs par grub pa/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi bdag nyid chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi rnam 'phrul/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs na 'dren zla thams cad dang bral ba/ rje btsun mi la ras pa chen po de nyid la yon tan gnyis te/ rigs dang 'brel ba dka' ba spyad pa'i yon tan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel ba nyams su myong ba'i yon tan te gnyis so// de la dka' ba spyad pa'i yon tan ni/ sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni gung thang*/ rus ni khyung po/ yab mi la shes rab rgyal mtshan/ yum nyang tsha dkar rgyan bya ba la/ sras ming sring gnyis yod pa la/ rje btsun chen po'i mtshan ni/ thos pa dga' zhes bya'o// rje btsun chen po dgung lo bdun bzhes pa'i dus su yab 'das pas/ pha spun rnams gros byas nas zhing khang nor rdzas thams cad 'phrog ste/ ma de yi bu phrug 'di gnyis khyed rang rnams kyi sha nas chad pas/ ltogs grir mi shi tsam re byin byas pas/ ha ha khyod ma smad bsad pas mi chog pa e yin zer bas/ 'jigs ting nger btang ngo*// der bus rnying ma ba gcig la yi ge bslab/ ma sprang du song ba la nyin gcig ma smad gnyis mi'i chang sa zhig tu 'phrad pas/ ma na re/ khong tshos 'o skol ma smad la 'di 'dra byas zer zhing ngus pas/ ngas ni mi thub pas thabs med dam ngu zer bas/ ma na re/

khyed kyis yi ge shes na mthu cig bslab na zer bas/ ngas mthu su las slob cug byed zer bas/ ma na re/ nga yi rdzong gzi de rnams phying khug cig tu bskungs nas yod pas/ de la brgyags byed nas/ g.yung ston pa mthu che zer bas der 'gro dgos zer nas/ rdzong gzi de rnams kyi rta ser po rdel grag bya ba nyos nas/ de la tshos tang bzhi bkal nas mthu slob pa'i mi drug dang 'grogs te song ba la/ dbus gtsang gnyis na g.yung ston bas mthu che ba med zer te/ de'i lam rgya yod zer ba'i g.yer chen po 'dug pa dang der song ba na/ g.yung ston pa de sngags pa skra se 'bal le ba zhig 'dug pas/ rta tshos dang bcas pa phul nas/ grogs tsho dang bcas pas lo cig la bslabs te/ der grogs rnams mthu lob nas yar la 'gro zer ba la/ thos pa dgas nga ni 'gro sa tig po cig med lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyed snying rje bas mi rigs/ mthu dgos pa'i lugs su 'dug pas/ da rung sdod dang*/ drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag bya ba/ gcig brgyud cig rang yin pas gdam ngag cig /ngas bon po rta nag pa bya ba cig la byin yod pas mthu drag thal ba cig yod na der 'gro dgos gsungs pas/ de la 'bul ba med pas e gnang zhus pas/ 'bul ba khyed kyi rta 'dra khyer yang mi ster/ nga'i rta dkar po stong la grags bya ba 'di khyer gsungs te/ khong rang gi bu la sna khrid bcol nas btang bas/ g.yung ston gyi sras pos de'i rgyu mtshan rnams zhib tu bshad pas/ 'jang rta nag gi bon po lha rje gnub chung bya ba de na re/ khong la mthu dgos par 'dug gsungs te/ der bon po'i bu gcig dang*/ thos pa dga' gnyis la mthu bslab nas mtshams byas pas/ lo gsum nas 'grub rgyu la mi la snying rus che bas zla ba gsum nas grub pas/ seng ldeng gi phur pa cig yod pa de/ rkang mgyogs gcig la bskur nas/ 'di nga'i ma yi lag tu gtod la/ nga'i pha spun tsho'i mkhar de la tshad tshad cig gyis la yar mgyogs par skur byas pas/

ma snying na bas/ mkhar la rgyag stangs mang du byas pas/ khol mo gcig gis mthong bas/ sdig pa glang shad tsam zhig gis mkhar gyi ka ba 'then pa mthong tsa na/ mi la'i khu bo'i mna' ma zhig blangs pa'i sa na/ mas mkhar khang la yang phur pas rgyag stangs mang du byas pas/ phyi mi gyes/ nang mi gyes pa mkhar gyi ka ba chags pas 'gyel te/ a ne gcig pu lus/ der mas brgyags gser srang gang btsal nas/ mi bang chen pa gcig gis phying pa dum bu'i rgyab tu ma mthong bar btsems te/ de'i steng du lhan thig nag po byas nas/ yi ge'i nang du khyod kyis mthu chen chen po byung yod pas lo kha yal la yul du ma 'ong*/ brgyags med na ri chen po'i nub phyogs sprin nag po'i 'og tu zhib pur ltos dang brgyag yod zer ba cig 'dug pa la/ ye nas ma shes pas/ bon po'i jo mos shes te/ khyod kyi ma lu grung mo zhig yod 'dug zer ro// der yul mi tshos 'di 'dra ba mthu byung bas/ bsad bsad na min pa yul phung zer bas/ yang yi ge bskur nas/ da nga la bsam ngan 'dzin pa tsam byung na'ang 'di 'dra byed pa yin zer nas/ bon po'i bu dang gnyis kyi ser ba bsgrubs nas phab pas/ khong la ngan lab byed pa tsho la ser bas bgos 'grim byas pas ngan yang lab mi nus pa red do// der ser ba ngan lang la song nas yul thams cad du ser ba babs pas don med pa'i zhing dang khang pa mang po khyer te/ bra byi bya byil mang po shi bas yul mi thams cad snying na bas/ ser ba 'bebs mkhan 'tshol du song ba la/ g.yung ston gyis g.yog po stobs gyad las che ba/ bang rta las mgyogs pa gcig yod pa des/ ral gri bton nas/ nga mi la thos pa dga' yin da shog zlos shing ded pas/ gcig gis kyang 'ju ma phod par bros song ste/ de'i shul du g.yung ston gyi bu dang mi la gnyis lkog tu bros 'ong bas g.yung ston gyi drung du slebs tsa/ ser ba lta pheb ste sems can mang po shi nas ma bzang gsungs/

der a khu mthu che zer ba'i g.yer chen po byung ste/ rang rtsis chen po yang skyes nas yod pa la/ nyin gcig g.yung ston drung du mjal du song tsa/ g.yung ston pa g.yung ston gsungs nas bshums shing 'dug pas/ slob dpon ci lags zhus pas/ kho da bzang po ma byas/ phu na yang mi mang po shi zer/ mda' na yang mi mang po shi zer/ 'di na yang mi mang po shi zhing 'dug gsungs/ mi shi bas gzod bshum du mi rung zhus pas/ kho de nged rang gnyis kyang 'chi ba yin pas nga rang la sdig pa chen po yod pa'i steng du/ khyed la yang sdig pa rngams po che byed du bcug pas/ da 'o skol gnyis 'gro sa dmyal ba min pa med pas/ nga shin tu 'jigs shing 'gyod pas ngus pa yin gsungs pas/ snying mi dga' phyed de btang bas/ slob dpon nges par bden lags sam zhus pas/ da khyod rang bon po la yang dris dang gsungs pas/ bon po'i rtsar song tsa/ bon po yang ngu shing 'dug pas ci lags zhus pas/ g.yung ston gis gsungs pas/ blo ma bde bar g.yung ston gyis drung du song nas/ da ci grag lags zhus pas/ da khyod snying rus can zhig 'dug pas chos shig e nus rem gsungs pas/ chos la su grag ci ltar byed zhus pas/ rong ston lha dga' rdzogs pa chen po la mkhas pas der song dang ngas brgyags bskur byas pas/ rong ston gyi zhal nas khyod 'ong ba legs/ da ma nor ba'i gdam ngag sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas pa'i chos rdzogs pa chen po bya ba/ rtsa ba o tho log /rtse mo byung rgyal/ sdong po 'dab rgyas/ nang thos pas nang sangs rgyas/ nub thos pas nub sangs rgya ba'i chos yod gsungs pas blo bde gcig byung*/ rdzogs chen zhus sgom zhing yod tsa/ nyin mtshan med par skad cig kyang ma yengs par snying rus chen po byed pa la bla mas gzigs pas/ bla ma 'jigs 'ub be song ste/ ga re 'di snying rus can 'di 'dra zhig 'dug pas gegs 'dra byung na yang thabs med pas lar yang dad pa can zhig 'dug dgongs te/

nyin gcig yid la med par kho de 'dir shog dang gsungs/ nga yi chos rdzogs pa chen po 'di yang lta ba mtho ba nam mkha' dang 'dra ste/ bsgom pa nyams myong gi rtsis ma zin/ spyod pa la thabs nag dgu sdug pa cig 'dug pas nga rang yang yid ches rgyu gcig med pas/ jo mo khro gnyer ma'i bzlas pa la 'bad cing yod pa yin te/ lho gangs pa khyer gyi kha phug na lho brag mar pa bya ba la thabs lam zab mo'i chos/ khyod yid ches shing blo khel pa ci yod zer bas der song na gsung pas/ yid ma ches ting nge song ste/ a tho slob dpon khong rang yid ma ches pa'i chos la/ ngas nyams len byas kyang mi phan bsam pa gcig byung ba dang*/ mar pa khong rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba cig yod/ khyod the tshom med par der song gsungs pas/ 'o na ci ltar byed lags zhus pas/ ngas gro phye bskur tsa song bas grags gsungs/ der gro phye ya gang gi steng du rdzogs pa chen po'i po ti bzhag nas song bas/ chu kha zhig tu lham phud nas po ti'i steng du yid la med par bzhag nas 'gro zhing yod tsa/ lam du bu chung 'ga' dang 'phrad pas khyod chos kyi steng du lham khur nas ci yin zer bas/ skyengs ting nger byung ste nga thag ring po nas yong ba dbang po med pas len gsungs pas/ da gar 'gro zer bas/ nga lho brag mar pa'i drung du chos zhu ba la 'gro bas gar bzhugs e shes dris pas/ mi shes zer/ gcig na re ngas shes zer/ ha ha su yin par 'dug tsa/ a khu blo gros la zer ba yin skad do// de nas bu tsha de rnams kyis bslab pa'i lam zhig la 'ong zhing yod tsa/ sa skyag cig gi steng du sngags pa rgad po skra se 'ba' le ba zhig gis 'phru rko zhing 'dug pas/ de la mar pa gar yod dris pas/ khyod rang da rung 'phrad pa med/ ci don zer bas/ ngas chos zhu ba yin byas pas/ e e// chos khyod 'dra bas thob pa zhig med/

'bul ba mang po dgos pas dka' zer/ 'o na ci ltar byed gar bzhugs dris pas/ gar bzhugs nga min pa gcig gis kyang mi shes/ da khyod rang nga yis sa rko 'phro 'di rkos dang*/ ngas lta nas 'ong gsung nas sa la ri mo zhig mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gnad// rtsa khams dbu mas bsdus byas te// nyon mongs thal ba 'dul lags na// 'bras bu myur du smin te mchi// zhes gsungs pas mi las ma go skad/ mi las sa de myur du rkos pa la gzigs te/ bla ma mgu nas rnal 'byor pa las 'ong ba cig 'dug gsungs/ yang sa la ri mo zhig mdzad nas/ 'di rkos dang 'phrin bya gsungs nas/ brgyud ldan bla ma'i byin brlab kyis// sems nyid lhug pa ngo bor gnas// dran pas thal ba 'dul lags na// ston thog 'bras bu myur du smin// ces gsungs pa la/ mi la'i bsam pa la/ mi rgan kha blas byed pa cig 'dug bsam pa byung skad/ khong gis sa de 'bad nas brkos pa la gzigs nas/ rnal 'byor pa las nang ba gcig 'dug gsungs nas mnyes skad/ de nas bla mas bong ba'i gseb nas chang rdzis ko gang byung nas/ kho rang thog cig gsol/ de 'phro mi la la gnang ba skom pas gsol ba ngom tshad cig byung ste/ yang bla mas tshig bcad gsungs pa ni/ bde ba chen po chang gi ngom// yang dag don chen gsang ba 'dis// yang dag gi thal ba 'dul lags na// 'bras bu myur du smin te mchi// zhes gsungs pas/ mi las chos tshig tu 'dug pa ma go skad/ de'i dus su mar pas mi la ras pa la phyag rgya chen po dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum du ngo sprad par 'dug ste ma go bar 'dug /sa la ri mo gnyis mdzad pa ni zhabs tog dka' blas kyi dka' ba dang gcig /sgom brgyags nyon mongs kyi dka' ba dang gnyis/ de'i rjes chang blud pa ni/ dngos grub nyams rtogs glo bur shugs 'byung du skye ba'i brda dang gsum yin par 'dug go /do nub tsa thon te byung ste/

da khyod rang gi rtsam pa de la gro gyis dang skyin ster zer te/ da khyod rem pa cig 'dug pas nga yi sa rkos dang*/ ngas gla la gser dngul dum pa cig ster zer te/ de la phyag rten byed nas mjal zer nas song ste/ sa zla ba gcig la brkos nas gla 'ong du re ba la/ nyin cig yid la med par bla ma dang mjal na da shog zer ba'i mi bzhi btang byung bas/ sngags pa des nga yi phyag rten rgyu'i gser dum pa cig 'ong ba de bsgug na byas tsa/ nam yin yin la bla ma de mjal sa yod pa min/ mjal na da 'dong zer bas song ste/ khong dang lhan cig 'grogs pa'i sngags pa de la mi rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhing 'dug pas/ khong skyengs pa zhig byung bas cho nge lus pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas ngas 'jig rten gyi bya ba ma thengs pas thams cad 'di ltar red pa yin/ khyod kyi bla ma gros le yang nga yin/ the tshom ma za par phyag gyis gsung*/ der phyag phul te zhabs la 'jus nas/ bla ma dam pa lags lus ngag yid gsum 'bul/ lto gos chos gsum zhu zhus pas/ gsum ka mi 'ong gang yin pa gcig ster bas khyod rang 'dom gsungs pas/ khong gi bsam mno btang bas/ da 'o na chos rang cig thugs la thogs zhus pas/ de bzhin bya khyod kyis lus ngag yid gsum ngas dbang ba yin/ po ti de nga yi lha khang du ma 'khyer/ nga yi lha la cham pa 'ong gsung pas/ 'di la rtsis chung zin bsam pas 'chol bar bzhag go /de nas bsod snyoms byed nas chos zhu bsam tsa/ thog 'jam pa red gsungs nas bkyon te/ da chos e 'ong bsam tsa/ mkhar las byed gsungs te/ mkhar las dang 'phru rko ba dang jo mo'i phye chu shing gsum la sogs pa'i g.yog rang byed la thug ste/ jo mo'i thugs zin par byung yang*/ bla ma mnyes pa'i tshul ma reg cing*/ mkhar las kyi sa rdo bskyab bskyas pas rgyab tu sgal pa chen po byung bas/ jo mos zhag 'ga' ngal gso bcug nas mi la sgal pa 'ong ba tshor ma myong zhus pas/

khyod ma tshor ba'i las la 'tsham pa med/ sgal khar cig byas pas chog gsungs te/ chos ma gnang bar nyin mtshan med par rdo khur bas dbang po med/ 'khyer la khad du song ba la/ lan gcig mi mang pos dbang bskur zhu zer zhing 'tshogs par 'dug pas/ bdag la yang 'di rnams kyi zla la dbang cig thugs la thogs zhus pas/ khyod la dbang khral e yod gsungs pas/ jo mo'i rtsar song bas mar cung zhig bskur ba de khyer nas bdag gi dbang khral 'di lags zhus pas/ 'di khyod la gang nas byung gsungs/ 'di jo mos gnang ba yin zhus pas/ 'di nga rang gi mar du 'dug pas/ khyod kyi dbang khral mi 'ong gsung nas ma gnang ba dang*/ yid rding ba cig byung*/ jo mo'i rtsar song bas/ slob dpon ci dgongs mi shes pas khyod yid ma chad gsungs pas/ bden bsam yang mkhar len gyi sa rdo rang bskyas bskyas pas/ dub cing ngal gsos tsa dbang po shor la khad byung ste/ dang po mkhar zla gam cig brtsegs/ de nas nga 'khrul zin shig gsungs/ de nas lho phyogs su sog ka gcig brtsigs/ yang 'khrul zin shig gsungs te/ sa tsho'ang sa'i mal/ rdo tsho yang rdo yi mal du phar la skyel du bcug /de nas nub phyogs su mkhar zlum po cig brtsigs te/ 'di yang khyi tshang 'dra ba gcig 'dug /sngags pa'i mkhar de gru gsum pa gcig dgos pa yin gsungs te/ byang du mkhar gru gsum pa gcig brtsigs te/ de'i dus su bdag med mas/ dgyes pa rdo rje yab yum gyi dbang zab mo che yod zer zhing*/ mi mang po 'tshogs shing 'dug pa da res nga la yang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ khyod la 'bul ba e yod/ 'bul ba med par ster thabs med gsungs pas/ jo mo la zhus par g.yu bzang po zhig byin pa de khyer song ste 'di khyod la gang nas byung gsungs pas/ nga la jo mo'i las byas pa'i gla la byin pa yin zhus pas/ jo mo'i g.yu la jo mo rang yang nga rang gi dbang ba la/ rang gi nor gyis nga yi 'bul ba mi 'ong*/

lar yang khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum nga la phul bas gla ster thabs med gsungs pas yid chad de 'gro dgos par 'dug bsam pa byung nas/ jo mo la zhus pas/ jo mos lhan cig skyes sbyor zhig gnang bas sems la phan pa tsam byung*/ de nas mkhar las byed cing yod pa la/ jag pa 'ong nas/ bla ma'i 'bul ba skyel ba bcom nas/ khyod kyi 'di la ser ba zhig phob dang ngas gdam ngag ster gsungs pas/ ser ba phab pas jag pa'i yul mkhar yod pa bshig /jag pa shi bas gdam ngag gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ mi bsad pa'i rngan du gdam ngag ster du mi rung bas/ 'o na da de nga rang yang 'gro zhus pas/ da song gsungs/ jo mos yang bla ma la zhus te/ 'dis las dang mthu dang 'o skol la phan pa 'di tsam zhig btag tsa/ 'di la gdams ngag mi ster bar slob dpon khrel med byed pa e lags zhus pas/ kho'i lus ngag yid gsum nga la phul nas yod pas/ song yang skyid mo e'u 'ong gsungs pas/ jo mos slob dpon khrel med red byed pa red zer nas/ gro phye gro mig dang bcas byin nas btang tsa/ de nub brag zhig gi rtsa bar bsdad nas nyal tsa/ kha ba 'dom pa gang bab nas 'dug pas/ tsha ba gcig byed pa'i me shing dang*/ sgyid pu 'tshol ba dang ka re ko re mang po byas pas/ tsha ba tshar tsha rjes kyis gang nas 'dug pas bsam mno mang du skyes te/ nga gcig pu yin rtsam pa ni btags pa yod pa la/ da nang tsha ba cig byas pa la rjes 'di ka tsam zhig byung bas/ de snga'i las de rnams kyi phyed bla ma'i las yin yang*/ phyed nga rang gi za ma'i g.yog red/ bla ma de'i thugs la ma btags kyang*/ jo mo des thang chad pa'i dus su/ zas bya na can 'grangs pa re/ skom za ba re 'phrod pas de bas drin che/ 'gro sa tig po cig kyang med/ bla ma yang 'di 'dra'i gdam ngag yod pa yang ma tshor bsam pa byung bas/ kha ba las ma thon pa dang log nas 'ong ste/ jo mo shin tu dga' bar byung ba/ khyod 'ong ba legs/

bla mas kyang yun ring na gdams ngag e gnang zer te/ jo mos bla ma la mthu chen gyis 'o skol blos ma thengs nas 'ong 'dug pas/ gdam ngag gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ 'o skol blos ma thengs pa min/ kho rang blos ma thengs pa yin/ da nga yi mkhar brtsigs rogs gyis dang gdams ngag sla nas 'ong gsungs/ da mkhar ci 'dra zhig brtsigs zhus pas/ mkhar gru gsum pa 'di hom khung dang 'dra bar 'dug pas mi 'thad par gda'/ da zur bzhi logs brgyad rtse mo rin chen 'bar ba 'dra ba zhig rtsigs gsung pas/ de 'dra ba zhig brtsigs shing yod tsa/ gnyal pa'i 'bul skyel pa rnams lho smad pa'i jag pas bcom pas/ da 'di la ser ba zhig phob dang sdig pas mi gnod pa'i gdams ngag nga la yod pas myur du ster gsungs pas/ de mi gsung bar zhu/ ngas sdig pa la e phan bsam zhing chos shig zhu ru 'ong ba lags zhus pas/ jo mo na re/ da res gzhan dang mi 'dra khag che bas ser ba phob zer bas/ jo mo'i ngo ma chog pas ser ba phab ste/ chos gnang du ma nyan pas/ mthu chen ngus te/ nga sdig pa che bas chos shig e thob la 'ong tsa/ dmyal bar 'gro ba la gting e zab lta ba 'dra ba zhig byung bas/ da las ngan chen po cig gis zin pas gzhan zhig tu sdig sbyong la 'gro zhus pas/ gzhan du song bas sdig pa mi 'dag /sdig pa e 'dag bsam na/ nga yi mkhar che ba 'di brtsig rogs gyis dang*/ gzhan du 'gro sa yang med/ song yang mi dga' gsungs pas/ jo mo na re/ slob dpon gyis khyod la khrel med cig byed par 'dug pas/ 'gro sa bzang po zhig yod gsung nas/ nā ro'i phyag 'phreng*/ dbu skra/ na bza' rnam snying rje bar byung bas bskur te/ bla ma la chang gcig la gcig rgyab byas nas drangs te/ bad pa dang ma tshor bar rngog ston pa can du bslab nas btang ngo*// de nas bla ma chang dngas pa dang*/ nga yi bu mthu che gar song gsungs pa la/ 'o skol gyi khrel med byas pas tshe ma phyin te sprang du song byas pas/

e e gsungs te spyan zim me lan gcig bzhugs pa dang*/ da res tsa na nga yi bu de gar ma song zin/ bong bu'i rna ba bzhin du rang la 'khor ba cig tu song zin/ lar jo mo khyed rang kyang ngas ci bsam mi shes pa'i brtsams las byed pa cig 'dug gsungs so// mkhar che ba de brtsigs na thos grol du 'gro ste ma dgongs so// mkhar de rnams mi la'i sdig sgrib e 'dag dang*/ dbus kyi brtsigs pa de ni pha spun tshos brtsigs su ma bcug pas pha spun rnams mgo bskor ba'i thabs dang*/ mi las zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i rten 'brel du brtsigs pa'o// mi las mar pa'i drung du dka' ba spyad pa la bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ thos grol nyid du 'gro ba zhig dgongs te bag ma byung bar 'dug go /de nas rngog ston gyi drung du song tsa/ rngog ston gyis khyed mthu chen 'bod ma dgos par 'ong ba legs/ de bla ma'i bka' drin red gsungs so// de nas bdag med mas bskur ba'i te lo nā ro'i dbu skra/ phyag 'phreng rnams phyag tu phul nas/ bdag sdig pa che bas chos shig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ rngog ston pas chos 'chad cing 'dug pa'i zhal nas/ da nang nga'i grwa pa tshong 'dus pas bcom pas/ khyed kyi de la ser ba zhig phob dang gdam ngag la ngas shes pa yin gsungs pas/ bla ma'i ngo ma chog pas ser ba phab pa'i ring la yul gyi lo thog thams cad dang*/ gnam gyi bya dang*/ sa yi byi ba yan chad sems can mang po shi/ jag pa rnam la'ang ser bas sgo 'grims byas pas tshang phung du thams cad song bas/ mthu chen snying rlung langs nas sgang cig tu phar byon tsa/ shing phung cig gis rtsa nas yang byi'u ro thu ba gang rnyed pa khyer nas bla ma rngog gi drung du byon te/ nga sangs rgyas pa'i chos shig zhu ru 'ong tsa/ dmyal bar 'gro ba la bang e myur dang gting e zab kyi sdig pa rngam po che 'di 'dra byed la thug pa da gar 'gro zhus pas/

a'u tsi/ ha ma las shig dang*/ byi'u ro tsho me 'di'i nang du thob cig gsungs nas/ mdun du me 'ong cig 'dug pa'i nang du byi'u ro rnams btab ste bla mas se gol cig brdab tsa nam mkha' tsi ti re 'phur nas song bas snang ba la phan pa cig byung skad do// de nas bdag med mas byin rlabs dang*/ gtum mo'i khrid gnang nas bsgom bcug ste/ rngog gi jo mo na re/ mthu chen rang mtshams gyis bla mas kyang chos phug sgor byon la shod/ ngas zhabs tog dang 'tsho ba skyel bas 'bung la bsgom dgos zer nas/ bsgoms kyang yon tan cher ma skyes shing skyed med pas/ nyin cig bla ma rngog gis/ kho de mthu chen nga yi brgyud pa 'di la dam sel byung na min pa/ dge sbyor mi skye ba'i dbang med pa yin/ khyed 'di ru 'ong dus su bla ma'i bka' e yod gsungs pas/ bla ma'i gsung med/ jo mo'i gsung yod zhus pas/ e āe des na mi 'ong bar 'dug /'o skol gnyis kyis khrid bsgoms pa yang stong las yin/ da bla ma mar pa'i sku mkhar yang tshar zer/ sku mkhar gyi dga' ston byed pa la/ slob ma rnams la khral brgyab nas yod zer/ nged rang la lug tsher mo brgya dang*/ snam 'phrug brgya dang*/ nas ya brgya/ mar thud la sogs pa khyer la shog zer bas/ nged rang gnyis ka 'gro dgos gsungs pa la/ nga la 'bul ba med pas ngo tsha zhus pas/ khyed la 'bul ba chen po mi re phyag rgyu dum pa cig ngas sbyin gsungs/ zangs dkar lung bzhi ma chung chung zhig gnang ba de khyer nas dpon slob gnyis 'bul ba mang po ded nas byon pas yar la nye ba dang*/ mthu chen sdon du btang nas/ jo mo bdag med ma dang mjal bas mnyes mnyes mdzad/ gzhan 'bul ba rnams 'ong ba bas khyod rang byung ba dga'/ da khyod rang bla ma'i drung du song la zhu ba gyis/ rngog 'byon zhing yod na mi che bas 'o skol gyi bsu ba dgos yong gsungs pas/ drung du song nas phyag phul tsa/

bla ma'i zhal yar gyu nas song bas/ bla ma lags nga la bka' bkyon mdzad kyang bla ma rngog gis 'bul ba mang po rta phyugs mang po ded nas yod pas bsu ba zhig e ma dgos lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ngas rgya gar nas tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag rgyud sde gdan drangs 'ong ba'i dus su/ bsu ba mi dgos khyi gcig kyang ma byung*/ da rngog gis dud 'gro ded nas 'ongs pa bsu ba dgos na phyir ded la song gsungs pas/ jo mo la dris pas/ slob dpon thug gtum pa yin/ rngog la bsu ba dgos zer nas jo mos bsu ba mdzad nas/ bla mas rngog dang bu chen rnams byon pa'i sna len la/ gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs mchod pa dpag tu med pa bshams nas bzhugs te/ rngog dang*/ mes dang*/ dol dang*/ mi la la sogs pa'i bu chen rnams dang*/ slob ma thams cad bsdus nas tshogs 'khor rgya chen po mdzad de bla ma mar pa'i drung nas rngog la nga yi bu mthu chen khyod can du song ba la gdams ngag e byin gsungs pas/ te lo nā ro'i dbu skra phyag phreng na bza' tsho bskur byung bas byin lags zhus pas/ der yum gyi zhal nas/ ngas bskur ba yin lags zhus pas/ jo mo la ber ma lcag gis brgyab ste/ yum bros nas song*/ nga bla ma la 'di tshos rkun ma byas zin gsungs pas/ jo mo spyan chab shor te/ der cung zad cig dgongs pa la bzhugs te/ bdag med ma la yar shog gyis gsung*// der yum la nang mchod gyis ka pa la de yar thegs gsung*/ de nas mi la mthu chen 'di 'thung gsung*/ mi las lhag ma ma lus par gsol/ ngas khyod la 'bar yin las bcol brdungs btang byas pas/ logs lta ma skyes pa de bu khyod snang ba dag pa yin/ khyod bud med gyis rigs 'di blo chung*/ nga bu 'di la yid chad thang dgu theng na bod 'dir 'ja' lus thob pa mang du 'byung zhing khyod rang yang phung po lhag ma med pa la sangs rgyas pa yin gsung*/ de nas byin pas gzim pa dang*/

bla ma yab yum gnyis/ rngog dang mi la bzhi min pa med pa la/ jo mo la phud cig tshogs la khyer la shog gsungs te/ dbang zab mo'i brda bzhi dang*/ gdams ngag gtum mo'i ngo sprod dang*/ rgyud sde zab mo'i bka' lung thams cad gnang nas/ mi las yang*/ bla ma gnyis ka la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kha zhe med par skyes so// phyi nang ston mo chen po'i dga' ston mdzad de/ de'i tshogs gral du mar pas mgur 'di skad gsungs te/ na mo bla ma bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// nga yi brgyud pa rin chen la// nyes ltung med pa'i bkra shis shog /gdams ngag zab mo'i nye lam la// nor 'khrul med pa'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /nga rang mar pa lo tsā la// zab mo gnad kyi bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la// byin brlabs dngos grub kyi bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /bu chen slob ma 'khor tshogs la// dad pa dam tshig gi bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /yon bdag yul mi nye ring la// mthun rkyen 'tshogs pa'i bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /las dang bya ba thams cad la// rogs ldan byang chub kyi bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la/ chad tho btsan po'i bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /'dir tshogs khrom gyi lha mi la/ bde skyid smon lam gyi bkra shis yod// bkra shis des kyang bkra shis shog /ces gsungs so// de nas rngog la bsnyen bkur gnang ste gra pa mang po la bshad dgos pas song gsung*/ rngog kyang nyams dga' nas en cig sdod dgos snyam nas bzhugs ma bcug par 'gyogs su btang*/ sang phod nga yis jo sras mdo sde 'di 'tshams don pa'i dus su thams cad tshogs pa yin gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ mi la khyod 'gro'am sdod gsung*/

mi las nga len cig khong bskyel du 'gro zhus pas/ 'o na khong skyel la song la/ rngog la ma zer bar pha ki gzhung du phyin tsa ma bsdod la shogs gsung*/ de nas mi las rngog skyel skyal ba la/ phar lam rngog gis yon bdag slob ris rnams gyis sna len byas yin song ba dang*/ gzhir phyin nas slob ris yon bdag thams cad kyi sna len la yengs nas zla ba cig thog /de nas mi las bla ma rngog la/ nga bla ma lho brag pa'i drung du lan cig 'gro zhus pa la/ bla ma dang jo mo gnyis kyis da 'dir dang skyid pa bya/ khyod bsgom pas chog /nged kyi zhabs tog la 'bad/ nged kyis bstan pa la yang phan gsung pa la/ nga len cig 'gro bar zhu zhus pas/ bla ma dang jo mo gnyis kyis zhal nas/ len cig song la yang 'dir shes gsung*/ der mi la shad kyi song ba la/ lho brag du bla ma'i drung du phyin pa dang phyag 'tshal/ bla mas mi la khyod phyin nam gsung nas dri rmed thams cad byas/ jo mo yang shin tu brnyes ste khong la bsnyen bkur byas/ de nas phyir nang bla ma'i zhal nas jo mo la/ khyod rang mi la'i mchod pa bzang po cig grab gyis dang*/ mi la'i chos cig zhags dgu bya dgos/ de'i tshe slob ma thams cad la bla mas rmi lam ngan pas zhags 'ga' rmis bsgyur chos spyod cig byed pas/ su la'ang ma yong gyis la ma sten/ khyod kyis kyang nged gnyis la bza' ba bug pa nang na yar byin/ nged gnyis 'tshams cig gcod pa yin/ jo mos kyang de ltar byas nas sha chang la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyis grab byas nas mchod pa bshams te nub dang po sa chog gnyis pa sta gon/ gsum pa dngos gzhi/ bzhi pa la btang rag byas nas dbang dang byin rlabs gnyis sprug mdzad/ de'i phyi de nub mo gtang rag gi mchod pa chen po bshams nas tshogs thon pa'i tho rang khar/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i nang gis lha tshogs dang*/ phyi zhing skyong gis ḍākki ma sum cu so gnyis dang*/

rigs ma'i lha mo bcu drug /mchod pa'i lha mo thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa skad cig yud tsam la zhal gzigs/ de'i dus su bla ma dang ḍakki mas rjes su gnang ba'i mtshan bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya'o// bu de de yin/ de de nyid min/ nga la 'di 'dra'i gdams ngag yod/ mkha' 'gro ma dang bla ma te lo pa dang na ro pa dang nga la yang cig rgyud yin/ 'di mdo sde la sbyin snyam/ mdo sde khyod gnyis snod ldan du 'dug /khyed gnyis kyang gnam sa 'dren du ma btub/ mkha' 'gro ma thams cad khyod la dga' bar 'dug pas/ da gdams 'di khyod la sbyin dgos/ de nas khyod kyis kyang mdo sde la sogs pa cig la sbyin/ snod dang mi ldan pa su thod thod la ma sbyin gsung nas bka' rgya dam par mdzad/ de nas snyan rgyud tshe rim par khrigs kyis bshad nas tshar bar byas/ gzhan yang rgyud 'grel man ngag du ma dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mdzad/ khyad par du ye shes kyi ḍakki'i thugs nas phyung pa'i gdam pa chos drug bsre 'pho'i man ngag zhib rgyas su gnang*/ gzhan yang thabs lam gyi gdam ngag mang po byin nas thams cad rdzogs par byas nas te lo pa la ye shes kyi ḍakkis bla ma na ro pa chen po lung bstan/ dpal na ro pa la te lo pa chen pos kho bo lung bstan pa yin/ kho bo la yang dpal na ro pa chen pos gdul bya snod dang ldan pa khyod lung bstan pa yin zhes gsungs/ de'i tshe mi las 'o na rje btsun chen pos bdag drung du sleb pa'i tshe gces par rkyang par ma mdzad/ yun du chos kyang ma gnang phru byed pa dang*/ gnag lug skyong ba dang sku mkhar dgu thogs rtsegs pa la sogs pa 'di dag ci la dgongs pa lags zhus pas/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ yang deng sang gis dus lta bu yin na ci ltar byas kyang btub de/ phyi rab kyis dus su slob ma ngan pas/ bla ma gnad la 'bebs pa'i dus 'ong ste de lta bu dgags pa'i phyir kho bos khyod la de ltar bstan pa yin no// bu khyod kyang tshogs gnyis rdzogs sgrib gnyis byang ba'i las can gyi skyes bu yin cing gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang khyod kho na la dga' nas tshogs par 'dug ste nga yis bka' zur cig bcag pa'i nyes pa rgyud pa la 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/

de ji ltar lags zhus kyang*/ bu khyod kyi mkhar dgu thogs rtsegs pa de'i bar ma bzhag par tshar bar byas nas khyod rang dang rtogs pa yon tan mnyam pa'i rgyud pa dgu'i bar byin gyi rlabs par 'dug pa la/ da rgyud pa bdun khyod rang dang mnyam pa 'ong rgyud pa gnyis kyis bar du spyod pa rtsing pa 'ga' re 'byung gsung*/ 'o na bdag gi bho khur nas rtsigs nas 'ong lags sam zhus pas/ mi 'ongs te khyod kyi las dad can du mthong ba dang*/ rten 'brel gyi 'grigs tshul dang sems can so so'i las yin gsung*/ de nas bla ma'i phyag mi la'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ dad ldan mos gus ldan pa la// 'od gsal ba ni rgyun chad med// bar do'i grong khyer de mi mthong*// na gnyis mkhyen pa du mar 'char// thegs pa'i mthar thugs snying po'i don// mtha' bral yid la mi byed pa// 'od gsal rgyun chad med bsgom// bar do'i snang ba de la med// gzhan don gzugs sku sna tshogs 'char// zhes gsungs ste/ tshe cig la mchog gis dngos grub thob par lung bstan pa'o// yang skabs cig du rngog gis snyan dril yid bzhin nor bu zhu zhus pas/ nga la snyan ril zhu na 'bul ba dgos gsungs pas/ 'bul ba nor lug thams cad ded nas phul ba la 'bul ba chung gsungs pa la/ bla ma lags nga'i zhol mo rgan mo de ni nor thams cad kyi phyi mo yin pas ma thon lags zhus pas/ 'o na nga yi snyan dril yang chos thams cad kyi phyi mo yin pas theb cig la ma the ga gsungs pas/ zhol mo thag ring byas nas 'ong ste 'ong pa rang gi chog /nga la zhol mo 'dis byed rgyu med de chos kyi che ba med na chos shi ba yin pas go bar mdzod/ lar nga yi gdams ngag 'di rnams 'jig rten blos btang ba'i mi las 'bul ba len du mi rung*/ sgom nus na 'bul ba thams cad zhor la 'ong ba yin/ tshe 'di'i mig brid pa'i skye bo la bstan mi rung*/ khyed rngog lta bu re re la ni bskal pa du mar tshogs bsags pa'i las ldan yin pas gzhan la de bzhin mi btub gsungs te/

snyan nas snyan dril bton nas gnang ste mnyes par mdzad do// mi las mi'i 'bul ba che lugs kyi nga yi zangs 'di phul yang e mnyes bsam ste/ zangs de phul bas shin tu mnyes nas sba ber gyis zangs de la brgyab pas phyi nang med par gzigs so// bzang bzang 'bul ba 'di rang bzang*/ zangs 'di che rgyu med pas rang la mnog /lung bzhi yod pas phyogs bzhir khyab// skad bzang bas snyan pa che// phyi dregs pa med pas dam tshig gtsang*// nang 'di dmar bas mkha' 'gro 'du// rgyu bzang bas brgyud pa je bzang je bzang 'gro/ da res khyed kyis nga la phul dus der nas 'bru gsum nang du ma btab pas chos brgyags dkon mo 'ong ste/ ltogs grir byung yang mi 'chi gsungs/ 'o na nas kyi 'gengs nas 'bul zhus pas/ da phan gnod med/ lar jo mo khyed gnyis sems chung bas nga yi mkhar brtsigs pa la gnyug thung min pa sla ste/ da chos la snying rus shig dgos te sla nas 'ong gsungs/ de nas yang lan gcig gis tshe nub cig bdag med ma'i zab dbang mdzad pa'i tho rangs kha cig /bla chen rnams ci mdzad gzigs/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon pos 'od gsal bsgom yin 'dug pas/ bdag la 'od gsal bum nang gi mar me 'dra ba cig yod pa de 'di yis khyer bar 'dug dgongs so// dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge des/ 'pho ba bsgom pa yin 'dug pas/ bdag la 'pho ba skar khung du mda' 'phang ba dang 'dra ba cig yod pa 'dis khyer bar 'dug go dgongs so// gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor gyi dpe la gzigs kyin 'dug pas/ bdag la bshad rgyud chu bo'i gzhung dang 'dra ba cig yod pa de 'dis khyer bar 'dug dgongs/ mi la la gzigs pas rlung 'dzin gyin 'dug pas/ bdag la gtum mo sdong skam la me sbar ba 'dra ba cig yod pa 'dis khyer bar 'dug dgongs te/ grub thob cig 'di la 'ong bar 'dug dgongs so// der mes ston chen po dang*/

tshur ston dbang nge dang*/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor dang*/ gur thang gi mi la ras pa dang bu chen bzhi yin pa la/ gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gdams ngag dang*/ dbang bskur zab mo mdzad de/ nam stod la dbang mdzad/ nam smad la sgom mdzad/ snga dro chos bshad/ dgong mo bsgom mdzad cing bzhugs pa la/ rje btsun gyis bla ma'i drung du

sras dar ma mdo sde gshegs pa'i dus mchod kyi nub mo zhus zer 'dug / bzhugs nas zhus pas/ bla ma chen po lags sras 'gran zla dang bral ba de gdul bya rnam kyi bsod nams la ma shong*/ da chos rgyud gang gis 'dzin gang dang gang du ji ltar gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ bu khyod rang rmi lam rtogs dang gsal bar 'ong gis gsung*/ der rje mi la'i rmi lam du/ phyogs bzhir ka ba chen por bzhi btsugs de rnams kyi steng du seng ge mchong ba dang*/ stag mo ngar ba dang*/ khyung chen 'phur ba dang rgod po lding ba rnams byung ste rnal sad pa dang*/ bla ma chen po la phyag 'tshal nas maṇḍal phul ste rmi lam brda mthong gis zhu don 'di phul lo// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyi ma shar du ka chen cig btsugs pa rmis// ka thog du seng chen 'gying ba rmis// g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis// gangs dkar stod du 'phyo ba rmis// shar rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// rje rin po che la zhu ba lags/ nyi ma lho ru ka chen btsugs pa rmis// ka thog du stag mo ngar ba rmis// stag gra 'dzum mtha' nas rgyas pa rmis// khong 'dzum len gsum byas pa rmis// thang shing rgyud du sbrel ba rmis// nags ma'i gseb du 'phyo ba rmis/ lhor rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// rje rin po che la zhu ba lags// nyi ma nub du ka chen btsugs pa rmis// ka thog du khyung chen lding ba rmis// rtse sgro gra ru rgyas pa rmis// bya spu gnam du gzing ba rmis// bya mig gyen la blta ba rmis// nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur ba rmis// nub rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// rje rin po che la zhu ba lags// nyi ma byang du ka chen btsugs pa rmis// ka thog du rgod po lding ba rmis// rgod tshang brag la bcas pa rmis// bya phran gyis nam mkha' gang ba rmis// rgod de la bu cig skyes pa rmis// rgod nam mkha'i dbyings su phur ba rmis// byang rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// rje rin po che la zhu ba lags// zhes zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas bu slob thams cad bos cig gsung ste/ thams cad 'dus pa'i tshe mdangs mi la ras pa'i rmi lam la ka ba chen po bzhi btsugs pa rmis zer/ der kho bos bshad gyis nyon cig ces ka bzhi ngo sprod gyis mgur 'di bzhengs pa/ ༈ nyi ma shar du ka chen btsugs pa de// dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge yin// ka thog tu seng ge 'gying ba de// khong mi gzhi seng dang 'dra ba yin// g.yu ral mtha' nas rgyas pa de// snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa thebs pa yin// gangs dkar stongs su mchongs pa de// thar pa'i lam du gshegs pa yin// rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// nyi ma lho ru ka chen btsugs pa de/ gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor yin/ ka thog tu stag mo ngar ba de// khong mi gzhi stag dang 'dra ba yin// gra 'dzum mtha' nas rgyas pa de// snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa thebs pa yin/ khong 'dzum lan gsum byas pa de// bshad rgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin/ stag nags ma'i gseb tu 'phyo ba de// tshe gcig gis grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags// thang shing gi rgyud du sbrel ba de// bu tsha bos kyang brgyud pa zin pa yin// nags ma'i gseb tu 'phyo ba de// thar pa'i zhing du gshegs pa yin// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// nyi ma nub tu ka chen btsugs pa de// gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po yin// ka thog na khyung chen lding ba de/ khong mi gzhi khyung dang 'dra ba yin// rtse sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa de/ snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa the bas pa yin// spyan mig gyen du gzigs pa de// 'khor ba la phyi phyag 'tshal ba yin/ nam mkha'i mthongs su 'phur ba de// thar pa'i lam sna zin pa yin// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*/ nyi ma byang du ka che btsugs pa de// khyod gung thang gis mi la ras pa yin// ka thog tu rgod po lding ba de// khyod mi gzhi rgod dang 'dra pa yin// rgod rtse sgro mtha' nas rgyas pa de/

snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa thebs pa yin// rgod tshang brag la bcas pa de// tshe srog brag bas sra ba yin// bya phran gyis nam mkha' khengs pa de// bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa dar ba yin/ rgod de las bu gcig skyes pa de// 'gran gyi do med cig 'ong ba yin// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// nga mi rgan kha la bltas yod na/ chos bsgrub rgyud bstan pa dar te mchis// zhes gsungs te/ kho bos jo bo nā ro pa chen pos lung bstan ji lta ba bzhin du dar ma mdo sde ni med/ da khyed rnams 'gro don 'phel zhing bstan pa dar bar 'ong ste/ khyed rang tsho tshogs 'khor zhig gyis/ ngas chos kyi phas phog bya'o gsungs/ der thams cad kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo bshams shing gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas gzhung gi rngog ston chos rdor la 'pho ba rgya mthong kha phyes pa lta bu'i gdams ngag gnang*/ 'gro don skyongs shig gsungs/ dol gyi mtshur ston dbang nge la bshad rgyud mu tig ltar la brgyus pa lta bu'i gdams ngag gnang*/ grwa slob skyongs shig gsungs/ gtsang rong gi mes ston tshon po la 'od gsal mun nang du sgron me btegs pa lta bu'i gdams ngag gnang*/ bar do chod cig gsungs/ rje btsun chen po'i thugs kar phyag 'khar gtad de gtum mo shing gshags la me sbar ba lta bu'i gdams ngag gnang*/ gangs khrod 'grims shig gsungs/ da mi la nged gnyis mtshams la sdod gsungs nas sku mtshams mdzad par/ de nas mi la ma 'gol bar/ jo mo la phud tshogs 'khor zhig shoms gsungs nas/ snyan brgyud brda yi dbang bzhi dang*/ gtum mo gnad kyi gdams ngag srog rtsol/ bsre 'pho snyan brgyud kyi man ngag rigs lnga dmar khrid la sogs pa rnams legs par ngo sprad de gnang*/ gzhan rnams la gdams pa sna re las ma byin/ khyod la bum pa gang byo'i tshul du byin yod pas nyams su longs shig gsungs nas sba sri dang*/ kha zhe med par gnang nas mgur 'di gsungs song*/

na mo/ bla ma bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// bsam pa'i gdams ngag de ka nyid// mang po thos 'dod g.yeng ba'i rgyu// gnad kyi gdams ngag sems la 'chang*// de de mang yang 'di nyid med// sdong po mang yang 'bras bu med// yon tan mang yang don ston med// de snga bslab kyang 'di mthong med// bshad rgyu mang yang phan pa med// phan snying la thog pa dam pa'i chos// nor phyug po 'dod na 'di la dril// chos nyon mongs 'dul ba thabs kyi lam// lam btsan sa zin pa 'di la dril// sems kho thag chod pa chog shes kyi dpon/ dpon bzang po 'dod na 'di la dril// 'khor ba la ngu bro'i sgyid lug skyur// mi med kyi rdza brag pha mi mkhar/ grogs yod gcig pu lha yi lus// sems la sems bzhon chad med kyi rta// rang lus dgon pa lha yi khang*// yeng med kyi dge sbyor sman gyi mchog /don dang ldan pa'i skyes bu la// don la thogs med kyi gdams ngag byin// nga dang gdams ngag khyed dag gsum/ ma rul ma zad ma skam par// bu yi lag tu bzhag pa 'dis// 'bras bu lo 'dab rgyas par shog /ces gsungs te/ nga yi gdams ngag 'di jo sras mdo sde 'dra ba re re min pa sbyin mi rung bas/ gang yin la ma sbyin cig gsungs nas bka' rgyas btab bo// nyams dang rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa skyes/ da bdag gis bla ma sku drin can yab yum la nor rdzas yo byad dang*/ dngos po'i zhabs tog ni bdag la med/ dben pa'i gnas shig tu sgrub pa'i zhabs tog gis mnyes par bya dgos snyam du dgongs shing yod pa la/ nub cig gi rmi lam na/ ḍā ki ma bu med kyi cha byad du byas pa cig gi zhal nas lho shal gyi phyogs su song zhig dang*/ ḍā ki'i byin rlabs 'jug cing 'grub thag nye bar 'ong ngo*// zhes ras dkar po zhig nam mkha' la dpyangs pa rmis/ yang de'i rjes su mnal thun cig la/ 'khrungs yul du phebs/ yum 'das/

khang pa zhig /sring mo 'khyams pa zhig rmis nas mang po bshums pas dbu sngas spyan chab kyis dgang*/ mnal sad pa dang skyo ba bzod blag med pa byung*/ der nam langs nas mtshams sgo phyes bla ma'i drung du byon tsa na/ bla ma mnal du bzhugs 'dug pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas zhu don glu ru blangs la// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang lan gcig yul du gtong bar zhu// yul ngan rtswa yi ko ron du/ nye ba dgrar langs kyi ma smad gsum// so sor gyes nas lo 'ga' song*// sprang lan gcig yul du gtong bar zhu// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma mnal sad pa dang*/ gzim khang du nyi ma shar ba dang*/ yum gyis bzhes pa 'dren du byon pa rnams 'dzom ste/ bu khyod mtshams dam por yod pa har 'don byed pa'i lugs med/ sgo nga ma'i drod la skye ba yin yul du 'gro long yod/ sgrub pa gyis lar khyod la phreng ba yul na med/ mtshams har 'don byed pa ci yin/ da rung khyod zhag kha yar cig la ma 'gro dang*/ ngas rten 'brel zab mo bsgrigs rgyu yod gsungs te/ de nas nyin gcig bla ma'i drung nas da khyod 'gro na yang song la sgoms/ yang rgya gar du lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu yod pa las bzhi ngas blangs pa yin/ lnga da rung yod pas nā ro'i bu brgyud cig song na lon par yod pas/ khyod 'gro nus na sems can la phan pas song sgrub pa nus na bla ma'i zhabs tog dang*/ pha ma'i zhabs drin len/ sems can gyi 'gro don thams cad dus gcig la 'grub pa yin/ sgrub pa ma nus na tshe ring por bsdad kyang dgos pa med/ tshe ngan ring dang las ngan mang la ma song bar rem/ yang dang yang du nga dran pa gyis shing 'bungs/ ngas kyang khyod yang dang yang du dran pa byed/ dran res ma 'dzol ba'i thabs med pa yin gsungs pa rnams kyis sems la phan te snying la gcag /sha la brad pa cig byung bas phyis sgrub pa snying rus byed dus kyang gsung re re dran zhing bsgom shed je che je cher song skad do// de nas ma la 'gro zer bas bdag med mas mi rtag pa'i nyams mang po mdzad de/

mthu chen la 'di skad ces gsungs so// khyod snying rus can gyi sdug sran can// phyi thag ring zhing ngang ring po// skal pa can gyi bu khyod kyis// bla ma'i bdud rtsi ye shes 'chang*// ngom par 'thung la bzhud par zhu// pha dang ma gnyis ma brjed par// gsol ba yang yang 'o dod bos// snying la phan pa'i gdams ngag la/ 'drongs par zo la bzhud par zhu// drin dang phan pa ma brjed par/ bka' drin soms shing snying rus mdzod// mkha' 'gro'i khas blangs zab mo'i chos// dro bar gyon la bzhud par zhu// ma nus sems can ma brjed par// rang sems byang chub lam la tshud// skal pa bzang po bdag med mas// bu la snying gtam bskul bskul bas/ bus kyang ma brjed snying la bzung*// mas kyang yi dam mgon du skyob// sems yid mthun pa'i ma bu gnyis// o rgyan yul du mjal bar shog /drin len chos kyis 'khor bar shog /ces gsungs pas/ mi las dga' ste ngas da rung chos shig mi byed de e ko bsam pa byung ngo*// de nas bla ma dang jo mos thugs la btags shing gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs pas/ da nga yar la 'gro zhus pas/ gtsang yar 'gro'i mgur 'di phul ba yin no// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang lan gcig yul du 'gro bar zhu// a ma lus kyi sgrom bu de// dus da lta zhig gam ma zhig lta// sring mo pe ta dpal 'dren de// dus da lta shi'am ma shi lta// khyim mtshes a khu g.yang dpal de// dus da lta shi'am ma shi lta// a ne khyung bza'i dpal 'dren de// dus da lta skyid dam mi skyid lta// khang pa ka bzhi gdung brgyad de// dus da lta 'gyel lam mi 'gyel lta// btsan mkhar zur bzhi logs brgyad de// dus da lta zhig gam ma zhig lta// gshong zhing 'ol mo gru gsum la// 'jag skya 'phyur ram ma 'phyur lta// dam chos glegs bam brgyad pa de// dus da lta bzhugs sam mi bzhugs lta// bla chos dkor gnyer lha 'bum de// dus da lta sku khams e bzang lta// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang lan gcig yul du 'gro ba la// skyel ma dang bsu ma thams cad mdzod// bar chad rkyen ngan gyis bzlog par mdzod// lus ngag dang bsam pa'i srung ma mdzod// smon lam dang thugs khur gyi rten 'brel mdzod// thugs rje dang nus pa'i dbang bskur mdzod// rgyud lung dang man ngag gis rgyab brten mdzod// tshe ring dang nad med kyi bkra shis mdzod// sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang shes/

ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhus pas/ 'o mthu chen yid gnyis dang the tshom mi dgos/ khyed la yang ngas shes/ nga la yang khyed shes/ chos nus na yang gang nas dga' dang 'di nas dga' med par dga'/ khyod la yang gang nas skyid dang 'di nas skyid med par skyid/ rem cig rem cig gsungs te mgur 'di gsungs so// ༈ rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// las bya ba chos dang mthun pa'i bu// lus sprul sku sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ngag rdo rje'i bzlas pa bdud rtsi'i ros// rten 'brel longs sku 'grub par shog /sems rtsa ba byang chub sdong po la// chos sku'i lo 'dab rgyas par shog /bla ma'i bka' tshig rdo rje'i gsung*/ snying la brjed med gnas par shog /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs de// srog gi rtsa bar gnas par shog /chos skyong srung ma'i rgyab brten de// 'bral ba med par skyong bar shog /rten 'brel zab mo'i smon lam de/ myur ba nyid du 'grub par shog /chos mdzad kun gyi thugs rje de// dus rnams kun tu 'dzin par shog /khyod gtsang sil ma la yi la thog tu// bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi bsu ma yod// sang nyin 'gro ba'i lam ka na/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gros skyel ma yod// pha yul zhen pa'i 'khor zhing na// mi rtag sgyu ma'i dam chos yod// a ne sring mo'i nye 'khor la// sgyu ma zhig pa'i gdams ngag yod// mi med lung pa'i brag phug na/ 'khor 'das rje ba'i tshong 'dus yod// snying rus lus kyi dgon pa na// lha bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mchod khang yod// na med zwa yi tshogs 'khor la// mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i bdud rtsi yod// 'khrul 'khor gnad kyi kha bsgyur la/ 'bras rin chen skye ba'i so nam yod// yul mi rtsis chung ba'i rang yul de// 'phral g.yeng ba med pa'i dge sbyor yod// mtshams dam po mi med khyi med na// rtags myur du thon pa'i sgron me yod// zas dkor zas med pa'i rang zas la// bde ba lha yi pha 'bab yod// grib dwangs pa lha yi gzhal yas na// rang don chen 'grub pa'i ltad mo yod// ngos lkog med pa'i lha chos la// dam tshig gtsang ba'i 'phrin las yod// bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i so nam la// dngos grub kun gyi gter kha yod// dam chos mkha' 'gro'i srog snying la// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi gyes so yod// mar pa lo tsā'i bu brgyud la// gtam snyan mang po'i 'ong sgo yod// mi la ras pa'i snying rus la// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing yod// ces gsungs te/

da kun 'gro na yang ngas yar skyel gsungs nas/ lam chas gang 'dod pa'i dro brgyags sprad de/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu khyod song yang a ma dang ni mi 'phrad par 'dug /'gro na btang bas chog gis/ khyod nang du 'ong ba dang nga gnyid du song ba 'phrad pas nged rang pha bu gnyis phyis mi 'phrad par 'dug /'on kyang mkha' la nyi ma shar ba de/ bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa de zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin khyod kyis dar bar byed 'dug /yum bzhes pa 'dren du byung ba dang 'dzoms pas/ bu khyod la phyis bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho ba zhig 'ong bar 'dug /lar kho bos rgya gar nas dka' las byas pa'i chos ma lus pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du byin zin/ chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu tsam du ngo sprad yod pas bu khyod de ltar shes par gyis/ yul du yang zhag bdun las lhag par ma sdod/ rtsa rlung thabs lam gyi gdams ngag rnams bka' rgyas thob la mang po la ma spel/ gnas g.ya' khrod dang gangs khrod kho na 'grim/ skabs lan gcig rtsa rlung gi gegs cung zad 'ong bar 'dug /de'i dus su shog dril 'di shig la ltos/ de tshun la ma lta// zhes phyag dpe rgyas btab pa cig gnang gtsang sil ma la 'jigs pa chen po yin/ grogs bzang po dang 'grogs la song gsungs/ yang rje btsun gyis zhu don mgur du bzhengs pa/ gtsang sil ma la yi la rtsa la// bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi bsu ma yod// rje byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs// rgyab brten dkon mchog gsum la 'tshal// gnas gsum mkha' 'gros skyel ma yod// grogs byang chub sems dang 'grogs nas 'gro// bsu ma lha srin sde brgyad yod// sdang ba dgra yi 'jigs dang bral// rje mi bskyod ngo bo thugs rje can// sprang lan gcig yul du 'gro ba lags// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas bdag med ma la mchod pa bzang po dang tshogs 'khor shoms gsungs/ mchod pa bshams/ jo mo la yang nyams 'phar ba dang*/

spyan chab mang po byung*/ bla mas kyang sku yi sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan/ lo tsā ba chen po'i zhal nas bu khyod kyi dam chos byed snyam na/ nga yi shes tshad khyod la sprugs// ngas nor phyir dam chos ga la gtong*// tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i mi// rmi lam du yang ga la rnyed// bu khyod nor med dam chos 'tshol// 'tshol sa ma nor nga la 'phrad// ngas snying gtam dril nas bshad gyur na// nā ro me tri'i gdams ngag 'di// gzhan la phan phyir dka' ba spyad/ rang gi don dang nor phyir du// dam chos blangs nas nga la sdig /bu snying nas nga la nyon dang lo// snying nas dam chos long na ni// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel dang lo// 'jig rten blo yis thong dang lo// snying nas dam chos byed gyur na// rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya mi 'tshal gyi// gdams ngag dang du long la sgoms// bu 'jig rten blo yis ma thong bar// 'di yi bya ba dam pa'i chos// bsres na chos de shor ba yin// bu yis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal som// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin 'di rang zhes// bdag gis lce brgyar rab sprul nas// bskal ba bye ba bsam yas su// bshad kyang brjod kyis mi long bas// ngas bshad dam chos chud ma gsan// zhes gsungs nas phyag spyi bor bzhag /bu de shin tu dge bar gyur cig /ces gsungs nas shis pa mang du brjod/ de nas rje lo tsā'i drung*/ mi las lam khyer drug gi mgur bzhengs pa/ 'gro na snang ba lam du 'khyer// tshogs drug rang grol gyi 'gro lugs yin// sdod na ma bcos rnal mar sdod// nyams snying po don gyi sdod lugs yin// nyal na mnyam nyid ngang du nyal// dus gsum mnyam bzhag gi nyal lugs yin// za na stong nyid kyi ngang du za// gzung 'dzin gnyis med kyi za lugs yin// 'thung na ye shes kyi chab la 'thung*// nyams rgyun chad med pa'i skyong lugs yin// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug sems la lta// mthun mtshams med pa'i dge sbyor yin// zhes pa'i mgur 'di mdzad do// de nas sems dpa' gting nge song ste/

ngas snying rus shig nus na dogs pa med par 'dug snyam pa'i snang ba mtho ling nge ba cig rgyun du byung ngo*// de nas bla ma mar pa dang rngog gnyis la sangs rgyas kyis 'du shes skyes pa'i dad pa brtan po thob cing*/ bla ma yab yum sku 'khor sum cu tsam gyis snga dro zhig gi bar skyel ma mdzad de/ yid 'phreng ba'i skyo shas/ ngag 'phreng ba'i snying gtam/ lus 'phreng ba'i snying gtam mang du mdzad cing*/ bla ma'i zhabs la 'jus te smon lam bzang po btab/ bla mas kyang phyag mdzub snying dkar gtad nas smon lam mang po gsungs te/ dpon slob gnyis 'bral mi phod pa'i gdung dbyangs mang po mdzad nas/ sa phag ma bud kyi bar du yid 'phreng ba'i phyi mig mang po yang dang yang du bltas tsa/ bla ma dpon slob rnams lho brag gangs dkar gyi la khar da rung smug spungs se 'dug pas yid la bcad rdo chen po yod pa yin pas des log chis byas so// phyi mig mang po yang dang yang du bltas pas/ mar pa'i zhal nas/ khos phyi mig yang yang bltas pa de nga la 'phreng nas log tshad de/ snying la rus pa cig yod do gsungs so// rje btsun gyi thugs la yang las ci la thug kyang chos byed bsam pa'i nges shes dang ma bral bar bla ma yid la spring nge ba cig byung bas skyo ting nge ba zhig la yul du byon no// bla ma mar pa yar la byon te nga yi bu des chos gsha' ma zhig nus par 'dug gsungs so// de yan chad thams cad dka' spyad snying rus kyi skor te lnga las gong ma'i skor ro// ༈ de nas ting nge 'dzin dang 'brel pa'i yon tan bco brgyad de/ 'khor ba la snying po med par rtogs pa'i yon tan dang*/ rmi lam brdar shar ba'i yon tan dang*/ bde drod ngo 'phrod pa'i yon tan dang*/ zas gos kyi 'dun pa dang bral ba'i yon tan dang*/ nyams myong bde bar shar ba'i yon tan dang*/ rtogs pa lam du shar ba'i yon tan dang*/ snang ba mthun rkyen du shar ba'i yon tan dang*/

chos brgyad rang grol du shar ba'i yon tan dang*/ rtsod pas mi brdzi pa'i yon tan dang*/ drin len bsab pa'i yon tan dang*/ spyod pa che ba'i yon tan dang*/ lha yi lhar gyur pa'i yon tan dang*/ ye shes sgron me bltams pa'i yon tan dang*/ nus pa che ba'i yon tan dang*/ byin brlabs che ba'i yon tan dang*/ phyag rgya chen po ngo 'phrod pa'i yon tan dang*/ tshe gcig gis zung 'jug rdo rje'i sku 'grub cing 'ja' lus su yal ba'i tshul bstan pa'i yon tan no// de la dang po 'khor ba la snying po med par rtogs pa'i yon tan ni/ rang gi yul du song tsa/ pha yi rus pa la btsa' zhan nas khang pa'i phug tu 'dug /ma yi rus pa khang pa'i sgo them na skya khro le 'dug /sring mo sprang du song*/ yul thams cad 'dre yod zer nas dri za'i grong khyer du song*/ zhing thams cad 'jag skya bshud bshud 'dug /tshang mang 'gyel ba'i gyang ral pha ma'i rtsibs khog skya zing nge 'dug /mkhar cig yod pa bong bu'i rna mchog bzhin du song ste/ chos de tsho'i glegs thag glegs shing mis khyer nas shog gu'i bar du rtsa ldum skyes nas 'dug ste/ nyin mo wa spyang 'drog 'u re/ nub mo yi dwags bshi ring nge 'dug pas blo dang snang ba mi bde ba'i ngang la de nub der nyal ba la/ mnal ye ma byung bas/ da de chos cig ma nus na phan pa mi 'dug bsam pa skyes te/ nam smad tho rangs khar snying mi dga' phyod de ba cig la chags ma dbyangs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// kye ma kye ma kyi hud kyi hud ang*// 'khor ba'i chos la blo gtad byas pa rnams// bsam zhing bsam zhing yi mug mang yang ldang*// dpyad cing dpyad cing sdug bsngal gting nas 'khrugs// bskor zhing bskor zhing 'khor ba'i gting du 'phen// 'di 'dra'i snying rlung las kyis zin pa rnams// cug byed cug byed chos las grag pa med// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang pos ri khrod thub par byin gyi rlobs// mi rtag sgyu ma'i grong khyer na// shul ring gi mgron po snying rlung ldang*// yul ya mtshan gung thang snol lung ral// nor lug ba ra'i kha zas rtswa// dus deng sang 'byung pos bdag tu bzung*// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe cig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// tshang mang ka bzhi gdung brgyad de// dus deng sang seng ge'i ya mkhal 'dra// mkhar zur bzhi log brgyad rtse dang dgu// dus deng sang bong bu'i rna mchog 'dra// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe cig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// gshong zhing 'ol mo gru gsum de// dus deng sang 'jag ma'i pha yul red// gnyen nye ba phan du re ba rnams// dus deng sang dgra bo'i dmag dpung red// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe cig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// pha bzang po thos pa se ba de// dus deng sang rus phye spar ba gang*// a ma nyang tsha dkar rgyan de// dus deng sang rus pa'i rtsibs khog cig

/'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// bla mchod dkor gnyer lha 'bum de// dus deng sang mi yi g.yog po red// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// dam chos dkon mchog brtsegs pa de// dus deng sang bya byis tshang stan byas// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red// dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// khyim mtshes a khu g.yang dpal de// dus deng sang sdang ba'i dgra dang bsdongs// sring mo khyung gza' dpal 'dren de// gar song rjes mgo gtad so med// 'di yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe zhig red/ dpe 'dis kyang rnal 'byor chos shig byed// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo sku drin can// sprang po ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gdung dbyangs mang po blangs nas/ chos rnams kyi yig 'bru gsal ba rnams/ slob dpon rnying ma ba yi ge bslab sa zhig yod pa de la phul nas gla'o zhib du dris pas/ tsha ba zhig gnang nas khyed da bar gar song*/ khyed la re ma byung*/ mi mang po bsad nas ma la yang ma phan/ yul mkhar yang ma zin gsung pas/ slob dpon rnying ma ba'i drung du mi rtag pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// kye ma 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// mi rtag mi rtag snying po med// 'gyur zhing 'gyur zhing snying po med// mi nges mi nges snying po med// yul yod bdag med snying po med// bdag yod yul med snying po med// bdag dang yul gnyis 'dzoms rung snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// pha yod bu med snying po med// bu yod pha med snying po med// pha bu gnyis ka 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med/ ma yod pha med snying po med// pha yod ma med snying po med// pha ma gnyis ka 'dzom rung snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// mi yod nor med snying po med// nor yod mi med snying po med// mi nor gnyis ka 'dzom yang snying po med// bde skyid longs spyod 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// ci byas sdug bsngal snying po med// ci bsags mi rtag snying po med// ci sgrub sgyu mar snying po med// thams cad 'dzom yang snying po med// 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// snying po med pa'i rang bzhin la// da ni rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// snying po'i don cig cug bsgrub ang*// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang pos ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// zhes mgur bzhengs nas/

kwa ye shing dang zhing dgos pa yod na 'dir shog ces bos nas/ pha bsags pa can gyi zhing mkhar la// bu stong phod can gyi thos pa dga'// zhen chags rdul tsam mi bdog pas// dgra med gnyen med bshes kyang med// ces gsungs pas/ slob dpon yin na go bcad de yul 'dir mi rnams kyi 'dre bsgrub las 'di byas zer zhing yod/ khyod kyi ma shi nas lo mang po red/ sring mo sprang du song yod/ a ne phu 'di na phu 'brog mda' zhing 'dzom nas yod pas/ der song na brgyags chu la phan pa ster mod gsungs pas/ rje btsun yang skyo phyod de btang ba la/ a ne can du yang song tsa/ a nes yun ring blta ma nyan te/ res shig sbra yi ka ba phab nas khyi bkyes nas brdung du byung nas/ sprang po pha mes kyi bla 'tshong*/ yul phung zer zhing brgyab pas/ rje btsun phyi nud phyi nud byas pas rdo zhig la 'thog nas ko mog cig tu 'gyel ba dang*/ ber ga'i sne mo la 'jus nas mgur 'di gsungs so// yul ngan rtswa ma'i ko ron du// gnyen 'dun dgrar langs kyi ma smad gsum// sran phung ber gas gtor ba bzhin// nga sprang pos mi yul sa mtha' bskor// a ma sdug mtha' shi bas bskor/ nged ma smad gsum las sdug pa med// nga rang pha yi yul la 'ong tsa na// snying rlung gis skyo shas khong nas langs// gnyen 'dun gyi gdung sems ma chod pas// khyod a ne bsnyags nas sprang du 'ongs// tshig ngan gyi brjod pa rgyang nas tshor// blo yid mug gi khong gzer nang nas bslangs// sbra yi ka bas brdung zhing bcom// lus zug rngu'i sdug bsngal na tshas bskol// khrel ngo tsha rib ma dkyil nas bkral// da gdug pa'i ru mig ma 'dzugs dang*// mi bdag gis gla'o tshig gsum lab// ces gsungs pas/ gla'o ci lab rgyu yod/ pha bzang po bu la khyod 'dra ba skyes zer zhing thal ba dang rdo ba mang po ngo la brgyab pas gting nas ma bzod nas mgur 'di gsungs so// a ne ru mi 'dug bdud mor 'dug

/gum par ma shi bdud mor 'dug /gnyan du a ne yod pa yin// sprang po bla 'tshong shog cig zer// khyi tsho tsho zer zhing bkyes nas ded// sbra yi ka bas brdung brdung brgyab// gor mo rdo yi sna len byas// sa rdo gnyis kyi char pa phab// ber ga'i sne mos mnan pa byas// chab ko mog nang du sku khrus gsol// sprang rin chen srog dang des bral byas// ma nus nye ba dgra bor 'dug /gnyom chung gi rogs pa byed pa nyung*// a ne nye ba'i kho thag chod// a ne bu nor bde skyid 'dzoms lags kyang*// 'di yang rtag tu skyong bar mdzod// rje sgra bsgyur gyi mar pa lo tswa ba/ sprang pos ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs nas spyan chab mang po yang shor bas/ a ne yang dum pa cig skyengs nas gla'o 'ga' re zer te/ khyed ma smad kyi mthu byas nas yul phung bas/ nged tshos rten bskyang byas na ngo tsha zhing ngan lab par yod pas len pa yin/ da mthu mi byed na zhing khang thams cad ngas nyo zer bas/ zhing nyo bar byas nas brgyags sprad pa'i don byas pas za ma dum pa cig byin/ da khyod rang chos byed na song zer skad do// de rnams snga ma las gong ma gnyen 'dun gyi skor ro/// /gnyis pa rmi lam brdar shar ba'i yon tan ni/ rag ma nam mkha' rdzong bya ba na bsgom pa la yon tan chen po tsam ma byung ste/ da cung drag na brtsam zhing yod pa'i rmi lam du/ zhing tha ba sra mo zhig 'dug pa rmos tsa/ ye nas ma phed pas/ chu bskyed cing snying rus byas pas/ dum pa phed pa cig rmis/ ngas thabs lam bsgom pa la/ snying rus dang sems bskyed gnyis dgos par 'dug dgongs nas de'i don gsal gdab pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// sprang pos ri khrod zin par byin gyi rlobs// gzhi mnyam pa gnyis med kyi zhing sa la// lam dad pa brtan po'i chu lud sbyar// sems dkar po dri med kyi sa bon 'debs// gsol 'debs drag po'i g.yu 'brug ngar// byin brlab rtsol med kyi char pa 'bab// sems yid gnyis med pa'i rmos khal la// thabs shes rab gnyis kyi rmos gshol btags// 'khrul rtog med pa'i skyes bu yis// yengs ba med par thong cig 'dzin// brtson 'grus drag po'i lcag gis brab// nyon mongs dug lnga'i tha ba slog

/rang rgyud ngan pa'i rdo ba sel// g.yo zol med pa'i yur ma byed// las bden pa drag po'i snye ma la// rnam thar bzang po'i btsas ma byed// dmas ngag zab mo'i 'bras bu yis// stor ba med pa'i bang ba 'gengs// mkha' 'gros rngo btag zan gyis mchog /bdag rnal 'byor bsgrub pa'i 'tsho ba yin// rmi lam rmis pa sad tsa brjed// tshig la don nyid mi skye bas// mtshon pa tsam gyis mi rtogs pas// slad nas bya chub bsgrub pa rnams// dka' thub dang snying rus rtsal bskyed la// dka' bas bsgrub na dkon pa 'grub// pho byang chub kyi skyes bu chos mdzad rnams// sgrub par bar chad med par shog /ces gsungs so// der 'bungs shing bsgoms nas yod tsa na/ nyin gcig a nes nas bre drug dang thul sgog cig khyer nas byung ste khyod kyi zhing rin 'khor/ da nga la bsnyad smyon med pa'i yi ge zhig byin la/ nged tshos mi tshor ba'i yul zhig tu song*/ khyod 'dir sdod pas nged tsho yang ngo tsha/ mis kyang lab par 'dug zer bas skyo ba skyes te mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i bka' drin ri khrod 'grim pa dang*// sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang shes// 'jig rten 'khor ba las kyi dug /'bag na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod// skye bo'i so nam sdig pa'i las// spyad na ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong*// nye ba'i gdung sems bdud kyi mkhar// gces na me 'obs kyi nang du tshud// zas nor gyi gsog 'jog mi yi rgyu// bsags tshad grong pa'i brgyags phye yin// skyid 'dod kyi ja chang btsan dug gis chu// 'thung 'thung yi mug gis mun par 'khrid// a ne'i zhing rin ser sna'i rdzas// zos na yi dwags kyis gnas su skye// a ne'i kha da zhe sdang gi tshig /lab na bdag gzhan gnyis ka phung*// bdag gi zhing khang thams cad de// a ne'i dbang pa'i yi ge 'bri// mi kha chos kyis sang pa yin/ lha kha snying gis bsgrub pa yin// 'dre kha snying rjes gnon pa yin// nye kha rlung la bskur ba yin// rang kha gyen du lta ba yin// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo sku drin can// sprang po'i ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs nas zhing khang a ne la byin/

gnyen nye 'brel gyi kho thag bcad/ sems yid gnyis ltos thag bcad/ yid skyo shas kyi snying rlung langs pas/ da de da de kho de kho de/ ngas cig ngas cig bsam pa yang yang skyes so// brin dang snye nam gyi mtshams brag dkar rta so dbu ma rdzong bya ba cig tu song nas slob dpon rnying ma bas byin pa'i rtsam pa dum gcig dang*/ ngo shes 'ga' la bslang nas dum pa cig byung ba rnams la rtsam pa ya chung gang tsam cig la blo phug gtad nas dam bca' rang gis rang la mang po byas nas/ ngas lus rten 'di'i steng nas sangs rgyas ma thob bar du bdag gis 'jig rten gyi bya ba mi bsgrub bar gyur cig /bdag gi las ngan ma zad bar du sdig pa spyad pa'i mi dang mi 'phrad par gyu cig /dngos grub dam pa ma thob bar du gshin zas dang dad zas sku glud kyi thal ba mi 'gam par gyur cig /bgegs rigs lan chags bar chad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad bdag gis byang bar gyur cig /bla ma sku drin can gyi thugs dgongs rdzogs par gyur cig /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ba byed par gyur cig /'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi khur po mi 'bol bar gyur cig /ces gsungs te/ bdag 'di nas byang chub cig ma thob bar du grong yul du mi 'bab e ko/ gal te babs na chos skyong srung mas chad pa chod cig /gsungs nas bsgoms te nyin cig sprang du 'gro 'dod pa cig byung ba la mgur 'di gsungs so// rdo rje 'chang chen mar pa'i rgyud// sprang pos ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// a mtshar po mi la thos pa dga'// gros rang gtam rang la phan pa'i dbyangs// rog gtam nyan pa'i mi dang bral// ltad mo lta 'dod kyi lung pa stong*// skyo ba sangs 'dod kyi yul rkyen med// sems ma spro ma spro rang sar zhog /spros na don med rnam rtogs dran// ma yengs ma yengs dran pa brtan// yengs na dge sbyor rlung la 'chor// ma 'gro ma 'gro nyal sa gnon// song na gom pa rdo la 'thug

/ma bsing ma bsing mgo bo khug /bsing na lag stong phyal bar 'gro// ma nyal ma nyal dge sbyor mdzod// nyams na bsam med dug lngas gnon// cis kyang bsgom pas ma grol yang*// mi med lung stong du 'chi bar shog /ces gsungs nas bdag 'di nas rtogs pa cig ma skyes bar du grong pa'i g.yeng ba la ma dga' e ko// gal te grong pa'i g.yeng ba la shor ba mkha' 'gro rnams kyis chad pa mthong zhig /ces gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje na ro'i bu rgyud thar pa'i lam// sprang po ri khrod du gnas par byin gyis rlobs// bdud 'jig rten gyi g.yeng bas mi g.yeng bar// sgom mnyam bzhag gi bsam gtan 'phel bar shog /zhi gnas kyi rdzi la ma zhen par// lhag mthong gis me tog 'khrungs par shog /spros bcas kyi rtsab rtsub mi ldang bar// spros med kyi lo 'dab rgyas par shog /sgrub khang du yid gnyis mi skye bar// nyams rtogs kyi 'bras bu smin par shog /bdud kyi bar chad mi 'byung bar// rang sems la nges shes rtogs par shog /thabs lam la the tshom mi skye bar// pha rjes bu yis zin par shog /rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo sku drin can// sprang pos ri khrod non par byin gyi rlobs// zhes gsungs te/ bdag grub pa cig ma thob bar du grong yul du 'babs e ko/ gal te babs na bla ma bka' drin can gyis chad pa thong zhig gsungs nas/ mi babs pa'i dam bcas rnam gsum bsdams te/ da mtshams dam po mi med lung stong du 'chi ba cig e nus bsam pa'i rang yid la byas te 'bungs nas bsgrub pas/ lo gcig ma 'khor bar du bar chad med par brgyags kyis skyol bar byung ba dang*/ spo ri spo mthon nam mkha' rdzong bya ba'i rdzong bzang po zwa mang po yod pa zhig tu spos nas bsgom dgongs pa la/ brgyags phye bre gang yang med pas thugs mug pa cig byung bas/ ngas 'di nas grub pa cig ma thob bar du zwa sngon mo'i 'tsho ba rang bzang bsam pa'i sems la dpa' skon nas bsgoms pa la/

ltogs pa'i snang ba chung ngu song tsa/ lus kyi shed je chung je chung song nas/ lan gcig kun yid mi ches pa byung ste/ sku lus la lta na med par song sngo ba/ hams pa/ rid pa/ 'gyel la khad la pa/ 'chag la khad pa/ nyin gcig mi mang po brag de la sgro 'tshol du 'ong bas kho mthong ste/ mi rnams kyis dang por mi ma yin red zer zhing bros/ nga 'dug yin byas pas/ e yin mi yin zer zhing rgyang ring nge sa na bsdad nas gla'o byas pas/ a mtshar po mi la 'chi rgyu med pa zer nas/ rgan pa gcig gis rtsam pa dum pa cig khyer nas byung ba de zwa la btab nas gsol bas khams bzang ting nge bas de dus mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// sprang pos ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// yon bdag bzang pos tshogs sogs dang*// 'dzegs ka zab mo'i rten 'brel 'grigs// rnyed dka' 'jig sla'i lus po 'di// zas dang 'phrad pas sku khams bzang*// dog mo sa yi rtsi bcud dang*// dgung sngon dbyings kyi char pa gnyis// 'gro la phan pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po lha chos yin// pha mas gsos pa'i sgyu lus dang*// bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gnyis// lha chos byed pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po snying rus yin// mi med lung pa'i brag phug dang*// kha zhe med pa'i dge sbyor gnyis// ci bsam 'grub pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten gyi snying po stong nyid yin// mi la ras pa'i sgom bsran dang*// khams gsum sems can gyi dad pa gnyis// byang chub 'thob pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po snying rje yin// brag la bsgom pa'i sgom chen dang*// 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag gnyis// sangs mnyam du rgya ba'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po bsngo ba yin// bla ma bzang po'i thugs rje dang*// slob ma bzang po'i bsgom bsran gnyis// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel yin// rten 'brel gyi snying po dam tshig yin// byin rlabs myur mo'i dbang bskur dang*// dad gus gdung bas gsol 'debs gnyis// myur du mjal ba'i rten 'brel yin/

rten 'brel gyi snying po bkra shis yin// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*/ sprang po'i skyid sdug khyed rang shes// zhes gsungs nas bsgom zhing yod pa la/ mi de rnams kyi nang nas rgan pa rtsam pa skyel mkhan de gshen rdor mo bya ba zin pas/ chang sa zhig tu phu 'di na mi la thos pa dga' bya ba/ chos min pa'i bsam pa med pa cig 'dug pas thams cad kyi tshogs gsog byas na 'thad/ khong gi nye ba a ne yod pa la brgyags skyol zer bas/ a ne ngo tsha bar byung nas brgyags ngas skyel zer nas sha dum pa cig dang mar cig khyer nas a ne dpon g.yog gnyis 'ong ba la/ mi la dge sbyor ma grol bar a ne ngang thung byas nas spang thog cig tu bskyur nas khros te song bas mi las ma gzigs pas/ wa spyang la shor skad do// de nas sring mos tshor te a ne bden nam bsam nas a ne la dris tsa/ ngas tshogs gsog khyer te len bzhin ma nyan/ khyod sring mo yin pas 'phrad pa 'ong le che bas zer a nes sring mo la lam bslab nas btang ste/ sring mo yar 'ong bas gnam so nas bos pas/ rje btsun gyis gzigs tsa/ 'di mi rid pa cig 'dug /nga yi ming po ma red bsam pa la/ yar shog gsungs pas/ ba spu thams cad sngo zhol le/ lus keng rus bzhin du song*/ shangs zhom/ spyan khong du song*/ zhal dang ljags rdib nas 'dug pas sring mo rang dbang med par yi mug skyes te/ nged ming sring gnyis las sdug pa mi 'dug bsam nas/ pus mo gnyis kyi bar du mgo bcug cing*/ mchi ma mang po phyung zhing ngus pa la/ rje btsun la na bza' a nes byin pa thul gog gcig las med pa des gsang gnas bkab nas sring mo'i lag pa nas bzung ste mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// sring mos gdung sems yi mug lus/ skyid sdug gang yang mi rtag pas// dbyangs 'di dar cig gsan par zhu// nga yi gnas la bltas na ri dwags 'dra// mi gzhan gyis mthong na snying rlung ldang*// nga yi zas la bltas na dud 'gro 'dra// mi gzhan gyi mthong na skyug bro lta// nga yi lus la bltas na keng rus 'dra// sdang dgra bos bltas na mchi ma 'chor// nga yi spyod lam la bltas na smyon pa 'dra// khyod sring mos bsam zhing yi mug skyes// nga yi sems la bltas na sangs rgyas dngos// bla ma gong mas gzigs na spro ba skye// nga yi 'og tu rdo ba'i gram gcal la// sha pags pa 'bigs pa'i snying rus byas// lus phyi nang zwa yi rang bzhin la// mdog sngon po cig las 'gyur ba med// mi med brag gis phug pa na// skyo phyod de ba la skyo 'dri med// bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas la// skyo dung nge ba la 'bral ba med// nga snying rus 'di yi che lugs kyi// nyams rtogs pa skye bar the tshom med// pe ta yi mug ma byed zwa tshod tshos// zhes gsungs te/

sring mo la ni 'bul rgyu med/ ming po la ni gnang rgyu med pas zwa 'tshod du bcug pas/ sring mo'i bsam pa la/ a ne'i tshogs gsog bskul zer bas dum pa cig e yod bsam pas/ zwa la rdor dgos zhus pas/ zwa la sdor yod na zas yin te/ zwa yi sdor la za rang thob gsung*/ zwa la yab dgos zhus pas/ zwa la yab yod na zas yin te/ zwa'i yab la zwa thob gsungs/ zwa la tshwa dgos zhus pas/ zwa la tshwa yod na zas yin te/ zwa yi tshwa la yang zwa thob gsungs pas/ sems mi bde ting nge ba la zwa lan gsum btsos nas drangs pas/ rje btsun gyis zhim sha dang bcas nas gsol zhing 'dug /sring mo ni sprang mo yin yang skyug bro ba cig byung bas yang mchi ma mang po shor zhing*/ 'o skol ming sring nyin gcig kyang tshe mi phyid par 'dug pas/ khyed rang yang bsod snyoms dum pa 'dra mdzad na zhus tsa/ ngas skyabs 'gro dum pa cig e 'ong bsam pas bsod snyoms byed thabs med byas pas/ 'o na cug grag bsam nas yid phyang nged ba gcig la yul du sprang la 'ong ste/ phu rgyug mda' rgyug byas pas/ sprang phye dum pa cig rnyed pa khyer nas yong tsa/ na bza' med par sngo hrang hrang 'dug pas/ nga sring mo yin pas ngo tsha yang mi shes par 'dug pas/ da mi ming mi 'dug byas pas rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// ngas rtag tu mi yul 'grim 'grim nas// rang yul ngang gis brjed nas thal// gcig pur ri khrod 'grim 'grim nas// grong yul ngang gis brjed nas thal/ spre'u yi rtsal la bltas bltas nas// bi'u lug ngang gis brjed nas thal// bla ma spyi bor bsgom bsgom nas// gnyen 'dun ngang gis brjed nas thal// lha chos yid la byas byas nas// mi chos ngang gis brjed nas thal// lus la gtum mo sbar sbar nas// lus gos ngang gis brjed nas thal// zas su ting 'dzin zos zos nas// sha chang ngang gis brjed nas thal// 'od gsal zung 'jug bsgom bsgom nas// spros bcas ngang gis brjed nas thal// mi rtog ye shes bsgom bsgom nas/

rnam rtog ngang gis brjed nas thal// me lcags rnon po bzung bzung nas// khyim mtshes ngang gis brjed nas tha// sems la gang byung byas byas nas// sba gsang ngang gis brjed nas thal// gcig pur bag yang byas byas nas// ngo tsha ngang gis brjed nas thal// 'jig rten so nam dug gi rdzong*// rdzong de la rnal 'byor thar thar 'dra// de rnams brjed pa bcu gnyis te/ rnal 'byor pa yi chos lugs lags// rnal 'byor yongs kyis de ltar mdzod// khyed 'dir bzhugs yon bdag dad 'dun mo// nga 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin zhig pa la// mi khyod kyi ngo tsha ma re mdzod// nga gzung 'dzin gyi mdud pa grol ba la// yon bdag srol ka ma re mdzod// lar bcos ma gcig la byang chub re// mi khyod kyi lha chos dka' mor gda'// zhes brjed pa bcu gnyis kyi mgur gsungs pas/ lar nga bag yangs su sdod pa yin/ ngo tsha byed na zol dang khram mi byed dgos pa yin/ ngas bcos ma'i spyod pa mi shes gsungs/ de nas sring mo sprang du song ba'i lam ka nas bla ma ba ri lotstsha ba bya ba/ longs spyod dang thab ka dang rta dang bel thul dang*/ gdugs bskor zhing chos gsungs pa'i tshogs gral du song bas/ mi yi chos pa la 'di 'dra zhig yod pa yin/ nga yi ming po tshe ma phyid pa'i chos pas ci 'ong bsam pa byung nas phu rgyug mda' rgyug byas pas/ ru ba'i mtsher rnying na bal dum dang*/ khyi spu ra bal rnams la byas pa'i snam bu sre'o cig thon pa khyer nas/ rje btsun la phul nas mi yi chos pa la bla ma ba ri lo tstsha ba 'dra ba zhig dgos pa yin/ ming po'i chos 'dis cang mi 'ong bas/ snam bu 'di la gos gyis shig dang*/ bla ma ba ri ba'i nye gnas la 'gro zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// sprang pos ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs/ gdugs ya thog gser gyi bum chung dang cig /ma thog dar gyi 'jol khang dang gnyis// bar na rma bya'i lding khang dang gsum// tshon rtsi sna lnga'i gdugs rtsibs dang bzhi// de bzhi bskor na ngas kyang 'khor tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na bde// blo chos brgyad spong shig pe ta ma// grong ltag gi dgon chung khra mo dang gcig

/ston chung gsar pa'i chos bshad dang gnyis/ yu mar ja yi thab dang gsum/ btsun chung gzhon nu'i phyag bde dang bzhi// 'di bzhi bskyangs na ngas kyang 'ong tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na bde/ blo chos brgyad spong zhig pe ta ma// rag dung ser po lcags kyi kha rgyan dang gcig /de la mdzes pa'i 'bur lugs dang gnyis// lce dbugs rkan gsum 'dzoms pa'i dung mkhan dang gsum// mgo nag mi yi 'du 'dzi dang bzhi// 'di bzhi bsgrub na ngas kyang 'ong tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na bde// blo chos brgyad spong zhig pe ta ma/ rta na bran gyi mgo 'phang mtho dang gcig /de la mdzes pa'i dar bstan dang gnyis// seng ldeng cho ris kyi sga bkra dang gsum/ mdo mang lcags kyi glo nan dang bzhi// 'di bzhi btsal na ngas kyang 'ong tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na bde// blo chos brgyad spong zhig pe ta ma// ma jo mo bsgom ma'i tshogs dpon dang gcig /mo bon rtsis gsum gyi grong chog dang gnyis/ kha za 'dod 'bar ba'i tshogs 'khor gsum// nya ma mgo skor gyi glu chung dang bzhi/ 'di bskor na ngas kyang 'khor tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spong na bde// blo chos brgyad spong zhig pe ta ma// pha yul skyid kyi mkhar khang dang gcig /pha zhing mtha' med du rmo ba dang gnyis// pha spun mnyam gnyis kyis 'gran sems dang gsum// nye du 'brel pa'i gdung sems dang bzhi// 'di bzhi byas na ngas kyang 'ong tshod du gda' ste// de bas kyang blo chos brgyad spangs na bde// blo chos brgyad spong zhig pe ta ma// gnyen nye du'i gdung sems sems la gzan// pha bla ma'i nye gnas dge sbyor spur// chos spyod kyi phyi bshol lag stong spur// khyod pe ta'i a lcam sprang du/ song*// nga nad med kyi rnal 'byor dge sbyor byed// ces gsungs pas/

sring mo na re/ de bzhin yin na nga yang dga' ste/ e yin zer/ de nas sring mo sprang du song nas nyin gcig sprang phyed dang*/ skyur po zo ba gang 'ong ba la tshogs 'khor mdzad do// da de sring mo khyod kyang ma 'ong gsungs te/ mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ sprang pos ri khrod zin par byin gyin rlobs// nga skyid pa dgra yis ma tshor zhing*// sdug pa gnyan gyis ma tshor bar// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga 'grangs pa pha yis ma tshor zhing*/ ltogs pa ma yi ma tshor bar// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga rgas pa grogs kyis ma tshor zhing*// na ba sring mos ma tshor bar/ ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga shi ba mi yis ma tshor zhing*/ ro rul 'bu yis ma mthong bar// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga yi sha rus la sbrang bus 'jib pa dang*/ rtsa rus 'bu yis za ba ru/ ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga sgo na mi rjes med pa dang*// nang na khrag rjes med pa ru// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin/ nga ro la khur mi med pa dang*// shi bas ngu mi med pa ru// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na// sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// nga gar song 'dri mi med pa dang*// 'dir song gtad so med pa ru// ri khrod 'di ru 'chi nus na/ sprang po'i bsam pa 'grub pa yin// mi med lung pa'i brag phug tu// sprang po 'chi ba'i smon lam 'di// 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog /ces gsungs so// 'di rnams snga ma las 'og ma ste de thams cad snga ma'i skor gsum mo/// /gsum pa bde drod ngo 'phrod pa'i yon tan ni/ sring mo na re/ khyod nyin mo glu len mtshan mo nyal bas/

sems yang yengs la song nas e'u zug zer bas mo bden dgongs nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gnad rnam pa gsum gyis gcun te/ sring mos byin pa'i snam bu yang bzo thabs dang bzo long ma byung bas/ tsog pu lus kyi gnad/ rgya mdud ngag gi gnad/ sbrul mdud sems kyi gnad de gsum la dril nas/ shi ma shi med/ 'gyel ma 'gyel med par bsgoms pas zhag bco brgyad nas bde drod rang 'bar la song ste/ sring mos byin pa'i snam bu yang 'bu mug mas zos nas dam me dum me song ba la/ yang nyin gcig sprang mo sleb byung bas khyed kyi snam bu e bzos zhus pas/ snam bu bzo ba ma byung nas 'bus zos gsungs pas khyed kyi snam bu chud zos byas nas/ da gcer bu ngo mi tsha ba e lags zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sprang pos ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// ngo mi tsha ba la ngo tsha byed// ngo tsha'i bu pho pang du pang*// ngo tsha'i bu pho rin gyis nyos// ngo tsha'i las la thod pa brgas// 'di ni rang byung gi pho rtags yin// pho mor ming btags tshun chad nas// 'di nyid yod pa sus kyang shes/ khrel ngo tsha gnyis la khyed mi 'dzem// ngan spyod g.yo sgyu rku ba dang*// spyod ngan zhe ngan log lta dang*// ngo shes nye ba bcom pa rnams// khrel ngo tsha yin te 'dzem mi med// rdo rje zab mo'i gsang spyod dang*// man ngag zab mo'i sgom chen kun// mi tshe chos la skyel ba la// ngo tshas 'jigs pa skad cig med// khyed pe ta re sdug sems ma chung*/ yid chad ma snga sprang du song*// zhes gsungs/ de nas brag dmar spo mtho ru byon/ zwa tshod 'ba' zhig la dka' thub mdzad pas nyams chung bar song*/ mtshams 'dir ma dpe las ldeb bcu gcig tshang mi 'dug /dpe gzhan gsum tsam la 'tshol bsdu byas kyang 'di las lhag pa mi 'dug pas gsab thabs bral/ rjes su ma dpe gzhan btsal rnyed thub na der bsab gnang yod pa mkhyen/

sar grol// dam tshig gi thag chod bde mor gda'// lar yang sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// 'bras bu re med kyi ngang las dogs med 'phyo// re dogs kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// 'bras bu'i thag chod bde mor gda'// lar yang sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// gsungs pas mang du byung ngo*// 'bung nas bsgom bsgom pa la zwa rang gis yang ma 'gyang par bsgom shed je chung la song nas dbang po snyoms po las ma byung ba la/ nyin cig khyi ra ba 'gas sha ba bsad pa'i sha khur nas brag rtse nas byung bas rtogs 'dod byas te/ skad mang po btang nas rje btsun gyis gzigs tsa/ khyod mi la thos pa dga' e yin zer bas/ yin gsungs pas/ khyod brag 'di la bsdad pa la brag 'di la yon tan ci yod zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin rlabs brag la zhugs// brag 'di yi yon tan ma shes na// spos ri spo mthon nam mkha' rdzong*// nam mkha' rdzong gi pho brang na// steng na lho sprin smug po 'thibs// 'og na gtsang chab sngon mo 'bab// rgyab tu brag dmar nam mkha'i dbyings// mdun na spang thang me tog bkra// zur na gcan gzan ngar sgra bsgrogs// log na bya rgyal rgod po lding*// dus su sbrang char zim bu 'babs// rgyun du bung bas rgyang glu len// sha rkyang ma bus rtse bro brdungs// lco ga ma bus 'gyur skad sgrogs/ lha bya gong mos gsung snyan sgrogs// rdza chab sil mas snyan pa brjod// dus kyi skad rigs nyams kyi grogs// gnas 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab// nyams dga' bas glu ru blangs pa yin/ gdams ngag kha ru bton pa yin// khyod khyi ra ba la bshad pa yin// las sdig pa ma mdzad dge ba mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ khyi ra ba rnams gyis ngo mtshar che zer nas sha ba'i sha dang phye yi lhag ma dum pa cig 'dug pa rnams phul ba la sha tshod mdzad de gsol bas/ sku lus 'bul shig ge btang nas sgom shed cher song*/
