khams dang lus bde/ sems gsal du song bas dge sbyor bzang po byung*/ yang zhag gcig gnyis nas khyi ra ba rgan pa cig gis rtsam pa zhig khyer nas yong bas/ da zhag sku khams bde 'am zhus pas/ legs por bde gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// brag dkar spo mtho pho brang na// mi la ras pa'i bsgom lugs bde// 'dzin chags med pa'i 'gro lugs bde// na tsha med pa'i sgyu lus bde// nyal pa med pa'i 'dug lugs bde// ltogs pa med pa'i ting 'dzin bde// grang ba med pa'i gtum mo bde/ zhum pa med pa'i brtul zhugs bde// rtsol ba med pa'i sa bon bde// yengs pa med pa'i dben gnas bde// de tsho lus kyi 'khyer so yin/ thabs shes gnyis kyis theg pa bde// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug nyams len bde// rlung 'gro 'ong med pa'i sems nyid bde// lab rogs med pa'i smra bcad bde// de tsho ngag gi 'khyer so yin// ngos bzung med pa'i lta ba bde// rgyun chad med pa'i sgom pa bde/ nyams nga med pa'i spyod pa bde// re dogs med pa'i 'bras bu bde// de tsho sems kyi 'khyer so yin// 'gyur med rtog med 'od gsal bde// bde chen rnam dag dbyings su bde// 'gags med 'char sgo'i klong du bde// shin tu bde ba'i dbyangs chung 'di/ nyams myong glu ru blangs pa yin// gdams ngag kha nas shor ba yin// lta spyod zung du bsdebs pa yin// slad nas byang chub bsgrub 'dod rnams// don nyams su len na de ltar mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ yon bdag de dga' nas phyag mang du 'tshal nas khyim du song ste/ zhag gcig gnyis nas/ yon bdag rogs 'ga' dang bcas te 'grogs nas rtsam pa dum pa re khyer nas yong ste/ bla ma lags/ khar nyin gyi mgur ma de legs po rang zhig byung ste nged shes rab chung ba dang ma zin/ tshig nyung la don gsal ba zhig gsung dang zer bas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin brlabs brag la zhugs// sprang brag la gnas par byin gyis rlobs// dad dang mkhas dang btsun dang gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi srog shing yin// btsugs na brtan la 'jus na bde// srog shing mdzad na de la mdzod// chag med zhen med rmongs med gsum// 'di gsum sems kyis go cha yin// gyon na yang la mtshon khar sra// go cha mdzad na de la mdzod// bsgom dang brtson dang bsran tshugs gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi rta pho yin// rgyugs na mgyogs la bros na thar// rta pho mdzad na de la mdzod// rang rig rang gsal rang bde gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi 'bras bu lags// btab la smin la za na bcud// 'bras bu mdzad na de la mdzod// sems don rnam pa bcu gnyis 'di// rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs// khyod yon bdag dad pa'i gdab len mdzod// ces gsungs pas/

yon bdag de dad pa can gshen rdor mo bya ba yin pas/ da rung mdor bsdus pa tshig gcig la dril ba cig gsung dang zer la yang mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma'i byin brlabs sems la zhugs/ sems stong nyid rtogs par byin gyi rlobs// yon bdag dad pa'i phyag rten la// lha yi dam mnyes pa'i glu zhig len// snang dang stong dang dbyer med gsum// 'di gsum lta ba'i mdor bsdus yin// gsal dang mi rtog ma yengs gsum// 'di gsum sgom pa'i mdor bsdus yin/ ma chags ma zhen ma 'khrul gsum// 'di gsum spyod pa'i mdor bsdus yin// re med dogs med mthar skyol gsum// 'di gsum 'bras bu'i mdor bsdus yin// ngos med lkog med zol med gsum// 'di gsum dam tshig mdor bsdus yin// zhes gsungs pas/ yon bdag rnams mnyes te khyim du song ngo*// lar snye nam gyis mi sde rnams dad pa che yang mkhos chung bas zhabs tog chen po tsam ma byung bas dkor gyi dge sbyor ma 'phrog /zla ba lnga drug nas ltogs drir rlung la ma bskur zhes gsungs so// de thams cad spo ri spo mthon gyis skor ro/// /de nas spo ri spo mthon na lo drug song ba dang*/ brag dmar mchong gling khyung gi rdzong na lo bcu gnyis/ zla ba bcu gnyis/ za ma bcu gnyis/ bcu gnyis cha bzhi'i dam bca' byas pa'i 'og tu shi ba cig e nus bsam nas bsgrub pa la/ yul gyi mi sdes kyang gar yod ma tshor bar bsgom pas/ e 'chi e 'chi bsam pa la 'chi rgyu ma byung zhing dbang po ngan por byung bas/ ngas 'jig rten gyis bya ba btang thal zin/ da rung ma shi yang chos rang byed bsam pa skyes te/ zwa zhig btsos nas gsol dgongs nas/ shing zhig 'thu ba la song ste shing hral hrul dum pa cig rnyed pa rdo leb cig gi steng du bzhag nas bsnyel ba gsos nas yod pa lhag pa zhig 'ong bas gtor song ba la/ thams cad mi rtag pa 'di rang yin ang*/

bdag la yang mi rtag pa nam yong ang dgongs shing yod pa la da rung shing zhig 'thu dgos dgongs nas shing skam po che ba gcig bcag ring la shing chag pa dang mnyam du 'gyel ba'i ngang la dbang po ma byung ste/ dgong mo nyi ma zer ba lhag pa ser bu bshi ring ba byung nas mnal sad pa 'dra ba cig la dbang po rnyed de/ skyo ba'i snying rlung drag po cig langs zin pas/ nyi ma shar phyogs su gzigs pas/ bla ma'i sku mkhar yod pa'i phyogs su/ sprin dkar po gcig ling nge 'dug pa dang*/ de ru bla ma dran pa'i mgur sprin dkar lding ba 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma de la phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sprang po'i snying rlung sang bar byin gyis rlobs// nyi ma shar na sprin dkar lang ma ling*// sprin dkar po lding ba'i 'og rol na// lho gro bo lung gis dgon pa na// brag seng chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng na// lho brag gi mar pa lo tswa de// dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la// da lta bzhugs na skyid pa la// sa skor thag ring yang mjal snying 'dod// lam bgrod par dka' yang mjal snying 'dod// lar yang bla ma dran pa byung*// bsam zhing rje btsun dran pa byung*// yum sangs rgyas bskyed byed bdag med ma// dus da lta bzhugs na dga' ba la// da lta bzhugs na skyid pa la// ma la phyag rten med kyang mjal snying 'dod// 'bul rgyu med kyang mjal snying 'dod// lar yang bla ma dran pa byung*// bsam zhing rje btsun dran par byung*// dbang zab mo brda yi dbang bzhi de// dus da lta mdzad na dga' ba la// da lta mdzad na skyid pa la// nga yo byad chung yang 'bul snying 'dod// 'tsho ba dkon yang zhu snying 'dod// lar yang bla ma dran pa byung*// bsam zhing rje btsun dran par byung*/ rgyud zab mo dgyes pa rdo rje de// dus da lta gsung na dga' ba la// da lta gsung na skyid pa la// nga shes rab chung yang nyan snying 'dod/ blo rtse rtul yang nyan snying 'dod// lar yang bla ma dran pa byung*// bsam zhing rje btsun dran par byung*// khrid zab mo na ro'i chos drug de/

dus da lta gsung na dga' ba la// da lta gsungs na skyid pa la// nga sgom bsran chung yang bsgom snying 'dod// 'byung bzhi rgud kyang sgom snying 'dod// lar yang bla ma dran par byung*/ bsam zhing rje btsun dran par byung*// pha bla mas bsdus pa'i mched grogs de// dus da lta tshogs na dga' ba la/ dus da lta tshogs na skyid pa la// bdag gdung sems chung yang mjal snying 'dod// bgro gleng go bsdur byed snying 'dod// lar yang bla ma dran par byung*/ bsam zhing rje btsun dran par byung*// bla ma mnyes pa'i sku mkhar de// dus da lta brtsigs na dga' ba la// da lta brtsigs na skyid pa la// na so rgas kyang brtsigs snying 'dod// sgyu lus ngan yang brtsigs snying 'dod// lar yang bla ma dran par byung*// bsam zhing rje btsun dran par byung*// drin chen a ma yab yum de// dus da lta yod na dga' ba la// da lta yod na skyid pa la// pha ma'i drin lan mjal snying 'dod// zhabs tog ci nus byed snying 'dod// lar yang bla ma dran par byung*/ bsam zhing rje btsun dran par byung*// rdo rje 'chang chen byin rlabs can// sprang po'i skyo ba sangs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ sprin de je che je che la song nas khong gis dbu thog tu snam bu brkyang ba bzhin du 'ong nas sprin de'i rtse mo la/ bla ma mar pa de nyid seng ge dkar mo srab med cig la chib nas 'dug pa gzigs pas/ mi la ras pa khyod de ring 'o dod chen po byed pa ci byung*/ bla ma la dad pa skyes sam/ rkyen ngan rtogs pa yul phyir 'brang ngam/ nang bsgrub pa'i khang par skyid 'dod kyi bar chad zhugs sam/ blo 'gong po re dogs bcer bas khong du spun nam ci byung*/ nga dang khyed gnyis 'du 'bral med pa yin gsung pa'i sgra thos pas dga' drag nas 'di bzlas ma rnyed pa la/ dpe dang bral ba'i rtogs pa shar/ brjod du med pa'i nyams skyes nas/

gsol 'debs mos gus kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i zhal mthong gsung thos pas// sprang po'i snying rlung nyams la shar// thugs rjes yid la bsam pa yi// rtogs pa mos gus gting nas skyes// bka' drin byin brlabs dngos zhugs pas// chos min gyi snang ba khregs se chad// mi med lung stong gi 'o dod 'di// bla ma'i snyan la gzan lags kyang*// sprang 'di min gyi snang ba tshim mi nus// snying rus sdug bsran gyi sgrub pa 'di// pha bla ma mnyes pa'i zhabs tog lags// na med gcig pu'i ri khrod 'di// mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i zhabs tog yin// shir chug ltogs bsgur gyi sdug bsran 'di// mgon med sems can gyi sbyin pa yin// grogs med gcig pu'i snying rus 'di// las rnam smin sbyong ba'i byab shing yin// zad med zwa yi chos brgyags 'di// nyams rtogs pa skye ba'i mthun rkyen yin// pha bla ma'i drin len bsgrub pas 'jal// drin thugs la thogs shig gu ru rje// sprang ri khrod non par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ snang ba bde ting nge shing dum pa cig khyer nas yar song tsa/ phug pa na lcags kyi a tsa ra gzugs mthe bong tsam mig phor pa tsam yod pa bdun gyis la las me 'bud/ la las chu len/ la las rtsam pa btag stangs dang*/ las sna tshogs pa'i cho 'phrul ston cing 'dug pas dngangs/ gzigs ma gzigs la ya nga ba cig byung bas/ lha bsgom nas drag sngags bzlas pas kyang lta stangs rol pa cher byas/ byams snying rje bsgom pas zhi ma nus pas 'di rnams yul 'di'i gzhi bdag e ma yin nga gnas 'di na lo zla ba 'di tsam bsdad pa la/ gtor ma dang bstod pa gcig kyang ma byas dgongs nas gnas la bstod pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma ri khrod dben pa'i gnas/ pha rgyal bas byang chub bsgrub pa'i sa// mi rang nyid gcig pur gnas pa'i yul// gnas brag dmar mchong gling khyung gi rdzong*// steng na lho sprin smug po 'chib// de la rgod po lang ma ling*// mda' la gtsang chab me re re// de la nya sram gya ma gyu// rgyab tu ri rgyal rtse mtho ba// de la rtsi shing sna tshogs rgyas// mdun du 'bras phung rang la 'khor// de la me tog chu mig rgyas// rtsa na na spang cho lo ris// de la sha rkyang ma bu rtse// shing lo me tog pad ma ris// de la 'jol mang gsung snyan bsgrogs// rdza dang g.ya' ma gangs ri mang*// de la gong mos skad snyan 'gyur// 'brog dang lung pa'i phu mda' dam/

de la bar chod mi rjes chad// nga dang gnas bzang byang chub mthun// de lta bu yi dben gnas 'dir/ nga mi la ras pa'i nyams myong skyong*// nyams myong rtsa ba byang chub sems// 'dre 'dir tshogs bar chod mi ma yin// byams snying rje'i bdud rtsi 'thung la dengs// zhes gsungs pas/ cho 'phrul gtong ba'i a tsa ra gsum dengs nas song*/ bzhi po de da dung 'gror ma nyan pas/ bzhi po de 'dre yi cho 'phrul bar chad yin par dgongs nas/ lta ba gdengs dang ldan pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// yang pho nga dang nga rang mi zer te// nga rang seng chen dkar mo'i bu// seng ma yi mngal nas g.yu ral rgyas// phru ma gangs dkar stongs su bkral// seng 'phrug gi dus na tshang sgo 'grims// seng phran gyi lo la khyu sna drangs// seng chen gyi lo la gangs stod bskor// kha ba bu yug 'tshubs kyang nyams mi nga*// pho nga dang nga rang mi zer te// nga rang 'dab chags khyung gi bu// khyung sgo nga'i nang nas gshog sgro rgyas// khyung phrug gi lo la tshang sgo 'grims// khyung phran gyi lo la khyung sna drangs// khyung chen gyi lo la nam 'phangs bskyod// khong g.yang sa che yang nyams mi nga*// pho nga dang nga rang mi zer te// nga dang nya chen yor mo'i bu// ma yi mngal nas gser mig 'khyil// nya chung lo la mtsho mtha' 'grims// nya phran gyi lo la khyu sna drangs// nya chen gyi lo la mtsho stod bzung*// mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs kyang nyams mi nga*// pho nga dang nga rang mi zer te// nga rang nā ro me tri'i bu/ chung dad skyes pa'i lo la chos sgor zhugs// chos sgor zhugs nas chos khrid zhus// bsgom khrid bskyangs nas ri khrod 'grims/ ri khrod 'grims pas nyams rtogs rgyas// khyod bar chad kyi gdon la nyams nga med// 'dre ngan gyi bar chod tshugs mi srid// 'dre de ring byon pa ngo mtshar che// sang nyin cis kyang 'byon par zhu// skabs su gleng lang yang yang byed// ces gsungs pas a tsa ra gsum 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song*/

gcig ni lta stangs rol pa'i gar chen btang bas/ 'di de ma rungs pa'i mthu bo che cig red dgongs nas yang rtogs tshad lta ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so// lcags kyi pha bong rdos mi shigs// lcags kyi pha bong rdos shig na// lcags zhun thar byas pa don go chung*// se ge gangs la spar mi 'khyags// se ge gangs la 'gying ba sbar 'khyags na// seng rtsal gsum rdzogs pa don go chung*// bya mkha' la 'phur ba lhung mi srid// bya mkha' la 'phur ba lhung srid na// bya gshog drug rgyas pa don go chung*// nya chab la gnas pa 'tshub mi srid// nya chab la gnas pa 'tshub srid na// nya gser mig 'khyil pa don go chung*// nga nā ro mai tri'i bu brgyud 'di/ sems stong nyid rtogs pa 'dres mi 'jig /sems stong nyid rtogs pa 'dres 'jig na/ mtho brag la bsgoms pa'i don go chung*// khyod 'dra'i 'dre la nyams nga med// khyod 'dra'i 'dre la nyam nga na/ sems snying rje shar ba don go chung*// 'dre da rung bzhugs na thug la btags// khyod rogs pa yod na sked la shog /nge rang gsung gleng kho thag chod// a tsa ma 'byung po snying re rje// rje mi bskyod ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang snying rje 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ byams snying rje lus la ltos pa med par kha na phar btsangs pas za rgyu ma byung bar 'ja' yal ba bzhin dengs nas song ngo*// de thams cad brag dmar mchong gling gis skor ro/// /de nas dam bca' rdzogs pa dang*/ brin dang snye nam gyi so mtshams la phyi gangs kyi ra ba der rje btsun byon nas bsgom bzhin yod pa'i ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo la/ la phyi chu bzang gis lha 'dre thams cad dmag byas nas 'ong pas/ cho 'phrul ya ma zung rigs mi 'dra ba mang po bstan pas de'i dus su rje btsun gyis mi ma yin de rnams la mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma'i bka' drin snying la zhugs// nang dngos por 'dzin pa'i snying rlung bsal// blo pad ma dkar po 'dab bzhi rgyas// blo 'khrul snang mi 'khrug shes pa la// gdon gnod sbyin pho mo'i cho 'phrul 'di// a tsa ma yi dwags snying re rje// sngon las ngan bsags pa'i 'bras bu de// da lta lus ngan rnam smin spyod// yid mkha' la rgyu ba'i kun slong ngan// sbyor ngan nyon mongs kyi gdub rtsub kyis// gsod gcod brdegs btsog byed do zhes// mi nga la khyed rnams mi gnod do// khyod las ngan bsags pas da gzod sdug

/nga stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ blo ya nga med pa lta ba'i gdeng*// dpa' bo seng ge'i spyod 'gros kyis// lus ni lha yi rdzong la zhen// ngag ni sngags kyi rdzong la zhen// sems ni 'od gsal rdzong la zhen// tshogs drug rang rang ngo bos stong*// 'od lus rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la// khyod yi dwags tho 'tsham ci la phan// spyir dge sdig 'bras bu bden nus che// rgyu mthun 'bras bu bsags bsags nas// ngan song 'gro ba yi re mug /a tsa ma yi dwags nyon re mongs// don gnas lugs ma rtogs snying re rje/ mdog ngan mi rgan ras pa 'di// rag rig byed glu yis chos bshad pas// nang bcud kyis bsdus pa'i sems can rnams// gnyen pha mar ma gyur gang yang med/ de drin chen yin pas sdug par 'phang*// khyod yi dwags gnod sems slar logs nas// las rgyu 'bras bsam na ci ma lags// chos dge bcu spyad na ci bde 'thob// tshig legs par bzung la rtog dpyod thong*/ don go bar mdzod la nyams su longs// zhes gsungs pas/ der tshogs pa'i yul btsan brag srin mo rnams na re/ 'dir tshogs pa rnams las ngan gom drag pas/ sdig pas gnod par shes/ dge bas phan par go yang*/ las ngan shugs kyi spyod pa la dga' ba cig byung bas rang dbang ma byung*/ bla ma'i mgur de 'dra yin na/ dge ba la spro spro 'dug cing*/ shin tu snyan pas phan par byung bas da rung mgur zhig bzhengs par zhu zer bas/ yang chos bshad 'di mgur du gsungs so// rje bla ma'i bka' drin sems la zhugs// sems bsam pa log pa skye ma myong*// don bden pa'i tshig dang ma 'brel na// glu gre 'gyur snyan pa pi wang yin// chos mthun dpe yis mi mtshon na/ tshig sdeb sbyor mkhas kyang tha snyad yin// chos lag len rgyud la mi 'gel na// ngas shes so zer yang mgo skor yin// don snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag mi bsgom na// gnas ri khrod bzung yang rang sdug yin// phan nges pa'i dam chos mi byed na// 'phral so nam rems kyang sdug las yin// las rgyu 'bras zhib tu ma brtsis na// tshig kha lta che yang smyon pa yin/

chos bshad pa yid la mi 'jog na// bshad lo byas kyang chud zos yin// ngas mi dge spang na ngang gis 'grib// las dge ba bsgrub na ngang gis 'grub// 'gag gcig la dril ba nyams su longs// tshig mang po bshad pas phan pa chung*// don de bzhin nyams su len gal te che// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma lags/ don 'di yin zhib tu ma bshad na ma go lags/ khyed kyis da rung mgur cig gsungs dang de rnams kyi cho 'phrul yang zhi bar byed zer bas/ bla mas cho 'phrul ma zhi ba rnal 'byor pa'i grogs su bzang zhing rgyan du che gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// nga rang sems rang dbang thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas// rgyan du che ba'i glu zhig len/ khyod 'dir tshogs kyi gnod sbyin pho mo rnams// yid ma yengs rna ba'i dbang po gtod// dbus ri bo mchog rab mchod rten la// lho baiḍurya yi 'od gsal ba// 'dzam gling nam mkha'i rgyan du che// ri gnya' shing 'dzin gyi gong rol na// nyi zla zung cig 'od gsal ba// gling bzhi yangs pa'i rgyan du che// klu byang chub sems dpa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis// nam mkha'i mthong nas char phabs pas// dog mo sa yi rgyan du che// phyi rgya mtsho chen po'i rlangs pa la// bar snang yangs la lho sprin byung*// lho sprin bar snang gi rgyan du che// 'byung ba drod gsher gyi ting 'dzin gyis// shar spangs ri'i logs la 'ja' mtshon bkra// 'ja' tshon spang ri'i rgyan du che/ nub ma gros mtsho la chu 'bab pa// lho 'dzam bu'i gling gi rtsi shing rgyas// skye 'gro yongs kyi rgyan du che// nga rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grim pa la/ sems stong nyid bsgoms pa'i nus mthu yis// 'dre gnod sbyin pho mo'i cho 'phrul byung*/ cho 'phrul rnal 'byor rgyan du che// khyed legs par nyon dang mi ma yin// mi nga ngo khyod kyis ma shes na// nga rnal 'byor mi la ras pa yin// nga byang sems kyi me tog gting nas 'khrungs// glu snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi brda sbyar nas// ngag bden pa'i tshig gis chos bshad pa// phan pa'i sems kyi gros shig 'debs// khyed byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// 'gro ba gzhan don ma byung yang*// mi dge bcu po spangs byas nas// rang zhi bde'i thar pa cis mi thob// mi ngas zer nyan na don chen 'grub// 'phral dam chos bya na yun du bde// zhes gsungs pas/

der 'tshogs pa'i lha 'dre rnams dad pa skyes te phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas rang rang gi gnas su deng nas song ba la/ da rung 'ba' ro chen po gcig la bal po 'gas bskor nas da rung 'gro ma nyan nas ri bsnyil ba dang*/ thog 'bebs pa sogs byed par byung bas/ yang rje btsun gyis rtogs tshad lta ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod da rung nyon dang mi ma yin// mkha' la rgyu ba'i thogs pa med// bsam ngan bag chags rgyud la 'jag /nyon mongs kyi 'tshe bas gzhan la rngam// gzhan sdug gi sdig pas rang nyid mnar// rgyu 'bras kyi bden pa stor ba med// rnam smin gyi nus pas sa nas sleb// khyod rang gi khyod rang mnar sdang byed// a tsa ma yi dwags kyis 'khrul pa la/ yi re mug las ngan gyis nus pa la// 'di 'dra rang bsam na snying rlung ldang*// khyod sngon yang las ngan bsags bsags pas// da rung las ngan gsog snying 'dod// gsod gcod kyis sdigs pas zin pa yin// zas su sha dang khrag la dga'// las su 'gro ba'i srog gcod pa// 'gro drug gi nang nas yi dwags lus// bde sdug spyad pas ngan 'gror ltung*// a re 'phang lha chos la snang ba bsgyur// dgos re med bde ba myur du thob// ces gsungs pas mi ma yin de rnams na re/ khyod nged tsho la chos bshad mkhas pa la tshad mi gda'/ khyod rang la lta ba rtogs pa'i gding ci tsam yod zer bas/ de'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// don dam rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// gzhi skye med ngang la gdeng bcas nas// lam 'gag med kyi rtsal de rim gyis rdzogs// thabs snying rje chen po'i brda' sbyar nas// don chos nyid ngang nas glu zhig len// khyod las nyon gyis sgrib g.yog 'thugs po yis// nges don gyi gnas lugs mi go ste// drang don gyi chos shig da rung bshad// sngon thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyis// bka' dri ma med pa'i mdo rgyud las// de 'gro ba yongs kyi snying gcig pus// don mi bslu nges pa'i bden tshig yin// rje byams pa'i gsungs la khyod kyang nyon// nga nyams la sbyangs pa'i rnal 'byor de// phyi 'khrul snang gi bgegs la phar bltas pas// skye med kyi cho 'phrul yin par go

/nang rig pa'i sems la tshur bltas pas// gzhi rtsa bral gyi sems nyid ye nas stong*// nga bla ma rgyud pa'i byin brlab dang*// rang gcig pur bsgom pa'i yon tan gyis// rje nā ro chen po'i brgyud pa 'dzin// don ma nor rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bsgom// thabs zab mo sngags kyi rgyud sde rnams// bla ma'i gdam ngag gnad bkrol nas// lam bskyed rdzogs brtan por bsgom bsgom pas// nang rtsa gnas rten 'brel shes pa yin/ phyi 'khrul snang gi bgegs la nga mi 'jigs// nged bram ze chen po'i brgyud pa la// rje nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor mang*// yid dbu ma'i don la sbyang sbyang nas// 'khrul snang gi dran pa dbyings su yal// gdon bya gdon byed ngas ma mthong*// chos sde snod kyi gsung rab zhal phye yang*// don 'di las med pa blo thag chod// ces gsungs pas khong rnams dad par gyur te/ phyag dang skor ba mang du byas nas/ nged rnams kyi 'tsho ba bshos gtsang re 'dren zer nas song ba dang*/ nam langs nas song ngo*// nyi ma shar ba dang ri rtser phar byon nas brag kha zhig tu dum pa gcig gzims nas bzhugs tsa/ 'dang gi de rnams ngo shes lhag ge tshan pa sum cu pa gcig byas nas 'bras dang*/ nya dang la phud dang*/ bur shing dang*/ go la dang*/ tshod ma'i bye brag mang po dang chang la sogs pa'i bza' btung mang la zhim pa drangs snyam byed/ khong rnams kyang dga' dga' spro spro mang du byas nas na ra ra/ nu ru ru deng nas song snyam pa byed pa la/ rje btsun yang khams dwangs sing nger song nas/ zla ba gcig gnyis la dang kha mer chi le 'tsho ba'i snang ba byung ngo*// de thams cad la phyi chu bzang gis skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun gyis thugs dgongs la/ zwa rang 'thung bas 'bu mang po mchi bar 'dug dgongs nas/ snye nam du bsod snyoms la byon pa la/ yon bdag gshen rdor mo dang*/ ston pa shag 'gu la sogs pa rnams dang ston mo byed pa cig tu mjal bas/

rje btsun la chos gtam dang*/ gla'o byed par zhu zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin brlab sems la zhugs/ sems yang yengs la shor bas sdug bsngal che// ngas byams dang snying rje bsgom bsgom nas// bdag gzhan 'dzin pa brjed de thal// bla ma spyi bor bsgom bsgom nas// mi chos kyi 'dun ma brjed de thal// yi dam 'bral med du bsgom bsgom nas// tha mal gyi rtog pa brjed de thal// snyan brgyud kyi gdan ngag bsgom bsgom nas// re dogs kyi bsgom pa brjed de thal// tshe 'di phyi mnyam du bsgom bsgom nas// skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa brjed pa thal// gcig pur nyams len bskyangs bskyangs nas// khe drag gi ngo srung brjed nas thal// rang rgyud la nyams len sbyar sbyar nas// chos gtam dang kha 'dzin brjed nas thal// skye 'gag gnas med du bsgom bsgom nas// khas len gyi lta ba brjed nas thal// snang ba chos skur sems sems nas// dmigs bcas gyi bsgom pa brjed nas thal// ma bcos lhug par bzhag bzhag nas// tshul chos kyis spyod pa brjed nas thal// lus ngag gi dman sa bzung bzung nas// mi chen gyi re ba brjed nas thal// sgyu lus dgon pa byas byas nas// bde 'byams gyi dgon pa brjed nas thal// zhes gsungs pas/ yon bdag rnams na re/ khyed la de lta bu yod pa de nged tshos mi go bas/ go sla ba'i chos shig zhu zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin brlabs lus la zhugs// lus snying rus bsgom pas don chen 'grub// khyed gson dang yon bdag dad pa can// dam chos thang mal bdal ba la// sdig bab col spyod pa shin tu glen// dka' las sna tshogs yod pa'i lus po 'di// mi tshe yang yengs du skyel ba shin tu glen// grong khyer gyang ra zhig po'i dur khrod du// dus rtag tu sdod sems byas pa shin tu glen// bza' mi tshong dus lta bu'i mgron po la// ngan shag 'thab mo byed pa shin tu glen// tshig sgra snyan sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la/

zhe ran gal du 'dzin pa shin tu glen// dgra sdang me tog bzhin du yal nas 'gro// glen pas rang srog skyel ba shin tu glen// gnyen tshan slu brid brdzun gyi zol khang la/ shi ba myang ngan byed pa shun tu glen// nor zas zil pa lta bu'i g.yar po la// ser sna'i mdud pa bcings pa shin tu glen// phung po mi gtsang rdzas kyis rkyal pa la// bzang 'dod byi dor byed pa shin tu glen// gdams ngag dam chos bdud rtsi'i zas mchog 'di/ zas nor phyir du 'tshong ba shin tu glen// glen pa mang du 'tshogs pa la// spyang na lha chos rang mgo thon// ces gsungs pas der 'tshogs pa'i yon bdag pho mo rnams na re/ da de rje btsun nged rnams kyis bla mchod byed dgos/ khyed ri khrod kho nar bzhugs pas nged tsho gar yod mi shes nas nged rnams la mi phan par 'dug zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin brlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag smra bcad byang sems chos kyi sgra// rje bla ma'i dad pa sems la yod// 'phral mnyam du 'grogs na snang ba spun// mig 'dris che na gshis kyi brnyas// 'grogs yun ring na re 'khongs mang*// gshis ngan 'thab mo dam tshig dkrug /grogs ngan gyis dge sbyor bzang po spur// gtso 'dun gyi kha bzung las ngan gsog /yin min gyi gtogs dgra yi 'khor// phyogs cha yi g.yo sgyu sdig po che// dad zas khas len bsam ngan 'khrug /gshin zas kyi ro dom khyag mtha' med// khyod mi nag gi bla mchod shin tu lod// 'grogs shing brnyas na yi mug ldangs// tshang mang gi dpon po 'chi ka sdug /de bas ri khrod rnal 'byor pa// grong yul du lus na gyong re che// nga la phyi'i gangs la bsgom du 'gro/ khyed dad pa yod pas tshogs gsog mdzod// 'dir 'tshogs kyis yon bdag pho mo rnams// bla mchod byed zer bag chags bzang*// smon lam gyis 'brel pas yang yang mjal// zhes gsungs te yon bdag gshen rdor mo bza' tsho dang ston pa shaka gus dbu mdzad pa'i ban skye mang pos ci tsam bshol yang ma shol bar khong rnams kyis phye bre do/

'bras bre gang*/ sha gzugs phyed gnyis/ mar gshag gcig dang de rnams phul nas/ rje btsun la phyi'i gangs la byon song ngo*// de thams cad gshen rdor mo'i skor ro// ༈ de nas bzhi pa zas gos kyi 'dun pa dang bral ba'i yon tan ni/ gshen rdor mo la sogs pa ban skye drug gis bskyal nas khong rnams kyis kyang rje btsun gyi dgun brgyags khyer nas/ lo gsar gyis tshes gcig la 'ong ba'i chad byas pa la/ khong rnams sang 'gro gnangs 'gro zer ba la kha ba nyin mtshan bco brgyad babs pas/ zla ba drug gi bar du snye nam dang la phyi'i bar du 'grul pa chad/ yon bdag rnams kyi rje btsun grong bar thag bcad nas cho ga dang bdun tshigs mchod pa tshogs 'khor la sogs pa byas so// de nas phyis dbyug gu zla bar song ba dang*/ khong rnams gros byas nas rje btsun gyi gdung e rnyed la ban skye drug gis da rung kha ba tsag tsig yod pa gshag nas song bas/ gangs la ma thon bar la phyir log dgos par 'dug byas shing yod tsa/ pha bong zhig gi steng du gsa' chen po gcig byung bas// gsa' 'dis gdung zos zin byas nas 'bug na gangs gshag tsa/ gsa' rjes kyang mi rjes su song 'dug pas/ mi ma yin gyis cho 'phrul red byas nas phyir la ldog rtsis byas tsa/ rje btsun ni dben gnas bdud 'dul phug mo che bya ba nas/ dbyangs shig lhang lhang grags pas/ khong rnams dga' drag pas mgyogs par song tsa/ rje btsun gyi 'tsho ba gsol ma dgos par de gangs kyi rtsam pa la zan thul byas/ mar gyi zan mar byas/ 'bras tshod la sha btab nas me zhig bus nas bzhugs pa la/ khong rnams kyi la las phyag nas 'then 'then byas/ la la rje btsun lags zer/ la la ngu zhing dga' ches kyi ngu bro byed/ las las phyag mang po 'tshal lo// der rje btsun gyis khyed tsho 'ong ba'i sngon la nga 'ong le e mthong gsungs pas/ da ci gsa' cig 'ong ba min pa ma mthong zhus pas/

de nga yin phyi snang ba'i sprul bsgyur bstan pa tsam yin gyi gsungs/ da ci dbyangs shig lhang lhang grags pa de da rung gsung dang zhus pas/ khong tsho la de'i dus sbrul gnyis rked pa la 'khyud pa dang*/ sbal pa ra tsam zhig gis pho 'khyud du bsdam pa la sogs pa mang po byung bas dang po re skrag ste/ nyams su shes pa bde phyam phyam song skad do// de nas nyams rtogs pa'i 'khrungs lugs 'di mgur du gsungs so// rje bla ma'i zhabs la spyi bos btud/ byin brlab dngos grub mkha' 'gros byin// dam tshig gi bdun tshigs phan pa che// dad pa'i mchod pas dbang po gsos// bu slob kyis tshogs gsog bzang nas byung*// lta ba'i sems la stong nyid shar// blta rgyu'i dngos po rdul tsam med// blta bya dang lta byed gtor nas song*// lta ba'i rtogs tshul bzang nas byung*// bsgoms pa'i nyams la 'char sgo mang*/ bsgom rgyu'i thun 'tshams bzung rgyu med/ bsgom bya sgom byed stor nas song*// bsgoms pa'i snying rus bzang nas byung*// spyod pa'i rgyu 'bras stong nyid kyi ngang*// rten 'brel gyi brda la 'tshams pa med// spyod bya spyod byed kyang gtor nas byung*// spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyang bzang nas byung*// dam tshig gi khong zer yang dam nas byung*// ngos lkog gi chos brgyad bsgrib pa med// bsrung bya dang srung byed kyang stor nas song*// bla ma mnyes tshul yang bzang nas byung*// 'bras bu'i byang sems lus ngag rgyas// phyogs cha'i rtog sgrib dbyings su yal// bsgrub rgyu dang sgrub byed kyang stor nas song*// bdag gzhan gyi don chen yang bzang nas byung*// mi rgan gyi glu rgan gang la len// skyid dga'i nyams dbyangs brag la phog /bsgrub pa'i sku 'tshams kha bas bsdam// 'tsho ba'i zhabs rtogs lha 'dres byas// rdza brag gi 'bab chu btung ba'i mtsho// sus bsgrub med par dpal las grub// las byed mi med par so nams tshar// 'phral gsog 'jog med par bang mdzod khengs// las ngan pa zad nas rgyal sa zin// bu slob ma yon bdag 'khor bcas rnams// dad pas zhag tog byas pa la// drin len chos kyi 'jal ba yin// thugs dgyes par mdzod la bsod nams che// zhes pas/

yon bdag rnams dga' ste/ rje btsun lags sngar bas kyang sku mdang cher song zin pas/ 'tsho ba lha 'dres ji ltar sbyar/ nged tsho'i mchod pa bdun tshigs kyi ji ltar phan zhus pas phal cher ting nge 'dzin rang la song*/ re 'ga' phye thur mgo tsam re yang 'gam/ res 'ga' rgya gar nas mkha' 'gro mas tshogs dum pa re yang bskyal/ rta zla ba'i nya skor nas bzung ste khyed tshos bza' ba byin pa'i snang ba zhig la brten nas dang kha mer chi le byung bas ltogs pa'i snang ba med pa shas che gsung nas/ dpon slob tshes grangs brtsis pas bdun tshig dang gnyis 'grig nas byung bas/ gshin po la dge ba byas pas phan che bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas da yul du 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ nga 'di rang skyid/ khyed rang tsho song gsung pas da res ma byon na nged tsho bsad pa dang 'dra zhus pas/ der yul du dpon slob rnams byon pas/ rje btsun ma grong zin zer ba'i g.yer chen po byung nas mi mang po mjal du 'ong bas/ ma grongs pa srid zin zer zhing phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ skor ba la sogs byas shing bsnyun dri mang po byas pas/ mi rnams da lan min pa dad du ma nyan/ lha 'dre rnams snga mo nas dad/ mi bas lha 'dre dad yang ba dang phyi gzhung ring ba la ga par gda' gsungs pas khong der tshogs pa rnams dad pa'i gdab len/ kha ba'i babs tshul gangs mgur ring mo bya ba 'di gsungs so// dpal de ring bkra shis kyi khri gdugs la// phyogs kyi yon bdag pho mo rnams// 'o skol ma shi 'phrad pas glo ba dga'// nga mi rgan glu yi dkor mdzod yin// snyung dri rmed kyi len du glu gcig len// snyan lhan ne gson la thugs gtad 'tshal// yang stag gi lo yi lo mjug dang*// yos bu'i lo yi lo 'go la// wa rgyal zla ba'i nya drug la// nga 'khor ba'i chos la yid 'byung nas/ 'brog la phyi gangs kyi ra ba der// mi ngas kyang dben pa bsnyags nas phyin// khong gnam sa gnyis po gros byas nas// skyi ser rlung gi bang chen btang*/

'byung ba chu klung g.yos g.yos nas// lho sprin smug po 'dun mar bsdus// nyi zla zung gcig btson du bzung*// rgyu skar nyer brgyad star la brgyus// khrims kyis gza' brgyad lcags su bcug /dgu tshigs skya mo brtod la mnan// skar chen yongs la sbud kyis btab// sbud kyi mdangs g.yogs tha ma la// kha ba nyin dgu mtshan dgu babs// cha la nyin mtshan bco brgyad babs// che ba che ste bal 'dab tsam// 'dab chags bya ltar lding zhing babs/ chung ba chung ste 'phang lo tsam// bung ba lta bur 'khor zhing babs// yang chung sra ma 'bring po tsom// khu 'phang bzhin du 'dril zhing 'babs// lar kha ba che chung tshad las 'das// mtho gangs dkar rtse mo dgung dang mnyam// dma' rtsi shing nag mtshal rgya zhos mnan// mtsho rba rlabs can la dar chags btab// ri nag po rnams la sku dkar gsol// gtsang chab sngon mo sbubs su rub/ sa mtho dman med par thang du mnyam// babs de ltar che ba'i ngang nyid nas// spyir dbu nag mi la bzang btson byung*// rkang bzhi phyugs la mu ge byung*// sgos ri dwags dman ma'i 'tsho ba bcad// steng 'dab chags rnams la rgyags chad byung*// 'og bra ba byi ba gter du sbas// gcan gzan rnams la kha chings byung*// de 'dra'i skyi 'dangs kyi bskal pa la// nga mi la ras pa'i sgos skal du// steng nas babs pa'i kha ba dang*// lo gsar sgang gi lhags pa gnyis// rnal 'byor ras pa'i ras gos gsum// gangs dkar gyi stongs su 'khrugs pa shor// kha ba ma rgyal chu ru bzhu// rlung 'ar 'ur che yang rang zhir thal// ras gos me ltar 'bar zhing gda'// dpal la dor gyi 'khrug pa rgyal rgyal 'dra// gyad dpe bzhag gi shi srog de ru bsnol// mtshon rtse rgyal gyi ral kha de ru sprad// spyir sgom chen rnams la tshad rdo bor// sgos gtum mo ras kyi che ba bton// nad 'du ba rnam bzhi srang la 'jal// phyi nang 'khrul med gtan mnyam bgyis/

rlung tsha grang gnyis ka bcud la bor/ phyis ci zer nyan par kha yis blangs// skyi 'dangs kha ba'i gdon srin mnan// phyis g.yo 'gul med par gcig la phab// srid pa'i dmag dpung las ngan la// dus da res kyis 'khrug pa rnal 'byor rgyal// pha myes kyi tsha bo stag slag can// sdar wa slag gyon nas 'bros ma myong*// pha la bu skyes gyad kyi rigs// sdang dgra la sta zur 'chor ma myong*// nga gcan gzan rgyal po se ge'i rigs// gnas gangs khrod min par sdod ma myong*// shor lar yang bre mo bgyis pa lags// nga mi rgan gyi kha la gtad yod na// gru thob 'ga' re 'byon te mchis// mi la rnal 'byor ras pa nga*// rgyal khams yongs la grags te mchi// khyed bu slob rnams kyang dad de mchi// sho gam phyi nas zlo ste mchi// sgrub brgyud bstan pa dar te mchi// nga rnal 'byor sku khams bzang nas byung*// khyod yon bdag sku khams bde lags sam// zhes snye nam rtsar ma'i bu slob rnams la gsungs so// de nas yon bdag rnams kyis grong yul 'byon pa'i zhu ba bya pas/ nga la phyi'i gangs la bsgom bsgom pas/ grong yul du babs pas dbang po 'grib/ gsungs pas ri'i mgul cig tu bcug nas/ yon bdag gshen rdor mos 'go byas pa rnams kyis rje btsun ma grongs pa'i phye mar la chang dang ston mo'i tshogs 'khor mang du byas pa'i tshogs gral du/ rje btsun lags thugs la 'khrungs pa'i nyams dbyangs shig gsung bar zhu zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin brlabs sems la zhugs// gnas mi med 'grims pas rtogs pa shar// gnas do nub bkra shis kyi bzhugs gnas 'dir// khyed ston pa shāka gus dbu mdzad pa'i// gdan gang 'dzom pa'i bu slob rnams// smon lam dag pas mtshams sbyar nas// yon bdag rdor mo bza' tsho dang*/ dam tshig chos kyis 'brel pa yis// khyed bu slob rnams kyis zhu phul bas// byon skyems chos shig gnang 'tshal skad// don de la mtshan nyid 'di skad lo// ngas 'khor ba'i chos la yid byung bas// skyo nas la phyi'i gangs la phyin// dben gnas dpal gyi bdud 'dul phug

/zla drug bsgom pa'i nyams la shar/ gnad kyi mdo drug 'di ltar gda'// phyi yi yul drug dper bzhag nas// nang gi skyon drug gtan la 'bebs// mi thar 'ching ba sgrog drug la// thabs kyis grol ba'i lam drug mthong*// klong drug gdings su gyur pa la// nyams la bde ba rnam drug shar// glu de rjes bskyar nas ma blangs nas// don de la thugs su mi 'byon pas// tshig brda' yis bkrol bas skad cig nyon// thogs rdugs yod na nam mkha' min// grangs kyis long na skar phran min// g.yo 'gul yod na ri bo min// 'phri bsnan yod na rgya mtsho min// zam pas sleb na chu bo min// bzung du yod na 'ja' tshon min// de ni phyi yi dpe drug yin// gza' gtad yod na lta ba min// bying rgod yod na bsgom pa min// blang dor yod na spyod pa min// rnam rtog yod na rnal 'byor min/ 'char nub yod na ye shes min// skye 'chi yod na sangs rgyas min// de ni rnal 'byor skyon drug yin// zhe sdang che na dmyal ba'i sgrogs// ser sna che na yi dwags sgrogs// gti mug che na byol song sgrogs// 'dod chags che na mi yi sgrogs// phrag dog che na lha min sgrogs// nga rgyal che na lha yi sgrog /de mi thar 'ching ba'i sgrogs drug lags// dad pa che na thar pa'i lam// mkhas btsun bstan na thar pa'i lam// dam tshig gtsang ba thar pa'i lam// ri khrod 'grim na thar pa'i lam// gcig pur sdod na thar pa'i lam// sgrub pa byed na thar pa'i lam// de thabs kyis grol ba'i lam drug yin// lhan cig skyes pa gnyug ma'i klong*// phyi nang med pa rig pa'i klong*// gsal 'grib med pa ye shes klong*// bdal ba med pa chos kyis klong*// 'pho 'gyur med pa thig le'i klong*// rgyun chad med pa nyams kyi klong*// de rnams gdings chen klong drug lags// lus la gtum mo 'bar bas bde// rlung ro rkyang dhu tir 'dus pas bde// stod byang chub sems kyi rgyun bab bde// smad dwangs ma'i thig les khyab pas bde// bar dkar dmar thug 'phrad bsre bas bde// lus zag med bde bas tshim pa bde// de rnal 'byor nyams kyi bde drug lags// da gnad kyi mdo drug nyams kyi dbyangs// zla drug bsgom pa'i nyams dbyangs 'di// khyed bu slob 'dzom pa'i dga' ston mdzod// lar mi dga' ba rnams tshogs pa da res tsam// chang bdud rtsi 'thung ba la nye bzang*// nga mi rgan glu rgan len pa yi// khyed bu slob rnams kyi ngo ma chog

/thugs dgyes par bkra shis chos la 'bungs// lam dgyes pa'i smon lam 'grub par shog /ces gsungs pas/ der tshogs pa'i yon bdag bu slob rnams dad par gyur cing*/ 'bul ba mang po byed zer ba ma bzhes te snye nam gyi ri la byon nas bzhugs so// de thams cad gangs mgur gyi skor ro/// /de nas lnga pa nyams myong bde bar shar ba'i yon tan ni/ snye nam gyi ri zhig la bzhugs pas rkyen bzang ngan thams cad bde bar lam lam shar bar byung bas chos zhu mi mang po byung ba'i zla la bu chung kha ser ba bya ba zhig 'ong pas/ rje btsun gyis mgur gsungs pa la/ yengs nas long rung la lus pas sgom gtad med la skyes na/ dbyangs la chags nas zhag tu lus pas mi tshos rje btsun la phul bas/ khrid gsungs nas bsgom du bcugs pas nyams bzang po skyes pa dang*/ bla ma mnyes nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// sprang nyams len bde bar byin gyis rlobs// khyod gsar pa'i khrid phrug nga la nyon// las dge sdig g.yo sgyu'i grong khyer na// bu skal ba ma chad lha chos dran// lam log par ma song nga dang 'phrad/ tshogs tshogs bsags pa'i sgom sgrub byed// byin rlabs kyi nyams rtogs na bun skyes/ skyes pas mi chog mgo 'don dgos// mgo bo 'don pa'i man ngag 'di rnams bzung*/ dben gnas ri khrod 'grim dus su// grong yul gyi ltad mo ma dran cig /dran na rang sems bdud kyis g.yengs// bsgom snying rus kyi gnad nas 'don dus su// sdug bsran gyis la rang mgo thon// zab mo'i sgom khrid zhu dus su// slob gnyer gyi shes 'dod ma che zhig /'dod na grong pa'i chos spyod dran// dran na mi tshe stong zad 'ong*// nyam chung gyis la rang mgo thon// nyams rtogs myug myug skye dus su// brjod 'dod kyi rang rtsis ma che zhig /brjod na ma dang mkha' 'gro 'khrugs// yengs med bsgom zhing rang mgo thon// bla ma dang mnyam du 'grogs dus su// bzang ngan gyi skyon yon ma brtags shig

/brtags na skyon gyi phung por mthong*// dag snang gyis la rang mgo thon// mched grogs dang dbang gral thun dus su// gral mgo dang kha rgan ma 'dod cig /'dod na chags sdang gi dam tshig 'khrugs/ mthun par gyis la rang mgo thon// grong yul ldom bu byed dus su// chos zog gis mi mgo ma g.yeng zhig /g.yeng na rang nyid ngan 'gror ltung*// las drang por gyis la rang mgo thon// lar dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// rang rtsis dang rang 'dod ma che zhig /che na chos pa'i gzugs kyis drang bar 'gro// rdzun zol zog spong la rang mgo thon// rang mgo 'don pa'i skyes bu la// rang drin che ba'i gdams ngag rnams// rang gzhan don du da rung ster// byin na snying gi dkyil du bzung*// zhes gsungs te/ bu chung de la ras chung ba bya ba'i slob ma zhig byung bas dpon slob gnyis 'grogs nas ri khrod 'gol pa ru 'gro gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ bla ma lags/ da rung 'di rang du 'dug pa skyid zhus pas/ bla mas kho yi zhen pa zlog pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin rlabs ri khrod 'grim// ri na bun sprang po'i gtan yul skyid// rang gcig pu'i lus la lha tshogs 'khor/ lha drin can 'khor ba ngang gi skyid// ma mkha' 'gro mi med lung par 'byon// mkha' 'gro'i brda skad rnams kyi zhi ba skyid// sgom bzang po bar chad med pas skyid// nyams rtogs sems la shar bas nga re skyid// grogs bzang po bsod nams bsags la 'khor// sgom snying rus can yod na thugs sems skyid// zas bzang po dkor med rang 'tsho zhim// nang ting 'dzin gyi zas mchog zos shing skyid// sgom bzang po dran shes gnyen po mang*/ 'phral yengs med btung ba 'thung zhing tshim// sgom rang mgo thon pa'i sgom chen la/ gnas gang du song yang shin tu skyid// bu ras chung zhen 'khris skyid 'dod chod// las long med mi rtag go cha gyon// gnas mi med kyi dben par bsgom du 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/

ras chung pas/ bla ma lags/ ri khrod bsgom du 'gro ba la brgyags chu dum pa re med na re med pas/ snye nam tshong 'dus na tshogs mang po yod pas bsod snyoms byed nas gang gsungs pa'i gnas la 'gro zhus nas/ dpon slob gnyis bsod snyoms la byon tsa/ phar la nye ba dang tshong pas ni sems can mang po bsod snya'i dmar 'tshong pa cig red pas/ sha mang po brtsigs khrag mang po pags pa'i nang du bskyil/ mgo mang po brtsigs pa yung ma spungs spungs byas nas tsar 'dug pa rnams/ rje btsun gyis gzigs pas/ phyi nud phyi nud mdzad pas/ ras chung pa la ma 'gro ma 'gro/ nga 'jigs nga 'jigs/ mi re re'i kha gso ba la sems can pha ki tsam bsad 'dug /sdig pa khams po che byed pa'i rtsar 'gro mi dgos rlung khar yang 'gro mi rung*/ mi 'chi ba ma dran pa dang 'phrad tsa/ skyabs 'gro rang dbang med par 'khrugs le yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// thar pa'i gnas la yar ltos dang*// a tsa ma sdig can snying re rje// las re rmongs mi yi lod pa la// zhe re 'phong sems can gyi gsod lugs la// gyong re che rang nor gyi mgo bo la// ji ltar song sha yi brtsigs lugs la// ji ltar byed khrag gi mang lugs la// ji tsam ltogs sha yi za lugs la// ci re byed snying rje med lugs la// ci tsam las sgrib rmongs gti mug la/ ci re byung zhe sdang gi so nam la// su yis rtsis 'dod pa'i gdung lugs la// gang gis dran yul lugs kyi skyags pa la// ci ltar byed skye bo'i 'phong pa la// gang du 'gro yi mug gi che lugs la// cug song pha ki tsho'i brel ba la/ pha ki tsho mthong zhing 'jigs pa la// sdig spyod tsho dran zhing snang ba 'khrugs// ras chung pa lha chos shig e dran ang*// dran na skyo shas kyi snying rlung skye// bsgom na ri khrod kyi gnas su gshegs// bsam na bla ma'i bka' drin som// bros nas sdig can gyi sa nas bros/

gtong na 'jig rten gyis bya ba thong*/ 'dzin na sgrub pa'i dam bca' 'dzin/ shes na mi tshe chos la dril// ces gsungs pas/ ras chung ba yang ba spu tsha zeng ba cig byung*/ rje btsun la ni spyan chab mang po byung ngo*// der ras chung pas da gang du 'gro zhus pas/ da bsgom du ri khrod du 'gro gsungs nas/ bsgom gshegs mi rtag pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// las ngan sgrib pa'i mun pas gnag /rnam rtog gi rkun ma mang la rgod// sems nyid nor bu 'chor las che// yeng med mel tshe byed re ran// mi pha ki tsho 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/ nged rang ras chung gnyis bsdebs la bsgom du gshegs// 'khor ba'i rgyud nas lam 'phrang ring*// dug lnga'i jag pa 'tshub la rgod// bu rigs pa'i khye'u chung 'dzin las che/ ye shes kyi skyel ma btsal re ran// mi pha gi tsho 'chi ba 'ong snyam med// nged rang ras chung gnyis bsdebs la bsgom du gshegs// skyon gyi ri bo dpang re mtho// nyon mongs kyi rngon pa khyi re bzang*// ting 'dzin gyi ri dwags gsod la che// yang dag gi mtha' la 'bros re ran// mi pha ki 'tsho 'chi ba 'ong snyam med// nged rang ras chung gnyis bsdebs la bsgom du gshegs// sgyu ma lus kyi khang rul la// zhag dang za ma'i char pa 'babs// lo dang zla ba'i thig pa byung*// sgyu lus kyis khang rgan 'gyel las che// da 'chi brod thig tshag byed re ran// mi pha ki tsho 'chi ba 'ong snyam med// nged rang ras chung gnyis bsdebs la bsgom du gshegs// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting re zab// rig pa'i nya chung rkyal re ran/ g.yo 'khrug gis rba la g.yeng las che// da gnyis med kyi klong du 'bros re ran// mi pha ki tsho 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/ nged rang ras chung gnyis bsdebs la bsgom du gshegs/ 'khrig chags bde ba'i na thang na// khyim thab dug gi 'dam rdzab rgyas// sems nyid glang po tshud nas zin// thar pa'i skam sa bsnyags re ran// mi pha ki tsho 'chi ba 'ong snyam med// nged rang ras chung gnyis bsdebs nas bsgom du gshegs// theg dman gyi lta bsgom g.yang sa che// blo dman gyi byis pa bya byed mang*// rig drug gi g.yang la lhung las che// chos theg chen gyi btsan sa 'dzin re ran// mi pha ki tsho 'chi ba 'ong snyam med/

nged rang ras chung gnyis bsdebs nas bsgom du gshegs/ zhes gsungs te lho mon gyi ri khrod zhig tu dpon slob gnyis gshegs nas byon te/ de thams cad ras chung zhal mjal gyi skor ro/// /de nas drug pa rtogs pa lam du shar ba'i yon tan ni/ snyen nam du bsod nams chen po skyes pas gang snang rtogs par 'khyer ma shes na re med gsungs nas/ mis mi rnyed pa'i 'tsho ba dkon pa/ sdod snying mi 'dod pa'i shing phug cig tu bzhugs pas/ ras chung pas/ 'di 'dra na mi zug par 'dug /chu yang len dka' bar 'dug pas mthun rkyen dum pa yod pa/ gang la yang mi 'gal ba'i sa zhig tu byon nas bzhugs dgos zhus pas/ ras chung pa/ khab rtse gnyis kyi bzo mi 'ong*// sems rtse gnyis kyis don mi 'grub// tshe 'dir e skyid la chos pa'i ming med// ces gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i rnam thar sems la gcags// gsung zhal da'i bdud rtsi brjed thabs med// chos long yod la bzhag na skal ba chad// chos rang rgyud la bsres la 'bungs la bsgom// tshe 'di la chags na phyi ma sdug /'phral skyid 'dod la dga' na bar chad che// chos long yod bsam na glan pa yin// rang 'chi bas 'jig na 'bungs la bsgom// las sdig pa spyod na ngan 'gror ltung*// sems g.yo zol 'dug na rang nyid brlag /rang bsam ngan skyes na bsod nams 'dzad// las rnam smin sbyong na 'bungs la bsgom// gos bzang po gyon 'dod snang ba 'khrul// zas zhim po za 'dod sdig spyod rem// gtam snyan po 'ong 'dod lha kha gdug /blo chos brgyad spong la 'bungs la bsgom// nor phyug po 'ong 'dod dgra dang 'phrad// 'khor mang po'i bskor 'dod blo 'gyod che// tshogs mang mang bsags 'dod log lta che// blo chos dang bstun la 'bungs la bsgom// sgom nus na rtogs pa sems la 'char/ bsgom ma nus kha bshad khram pa'i shag /yun ring por bsdod long ma mchis pas// yengs med du bsgom dang gar yang spro// rog med du sdod dang cis yang drag

/sgom gsal stong gi bsam gtan rin po che// bu ras chung gi snying la gnas par shog /ces gsungs pas/ ras chung pa yang snang ba 'gyur nas bsgom pas nyams rtogs bzang po skyes nas sems dwangs snyig phyes pa'i rgyu 'bras rang sa nas shar nas/ ras chung pas rtogs dpyod sgyu ma'i nyams dbyangs 'di phul lo// pha bla ma'i bka' drin lha chos byed/ sems 'phreng ba'i drin chen pha ma bskyur// spangs dka' ba'i pha yul rgyab tu spangs/ grogs nye du'i gdungs sems da rung 'dug /'phral zas nor gos gsum gsog 'jog bshol// ser sna sdug sogs mthun rkyen med// dka' thub mthun rkyen bcud len gyi brag la bsgom// sems gsog 'jog gi snang ba da rung 'dug /mjal ni grub thob dngos dang mjal// thob ni snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thob// bsgom ni yeng med kyi brtson 'grus byed// mjal 'dod dang zhu 'dod da rung 'dug /byed ni pha yi zhabs tog byed// sgrub ni tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub// bzhugs ni ri khrod gyis gnas su bzhugs// bya lo dang byed lo da rung 'dug /rje mi skyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// bu yi snang ba 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod ri khrod kyi gnas su bag chags kyi snang ba spun/ mi dran dgu dran gyi drang ba cig 'ong ba la tshegs med/ mi shes dgu shes kyi chen po zhig 'dod na/ mgo g.yogs kyi zog po zhig 'ong ba la tshegs med// ces gsungs nas ras chung pa'i sems rtog sel ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin brlab ri la zhugs// gnas ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// khyod skal ba can gyi ras chung pa/ sems dbang po bsgrim la glu 'di nyon// dben gnas ri khrod 'grim dus na// nye ba'i kha ches ma dran zhig /dran na dgra sdang gson lang byed// bla ma'i drung du bsgom dus na/ tshogs gsog kha len ma dran zhig

/dran na spyod ngan dmag dpung 'khrugs// 'byung po'i gtor ma gtong dus na// gtor ril gyi gsog 'jog ma dran zhig /dran na rang nyid 'byung por 'gro// yeng med kyi bsam gtan bsgom dus na// grogs po la mjal 'phrad ma dran zhig /dran na mched grogs kyi dge sbyor spur// dka' thub kyi snying rus byed dus su// sha chang gi zhim lto ma dran zhig /dran na yi dwags kyi gnas su skye// snyan brgyud kyi thabs lam bsgom dus su// shes 'dod kyi slob gnyer ma dran zhig /dran na log pa'i lam du 'jug /mon gyi shing rir sdod dus su// 'gro 'dod kyi bya ra ma dran zhig /dran na yid ngan 'phral la ldang*// bu snying rus lha chos mgo bo thon// sdug khur gyi 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spong*// smon lam dang 'brel pa'i bu slob la// pha yi rtogs pa skye bar shog /snang srid chos skur rtogs pa 'di// bu yi nyams la rdzogs par shog /ces gsungs pa dang ras chung pa'i thugs legs par 'gyur nas ri la zug pa dang*/ bsgom la 'phel skyed chen po byung nas bla ma dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral ang bsam pa'i nges shes drag po skyes nas/ thugs dam 'phel ba dang*/ 'khor ba la zhen pa log ste/ yang nyams rtogs gong du 'phel ba'i don du mgur 'di gsungs so// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas// lus sha khrag gi phung po sdig po che// gzugs sha khrag lus la chags chags nas// skye shi'i rtsa gdar chod dus med// sems gzhi rtsa chod cig ras chung pa// ma rig 'khrul pa'i grong khyer na// gti mug gi rnam rtog sdig po che// don med nye ring byed byed nas// sems btang snyoms ngang la gnas dus med// sems chag sdang skyur cig ras chung pa// mtho mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings shed na// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas zhal bzhugs mkhan// chos drang don bslu brid gsung gsung nas// da nges pa'i don la rtogs dus med// sems spros pa chod cig ras chung pa// lung rig gnyis kyi bar do na/

gzung 'dzin nga bdag gi sdig po che// glo bur gyi rkyen kha 'grim 'grim nas// sems gnas lug ngang la gnas dus med/ sems klod la zhog cig ras chung pa// skye 'chi gnyis kyi bar do na// bar do'i rnam shes sdig po che// lus med lus dang 'grogs 'grogs nas// sems chos nyid kyi ma dang mjal dus med// sems btsan sa bzung zhig ras chung pa// chos lta ba dang bsgom pa spyod pa gsum// tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// gcig tu dril la nyams su longs// zhes dang*/ yang nyams len 'di gsungs so// 'chi bdag gshin rje'i pho nya la/ dus la nges pa mi gda' na// glo bur du shi na yid re mug /da lta rang nas 'chi ches gyis// zang zing sgyu ma'i nor rdzas kyang*// gzhan gyi spyod na nyon mongs skye// shul du lus na mi yis 'phya// zhen chags med pa'i sbyin pa thong*/ tha snyad tshig gi dam chos kyang*// slob par dka' la phan yon chung*// shes nas nga rgyal 'dod pa skyes// bla ma'i gsung bzhin nyams su longs// grong yul yon bdag ngo srung yang*// mgu ba nyung la 'khang ba mang*// bslab nyes lags su ma btang zhig /bya ba thong la ri khrod bzung*// rtag tu dgos pa'i lto gos kyang*// bzang por byas kyang tshim pa med/ ngan par byas kyang de ka tsam// rtsol sgrub skyur la sdug bsran bskyed/ sems skyo ba skyes pa'i dbyangs chung 'di// sems la zhog cig ras chung pa// zhes gsungs pas/ nyams dang rtogs pa gong du 'phel ba byung ngo*// de thams cad mon gyi shing ri'i skor ro/// /de nas dpon slob gnyis sing gha la yi nags ka ti shel phug nam mkha' rdzong bya ba na bsgom zhing yod pa la/ yon bdag gshen rdor mos 'gos byas snye nam pa'i mi brgyad kyis brgyags dum pa re khur nas ma rnyed tsam byung bas/ rje btsun lags/ 'dir mthun rkyen mi 'dzoms pa/ blo sdug pa'i ri 'dir mi bzhugs par bod la 'byon par zhu zhus pas/

gnas 'di sdug zer du mi rung 'dir skyid gsungs nas gnas la bstod pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin rlabs gnas la zhugs// mon gyi shing ri bde ba'i mkhar/ spang ri me tog bkra ba'i yul// ljon shing gar stabs byed pa'i gseb// spra spre'u rtsed mo rtsed pa'i sa/ bya skad sna tshogs sgrogs pa'i gnas// 'bung ba lang ling 'phur ba'i sa/ nyin mtshan med par 'ja' ris 'khyug /dbyar dgun med par sbrang char 'babs// ston dpyid med par na bun 'khrigs// de lta bu yi dben gnas na// nga mi la ras pa rnal 'byor pa// sems stong nyid bsgom pa'i 'od gsal bde// 'char sgo mang na shin tu bde/ mthon dman che na de bas bde// lus ngan slong ba'i skye gzugs bde// sna tshogs 'khrugs na shin tu bde// 'jigs snang che na de bas bde// nyon mongs shi 'chi'i shi 'bras bde// gdug rtsub che na shin tu bde// na tsha mang na de bas bde// sdug bsngal bde bar gyur bas bde/ nyams shugs las 'khrul 'khor shin tu bde// mchongs rgyug gar stabs de bas bde// ngag byung rgyal glu yi dkor mdzod bde// tshig snyan pa'i dal dbyangs shin tu bde// sgra sna tshogs bsgyur na de bas bde// sems ngar drang gi spros pa dbyings su bde/ rang shugs kyi rang shar shin tu bde// sna tshogs su shar na de bas bde// nyams bde zhing skyid pa'i rnal 'byor la// bu dad can mjal ba'i byon skyems mdzod// ces gsungs pas yon bdag rnams na re/ khyod la nyams bzang po yod pa thugs la btags/ nyams bzang po yod pa nged tshos shes te gnas 'di la lam bzang po mi 'dug pas/ 'o brgyal dogs pa lags zhus pas gnas 'di shin tu bde/ khyed tshos ma brtags pa yin gsungs nas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// gnas ri khrod shing ri'i dben gnas 'dir// 'og na spra ba'i 'bol chung bde// 'gro 'dug med pas yang yang bde// lus la bal po'i shing bal bde/

rtsol bsgrub med pas yang yang bde// nang du gtum mo 'bar bas bde/ grang dro med pa'i yang yang bde// ngag la smra ba bcad pas bde// lab rogs med pas yang yang bde// dbugs la 'gro 'ong med pas bde/ rgyu ba khegs pas yang yang bde/ sems la dogs pa med pas bde// bying rgod med pas yang yang bde// ting 'dzin 'od gsal shar bas bde// gsal 'grib med na yang yang bde// nor la 'dzin chags med pas bde// zhen pa med na yang yang bde// zas la ser sna med pas bde/ sred pa med na yang yang bde// gnyen la 'brel pa med pas bde// zhe gdung med na yang yang bde/ dgra la zhe sdang med pas bde// kun dang mthun na yang yang bde/ gnyis su med pa'i lta ba bde// ngos bzung med na yang yang bde// rgyun chad med pa'i sgom pa bde// mnyam rjes med na yang yang bde/ tshul 'chos med pa'i spyod pa bde/ spang blangs med na yang yang bde// theg pa che chung med pas bde// don gcig tu rtogs na de bas bde// sems la ji ltar byas kyang bde// rtsol sgrub med na yang yang bde// rnal 'byor ras pa'i bde ba 'dis// sems can thams cad bde bar shog /ces gsungs pas yon bdag rnams na re/ khyed de bzhin bde ba 'dis gar song yang bde/ gar bzhugs la khyad med pas nged kyi yul du'ang 'byon yang e ma bde bas 'byon bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i bka' drin chos kyi 'jal// chos byin brlabs dbang bskur rang rgyud smin// rgyud zab mo man ngag glu ru len// khyed 'dir bzhugs snyan gyi dbang po gtod// gangs dkar gyi seng lcam dkar mo de// seng gangs dkar klong du 'dug stangs 'gying*// seng srog chags 'jigs pa ma mchis te// gangs stod 'dzin pa ya tshul yin/ brag dkar gyi thang dkar rgod po de// gshog drug nam mkha'i dbyings su brkyangs// rgod g.yang la lhung dogs ma yin te// nam 'phang bskyod pa ya tshul yin// ma ki chu bo'i rgya mtsho na// nya sram ma bus yang rtsal sbyangs// nya 'tshub kyis dogs pa ma lags te// gya gyur 'khyugs pa ya tshul yin// mon gyi shing ri'i lo ma la// spra spre'u rtsed mo rtse ba de// sprel 'gyel gyi dogs pa ma yin te// rtse snang mang ba rang gshis yin// shing gseb nags kyi sa 'phrang na// rgya stag khra bos yang rtsal sbyong*// stag 'jigs kyis dogs pa ma yin te/

rtsal gsum rdzogs pa rang gshis yin// nag gseb ka ti'i rdzong gseb tu// rnal 'byor ras pas stong nyid bsgom// bsgom shor gyis dogs pa ma lags te// sgom yun du bsring ba ya tshul yin// chos nyid dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor na// yengs pa med par lta ba de// don nor gyis dogs pa ma yin te// gnad rang sa 'dzin pa ya tshul yin// nang cho 'phrul ting 'dzin rten 'brel la// gegs dang gol sa 'khrugs pa de// chos skyon chen yin pa ma lags te// rtags myur du ston pa'i kha po yin// rang shar spyod pa'i rang 'gros la// mtho dman rnam 'gyur mang ba de// blo gnyis snang gi rtog pa ma lags te// brda sna tshogs snang ba rten 'brel yin// las rgyu 'bras 'bras bu smin pa la// dge sdig gi rang gzugs mthong ba de// sgom gol sar song ba ma lags te// rig so sor gsal ba'i bden tshig yin// sgom rang tshugs thub pa'i sgom chen des// 'jig rten la sred pa chung ba de/ gtam zer lo'i snyan grags ma yin te// 'phral zhen pa log pa dam tshig yin// chos zab mo bsgoms pa'i rnal 'byor la// ri dang brag la skye ba de// zob dang tho co ma lags te/ rtse gcig tu bsgom pa rang 'dod yin// ras pa'i glu dbyangs mang po de// yengs 'dod kyi kha khram ma yin te// spro dga'i yon bdag dad pa can// phan pa'i snying gtam sems la bzung*// zhes gsungs pas der 'ong ba'i yon bdag dad pa can rnams shin tu dad pas phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas te yul du song ngo*// de thams cad sing gha la yi nags gseb kyi skor ro/// /de nas yang yul nas khrid zhu ba'i ban dhe lnga tsam zhig byung bas/ snyan brgyud kyi khrid zhus nas bsgom pas chos la snying rus dang*/ 'dod pa chung zhing ras thub par byung bas de rnams la zhal ta bdud rtsi'i nyams dbyangs 'di mgur du gsungs so// rje btsun bla ma chos kyi sku// 'gag med thar pa'i lam ston pa// mdzad pa'i thugs rje 'gro ba'i bdag

/rtse gcig sems la gnas par byin gyis rlobs// snyan brgyud zab mo sgom pa skal pa bzang*// khyed gzhon nu rab tu byung dus su// rang rtsis rang 'dod ma che zhig /ches na dge sdig sna tshogs spyod// spyad na ngan 'gror ltung bar 'gyur/ bla ma'i zhabs tog byed dus su// ngas byas dang khong yus ma che zhig /ches na dpon slob re chod 'dzol// 'dzol na bsam pa'i don mi 'grub// sdom pa dam tshig bsrung dus su// mi nag gi grong du ma nyal zhig /nyal na mig slong ngan pa skye// skyes na dam tshig gis sdom pa 'chor// thos pa slob gnyer byed dus su// tha snyad nga rgyal ma che zhig /ches na dug lnga'i me ro ldang*// ldang na dge sbyor gyi bsam pa 'khrug /mched grogs dang lhan du bsgom dus su// bya rgyu dang byed rgyu ma mang zhig /mang na zab mo'i dge sbyor spur// spur na chos kyi skal pa chad// thabs lam snyan brgyud bsgom dus su/ byin rlabs 'dre brdung ma dran zhig / dran na rang rgyud 'dre ru ldang*// ldang na grong pa'i chos spyod rem// nyams dang rtogs pa shar dus su// mngon shes dang rang tshod ma lab cig /lab na gsang ba'i brda' skad 'chor// shor na nyams rtogs kyi yon tan 'grib// skyon du shes pas spangs bar mdzod// sdig spyod kyi khram zas ma za bar// gshin po'i khu ru ma khur bar// ngo srung gi 'dun pa ma sgrigs par// nyams chung chos 'go brag las thon// zhes gsungs pas/ yang ras pa rnams kyis gser dum pa re 'dug pa phul nas/ lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad 'gag gi chos re zhu zhus pas/ gser khyed rang tsho'i sgrub pa'i brgyags gyis gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i lta sgom spyod pa'i 'gros// rang grub tu gnas par byin gyis rlobs// lta ba 'di la gzer gsum gda'// sgom pa 'di la gzer gsum gda'// spyod pa 'di la gzer gsum gda'/

'bras bu 'di la gzer gsum gda'// lta ba'i gzer gsum bshad tsa na// snang srid sems su 'dus te gda'/ sems nyid gsal pa'i ngang du gda'// de la ngos bzung med par gda'// bsgom pa'i gzer gsum bshad tsa na// rnam rtog chos skur grol bar gda'// rig gsal bde ba'i ngang du gda'// ma bcos mnyam par bzhag par gda'// spyod pa'i gzer gsum bshad tsa na// dge bcu spyod pa'i shugs las 'char/ sdig bcu rang bzhin gnas su 'dag /gnyen po gsal stong bcos su med// 'bras bu'i gzer gsum bshad tsa na// myang 'das gnas su sgrub rgyu med// 'khor ba gzhan du spangs pa med// rang sems sangs rgyas su blo thag chod// gzer gsum nang nas gzer cig 'debs// gzer ni chos nyid stong pa'i gzer// 'debs mkhan bla ma dam pas rim gyis mdzad// mang du spyod na thebs mi 'gyur// lhan cig rtogs na theb pa yin/ spyir chos mdzad rnams kyi spyi nor yin// rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs// khyed bu slob rnams kyi thugs dam mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ ras pa rnams kyis zhus pas de lta bu'i chos de la bla ma rang bsgom pas e chog zhus pa la yang mgur 'di gsungs so// gru thob bla ma rje btsun de// mun pa sel ba'i lam mkhan yin// skyo ngal med pa'i dad pa 'di// bde 'gror 'khrid pa'i lam mkhan yin// dbang po lnga yi rtogs pa de/ thug 'phrad bsgom pa'i lam mkhan yin// bla ma dang gdams ngag slob ma gsum// snying rus dang sdug bsran dad pa gsum// shes rab dang snying rje mi gzhi gsum// 'di gsum rgyun gyi lam mkhan yin// 'du 'dzi med pa'i dben pa 'di// bsam gtan skyong ba'i lam mkhan yin// bka' rgyud bla ma'i zhal gdams de/ sku gsum ston pa'i lam mkhan yin// skyabs yul dkon mchog gsum po 'di// nor ba med pa'i lam mkhan yin// lam mkhan drug gis sna drangs nas// snang med bde chen lam du 'gro// spros med mi rtog ngang la sdod// rang shes rang grol gyi rang yul skyid/

nges shes don shes kyi rang tshugs zin// rgyal khams mi med kyi lung stong du// rnal 'byor gyi skyid glu 'brug bzhin sgrogs// snyan pa'i char pa phyogs bcur 'babs// snying rje'i me tog lo 'dab rgyas// byang sems gyi 'bras bu dag par smin// byang chub kyi 'phrin las thams cad rgyas// zhes gsungs so// yang bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ngas skye ba med pa'i gdings shig rnyed// snga phyi gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag /rigs drug gi snang ba rdzun du thal// skye shi gnyis kyi sgro 'dogs chod// gnyis su med pa'i gdings shig rnyed// lus sems gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag /tshogs drug gi snang ba rdzun du thal// dngos por 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod// mnyam pa gnyis kyi gdings shig rnyed// bde sdug gnyis su 'dzin pa dag /tshor ba'i nyams myong rdzun du thal// spang blang gnyis kyi sgro 'dogs chod// dbye ru med pa'i gdings shig rnyed// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag /sa lam sbyangs pa rdzun du thal// zhes gsungs pas/ ras pa rnams na re/ gnas dang bla ma 'dzoms pa'i slob ma nged tsho skyid par byung bas/ dben gnas 'di 'tsho bas dben pa'i gnas dgon pa 'ga' zhig brtsigs dgos zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ dgon pa brtsigs mi dgos/ nga yi brag phug 'di rang skyid/ 'di dpa' gro stag tshang gis phug pa bya ba yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i zhabs drung sdod pa'i tshe/ thugs rje'i bka' drin byin brlab mkhar// da 'jigs kyis dogs snyam bdag la med// ngas grang gis dogs nas gos shig btsal// gos de ni gtum mo lhun grub gos// da grang gis dogs snyam bdag la med/ ngas dbul gyi dogs nas nor zhig btsal// nor de ni 'phags pa'i nor mchog bdun// da dbul gyis dogs snyam bdag la med// ngas ltogs kyis dogs nas zas shig btsal// zas de ni chos nyid ting 'dzin zas// da ltogs kyis dogs snyam bdag la med// ngas skom gyi dogs nas hub cig btsal// skom de na dran shes bdud rtsi chang*// da skom gyi dogs snyam bdag la med// ngas skyo yi dogs nas grogs shig btsal/

grogs de ni bde stong sgyu ma'i grogs// da skyo yi dogs snyam bdag la med// ngas nor yi dogs nas lam zhig btsal// lam de ni zung 'jug yangs pa'i lam// da nor gyis dogs snyam bdag la med// sgos 'dod dgu tshang ba'i rnal 'byor pa// gnas gang du bsdad kyang skyid par 'dug /stag tshang dpal gro seng ge'i phug /stag mo'i ngar skad skyi sha tsha// des dbang med du sku mtshams bsdams su bcug /stag phrug gi tsi tshos snying rje skyes// des dbang med byang chub bsgrub tu bcug /spre'u yi skyal sgras zhe ba gcu// des dbang med du skyo shas skye ru bcug /sprel phrug gi mya sgras rgod snying 'dod// des dbang med du sems bskyed bsgom du bcug /khu byug gi ngag snyan yid rtsa g.yo// des dbang med du mchi ma 'chor du bcug /lco ga'i 'gyur skad rna bar snyan/ des dbang med du snang ba skyid du byung*/ bya rigs kyi skad rigs sna tshogs kyi// rnal 'byor gyi 'dug rogs sems la phan// gnas 'di 'drar bsdad na ngang gis skyid// rogs gcig kyang med na de bas skyid// rnal 'byor skyid pa'i nyams dbyangs 'dis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel bar shog /ces gsungs pas/ der 'ong pa'i ras pa rnams kyang skyo shas bzang po skyes nas dge sbyor la brtson ting nger song nas dpon slob rnams thugs dam 'phel bar byung ngo*// de thams cad dpal gro stag tshang gi skor ro/// /de nas bdun pa snang ba mthun rkyen du shar ba'i yon tan ni/ lam mi bde ba chu sgra che ba/ mthun 'jug dka' ba'i gnas brag gseb cig tu byon song ba dang*/ 'di mi bde bar 'dug zhus pas/ 'di shin tu bde btsan dro skyid phug nyi ma rdzong bya ba yin gsung nas gnas la bstod pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma ri khrod nags kyi gseb// brag dkar skyid phug nyi ma rdzong*// btsan la bag yangs shes pa bde// nyams rgyud la skye ba'i dben sa 'dir// rig pa dwangs shing shes pa bde// rgyu 'grul med pas snang ba bde// me shing 'dzoms pas ngang gi bde// kha skad mi tshor chags sdang zad// ri brag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'dra// rgyab ri lha yi pho brang 'dra// mdun ri ma yi pang dang 'dra// g.yas ri rgyal mtshan 'phyar ba 'dra// g.yon ri pad ma bye ba 'dra// shing lo mchod pa'i lha mo 'dra// shing thog rtsi bcud 'bras bu 'dra// chu dang chu phran khrus bum 'dra/

stag dang gcan gzan sgo khyi 'dra/ bya dang ri dwags nor phyugs 'dra// spra dang spre'u khyim mtshes 'dra// na bun 'ja' tshon rma g.yang 'dra// sbrang char zim bu mchod sprin 'dra/ spangs dang me tog maṇḍal 'dra/ 'di lta bu yi dben gnas 'dir// lha yi yog shing bla mas byin// mkha' 'gro mnyes shing yi dam 'khor// chos rang dbang med par shugs las 'byung*// sdig rang dbang med par ngang gis 'dag /slad nas byang chub sgrub pa rnams// gnas 'di 'dra bsten cing yengs med sgom// bu 'dir bzhugs ras pa bu slob rnams/ nyams dga' bar e 'dug ltos dang gsal// zhes gsungs pas snang ba dga' lhag lhag pa'i nyams bzang po slob ma rnams la skyes so// de nas bsgom zhing yod pa la yon bdag gshen rdor mos 'gos byas pa'i ban skyes mang po zhig brgyags dum pa re khur nas mjal du byung ste khong rnams na re/ bla ma lags/ dgon pa thag ring zhing mthun rkyen yang dkon pas snyen nam gyi ri phug la bzhugs nas nye gnas re yang 'jog pa dang*/ ras pa dpon slob 'tsho bas ma bkres pa mdzad par zhu zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*/ sprang pos ri khrod zin par thugs rjes bzung*// 'dir bzhugs kyi yon bdag dad pa can// thag ring po nas yang yang byon pa la// gdab len glu yis 'jal ba de// khram gtam gyi mgo g.yogs ma lags te// nyams snang ba mthun pa'i skyid skyid yin// tshig snyan pa'i man ngag bshad pa de// bcos ma'i kha rgan ma yin te// sems la e phan snying gtam yin// gnas chu shing 'dzoms pa'i dgon pa der// 'khor nye gnas zer ba rdzun du gda'// za rogs ngan pa dgos rgyu chung*// nye gnas shes rab ral khas byed// gcig pur ri la sdod pa la// nor zang zing zer ba rdzun du gda'// dgra bo'i g.yab mo dgos rgyu chung*/ chog shes kyi phyug la zad pa med// lhun grub gtum mo sbar tsa na// gos slog zer ba rdzun du gda'// khres log khur pos dgos rgyu chung*// bde stong rang 'od shin tu dro/

rin chen sems kyi gter rnyed tsa// las so nam zer ba rdzun du gda'/ bral brel g.yeng bas dgos rgyu chung*// nyams gsal stong rig pa zad rgyu med// rang rig 'od gsal rtogs tsam na// kha brda skam po rdzun du gda'// khas len grub mtha' dgos rgyu chung*// stong nyid cho 'phrul rang dbang che// rang byung chos nyid shar tsam na// dmigs bcas bsgom pa rdzun du gda'// sdug btsir sems 'dzin dgos rgyu chung*// gsal stong rten 'brel rang dbang che// rtsol med shugs 'byung shar tsam na// bcos ma'i tshul 'chos rdzun du gda'/ lhag pa'i spyod pa dgos rgyu chung*// rang byung rang grol rang dbang che// skyes med spros bral go tsam na// sgra tshad sgrogs gleng rdzun du gda'// tha snyad bslab pa dgos rgyu chung*// 'gag med rang rtsal rang dbang che// gang shar chos nyid dkyil 'khor la// 'khor 'das bzang ngan rdzun du gda'// blos byas 'bras bu dgos rgyu chung*/ dben pa'i rang grub rang dbang che// mos gus sems la thob tsam na// ngo srung zhabs tog rdzun du gda'// ngas byas 'bul ba dgos rgyu chung*// sems mthun snang ba rang dbang che// lam nor sa med pa'i rnal 'byor la// skyid ja chang gnyis kyi thab kha med// zas sha thud gnyis kyi mgron zas med// khyed yon bdag gnyis po'i nor zas med// ma jo mo dga' ba'i skye gzugs med// 'khor slob ma dga' ba'i g.yeng ba med// mi thams cad dga' ba'i pho rgod med/ sprang blo phug bcug pa'i rnal 'byor la// gcig kyang med pas phun sum tshogs// glu bde skyid spros dga' len pa de// nyams snang ba skyo shas che ba'i don// khyed 'dir bzhugs yon bdag bu slob rnams// nyams skyid pa'i smon lam mang po thob// ces gsungs pas yon bdag rnams dad ste/ srog gcod pa spangs par khas blangs zhing*/ khong rnams dge bsnyen byas te ma ṇi'i lung zhus shing*/

kha ma ṇi dang ma bral/ lag 'phreng ba dang ma bral bar byung ngo*// der khong rnams na re/ bla ma gcig pu rang la mnyes par 'dug /nged grong pa'i las dar bya ba theb re e dran lags zhus pas/ de chen po mi dran/ dran na gang zug gsung nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sprang ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs// ngas gnas mi med gcig pur bsgom bsgom nas// grong pa'i g.yeng ba brjed nas thal/ ngas na med sdug sgur byas byas nas// skyid 'dod kyi dga' ba brjed nas thal// dug po ras gos gon gon nas/ 'phyor rang mthong ngang gis brjed nas thal// sprang ber gyi mgo bo bzung bzung nas// ris lug gi skyong bran brjed nas thal// ngas me lcags rnon po bzung bzung nas// khyim mtshes ngang gis brjed nas thal// gnyom chung 'dug tshul mkhas mkhas nas// mi chen gyi ngo srung brjed nas thal// tshe phyi ma'i bde skyid bsam bsam nas// tshe 'di yi bde skyid brjed nas thal// nam 'chi'i snang ba 'phros 'phros nas// zhag dang za ma brjed nas thal// e 'chi la snying rus byas byas nas// lo dang zla ba brjed nas thal// 'chi dus ci 'ong bsam bsam nas// tshe 'dir ci 'ong brjed nas thal// lar tshe 'di'i bya bzhag rlung la 'phyar// dus gtan du skyid pa zhe la bzhag /'chi ba myur du nam 'ong bsam/ 'chi ba btsan thabs su 'gro ba e 'grub bsam// khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi yon bdag bu slob rnams// 'chi ba 'di bzhin som la lha chos mdzod// tshe la sdod long med pas myur du sgrubs// ces gsungs pas/ yon bdag de rnams skyo shas chen po skyes te chos dang dge ba la rang gzhan bskul nus pa'i dad pa can byung nas brin dang snye nam du rje btsun gyi snyan pa brjod nas/ yul mi tsho yang dge ba la brtson zhing*/ rje btsun gyi mdzad spyod la nyan pas mi thams cad snang ba dga' ba'i bde skyid dpag tu med pa la 'jug nus pa 'byung ngo*// de thams cad skyid phug nyi ma rdzong gi skor ro/// /na mo gu ru/

rje btsun chen po brag skya rdo rje rdzong na bzhugs pa'i dus su ri bong zhig gis wa zhig bzhon nas/ tsi spyang gis mda' gzhu thogs/ ri sho khog ma'i phub khur nas rje btsun gyi mdun du phar rgyug tshur rgyug byed pa de gzigs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// nga pha la bu skyes gyad kyi rigs// sdar wa dom phyong nge 'bros ma myong*// nga pha myes kyi tsha bo stag slag can// sdang dgra la sta zur shor ma myong*// nga gcan gzan rgyal po seng ge'i rigs// mtho gangs dkar min pa sdod ma myong*// lcags kyi gar bu rdos mi shigs// lcags kyi gar bu rdos chog na// lcags zhun thar byas pa don re chung*// seng ge dkar mo nyams mi nga*// seng ge dkar mo nyams nga na// seng rtsal gsum rdzogs pa don re chung*// bya rgyal rgod po g.yang mi za// bya rgyal rgod po g.yang za na// rgod gshog drug rgyas pa don re chung*// nga mi la ras pa 'dres mi 'jigs// mi la ras pa 'dres 'jigs na// sems stong nyid bsgom pa don re chung*// wa da rung rgyug dang mtshar yang che// wa mo'i rta pho bang yang mgyogs// ri bong gi mi pho rtsal re che// tsi spyang gi mda' gzhu kha re tsha// ri shwa'i phub chung go re btsan// a na re mtshar la dgod re bro// zhes gsungs pas wa mo'i rta kha yar bsgyur nas mi rgyug khyod mi skrag par 'dug zer te yar nas song ngo*// de nas bde ba'i mgur gsungs pa/ 'du 'dzi med pa'i dben gnas bde/ na tsha med pa'i sgyu lus bde// rnam rtog 'jams pa'i kha zas bde// sems la 'od gsal shar bas bde// zhen chags med pa'i 'gro 'dug bde// rlung gi 'gro 'ong med na bde// bde chen lus la rgyas na bde// lta ba gnyis med rtogs na bde// zhes gsungs/ phyag ni gnyis med ye shes te// rgya ni 'khor ba'i skyon ma gos// chen po zung du 'jug pa ste/ de rtogs phyag rgya chen po yin// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad brag skya rdo rje rdzong gi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun gyis bu slob rnams la/

gnas gcig tu rang lo bar gnas 'byams pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i rgyu ba dang*/ brtson 'grus kyang 'byams 'gro ba dang ling pa'i brag la bsgom du 'gro gsungs pa la/ slob ma rnams nged tsho yang 'gro zhus pas/ mi mang po song bas mi dga'/ nga la khams 'dus thebs gsum 'ong ba la/ khams 'dus dang po la phyi chu bzang dang*/ brag dmar mchong gling du 'ong bas/ da yang ri khrod gnyen po zhig tu 'dus 'ong nas mi dga' gsungs nas/ slob ma rnams ling ba'i lung pa zhig tu bsgom bcug nas/ khong rang ling ba'i brag gseb tu bsgom zhing bzhugs pa la/ nub cig yid la med par nam srod yol tsam la brag gi ser ga nas bshud pa cig tse re re byung bas/ rje btsun gyis gzigs tsa/ brag gis logs la 'od dmar po khyug khyug byung bas/ legs par gzigs pa la 'od de'i sna la mi dmar po gcig gla ba la zhon nas bud med gcig gis sna khrid de rje btsun gyi g.yon skor du ko ro ro/ thams cad mgyogs par shog zer zhing mang po yod pa'i brda' byed cing 'dug pa la/ rje btsun gyis 'di brag srin mo'i cho 'phrul red dgongs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// mi nga bar chod tho 'tshams pa// mi sdug sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan can// khyod ling ba brag gi brag srin mo// las ngan 'dre mo ma yin nam// glu snyan pa'i 'gyur khug ngas mi shes// ngag bden pa'i tshig 'dir khyod kyang nyon// ya ki dgung sngon gyi dkyil shed na// nyi zla zung gcig g.yang chags pa// de ngo mtshar lha yi gzhal yas khang*// 'od zer skye 'gro'i dpal du shar/ las su gling bzhi'i mun pa sel// gza' khyab 'jug dgra ru ma ldang zhig /khyab 'jug 'dre ru ma gnod cig /shar rtse mtho shel gyi gangs ri la// seng lcam dkar mo'i g.yang chags pa// de byol song kun gyi rgyal po yin// che rtags su god kyi sha mi za// khong gangs dkar gyi zur kha 'grim pa la// bu yug dgra ru ma ldang zhig

/bu yug 'dre ru ma gnod cig /lho nags ma'i gseb kyi lding khang na// rgya stag khra bo'i g.yang chags pa/ de gcan gzan rnams kyi gyad pa yin/ dpa' rtags su rang gi srog mi 'phang*// khong dogs mo'i sa 'phrang 'grim pa la// khyod sa mda' dgra ru ma ldang zhig /sa mda' 'dre ru ma gnod cig /nub ma sang g.yu mtsho mer ba la// 'gyur mo nya yi g.yang chags pa// de 'byung ba chu yi gar mkhan yin// ya mtshan gser mig 'khyil ba yod// khong 'dod yon zas kyi 'brangs pa la// lcags kyu dgra ru ma ldang zhig /lcags kyu 'dre ru la gnod cig /byang ling ba'i brag dmar bsam yas na// bya rgyal rgod po'i g.yang chags pa// de 'dab chags bya yi drang srong yin// khong ngo mtshar gzhan gyi srog mi gcod// khong ri gsum rtse la gzan 'tshol ba// khyod mgul rnyi dgra ru ma ldang zhig /mgul rnyi 'dre ru ma gnod cig /brag rgod tshang can gyi ling ba 'dir// nga mi la ras pa'i g.yang chags pa// rgyu byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas// tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la// rtse gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa la// khyod brag srin mo dgra ru ma ldang zhig /brag srin mo 'dre ru ma gnod cig /glu ngo mtshar dpe lnga don dang drug /tshig snyan dngags mdo lung gser thag can// don mjal bar gda'am brag srin mo// las bsags shing lji ba sdig pa yin// khyod sdig la nan tan ma che bar// ngan sems gdub rtsub zhi bar mdzod// khyod ma gnod ma gnod 'dre mo ngan/ mi nga la ma gnod phar log cig /ces gsungs pas/ mi des rje btsun la gru tsog cig brgyab nas gar song yang cha med/ bud med de khyi mo dmar mo zhig tu sprul nas rje btsun gyi zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung la 'jus nas byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis brag srin mo khyod snying re rje ang gsungs nas/ mgur tshigs bzhi ma 'di gsungs so// a tsa ma 'byung po snying re rje// las re ngan gdub rtsub kyi bsam pa la// zhe re 'gyod sdig pa'i rnam smin la// bsam zhing snying rlung 'khrugs pa'i rgyu// nga stong nyid 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor la// 'dre khyod kyis gnod pa mi srid de/

sems can la gnod pas sdig pa che// lar thams cad sems su ma shes na/ rnam rtog 'dre la zad pa med// sems 'di stong par ma shes na// 'dre log nas yod snyam 'khrul pa yin// gdon gnod sbyin pha mar ma shes na// rgyud ngan pa'i 'dre la zad mtha' med// sems stong nyid byang chub tu ma grol na// 'dre brdung zhing brdung zhing je mang 'gro// 'dre khyod bas snang srid dgrar langs kyang*// 'jigs snang gi khu 'khrigs dbyings su yal// rdzun snang gi zol zog rlung la shor// nga byang chub sems kyi rdzong nang na// thugs rje'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro// bdag gzhan don rnams rtsol med 'grub// 'dre byang sems bskyed cig legs par sbyangs// skal pa bzang po'i chos shig mdzod// tshe 'di bde phyi ma shin tu skyid/ dus rgyun du bde bas go bar gyis// zhes gsungs pas/ zhabs la bzung ba de ni ma btang bar gzugs med pa'i skad lhang lhang ba zhig bar snang nas 'di skad len btab/ 'dre mos yi dwags kyi tshig dbyangs rta la bskyon pa 'di skad do// e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// gcig pur sdod pa'i snying stobs can// ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor pa// dka' ba spyad pa'i ngo mtshar can// mi khyod kyi glu dbyangs rgyal po'i bka'// rgyal po'i bka' de gser las lji// gser las rag shog mtshungs su che// mtshang de las slar log ma shes na// khyod sngon chad bzlas pa rdzun du zad// de yan chad rgyal po'i khrims kyi glu// da dpe la drangs pa'i tshigs lan 'tshal// thugs ma yengs dar cig gsan par zhu// ya ki dgung sngon gyi dkyil shed na// 'od gsal nyi zla'i g.yang chags pa// gling bzhi'i mun pa sel lo skad// khong snang gsal bya ra mi gtong zhing*// dkyil 'khor 'od kyis ma bslus na// gza' khyab mjug dgra ru ci la ldang*// khyab mjug 'dre ru ci la gnod// shar gangs dkar shel gyi zur shed na// seng lcam dkar mo g.yang chags pa// 'brong byol song khrims la gnod do skad// khong khro gtum nga rgyal mi che zhing*// g.yu ral sngon mos ma bslus na// bu yug dgra ru ci la ldang*// bu yug 'dre ru ci la gnod// lho nags ma gseb kyi lding khang na// stag gu ri bkra'i g.yang chags pa// spyir sder chags zil gyis gnon no skad// khong yang rtsal dregs pas mi brlom zhing*// ri mo 'dzum gyis ma bslus na// sa mda' dgra ru ci la ldang*// sa mda' 'dre ru ci la gnod// nub ma sang g.yu mtsho mer ba la// 'gyur mo lto dkar g.yang chags pa// lha drang srong gzigs mo che'o skad// khong kha zas don du mi gnyer zhing*// sgyu ma'i lus kyis ma bslus na// lcags kyu dgra ru ci la ldang*// lcags kyu 'dre ru ci la gnod// byang ling pa'i brag dmar bsam yas na// bya rgyal rgod po'i g.yang chags pa// 'dab chags zil gyis gnon to skad// khong sha khrag gzan du mi za zhing*// gshog drug ldem gyis ma bslus na/

mgul rnyi dgra ru ci la ldang*// mgul rnyi dgra ru ci la gnod// brag rgod tshang can gyi ling pa na// khyod mi la ras pa'i g.yang chags pa// 'gro drug lam sna 'dren no skad// khyod rnam rtog gi nyer len mi mang na// rang snang bag chags mi 'khrul zhing*// rang sems dgra ru ma ldang na// brag srin mo dgra ru ci la ldang*// nga brag srin mo 'dre ru ci la gnod// bar chad bdud 'di sems las byung*// sems kyi de nyid ma shes na// khyod song zhig byas kyang nga mi 'gro// rang sems stong par ma rtogs na// 'dre nga yi mi tshad gzhan yang mang*// rang sems rang gis ngo shes na// mi mthun rkyen rnams grogs su 'gyur// nga brag srin mo yang 'bangs su mchi/ lar khyod kyi sems la khu 'khrigs yod// da rung khu 'khrigs bden rdzun ltos// da rung 'khor ba'i rdzun phug gtib// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// da rung 'khrul pa'i phu thag chod// ces nam mkha' nas brag srin mos de skad brjod pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po'i mo yi tshig de la bden pa'i nges shes drag po skyes te/ de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod bden no bden no 'dre mo bden/ tshig de las bden pa yod re kan// ngas sngon chad rgyal khams 'grim 'grim nas// glu de bas snyan pa tshor ma myongs// mkhas btsun brgya yis zhal phyes kyang*// don de bas zab pa yod re shi// pha bla ma'i bka' drin dngos su shar// 'dre khyod kyi kha nas legs bshad byung*// legs bshad gser gyi thur ma de// mi bdag gi rnam shes snying la brgyab// nad dngos por 'dzin pa'i snying rlung bton// ma rig 'khrul pa'i mun pa bsal/ blo padma dkar po kha phyes bas// rang rig gsal ba'i sgron me sbar// dran pa'i ye shes tur re sad// dran pa sad dang ma sad pa// dgung sngon gyi dbyings su yar bltas pas// chos nyid stong pa tur re dran// da dngos po'i chos la nyams nga med// nyi zla gnyis la yar bltas pas// sems nyid 'od gsal tur re dran// da bying rgod gnyis la nyams nga med// ri bo'i rtse la phar bltas pas// 'gyur med ting 'dzin brtan por tshugs/

da 'pho 'gyur gnyis la nyams nga med// chu bo'i gzhung la phar bltas pas// nyams myong ye shes rgyun chad med// da glo bur gyi rnam rtog la nyams nga med// 'ja' tshon ri mo phar bltas pas// gsal stong zung 'jug dbyings su 'dres// da rtag chad gnyis la nyams nga med// me long gzugs brnyan mthong tsa na// 'dzin med rang shar tu re dran// da gzung 'dzin gnyis la nyams nga med// rang rig sems la tshur bltas tsa/ bum nang mar me ta ler gsal// da gti mug rmongs la nyams nga med// 'dre khyod kyi kha nas tshig thon pas// mi kho bo'i yid la gsal te shar// da bar chad bgegs la nyams nga med// 'dre mo'i glu dbyangs chos kyi sgra/ thos pas kho bo spro ba skyes// da 'dre dang bdud la nyams nga med// a mtshar po gtam snyan dbyings nas thos// bsam zhing kho bo ngo mtshar skyes// da the tshom gnyis la nyams nga med// khyod legs bshad 'di 'dra shes shes nas// sems kyi de nyid go go nas// lus ngan 'dre mor skyes pa ci'i len ang*// lus ngag sdug bsngal bsgrub bsgrub nas// las ngan gnod cing 'tshe bar byed// de rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad pas len// da ni 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgoms// sdig mi dge bcu po gtan spongs la// chos dge ba bcu po dang du longs// nga seng ge lta bur nyams nga med// 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la// 'dre khyod kyi do nub tho 'tshams pas// gdon gnod sbyin sha za spun lnga dang*// mig bsgyur sprul pa'i lha 'dre rnams// rgya po byams pa'i stobs bzhin du// smon lam 'brel bas mtshams sbyar nas// byang chub sems dang ldan gyur te// dus phyi mar nga yi gdul byar shog /ces gsungs pas/ brag srin mo des zhabs la 'jus pa de btang nas rlung dmar 'tshub ma gcig tu byas te// yang
