tshur je nye je nye la btang yang snyan pa'i glu dbyangs zhu ba'i don 'ga' zhig 'di skad ces zer ro// kye ma skal ldan rnal 'byor pa// bsod nams bsags pas dam chos spyod// ngo mtshar gcig pur ri la bzhugs// thugs rjes spyan rgyang 'gro la gzigs// nga padma thod phreng brgyud pa 'dzin// dam chos tshig gi 'phreng ba nyan// tshig thos pa yod kyang zhe la med// da lta rnal 'byor tshogs khang 'grim// las 'phro can rnams dge la bkod// skal ba can rnams don dang sprad/

sems bzang snang ba dkar lags kyang*// lus ngan ma sos ltogs tshor che// las su 'dzam gling grong khyer nyul// zas su sha dang khrag la dga'// mi tsam po phal pa'i sems la 'jug /sman 'phyor mo kun la bslu chu blud// pho 'phyor po kun la mtshal ris btab// mig gis kun la ltad mo blta// sems kyis rgyal khams zhe la gnon// lus kyis kun la yengs rgyag byas// gnas ni ling ba'i brag la gnas// de tsho nga yi spyod 'gros yin// khyed kyi drung du zhu ba lags// lan gcig glu ru blangs pa yin// 'o skol mjal ba'i spro dga' yin// da lta mtshar ba'i zhu don yin// rje btsun bzhugs pa'i zhabs tog yin// nga rang dad pa'i gsal tshig yin// glu drang gtam phul bas mnyes par shog /ces zer bas/ rje btsun gyis dman mo'i rigs 'di rnams kha mkhas kyang lag len la re ba med pas/ da rung dri ba zhig byed dgos dgong nas mo'i glu lan du mgur bzhengs pa 'di gsungs so// 'o na nyon cig dman mo khyod// slob dpon bzang ste slob ma ngan// lha chos thos bsam mang byas kyang*// don ma go tshig gi 'phreng ba bzung*// khas yag yag gtam yang lag len med// khram gtam kha yi stong bshad de// rang rgyud dri ma 'dag mi srid// khyod sngon gyi bag chags ngan pa dang*// 'phral du las ngan bsags bsags pas// sdom pa dam tshig khas blangs nyams// de yi stobs kyis dman mor skyes// lus sdug bsngal sha za'i grong khyer rgyu// ngag mi bden ngo lkog rdzun rdzun mang*// sems mi dge 'gro ba'i srog la gnod// lus ngan pa'i gzugs su skyes pa de// las rgyu 'bras khyad bsod ches pas lan// da 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam shes na// las mi dge byas tshad bshags pa gyis// dge ba bsgrub par kha yas longs// nga seng ge lta bur nyams nga med// glang chen lta bur nyams nga med/ smyon pa lta bur gza' gtad med// nga yis khyod la bden tshig brjod/

khyod kyis da rung drang gtam smros// mi nga la bar chad tho 'tshams pas// 'dre khyod kyi gtan gyi so nam red// sngon gnod sbyin sha za spun lnga dang*// rgyal po byams pa'i stobs bzhin du// chos smon lam 'brel ba'i stobs bzhag nas// ma 'ongs dus na rjes su 'dzin// de rtog dpyod mdzod cig dman mo 'phrul// zhes gsungs pas/ brag srin mos drang por gtam bshad pa'i don gyi glu 'di phul lo// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gtso// rdo rje 'chang la drang srong lus// ngo mtshar bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad// ya mtshan byang chub thugs bskyed bzang*// nged dman mo ming sring bsod nams che// khyed kyis gsung thos go ba skyes// nga dang por slob dpon gnyan gyis bkas// dam pa'i lha chos thos bsam byas// bar du las 'phro ngan la zhugs// nyon mongs gdub rtsub bsran bzod med// tha mar chos 'khor dman mor skyes// 'gro ba sems can thams cad la// phan yang btags te gnod yang bskyal// dus na ning song ba'i sngon rol tu// ling pa'i brag la sgom chen khyed// byon nas gcig pur sgrub pa mdzad// nga yang res dga' res ma dga'// dga' ba'i phyir na do nub mjal// ma dga'i phyir na zhabs la 'jus// de gnong ba'i phyir na rje la bshags// dus da lta dman mo'i gdug rtsub yang*// chos snying nas byed la sdong grogs byed// ma 'ongs dus na bdag gzhan rnams// sku bde chen 'byon pa'i bsal grib kyis// dug lnga nyin mtshan gdung ba la// las ngan 'dre mo bskyab tu gsol/ khyod kyi bka' la brten nas su// 'di nas bzung ste byang chub bar// gdug pa'i bsam pa kun zhi ste// rnal 'byor skyong ba'i srung ma byed// sgrub pa byed pa'i sdong grogs byed// sgom chen kun gyi 'bangs mo byed// chos mdzad kun gyi kha 'dzin byed// dam tshig can gyi las grogs byed// bstan pa bsrung shing zhabs tog byed// ces smon lam bzang po brjod cing*/

sgrub pa byed pa thams cad kyi mgon byed cing gnod pa mi skyel bar dam bcas shing dad par gyur te/ yang rje btsun gyis brag srin mo rjes su 'dzin pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// nga 'khor ba spangs pa'i ban de yin// bla ma dam pa'i sras bu yin// gdam ngag rin chen gter mdzod yin/ dam chos snying nas sgrub pa yin// stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor yin// sems can rnams kyi ma rgan yin// snying stobs can gyi dka' thub yin// shākya thub pa'i srol 'dzin yin// byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid yin// byams pa sngon nas bsgom pa yin// snying rjes gdug pa 'dul ba yin// ling pa'i brag la byon pa yin// yengs ba med par bsgoms pa yin// khyod dga' bar sems sam dman mo 'khrul// dga' bar ma tshor khyed cag ngan// 'dre khyod bas che ba ngar 'dzin yin// 'dre khyod bas mang ba 'du byed yin/ 'dre khyod bas mang ba bsam ngan yin// 'dre khyod bas rgod pa rnam rtog yin// rnam rtog ngo bo chos nyid yin// 'dre lang shor bag chags ngan pa yin// 'dre 'dre ru bzung na sdang dgra yin// 'dre stong par shes na sod pa yin// 'dre chos nyid du grol na rang grol yin// 'dre pha mar shes na zin pa yin/ sems byang chub tu rtogs na 'dre ming med// de yin lugs shes pas thams cad grol// 'dre dman mo'i zhu tshig brda ru bstan// mi kho bo'i gdul byar dam la btags// de dbab khyed cag tshig bzhin nyon// bdag cag rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' ma bcag /gdams ngag gnyan po'i gsung ma bkral// thugs rje chen po sun ma phyung*// lus ngag bsam pa'i bar ma gcod// gal te bab bcol spyad gyur na// rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro bar nges// do gal che bas len gsum gdab// de go bar gyis la lag len mdzod// 'o skol smon lam bzang pos 'phrad// ma 'ongs tshe na bde chen zhing*// rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab par// khyod byang chub sems dang ldan par gyis// byang chub sems dang khyod ldan na// gdul bya 'khor gyi dang por skye// rdo rje sems dpa'i bud med bya// zhes gsungs te dam la btags pas/

brag srin mos kyang bden par smra zhing smon lam btab/ bla mas kyang bka' bskyon zhing chos bshad pas brag srin mo yang dad par gyur to// phyag dang skor ba byed cing yod pa la/ bla ma thang chad pa'i sna nga ba 'dra ba zhig byung ba la/ gnyid yin nam ma yin pa'i snang ba zhig byung ba thun chung ba gcig la song tsa/ nam yang langs nas byung*/ de nas nyi ma rtse shar la brag srin mo ni sngar gyi 'dre gzugs med par lha mo yid du 'ong ba dpon g.yog lnga byas nas/ 'bras dang*/ la phud dang*/ sa lu dang*/ gor ba/ bu ram/ sbrang*/ shing mngar/ rgun 'brum/ kham bu la sogs pa'i dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi zas sna brgya rtsa brgyad bshams nas/ bar snang gi dbyings na sman btsun lnga po de mgrin cig tu bsdebs nas/ chos nges pa'i don zhu ba'i mchod dbyangs 'di phul lo// e ma ya rab mdzangs kyi bu// bsod nams bsags pa'i skal pa can// bla ma bzang pos byin brlabs can// sgrub pa byed pa'i snying rus can/ gcig pur sdod pa'i snying stobs can// zab mo gnad kyi sgrub par brtson// 'dre bar chod yod par mi srid kyang*// nang rtsa rlung rtags kyi rten 'brel la// sgyu ma gar gyi don ston pa// nged cag khyed kyi sems dang bsdong*// sngon chad sha za spun snga la// deng sang sman mo spun lnga bstan// ma 'ongs tshe ring spun lnga la// smon lam 'brel ba'i mngon shes shar// sngon chad gru thob mang mjal yang*// bka' drin byin rlabs rje las thob/ da sman btsun lnga yis zhu 'phul ba// chos drang don theg chung mgo bskor 'di// las nyon mongs thul bar dka' bar gda'// kha bshad stong pa'i 'khyor mgron des// rkyen sdug bsngal byung na 'bros par nges// mi chos dred du song ba'i slob dpon de// rang 'dod pa ma grub khro bar 'dug /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// nges pa don gyi don rtogs pa// thugs las 'khrungs pa'i zab mo'i don// gnad la dril ba'i man ngag dbyangs// nges don mthar thug skyel so de// bdag cag ming sring byams pa'i spun// 'khor dang slob mar mchis pa la// rdo rje'i gsang tshig dam pa'i don// ye shes chen po'i 'od gsal ba// mchog gi don gsal gnang du gsol// nges don zab mo gsang ba'i rgya// thos pas ngan song ltung mi srid// bsgom pas 'khor bar 'khyams mi srid// sba sri med par gnang bar zhu// zhes zhus pas/

rje btsun gyis/ da rung khyed tshos nges don bsgom mi nus/ gal te nus na dam bca' drag po dgos gsungs pas/ 'gyur ba med pa'i srog snying thams cad phul nas/ da phyin chad chos mdzad thams cad la sdong grogs byed par dam bcas pas/ rje btsun gyis nges pa'i don gyi nyams dbyangs them pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad du gyur pa 'di mgur du gsungs so// rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can// mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i lo tswa ba// pha sku drin can gyi zhabs la 'dud// nga rig byed glu mkhan ma yin te// 'dre khyod kyis glu longs glu longs zer// da res gnas lugs dbyangs shig len// 'brug dang glog dang lho sprin gsum// byung yang nam mkha' rang las byung*// thim yang nam mkha' rang la thim// 'ja' dang na bun khu rlangs gsum// byung yang bar snang rang las byung*// thim yang bar snang rang la thim// rtsi bcud lo tog 'bras bu gsum// byung yang sa gzhi rang las byung*// thim yang sa gzhi rang la thim// nags tshal dang me tog lo 'dab gsum// byung yang ri bo rang las byung*// thim yang ri bo rang la thim// chu rlangs chu lbu chu rlabs gsum// byung yang chu bo rang las byung*// thim yang chu bo rang la thim/ bag chags 'dzin chags zhen chags sum// byung yang kun gzhi rang las byung*// thim yang kun gzhi rang la thim/ rang rig rang gsal rang grol gsum// byung yang sems nyid rang las byung*// thim yang sems nyid rang la thim// skye med 'gag med brjod med gsum// byung yang chos nyid rang las byung*// thim yang chos nyid rang la thim// 'drer snang 'drer 'dzin 'drer rtog gsum/ byung yang rnal 'byor rang las byung*// thim yang rnal 'byor rang la thim/ lar bgegs rnams sems kyi 'khrul pa ste// rang snang stong par ma rtogs na// 'dre rang rgyud du 'dzin na sgom chen 'khul// lar 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba sems las byung*/

sems nyid ngo bo rtogs pa la// 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med par mthong*// phyi yul du snang ba 'khrul pa'i sems// snang ba'i mtshan nyid rtogs pa la// snang stong skye ba med par rtogs// lar sgom pa nyid kyang rtogs pa la// mi bsgom pa yang rtogs pa ste// bsgom dang mi bsgom gnyis su med// gnyis 'dzin gyis lta ba 'khrul pa'i gzhi// mthar thug don la lta rgyu med// 'di kun sems kyi mtshan nyid ste// rang sems la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dper bzhag na// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// mtshan nyid med pa bsgom bsgom nas/ chos nyid gtan la 'bebs par byed// chos nyid la yang mtshan nyid med// mthar thug don la dgag bsgrubs med// yang dag don la bsam rgyu med// bsam rgyu med par bsgom shes na// nyon mongs dri zad bdar zad yin// bsam blo mang po skyes phyin chad// ji ltar bsgom yang grol mi 'gyur// bsam med rtog pa zad pa na// sdig pa las ngan zad pa yin// las ngan rtog pa ma skyes par// skye med ngang du sgom zug na// 'khor ba rdzun gyi zol ris yal/ lar lta rgyu med pa'i don la ltos// yengs ba med pa'i ngang du bsgom/ spyod pa gang byung nges med spyod// 'bras bu re dogs tha snyad spangs// 'dre khyod kyi dam chos de la mdzod// ngas stong 'byams glu re len mi khom/ khyod 'dri rgyu ma mang kha rog sdod// khyod longs shig zer bas blangs pa yin// da lta kho bo'i smyo tshig yin// da khyod ni kha rog sdod zug na// zas su bde chen zan la zo// skom du zag med bdud rtsi 'thung*// las su rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ brag srin mo la sogs pa dad par gyur pas phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song ngo*// de phyin chad la brag dgon pa de la su bsdad bsdad la/ gnod pa med cing sdong grogs byed do// gung thang ling pa'i brag de la mi la ras pa dang brag srin mo gnyis kyi zhu ba zhus len ling ba'i skor te skor che ba'o/// /de nas brgyad pa chos brgyad rang sar grol ba'i yon tan ni/

gnyen 'dun rang sar grol ba dang*/ chos brgyad rang sar grol ba gnyis yin pa la/ gnyen 'dun rang sar grol ba ni/ bu slob rnams 'ong nas ling pa brag nas gdan drangs nas/ snyen nam grod phug bya ba na dgon pa mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ khrid zhu mi dang yon bdag pho mo mang du 'tshogs pa la/ sring mo pe tas kyang zas gos dum pa re rnyed pa tsam du yod pa mjal du byung ste/ sring mo dgal ches pas ngu bro'i mchi ma mang du shor te/ ming pos sdug thug pa'i las la mi tshe bskyal ang*/ mi ma shi ba la 'phrad dus 'ong bar 'dug /da dgon pa 'di rang la bzhugs na tshogs sogs skyel zer ba mang po dang*/ chos zhu zer mi mang po yong zer bas bzhugs par zhu byas pas/ rje btsun gyis zhen pa rang log pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rdo rje 'chang chen mar pa'i zhabs// sprang zhen pa log par thugs rjes bzung*// tshe 'di la zhan cing chags tsam na// 'chi ba 'ong snyam mi dran te// 'chi ba tug ge tsa nas slebs// yang yengs rtog 'dod can la zhen pa log /grogs mang 'khor gyis bskor dus su// 'bral ba 'ong ba mi dran te// gnyen grogs mthun yang myur du 'bral// gnyen tshan gdungs sems can la zhen pa log /ser snas zhib tu gsog dus su// glo bur 'ong ba mi dran te// bsags tshad mi yis myur du spyod// chog shes med pa'i mi la zhen pa log /skyid dus na tsha med dus su// sdug bsngal 'ong ba mi dran te// sdug bsngal dgra 'dre yid mi slong*// so gsod lkog nyal mkhan la zhen pa log /rnyed tshad kha na grub dus su// ltogs ched 'ong ba mi dran te// 'grang ltogs phyug po'i bu la'ang 'ongs// chags sred gdung sha can la zhen pa log /nyon mongs dug lngas non tsa na// chos kyis phan pa mi dran te// zas kham gang za ba chos kyi drin// log lta gti mug can la zhen pa log /rang la rang rtsis skyes tsam na// sdig gis gnod pa mi dran te// sdug bsngal byung tshad sdig pa'i las// sdig pa khrel 'dzem med la zhen pa log

/zhen pa nang nas skyes tsam na// gtam phan par smras kyang nyan pa nyung*// chos la 'bros shing sdig la spyod// bsam zhing zhen pa ting nas 'khrugs// pha la bu skyes mi la ras pa la// sring mo'i kha brdas zhen pa log pa'i rkyen// 'khor ba'i zhen pa zad par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas sring mo yang skyengs par gyur cing*/ rje btsun gyi drung du de nub bsdad tsa/ a nes tshogs gsog cig khyer nas byung ba la/ sring mo na re/ 'o skol ming sring la dgra 'di bas che ba med pas ma sprad cig zer bas/ rje btsun gyis bdag dang dgra dang gnyan la dbye ba med pas 'ong du chug gsungs pas/ sring mo ngo nag chil le song bas/ rje btsun gyis khyod ma khro zhig /dgra la 'dun ma grub pa'i so nam gyi yang rab yin gsungs nas a ne 'ong nas/ rje btsun la khams dri byas pas lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje sku drin can la gsol ba 'debs// lan re ba zad pa ra byin gyis rlobs// byams pa'i gnyen la re tsa sdug /sdang ba'i dgra la dogs tsa thar// las ngan gyi mi de skyid tsa sdug /rig ngan gyi bu de tshar tsa lod// drin chen pha ma rgas shing lod// mi ngan gyi 'dun ma zhus shing rkyag /khram pa'i ngo de bsrungs shing sdad// ltas ngan gyi nye ba 'dris shing ngan// a ne'i kha la re ba med// nga brag dkar rtse la bsgoms dus su// kha zas lcags kyi brab dus su// khyod a nes phan pa rtswa tsam med// drod phug ri la phyin dus su// a ne'i tshogs gsog phan pa chung*// a ne'i bde skyid 'byor pa'i nor// chos la btang na phyi ma bde// bsam na nor la snying po med// bsags na nor la dgra 'dre ldang*// gces na bu la na tsha 'ong*// mi la brnyas na rang gi byur/ rogs la sdang na rang srog chad// rje la bdos na thal khung lhung*// gros la ngan na mi yi 'khyer// 'gro 'dug mang na khyi dang thug /bya spyod ngan na rlung gis gtor// rang rtsis che na rogs dang 'gras// de ltar nyan na phan pa'i dbyangs// a ne'i sems la 'jog par zhu/

kha la nyan na rgyal po yin// mi dang mthun na yang rgyal yin// chos dang mthun na chos rgyal yin// kun dang mthun na kun rgyal yin// dgra dang mthun na don rgyal yin// mi nga dang a ne de ring mthun// chos legs snying po a ner bshad// de phan par sems shing yid la bzung*// dus kun tu kun mthun rgyal por shog /ces gsungs pas/ a ne dum pa cig skyengs ting nger song ste/ rje btsun gyi drung du phyag dang bskor ba bshags pa mang du byas shing dad par gyur nas rang yul du song tsa na/ phyis mi tsho na re/ a mtshar po mi chos pa'i 'dun ma las sla ba mi 'dug /bar pa yang mi dgos par 'dug zer ro// de nas sring mo na re/ khyod a nes kyang nged ming sring gnyis la de tsam sdang ste de ring yag nas thal zer bas/ rje btsun gyi di ring mi tshad sngar nas yag pa'i smon lam mang du song ba yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i zhabs tog zhabs tog rem// dad gus gdung ba rgyud chad med// rje mnyes par gyur pas yag pa yin// pha yul bdud kyis grong khyer spangs// nye du shan pa'i gshin rjes bskur// las bya ba thengs pas yag pa yin// mi med lung pa yul du bzung*// brag phug stong pa mkhar du brtsigs// gcig pur zug pas yag pa yin// snying rus sdug bsran snying khams che// dad pa dang snying rje shes rab bzang*// yeng med du bsgoms pas yag pa yin// bla ma dang slob ma gdam ngag bzang*// byin brlabs dang nus pa snyi rje che// nyams rtogs 'khrungs pas yag pa yin// nyams len dang sems bskyed gnad du song*// lha 'dre mi gsum dam la thogs// 'gro don 'grub pas yag pa yin// a ne dang sring mo re 'khor med// bla ma dang slob ma yon bdag rnams// mnyam por mjal bas yag pa yin// da de ltar yag pa'i lcam sring ma// sha khrag 'brel pa'i a ne skyid// lha chos byas na de bas yag

/bsags tshad chos la btang na phyug po yin// su dang 'khon pa med na btsan po yin// rang nyid spyod pa bzang na 'phel po yin// sems chags sdang med na chos pa yin// kun la byams pas skyong na dpon po yin/ g.yo sgyu ngos lkog med na bzang po yin// yin lugs lag len byed na mdzangs pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ a ne yang shin tu dad pa skyes nas/ dgra gnyen mnyam zer ba de bden par 'dug zer nas/ phyis kha zhe med pa'i zhabs tog byas te snang ba chos la 'gyur/ ma ṇi dang phyag skor byed pa zhig byung ngo*// sring mo pe ta ma de phyis chos sgor zhugs pas rang byung gi rnal 'byor ma bzang mo zhig byung ste/ rje btsun la skyes dman gyi slob ma brgyad yod pa'i ya bar gyur pa zhig yin gsungs so// de thams cad gnyen 'dun rang sar grol ba'i skor ro/// /gnyis pa chos brgyad rang sar grol ba la/ der 'tshogs pa'i bu slob rnams kyis da de dgon pa chen po zhig 'debs nas nged rang dpon slob rnams kyang ja chang gi longs spyod dum pa re yang byed/ nged yon bdag tsho yang 'ong dus za rgyu dum pa re gnang ba mdzad pa'i mdzo mo dang*/ 'bul ba thams cad len par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad 'di chos pa'i phung 'dre yin/ de bas nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang zhen pa zad par byin gyis rlobs// pha bla ma mi chen dpon 'dod 'di// stabs ngan na chags sdang bsam ngan skye// de bas bya bral gcig pur dga'// gnas bde mo gro ltag gi dgon pa 'di// yun ring grong yul mi nag 'dra// de bas dben gnas ri khrod dga'// 'khor slob ma kha phyid za 'dus 'di// 'grogs thal na 'khrugs pa kha po byed// de bas yeng med du bsgom na dga'// dus ngan pa'i yon bdag ngo mtshar che// ngo bsrungs na gshe bskur ngan pa 'debs// de bas phyogs med bas phyogs med bsod snyoms dga'// mi chen po'i ngo srung zhabs tog de// zhus thal na nag med khrims la gtug

/de bas kyang dman sa bzung na dga'// zas zhim po ja chang tshogs 'khor de// mang thal na dge sbyor bar chad yin// de bas kyang gyi nas 'tsho ba dga'// dkor gnyan po srog gi spu gri de// zos thal na thar pa'i srog rtsa gcod// de bas sems khur chung na dga'// gnyen nye du rkang pa'i thag nag de// 'brel ches na ngan song gi gnas su 'khrid// de bas kyang gnyen med bshes med dga'// grogs ngan pa gshis ngan ru co 'di// len ches na 'jigs pa'i g.yang sar 'phen// de bas kyang grogs med gcig pur dga'// nor phyug po be'u lug 'tsho skyong de// mang thal na 'byung po'i dmag dpung sdud/ de bas kyang chog shes zin na dga'// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang zhen pa med par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ khong rnams na re/ bla ma lags/ sku na gzhon dus dang mi 'dra/ bgres tsa dkar dum pa re gsol ba'i mdzo mo re bzung na legs zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang zhen pa zad par thugs rjes bzung*// nga sgyu ma lus kyi nags khrod du// stong nyid snying rje'i na spang rgyas// zhen med dad pa'i she ma yis// spyod pa gtsang ma'i lag pa bkrus// thabs shes gnyis kyi 'dzo skyogs su// sems nyid rin chen ba mdzo bzho// rnam dag gnyug ma'i bsgom chen la// zag med bde chen 'o ma 'dren// spros med chos nyid zhal gyis gsol/ chags med longs spyod mgul du bsgrim// dmigs med snying rjes thugs la bstim/ 'phrin las phyogs med zag pa gtong*// 'gro don lhun grub bsgrags pa klog /de 'dra'i ba mdzo bzho ba la// khyod 'jig rten ba mdzo'i dgos pa med// chos brgyad kyi dgon par nga mi sdod// khrel med kyi spyod pa byed la thug /ces gsungs pas/ yang bu slob rnams na re/ 'o na 'o skol dpon slob mon yul 'dra ba'i 'bru rtsam mod pa zhig tu 'gro nas bsod snyoms byed dgos zhus pas/

bla mas 'di gsungs te/ ngas rgyal khams zho dar bzhin du bshig /sgo kha ran 'thag bzhin du bskor// mig spyod so pa bzhin du bltas// skyid sdug tshod ma bzhin du myong*// 'grang ltogs srang kha bzhin du 'jal// pha yul btson dong bzhin du spangs// gcig pur sha za bzhin du bsdad// sdug bsngal phye rkyal bzhin du khur/ da dus la ma bab pa'i bsod snyoms la mi 'gro gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje mi bskyod kyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// sprang zhan pa zad par byin gyis rlobs/ mi 'dod pa can khong yus che tsam na// rgyal khams yongs la 'grim yang rnyed dus med/ kha na byung tshad zos kyang brgyags rgyu med// sug ge dum pa skums zhig ras chung pa// khrel med po'i nye ba bcom tsam na// drin chen pha ma yin kyang gnyan rgyu med// bla ma slob dpon yin kyang 'dzem rgyu med// bsam blo dum pa thong zhig ras chung pa// zhe sdang gdug sems 'khrug tsam na// tshe rang srog yin yang 'phong rgyu med/ mtshon mang pos gtubs kyang 'gyod rgyu med// go cha sems la gyon cig ras chung pa// 'dod pa can zhen pa khol tsam na// rta brgya brgya yod kyang ri'u lug rku// nor stong stong yod kyang gnyom chung 'joms// ser sna sdug sogs spongs shig ras chung pa// gti mug can nyal 'og zin tsam na// dgra rna bas tshor yang ldem me ba// gnyen mig gis mthong yang har re ba// mdzangs rang mgo thon cig ras chung pa// nga rgyal can rang ro che tsam na// mi chen po'i drung du nga rgyal bskyed// sku btsun po'i drung du zas ngan 'dren// 'phral rang tshugs zungs shig ras chung pa// las dug lnga 'khrugs pa'i grong khyer na// kha za 'dod 'khyams pas kha mchu 'phog /rkang 'gro la dga' de rdo la 'phog /bu dge sbyor mdzod cig ras chung pa// bla ma'i drung du ri khrod gnas// khyed ras pa rnams la da rung gces// gdul bya dus bab kyi slob ma la// chos snying rus bzod pa ldan par shog

/nyams myong rtsal kha rdzogs par shog /don sku bzhi'i 'bras bu thob par shog /ces gsungs so// yang rje btsun mi la ras pa dpon slob ri la skyo sang la byon tsa na/ char pa zim pa cig babs pas/ ras chung pa 'phru sa tshol du phar rgyug tshur rgyug byas pa'i tshe char pas bang skad/ rje btsun chen pos dbu btum nas bzhugs pas char pas ma bang skad/ char pa chad pa dang ras chung pa la mgur gsungs pa/ lta ba rgod pos nam 'phang bskyod pa dang 'dra ste// sems res 'ga' mtho ste res 'ga' dma'// sems mtho dman du gyur cing sa ma zin// sems sa ma zin pa de gang du 'khyams// sems thag chod kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// sgom pa kun sprin bar gyi nyi ma dang 'dra ste// sems res 'ga' gsal te res 'ga' 'grib// sems gsal 'grib tu gyur cing sa ma zin// sems sa ma zin pa de gang du 'khyams// sems thag chod kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// spyod pa kun chu kha'i bye ma dang 'dra ste// sems res 'ga' zhib la res 'ga' rtsing*// sems rtsing zhib tu gyur cing sa ma zin// sems sa ma zin pa de gang du 'khyams// sems thag chod kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// 'bras bu kun long ba'i 'khar ba dang 'dra ste// sems res 'ga' thob ste res 'ga' shor// sems thob shor du gyur cing sa ma zin// sems sa ma zin pa de gang du 'khyams/ sems thag chod kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde/ dam tshig kun sa mtshams kyi mkhar dang 'dra ste// sems res 'ga' thob ste res 'ga' shor/ sems thob shor du gyur cing sa ma zin// sems sa ma zin pa de gang du 'khyams// sems thag chod kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// zhes gsungs pas ras chung pa shin tu mnyes skad/ yang gsungs pa/ skye gnas srid len gyi phung po 'di// sgo nga rdog pas brdzis pa 'dra/ 'dzin pa'i thag pa chad tsam na// sa mtshams srid pa'i bar do 'di// sbrul la bgyis pa'i mdud pa 'dra// spyod pa blang dor grol tsam na// sems bya bral gyi ngang la gnas pa de/

rtsal gsum rdzogs pa seng ge 'dra// snang gsal stong gsal ye shes gsal// gsal ba gsum dang 'grogs tsam na// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar 'dra// yul dang phung po rtag kyang 'gyel// sems dang phung po 'ching thag chad// mi lus rin chen chud ma zos// nga rnal 'byor gyi so nam zin nam snyam// khyed la de ltar cang gda'am// rlom sems ma che ras chung pa// zhes gsungs so// yang rje btsun gyis bde sdug shan 'byed kyi mgur 'di gsungs pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rang ngo rang gis shes nas gnas lugs don dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// 'khrul pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas sdug bsngal bsring skyed byed pa'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /ma bcos ngang la bzhag nas 'gyu byed rang sar dag pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// byung tshor rjes su 'brangs nas chags sdang rang ka gsog pa'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /snang ba chos skur rtogs nas re dogs the tshom med pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// bab col tho cor spyad nas chos brgyad mgo bo ma non pa'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /thams cad sems su shes nas cir snang grogs su 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// mi tshe yengs la bskyal nas 'chi ka 'gyod pa skye ba'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /rtogs tshad khong du chud nas gnas lugs rang sa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// 'dod pa ngan pa khong du bcug nas dung dung sham sham byed pa'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /mtshan ma rang sar grol nas nyams myong rgyun chad med pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// tha snyad tshig phyir 'brangs nas sems la thag chod med pa'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /'jig rten bya ba btang nas chad 'dzin gza' gtad dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// bre phul sdug sogs byas nas bu smad gnyen 'dun gso ba'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /zhen pa nang nas log nas thams cad sgyu mar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// g.yeng ba'i 'dam du zhugs nas lus ngag bran du khol ba'i chos pa de nam yang sdug

/brtson 'grus kyi rta la bzhon nas thar pa'i sa lam bgrod pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// le lo'i sgrog tu tshud nas 'khor ba'i gting rdo byed pa'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod nas gnyug ma rgyun chad med pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// sna thag mi la byin nas ngo srung mthun 'jug byed pa'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /ci dgu rgyab tu skyur nas rtag tu lha chos byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa de nam yang bde// byung tshor rjes su 'brangs nas chags sdang rang khar song pa'i chos pa de nam yang sdug /ces dang*/ yang gsungs pa/ na mo gu ru/ lta sgom gcig tu shes nas rtse gcig gi ngang la 'jog pa'i rnal 'byor pa de bde ste/ lta sgom tha dad byas nas sems la yid ches med pa'i chos pa 'di sbyangs// cir snang chos nyid du shes nas sgom pa'i thun mtshams med pa'i rnal 'byor pa bde ste// skye med thun du bcad nas rnam rtog gar dgar ldang ba'i chos pa 'di sbyangs// spyod pa byar med shes nas tshogs drug rang sar grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa bde ste// sgo lnga yul lngar shar nas bdag 'dzin gyi spyod pa byed pa'i chos pa 'di sbyangs// 'bras bu skye med du shes nas 'khor 'das snang ba la 'das pa'i rnal 'byor pa bde ste// 'bras bu ma rig pas bsgribs nas gtan du 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i chos pa 'di sbyangs// rtogs tshad khong du chud nas rgyal khams phyogs med bskor ba'i chos pa rnal 'byor pa de bde ste/ rang yul yid la brtags nas sems la bag chags sogs pa'i chos pa 'di sbyangs// bla ma spyi bor bkur nas 'khor 'bangs phyogs med du bsten pa'i phyag rgya mo de bde ste// snang tshad dgra ru ldang nas bla ma tha mal du khur ba'i phyag rgya mo de sbyangs// zhes gsungs te bsam blo rtsab rtsub med par bsgoms pas// ras pa yang nyi shu tsam byung ngo*// gzhan sgom chen yang bzhi bcu tsam byung bas 'gro don re chel 'phel te/

gdams ngag bas kyang mig khrid gal che bas/ der song ba rnams tshe 'di'i snang ba med cing*/ bya ba thong ba gcig pu la dga' bas/ snying rus che ba mang du byung ngo*// de thams cad chos brgyad rang sar grol ba snyen nam drod phug gi skor ro// ༈ de nas dgu pa rtsod pas mi rdzi ba'i yon tan ni/ rje btsun chen po dpon slob snye nam drod phug na bzhugs pa la/ snye nam steng chen bya ba na ston pa dar lo dang*/ lo ston bya ba gnyis kyi mgos byas mtshan nyid pa'i ston pa mang po yod pa la/ dbyar kha zhig than pa chen po byung nas nas dkon pas/ yon bdag rnams kyis ston pa rnams la nas bun thong byas pa la/ bun ma btang bas yon bdag rnams ma dga' nas/ phyis tshogs sogs rnams mi la ras pa dpon slob la tshogs che zer nas shi dge gson gnas thams cad der khyer bas/ ston pa rnams kyi bsod nams chu bcad du song bas der ston pa rnams bka' gdams pa yin pas chang sdang byas te/ ston pa rnams tshogs nas lo ston na re// 'o skol tsho'i yon bdag rnams la bun re btang na 'thad de/ de ma btang bas da mi tshos dad log byas nas rnal 'byor pa 'di la thams cad 'dus pas ma bzang*/ da 'o skol gyis lag pa nas bzung ste phud na 'phud thub ste mi la ngo tsha bas/ khyed ston pa sgra tshad la mkhas pa gsum song la chos gtam gyis dang*/ kho yi kha nas lce min pa byung rgyu med pas kho rang bud la 'gro ba yin zer bas/ der ston pa gsum song nas nged bla ma la mjal du 'ong ba yin zer bas/ ras chung pas/ ston pa gsum mjal zer bas mjal lam mi mjal zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga lho brag mar pa'i drung du yod dus/ khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyis phan gar thog gyis/ tha na 'bel gtam gleng bslang la sogs pas kyang don chen du 'gyur gsungs pas/ ston pa dang 'phrad dgos gsungs nas nang du bos te tsha ba drangs te chab btang nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/

'o dad pa can gyi dad zas 'di/ sa la phog na sa 'gas/ rdo la phog na rdo 'gas/ chu la phog na chu 'chad bya ba yin pas/ khyed ston pa rnam gsum gyis kyang mdo re gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ ston pa gral mgo ma de langs nas/ nged ston pa bslab pa gsum dang ldan zhing chos gsum dang mi bral ba 'di/ yon sbyong ba'i gnas yin pas/ mdo bton yang chog ma bton yang chog /khyed rnal 'byor pas dad zas 'di tsam za ba'i gdings ci yod zer bas/ nyams rtogs pa'i nyams len mgur 'di gsungs so// dam chos theg pa'i mthar thug snying po'i don// lung rig man ngag 'dus pa bdud rtsi'i ro// bla ma kun gyis bkur ba spyi gtsug rgyan// rje mi 'bral gtsug gi rgyan du bzhugs// bdag gis nyams len sum cha gsum du byas// gsum cha yi dam bskyed rim bsgoms// gsum cha rtsa rlung thig le bsgoms// gsum cha phyag rgya chen po bsgoms// sgom thun bzhi'i sems bskyed byang chub sems// dngos dad kyi lha yon stong par sbyangs// blun dad kyi tshogs gsog gtor mar bsngos// rang dad kyi tshogs gsog lha la 'bul// lha dad kyi tshogs gsog 'byung por bsngos// nga tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i rnal 'byor pa// blo chos la 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ yang ston pa na re/ khyod la bslab pa'i shes rab med na/ lag sdum brag la 'dzegs pa 'dra/ thar pa thob mi srid/ sgom pa'i nyams len med na long bas lha khang lta ba dang 'dra/ yang dag pa'i don mthong mi srid/ khyod yi dam bskyed rim ji ltar bsgom zer bas/ zab mo bskyed rim bsgom lugs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// bdag gis yi dam bskyed rim bsgom tsa na// lus snang stong bar snang gi 'ja' tshon 'dra// de la ngos bzung med pas sred pa zad// ngag grag stong lung stong gi brag cha 'dra// de la bzang ngan med pas 'khrul pa zad// sems gsal stong nyi zla'i 'od dang 'dra// de la phyogs ris med pas bdag 'dzin zad// tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum nyid// de rang byung rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs// sgo gsum tha mal du ma lus blo re bde// ci byas chos dang mthun pa'i zhe re skyid// chos lam du 'gro bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/

yang ston pa na re/ phyi ba sa 'og tu zla ba gsum bzhi nyal bas lus mi 'gul/ nya chu la gnas pa 'tshub mi srid pas/ de tsho rlung gi yon tan yin/ sems la yon tan rta rnga tsam med par khyod kyi rtsa rlung ji ltar bsgom zer bas/ zab mo rtsa rlung bsgom lugs 'di mgur du gsungs so// bdag gi rtsa rlung thig le bsgom tsa na// rtsa gtso bo gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi// lus sred pa zad pas rang lus 'dra// rdzas yi ge dag pas ma dang 'phrad/ don rang zhal mthong bas nor ba med// rlung ma la 'dus pas gnad du bsnun// nyams bde gsal mi rtog lhun gyis grub// blo zhen pa med pa'i mi dang 'phrad// sems the tshom mdud pa dngos su zhig /khams dwangs snyigs 'khrugs pa 'dod chags khams// chos kha la ma lus rgyud dang 'dres// 'od gsal ma bu'i brtse gdung 'grigs/ 'dod srid zag pa'i phung po zhig /snang ba chos su zad pa'i mi re skyid// stong pa go yul du ma lus dang re spro// lam 'khrul pa sel bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ yang ston pa na re/ sgom chen pa rnams la bsgom ci 'dra zhig yod byas tsa/ bsgom bya sgom byed kyi mtha' dang bral bas lab rgyu med/ go rgyu med/ shes rgyu med zer tsa/ khyod la ci dris la byed rgyu re dang*/ bsgom rgyu re dang*/ ston rgyu re yod la khad kyi snang ba dga' dga' chen po 'dug pas nyan 'dod cing byung bas da rung phyag rgya chen po de ji ltar bsgom zer bas/ zab mo phyag rgya chen po bsgom lugs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// bdag gi phyag rgya chen po bsgom tsa na// don yin lugs steng du rtsol me bzhag /ma yengs ngang du yengs par bzhag /stong pa'i ngang du gsal bar bzhag /bde ba'i ngang du rigs par bzhag /mi rtogs ngang du rtogs par bzhag /sna tshogs ngang du mnyam par bzhag /de ltar bzhag pa'i sems nyid la// 'gag med nges shes sna tshogs 'char// rang gsal rtsol med 'phrin las 'grub// 'bras bu yid smon du ma lus blo re bde// re dogs gnyis 'dzin dang bral bas dang re spro// 'khrul pa ye shes su 'bar bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/

ston pa na re/ e ma thos bsam byas pa la/ 'di 'dra blo la sha ra ra mi 'ong 'di tsho de gong nas bsgrigs nas ster ba'i bla ma zhig yod pa e ma yin/ bla ma de yod na nged tsho la ston dang ze ba la/ zab mo bla ma ston pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// mi bdag gi bla ma rje btsun de// rtsa gsum 'dus pa sangs rgyas kyis zhing*// rlung lnga dag pa seng ge'i khri// khams lnga dag pa padma'i gdan// sems nyid stong pa bla ma'i sku// ye shes lus can rdo rje 'chang*// mngon shes drug ldan te lo pa// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nā ro pa// bka' drin stobs ldan mar pa'i sku// mi bdag gis spyi bo'i gdan steng du// 'bral ba med par rgyun du bzhugs// khyed mos gus mig gis lta shes na// rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su med// mos gus kyis gsol ba 'debs shes na// byin rlabs kyi sbrang char zad pa med// stong nyid kyi mchod pa 'bul shes na// dngos grub kyi gter kha thams cad 'grub// ces gsungs pas ston pa dad pa skyes nas/ ma go ma shes ma rig gsum/ 'jig rten 'di na dbang re che/ mi tshos zer ba bzhin mi bden par 'dug /khyed la yang chos lugs bzang po 'dug /khyed kyi bla ma de yang su yin gyis mthong rgyu ma red/ da ci rtsod pa'i tshig mang po song ba rnams bzod par gsol/ da bdag ston pa 'di gsum la gdams ngag gang phan pa thugs la thogs zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi gdams ngag gnang nas bsgom du bcug pa sa/ thos pas phyi'i sgro 'dogs chod/ bsgom pas nang gi sgro 'dogs chod pa'i ston sgom khyad 'phags gsum byung ngo*// de nas zla ba mang po song ba la/ ston pa dar blo dang yon bdag rnams 'dun ma byung nas yod pa la/ ston mo chen po zhig yod pa'i sa na rje btsun dpon slob yang gdan drangs te/ lo ston dang dar lo gnyis khri re re byas nas ston pa'i gral ring gnyis byas nas 'dug go

/rje btsun la yang khri zhig brtsigs pa'i steng du bzhugs nas ras pa'i gral ring byas pa'i gral gyi rked smad na/ khong tshos rtsod pa la btang ba'i ston pa gsum po de rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad byas nas yod pa de lo ston gyis mthong bas/ rnal 'byor zob pos mi mgo g.yogs nas nga yi ston pa gsum yang lad du bcug 'dug /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la gnod pa byas 'dug ste/ de ring chos 'brel zhig byed zlo nas dma' zhig 'beb dgos bsam pa skyes nas lo ston gyi sha khog gcig /mar thud cig khyer nas phul te/ lo ston na re/ chos thams cad tshad mas gtan la 'bebs dgos pas/ tshad ma spyi'i mtshan nyid dang*/ mngon gsum dang*/ rjes dpag dang grub mtha'i dbye ba dang 'gal ma 'gal dang*/ grub ma grub dang*/ snang la ma nges pa'i dbye ba zhig thong dang zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis ston pa tha snyad kyi rdzong la ma zhen par chos nyid skye med gnyug ma'i ngang la zhog dang*/ yon tan nang nas skye zhing 'dug /phrag dog dug lnga 'di ngan song gi 'bras bur gda' bas rang rgyud ma sreg /nga yi byung tshul ni 'di yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// dus snyigs ma'i sems can phrag dog che// khyod lo ston dang dar lo tshur nyon dang*// nga ma yi mngal nas ma skyes na// nu zho mngar mo ci la 'thung*// nu zho mngar mo ma 'thung na// phye mar kham gsum ci la za// phye mar kham gsum ma zos na/ byin pas lus po ci la thegs// byin pas lus po ma thegs na// them pa'i la sgo ci la brgal// them pa'i la sgo ma brga na// rgyal khams phyogs med ci la 'grims// rgyal khams phyogs med ma 'grims na// bla ma rje dang ci la mjal// bla ma rje dang ma mjal na// gru thob snyan brgyud ci la zhu// gru thob snyan brgyud ma zhus na// ri khrod dgon pa ci la 'grim// ri khrod dgon pa ma 'grim na/ nyams dang drod rtags ci la 'char// nyams dang drod rtags ma shar na// ras gos rkyang pas ci la dros// ras gos rkyang pas ma dros na/

yon bdag pho mo ci la dad// yon bdag pho mo ma dad na// khyed ston pa phrag dog ci la skyes// ston pas phrag dog ma skyes na// ston pa dmyal bar ci la 'gro// spo ri spo mtho'i rtse mo na// she'u chung dgo'u chung rtswa za ba// spyang ri khyi sngon mo zug rngu skye// de ring ri khyi e ma 'khrul// snye nam ri yi dgon pa na// mi la ras pa bsgom pa la// ston pa lo ston zug rngu skye// de rang ston pa e ma 'khrul// yon bdag pho mo'i dad zas la// khyed mkhas btsun bzang po ser sna skye// de rang mkhas btsun e ma 'khrul/ don med tshig gi stong sgra la// don bden par ma 'dzin ston pa ba// tshe sum gnyis zad pa ma tshor ram// rtog ge'i ngan tshig sna tshogs la// tshe stong par ma zad ston pa ba// ngas tshig ngan ya bo lab mi khoms/ mu stegs rtogs pa bgrang mi lang*// tshod ma'i tshad ma 'thung ma myong*// de res kyi rtsod pa ston pa rgyal// zhes gsungs pas/ lo ston khros nas/ dris pa'i chos skad kyi len de med par/ rbad mi shes pa'i kha rbad chen po byed pa'i zob po cig gis yul gyi bcud khong tshos bsdus zer nas thal ba bla ma'i zhal du btab pas/ rje btsun gyis/ 'o re khyed mtshan nyid pa la 'di 'dra'i chos lugs shig yod gsungs nas thugs skyo ba chad de/ ras chung pas/ nga yi bla ma'i ba spu yang mi do ba la 'di 'dra byas bsam nas/ ber ka zhig khyer nas brgyab tu phyin pa la/ rje btsun zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas ras chung pa'i lag pa nas 'jus te/ ras chung pa bka' yi mnan pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje spyi gtsug nor bu 'gro ba'i mgon// bla ma sku drin can gyi zhabs la 'dud// rkyen ngan byang chub tu 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs// bu ras chung ma yengs dar cig nga la nyon// kha ngom lto skyid kyi chos pa la/ rkyen ngan pa byung dus tha mal pa// de rgyud ngan du song na bar chod che// 'khrugs pa byas na rang nyid pham// bu dar cig bla ma'i bka' la nyon// chos lta ba'i rgyal po nam mkha' la/

bu rigs pa'i khyung phrug yangs rtsal sbyangs// khyung phrug yangs rtsal ma zhen cig /brgya la gshog rtsal zhen pa na// phyogs ris kyi dong la ltung nyen gda'// bu ras chung bla ma'i bka' la nyon// chos sgom pa'i rgyal po mtsho mo la// bu rigs pa'i nya chung yangs rtsal sbyangs// nya chung yangs rtsal ma zhen cig /brgya la yangs rtsal zhen pa na// 'khrul pa'i dong du tshud nyen gda'// bu ras chung bla ma'i bka' la nyon// chos spyod pa'i rgyal po gangs ri la// bu rigs pa'i seng phrug yangs rtsal sbyangs// seng phrug yangs rtsal ma zhen cig /brgya la yangs rtsal zhen pa na// chos brgyad sgrogs su tshud nyen gda'// bu ras chung bla ma'i bka' la nyon// chos 'bras bu'i rgyal po rin chen gling*// bu rigs pa'i tshong phrug tshong zhig 'dod// tshong phrug mel tshe ma zhen cig /brgya la mel tshe zhen pa na// sems stong nyid nor bu 'chor nyen gda'// bu ras chung bla ma'i bka' la nyon// bu zhe sdang ma che rang rgyud sreg /sdug bsngal ma byed rang sems brlag /ces gsung pas/ ras chung pa yang nga rgyal dum pa zhi nas bzod pa bsgom mo// lo ston la mi kha phog nas bsod nams chu bcad pa bzhin du song*/ phyis shi ba'i dus su sgrom rmya bya ba zhig la chags nas yul de'i dkor bdag cig tu skyes nas/ mi rnams kyi mna' skyel ba'i dpang po byed pa cig byung skad do// dar lo'i bsam pa la/ rnal 'byor pa gnyen po zhig 'dug bsam nas khyed la sgom nyams bzang po yod las che zer bas/ bla mas nga yi nyams khyod la bshad pas 'phangs gsungs nas 'phangs pa drug gi mgur 'di gsungs so// chos gsang sngags kyi lta ba kha po che// khyod phyogs 'dzin can gyi ston pa la// tha snyad rgol ba byed pa 'phangs// sgom pa yengs su med pa la// bla bo long gtam 'chol tshig la// rnal 'byor shes pa yengs su 'phangs// gsang spyod brtul shugs rlabs po che// gsang ba'i gnas su spyod rgyu la// rtul zhugs khrom du ston pa 'phangs// sgom pas byang chub thob pa la// sgom pa bzhag nas chos bshad byed// sgom chen ston pa byed pa 'phangs// bla ma'i gdams ngag seng ge'i zho// snod bzang nang du blugs rgyu la// snod ngan gdams ngag ster ba 'phangs// dben gnas yid du 'ong ba de/

dang por dang du blangs nas kyang*// bar du stong par bzhag pa 'phangs// rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i glu// ri khrod dgon par blang rgyu la// mang sar nyams myong glu len 'phangs// zhes gsungs pas/ dar lo na re/ khyed kyi pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su len shes sam/ zer bas yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su len tshul gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// skyabs chen rgyal ba dkon mchog gsum// bde chen spyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs// 'bral med dus gsum bla ma de/ mi brjed snying gi dkyil du bzhugs/ 'gro drug sems can ma rgan rnams// bde ldan blo yi phugs su bzhugs// nga theg chen chos la thon pa med// thugs ka'i stong nyid la bsam pa med// skye med gnas lugs la sgom pa med// mi dge bcu la log pa'i chos// ser sna'i rgya mdud grol ba yi// chos brgyad sbyin pas ci la phan// g.yo sgyu zol zog ma spangs pa'i// tshul 'chos tshul khrims ci la phan// tshig rtsub go cha mi thub pa'i/ sems 'khrugs bzod pas ci la phan// le lo dang snyoms las ma spangs pa'i// khral 'jal brtson 'grus ci la phan// rang sems g.yeng ba ma zhi ba'i// nan bsgom bsam gtan ci la phan// snang ba grogs su ma shar ba'i// yin lugs shes pas ci la phan// 'gag dang nya ga mi shes pa'i// thos pa che bas ci la phan// spang blangs lag len mi gtubs pa'i// rgyu 'bras kha rtsis ci la phan// rang rgyud tshogs dang mi ldan pa'i/ bdag lta'i 'dod pas ci la phan// lar nyon mongs dug sbrul mi gsod par// ye shes 'dod pa log lta yin// phrag dog gi 'tshub ma ma zhi bar// byams sems 'dod pa log lta yin// 'gro la gnod 'tshe ma spangs pa'i// chos la 'dod pa log lta yin// ngar 'dzin phyogs ris ma spangs pa'i// mnyam nyid 'dod pa log lta yin// rang zhi 'dod 'gong po mi rdung par// nyon mongs tho bas rnal 'byor rdungs// byed spyod tshogs su mi bsgyur bar// gzhan gyi dge la bar du gcod// sems dang chos gnyis mi bsre bar/

don med sdig pas rang sems dkrugs// chos la ma bsgom gyi nar gda'// 'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ ston pa de'i sems slus te mi kun gyis zer ba tsam mi 'dug /khyed la yang chos zab mo 'dug /da khyed pha rol tu phyin pa bcu nyams su len shes sam zer bas/ yang pha rol tu phyin pa bcu nyams su len tshul gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// khyed lo ston ston pa dar lo nyon// lar tshe yod du re la mi tshe zad// 'gal 'brel gyi tshig la sems sems nas// tshe sum gnyis zad pa ma tshor zi// lar ni dam chos mdzad na legs// dus snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs rags// mi sdig chen gyi kha la bzod klag med// rje sgra bsgyur mar pa sku drin can// dus snyigs ma'i sems can skyabs du gsol// dran pa sna tshogs kyis pha rol na// sbyin pa btang ba log na med// dran med rtogs pa'i pha rol na// tshul khrims bsrung ba log na med// zab mo mthong ba'i pha rol na/ bzod pa bsgom pa log na med// de gsum dbyer med pha rol na// brtson 'grus brtsams pa log na med// stong nyid rtogs pa'i pha rol na/ bsam gtan bsgom pa log na med// shes pa sna tshogs pha rol na// shes rab spyad pa log na med// byams sems rgyas pa'i pha rol na// 'gro don bya ba log na med// ye shes rgyas pa'i pha rol na// thabs zhes bya ba log na med// bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i pha rol na// stobs zhes bya ba log na med// bdag gzhan dbyer med pha rol na// smon lam 'debs pa log na med// ces gsungs pas/ yang zhus pa/ 'o na khyed la lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu ji lta bu bdog /bla ma su yin zer ba la mgur 'di gsungs so// sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la// phyi nang chos kun gsal la dag /shel sgong lag mthil bzhag pa 'dra// de rnam pa kun mkhyen stong pa nyid// de lta ba tsam zhig dper bzhag na// blo 'das kyi zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// rtag chad cham la 'bebs shing 'gro/

'gyur med lam du slong zhing 'gro// lta ba ngan te nga mi 'gyod// slad kyi sgom pa bzhed pa na/ sems nyid ma bcos lhug par zhog /'di la bcas bcos mi bya ste// bcos pa'i skyon gyis mthong mi 'gyur// sems nyid ma bcos chos kyi sku// sgom pa tsam zhig dper bzhag na// 'od gsal zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// bying rgod cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// rang byung lam la slong zhing 'gro// sgom pa zhen te nga mi 'gyod// yang cig spyod pa zhen pa na// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug lhug par zhog /shes pa ma dgug lhug par zhog /bya ba thong la sems kyi rten ma bca'// bying rgod byung na de ka rang la ltos// zhe 'dod byung na bdud du shes par gyis// de spyod pa tsam zhig dper bzhag nas// nges med kyi zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// phyogs ris cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// zhen med lam du slong zhing 'gro// spyod pa dman te nga mi 'gyod// sgrub pa'i dam tshig bzhed pa na// sems nyid ngang du bsrung bya dag /mi dge bcu las rnam par grol// g.yo sgyu mngon lkog ma mchis par// dam tshig lhun grub dper bzhag nas// rnam dag zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// g.yo sgyu cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// dam tshig 'phyal te nga mi 'gyod// lan gcig 'bras bu bzhed pa na// blo 'das mtshan ma rang grol ba'i// 'khor ba myang 'das spang blang med// rtogs pas dbang gis 'khor ba la/ skye 'gag med pas mya ngan 'das// gnyug ma tsam zhig dper bzhag nas// tshe gcig gi zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// re dogs cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// 'bad med lam du slong zhing 'gro// thob rgyu med de nga mi 'gyod/ de 'dra'i bla ma bzhed pa ni// rdo rje 'chang gis byin brlabs pa'i// rnal 'byor chen po te lo pa// grub pa brnyes pa'i nā ro pa// dka' ba spyad pa'i lo tsā ba// sangs rgyas nyid kyi brgyud pa bzhi// rje ras pa tsam zhig dper bzhag nas// man ngag zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// tha snyad cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// snyan brgyud lam du slong zhing 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/

ston pa dar lo dad pa skyes nas chos zhus te/ brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma ston sgom rab byung gi ya bar gyur pa zhig byung skad do// de thams cad dar lo'i skor ro/// /de nas ras chung pas/ bla la zhu ba zhus pa tshe cig la sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag zab ste/ ston pa rnams kyi chos skad la len ma theb na mi mang du ngo tsha bar 'dug pas/ nga rgya gar du chos shig zhur 'gro bas/ bla mas khyod tshe gcig la sangs rgyas 'grub na nor mi nyan/ tshig ngan gyi len 'debs 'dod pa bdud langs pa yin/ da rung khyod rang bsam blo legs par thong gsungs pa la/ ras chung pas zhus pa/ ngas bsam blo btang yang 'gyod pa med skyid pa yin zhus nas mgur 'di phul lo// sngon tshe pha yul rang sa bas// da lta snye nam drod phug bde// sngon tshe pha yul 'bru rko byed// da lta spyil po'i ga dar byed// sngon tshe pha khu'i gdan sa bas/ da lta bla ma'i zhabs drung skyid// sngon tshe da phrug kha ser bas/ da lta ras chung rdor grags bde// sngon tshe mthong thos sdug bsngal bas// da lta kun gyis mchod gnas bde// sngon tshe bkres skom 'bral med bas// da lta ting 'dzin 'tsho bas bde// chos la mi tshe skyel ba la// bde skyid thams cad 'grub pa'i thabs// rje ri khrod ras pa'i byin brlabs kyis// bdag bsam pa 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'o bu bde ba ngo shes pa de yon tan skyes pa'i rtags yin/ khyod kyi ming yang bde ba yon tan du thog gsungs so// de nas yab sras gnyis kyi snye nam pa la gser gyi bsod snyoms mdzad pas/ gser re mang zhig byung bas ras chung pa la thams cad gnang ste bla mas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu thos chung rtsod pa pham pa de/ nyams len zhan cing the tshom za// slob gnyer 'dod cing sa mtha' bskor// de rnal 'byor ldog pa'i 'phrang cig yin// khyod rgya gar yul du 'gro 'dod na// lus med mkha' 'gro'i dam chos zhus// rtsod pa'i tshig ngan bya rgyu med// nga dang po gtug sa ma nor bas// nā ro chen po'i brgyud la gtug

/bar du bsgom sa ma nor bas// bra dkar spo mthon rtse la bsgrubs/ tha mal ldom sa ma nor bas// bshes med 'dris med yul du ldom// de nas rnal 'byor ldog mi srid// nga lho bra mar pa'i zhabs drung du/ skal ba bzang po'i dam chos zhus// rje bla ma sangs rgyas 'di skad gsungs// 'khor los sgyur rgyal rin chen 'dzin// lam lnga bya 'phur chos nyid klongs// rig pa ye shes sgron me gcig /rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo gnyis// bde can gsung gi rin chen gsum// ro snyoms phyi yi me long bzhi// rang grol phya rgya chen po lnga// dam chos 'di lnga yod gsungs pas// nga na so rgas nas ma thon pas// khyod nā ro'i slob brgyud 'dzin pa'i bu// rgya gar yul nas long la shog /ces gsungs pas/ ras chung pa dga' nas gser tsho'i nang nas/ gser theg po gcig bla ma'i dbu thog tu 'phang nas 'di skad zhus so// bla ma'i bka' lung dgongs pa rnams// srog 'dor phyir yang sgrub par zhu// gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i bdud rtsi la// lung bstan bzhin du len par zhu// byin rlabs bka' drin thugs rje la// yeng ba med par 'jug par zhu// bka' tshig rdo rje'i phreng ba la// brjed pa med par dran par zhu// snang ba lam gyi bar chod la/ ras chung rje med bshes med la/ las ci la thug kyang skyob par zhu// rgya gar gcan 'phrang 'jigs pa las/ bdag gang du 'gro yang gzigs par zhu// 'dris med mi yi gdong dmar la// las 'phro bzang dang sprod par zhu// snang ba lam gyi bar chad la/ nor ba thal na bsgyur bar zhu/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// thugs rjes cis kyang 'dzin par zhu// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ras chung pa khyod kyi ston pa la lan ma theb bsam nas/ tshig ngan rtog ge'i sgum bu bslab na rang rgyud gyong hrang nge 'gro nas trang ba mis mi thub pa zhig red nas dge sbyor 'khrugs pas/ tshig ngan ma slob cig

/lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor dgu yod pa las/ bzhi lho brag mar pas blangs zin/ da lnga yod pa nga la long gsungs pa'i lung bstan yod de/ nga na so rgas pas ma thon pas/ khyod kyis long dang sems can la phan thog pa yin gsungs nas ras chung pa la rdzongs su btab pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// bu gcig tu gsang sngags thabs lam che// gnyis su bla ma'i gdams ngag che// gsum du rang gi shes rab che// de la che ba rnam gsum mdzod// gcig tu mkhas pa'i zhabs tog dgos// gnyis su bla mar dad pa dgos// gsum du rang la snying rus dgos// de la dgos pa rnam gsum mdzod// gcig tu srog rtsol gnas su tshud// gnyis su chos nyid klong du tshud// gsum du chos la nang byan tshud// de la tshud pa rnam gsum mdzod// gcig tu bde ba'i 'od gsal mthong*// gnyis su snang ba sna tshogs mthong*// gsum du lung rigs man ngag mthong*// de la mthong ba rnam gsum mdzod// bu phyag rgya mtshan ldan grogs su gces// nyams myong bde ba sems la gces// spyod pa glang chen lta bu gces// de la gces pa rnam gsum mdzod// snod ngan gdams ngag ster ba 'phangs// nyams myong glu ru len pa 'phangs/ rnal 'byor grong du 'khyams pa 'phangs// de la 'phang ba rnam gsum mdzod// gcig tu mched grogs tshogs su 'dus// gnyis su mkha' 'gro tshogs su 'dus// gsum du longs spyod tshogs su 'dus// de la 'dus pa rnam gsum mdzod// ces gsungs so// ras chung pa rgya gar du 'gro ba la/ kye ston zer ba'i rdzogs chen pa gcig gis dbus mdzad dpon slob bco lnga song ba la/ bal por sleb pa na/ bal po'i bha ri ma thams cad bod kyi dzo ki bzang po la chos zhu zer nas 'ong ba la/ bha ri ma cig gis 'phreng ba ske nas phud/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas dad pa chen po byas pa la/ kyi ston gyis rdzogs chen bshad pas/ bha ri ma de'i rna ba mi gtod par mi dad pa'i tshul byas pas/

ras chung pas/ khyod dang po dad nas phyis mi dad pa ci yin byas pas/ mo na re/ jo ki'i chos la dad rgyu ma byung*/ sangs rgyas pa'i chos shig bsgrubs pa la/ byin gyis rlobs pa'i bla ma/ dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam/ bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong dgos pa la/ lha med 'dre med rang zer bas gang la dad pa zer/ ras chung pas 'o na khyod kyi gdams ngag gcig zhu byas pas/ bod phrug sgron chung 'dra ba zhig /ngas gdams nga mi shes zer nas bud song*/ der de yi g.yog mo zhig 'dug pa la/ khyod kyi jo mo des chos ci byed byas pas nga la brngan zhig ster dang bshad zer/ der gser dum pa zhig byin pas/ dbyug pa zhig sgyid du bcug /phor pa zhig lag tu bzung nas/ rnal 'byor ma'i cha lugs shig byas nas song ngo*// ras chung pas/ rnal 'byor ma'i chos lugs shig yod par go'o// de nas bal po dang rgya gar gyi bar du 'grim ma byung bas/ dgun bal por bzhugs nas/ bal po hang su dkar po'i phag mo yang zhus nas dpyid kar song ba dang*/ bal po'i rgyal pos lam rtags shig blangs na rgya gar du phyin dgongs nas/ rnga ma dkar po gcig /gla gor gcig /gser zho gang dang gsum khyer nas mjal zhus tsa/ bod glan pa khyod dang rgyal po mjal sa med zer bas/ 'o na sku mkhar gyi rtse la byon nas ngas zhu rgyu gal chen zhig yod byas pas/ rgyal po sku mkhar gyi rtser mngon pa la/ phyag rten sna gsum po de phyag tu phul nas mgur 'di zhus so// rgyal po'i sku mkhar mtho mi mtho// phyogs ris dmag gi bskor na mngon// sgom pa'i ri rgyal brtan mi brtan// dgon par yun ring bsdad na mngon// spyod pa'i rgyal po bzang mi bzang*// chos brgyad chab la brgal na mngon// brtson 'grus rta pho mgyogs mi mgyogs// le lo'i thang la brgyugs na mngon// ser sna'i mdud pa grol mi grol// zang zing nor dang 'phrad na mngon// shes rab ral gri rno mi rno/

lung dang grub mtha' gshags na mngon// rgyal po'i bka' khrims dam mi dam// ras chung rgya gar du phyin na mngon// zhes zhus pas/ rgyal po'i zhal nas khyod mi la ras pa'i slob ma ras chung pa bya ba yod zer ba de e yin gsungs pas/ yin lags zhus pas/ gaṇḍi'i rtags shig gnang ste phyag rten yang phyir gtad de/ lam chas gang dgos pa khyer gsungs nas lam chas kyang gnang*/ da res khyed kyi rgya gar du 'gro tshad khrid dang cang yang mi gsung pas/ ras chung pas brgyad tsam khrid nas song bas/ shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal gyi rtsa ba na/ gsang sngags rgya po ti pu pa dang mjal nas gser srang gang kha phyes te phyag rten btang nas mgur 'di zhus so// rje bla ma'i sku mthong snang ba 'gyur// gsung thos pas las ngan sgrib pa 'dag /phyag dbang rkyen ngan bar chad sel// bltas shing lta 'dod gsol ba 'debs// bdag chags pa'i rgyal po pha yul spangs// 'dzin pa'i rgyal po nor rdzas spangs// zhen pa'i rgyal po nye 'brel spangs// las brgal bar dka' ba'i them pa brgal/ bgrod par dkar ba'i lam ring bgrod// nga sing ga la yi nags su phyin tsa na// nags khrod mun nag 'thib pa 'dra// mi rkun sbrang char bas kyang mang*/ tshe srog na bun bas kyang yal// gtsang kha la yi nags su phyin tsa na// sba zam lcam pa rlung spyod 'dra// tshe srog na bun bas kyang yal// bal po'i mthil du phyin tsa na// mi nad bu yug bas kyang 'tshubs// mi ro lud phung bas kyang mang*// tshe srog zil pa bas kyang yal// lam ring po'i dka' ba sna tshogs spyad// lus rkyen snang sdug bsngal mang lags kyang*// rje yid la byas pas gnod ma byung*// rje bla ma'i chos ni rgya mtsho 'dra// rgya mtsho'i gting la thug mtha' med// thug mtha' med pa'i chos shig zhu// bla ma'i chos ni nyi zla 'dra// nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'gro ba khyab// 'od kun la 'khyab pa'i chos shig zhu// bla ma'i chos ni nor bu 'dra// nor bus dgos 'dod char bzhin 'bab// don dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i chos shig zhu// bla ma'i chos ni sman mchog 'dra// sman mchog 'dus pa'i nad rnams sel// nad nyon mongs sel ba'i chos shig zhu// rje yid bzhin nor bu 'gro ba'i sman// ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'od zer gyis/

'gro ba sems can thams cad la// dgos 'dod nyi zla 'char du gsol// zhes zhus pas/ ti pu ba'i zhal nas bod phrug shes rab can zhig 'dug gsungs pas/ rma lo tswa ba na re/ shes rab che dang po nas bsam bsam pa yin zer bas/ ngas bod skad mi shes te thams cad shes rab kyi gshis las 'ong ba zhig 'dug gsungs/ gong nas bsam e yin/ 'phral la brgyud pa dang*/ bla ma dang*/ gdams ngag gang 'dod dris dang*/ 'phral du len theb na/ shes rab che ba'i rtags yin gsung pas/ gsungs ba bzhin dris pas mgur 'di phul lo// nga yi brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen yin// dka' babs te lo pa nas babs// bcud kyi bdud rtsi nā ros gsol// yon tan rgya mtsho mar pas blangs/ snyan brgyud drod rtags mi las bton// nga mi la ras chen brgyud pa 'dzin// gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud yin// nga rang ras chung rdor grags yin// nga ro snyoms phyi yi me long zhu// rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo 'dod// bde chen gsung gi 'khor lo 'dod// rang grol phyag rgya chen po 'dod// rig pa ye shes sgron me 'dod// gzhan yang gsang sngags dam pa'i chos/ gdams ngag rin chen dam pa'i nor// nor 'khrul med par gnang bar zhu// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma te phu ba'i zhal nas 'di gsungs so// khyod brgyud pa ma nor rdo rje 'chang*/ gdams ngag ma nor mkha' 'gro'i gsungs/ bka' babs ma nor te lo pa// bcud kyi bdud rtsi nā ros gsol// yon tan rgya mtsho mar pas blangs// mi la ras chen rtogs pa che// bka' babs bla ma'i brgyud pa 'dzin// bu khyod kyang snod ldan yin par mchi// da ro snyoms phyi yi me long yod// de yod khyod la ci mi sbyin// rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo yod// de yod khyod la cis mi sbyin// bde chen gsung gi rin chen yod// de yod khyed la cis mi sbyin// rang grol phyag rgya chen po yod// de yod khyed la cis mi sbyin// rig pa ye shes sgron med yod// de yod khyed la cis mi sbyin// gzhan yang dgos pa'i chos drug yod// de yod khyed la cis mi sbyin// brda don gsung gi nor bu yod// de yod khyod la cis mi sbyin// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len yod/

de yod khyed la cis mi sbyin// ngo sprod gnad kyi bar do yod// de yod khyed la cis mi sbyin// bsam gyis mi khyab gter mdzod yod// de yod khyed la cis mi sbyin// bsam gtan thun 'jog gdams ngag yod// de yod khyed la cis mi sbyin// zhes gsungs te zhus pa'i lnga/ ma zhus pa'i drug dang bcu gcig byung bas yid dum pa cig ma ches pas/ lo tswa ba 'di rnams kyis phrag dog byed pa e srid bsam nas/ rma lo tsā ba/ 'gos lo tsā ba gnyis la gser dum pa re byin te mgur 'di phul lo// khyod sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin lo tsā ba// spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i pha yul du// gti mug mun pa'i smag rum 'thib/ dpal mgon chags sdang gi 'dam du bying*// gnas thar med ngan song gi khong par tshud// khyed dus gsum mkhyen pa'i lo tswa ba/ blo ma rig mun pa bsal du gsol// sems the tshom dri ma bcad du gsol// ngag mi shes rgya mdud bkrol du gsol// lus chags sdang nyon mongs 'joms du gsol// zhes zhus pas/ lo tswa bas gser bsdus nas song*/ bla ma dang lo tswa ba sku bsod la yengs nas lo ma 'khor bar du chos ma byung bas/ yang ras chung pas/ gser mang sa cig la maṇḍal byas nas bla ma la phul te 'di zhus so// bdag lus tsha grang yid la ma bgyis te// sdug khu ru'i 'og nas sa lam bcad// yul bzang por phyi chags ma byas par// drin chen pha ma gson bskyur byas// zas zhim po ro la ma chags pas// tshong khe phog khram zas bsgrubs te bshol/ tshe 'di la chags sems ma skyes pas// srog shing 'gor gzad nas bla ma btsal/ lo na ning gi lo la dka' ba spyad// da lo'i lo la rje dang mjal// ngo mtshar ltad mo mtshar dgu mthong*/ shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal mthong*// te phu gsang sngags kyi sdang po mthong*// ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo mthong*// bhaṃ ga la yi phag mo mthong*// bal po shi la bha ro mthong*// bha ro gra ma'i spyod yul mthong*// chu srin kha nas chu 'babs mthong*/

gser gyi wa ti sor bzhi mthong*// mi rtag mya ngan 'das chen mthong*// lha dang lha mo'i zhing khams mthong*/ mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i mchod rdzas mthong*// bla ma'i dam chos seng ge'i zho/ snod ldan bu la gnang bar zhu// lo tsā'i thugs bskyed byams pa'i chang*// 'gro drug gi mgron la gnang bar zhu// sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung mkha' 'gro'i zas// rigs ldan bu la gnang bar zhu// bka' brgyud kyi rnam thar rin chen nor// rgyud ldan gyi bu la 'bog bar zhu// gsang tshig gi nyams dbyangs rdo rje'i sgra// chos mthun gyi bu la 'bog par zhu// dad ldan gyi skyes bu lo tswa ba// bka' drin gsung ni gsal bar mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ bla ma te pu ba'i zhal nas gdams ngag rnams gnang zin pas/ ras chung pa da khyed yid e ches gsung pas/ gdams ngag de'i mang lugs de la cung zad yid ma ches zhus pas/ te pu pa'i zhal nas/ lo tswa ba gcig gis kyang chos tshad mar ma bsgyur zin te/ lam du mkha' 'gro ma'i sprul pa gcig gis lhag chad sel bar 'dug gsungs so// de nas de nub ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mos tshe dbang mdzad pas/ ras chung pa la yang bla mas lung bstan nas zhus pas/ ma yi zhal nas khyod tshe ci tsam thub pa zhig 'dod gsungs pas/ ras chung pas bdag da kun shi na'ang bzang bsam pa zhig gi bar du thub pa gcig 'dod zhus pas/ ma yi zhal nas bsam pa mthon pos ci bsam la nges pa med/ bu pha yi tshe tshad dang mnyam pa gcig byed dgos gsung sa nas/ ras chung pa'i tshe tshad bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi yin pa la/ brgyad cu rtsa brgyad thub pa yin no// de nas de nub paṇḍi ta zla ba snying po de nags gseb tu phar tshogs 'khor tshar ba dang bzhud nas thal ba mthong bas/ ras chung pa yang phyir 'brangs nas song tsa/ shing tsan dan gcig gi rtsa ba na 'od dkar po phub tsam zhig kyi li li 'dug /de'i rtsa ba na 'dod 'jo'i ba zhig nyal 'dug pa la/ panḍi tas/

phyag byed 'dug pas/ ras chung pas phyag mang po rdol med la 'tshal 'dod pa byung bas/ mang du 'tshal tsa/ panḍi tas nam mkha' nas gar mang po mdzad/ me tog gi char pa bol nub pa tsam bab nas 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub pa'i nang du mkha' 'gro ma mang po 'dug pas mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma gsang sngags che ba'i sku// 'dod dgu sems la char du 'babs// lho sprin nags kyi shing gseb na// rang byung 'od kyi gzhal yas na// a ma rgan mo'i byin brlab la// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i me tog 'bab// shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal la// 'dod 'jo'i ba mo'i skur yang bstan// bhaṃ ga la yi phag mor 'khrungs// te pu dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// byin rlabs nus pa'i char pa 'babs// rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo bskor// ro snyoms phyi yi me long ltos// bde chen gsung gi rin chen chongs// dam tshig rang sems me long srung*// rmi lam sems kyi rgya mdud grol// 'od gsal ma rig mun pa sel// spyod pa chu la ral gri rgyob// dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma 'des// rang grol phyag rgya chen po bsgom// lus med mkha' 'gro'i brda yi chos// bu yi snying la gnas par shog /ces gsungs pa'i dbyangs rta la chags nas tshig ma zin pa la ras chung pa gnyid du song 'dug /gnyid sad tsa de rnams gar song ma shes 'dug /der tshig ma zin pas ras chung pa blo ma bde tsa/ te pu ba'i gzim khang ya them la shing ta la'i lo ma zhig la tshig rnams lhag chad med par bris nas 'dug skad do// gzhan yang gdams ngag mang po zhus te phyag rgya chen po la su mkhas dris pas/ bod glan pa bla ma bal po rang mkhas pa mi shes e yin zer/ de nas gser yod pa la tshogs 'khor bzang po zhig mdzad/ gser dum pa zhig bzung shul de rje te pu pa la phul nas mgur 'di zhus so// bdag dka' ba spyad pas don chen 'grub// dkon pa'i ltad mo mtshar dgu mthong*// ro snyoms phyi yi me long la// sgyu ma 'khrul pa'i sprul pa mthong*// bde chen gsung gi rin chen la// bden pa med pa'i mchod dbyangs tshor// rang grol phya rgya chen po la// dngos po med pa'i ltad mo shar// rig pa ye shes sgron me la// sna tshogs 'khrul pa'i cho 'phrul skyes// rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo la// tshe snga phyi rten 'brel mdangs gsal grub// gzhan yang dgos pa'i chos drug la// rgyud zab mo'i lung rigs 'khor du 'dus// te pu gsang sngags sdong po la// yi dam lha yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs// ma gcig grub pa'i rgya mo la// gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor// shing spang gser gyi maṇḍa la// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i mchod sprin 'dug

/'dod 'jo lha yi ba mo la// dngos grub gter gyi char pa 'bab/ bhaṃ ga la yi phag mo la// dus gsum sangs rgyas bzhugs gnas bcas// paṇa chen zla ba'i snying po la// thar par 'gro ba'i lde'u mig 'dug /'dir tshogs skal ldan pho mo la// gsang sngags chos kyi nyi ma shar// 'gro drug sems can pha ma la// mtho ris lam gyi nam mkha' langs// pha yi bka' drin ras chung la// nges shes zab mo'i me tog 'khrungs// mched grogs rdo rje'i spun tshogs la// dam tshig lha yi pha 'bab gnang*// bod kyi mgo nag mi rnams la// mun pa sel ba'i sgron me gtad// bdag re dga' re skyid skyid par byung*// ci dga' bsam shing de bas skyid// da dga' yul du 'gro snying 'dod// ces zhus pas/ te pu ba'i zhal nas/ da khyed rang 'gro na'ang song dang*/ khyod kyi bla ma rje btsun de yang sku khams bzang por bzhugs pa dang mjal bar 'dug gsungs nas dbang dang byin brlab gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par gnang ste khyod bod la 'gro dus su ga pur dang*/ gu gum dang*/ sindhu ra la sogs pa rnams bod du khyer dang khyod kyi bla ma de yang mnyes pa yin zhing*/ shing a ka ru nag po 'ba' zhig gi phyag 'khar 'di khyod kyi bla ma de la nged kyis bskur bas lam du ma stor bar gyis la phyag tu thong dang*/ khong sprang la mnyes pa'i rta dod yin// rgya bod gnyis kyi chos pa la khong bzang bas/ khyod kyis kyang gus pa'i sgo nas zhabs tog la 'bungs gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bka' drin che ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs shing bzhud par zhu// yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la// tshogs 'khor 'bul zhing bzhud par zhu// bka' dang bsrung ma'i chos skyong la// gtor ma 'bul zhing bzhud par zhu// bar chad rkyen ngan 'byung po la// snying rje bsgom zhing bzhud par zhu// sa 'phrang 'jigs pa'i g.yang sa la// the tshom med par bzhud par zhu/

bla ma rje btsun sangs rgyas la// dad gus bskyed cing bzhud par zhu// rnam thar zab mo'i bya btang la// dag snang bskyed cing bzhud par zhu// mi med lung stong gcig pu la// ngo mtshar bskyed cing bzhud par zhu// lung bstan zab mo'i mngon shes la// yi rangs bskyed cing bzhud par zhu// bla ma'i bka' drin yon tan la// drin du gzo zhing bzhud par zhu/ 'dir tshogs dpon slob grogs mched la// smon lam 'debs shing bzhud par zhu// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung ba dga' drag nas gser lhag ma ji yod pa las dum pa gcig bzung nas de shul phyag tu phul nas rtsol med kyi phyag mang po phul te sku khams bde bar bzhugs pa'i mgur 'di phul lo// nga song ba'i dus na rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas rin po che// skur gyur bla ma bde bar bzhugs// chos kyi spyan can chos kyi sku// byang chub lam mkhan bde bar bzhugs// yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi rgyan// gsang sngags sdong po bde bar bzhugs// thams cad mkhyen pa sprul pa'i sku// 'gro ba'i sgron me bde bar bzhugs// skal ldan bu yi skyabs gnas mchog /bka' drin dran pas bde bar bzhugs// da rung 'gro ba'i dpal mgon la// myang ngan mi 'da' bde bar bzhugs// ye shes 'phrin las sna tshogs kyis// bu yi lam sna 'dren du gsol// lam dang chu 'phrang sna tshogs la// 'od gsal dbyings kyi sgron me khyogs// rkyen dang bar chod thams cad la// byang chub rdo rje'i zlog pa mdzod// mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon thams cad du// ye shes dpa' bo'i skyel ma zhu// gar sdod bya ba'i las rnams la// mkha' 'gro chos skyong sdong grogs mdzod// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// bkra shis rten 'brel mdzad du gsol// zhes zhus pas bla ma shin tu mnyes nas smon lam bzang po'i 'phrin las bskul nas bal por slebs pas/ sngar 'phrad pa'i bha ri ma gtso mo de mdun du sleb byung bas khong dang 'phrad ma thag tu mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod spyan 'phangs 'di yi mtho lugs kyi// rdo rje 'chang nas brgyud las che// spyan rtsa 'di yi dmar lugs kyi// yi dam phag mo bsgom las che// gsang tshig 'di yi dam lugs kyi// te lo'i brgyud pa 'dzin las che// sku mdangs 'di yi che lugs kyi// mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig bsgom las che// dad gus 'di yi che lugs kyi/

te pu'i slob ma yin las che// nga dang dang por 'phrad lugs kyi// a ne'i gdams ngag thob las che// thugs rengs 'di yi che lugs kyi// sna gtad bzang po yod las che// ngang rgyud 'di yi 'jam lugs kyi// byang sems stong nyid rtogs las che/ thugs khur brtson 'grus che lug kyi// dam tshig sdom pa gtsang las che// zhes gsung pas khyod rgya gar du e phyin/ bla ma a ne sku khams e bzang zer bas/ a ne su la zer byas pas/ a ne grub pa'i rgyal mo che tshe lo lnga brgya lon pa gcig yod pa dang ma mjal ba e yin zer bas/ de la ngas tshe dbang dang gdams ngag zhus/ phag mo dang 'dod 'jo'i ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba mang po mthong zhus pas/ bha ri ma na re/ de shin tu bzang da 'o skol gnyis gsang tshig mthun par 'dug pas khyod kyi dpe cha rnams nga la ston dang gsungs pas/ ras chung pas dpe cha phyag tu bzhag nas mgur 'di phul lo// bka' brgyu bla ma ras chen bu// pha dang 'phrad pa'i smon lam zhu/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig bsgoms pa la// nyams dang rtogs pa'i byin brlab zhu// te phu'i slob ma yin pa la// dam tshig bla ma'i dngos grub zhu// a ne grub pa'i gdams ngag la/ de dang 'brel pa'i ngo sprod zhu// lta bsgoms zab mo'i nyams khrid la// yengs med bsgom pa'i smon lam zhu// lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor la// lhag chad med par zhu dag zhu// lam dang mdun gyi 'gro 'dug la/ bar chad med pa'i smon lam zhu// zhes zhus te ras chung pas dpe cha rnams gtad pa la legs par gzigs nas la la na dad dad dang gus gus byed cing mchi ma si li li 'ong zhing 'dug /la la sa na mi dad pa dang khro sdang byed cing 'dug pas/ ras chung pas khyod la la sar dad la la mi dad pa byed cing 'dug pa ci yin zhus pas/ khyod sgra mi shes pa'i skyon chen po byung 'dug /nga yi bla ma des 'di 'dra gar gsungs/ lo tsā bas khyod bod la phrag dog byas nas gal che ba'i gdams ngag rnams gcig kyang med par/

mi dgos pa'i tshig mang po btab nas 'dug gsungs nas/ lhag chad med par sgrig nas gtad pas bla mas lung bstan pa'i mkha' 'gro ma yin par ngo shes nas ras chung pa yang dad pa dang nges shes bzang po skyes so// de nas sman bzang drug mang po zhig khur nas 'ong zhing yod tsa/ lam khar mu stegs pa'i ston pa gcig 'dug pa dang 'phrad pas de na re/ ras chung pa khyod bod du 'gro ba la/ bstan pa spel ba dang 'dzin pa dang*/ bsrung ba dang gsum yod pa yin pas/ bsrung ba la nga yi gdams ngag 'di med thabs med pas khyod la gser dum pa zhig yod na ngas ster zer bas/ ras chung pas gser dum pa zhig yod pa byin nas mthu zhag bdun ma dang*/ gtad skyel ba dang*/ ser ba 'bebs pa dang*/ sri'u gso ba dang*/ gag lhog gzer gsum la sogs pa'i gdams ngag mang po zhig zhus so// de nas don thams cad grub pa dang lam bde bar 'ong ngo*// de thams cad te pu pa'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun chen po de/ brag dmar mchong gling gi brag la bsgoms shing bzhugs pa la/ ras chung pa shel gyi mchod rten 'od lhag ge ba zhig tu gzigs shing yod tsa/ ston pa'i ngan sngags zhus pa dang rlung dmar 'tshub ma zhig tu kyi li lir gyur nas song bas/ thugs ma bde nas mtshams bton te byon 'ong ba la/ nga yi bu de 'ong ba yin 'dug ste lam de na bar chad cig byung ba e yin dgongs nas/ thang dpal mo dpal thang la sleb pa dang*/ dpon slob gnyis gcig gis gcig 'byon pa gzigs nas/ ras chung pa'i bsam pa la/ nga rgya gar nas chos gdams ngag 'di tsam zhus pa la bla mas bsu ba byed pa red bsam nas nga la phyag len byed las che bsam/ bla mas khos don grub pa thams cad la nga yang dka' ba kho dang mnyam pa zhig song dgongs nas byon pas// thang gi stod du dpon slob gnyis mjal ba la/ ras chung pa la phyag len ma mdzad par hring nge dum pa zhig lus pas/ ras chung pas/ bla ma sku khams e bde lags zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje gangs dkar 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor la// khams bde ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rgyas// dug lngas dregs pa'i nad sangs pas// mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// 'du 'dzi zhen pa'i g.yeng ba spangs// gcig pur rang dbang thob pas bde// sna tshogs 'brel pa'i las spangs pas// mi med lung pa dben par bde// 'jig rten sdug gi khyim thabs spangs// 'phral du gsog 'jog med pas bde// mkhas 'dod dpe cha ma bsgrubs pas// sems brel med pa'i sems nyid bde// smra 'dod nga rgyal mi che bas// kha mchu kha smras med pas bde/ g.yo sgyu zol zog mi shes pas// de byung 'di byung med pas bde// grags 'dod dregs 'dod med pa yi// gtam ngan mi kha zad pas bde// gnas gang byung chog pas gar yang bde// gos gang gyon chog pas cis kyang bde// zas gang zos chog pas gang byung bde// mi nga ni dus rnams rtag tu bde// bu ras chung bde'am don grub bam// zhes gsung pas/ ras chung pas bla ma la zhus pa/ ngas rgya gar nas lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnams gdan drangs pa la khyed kyi phyag dang mchod pa dang bstod pa ma byas na bod blun po'i grong khyer mi dad lags zhus nas mgur 'di phul lo// rje bla ma'i bka' bzhin dka' ba spyad// lam 'phrang 'jigs pa'i sdug bsngal byung*// dka' spyad sdug bsngal rin thang che// rin thang bla ma rje dang mjal// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i sprin bzhin 'dus// ngo mtshar ltad mo thams cad mthong*// gdams ngag mkha' 'gro'i srog snying zhus// lha dang bla mas mnyes mnyes mdzad// bdag dang byin brlabs cig tu 'dres// dngos grub me tog char pa babs// rang dbang rjes gnang gos su bkon// ltas dang rten 'brel mgul du btags/ lha yi pha 'bab kha na bcug /man ngag dmar khrid lag tu gtad// bkra shis smon lam skyel ma mdzad// rtag tu lung bstan sun mas bsus// don chen bsam pa dgung dang 'grub// spro dga' skyid pa'i nyi ma shar// yang dga' bla ma khyed dang mjal// lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor la// mchod bstod zhabs tog khyed rang shes// zhes zhus pa dang*/

bla ma gang du bzhugs/ sku khams bde ba'i nyams rtogs gang du 'phel/ bu slob ras pa mched grogs mtshams par e bzhugs zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu ras chung bla ma'i mgur la nyon// bka' dri med bdud rtsi yid la zungs// nga gar bsdad bde ba'i zhing khams yin// chos gar byas lha yi pho brang yin// don gang phan mkha' 'gro'i gdams ngag yin// chos rgyud la bsre na dam pa yin// tshig gang phan bshad na bla ma yin// phan yid la 'jog na slob ma yin/ sems snang ba mthun pa 'brel ba yin// 'phur shes kyi bya la nam mkha' bde// rkyal shes kyi nya la chu bo bde// bsgom shes kyi mi la sems nyid bde// bu mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// nga dbyar ni g.ya' dang spang la bde// bsil dang rdza mo'i gseb tu bde// dgun ni nags ma'i gseb tu bde// chu shing 'dzoms pa'i phug pa bde// dpyid ni ri bo'i rtsibs na bde// na spang me tog tshom bu bde// ston ni ri bo'i rtse na bde// rin chen lo thog sna tshogs bde// na spang mtshams kyi khams sing bde// lus la gtum mo 'bar bas bde// ngag la gsang ba'i rgya mdud bde// sems la rang so zin pas bde// 'pho ba gser 'gyur rtsi legs bde/ grong 'jug sbrul lpags 'dor len bde// rmi lam 'khrul ba rang sangs bde// sgyu lus chos brgyad rang grol bde// 'od gsal ma rig mun sel bde// bar do chos nyid klong na bde// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod bde/ bde chen zag med dbyings su bde// ras pa mched grogs sku khams bzang*// bu ras chung bde'am don grub bam// zhes gsung pas/ yang ras chung pas gsung lan 'di mgur du phul lo// rje bla ma'i gsung ngag rdo rje'i tshig /bsgrubs pas rgya gar yul du phyin// gsang sngags sdong po rje dang mjal// grub pa'i rgyal mo'i dngos grub thob// ngo mtshar che ba'i yi dam mthong*// mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan rtags dang mjal// gdams ngag rin chen bum pa thob// bde chen gsu gi rin chen thob// dam tshig rang sems me long thob// dam rdzas rtogs pa'i nyi ma thob// spyod pa chu la ral gri thob// rang grol phyag rgya chen pa thob// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len thob// ngo sprod gnad kyi bar do thob// bsam gtan mthun 'jog man ngag thob// brda don gsum dang rin chen lnga// gzhan yang dgos pa'i chos drug dang*// bsam mi khyab pa'i gdams ngag thob// rin chen gser dang 'dra ba'i chos// mang du bzhugs pa'i mchod bstod mdzod// thugs la e 'phrod gzigs par zhu// zhes zhus pas/

bla mas/ ras chung pa la/ nga rgyal chen po 'dug pa dgongs nas ras chung pa'i nga rgyal gcog pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// bu chung nas bskyangs pa'i ras chung pa// khyod sdug yus ma che glu 'di nyon// glu don chen gser thag 'phreng ba'i ngag /brda snyan po gsang ba'i ngar sgra 'grigs// don 'thad 'thad 'dra na thugs la zungs// mi chad po rang che 'dod pa de// mi ngan pa'i lag tu grir 'chir 'gro// nor phyug po ser snas bsags pa de// dgra sdang ba'i lag tu nom pa sprad// rgyags pa rgyags lhag 'tshol ba de// ltogs drir shi ba'i snga ltas yin// ngan pas ngan tshod mi zin par// rang pham par 'gro ba kho na yin// dpon ngan pas g.yog po bcom pa de// yul bzang po lad pa'i phung 'dre yin// mi ngan pas rje bo mi khur ba// rang phung ba'i than ltas ngan pa yin// chos pas rang tshugs mi zin pa'i// bstan pa bsnubs pa'i phung shing yin// mkha' 'gro'i gdams ngag mi gsang ba// lha dang lha mo 'khrugs pa'i rtsa ba yin// bu gdams ngag rang rtsis che ba de// rgyud ngan pa skra ring 'chor 'dod yin// kha skam po chos bshad mang ba de// nyams bzang po'i bsgom 'phro 'jog 'dod yin// byas sha dang byas yus che ba de// bla ma spang blangs byed 'dod yin// slob mas bla ma mi khur na// gyong la de bas che ba med// sgom chen ri la mi zug na// god la de bas che ba med// chos pas nye ring ma spangs na// phung la de bas che ba med// mkhas pas nyams len ma byas na// khram la de bas che ba med// btsun pas tshul khrims mi bsrungs na// ngo la de bas tsha ba med// bu ras chung zer ba'i bzhin legs po// don 'thad par gda' na thugs la zungs// de mi 'thad dgongs na gang mdzad mdzod// nga myur du 'chi ba'i mi rgan la// yun ring lab snying byed mi khom// khyed gzhon nu rang rtsis re bden bsam// nga rgyal mi rgod kha rgod la// lab na tshur lab grim du gtong*// rje sgra bsgyur gyi mar pa sku drin can// sprang chos brgyad zad par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs te ras chung pa'i dpe cha khres po rnams bla mas khur nas byon song ba la ras chung pa thag ring po nas 'ong bas bla ma'i phyi la ma slebs pas/

rtog pa gcig la nga yi gdams ngag mi 'dod gsung pa 'dra ba zhig la 'khyer nas 'gro ba e ma yin/ ngas ma slebs na don med pa'i mi la gtad pa e srid bsam nas rjes su mar rgyug cing mgur 'di ras chung pa'i mgur dbyangs su grags pa 'di phul lo// bla ma rje btsun snyan gson dang*// sprul sku ras chen snyan gson dang*// bu pha dang thugs yid 'dzol mi srid// bka' dri ma med pa'i gdams ngag rnams// pha yis gzigs nas bzhes par zhu// lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnams// lhag chad nor 'khrul mkha' 'gros bsal// zab dang yang zab bka' rgyas btab// bla ma'i drung du 'bul lags pas// pha yis gzigs la bzhes par zhu// gzhan yang rten 'brel tshe sgrub dang*// mkha' 'gro brda yi gsang tshig dang*// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs dang*// grub pa'i rgyal mo'i thugs dam yod// de yod bla ma rje la 'bul// pha yi gzigs la bzhes par zhu// gzhan yang bstan srung zab mo dang*// nad la phan pa'i man ngag dang*// gdon la phan pa'i gnad gzer dang*// rta brgya brgya re ba'i gdams ngag mang*// de rnams bla ma rje la 'bul/ pha yi gzigs la bzhes par zhu// sman mchog a ga ru chen la// phyag mkhar mnga' gsol te pus mdzad// ya mtshan rin thang nor gyi mchog /de la mkha' 'gros byin brlabs yod// de yang bla ma'i phyag tu 'bul// pha yi gzigs la bzhes par zhu// bzang drug sman gyi sgye'u dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dam rdzas rnams// rje la 'bul snyam dpung pa'i sgang*// 'phrag pa'i kha la bkal nas 'ong*// bla ma'i bka' drin len du 'bul// pha yi gzigs la bzhes par zhu// thang chad ngal gso'i bka' gnang na// sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i mchog tu 'gyur// bkres skom lus la phan btags na// bka' drin yongs kyi rgyal po yin// kha tshig bzang pos nor sbyin na// phongs pa rnams la khyad par 'phags// zhal ta bzang po'i lam ston na// chos rgyal rnams kyi dam tshig yin// zhes zhus pas/

bla mas ras chung pa bsgug nas mgur de la dar cig gsan pa dang*/ ras chung pa la zhal ta bzang po'i mgur 'di gsungs so// bu kun dang mthun na rgyal po yin// pha dang mthun na yang rgyal yin// bu gcig dang mi mthun brgya than yin// pha dang mi mthun 'dre than yin// bzang spyod pha dang mthun na 'grub// drin can ma la byams na 'khor// spyod pa mi dang mthun na mdzes// bsam pa bla mar dad pas 'grub/ byin rlabs mched grogs mnyes pas 'grub// rang 'dod rang rtsis chung bas 'grub// chos pa gshis ngan spangs na yin// mi kha drin chen bkur na byams// gtam snyan gnyom chung bskyangs na yod// lha kha ngos lkog med na dge /yon tan rje dang 'grogs na skye// 'dre kha rnam rtog chung na khog /bzang po byams sems che na 'ong*// lar mkhas pa'i nye ba thams cad yin// blun pos dgra gnyen ngo mi shes/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor la// lam du bltas pas ci la phan// te pu gsang sngags sdong po la/ khyod bas 'brel pa nga rang zab// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig rnams// nga la gsang nas su la zlo// ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo la// rang bas lhag pa'i slob ma yod// shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal na// tshogs kyi skal pa mang po zos// yi dam rdo rje phag mo la// khyod bas nga rang 'grogs yun ring*// lha dang lha mo'i zhing khams rnams// nga dang 'brel pa'i lha tshogs rang*// khyod kyis byas pa'i las rnams la// de bas nga rang sems khur che// bu legs 'dod dregs pas mi 'ching bar/ ri khrod dben par bsgom du 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa'i bsam pa la bla ma la mngon par mkhyen pa thogs pa med pa mnga' bas/ nga 'ong ba ni mkhyen/ de'i chos shig yod bsam pas/ bla mas gar gsungs pa'i gnas su 'gro zhus nas dpon slob gnyis 'grogs nas thang la yar byon no// de thams cad zhal ta yo bde'i skor ro/// /de nas dpon slob gnyis thang dpal mo dpal thang na yar sleb pa dang*/

ras chung pa la rtog pa ngan pa zhig skyes te nga yi bla ma 'di thod pa mi tshe'i ring la ma phyid par sdod pa zhig gda'/ mi'i chos pa gang bzang bzang rnams la'ang chos brgyags dum pa re la ma brten pa mi 'dug /ngas rgya gar yul nas chos 'di tsam zhig gdan drangs nas 'ongs kyang*/ nub cig gi gnas mal yang med las che bsam zhing*/ sku lus la bltas tsa/ sngo ba ham pa/ dbu skra phying pa'i sngas dang*/ ras dug rkyang pa re la mi tshe bskyal nas grub pa thob pa'i rtags kyang de snga ma rig /las ngan pa zhig la ming grub thob tu btags pa ni mi srid ang bsam zhing yod tsa/ yid la med par g.yag
