ru zhig rnyed pa de/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu mi mkho ba'i nor bzung na mkho ba'i dus 'ong bya ba yin pas g.yag ru 'di zungs shig gsungs pas/ ras chung pas 'dis ci byed za ni mi nyan/ gyon ni mi nyan pa 'dis nor zhig e 'ong yin bsam zhing bzung nas 'ong*/ yang ras chung pas 'di mi 'khyags par 'dug lags zhus pas/ da rung dum pa zhig zungs gsungs/ nam mkha' dang nas yod tsa/ sprin thams cad dus gcig la 'dus nas ser ba chen po lag mgo tsam babs pas/ ras chung pas g.yag ru bskyur nas bros tsa/ 'gro yang ma bcug pas mgo btum nas bsdad/ bla ma gar byon yang mi shes/ ser ba chung du song ba dang btsal tsa ye nas ma rnyed/ theb cig mgur lhang lhang grags pas nyan tsa/ g.yag ru'i rtsar grags pa der song tsa/ g.yag ru de'i nang nas gsung lhang lhang grags pas de ci yin nam bsam nas/ ras chung pas g.yag ru yar blangs tsa/ brag la 'jus pa bzhin song bas/ 'gram pa sa la phab nas bltas tsa/ g.yag ru yang du ma song*/ rje btsun chung du ma song bar g.yag ru'i dogs pa rang du sku lus 'khrul 'khor lde ma ldem mdzad nas ras chung pa la mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus tha mal du sdod pa sgom chen min// rdzu 'phrul lus kyi bkod pa la// phyag bskor ba gyis shig ras chung pa// bla ma'i byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag 'chal tshig smra ba sgom chen min// gdams ngag glu yi dkor mdzod la// don yid la zungs shig ras chung pa// bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs// sems rtog ngan du 'khyams pa'i sgom chen min// mngon shes rig pa'i rten 'brel la// dad gus bskyed cig ras chung pa// bu ras chung gi lta ba rgod po 'dra// res 'ga' mtho ste res 'ga' dma'// lta ba mtho dman gyi bar du bsam blo thong*// blo tshab tshub ma mang ras gos 'bangs// bu ras chung gi sgom pa nyi zla 'dra// res 'ga' gsal te res 'ga' 'grib// sgom pa gsal 'grib gyi bar du bsam blo thong*// blo tshab tshub ma mang ras gos 'bangs// bu ras chung gi spyod pa skyi ser 'dra// res 'ga' dal te res 'ga' brel/

spyod pa dal brel gyi bar du bsam blo thong*// blo tshab tshub ma mang ras gos 'bangs// bu ras chung gi 'bras bu lo thog 'dra// re 'ga' yag ste res 'ga' nyes// 'bras bu yag nyes gyi bar du bsam blo thongs// blo tsab tsub ma mang ras gos 'bangs// bu rkyen phra'u ser ba'i glo rgyag la// mkhar btsan po g.yag ru'i nang na skyid// pha yis bu la 'bod pas 'byon par zhu// bu pha khyim du mi 'byon 'thad rgyu med// pha g.yag ru'i phra sar 'khrul 'khor bzhugs// bu g.yag ru'i sbom sar 'byon par zhu// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas lag mgo shong yod pa e yin bsam nas 'dzul song tsa lag mgo yang ma thar bas/ de ring 'di ci yin bsam nas gsung lan mgur 'di phul lo// bla ma rje btsun snyan gson dang*// nga yi lta ba mtho yang mi mtho rang sar gda'// dma' yang mi dma' rang sar gda'// lta ba mtho dman med pa'i ngang la gda'// ras gos skam rung rlon rung gsol ba 'debs// nga sgom pa gsal yang mi gsal rang sar gda'// 'grib kyang mi 'grib rang sar gda'// gsal 'grib med pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// ras gos skam rung rlon rung gsol ba 'debs/ nga yi spyod pa dal yang mi dal rang sar gda'// brel yang mi brel rang sar gda'// dal brel med pa'i ngang la gsol ba 'debs// ras gos skam rung rlon rung gsol ba 'debs// nga yi 'bras bu yag kyang mi yag rang sar mda'// nye kyang mi nye rang sar mda'// yag nyes med pa'i ngang nas gsol ba 'debs// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma g.yag ru'i nang nas phyir bzhengs te/ nam mkha' lta stangs zhig mdzad pas sprin rnams so sor deng nas/ nyi ma tsha lhem pa zhig byung ba las/ ras gos bskam nas/ dar tsam zhig dpon slob gnyis bzhugs tsa/ nyi ma yang la 'das nas thal bas ras chung pa'i bsam pa la ngas rgya gar nas nga sngags mang po 'khyer nas 'ong dgongs nas/ bla mas kyang ser ba 'beb pa bslab 'dug bsam nas/

bla ma lags/ de ring ser ba de 'bab don med pa la babs/ da 'grang ltogs gnyis ka 'dzom pas/ pha ri'i ru ba de la bsod snyoms la song na zhus pas/ ser ba babs pa nga len pa min/ bsod snyoms dus la ma 'bab pas/ mi 'gro mi ngan pas labs gsungs pas/ ltogs pa'i dus 'di dus yin/ bsod snyoms la 'byon par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ 'o na mdun gyi dang po la rten 'brel gyi gsum gnyis yod bya ba yin pas/ yar gyi sbra mo che la gtod ma 'dong gsungs pas/ bla ma lags/ sbra mo che ring bar 'dug /chen po la ma rngams/ chung ngu la ma brnyas bya ba yin pas/ ru sna'i sbra chung ser po 'di nas yar 'dong dgos lags byas nas/ mar gyi sbra chung ser po'i sgor song ba la/ nang nas rgan mo zhig byung ste/ mo na re/ rnal 'byor pa sprang ba'i dus mi shes pas/ da zhags su la yang tsa med/ khyed tsho za 'dod pas chog pa min zer nas ngan smad smras byas pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ras chung pa/ do nub bza' mi zos par 'dug gsungs nas/ pha zad cig tu song nas gzims tsa/ nam phyed ru ba de rnams ku ti ri ri byung bas/ bla mas ras chung pa la nam langs pa dang*/ ras chung ba mdang ru ba de/ ku co che bas ci red ltos dang gsungs pas bltas tsa/ mdang gi a lding ser po de min gyi ru ba rnams gar yang mi 'dug zhus pas/ 'o na der 'dong zhig gsungs nas dpon slob gnyis byon pa la/ rgan mos de nub yul gnyen po la ngan smras byas pa'i chad pas shi nas 'dug /nor rnams ru bas khyer nas za rgyu mar thud rtsam pa mang zhig dang zho zo ba gang bsnyal rung la lus 'dug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ras chung pa thams cad 'di dang 'dra/ mdang mo la 'di rnams 'phangs mo yod de da nang 'o cag gnyis la bzhag 'dug pas/ kha zas dod pa dang da phyir sprod cig gsungs pa la/ ras chung pas bla ma'i zhal la bltas nas bsdad pas da ma sdod par 'tsho ba drongs shig gsungs nas de rnams la 'tsho ba bzang po drangs nas lhag ma byung ba rnams khres por brdzeb nas da 'byon lags zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas/ ras chung pa ro zas zos nas ro chog ma byas pas mi 'ong*/ zas za ba rgan gyis zo/ las byed pa de gzhon gyis byed bya ba yin pas khyod kyis ro khur/ ngas ro sna byed gsungs pas/ ras chung pa'i thugs dgongs la/ bla mas gang min min byed par 'dug /rgan mos 'di'i ro khur bas grib cig kyang e 'ong bsam zhing*/ ma ngam tsam zhig la khur nas song ste/ spang kha zhig tu sleb pa dang da 'dir zhog gsungs nas/ sba yi ber ma lcag de rgan mo'i snying khar btsugs nas 'o ras chung pa/ 'di lta bu'i mi rtag pa skye 'gro thams cad kyi steng du gnas/ sgos su 'o cag gnyis la myur du 'ong ba mi shes nga tsho'i skal pa chad nges pas dogs zon tsha mo zhig dgos gsung nas mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe drug 'di mgur du gsungs so// rje bla ma'i sku drin bsam las 'das// mi rtag rgyud la skyes pas byas tshad chos su song*// 'chi ba yang yang dran pas le lo'i bdud las rgyal// nam 'chi shes rgyu med pas mdang gi rgan mo 'dra// ras chung snang ba ma 'gyang bla ma'i glu 'di nyon// phyi snang ba'i yul la phar bltas tsa// snang ba mi rtag mdang gsum rmi lam 'dra// rmi lam dran zhing 'khrul pas blo ma bde// 'khrul pa rtsad nas chod dam ras chung pa/ bdag bsam zhing blo sems bde ba zhig byung*// nang skyid 'dod gzugs kyi tho yong 'di// ci phan phan sgrub snyam sdug bsngal spyod// mi gtsang rdzas kyi tho yong la// rang rtsis ma che glu 'di nyon// rang gi lus la tshur bltas tsa// lus mi rtag rtsa thog zil pa 'dra// lus blangs shing 'jigs pas blo ma bde// skye shi rtsad nas chod dam ras chung pa// bdag bsam zhing blo sems bde ba zhig byung*// sems ngan pa'i mi la skyid thabs med// tshab tshub kyi blo mang gyod dang 'phrad// rang gshis ngan pa rang gis byur/ sems rtog 'dod ma che glu 'di nyon// nang 'dzin pa'i sems la tshur bltas tsa/

sems mi rtag sgang kha'i byil dang 'dra// sems bzhag sar mi sdod blo ma bde// sems nyid btsan sa zin nam ras chung pa// bdag bsam zhing blo sems bde ba zhig byung*// nang srog dbugs rta rnga'i nyag ma tsam// chad la khas kyi spring spring po/ rkyen zur tsam mi brtan rgan mo'i dbugs dang 'dra// tshe 'di la ma zhen glu 'di nyon// nang 'gyu ba'i dbugs la tshur bltas tsa// dbugs mi rtag nam mkha'i na bun 'dra// na bun yal nas 'gro bas blo ma bde// 'gyu ba rang sangs phyed dam ras chung pa// bdag bsam zhing blo sems bde ba zhig byung*// rigs ngan gyi nye ba 'grogs shing sdang*// mi ngan gyi grogs pos dme ngan slong*// phan e thog rgan mo'i khyim mtshes 'dra// bu re ba ma che glu la nyon// 'dus pa'i grogs la tshur bltas tsa/ grogs mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron po 'dra/ grogs 'dus nas 'bral ba blo ma bde/ 'brel pa gong du zhog gam ras chung pa// bdag bsam zhing blo sems bde ba zhig byung*// nor bsags tshad bdag pos mi spyod pa// srid pa las kyi bden pa yin// ser snas bsags pa'i nor rdzas rnams// rgan mo'i sngas kyi phye thud 'dra// bu zhen pa ma che glu la nyon// rang gis bsags pa'i nor la tshur bltas tsa// nor mi rtag sbrang ma yi sbrang rtsi 'dra// bdag bsags gzhan gyis spyad pas blo ma bde// sems nyid gter kha phyed dam ras chung pa// bdag bsam zhing blo sems bde ba zhig byung*// zhes gsungs te/ ras chung pa/ 'o skol gnyis 'jig rten 'di na sdod pa'i long med/ gangs ti se la bsgom du 'gro gsung pas/ ras chung pas zhus pa/ bdag rgya gar nas dka' ba spyad nas bod du sleb pas lus ngan cing ngal dub ma gsos pas/ bsod snyoms byed nas dgon pa thag nye ba zhig tu bsdad na min pa sgom nus le med lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ chos snying nas byed bsam na 'di bzhin byed pas chog gsungs nas chog pa brgyad kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// bu dgon pa rang gi lus kyi chog

/lus gnad lha yi pho brang yin// bla ma rang gi sems kyis chog /nges shes dam pa'i skyes mchog yin// dpe cha phyi snang yul gyi chog /sna tshogs thar pa'i lam dpe yin// zas su ting 'dzin za bas chog /zhi gnas lha yi pha 'bab yin// gos su gtum mo gyon pas chog /bde drod mkha' 'gro'i ras gos yin// gnyen la 'brel thag gcod pas chog /gcig pu lha yi tshogs dpon yin// sdang ba'i dgra la byol bas chog /dgra bo mgron po lam 'khyams yin// bgegs la stong nyid bsgom pas chog /sna tshogs cho 'phrul nyams snang yin// yin lugs spyod na de ltar mdzod// med bzhin spyod pa log pa'i lam// nga mi rgan 'chi ched byed pa la// khyod dang yun ring lab mi khom// khyod gzhon nu sha snying khrag rgyas la// phan par lab kyang khar mi nyan// rang rtsis che yus log pa la// drang por smra ba chud zos yin// sgom na nga yi phyi la 'dong*// mi sgom khyed rang ci bsam gyis// zhes gsungs nas byon song ba la/ ras chung pa bla ma'i thu ba la 'jus nas mi chog pa brgyad kyi mgur 'di phul lo// dgon pa rang gi lus kyi chog lags kyang*// nyal sa bla gab gar yang dgos// char chu dgra bos su la'ang gnod// der yang ma chog pa zhig byung*// bla ma rang gi sems kyis chog lags kyang*// ngo sprod bla ma cis kyang dgos// gsol ba 'debs yul med thabs med/ der yang ma chog pa zhig byung*// dpe cha phyi snang yul gyi chog lags kyang*// the tshom bar chad gang yang sleb// gsol 'debs dpe bum med thabs med// der yang ma chog pa zhig byung*// zas su ting 'dzin za bas chog lags kyang*// 'tsho ba lus 'tsho tsam zhig med thabs med// sgyu ma'i lus po rdzas la brten// der yang ma chog pa zhig byung*// gos su bde drod gyon pas chog lags kyang*// ngo tsha'i dri mas gang yang sleb// khrel dang ngo tsha gang la'ang 'jigs// der yang ma chog pa zhig byung*// gnyen la 'brel thag bcad pas chog lags kyang*// mthun 'jug spyod pa gar yang dgos// grogs la bzang ngan su la'ang yod/

der yang ma chog pa zhig byung*// sdang ba'i dgra la byol bas chog lags kyang*// mi ngan lam sgo gar yang tshugs// zhe sdang dgra bo gar yang slebs// der yang ma chog pa zhig byung*// bgegs la stong nyid bsgom pas chog lags kyang*// 'byung po yi dwags bsam pa ngan// ngar 'dzin 'byung po thul bar dka'// de yang ma chog pa zhig byung*// lar bla ma'i drung du 'tshams par slebs// gang byas kyang bde zhing skyid par nges// zhes zhus pas ti se la 'gro ba bshol nas mchong lung gi brag la dpon slob gnyis byon no// de thams cad g.yag ru'i skor ro/// /de nas mchong lung du sleb pa dang bla mas brag gi gseb nas rdzi'u gnyis bton nas byung ba dang*/ ras chung pa dpe cha rnams nga la thong dang chu mig 'dis nga yi mig la gzan par byung bas gos chu pha ki nas chu zhig long la shog gsungs te ras chung pa chu len du btang bas/ de'i shul du bla mas me zhig bus nas dpe cha'i glegs shing g.yas g.yon du bzhag nas 'di gsungs te/ ngas rgya gar du chos 'tshol du btang ba'i lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor thams cad mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi brag gi gseb tu gdan drongs shig /gzhan mu stegs kyi ngan sngags rnams phying khug 'dir sdod cig gsungs nas ngan sngags thams cad me la bsreg nas bzhag /der ras chung pa chu kha na song tsa/ pha ri'i thang zhig na rkyang ma bu bdun/ spyang ma bu bdun/ rtsed mo rtse zhing 'dug pa la bltas pas/ rkyang phrug khrid ma khad kyi spyang ki la 'brel shes spyang phrug khrid ma khad kyis rkyang 'ded shes par 'dug pas/ a mtshar po bag chags goms pa la pha ki 'dra yi nus pa 'dug bsam zhing yun ring po zhig song ba'i bar du yengs nas song 'dug pas/ a e de ma bzang bla ma ma mnyes dgongs nas mgyogs par 'ong bas gnam sgor sleb tsa na/ shog bu'i dri ma chil le 'dug pa dang*/ ras chung pa'i bsam pa la/

nga yi bla ma 'dis smyo spyod byed e yin/ dpe cha rnams bsreg las che bsam zhing steng du phyin tsa/ shog bu'i dud pa chi le bsreg nas 'dug pas/ ras chung pas/ bla ma lags/ khyed rang gis ston pa'i chos skad la len ma theb pas ngas rgya gar du dka' ba de tsam zhig la gtad don mi 'dug /lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor me la bsreg kyang mi rung tsa zer nas/ sngar dad pa log pa'i steng du de ring rang dbang med pa'i dad pa log nas gnam sgo'i steng du rkang pa brkyangs nas mig gi dkar sa/ ltag pa'i nag sa bstan pa/ rje btsun gyi khong rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug tu/ rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams skad cig la sprul nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu nyon dang gsan dang ras chung pa// pha rje btsun bzhugs pa'i spyi gtsug na// nyi zla pad ma'i gdan steng na// bla ma te lo dang nā ro mar pa gsum// de gsum 'du 'bral med par bzhugs// mu tig rtsar la brgyus pa bzhin// khyod dad pa'i sems kyis lta shes na/ mos gus ltad mo de la ltos// byin brlabs dngos grub zad pa med// rje dang thugs yid bsres shig ras chung pa// khyod ltad mo dang gzigs mo 'di la ltos// rkyang la ltad mo lta rgyu med// rkyang phrug 'o mas 'grangs pas bsam rlag yin// spyang phrug sha yis brgyags pa 'byung po yin// de la ltad mo lta ba 'byung po yin// ltos shig ltos shig yar la ltos/ bdag gi spyi gtsug steng du ltos// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ yar la zur mig /cig bltas pas/ bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ bla ma rje btsun dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang skad cig kyang 'du 'bral med kyang bla ma khyed kyi grub rtags bstan pa ngo mtshar che ste/ mkha' 'gro'i chos skor tsho me la bsregs pas blo ma bde/ rkyang ma bu la lta 'dod zhus pas/ yang rje btsun gyis/ bu nyon dang gson dang ras chung pa/

pha bla ma'i spyan mig g.yas g.yon na// gdugs nyi zla zung gcig gur khang na// 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i khyon thag 'then// byang sems dkar dmar 'od zer 'phros// skyabs mchog lo tsā de na bzhugs// che na ngo mtshar de che mod// rkyang la ngo mtshar che rgyu med// ces gsungs pas 'od zer gyis mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin mthong*/ bla ma'i mdzad pa mtha' yas kyang sems can las las grub pa 'di kun kyang ya mtshan che snyam pa la/ bu de kun sku'i grub rtags bstan pa tsam yin/ da 'di nas ltos gsungs nas/ ljags kyi steng du gsung gi grub rtags la/ shel gyi mchod rten rtse dgu pa snang la rang bzhin med pa 'od dang thig le'i gur phub pa zhig bstan pa de la ma dang mkha' 'gros phyag 'tshal/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi skor ba byed pa zhig bstan nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu gcig nyon dang ras chung pa// pha bla ma bzhugs pa'i ljags dkyil na// shel gyi mchod rten rtse dgu pa// snang la rang bzhin med par gsal// phyi nas bltas na nang yang gsal// nang nas bltas na phyi yang gsal// phyi nang gsal ba'i chos kyi sku// de la sngon po g.yu yi kha bad btang*// dkar po dung gi maṇḍal bkod// 'ja' 'od gur khang thig le'i nang*// yi ge rang sgra mchod pa'i dbyangs// ma dang mkha' 'gros bskor ba byed// lha srin sde brgyad phyag kyang 'tshal// khyod dag pa'i snyan pa brjod shes na// chos rnams rang gis ngag la grags// kha nas gang smras chos kyi sgra// ngag la nus pa thon cig ras chung pa/ khyod ltad mo dang gzigs mo 'di la ltos// rkyang la ya mtshan che rgyu med// rkyang ma bu dud 'gro sha sgye yin// spyang mo sha zan srin mo yin// de la lta ba yi mug yin// ltos shig ltos shig yar la ltos// bu bdag gi ljags kyi steng du ltos// zhes gsungs pas de yang ji lta ba bzhin mthong*/ bla ma'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab/

khyad par gsung gi rnam 'phrul brjod kyis mi lag kyang*/ dpe cha bsreg pa la yid tung nge theg pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu khyod kyis bye ma la snag btsir ba cig snang*/ ngas ltad mo zhig ston gsungs nas gri gug gcig gis thugs ka nas bshags kyi bshags nas phyag gnyis kyi pha yar brgyangs par mdzad de gyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar gar dang gar stabs khrig ge ba bstan nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu cig nyon dang ras chung pa// pha rje btsun bzhugs pa'i thugs kha nas// dgyes rdor sprul pa'i lha dgu rnams// cung zad ma rig rig la khad// dpa' bo'i g.yas gral g.yas nas bya// dpa' mo'i g.yon gral g.yon nas byas// 'ja' yi gur phub lta bur bzhugs// las kyi mkha' 'gros lag bde byed/ khyed rang lus lha skur bsgom shes na// don gsal 'grib med par dngos su 'char// tha mar lus po 'ja' lus 'grub// bskyed rim lus la sgoms shig ras chung pa// bu ltad mo dang gzigs mo 'di la gyis// rkyang la ngo mtshar che rgyu med// rkyang smad glan pa sha rkyal yin// spyang smad sdig pa ro sbrel yin// de la lta ba rngon pa yin// ltos shig ltos shig tshur la ltos// bdag gi snying ga'i nang du ltos// zhes gsungs nas/ thugs kyi grub rtags su bstan tsa/ ras chung pas/ bla ma lags/ grub rtags gcig dang gnyis la khyad par med// rtswa khur ba la zor bas yang lji dang 'dra/ snang ba dum pa ma zhig ma bde zhus pas/ bu khyod log lta re che gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu gcig nyon dang ras chung pa// pha rje btsun bzhugs pa'i sku smad na// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'khor bskor// sems dpa' bcu dang sems ma bcu/ sgo ba bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi// dur khrod chas brgyad tshang bar bzhugs// zab mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo la// las kyi mkha' 'gros phyag bde byed// bu ltad mo lta na de la ltos/

gzig mo mdzad na de la mdzod// bu rkyang la ya mtshan che rgyu med/ de skad ces gsungs nas sprul pa mdzad kyang*/ kho dad par ma gyur nas bla ma 'di 'di tsam gyis mig 'phrul bslab 'dug bsam pas/ yang rje btsun gyis mda' ma ki na pha bong chen po zhig yod pa de mgar ba gang gis kyang gse ma thub pa yod pa de'i steng du 'phur nas byon te/ zan bzhin du bcad/ chu bzhin du phyar/ rdzas bzhin du rdzi mdzad cing mgur 'di gsungs so// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa// brag ling pa mthil gyi thang shed na/ rdo ling pa thang gi thang dkyil na// lcags kyi pha bong g.yag shad tsam/ mgar tho thogs brgya yi chog pa med// sbud thogs brgya yis zhu sa med// ngas 'dam ltar rdzi na 'di ltar rdzi// zan ltar gcod na 'di ltar gcod/ chu ltar phyar na 'di ltar phyar// khyod snang ba la zhen pa log shes na// mi 'dod bzhin 'dod dgu char ltar 'bebs// gang dgos kyi longs spyod gter kha phye// bu snang ba 'gyur cig ras chung pa// khyod ltad mo dang gzigs mo 'di la mdzod// rkyang la 'di yin rtswa tsam med/ rkyang dang ri dwags sdig can zas// spyang khu gcan gzan las ngan lus// de la lta ba sdig pa yin// ltos shig ltos shig bdag gi lus la ltos// zhes gsungs nas/ yon tan gyi grub rtags su bstan tsa/ ras chung pas/ khyed rang lus kyi bkod pa gcig mi dgos// brgya mdzad kyang dbang che// rkyang ma bu la bud nas thal bas mi lta ste/ sems 'di ye nas 'gyur mi thub par 'dug pas/ ci drag nas zer bas/ bla ma rje btsun gyi ras kyi na bza' la gshog pa mdzad nas/ nam mkha' la 'phur nas je mtho je mtho la song nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu cig gsan dang ras chung pa// mchong lung brag dmar khyung gi rdzong*// sngar yang mi ni 'phur ma myong*// da yang mi ni 'phur mi srid// bya rgod po 'phur yang gshog rtse 'dar// bya phran 'phur na ltag pa 'chag

/nga mi la 'phur na 'di ltar 'phur// nga bya ltar lding na 'di ltar lding*// khyung ltar 'phyo na 'di ltar 'phyo// khyod rten 'brel lus kyi rdzu 'phrul// dbang bskur dang 'khor 'das bsre shes na// bdag dang gzhan la gnyis su med// bu rang rgyud sbyongs shig ras chung pa// khyod ltad mo dang gzigs mo 'di la ltos// rkyang la ltas pas ci la phan// rkyang ni ri yi 'byung po yin// spyang khu las kyi shan pa yin// de la lta ba yi dwags yin// ltos shig nam mkha'i dbyings su ltos// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ nam mkha' la bltas pas// bla ma mi rig la khad du je mtho la song nas/ e shes pha bla ma mkha' spyod du 'gro ba red/ nga de ring ci red na dgongs te ha las nas rang dbang med pa'i dad pa skyes nas mchi ma mang po byung nas ngas bla ma gar song yang mi rnyed pa e ma yin bsam pa la/ yang bla ma rje btsun nam mkha' la byon nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa// sra mo'i shing dang gyong po'i rwa/ bkug na 'di nyid khug tshod 'dug ste// rang sems gyong po 'di la khug dus med/ rang sems gyong po khug cig ras chung pa// lho kha'i stag dang byang kha'i 'brong*// btul na 'di gnyis kyang thul tshod gda' ste// bdag 'dzin dregs pa 'di la thul dus med// bdag 'dzin dregs pa thul cig ras chung pa/ chos thos pa dang bsam pa bsgom pa gsum// bslab na 'di gsum yang lob tshod gda' ste// rang sems dngos po 'di la rtogs dus med// sems nyid stong pa sgoms shig ras chung pa// drin gyi pha ma byams pa'i gnyen// bskyur na 'di gnyis kyang bskyur tshod gda' ste/ gshis ngan rang bde 'di la sgyur dus med// kha gshis ngan pa bskyur cig ras chung pa// pha yul gyi mkhar dang re'u lug nor// spangs na 'di gnyis kyang spangs tshod gda' ste// skyid 'dod so gsod 'di la spangs dus med// yang yengs 'gyu dal spongs shig ras chung pa/

'khyor po'i gos dang mdzes pa'i grogs// spangs na 'di gnyis spang tshod gda' ste// mal bde dro 'jam 'di la spangs dus med// gting mug dro nyal spongs shig ras chung pa// pha ri'i ri dang tshu ri'i brag /gzad na 'di gnyis kyang zad tshod gda' ste/ sred pa'i zhe 'dod 'di la 'dzad dus med// sred pa nang nas zod cig ras chung pa/ rgyal po'i lung dang btsun mo'i tshig /zhus na 'di gnyis kyang gnang tshod gda' ste// 'chi bdag gshin rje 'di la zhu sa med// 'chi ba lam du slongs shig ras chung pa// khyod rang rgyud ngan pa'i snang ba zlog /spyod pa ngan pa'i rnam 'gyur zhog /zhe sdang rtsub mo'i bsam pa spongs// zhes gsungs nas mchong lung gi brag gseb bya min pa mi thon pa zhig tu byon nas gar yod kyang mi mthong bar 'dug pas/ ras chung pa'i dgongs pa la de ring bla mas grub rtags de tshan zhig bstan pa la/ nga snang ba log rung la bsdad pa de sdig pa'i las ngan pa zhig gis zin pas/ da ngas bla ma yang ma mthong bas brag 'di la shi ba zhig byed dgos dgongs nas brag la lcibs pa'i dod la de ring mi rung ba byas pas/ rje btsun gyi bka' yi chad pas shi bar gyur cig /bsam pa'i blo the tshom med par dad pa rang dbang med par skyes pas/ skad chen po'i 'o dod bos nas/ rje btsun nga ci byed na byas nas 'dzeg pa la/ phyad phyod song ba'i snang ba la/ mchong lung gi rtse la brag phug bde mo zhig rang 'grub du 'dug pa'i nang du rje btsun gang yin mi shes pa'i sku gsum sprul nas 'dug pas g.yas g.yon gnyis kyis ram 'degs tshul du mdzad/ dbus mas dpon gyi tshul du mdzad nas mgur 'di ras chung pa la gsungs so// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa/ rje btsun gcig la rje btsun gnyis// rje btsun gnyis la rje btsun gsum// rnam 'phrul gsum du bzhugs pa la// phyag mchod pa 'bul na gang du 'bul// bsnyun dri rmed byed na gang la byed// sdig bshags kyi bshags yul gang la byed// rgyud sdom pa'i len yul gang la byed// brda zab mo'i dbang bskur gang la zhu// don zab mo'i ngo sprod gang la zhu// skyabs zab mo'i gsol ba gang la 'debs// blo re ba'i zab mo gang la bca'// bu sprul bsgyur lus kyi bkod pa la// dad pa skyes na khong yus shod// blo log bdud kyi bar chod la// 'gyod pa skyes na drang por smros// spyod ngan gshin rje'i lag rtags la/

'jigs pa skyes na myur du spongs// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas mgur 'di yar phul bar gda'o// brag dkar rta so dbu ma'i rdzong*// dbu ma rdzong gi nang shed na// pha rje btsun gsum du bzhugs pa la// phyag mchod pa 'bul na dbus mar 'bul// dbang gdams ngag zhus na dbus mar zhu// g.yas pa chos sku skye ba med// g.yon pa ci yang sprul pa'i sku// dbus ma longs sku nyid la zhu// zhes zhus pas/ g.yas g.yon gyi sku gnyis po dbus ma la thim nas gcig tu gyur dang*/ brag phug dang bla ma mthong snang bzhin du song nas dpe cha bsregs pa'i thal ba'i rtsa na yab sras gnyis rang 'dug pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ngas de ring grub rtags de tsam zhig bstan pa la khyod snang log byas nas snang ba skad cig kyang 'gyur du ma gtub pa de shin tu ma bzang*/ lar chos 'di shin tu dka' bar 'dug /khyod gdams ngag tshul du btang tsa/ ngan sngags khyer nas byung*/ khyod la mthu ngan sngags mkhan zhig 'ong gis dogs/ mthu nga bas che ba med de/ ngas sdig pa ma byang bas dka' las chen po la gtad/ lar mthu byed pa'i mi rnams tshe 'di pa skyabs yin/ de bas nga yi glu 'di nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu chung nas bskyangs pa'i ras chung pa/ khyed gdams ngag len du btang ba la// dpe cha 'di yi mang lugs kyi// khyod gzhung bshad mkhan gcig byung gis dogs// khyod lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis// bu chung nas bskyangs pa'i ras chung pa// sgom chen stan rdol re ba la// bshad pa 'di yi mang lugs kyi/ ston chen lham rdol cig byung gis dogs// khyod lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis// bu chung nas bskyangs pa'i ras chung pa// khyod gcig shes kun grol cig re ba la// tha snyad 'di yi mang lugs kyi// kun shes gcig sdug cig byung gis dogs// khyod lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis// bu chung nas bskyangs pa'i ras chung pa// khyod dam chos 'tshol du btang ba// sgrub yig 'di yi mang lugs kyi// rgyud chags sdang mkhan gcig byung gis dogs// khyod lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis// bu chung nas bskyangs pa'i ras chung pa// khyod 'tshol du btang ba'i gdams ngag rnams/

'phur ni brag gi gseb la yod// da lta mkha' 'gro'i phyag tu bsnams// khyod gsol ba thob dang 'byon te mchis// mthu gtad la sogs ngan sngags rnams// zhugs na 'bar ba'i me la bsregs// bcom ldan me lha'i zhal du phul// bu zhe sdang ma che rang rgyud sreg /sdug bsngal ma byed lus sems klod// sems rang lugs su gnyen pas lhan ne brtan ces gsungs pas/ ras chung pas e bden bsam nas gsol ba btab pas/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnams tshang bar pang du ling nge byung ba dang*/ ras chung pas bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes nas rang dbang med pa'i mos gus skyes te ngas de snga bla ma'i zhabs tog lo bcu drug byas/ da yang lo bcu drug gis zhabs tog byed zer ba'i dam bca' yang phul zhing*/ de phyis nas mos gus 'du 'bral med pa skyes so// de nas bla ma rje btsun dang dpon slob gnyis ri khrod 'grim zhing nyams myong skyong ba la/ gtum mo'i yon tan ni skyes/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa ma shar ba la bla ma'i thugs dgongs la/ ras chung pa 'di la tha snyad kyi bla ma 'ga' re yod kyang*/ ngo sprod kyi bla ma med/ nga gcig char pa'i ngo sprod kyi bla ma yin kyang mos gus ma skyes pas len/ de ring rang la kho yid ches par bya ba'i phyir sprul pa cig ston dgos dgongs te/ ras chung pa skyo sangs la 'gro 'dod pa cig byung ste song ba la/ stod ne'u thang chen po zhig gi dkyil na rkyang cig la phru gu gcig skyes nas lus po phru ma dang ma bral bar ma yi phyir 'brang zhing 'dug pa la/ spyang ki cig byung bas rkyang phrug la tsha rag rgyug /rkyang mas kyang spyang ki bdas de rang nyi ma la ltad mo ngo mtshar skyes te/ 'di ni slob dpon la len mo zlo dgos snyam nas drung du 'ong tsa na/ slob dpon sku gzi mdangs skyil krung bcas nas snang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bsdad nas len mo zlo rgyu rnams tshur la gsungs pa/

bu ras chung pa shes pa yul la ma yengs par sems la ltos/ dud 'gro la la skyes nas kyu ba de phal gyi chos nyid yin pas/ khyod nga yi glu dang lus kyi bkod pa 'di la ltos gsungs nas/ rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba yis// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bu cer re gson dang ras chung pa// rkyang la ngo mtshar che rgyu med// pha rje btsun spyi bo'i yang steng na// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gdugs shig 'khyil// rkyang ngo mtshar che na de che mod// pha rje btsun dpral ba'i sum mdo na// gser gyi mchod rten khru gang pa// 'od zer stong phrag phyogs bcur 'phro// rkyang ngo mtshar che na de che mod// pha rje btsun thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// yi dam lha yi dkyil 'khor bkra// rkyang ngo mtshar che na de che mod// pha rje btsun ras gos nang phyogs na// phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bkra// rkyang ngo mtshar che na de che mod// pha rje btsun lte ba'i dkyil 'khor na// gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi mkha' 'gro rnams// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing yod// rkyang ngo mtshar che na de che mod/ brag long pha bong gur dkar tsam// mgar tho thogs stong gis ma shigs pa// nga rje btsun zhabs tis 'di ltar gse// rkyang ngo mtshar che na de che mod// brag dmar spo mthon nam mkha' rdzong*// bya rgod po phur yang glad yu 'khor// pha ras pas bgrod na 'di ltar 'gro// pha rje btsun sprul sku gsum du bkod// khyod lha phyag 'tshal na gang la 'tshal// bskor ba cig byed na gang la byed/ gdams ngag cig zhu na gang la zhu// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas kyang bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin rim par mthong snang re re mthong tsa na dad gus sing sing pa rgyud la skyes shing*/ phyi ta res sku yi bkod pa gang la yang phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gdams ngag zhu ba ngo ma shes te/

dus de skad cig ma la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skad cig de nyid la thugs la 'khrungs pa yin skad/ de ni thams cad rkyang mgur gyi skor ro/// /de nas ras chung pas rgya gar nas phebs shing sne len la/ tshogs 'khor zhig mdzad nas mnyes mnyes mdzad cing*/ gsung gleng mang du mdzad pa la/ 'bri sgom dang*/ se ben gnyis la chos gtam gyis gsungs pas/ ras chung ba rgya gar nas byon pa'i mkhas pa yin pas gtam ma nus/ rje btsun gyi ras chung pa khong gnyis spobs pa zhen zin/ khyed rang ras chung pa rgya gar nas gdams ngag 'ong nas bod du rtsod pa ji ltar zlog blta gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ tha snyad tshig gis brgol ba la zlog cig mi 'dug /tshig sgra bcad pas 'di yin med/ gzhan gyi rgol ba zlog na 'di ltar zlog /zhus nas mgur 'di phul lo// nga yi brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// rgyud ngan chad pa'i rtsod pa zlog /bla ma sangs rgyas ras pa yis// 'dod ldan bla ma'i rgol ba zlog /gdams ngag thabs lam snyan brgyud kyi/ blos byas bdud kyi rgol ba zlog /ro snyoms phyi'i me long gis// skyon can lkugs pa mtha' nas phud// bden tshig gsung gi rin chen gyis// rnam rtog ye shes me la bsreg /rtsa rlung dra mig 'khor lo yis// bying rgod had po med par byed// rang grol phyag rgya chen po yis// rgol ngan ngar 'dzin 'gong po 'dul// rig pa ye shes sgron me yis// snyoms las ma rig mun pa sel// spyod pa chu la ral gri yis/ chos brgyad mdud pa rang sar grol// ces zhus pas/ rje btsun mnyes te/ khyod kyi rtsod pa zlog lugs yag /ming yang rtsod pa zlog pa'i rin chen bya bar thogs gsungs so// lar khyod kyi gdams ngag gi gnad de ltar shes pa la/ lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad 'di rnams gal che gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// lta ba stong pa'i ye shes yin/

sgom pa 'od gsal 'dzin med yin// spyod pa chags med rgyun zhig yin// 'bras bu dri med gcer bu yin// lta ba stong pa'i ye shes de// kha lta rkyang par 'chor nyen gda'// don la nges shes ma skyes na// kha ltas bdag 'dzin grol ba med/ de la nges shes dag pa skyes// sgom pa 'dzin med 'od gsal de// gnas pa rkyang par 'chor nyen gda'// ye shes nang nas ma shar na// gnas pa 'thug kyang phan pa chung*// bying rgod la ye shes mi skye bas// des na ma spangs dran pa gces// spyod pa chags med rgyun zhig de// tho co rkyang par 'chor nyan gda'// lta sgom grogs su ma shar na/ brtul zhugs spyad kyang phan pa chung*// des na zhen pa bral ba gces/ 'bras bu dri med gcer bu de/ mtshan ma'i na bza' gsol nyen gda'// 'khrul pa nang nas ma zhig na// brtson 'grus byas kyang phan pa chung*// des na 'khrul pa zhig pa gces// lta ba sems kyi gcod pa yin/ sgom pa sems kyi brgyang shing yin// dam tshig sems kyi gnya' gnon yin// man ngag sems kyi lde'u mig yin// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa nges shes skyes nas de nub gzims pa'i rmi lam na/ mkha' 'gro ma mang po byung nas mgur mang po gsung zhing 'dug pa la/ rang dbang med par nyan cing bsdad pa la lan re rje btsun yin du yang go rje btsun gyi mgur 'di gsungs pas/ des rkyen byas te mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis 'di skad gsungs so// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa// 'khor 'das rkyen las rag las pas// bla ma dam pa brten nus na// 'bad med yon tan shugs las 'byung*// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa/ khyod yul la chags sems spong nus na// ri khrod dgon pa 'grim nus na/ rtsol med dngos grub shugs las 'byung*// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa// las ngan 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba can// nor la chags sems spangs nas kyang*// chags med zhen med byed nus na// bde chen lam sna shugs las 'byung*// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa/

'khor bar skye ba'i rtsa ba can// bu tsha'i 'khri ba gcod nus shing*// rang nyid gcig pur sdod zug na// zhing khams rnam dag shugs las 'byung*// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa// da lta dam chos dar lags kyang*// chos 'dra min mang po bsre bslad byas// bla ma slob dpon byed mi mang*// kha bzang 'dod gtam chags pa smra// brgyud pa bzang dgu 'doms shig pha yi bu// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa// snying nas dam chos mdzad dgongs na// chos nyon mongs gnyen por 'gro dgos pas/ kha bshad kyi ngos lkog ma che bar// zhe phug gis skyid 'dod phra la ba gces// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa// 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob 'dod na// tshe 'di yi bde skyid ma bsam par// rang sems rtsa ba ma shor bar// sgom pa rgyud la brtan na ang*// zhes gsungs pas gnyid sad pa dang*/ dga' ya le tshig rnams ma brjed par 'dug pas de phyin chos dang rgyud bsres pas dum pa 'dres thub pa byung skad do// de rnams mchong lung gi skor ro/// /de nas bcu pa drin len bsab pa'i yon tan ni/ spo ri spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong du bzhugs pa'i dus su snye nam na bon po zhig yod pa de yi rje btsun 'di 'dod pa la blo log pa zhig 'dug zer nas/ khong rang gi slob mas ma tshor bar bsnyen bkur dum pa re yang byas/ gdams ngag rnams kyang lkog tu zhus pa'i bon po de nad kyis zin pas shi bar nye ba na kho'i bla ma rnams kyis kha chems 'jog dgos zer bas/ bon po na re/ nga yi kha la nyan pa'i lab gtong mkhan yod na nga la lab rgyu yod zer bas/ ci yod na bsam pas thams cad kyi mna' byas pas/ de na nga yi bu mo yang bos zer bas bu mo bos pas/ a mas ci byed zer bas/ bu mo dpang por bzhag nas kha chems su bzhag ste/ da 'o skol bon po zer le 'di nor nas 'dug /'di gzhi 'chug ste ha re long*/ lam nor te mi dge ba la mi 'dzem/

'bras bu nor te 'jig rten pa'i chen po zhig las mi skye/ skyabs log ste mi ma yin la gsol ba 'debs/ sems bskyed nyes te lags rtags khur zhing bu smad gso ba zhig la ma byung bar 'dug /da nga yi nor skal de rje btsun dpon slob la phul la/ bdun tshig gcig zhu/ de ma byas na nga khyed tshos bsad pa dang 'dra zer bas/ khos zer ba bzhin byas pa na/ bdun tshig gi nub mo mtshan byang zhig byas pa la/ rje btsun gyis bon po'i rnam shes mngon du bkug nas sngar ci yod pa bzhin dbang po skye mched dang sang nge byas te/ rje btsun dpon slob kyis mtshan byang de la lam bstan sgrib sbyong gi tshul du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bka' brgyud kyi byin brlabs rgyab dpung bzang*// rigs brgyud mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub thob// chos brgyud ma nor bu slob rnams// las ngan rnam smin sbyong pa la// rang rgyud la sdom pa yod pa dgos// yon bdag gi bla mchod byed pa la// snying rje dang byams sems rgyas pa dgos// mang po'i tshogs dpon byed pa la// yon tan dang rtogs pa ldan pa dgos// grub thob kyi bla ma brten pa la// dag snang snying rus che ba dgos// gshin po'i za ma za ba la// mthong lam gyi yon tan skye ba dgos// tshe 'das kyi rnam shes 'dren pa la// mngon shes dang grub rtags thon pa dgos// dad log gi snang ba bsgyur ba la// rdzu 'phrul gyi sprul pa nus pa dgos// de ring bdun tshig kyi dkyil 'khor la// mngon shes lam sna zin pa dgos// bon po'i yon bdag bu slob rnams// sems la the tshom ma byed cig /ces gsungs pas/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ me tog gi char babs/ mtshan byang ni 'od kor kor du nam mkha' la kyi li li song bas/ de rnams bon po'i bu slob rnams kyis mthong ba la/ nam mkha' nas sgra zhig byung ste rje btsun nga la sku drin che/ khyed min na nga la thar pa'i skabs mi 'dug zer ba thams cad kyi tshor bas de ring de ka yin/

ngo mtshar rang che zer bas de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje ngo mtshar bla ma'i byin brlabs zhugs// ngo mtshar mar pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bka' drin mos gus kyi 'khor bar thugs rjes zungs// nga dang po rje dang mjal ba de// ngo mtshar yongs kyis che shos yin// gdams ngag snyan brgyud thob pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin// 'jig rten bya ba btang ba de// ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin// ri khrod dben par zug pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin// nang nas nyams rtogs skyes pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin// gcig pur sdug bsran byas pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin// chos brgyad 'dun ma med pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin// bla ma mnyes par 'grub pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin// bon pos kha chems 'jog pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyi che shos yin// bu slob kha la nyan pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyis che shos yin// mtshan byang 'ja' tshon gur phub de// ngo mtshar yongs kyis che shos yin// 'dir tshogs dad pa skyes pa de// ngo mtshar yongs kyis che shos yin// zhes gsungs pas/ sring mo pe ta ma der yod pas mchi ma khral le byung nas/ khyed kyis mi gzhan la 'di 'dra'i nus pa ston rgyu 'dug /rang re gnyis kyi pha ma'i shi lugs zer zhing ngus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ngu mi dgos ngas pha ma gnyis drangs tshar gsungs pas/ de ji ltar nga la bshad par zhu zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// pha ma'i drin len 'khor bar thugs rjes zungs// ngas a ma lus kyi sgrom bu la// pha mas drin gyi rgyal po la// sgyu ma'i lus shig 'dor dus na// rnam shes rang gi sems la bsre// sems nyid rgyal ba'i thugs la bstims// thugs rjes 'ja' 'od zhing khams shar// lus stong lha'i sku la bstims// lha rang byung grub pa ngo mtshar che// ngag grags stong brjod med sngags su 'dres// sngags rang sgra snang ba ngo mtshar che// sems 'khyams po ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug

/gsal stong rig pa rang ngo shes// sems rang sa zin pas 'khrul pa med// 'pho 'gyur med pas ngo mtshar che// mi bdag gi sgrub pa byed pa'i ring*// byams dang snying rje'i drag sngags des// nyin med mtshan med sdig sgrib sbyangs// rigs drug 'khor ba'i skye sgo gcod// gtsang zhing dag pa'i zhing khams su// bde zhing dag pa'i tshogs la bsgrigs// dga' zhing mnyes pa'i longs spyod 'phel// bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i 'khor gyis bskor// khyod sems chung mi dgos pe ta ma// zhes gsungs te mo yang mdangs sal te byung nas/ lags de ni mtshar zin/ khyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang mtshan byang dang*/ tsha tsha la sogs pa e mdzad zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs// pha ma'i drin len 'khor bar byin gyis rlobs// sems can thams cad drangs pa thugs rjes zungs// ngas bden gnyis dbyer med dkyil 'khor du// rang rig gsal ba'i lha tshogs bkod// rgyud lung man ngag bum pa la// pha rol phyin drug khrus chab blugs// ser sna dug lnga'i sgrib pa sbyangs// bka' brgyud bla ma'i bdud rtsi yis// lus ngag sems la dbang bcu bskur// rtogs pa lam gyi rim pa des// dbyer med bde ba chen por bstan// sku gsum dbyer med tsha tsha btab// zag pa med pa'i bdun tshigs bskyangs// rjes shes zab mo'i dus dran la// gnyen po bzang po'i mchod pa 'bul// phyag rgya chen po'i bsngo ba la// rang bzhin rnam dag smon lam 'debs// bdag dang pha ma sems can gyis// bsam pa thams cad gcig tu bsgrubs// bla ma'i bka' drin dran pa la// pha ma'i drin len 'khor ba yin// yang gsungs pa/ lus kyi shing der spre'u'i sems// 'dres med bshes med rgyal khams su// gcig pu gnyis med 'khyams gyur pas// sgyu ma lus kyi hom khung du// 'gro drug sa bon bud shing der// skye ba med pa'i byang bu btsugs// ro ni gsal stong dag du sbyangs// bdun tshigs snang stong gnyis su byas// tsha tsha skye ba med par btab// zas ni bde ba chen po gtad// lam ni gnyis su med par bstan// bsngo ba phyag rgya chen po'i byas// smon lam byang chub sems su btab// pha ma'i drin len 'khor te mchi// zhes gsungs pas mo shin tu dga' ste/

a la la tshad mi 'dug /da nga yang 'dren par zhu zer zhing rtsol med kyi phyag mang po 'tshal ba'i ngag tu brgyal nas song ste/ dran pa rnyed pa dang*/ sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i chos sna chen po zhig byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis khyod kyi chos byed na bsgom e nus gsungs pas/ sgom chen 'di tsam yod pas bsgom nus na/ ngas bsgom mi nus pa ci yin zer nas nges shes dang dad pa mos pa rang dbang med par skyes pas/ rje btsun gyis mo'i sems la e phan gyis mgur 'di gsungs so// rje lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud// gnyen la gdung sems zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// chos dang sems rgyud 'dres par thugs rjes zungs// gson dang sring mo pe ta ma// khyod gzhon dus snying rus ma byas na// rgas tsa byed bsam ci la phan// bla ma rje btsun ma bsten pa'i/ grogs bzang bla mas ci la phan// gdams ngag snyan brgyud mi bsgom pa'i// kha bshad skam po'i ci la phan// rang sems ngo ma shes pa yi// mang po bslab pas ci la phan// skye med rang sa ma zin pa'i/ kha ta sgam pos sdig pa bsags// nyams myong nang nas ma shar ba'i// tshul 'chos mkhan cig 'dod pa mang*/ rten 'brel ltad mo ma mthong ba'i// tho co mkhan cig rang rtsis che// byang sems snying rje ma skyes pa'i// ngo lkog mkhan cig gtsang gtsang mang*// sangs rgyas e 'thob mi shes pa'i// chos pa zer zhing nor la nag /sems can yongs la mi phan pa'i// pha mar byams shing 'khor ba'i rgyu// chos dang mthun par mi sgrubs na// nye ba yin yang sdang ba'i dgra// rogs la gnod par byed pa'i mi// mdzes mdzes 'dra yang bdud kyi rigs// 'phral sgom chen zer yang sgom sdug yin// ci phan ci bsam mi bsgrub pa'i// 'grogs bzang po byas kyang zhe 'gyod mang*// nga ma phyid sdug bsngal gyis yi mug des// khyod sring mo'i sdig sgrib dag dag 'dra// zhes gsungs pas sems la phan te snang skyid ting nge song nas/

rje btsun gyis gdams ngag gnang nas bsgom du bcug pas rang byung gi sgom bzang po skyes te/ bla ma mnyes nas 'dis nga sdug pa'i sems gsal te rang gis mo'i sdig pa zad zin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// da rung nyon dang pe ta ma// chos la snang ba ma log tsa// sdug bsngal zad rgyu 'ong ba yin// mi la ngan pa ma brjod tsa// rang la lha bzhin mthong ba yin// gzhan la bsam pa mi ngan na// rang gi bsod nams 'phel ba yin// tshe 'di la zhen pa ma che na/ phyi ma bde zhing skyid pa yin// rang mthong nga rgyal ma bskyed dang*// gzugs bzang yid 'ong 'thob pa yin// sems nyid rang gshis skyong ba na// sangs rgyas myur du 'thob pa yin// mtshams dang smra bcad dam pa na/ mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs 'khor ba yin// lus la skyid 'dod med pa na// rnam smin sgrib pa byang ba yin// sgom yun shi dang snyoms nus na// yang rgyal dgung dang mnyam pa yin// sems la nongs 'khris mi gda' na/ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i bsu ba yin// byed spyod chos dang bstun shes na// chos skyong dpa' bo'i bsrung ba yin// bla ma rje la gsol btab na// byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung ba yin/ khyod shes par gyis la nyams su longs// dus kun tu bde skyid dpal la spyod// ces gsungs te las rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang du gsungs pas/ pe ta ma nges shes skyes nas chos ma nus pa gang gis kyang skyid 'thob pa ma red zer ba'i rtogs ldan ma bzang mo zhig byung ngo*// de thams cad pha ma'i drin len bsab pa'i skor ro// ༈ de nas bcu gcig pa spyod pa che ba'i yon tan ni/ nyin re yang sprul pa'i gzugs mang du mdzad de/ spyil po'i nang du bsgom zhing bzhugs pa dang*/ thag ring po'i sgom chen rnams la chos gsungs pa dang*/ lha yi yul du lhas gdan drangs nas chos gsungs pa dang*/ lha 'dre dang mi ma yin la chos gsungs pa/ sman dang yul lha rnams la mgur byed pa dang*/

brin du nags la me shor ba gsod pa dang*/ snye nam du zam pa chu la shor ba 'don pa dang*/ dud 'gro'i gnas su chos gsung pa la byon pas go nus pa re re tsam min pa ma byung*/ yi dwags kyi yul du chos gsungs pa la byon pas chos mi go bar ser snas gdung zhing bshud pa byed cing byung ba la chos sbyin mdzad/ dmyal ba'i gnas su byon pa la chos kyi snang ba yid la med pa thugs la 'dug pas thugs chad/ a pa sdig pa'i nus pas de 'dra ba cig 'grub zin dgongs nas spyan chab mang po shor/ chos gral gcig tu ras pa rnams dang yon bdag rnams kha ma 'cham ste/ de la drin che nged la drin che zer ba mang po byung ste/ ras chung pas zhus pa/ nyin gcig tshes grangs dus tshod thams cad gcig pa la sprul pa 'di tshan mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ khyed rnams sems chung ba yin/ nga ma song ba dang ma byas pa med gsungs shing res bshum/ res bzhad/ res the tshom mi mdzad/ res spyan hrig hrig mdzad cing bzhugs tsa/ lha yi bu dang bu mo mang pos bka' drin che zer ba'i me tog gtor ba mthong*/ yul lha mang pos gzugs med pa'i sgra skad kyis bka' drin che zer ba dang*/ khar sang gi mgur de 'dra gsungs dang zer ba'i sgra skad yang thos pas/ ras pa rnams kyis rgyu rkyen ci lags zhes yang dang yang du zhus pa'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bla ma'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus sgyu lus grub pa sprul pa'i sku// bla ma'i byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag glu dbyangs len pas gdams ngag ston// bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la zhugs// sems rtogs pa thob pas sangs rgyas grub// nga mes mi 'tshig cing chus mi 'khyer// spyod pa glang chen 'gros gyi gar// dag pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la// tha dad kyi snang ba so so yis/ nga yi sku mthong gsung thos shing*// bsod nams bsags pas sku mthong grol// ma dag 'gro ba las ngan gyis// nga yi lus kyang ma mthong zhing*// sdig pas sdug bsngal spyod pa la// sangs rgyas mthu yis ma phan pa// de yi yi mug ngu bro skye/

khyed rnams chos la 'bungs shig ang*// ngas ni bshad tshul thub pa med// a tsa ma sdig can snying re rje// log spyod mkhan rnams thar mtha' mi gda' na// sdug bsngal mthong bas snying rlung langs/ nged rang tsho sgom yun sring cig ang*// tshe 'di ci byed mi bsam par// phyi ma ci 'ong bsam pa gyis// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa dang*/ ras pa rnams kyis de'i rgyu rkyen ci lags zhus pas/ sprul pa'i rnam pas 'gro ba thams cad gzigs las che bas/ sdug bsngal gang che/ bde sdug gnyis las ji lta bu'i bsgyur bar gda' lags/ rigs drug gi sems can la tshad zin par e 'dug zhus pas/ bla mas rigs drug gi tshad zin gsung 'byon du ma nyan pas/ ras chung pas mi gsung bar 'dug bsam pas/ nged rnams skal ba bzang ba'i bla ma dang 'brel pas thugs rjes gzigs// zhes zhus pas/ 'o na maṇḍal phul cig gsungs pas maṇḍal mang du phul/ phyag rtsol med mang du 'tshal bas/ da sdod la nga yi mgur la nyon gsungs nas dang por lha yi rgyu 'bras mgur du gsungs pa ni/ bka' drin bla ma rje la gsol ba 'debs// byin rlabs can yongs la khyab par shog /'jig rten lha yi bde ba yang*// g.yer ni lha zhes che zhing 'dug /skad ni g.yu 'brug bzhin du cher grags kyang*// de la snying po mi 'dug ste// bzang ngan yid la mi dran cing*// 'du shes rmugs pas tshor ba med// deng sang dbang po brgyal ba bzhin// bskal mang yang bgrang brtsis kyang*// skad cig tsam zhig ma gtogs pa// de la snying po ye ma mchis// lhung dus bsam ngan skyes nas lhung*// de yi rgyu rkyen gnas lugs ni// stong lta kha lta sgam po byung*// gzugs khams gnas ris bcu drug kyang*// gtsang ma ris lnga rang so ste// 'og ma bcu gnyis lhung ba yang*// rgyu 'bras bsod nams ma zad bar// de yi bde ba spyod byed cing*// nyon mongs tshor ba myong ba bzhin// lo grangs bskal grangs mang brtsis kyang*// bde ba 'khrig zhen yun mi tshor// yid med bsam ngan skyes shing lhung*// lhung ba'i rtags dang rang sgra yis// lhung khar sems la sdug bsngal che// chos la bden pa med bsam pas// thar med gnas su sdug bsngal spyod// de 'dra mthong tsa snying rlung lang*// rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha rnams kyang*// sum cu rtsa gsum dang po ste// 'og ma thams cad gong bzhin ltung*// de yi rgyu rkyen rnam smin yang*// phyogs cha can gyi dge ba dang*// zhen 'dzin can gyi sgom chen dang*// chos brgyad bsgrigs pa'i chos spyod rnams// khas yag yag smras kyang sems ma dag

/sa bon bzhi yi bag chags lus pa des// yun du song tsa bsam ngan skye// bsam ngan skyes pas bsod nams 'dzad// bsod nams zad pas myur du lhung*// ltung byed lha yi sdug bsngal yang*// zhib tu bshad na snang ba 'khrugs// de go bar mdzod la sgom yun sring*// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa yang snang ba skyo phyed de song nas/ bla ma lags lha ma yin gyi sdug bsngal ji lta bu 'dug zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// byang sems rgyud la skye bar byin gyi rlobs// lha min sdug bsngal mi che rgyu// sdig sems 'khrugs pas rang gzhan brlag /sems nyid 'khrugs pas rang mgo 'khor// tshor ba ngan pas 'du shes rag /gang snang dgra ru len pa la/ bde ba skad cig yod thabs med// las ngan rang srog mi 'phangs par/ gzhan la phan sems skye ba dka'// rtsod pa las kyi 'khrugs pa la// da rung kha la mi nyan 'dra// de yi rgyu rkyen bshad na yang*// rang bde gzhan sdug 'dod pa dang*/ gnyen la byams shing dgra la sdang*// yin pa min te bya thabs med// khyod 'dir tshogs sgom yun shi dang snyoms// zhes gsungs pas/ yang zhus pa/ bla ma lags/ las rgyu 'bras phra'u re la de ltar song na nged rang mi tshe yang thar bar dka'/ tshig re yi gong 'og dang legs nyes dum pa re mi 'ong mi srid 'dus pas/ ji ltar byed zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi yi gzugs// lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud// 'o skol 'gro ba mi yi lus// dge sdig gang spyad nus pa che// de khams drug tshang ba'i ngang nus yin// khyed mkhas par shes zer ras chung pa// 'gag dang gnad mig mi shes pa// mang po shes zer 'chal pa yin// sems kyi rtsa ba ma rtogs na// lo mang bsgoms zer rdzun ma yin// zhing dang bsam pa ma 'brel na// rgyu mang po btang yang chud zos yin// phyogs med kun la ma phan na// 'grogs gang bzang mchod pa kha len yin// gang la gang 'gros mi shes pas// glan pas drang gtam smra ba ltung gzhi yin// gang la gang phan shes pa na// mkhas pas rdzun du smra ba dge ba yin// nga la rgyu med zer ba na// rmongs pa rmongs gtam yang la gnod// dge ba sems la shar ba na// sa rdo rtsi shing dge ba'i rgyu// lang bsam shes pa la mi bas lod pa med// za 'dod pa khyi bas ltogs pa med// khrel med pa la dpon bas 'jigs pa med// phyug po thams cad yod sdug yin// dbul po tshol bas dbul sdug yin// yod med gnyis ka sdug bsngal yin// bu chos shig nus na skyid dang mjal 'ong*// de go bar mdzod la yun du bsgom// zhes gsungs pas/

yang ras chung pas/ mi yi rgyu mtshan yang gsung re re'i go zhing 'dug /mar ngan song gi gnas 'di rnams rgyu rkyen ci lags zhus pas/ yang mgur 'di gsungs so// skyabs bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ngan 'gro yi 'jigs pa sel bar byin gyis rlobs// sha khrag zas su za byed cing*// gsod gcod las su song ba rnams// tsha dmyal brgyad du bsregs par 'dug /de yang dge ba ma brjed na// thar pa'i dus ni bstan par 'dug /zas su ma zas za byed cing*// rang sems lhag mar 'dzin sems pa/ bcom zhing phrog phrog brgyab pa rnams// grang dmyal brgyad du skye bar 'dug /chos la log lta ma skyes na// thar pa'i gnas skabs bshad pa yin// bka' la log pa 'gal byed cing*// skur pa ngan pa 'debs pa dang*// zhal lce log khrims gcod pa na// ro myags 'dam dang me 'ob dang*// ral gri lo mas gcod par 'dug /khas blangs tshul khrims nyams pa rnams// dam tshig chad pa phog pas na// shal ma ri dang me 'obs nang*// nags ri can dang chu tshan dong*// bsregs shing sdug bsngal spyad par 'dug /dkon mchog yid la dran srid na// nam dran dus na thar dus bstan// las ngan yang yang spyad spyad pas// sdig sems log pa'i las dbang gis// rang nyid bde ba 'dod pa'i phyir// pha ma slob dpon gsod byed cing*// dkon mchog dkor nor 'phrog pa dang*// skur pa log pa'i tshig lce smra// chos la bden pa med zer bas// mnar med dmyal bar sreg par byed// 'di la thar pa med par gsungs// bu bsam zhing snying rlung ldang bar yod// blo chos la gtad la 'bungs la sgoms// zhes gsungs pas ras chung pa dang der bzhugs pa rnams ba spu tsha zing nge song ste bla ma lags/ de 'dra gsungs pas 'di tsam 'jigs shing 'dug pa na/ der skyes pa'i sems can rnams ci tsam lags zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phya 'tshal lo// ngan 'gro 'jigs pa sel bar thugs rjes zungs// dmyal bar rang srog gcod spro bas// 'jigs shing bros pas thar thabs med// yi dwags snang ba dgrar langs pas// gang la 'bros shing gang la skyabs// dud 'gro gcig la gcig za bas// su yi le len su la 'ded// khyad par yi dwags sdug bsngal de// bsam ngan ser sna can gyi len// yod dus dge ba mi shes shing*// 'jungs pas rang gis za mi phod// mi la ster ba mi srid cing*// yang yang lta zhing gsog pa yi// byi ba bzhin du chog zhes med// rang gi sdug gsog gzhan gyis spyod// 'chi dus ser sna'i snang ba bzhin// bar do yi dwags snang ba skye/

snang log las kyi bkres skom spyod/ gal te bde spyod mthong srid na// de la ser sna sdug sems skye// de yi las kyi yang yang ltung*// de snying rus byas pa'i sgom chen gyis// yi dwags glu ru blangs pa yin/ 'dir bzhugs ras pa bu slob rnams// gtam go bar byung na sgom yun sring*// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas zhus pa/ mgur ma de rnams phan pa rang gcig byung*/ da rung dud 'gro 'di rnams rgyu mtshan gang gis 'khrul pa lags// zhes zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa sel bar thugs rjes zungs// dud 'gro mi shes gti mug pas// blun po bong ci dud 'gro las// ma rig las ngan nus pa yi// chos la bden par ma rtogs shing*// dge sdig bzang ngan ma phyed par// phyam phyam las la mi tshe zad// brtags dang rtog dpyod mi shes shing*// ha re long bzhin blun spyod mang*// dge ba sdig pa mi shes pas// smyon pa bzhin du phung nyes spyod// dbugs dbyung dbang po ma skyes pas// de la bzang po yin zhes 'khrul// lar mi shes sdig pa gcod gcod rnams// gcan gzan dud 'gror skye bar mchi// bzang ngan med pa'i blun po rnams// tshogs phal pa'i dud 'gror skye bar mchi// bsam pa rmongs pa'i skye bo rnams// phra'u dud 'gror skye ste mchi// lar dud 'gro'i rnam smin las rnams la// bshad pas long thabs mi gda' bas// mgo bo khug la rang sems rtsal sbyangs gyis// zhes gsungs pas der tshogs pa'i bu slob rnams na re/ bla mas chos ci gsungs la/ mgur dang glu rang mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga ri khrod na lha 'dre dang 'grogs yun ring*/ glu la khong cag lha 'dre yang dga'/ nga rang yang glu len snying 'dod// ces gsungs pas/ glu rang len snying 'dod pa de ci lags/ gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ yang mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i bka' drin yang yang dran// dag snang glu yi drin lan mjal/

spang ser po ri yi logs shig na// sha rgyas pa'i ri dwags glu dbyangs len// dbyar me tog ser po'i ze'u 'bru la// rtsi rgyas pa'i bung bas glu dbyangs len// dgung sngon po 'byung ba 'thag pa la// drod shar bas g.yu 'brug glu dbyangs len// ri g.ya' spang dag pa'i g.yu lo la// khams rgyas pas na chung glu dbyangs len// grong khyer phyug pa'i sgo 'gram na// za 'dod pa 'khyams pas glu dbyangs len// mi shi ba ro yi sngas kha na/ nor 'dod pa ban bon glu dbyangs len// ri na bun can gyi ri khrod na// nyams shar bas rnal 'byor glu dbyangs len// glu khong nas skyo bas dbyangs su blangs// nyams rig pa dngas pas sems nyid bde// chos snying nas gnag pas ci bsam 'grub/ blo gang byung ldan pas skyid par byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ der bzhugs pa'i ras pa rnams la nges shes dang*/ skyo shas dang*/ zhen log dang*/ snying rus dang*/ sdug bsran dang*/ dad pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ brtson 'grus la sogs pa brtson pa dang ngo mtshar ba'i rtogs pa rnams rgyud la skyes so// de gsungs pa de thams cad sgyu 'phrul rig pa'i skor ro/// /de nas yang nyin gcig bla ma'i gzim khang na 'od zhig kyi li li 'dug /yang nyin gcig mar me zhig 'bar zhing 'dug /yang nyin gcig yon chab zhig ltem mer 'dug yang nyin gcig tsha tsha zhig cog ger 'dug /yang nyin gcig spos rengs shig ldem me 'dug /yang nyin gcig rlung zhig kyi li li 'dug /de la sogs pa sprul pa rnam mthong bas/ ras chung pas zhus pa/ bla ma lags 'di lta bu rnams ci lags zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// lus sprul bsgyur mang bar thugs rjes zungs// bu nyon cig ras chung bzhin legs po// nga 'byung ba sa la dbang thob tsa// sa yang nga yi rang bzhin yin// 'byung ba chu la dbang thob tsa// chu yang nga yi rang bzhin yin// 'byung ba me la dbang thob tsa// me yang nga yi rang bzhin yin// 'byung ba rlung la dbang thob tsa// rlung yang nga yi rang bzhin yin// nam mkha' stong nyid 'byongs tsam na// snang srid nga dang dbyer med 'dres// lus sems snang ba dbang thob tsa// ci la sprul yang 'grub par 'dug

/rdzu 'phrul lus kyi bkod pa la// khyod mos pa skyes na gsol ba thob// rje grub thob rnams kyi byin rlabs 'jug /ces gsungs te de'i dus su zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin rnams brtan par 'dug go /de'i dus su lcam me bya ba'i yon bdag mo gcig gis tshogs 'khor drangs nas bla ma lags/ khyed kyi slob ma la grub pa thob pa e yod zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas mi rnams kyi nga la 'khos med bsam ste mkha' 'gro/ lung bstan 'di skad ces gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// 'gro don lhun gyis grub par byin gyis rlobs// mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan sprul pa'i sku// dwags po nyi ma 'gro la 'char// ras chung zla ba sprul pa'i sku// sgom stag jo dar zhi ba 'od/ 'bri sgom la sogs nyi shu lnga// 'gos byas de rnams mkha' 'gros gsungs// grub thob lnga dang rtogs ldan brgyad// rab byung nyams shar brgya rtsa brgyad/ chos mthun slob ma stong rtsa 'ong*// chos 'brel thob pa khri 'bum ste// lag len skyong ba re rer 'du// khyod dri rtog byed pa bag chags bzang*// zhes gsungs pas a la la mang po 'ong bar 'dug zer zhing phyag mang po 'tshal ba la snang ba 'gyur te chos dang mthun pa'i slob ma cig tu gyur te chos tshogs gral de nas phyogs ris kyi ri khrod du 'gro zer ba'i bu slob 'ga' byung ba la mgur 'di gsungs so// lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mos gus 'bral ba med pa byin gyis rlobs/ khyod ri khrod 'dzin pa'i sgom chen rnams// nyin mtshan med par nyal ba la// gdings dang ldan pa'i gdams ngag dgos// gdams ngag med pa'i ri khrod de// rnal 'byor grong pa'i gseb tu 'chor// shes rab med pa'i sgom chen de// blun po rdzun gyi mgo skor bas// rnal 'byor ba glang gseb tu 'chor// lta ba med pa'i sgom chen de/

kha lta skam po'i chos bshad pas// rnal 'byor shan pa'i lag tu 'chor// sgom pa med pa'i pho tshod kyis// rdzun rdzun smra rgyu mang ba de// rnal 'byor rdzun ma'i gseb tu 'chor// rang grol nang nas ma skyes pa'i// tho co brtul zhugs spyod pa de// rnal 'byor smyon pa'i gseb tu 'chor// lha grogs la dam tshig srung ba la// ngo lkog med pa'i tshig spyod dgos// de yi gdams ngag med pa na// rnal 'byor 'byung po'i gseb tu 'chor// gtsang btsog med pa'i spyod pa dgos// nyam nga med pa'i gdings shing dgos// de yi gdams ngag med pa na// rnal 'byor khyi phag gseb tu 'chor// ro snyoms ldom bu byed pa la// 'gro nyal khyad med sgom zhig dgos// de yi gdams ngag med pa na// rnal 'byor sprang po'i gseb tu 'chor// bla ma dam pa bsten pa la// ci gsungs sgrub pa'i dam bca' dgos// de yi gdams ngag med pa na// ji ltar 'bungs yang zol zog yin// zhes gsungs so// yang lcam lhan skyes pa'i sgron mes zhus pa la/ yang gsungs pa/ blta ru med de mthong ba'i mchog /de ni sems kyi 'od gsal lags// btsal du med te rnyed pa'i mchog /de ni rin chen sems gter lags// za rgyu med de 'grangs pa'i mchog /de ni mi rtog rnam grol zas// btung du med de ngoms ba'i mchog /byang chub sems la btung du med// rang rig sems kyi ye shes la// ngag tu brjod pa'i lam ma mchis/ nyan thos byis pa'i yul min te// rtog ge pa yi de mi shes// bskur thob med pa'i don rtogs nas// dbang gi mchog ni de la bya// mtho dman med pa'i don rtogs nas// sa yi mchog ni de la bya// bgrod du med pa'i don rtogs na// lam gyi mchog ni de la bya// skye shi med pa'i don rtogs na// sgyu ma'i mchog ni de la bya// 'du 'bral med pa'i don rtogs na// tshig gi mchog ni de la bya// gzhal du med pa'i don rtogs na// tshad ma'i mchog ni de la bya// che chung med pa'i don rtogs na/

thabs kyi mchog ni de la bya// bzang ngan med pa'i don rtogs na/ theg pa'i mchog ni de la bya// gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs na// lta ba'i mchog kyang de la bya// rtsol sgrub med pa'i don rtogs na// sgom pa'i mchog kyang de la bya// de nyid don las ma g.yos na// 'bras bu'i mchog kyang de la bya// de lta'i don dang mi ldan par// lta bar snyems pa'i ston pa dang*// tshig khog mkhas pa'i grwa pa dang*// spang len byed pa'i sgom chen kun// grol du re ste 'ching bar mchi// gnyis 'dzin gyi thag pas 'ching bar mchi// thar du re ste 'ching bar mchi/ gzung 'dzin lcags kyus bzung ste mchi// thon du re ste bying du mchi// khams gsum 'khor bar bying ste mchi// zhes gsungs so// yang gsungs pa/ gnyis su med pa lta ba'i don// yeng ba med pa sgom pa'i don// zung du 'jug pa spyod pa'i don// de gnyis dbyer med 'bras bu'i don// dam pa'i brgyud pas zin pa dang*// 'khrul pa dbyings su dag pa dang*// bya ba gnas su thegs pa dang*// 'di gsum ldan na rnal 'byor yin// phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la// mtshan ma'i sems 'dzin dgos rgyu med// spros bral nang nas shar ba la// sgra dang tshad ma dgos rgyu med// 'di gsum ldan pa rnal 'byor yin// zhes gsungs so// yang gsungs pa/ bu dang chung ma ngo srung gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gyi 'ching ba yin// rdzas dang longs spyod khe grags gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gyi chad pa yin// gnyen dang yon bdag slob ma gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gyi bshol 'debs yin// chang dang ngal dub gnyid dang gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor gyi chom po yin// gtam dang gad mo ltad mo gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gyi g.yeng ba yin// bla ma gdams ngag dad pa gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gyi gzhi ma yin// dben gnas grogs mchog 'tsho ba gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor gyi lam rtags yin// ma yengs mi rtog bde ba gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor gyi gtan grogs yin// lhug pa shugs 'byung rang lugs gsum/

'di gsum rnal 'byor gyi 'khyer lugs yin// chags med sdang med rmongs med gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor gyi lam rtags yin// zhes gsungs so// yang gsung pa/ rnal 'byor rab gcig yod pa de// dgon pa gangs dkar rtse la brtsegs// 'tsho ba snang srid lha 'dres 'dren// skyo rogs dkon mchog gsum gyis byed// gtor ma seng lcam dkar mos za// nam tshod bya rgyal rgod pos 'dzin// de 'dra'i rnal 'byor skyid skyid 'dra/ de 'dra'i rnal 'byor brod kyang brod// rnal 'byor 'bring cig yod pa de// dgon pa ri bo'i mgul du brtsegs/ 'tsho ba yon bdag pho mo'i sbyor// skyo rog ma dang mkha' 'gro'i byed// gtor ma wa dang spyang kis zas// nam tshod lha bya gong mo 'dzin// de 'dra'i rnal 'byor de brod kyang brod// rnal 'byor tha ma cig yod pa de// dgon pa grong khyer gyi dbus su brtsegs// 'tsho ba zol zog gnyis la byed// skyo rogs de a zhe go mas byed// gtor ma de khyi dang rmang rtses za// nam tshod de bu chung ngu bas bzung*// de 'dra'i rnal 'byor yi re mug /yi re mug la snying re rje// zhes gsungs so// yang gsungs pa/ nyin mtshan med par nyal ba la// gdings bzhi ldan pa'i gdams ngag 'tshal// de yi gdams ngag med pa na// rnal 'byor khyi phag gseb tu 'chor// 'gro nyal 'dug sgom gdams ngag 'tshal// de yi gdams ngag med pa na// rnal 'byor sprang po'i gseb tu 'chor// cha la bla ma'i gdams ngag 'tshal// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad lcam me'i skor ro/// /de nas bcu gnyis pa lha yi lhar gyur pa'i yon tan ni/ rje btsun 'om chung dpal gyi nags su bzhugs pa'i dus su/ dbyar kha zhig la char pa ma bab pas chu dkon mo byung nas chu bcad de yon bdag rnams 'khrug pa byung bas gang gis bsdum yang 'dun ma ma dum pa la gtso bo cig na re/ 'o skol tshos 'khrug pa de sus bsdum yang mi dum pa/

lha 'dre 'khrug pa yin las che/ da 'dun ma 'di rje btsun la zhus na 'ong zer nas gtso bo bdun rje btsun gyi spyan sngar song nas zhus pas/ bla mas ngas 'jig rten gyi 'dun ma mi shes/ kha mkhas lce bde'i ya bo mi 'ong khyod rang tsho der sdod dang*/ ngas bla ma la gsol ba zhig 'debs gsungs nas/ chos 'gal nyes pa rgyu bdun la gnyan po rim pa bdun gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// yon tan phun tshogs dpal gyi ri// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// sgra sgyur lo tsā chen po yi// zhabs la sgo gsum gus pas bstod// spyi pa bar pa gros 'debs gsum// phyogs ris zug rngu skye ba'i rgyu// phyogs ris rang sa zin 'dod na// gnyer med lkugs pa mkhyen lags sam// pha yul dang nor rdzas gnyen 'brel gsum// khams gsum 'khor ba 'khyams pa'i rgyu// sdug bsngal chu bo sgrol 'dod na// 'khri ba btsan gcod mkhyen lags sam// rang 'dod dang g.yo sgyu zol zog gsum// ngan song gsum du ltung ba'i rgyu// mtho ris thar lam thob 'dod na// rang sems drang por mkhyen lags sam// bshad pa 'chad nyan sgrogs gleng gsum// nga rgyal phrag dog skye ba'i rgyu// dam chos nyams su len 'dod na// dman sa 'dzin pa mkhyen lags sam// thab ka dang las ka ngo srung gsum/ rnal 'byor bsam gtan bshig pa'i rgyu// gnyug ma'i ye shes skyong 'dod na// khrel med 'dod chung mkhyen lags sam// dpon dang g.yog dang slob ras gsum// g.yeng ba sems bsral skye ba'i rgyu// gcig pur nyams su len 'dod na// mthu dang nus pa tho co gsum// rnal 'byor rang srog skyel ba'i rgyu// dam chos mtha' ru 'don 'dod na// 'jol mo'i rnam thar mkhyen lags sam// chos 'gal nyes pa rgyu bdun la// gnyen po rim pa bdun gyi dbyangs// nyams la shar nas blangs pa yin// dge bas byang chub thob par shog /ces gsungs pas/

de nub gsol ba chen po btab pas/ char zhag bdun babs nas 'khrug pa thams cad rang zhi la song*/ der gtso bo rnams dga' nas rje btsun la rta yi srab mda' gos yug la byas nas drin lan du phul ba ma bzhes te/ bal po'i ka te'i phug tu bros nas byon te bzhugs tsa/ khu khom dang ye rang gi rgyal sa chos rgyal cig bzhugs pa'i mnal lam du/ 'phags ma sgrol mas lung bstan te 'di skad gsungs/ ka te'i phug gi nags khrod du// zhi ba'i lam ston zhi ba'i dpal/ bzang po'i lam ston bzhad pa bzhugs// 'gro ba skyob pa gcig pu gzhol// de la ras 'di 'bul bar rig /rnam par rgyal ba gcig pu nyid// bzhad pa yin gyi dpang po nga*// mi bslu bas na sman pa'i mchog /ces gsungs nas/ khyod kyi mdzod na yod pa'i ka shi ka'i ras yug de dang*/ a ru rnam rgyal de gnyis bal po ka te'i phug la mi la ras pa bzhugs yod pa la phul zer ba rmis pas/ rgyal pos e bzhugs lta ru btang bas bzhugs 'dug pa dang phul bas ras de sku la gsol/ a ru ras spyan phye zhing yod tsa/ ras chung pa sleb byung bas/ bla ma lags/ sngar med pa'i na bza' dang*/ sman mchog 'di ci lags zhus pas/ lha yi lhar gyur pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin rlabs dngos grub shar/ 'om chung dpal gyi nags 'dab tu// nga bod kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i dus// dus snyigs ma'i sems can 'khrug pa shor// ngas byams dang snying rjes gsol btab pas// 'khrugs pa rtsod med rang sar zhi// khong drin len skyel ba'i mi bdun byung*// ngas zang zing bsod nams mi 'dod pas// bal po ka te'i phug tu 'ong*// mi yi bdag po rigs kyi rje// ye rang khu khom rgyal sa na// bcom ldan 'phags mas nyer bzung ba'i// rgyal po chos kyi spyan can gyis// nga bod kyi mi la ras pa la// shing bal dkar 'jam ras go phul// gtum mo lhun grub grogs su bskur// rnam rgyal mchog gi a ru ra// 'byung ba nad kyi gnyen por bskur// lha yi lhar gyur yul phyogs 'dir// kun tu lo bdun nad dang bral// zhes gsung pa dang*/

ras chung pas/ a la la te tshogs su che zer/ yang snye nam du 'byon par zhu zhes zhus pas/ de'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// bu gcig gson dang ras chung pa// mi med lung pa'i ri khrod 'di// pha bla ma bzhugs pa'i gdan sa yin// tung tung tung gi 'dod zhus 'di// sgom chen sdug thug rtags mtshan yin// grwa pa bu slob e mang de// dge sbyor spur ba'i dkrugs shing yin// mi ngan za 'dod kyi slob ma de// kha mchu 'phog pa bsnyad tshol yin// za 'dod dbang gi cho ga de// ma mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i tshag rdo yin// kha len mang po'i za ma de// sdug bsngal 'khrugs pa'i zhi ma yin// gzhan zas gshin po'i za ma de// dge sbyor bsgrub pa'i btsan dug yin// bu rang zas phye thang tsha mo 'di// dge sbyor gso ba'i sman mchog yin// chos la sdug bsgrur byed pa 'di// skyid dang 'phrad pa'i bskul ma yin// yeng med rgyun du bsgom pa de// bskal pa bzang pos zin pa yin// byams dang snying rje bsgoms pa de// sngon nas bsod nams bsags pa yin// mtshan ldan bla ma rnyed pa de// 'brel pa gong nas song ba yin// chos rgyal 'phags pas mchod pa de// byang sems nang du brtan pa yin// mthong thos thams cad dad pa yin// rtogs pa snying rje rgyas pa yin// yin lugs shes pa'i glu dbyangs 'di// dngos grub gter kha phyed ba yin// bu chung nas bskyangs pa'i ras chung pa// skyis phyed de mdzod la lha chos mdzod// ces gsungs so// de thams cad 'om chung nags 'dab ma yi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun btsan gyi brin po nas/ ras chung pa dang dpon slob gnyis drod phug na byon nas bzhugs tsa/ ding ri na rgya gar nag chung*/ la stod na gu ru tshem chen/ bal po na shi la bha ro/ rgya gar na dharma rā dza ste grub thob bzhi yod pa la/ bod kyi mi la ras pa dang lnga bzhugs pas/ shi la bha ro dharma bo dhir brdzus nas bod du byon pa bal por sleb pas/

bal bod kyi mi mang po mjal du 'gro zer ba la chas 'dug pa la/ ras chung pas 'gos byas ras pa rnams kyang 'gro bar sems pas/ bla ma lags/ grub thob la mjal ba la rang re yang gshegs sam zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i byin rlabs grub thob mang*// ngo mtshar sangs rgyas bstan pa dar// bde skyid 'gro ba mi la shar// rje grub thob dang mjal mi mang ba de// skal ldan 'ga' re 'ong 'dod yin/ ding ri'i rgya gar nag chung dang*// ston pa gu ru tshem chen dang*// bal po shi la bha ro dang*// rgya gar dharma bo dhi dang*// gung thang mi la ras pa rnams// sems rnam rig tsam re gang la'ang yod/ sgom rang mgo thon pa gang la'ang yod// sems rang gsal sems ngo sus kyang shes// lus sprul bsgyur nus pa sus kyang shes// ngag rang byung gdams ngag khong la'ang gsol// sems stong nyid snying rje ngas kyang 'byongs// 'phral ngo mtshar ltad mo khong gis ston// zhen log dang snying rus nga rang che// gzhan nged tsho khyad par ma mchis pas// nga da res mjal du mi 'gro yis// bu khyod rnams mjal du ces kyang song*// gzhan skyon yon yod pa ma yin te// nga na so rgas nas ma thon pas// dpal o rgyan yul du myur du mjal// sems the tshom mi dgos blo gdings yod// ces gsungs pas/ ras chung pas zhus pa/ skyon med na mi rnams kyis mi la ras pa mi 'byon pa chags sdang red zer bas/ gshegs pa zhig 'thad par 'dug lags zhus pa'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs// nyes ltung dag par byin gyis rlobs/ bu mi kha byur gyi sa mda' la// the tshom zos na rang nyid 'khor// sgom sgrub snying nas bsam dus su// 'gro 'dug mang na lta kha rdug /bla ma rje dang mjal dus su// bcol ma mang na lha kha 'khrugs// gsang sngags zab mo'i thabs lam la// yid gnyis byas na 'grub mi 'gyur// grub thob byin rlabs che lags na// 'khor dpung mang po'i tshig pa za// bu ras chung grogs mched ces kyang song*// nga da res cung zhig mi 'gro ang*// zhes gsungs pas/

ras chung pas zhus pa/ mi ngan pas sdig pa gsog par 'dug pas cis kyang 'byon par zhu dang*/ nged tsho la yang phan zhus pas/ de go dharma bo dhis phyag len du 'gro gsungs pas/ ras chung pa dga' nas da bla ma 'byon tsa/ gser zhig 'bul rgyu med na ngo tsha/ rgya gar gser la dga' ba yin/ zer ba'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bdag byas tshad chos su 'gyur bar shog /byas tshad chos su ma shar na// sems byang sems rgyas pa'i don mgo med// sgom ting 'dzin skyes pas rogs mi 'dod// sems rang grol bar bas rogs 'dod na// rgyun du bsgoms pa don mgo med// nga mi la ras pas nor mi 'dod// mi la ras pas nor bsags na// bya ba btang ba don mgo med// dharma bo dhis gser mi 'dod// dharmā bo dhis gser 'dod na// grub pa thob pa'i don mgo med// ras chung rdor grags khe mi 'dod// ras chung khe 'dod grags 'dod na// bla ma bsten pa don mgo med// ces gsungs te ras pa dpon slob bzhi cu tsam byon pa la/ dgong mo khrom che sgang gcig la phebs pas// khrom rnams kyis mi la ras pa byon thal ze bas/ dharmā bo dhi khri las bab nas mi la ras pa la phyag byas pas de la phyag le na ma byas pas 'khor gcig gis phyag len mi mdzad dam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis/ yid 'ong bal po'i rdzong gseb na/ bod kyi mi la ras pa nga*// rgya gar bo dhi rā dza yis// sgyu ma lus kyi phyag byas na// zung 'jug thal sbyar pus btsugs nas// sku khams phyag rgya chen pos dris/ de la ngas brjod du med pa'i grong khyer du// rnal 'byor sku khams bde bar mchi// gnyis su med pa'i dgon pa na// rnal 'byor sku khams bzang ngam byas// mi rnams kyis mi la ras pa bzang ba red ang zer ro// der dharmā bāo dhi dang gsungs gleng byas pas/ dharmā bo dhis khyed rogs mi 'dod par 'dug zer bas khyed la grogs bzang po ji ltar yod gsungs pas/

rje mi las/ dharmā bo dhi dpon slob gsum/ ras chung pa dang khong rang dpon slob gnyis dang lnga min pa med pa'i gnas gcig byung ba dang mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma gsang sngags sprul pa'i sku la gsob ba 'debs// bka' brgyud grub thob rnams la byin gyis rlobs// 'di ru dpon slob lnga bzhugs pa// ye shes lnga yi dbyangs len pa// sprul sku lnga yi ngo ma chog /rtsa yon po lnga po rlung gis bsrang*// rlung log pa lnga po lam du bsad// khams snyigs ma lnga po me la bsregs// sems dug chen lnga yi sdong po bsgyel// dgra las rlung rnam rtog dbu mar bsad// dgra sdang ba thub pa'i dpa' bo la// rogs ngan pa'i 'khri bshal bya rgyu med// ces gsungs pas/ dharmā bo dhis dgra 'dul lugs bzang*/ dgra thul rting gnyen bzang po dgos pas/ gnyen bzang po gang bsten gsungs pa la mgur 'di gsungs so// rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs// grogs nang nas 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// rtsa dngas ma lnga yi a ma de// rlung dngas ma lnga yi pha dang 'phrad// khams dngas ma nga yi 'bras bu la// sems dngas ma la lnga yi rang zhal mthong*// 'di rgyal sa zin pa'i kha po de// pho brang dbu ma'i gzhal yas khang*// 'ja' sa 'khor lo drug la sgrogs// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dmag bsdus pas/ chad 'dzin med pa'i khrims kyis mnan// gang shar rig pa'i rten 'brel la// rang shes ngo sprod kyi gnyen dang mjal// khams gsum sems can thams cad de// bdag gis gnyen nyid de la byas// de rnal 'byor nga yi gnyen grogs yin// gnyen bzang byang chub sems nyid dang*// dus nam yang 'bral ba mi gda'o// zhes gsungs pas dharmā bo dhi mnyes nas/ khyed rnal 'byor pa'i nyams la bshad pas mi long ste/ lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad 'gag ji lta bu rigs gsungs pa yang mgur 'di gsungs so// yengs med sems la lta nus na// kha lta skam po lab don med// rang rig nyams dang 'dres pa na// blun sgom ro nyal 'khrul pa yin// rten 'brel 'char tshul shes pa na// chos brgyad spyod pa khram gzhi yin// sems la nongs 'khres med pa na// tshul 'chos ngo srung zog po yin/

'khor 'das sku dang ye shes te// grub 'dod rtsol bas sgrub pa med// ces gsungs pas/ rnal 'byor pa'i lta sgom spyod pa legs gsungs pa dang*/ mi la'i zhal nas/ rang re la yang sgom gnad bzang po yod dam gsungs pas/ dharmā bo dhis mgur 'di gsungs so// nga lta ba bzang po'i sgrub brgyud cig /'dir tshogs skal ldan gsol ba 'debs// las kyi 'brel pa bzang po la// myur du mjal bar byin gyis rlobs/ rnam rtog bag chags ma zhi pa'i// sems la bltas pas ci la phan/ bdag 'dzin skyid 'dod ma spangs pas// yun du bsgoms pas ci la phan// 'gro ba'i don la mi brtson pa'i// nga rgyal spyod pas ci la phan// bla ma'i gsung la mi gnas pa'i// dga' dus a rgun ci la phan// rang sems dpang po mi 'jog pa'i// ngo lkog g.yo sgyu khrel gyi gzhi// 'bras bu kho thon mang byas kyang*// bla ma med par 'grub mi 'gyur// yin lugs bshad pas gnong la 'phog /'khrug pa byas na phung gzhi yin// kha rog bsdad pas gdams ngag zab// khyod bod kyi rnal 'byor dbyangs la snyan// nga glu dbyangs mkhas pa mi shes te// spro ba skyes nas blangs pa lags// dpal bde ba rgyal po'i zhing khams su// dbyangs len par spro na myur du byon// zhes gsungs nas mnyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du mdzad de dharmā bo dhi phar la byon/ mi la dpon slob snye nam phug tu byon pa la yon bdag rnams mjal du 'ong nas/ dharmā bo dhi dang mjal lugs dris pas de'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// dgung nyi zla mjal bas 'gro ba gsal// ma bu 'phrad pas gdung sems zhi// dbyar spang mjal bas rtsi thog rgyas// nged grub thob mjal bas rgyal khams bde// bal po rdzong gi nang gseb tu// dharmā bo dhi phyag phebs pas// mi la ras pa mjal du song*// khong dharmā bo dhi sku bzhengs nas// mi la nga la phyag byas pas// khrom gyi mi rnams the tshom zos// khong sgyu ma lus kyi phyag rgya yis// zung 'jug thal sbyar pus mo btsugs// bsnyun dri smras chos kyi dbyings su byas// len ni phyag rgya chen pos btab// gnyis med dag pa'i dgon pa na// 'od gsal brjed med gsung gleng byas// smon lam bzang po'i 'brel pa de// sngon rgyal ba'i ring nas yod pa yin// nged grogs mched mjal 'phrad mdzad pa de// rgyal khams yongs la grags pa yin// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad bal yul nags ma'i skor ro//

༈ de nas yang re zhig gi tshe/ rje btsun mi la ras pa dpal mo dpal thang na byon pa'i tshe/ tshong pa 'ga' zhig dang 'phrad pas rnal 'byor pa khyod rgya khams 'grims pa la grogs yod dam med zer ba la/ de'i dus su grogs bzang po nyi shu rtsa gcig yod gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// nga rnal 'byor rgyal khams 'grim pa la// grogs bzang po nyi shu rtsa gcig yod// bla ma rin po che dang rtsa gnyis yod// rnal 'byor rang dang rtsa gsum yod// dad pa dang brtson 'grus shes rab gsum// lha chos byed pa'i grogs su bzang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum// rgyab brten byed pa'i grogs su bzang*// 'dul ba mdo sde mngon pa gsum// slob gnyer byed pa'i grogs su bzang*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum// dngos grub zhu ba'i grogs su bzang*// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum// nyams len byed pa'i grogs su bzang*/ lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum// sangs chung rgya ba'i grogs su bzang*// dka' thub bcud len chu 'thung gsum// ri khrod 'grim pa'i grogs su bzang*// der yang gdams ngag le'u gcig thal// da rung gdams ngag dbyangs su len// rtsa gsum grogs dang 'grogs 'grogs nas// skyel ma ngang gis brjed nas thal// me cha rnon po 'dzin 'dzin nas// khyim mtshes ngang gis brjod nas thal// gcig pur ri khrod 'grims 'grim nas// grong yul ngang gis brjed nas thal// rtag tu bag yangs sdod sdod nas// ngo tsha ngang gis brjes nas thal// dpon med g.yog med sdod sdod nas// zhes sa ngang gis brjed nas thal// me sgra 'ong gis 'jag khyim nas// rlung sgra 'ong gi sbra khyim pa// chu sgra 'ong gis sa khyim pa// 'chi ba 'ong ngo skyes bu kun/ mi lus thob nas chos yod dgos// mi lus thob nas chos med na// byol song gi rtsam pa 'gam pa 'dra// der yang gdams ngag le'u gcig thal// da rung gdams ngag dbyangs su len// nam srod la dbang po gzhi la bzhag

/dbang po gzhi la bzhag tsam na// mar me rlung gis ma bskyod 'dra// sems gsal 'grib med pa'i gdams ngag bdog /nam gung la shes pa bum par bcug /shes pa bum par bcug tsam na/ mkhar gzhong nang gi ru sbal bzhin// sems phrag phrig med pa'i gdams ngag bdog /nam tho rangs la rang sems gsal cig 'debs// sems la gsal cig 'debs tsa na// dngul dkar me long phyis pa ltar// sems 'od gsal chen po'i gdams ngag bdog /der yang gdams ngag le'u gcig thal// da rung gdams ngag dbyangs su len// pho rab cig la chos shig dgos// pho rab cig la chos med na// gangs stod kyi seng ge dkar mo 'dra// kho la shi ba'i dus shig byung tsam na// dpal rtsal che yang don mgo chung*// pho 'bring cig la chos shig dgos// pho 'bring cig la chos med na// sde pa'i glang bu rol zhugs 'dra// kho la shi ba'i dus byung tsam na// ro chen cig byung yang don mgo chung*// pho tha ma cig la chos shig dgos// pho tha ma cig la chos med na// tshong pa'i bu chung lam zhugs 'dra// kho la shi ba'i dus shig byung tsa na// sdug bsran che yang don mgo chung*// der yang gdams ngag le'u gcig thal// da rung gdams ngag dbyangs su len// mo rab cig la chos shig dgos// mo rab cig la chos med na// rma bya'i mdongs la lta dang mtshungs// mo la shi ba'i dus shig byung tsa na// kha dog legs kyang don mgo chung*// mo 'bring cig la chos shig dgos// mi 'bring cig la chos med na// rtsig gseb kyi byi ba tshang nyal 'dra// mo la shi ba'i dus shig byung tsa na// gsog 'jog rem yang don mgo chung*// mo tha ma cig la chos shig dgos// mo tha ma cig la chos med na// sgo rgyab kyi khyi mo tshang ma 'dra// mo la shi ba'i dus shig byung tsa na// sgo tshe rem yang don mgo chung*/ der yang gdams ngag le'u cig thal// da rung gdams ngag dbyangs su len// bya rgod po rnyi la ma zin na// brag stod g.yang la bde bde 'dra// gshog drug ldem me skyid skyid 'dra// skyid skyid 'dra nas 'gying pa lags// sha ru bcu gdos la ma zin pa// spang stod yangs la bde bde 'dra// sha ru bcu ldem me skyid skyid 'dra// nya mo rgya la ma zin pa// mtsho stod yangs la bde bde 'dra// gser mig kyi le skyid skyid 'dra// khyod yon bdag ser snas ma bcings de// khong rgya khang gi nang der bde bde 'dra// sbyin pa phyogs med du gtong bas skyid skyid 'dra// nga rnal 'byor pha yul du ma chags pa de// rgyal khams yangs la 'grims pas bde bde 'dra/
