gdams ngag dbyangs su len pas skyid skyid 'dra// bde bde 'dra nas bgyis pa lags// skyid skyid 'dra na khyed kyang mdzod// ces gsungs pas tshong pa rnams dad pa skyes te chos zhus nas smon lam btab bo// zhes gsungs so// de nas ru yang gi ston pa bya ba bal yul nas tshur 'ong ba dang 'phrad nas ston pa na re/ khyed glu la mkhas pa yin zer bas khyed dag gis nged dag la dpe mdzod la glu zhig long dang zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis kho yi len gsungs pa/ sems nyid 'di la dpe ma rnyed// sems nyid 'di la dpe rnyed dus// nam mkha' 'di la dpe mi gtub// nam mkha' 'di la dpe gtub rgyus// nam mkha' reg med stong pa yin// sems nyid rig pa stong pa yin// stong pa'i ngang la mnyam lags kyang*/ mnyam la mi mnyam khyad par med// nyi zla 'di la dpe mi gtub// nyi zla 'di la dpe gtub rgyus// nyi zla dngos po gsal ba yin// sems nyid dngos med gsal ba yin// gsal ba'i phyogs nas mnyam lags kyang*// mnyam la mi mnyam khyad par che// ri bo 'di la dpe mi gtub// ri bo 'di la dpe gtub rgyus// ri bo sa rdo brtsegs pa min// 'pho 'gyur med par mnyam lags kyang*// mnyam la mi mnyam khyad par che// chu bo 'di la dpe mi gtub// chu bo 'di la dpe gtub rgyus// chu bo chu phran 'dus pa yin// sems nyid 'di la 'dus pa med// rgyun chad med par mnyam lags kyang*// mnyam la mi mnyam khyad par che// skyi ser rlung la dpe mi gtub// skyi ser rlung la dpe gtub rgyus// skyi ser 'byung ba bsdong ba yin// sems nyid 'di la bsdong ya med// ngos bzung med par mnyam lags kyang*// mnyam la mi mnyam khyad par che// mi khyed la nged kyis dpe mi gtub// khyed dang nged la dpe gtub rgyus// khyed ni 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba yin// nged ni bya ba btang ba yin// mi rgyu yin pa mnyam lags kyang*/

mnyam dang mi mnyam khyad par che// zhes gsungs pas/ khong skyengs nas bza' drongs zer skad/ yang gsungs pa/ rje byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs// nyon mongs dgra la zhe zon gyis// 'gro drug g.yang la lhung nyen yod// rtag tu rang gi sems la ltos// lung ma bstan du 'gro nyen yod// lar rtag tu ri khrod dgon pa 'grims// yon tan rang la 'ong ste mchi// nags tshal dgon pa'i sa phyogs su// spyod lam dus bzhi cha snyoms 'tshal// nang gi 'byung bzhi ro snyoms 'tshal// dga' ba'i don ni shugs la 'char// sems nyid 'od gsal stong pa 'di// nyi zla'i 'od ni shar zhing nub// sems nyid 'od gsal shar nub med// ces gsungs so// yang gsungs pa/ snang ba chos skur shar ba dang*// 'khor 'das dgag sgrub med pa ste// grub mtha'i khas len med pa gsum// 'di gsum lta ba'i mthar thug yin/ sems nyid dwangs snyigs phyed pa dang*// gnyug ma rang sa zin pa gnyis// mnyam rjes med pa brda dang gsum// 'di gsum sgom pa'i mthar thug yin// zhen pa nang nas log pa dang*/ chos brgyad mgo bo snyoms pa dang*// spyod lam rang dga' rang tshugs gsum// 'di gsum spyod pa'i mthar thug yin// sems nyid ye sangs rgyas pa dang*// rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa gnyis// 'gyur med khong du chud pa gsum// 'di gsum 'bras bu'i mthar thug yin// ci byed chos dang bstun pa dang*// spyod lam mngon lkog med pa dang*// bla ma'i gsung bzhin byed pa gsum// 'di gsum dam tshig mdor bsdus yin/ yang gsungs pa/ snang dang stong dang dbyer med gsum// 'di gsum lta ba'i mdor bsdus yin// gsal dang mi rtogs ma yengs gsum// 'di gsum sgom pa'i mdor bsdus yin// ma chags ma zhen lhug pa gsum// 'di gsum spyod pa'i mdor bsdus yin// chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum// 'di gsum 'bras bu'i mdor bsdus yin// yang gsungs pa/

lta ba stong pa'i ye shes yin// sgom pa rang gsal 'dzin med yin// spyod pa chags sdang rgyud zhi yin// 'bras bu dri med gcer bu yin// lta ba stong pa'i ye shes de// kha lta phugs su 'chor nyen gda'// kha ltas dngos po grol ba med// lta ba mtho yang phan pa chung*// de phyir rnam par dag pa mdzad// sgom pa rang gsal 'dzin med de// gti mug gi dbang du 'chor nyen gda'// gti mug la ye shes skyes pa med// shes bzhin gyi dran pas ma zin na// zhi gnas 'thug kyang phan pa chung*// de phyir dran pas zin par mdzod// spyod pa chags sdang rgyud zhi de// tho co'i spyod par 'chor nyen gda'// tho co la nges shes skyes pa med// lta sgom gyi grogs su ma shar na// brtul zhugs spyad kyang phan pa chung*// de phyir ro snyoms shes par mdzod// 'bras bu dri med gcer bu de// mtshan ma'i gos kyis ma dkris sam// mtshan mas 'khrul pas bshig pa med// nges shes rgyud la ma skyes na// rtsol sgrub byas kyang phan pa chung*// de phyir lhun gyis grub par mdzod// lta ba sems kyis gcod pa yin// sgom pa sems kyi brgyang shing yin// spyod pa sems kyi srog shing yin/ dam tshig sems kyi gnya' gnon yin// man ngag sems kyi lde'u mig yin// zhes gsungs so// yang gsungs pa/ stong pa nyid kyi gzhu mo la// mnyam pa nyid kyi rgyus kyis brgyus// rang rig gsal ba'i mda' smyug la// tshad med bzhi yi sgro yis bsgron// rnam rtog 'ban du btsugs btsugs nas// zung 'jug gnyis kyi 'then 'then nas// rnam rtog tal gyis mi gtong te// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad dpal mo dpal thang la sogs pa'i skor ro/// /de nas gung thang sna rtse'i phug tu sgom zhing bzhugs tsa na/ nyin gcig bya phug ron gcig la gser gyi rna cha 'chang ba cig drung du 'ong nas phyag dang bskor ba byed cing 'dug pas mtshar ba zhig byung nas/

rje btsun gyis khyod nga 'bod du 'ong ba e yin gsungs pas/ rke dgye rgu mang po byas nas yin zer ba'i brda byas te phar ri'i brag gseb tu 'phur song bas/ rje btsun yang der byon tsa/ brag rtsa zhig na 'bras dkar mo khal gcig bre gang spungs 'dug pa la/ mchu tshug byas nas 'phur song ba dang*/ bla mas kyang 'bras gsol zhing sus ma mthong bar bzhugs pas/ thugs dam 'phel bar byung bas lta sgom bde ba'i mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma ho/ drin chen mar pa lho brag pa// snying nas dran pas snying du bsgoms/ yang yang dran pas 'bral ba med// nga dang bla ma 'dres pas bde// a la la gshis kyi ting 'dzin 'di// skye med chos skur ngo sprad nas// ma bcos chos sku'i ngang du 'dres// lta ba mtho dman rtsis gdab med// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// ye shes stong gsal sems kyi ting 'dzin 'di// gsal stong rig pa ngo sprad nas// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du 'dres// sgom pa bzang ngan gyi rtsis gdab med// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// tshogs drug rang sar dengs pa la// bde sdug gnyis po rang sar 'dres// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang las 'das// spyod pa yin min rtsis gdab bral// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'/ 'bras bu chos sku'i rang bzhin 'di// sna tshogs sprul skur ngo sprad nas// goms pa 'dres 'jags kyi ngang du 'dres// 'bras bu tshur shog gi yid smon mi gda' na// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mo cig byung*// zhes gsungs shing yod tsa phug ron sngon ma des phug ron 'dra 'dra bdun khrid nas byung*/ mo rang dang brgyad kyis phyag dang bskor ba byed cing 'dug pa la/ bla mas ci yin dud 'gros 'di 'dra shes pa sprul pa'i bya zhig red dgongs nas/ ci yin khyed tshos nga la chos zhu ba e yin gsungs pas/ yin zer ba'i brda byed cing mgo zhung nge byas pas bla mas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje ngo mtshar sprul pa'i bla ma de// thugs rje ma chung byin gyis rlobs// khyod phug ron sngon mo gzugs bzang 'di// rnam 'phrul grung grung gi spyod pa can// glu 'di don yid la 'dzin par zhu// spyir 'jig rten skyid pa'i bde ba 'di// skyid skyid 'dra yang myur du 'bral// mo btsun bzang mo'i snang ba 'di// mtho mtho 'dra yang gtad sa med// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi khyim thab 'di// 'thad 'thad 'dra yang sdug bsngal mang*// rigs rgyud bzang po'i bya phrug de/

rang mkhos med na med ngan che// bla ma bzang po'i slob ma de// spyod pa ngan na 'khor bar ltung*// phug ron sngon mo'i yon bdag de// zhabs tog bzang yang yid ma ches// khyod dad pa can gyi phug ron brgyad// dam chos dgos na rnam 'phrul shig /ces gsungs pa phug ron brgyad po bu mo brgyad du 'dzum 'dzum byed/ khyed rnams su yin byas pas/ nged rnams dang po mjal snga ba de lha yi bu mo yin/ nged 'og ma bdun po de yang lha yi bu re re'i bu mo yin lags zer/ khyed rnams phug ron du 'ong ba ci yin gsungs pas/ khyed mi yi yul du bzhugs pas/ mi spyod pa ngan pas yid ma ches te sprul pa byas nas 'ong ba yin zer nas/ phug ron slud bu brgyad rnams phrag tu bcug song de ci yin gsungs pas mi ngan pas gshis ngan bslab pa yin zer/ khyed gcig pu la bzhugs pas nged lha rnams 'ong bas dga'/ da khyed lha yul du 'byon par zhu/ sngar yang 'byon pas bka' drin che zer bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ nga mi yi 'gro ba 'dul dgos pas 'gro ba mi 'ong khyed rang tsho nga yi glu 'di nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud// pha bla ma byin rlabs dngos grub shar// khyod lha yi bu mo sngon mo brgyad// 'bras dkar mo dngos grub bsam gtan zas// khams gsos par gyur pas thugs dam 'phel// da gdab len chos kyis 'jal ba la// snyan lhan ne gson la yid la zhog /dkar po lha yi rgyal sa de/ 'dzin snying 'dod kyang snying po med// lha bu gzhon nu'i brtse gdung de// snang ba skyid kyang myur du 'bral// sgyu 'phrul sgyu ma'i zol zog de// longs spyod che yang ltung ba'i rgyu// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de// bsam na snying rlung drag po ldang*// khyed deng sang lha chos byed bsam na// skyabs dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thob// 'gro drug sems can pha mar bsgom// mchod pa bla ma rje la 'bul// sbyin pa khams gsum yongs la bsngos// rang lus lha yi dam lha yi ngang*// brjod pa zab mo sngags la gyis/

snying las mi rtag skyo ba bskyed// da rung rang sems dpang por zhog /ces gsungs pas khong rnams na re/ nged 'jig rten pa'i 'gro ba 'di/ cis kyang sdug bsngal rang la spyod cing*/ bde ba yan du go ba cig 'dug pas/ sgom mi nus kyang sgom rang la dad pas/ nges par sgom lugs gcig gsungs par zhu zer bas/ yang bla mas gnyen bzang po zab mo'i bsgom lugs 'di mgur 'di gsungs so// drin chen bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sgom zab mo skye bar thugs rjes zungs// rtag tu rang sems bsgom pa la// nang du zhi gnas bsam gtan bsgom// bya ba btang ba cig rgyan du che// phyi ru gnyen pos tu re zungs// lus ngag dal ba cig rgyan du che// rgyun du dran pa'i rang so zungs/ bya byed nyung ba cig rgyan du che/ lar rkyen ngan blo rgyag byung tsa na// zhe sdang lang dogs 'dzum me gyis// 'dod pa'i nor dang 'phrad dus su/ 'dod chags skyes dogs rgyang nge gyis// tshig ngan gtam ngan zer dus su/ snang ba 'khrugs dogs rgyang nge gyis// bdag dang mnyam du 'grogs dus su// phrag dog skyes dogs yang nge gyis// rang la bkur sti byas dus su// nga rgyal skyes dogs kum me gyis/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ rang rgyud dal bar lhan ne sdod// bsgom dus za dus nyal dus dang*// 'gro spyod gnas pa ci byed kyang*// stong nyid rang sgyu mar bsgom/ mkhas btsun brgya yi zhal phyes kyang*// don 'di las zab pa yod pa min// khyod dga' bar soms la lha chos mdzod// ces gsungs pas thams cad dad do// da phyin chad kyang 'tsho ba 'dren zer nas/ phug ron gyi slud bu re re rnams bton te nam mkha' la 'phur nas song ngo*// de thams cad phug ron sngon mo'i skor ro// ༈ rje btsun chen po dang bu mo yid 'phrog ma gnyis kyi zhus len 'dir bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ yon tan mchog mnga' rgyal ba bka' drin can/

dpal dang snyan pas phyogs bcu khyab/ mtshungs med bde gshegs bka' drin can/ mkhas pa chen po de la 'dud// bdag dgon pa cig tu 'dug tsam na// de 'dra'i bu mo ya mtshan can/ mnyen lcug 'khril ba'i sku lus la// na bza' shel dar ha lo ris/ dar zab gnyis kyi cha ga can// 'od chags gser gyi theg les spras// gong ba tho ti rgya mtsho sprin// mdzes sdug 'jam mnyan 'khril pa gyon// ska rag gser la ska nan g.yu// bai ḍūr mu tig tsar tsar can// chab ma dngul la chab lce dung*// dngul dkar me long ska gseb bcug /rin chen mdzes pa'i gos la// sgrog zung ser po gser la byas// sgrog rten smug po mchong la byas// phyi nang ldem gyon 'od dang ldan// chag lham za 'og pad ka ris// skyid 'thi dmar po'i bham mthil can// lham sgrog nan tan shel la byas// a long mu man chab ma mig /mthon nag po'i dbu skra la// gser gyi me tog ser pos spras// mtsho ro g.yu yi zur phud can/ rin chen sna tshogs rgyan dang ldan// dung sgong dkar po'i do shal can// byu ru dmar po'i phra ra dgos// rna long a long gser dang g.yu// mgul do gzi dang spug la byas// dngul dkar zhun ma'i dor gdub la// rwa ga dmar po'i phra ra can// ra gan mdzes pa'i gdu bu la// ke ke ru yi spar kheb byas// smin ma nag phran bar ma chad// sna rgyud drang zhing sgro rtse dmar// dung so mtshams med shin tu dkar// rdzi ma ma 'dres ba yi 'dra// dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa// li khri mtshal gyi thig le byas// bzhin mdzes mdangs chags 'od kyang chags// sked skabs phra zhing lus po ran// sba gling dkar po 'bud pa'i sgras// rang dbang med par sems yid 'phyo// stab sdug mdzes pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ kho bo'i mdun du byung nas 'dug /de la bdag gis 'di skad dris// mdzes sdug lha mo'i cha byad can// sngon chad khyod 'dra mthong ma myong*// bka' mchid ma yo drang du smros// khyod dang po skyes pa'i yul de gang*// 'gro sa 'dug gnas ji lta bu// rigs sam mtshan nyid ji lta bu// sprul pa yin nam rang rgyud pa// bu mo de yis 'di skad zer// kye ho gson dang rigs kyi bu// nga skyes pa thog ma med nas skye// yul ni nges med 'jig rten khams// 'gro ba thogs pa med par 'gro// 'dug gnas 'gro drug kun gyi sems// rigs ni mtho dman med pa yin// mtshan nyid khyed rang rang la dris// cir yang byung bas sprul pa yin// bag chags brgyud pas rang rgyud yin/

'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'phrin pa yin// legs so mdzes sdug yid 'phrog ma// ban sprang bdag la snyan gson dang*// khyed mdzes btsun chas bzang 'dzom pa de// rigs ldan ma cig yin par nges// sngon chad 'dris pa su dang 'dris// mdzad spyod 'byor pa ci dang ldan// khyed la rang dbang ci tsam yod// sku tshe ring thung ci tsam gnas// kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas man chad nas// rdo rje dmyal ba yan chad kyi// 'khor 'das gnyis dang snga nas 'dris// bzang ngan bden rdzun mtho dman med// thams cad ma lus nga yis byed/ la la thar pa'i yul du bskyal// la la 'byung ba'i lam yang bstan// la la mtho ris gnas su bskyal// la la ngan song gnas su khrid// la la mthon po dma' mor gtong*// la la dma' mo mthon por gtong*// la la phyug po dbul por gtong*// la la dbul po phyug por btang*// 'khor 'das longs spyod ji snyed pa// bu mo nga yi 'byor pa yin// dag dang ma dag 'jig rten na// bu mo nga bas dbang che med// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom ji snyed pa// sa lam ma lus nyer bgrod nas// 'bras bu'i mchog rnams thob pa yang*// nga yis dbang gis thob pa yin// lha dang lha min thams cad kyi// bde dang sdug bsngal ji snyed pa// bu mo nga yi dbang gis byung*// phung 'tshe gnyis ka nga yis byas// gla pa kun gyi snying la zhugs// nyin mtshan med pa'i sdug bsngal gyis// dpung shed mi la phul pa'i rin// zad nas stong par 'gro bar byas// mgron po kun gyi snying du zhugs// sdig sdug mang po'i bsags pa'i nor// don med nga yis dbang byas nas// zad nas sprang du 'gro bar byas// dper na nor med sprang po cig /nub gcig gnyid pa'i rmi lam na// nor mang rnyed nas dga' gyur kyang*// sad nas stong pa de bzhin te// 'phyor po kun gyi snying la zhugs// la la rin chen spyan dang bral// la la 'phangs pa'i srog dang phral// la la nor shor gcer bur btang*// 'phyor ma kun gyi snying la zhugs// rtsis ngan ngan par lhung bar byas// 'bring po khyi dang 'thab tu bcug

/rtsis med rngan gyi tshe srog bkum/ sngags pa kun gyi snying la zhugs// dam tshig sa ya 'bum sde de// mdzes ma nga yi dbang du song*// thun bzhi'i sgrub pa bshol bar byas// mi chen kun gyi snying du zhugs// bzang 'dod bsam pa gnyan po de/ mdzes ma nga yi dbang du song*// rgyal po khri las lhung bar byas// rab byung kun gyi snying du zhugs// lhag pa'i tshul khrims dri med de// mdzes ma nga yi dbang du song*// 'di phyi gnyis ka med par byas// bla ma kun gyi snying la zhugs// rang gzhan gnyis kyi don chen de// mdzes ma nga yi dbang du song*// so so skye bo smod par bya// sgom chen kun gyi snying la zhugs// zhi gnas lhag mthong zung 'brel de// mdzes ma nga yi dbang du song*// tha mal grong pas bzhad gad bya// rnal 'byor kun gyi snying du zhugs// chags med rin chen nor mchog de// mdzes ma nga yi dbang du song*// ther zug sred bus bcings nas bzhag /dge bshes kun gyi snying du zhugs/ thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab de// mdzes ma nga yi dbang du song*// seng ge khri las lhung bar byas// nam mkha' mtha' ma gang yin dang*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ci gnas par// mdzes ma nga yi tshe yi tshad// de srid bar du gnas pa yin// khyed kyi bsam pa'i rang zugs de// mdzes ma nga yi dbyer mi phyed// bden nam mi bden rang la dris// bden par go na don chen 'grub// legs so mdzes sdug yid 'phrog ma// dge dang mi dge'i mtshan nyid gang*// sems kyi mtshan nyid ji lta lags// bdud rigs gang gi yul la 'jug /kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// phan sems gzhan don snying rje yi// mi dge spyod pa ltar snang mang*// dge ba'i rtsa ba rtsir gyi zungs// kun slong rig pa'i sems kyis su// g.yo sgyu 'dod pa'i las dbang gis// dge ba spyod pa ltar snang yang*// de ni mi dger shes par bya// sems kyi mtshan nyid nam mkha' 'dra// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid nga la dris// nga yi rang bzhin shes pa na// bcings pa'i dra ba rang sar grol// bshes gnyen mkhas dang mi ldan zhing*// shes rab rnam gsum mtshon cha de// rang la rang dbang ma thob na// bdud rnams de yi yul la 'jug

/kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// nyon mongs bdud kyi dmag dpung de/ khyod kyis bzlog na ji ltar zlog /mgul gyi bum par glu ru gsungs// legs so mdzes sdug yid 'phrog ma// rnam par shes pa'i sgyu 'phrul de// don med yul du stong skor byed// khyod dran pa rtse gcig tur re ston// thos pa'i shes rab ral gri des// sgro 'dogs yid gnyis thag phyi nang*// med par rbad de bcad/ tha dad kyi bdud la nyam mi nga*// bsam pa'i shes rab bshan bu des// yin min sred bu gsum bsgril de// nges shed ngang du rbad kyis bcad// the tshom bdud la nyam mi nga*// sgom pa'i shes rab mda' mo ches/ dmigs pa'i phub mo gsum rim de// 'od gsal rgyun gyis tal gyi phug /mtshan ma'i bdud la nyams mi nga*// rang lus lha sku'i rang bzhin la// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor gsal btab cing*// 'ja' tshon lta bur rtogs pa la// phung po'i bdud la nyams mi nga*// sems nyid rig pa 'od gsal 'di// rgyun chad med pa'i rang bzhin la// dngos po med par 'dug pa la// 'chi bdag gi bdud la nyam mi nga*// sems nyid nam mkha' dngas pa la/ rnam rtog sprin ltar ngang du zhi// thams cad grogs su gyur pa la// nyon mongs bdud la nyam mi nga*// bzang ngan bde sdug thams cad kun// chos nyid ngang du dbyer med cing*// ro snyoms byed pa'i rnal 'byor la// lha yi bdud kyi nyam mi nga*// 'khor ba myang ngan 'das pa kun// thams cad sems nyid rig par bcas// sems la rang dbang thob pa la// bdud rigs thams cad sdug par mchis// 'di mkhas pa chen pos gsung sgros yin// rnal 'byor bdag gi nyams rtogs yin// mdzes ma khyed la bzlas pa yin// rin chen sems kyi yon tan yin// kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// ngo mtshar rmad kyi glu blangs pas// rnam par shes pa'i skyo ngal spangs// nga yi rang bzhin khyed shes zin// gnyen 'dun bdud kyi jag pa yin/

dgra sdang byams pa'i sag dar yin// chung ma thar me rtsa ba yin// sras bu 'khor ba'i gting rdo yin// bsod nams bdud kyi phye gtor yin// mnga' ris gshin rje'i 'jigs pa yin// zas nor dug gi sdong po yin// nga yi rang bzhin ma brjed mdzod// legs so mdzes sdug yid 'phrog ma// 'khor ba spong na ji ltar spangs// mya ngan 'das pa ji ltar bsgrub// rang gzhan don gnyis ji ltar bya// kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// 'khor ba'i rang bzhin mya ngan 'das// de nyid rtogs na thar pa 'thob// gnyis med don 'di go lags sam// byams pa snying rje'i rang bzhin gyis// rtag tu byang chub sems bsgom zhing*// gzhan don gtso bor byas pa na// rang don shugs las 'byung ste mchi// kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// lar 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba ma chod na// byas pa thams cad don med yin// de bas 'khrul pa rtsad nas chod// kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// khyod kyi brgyud pa ci lta bu// drin can bla ma ji skad bya// gdams pa'i gtso bo gang la byed// kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi// khyod kyi gsan na ji ltar rtogs// mdzes ma nga la drang du smros// legs so mdzes sdug yid 'phrog ma// nga yi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// la lar bshad pa'i brgyud par zhus// sgro 'dogs chod pa de ltar lags// la lar tshig gi brgyud par zhus// sdeb sbyor mkhas pa de ltar lags// la la gdams ngag gi brgyud par zhus// nyams len mkhas pa de ltar lags// la la byin rlabs kyi brgyud par zhus// bar chad sel ba de ltar lags// la la sems bskyed kyi brgyud par zhus// gzhan don byed pa de ltar lags// la la nyams kyi brgyud par zhus// gol sa med pa de ltar lags// la la rtogs pa'i brgyud par zhus// gnyis 'dzin med pa de ltar lags// yon tan rgyud la skyes pa'i phyir// drin chen gyi bla ma de kun yin// gdams ngag de rgyu 'bras mngon gyur yin// lam nor sa med pa de ltar yin// lta ba phyogs 'dzin med pa yin// sgom pa bsam gtan yeng med yin// spyod pa bcos ma med pa yin// 'bras bu 'khor 'das lhun grub yin// mi nga yi gnas lugs de ltar rtogs// mdzes ma khyod la bshad pa yin// de bas gdams ngag yod pa yin// rnal 'byor bdag la gsung bar zhu// zhes gsung pas kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa// lar ni dri rtog byed pa legs// deng sang lnga brgya'i snyigs ma la// sems can log pa'i dbang song bas// bden par gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas pas// rdzun la brten pa'i mu stegs 'dod// bde legs 'byung ba'i dam chos bas// sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i bon po 'dod// bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun bas// bstan pa bsnub pa'i rtags 'dzin 'dod// chos pa 'dod pa'i dug la spyod// sgom chen 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba bsgrubs// ston pa tshig dang don du 'dzol// gzhan don rang che zhe phug bzhag

/btsun pas tshul khrims dmag dpon byed// sngags pa dam med nang 'gras byed// rnal 'byor rdzun gyi lto rgyab 'tshol// gsang sngags zab mo bon du gyer// grub thob mgo skor zas nor 'tshol// bla ma chos brgyad rta khas khyer// tshogs gsog kha len rlung gi khyer// yon tan rin chen 'od du nub// gser mdog can gyi bstan pa la// tshul bzhin sgrub pa shin tu nyung*// a mra'i 'bras bu brtags dka' ltar// yon tan gang la yod pa dang*// skyon rnams gang la yod pa rnams// mngon du byung yang shes mi med// brgya la 'ga' zhig sgrub mod kyang*// bla ma mkhas pas ma zin pa'i// shes rab gsum dang mi ldan pas/ byams pa lam du 'gro ba nyung*// dang po mtshan med lta bar bzung*// bar du spyod med spyod par bzung*// tha ma thob med 'bras bur bzung*// de ltar 'ching 'gyur grol mi 'gyur// mi rnams 'dris shing ngan dus 'dir// sprang po'i tshul 'dzin 'dris mi bya// mi rnams log rtog che dus 'dir// yon tan gzhan la gsang bar bya// mi rnams 'grogs shing 'tshe dus 'dir// gcig pur grogs med ldum bur bya// mi rnams rang bzhin ngan dus 'dir// ri khrod dgon par bsdad par bya// mi rnams mu cor smra dus 'dir// rnal 'byor rang dbang thob par bya// ngag 'chal mi dge'i rgyu yin phyir// smra ba ngag rnams bsdam par bya// yod pa sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir// sprang zas kham res chog par bya// byas pa mi rtag chos yin phyir// byar med rang sar bzhag par bya// yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i phyir// bshes gnyen dam pa bsten par bya// phyi ma nam yin cha med phyir// de ring nyid nas bsgrub par bya// gzhan don kun mkhyen rgyu yin phyir// byang chub sems mchog bsgom par bya// bsod nams tshogs gsog rgyu yin phyir// lus ngag dge sbyor rtag tu bya// sangs rgyas gzhan nas med pa'i phyir// rang sems ngo bo rtogs par bya// thams cad mtshan ma'i chos yin phyir// phyag rgya chen po bzhag par bya// gzhan gyis dris kyang khar ma 'don// de tsam shes par gyur pa na// khyed rang 'di ltar 'dug pa cig

/zhes ni nges par zer bar 'gyur// legs so mdzes sdug yid 'phrog ma// de snga gsungs pa thams cad do// kho bo rang gis shes par bya// gdams ngag yod na da rung gsungs// kye ho gson dang rnal 'byor pa/ khyod kyis de ltar shes mod kyang*// rtag tu sdod chos byed pa la// mi rtag shes pas ci la phan// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sgrub pa la// rgyu 'bras shes pas ci la phan// grags la chags shing zhen pa na/ gdung 'bras shes pas ci la phan// rtag tu sdig pa spyod pa la// dge ba shes pas ci la phan// dge ba cung zad mi sgrub pa'i// legs nyes shes pas ci la phan// bka' lung dgongs pa mi khrol ba'i// chos rgyud shes pas ci la phan// chos la byan mo mi chud na// chos mang thos pas ci la phan// rang gi rgyud la ma phan na// bshad pa byas pas ci la phan// tshul khrims sna gcig mi srung ba'i// rab tu byung bas ci la phan// khyad par bzhi dang mi ldan pa'i// sngags pa yin pas ci la phan// yon tan gong ma ma skyes pa'i// rnal 'byor yin pas ci la phan// gzhan don bag tsam mi byed pa'i// sems bskyed byas pas ci la phan// tshul bzhin nyams su mi len pa'i// dgon pa bsten pas ci la phan// bstan pa'i spyi rgya mi 'tsho ba'i// gnas gnyis byas pas ci la phan// de nas nyams su mi len pa'i// bya bsam yod pa'i ci la phan// dam tshig tshul bzhin mi bsrung ba'i// dbang bskur byas pas ci la phan// snod min rnams la gsang ba bsgrags// gnyen par shes pas ci la phan// bdag gzhan gang la'ang mi shes pa'i// dpe cha mang pas ci la phan// bsod nams rgya chen ma bsags pa'i// nor mang yod pas ci la phan// chags sdang gnyis la gnas pa yi// mnyam nyid shes pa ci la phan// 'dod chags dug la spyod pa yi// gnyen po shes pas ci la phan/ rtag tu zhe sdang rgyud sbyangs pas// byams pa shes pas ci la phan// dge sdig khyad par mi shes pa'i// shes rab che bas ci la phan// nga rgyal min pa mi bsam pa'i// dman spyod shes pas ci la phan// kha grang 'ba' zhig gtsor byed pa'i// 'du byas dge bas ci la phan// rtag tu sdig pa 'phel ba yi// grogs po bsten pas ci la phan// sdug bsngal che zhing grog sbur 'chi// mkhar las byas pas ci la phan// 'khri ba rbad kyis mi gcod pa'i// skyo ba skyes pas ci la phan// rang nyid nyams su mi len pas// gdams ngag shes pas ci la phan// zas nor rang gi srog bas 'phang*// 'dod pa spangs pas ci la phan// gnas lugs gtan la mi pheb pa'i// lta ba mtho bas ci la phan// sems nyid ngo bo mi shes pa'i// yun ring bsgoms pas ci la phan// dge sbyor grogs su mi 'gro ba'i// spyod pa byas pas ci la phan// zag med bde ba mi 'thob pa'i// 'bras bu thob pas ci la phan// dkon mchog gsum la mi brten pa'i// dad pa che bas ci la phan// rang la rang yid ma ches pa'i// gzhan gyis bstod pas ci la phan// rang gi ci ngan byed pa yi// bla ma bzang bas ci la phan// sems can gzhan la mnar sems pa'i// snying rje bsgom pas ci la phan// bdud bzhi'i bar chad mi sel ba'i// byin rlabs che bas ci la phan// nyon mongs g.yul ngo mi zlog pa'i// dpa' bo yin pas ci la phan// 'khor ba'i g.yang sa mi chod pa'i// yang rtsal che bas ci la phan// ma rig mun pa mi sel ba'i// rig pa rno bas ci la phan// rang skyon sna gcig mi rtogs pa'i// mdzangs pa yin pas ci la phan// gzhan skyon 'ba' zhig brjod pa yi// mthun pa 'dod pas ci la phan// tha mar cis kyang 'chi ba la// da lta chags pas ci la phan// rang sems sangs rgyas yin pa la// gzhan du btsal bas ci la phan// chos rnams sems su ma shes na// grub mtha' shes pas ci la phan// go bar gyis la rgyud la sbyor// de ltar go bar ma gyur cing*// rang gi rgyud la ma sbyang na// bde ba rnyed pa dka' mor gda'// legs so mdzes sdug yid 'phrog ma// phyi bzung ba'i yul du snang ba 'di// nang 'dzin pa'i sems su blo thag chod// tha dad 'dug kyang gang dgar thogs// sems nyid skye 'gag med par rtogs// thams cad stong nyid rang bzhin la// dran pa'i rnam rtog 'phrul nyid byung yang*// nam mkha'i sprin bzhin gang dgar thong*// sems nyid bde ba chen por rtogs// bde chen zung 'jug spyod pa la// rtag chad mtshan ma ci byung yang*// mnyam nyid chen por gang dgar thong*// 'khor ba myang ngan 'das pa rnams// tha mal shes pa ngang du rdzogs// 'bras bu thob dang ma thob dag

/dbyings dag pa'i ngang du gang dgar thogs// legs so mdzes sdug yid 'phrog ma// thugs ma yengs lhan ne snyan gson dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi rig pa la// nyams dang rtogs pa 'di ltar shar// sems nyid nam mkha' dngas pa la// grub mtha' sa lam bye brag rnams// dbyer med rig pa'i ngang du rdzogs// spros dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor lags// sems 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ri bo la// gzhan don lhun grub rtsi shing rgyas// bde chen lo gdab 'bras bu smin// rtsol sbrub bral ba'i rnal 'byor lags// sems mi g.yo rgya mtsho chen po la// gzhan don yid bzhin nor bu gang*// ci 'dod dgos dgu thams cad 'byung*// 'byor par ldan pa'i rnal 'byor lags// sems chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la// theg chen gsung mchog rgyun sgra yis// rtag chad the tshom gcod par byed// bar chad med pa'i rnal 'byor lags// sems 'od gsal nyi zla rgyas pa lags// gzhan don thugs rje'i 'od zer 'phro// gdul bya ma rig mun pa sel// 'od gsal chen po'i rnal 'byor lags// sems 'od gser gyi sgrom bu la// yid ches mngon gyur zhun dang ldan// yon tan 'byung gnas rgyan du che// gang dang 'byor pa'i rnal 'byor lags// sems gdod nas rang byung rdzogs sangs rgyas/ sems dgos 'dod rtsol sgrub mtha' las 'das// 'gyur med dus gsum mnyam nyid gnas// lhun gyis grub pa'i rnal 'byor lags// tshig tshogs mang po'i dgos pa med// da ni don la dril la thong*// dge ba dag ni sdig pa'i chos// bsam pa bzang ngan khyad par yin// bka' dang bstan bcos gdams ngag dang*// chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed pa// ming gi rnam grangs so so yang*// sems la rtogs par gsungs pa cig /dper na shing rigs tha dad kyang*// grib ma gcig pa de bzhin no// de la gang zag log sred can// bzang ngan 'dod na 'khrul pa'i lam// 'khor ba'i skyon rnams thams cad dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i yon tan rnams// rang rig sems kyi ngang du rdzogs// de bas lhag pa med do snyam// rje btsun mi la ras pa dang bu mo yid 'phrog ma gnyis kyi zhus len mgur du gsungs pa'i skor ro//

༈ de nas bcu gsum pa ye shes sgron me bltams pa'i yon tan ni/ shel stod lha mi mgul/ me shel brag gi rked pha bong rta sga can gyi steng du rje btsun dpon slob bzhugs pa la/ ras chung pa la lta ba ci 'dug lta ba'i don du bslu ba bcu gnyis kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// 'jig rten chos kyis bslu bslu 'dra// da yang don la nyer len na// zang zing g.yeng bas bslu bslu 'dra// da ni gnyis med nyams su long*// 'khor dang g.yog gis bslu bslu 'dra// da ni gcig pur ri khrod 'grim// nor dang zas kyis bslu bslu 'dra// da ni yod tshad chos la thong*// phyi snang ba'i yul gyi bslu bslu 'dra// da ni nang gi sems la ltos// rnal 'byor rtog pas bslu bslu 'dra// da ni ye shes rjes su 'brangs// chos drang ba'i don gyis bslu bslu 'dra// da ni nges don gtan la phob// yig nag dpe chas bslu bslu 'dra// da ni snyan brgyud gdams ngag sgoms// tha snyad bshad pas bslu bslu 'dra// da ni ma bcos lhug par zhog /skye 'chi gnyis kyi bslus bslus 'dra// da ni skye med don la ltos// tha mal shes pas bslu bslu 'dra// da ni rig pa'i rtsal sbyangs gyis// sems 'dzin spros pas bslu bslu 'dra// da ni gnas lugs steng du zhog /zhes gsungs pas ras chung pas bla ma la bslu ba med/ nga la dgongs zin bsam nas lta sgom gnad du dril ba'i mgur 'di phul lo// pha bla ma dam pa snyan gson dang*// bdag rmongs pa'i blo 'di yi re mug /thugs rje'i zhags pas bzung du gsol// rtag chad gnyis kyi so mtshams su// mtha' bral lta ba stong ste thal// gnas lugs gtan la ma phebs so// bying rgod gnyis kyi so mtshams na// bde gsal sgom pa stor te thal// zhen pa log tu ma 'dod do// blang dor gnyis kyi so mtshams na// rang shugs spyod pa stor te thal/ 'khrul pa 'jig tu ma 'dod do// zol zog gnyis kyi so mtshams na// rnam dag dam tshig stor te thal// g.yo rgyu cham la ma phebs so// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi so mtshams na// rang sems sangs rgyas stor te thal// chos sku rtogs su ma 'dod do// re dogs gnyis kyi so mtshams na// 'bras bu sku bzhi stor te thal// rang ngo rang gis ma shes so// bla ma rje btsun rin po che// sngar yang thugs rjes bzung bzung bas// da yang sku drin bskyangs du gsol// zhes zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas ras chung pa/ khyod la de bas drag pa cig yod/ nga la gsang du mi rung*/ rtogs pa phul cig gsungs pas/ ras chung pas rnyed pa bdun gyi rtogs pa 'di phul lo// bla ma khyed kyi bka' drin gyis// rnyed pa bdun gyi don cig rtogs// snang ba'i nang nas stong pa rnyed// da dngos po yod snyam mi bgyid do// stong pa'i nang nas chos sku rnyed// da bya rtsol yod snyam mi bgyid do// sna tshogs nang nas gnyis med rnyed// da 'du 'bral yod snyam mi bgyid do// dkar dmar nang nas mnyam nyid rnyed// da dgag sgrub yod snyam bgyid do// sgyu lus nang nas bde chen rnyed// da sdug bsngal yod snyam mi bgyid do// kun rdzob nang na don dam rnyed/ da 'khrul pa yod snyam mi bgyid do// rang sems nang nas sangs rgyas rnyed// da 'khor ba yod snyam mi bgyid do// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ de nyams myong klong du gyur pa ni ma yin/ nyams 'di 'dra zhig dgos pa yin gsung nas mgur 'di gsungs so// snang dang stong pa dbyer med na// lta ba klong du gyur pa yin/ rmi lam dang nyin par khyad med na// sgom pa klong du gyur pa yin// bde dang sdug bsngal khyed med na/ spyod pa klong du gyur pa yin// tshe 'di dang phyi ma khyad med na/ gnas lugs klong du gyur pa yin// sems dang nam mkha' khyad med na// chos sku klong du gyur pa yin// skyid dang sdug bsngal khyad med na// gdams ngag klong du gyur pa yin// nyon mongs ye shes khyad med na// rtogs tshad klong du gyur pa yin// rang sems dang sangs rgyas khyad med na// 'bras bu klong du gyur pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ mthar thug gi skyel sa 'di las med bya ba 'khrungs tshad kyi rtogs pa/ bar do drug tu dril nas phul ba yin no// bla ma rje btsun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// snang stong gnyis kyi bar do na// stong pa'i lta ba yul na med// rnam rtog grub mtha' ngas mi shes// da lta skye med blo las 'das// 'di ldom bu bdag gi lta ba yin// shes rab can 'dzom yang gnong rgyu med// bde stong gnyis kyi bar do na// zhi gnas chu rgyun yul na med// sdug btsir sems 'dzin ngas mi byed// ma yengs gnyug ma'i ngang la 'byams// 'di ldom bu bdag gi sgom pa yin// grogs rtogs ldan 'tshengs kyang gnong rgyu med// chags chen chags bral bar do na// zag bcas bde ba yul na med// tshul 'chal log 'tsho ngas mi sgrub// da lta cir snang grogs su 'char/

'di ldom bu bdag gi spyod pa yin// grogs mkhas btsun 'dzom yang gnong rgyu med/ skyon can skyon med bar do na// rnam dag dkar ba'i sems las med// g.yo sgyu zol zog ngas mi byed// da lta rang sems dpang du btsugs// 'di ldom bu bdag gi dam tshig yin// grogs khrims ldan tshogs kyang gnong rgyu med// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bar do na// sems can sangs rgyas gnyis su med// da lta sdug bsngal bde bar shar/ re dogs 'bras bu ngas mi 'dod// 'di ldom bu bdag gi 'bras bu yin// grogs grub chen tshogs kyang gnong rgyu med// tshig dang don gyi bar do na/ mkhas pa'i tha snyad yul na med// blo ma rig the tshom ngas mi byed// da lta snang srid chos skur shar// 'di ldom bu bdag gi rtogs pa yin// grogs ston chen tshogs kyang gnong rgyu med// ces phul bas bla ma yang mnyes te/ ras chung pa khyod slob ma dam ldan yin/ khyod la dang po shes rab yod/ bar du thos bsam byas/ tha mar zab mo gsang sngags bsgoms/ da kha nang du ltos gsungs nas gsung ba sum cu mgur du gsungs so// bu rten du dkon mchog bzang ngo gsungs// grogs su dad pa brtan cig gsungs/ gdon du rnam rtog che'o gsungs// bdud du nga rgyal che'o gsungs// sdig tu skur pa che'o gsungs// lam du phrag dog gnod do gsungs// phung khrol chang gis byed do gsungs// sdig pa stobs bzhis ma bshags na// 'gro ba drug tu 'khyam mo gsungs// bsod nams 'bad nas ma bsags na// thar pa'i bde ba mi 'thob gsungs// mi dge bcu po ma spong na// mtho ris thar pa mi 'thob gsungs// stong nyid snying rje ma bsgom na// mthar thug sangs rgyas mi 'thob gsungs// tshe 'dir sangs rgyas 'thob 'dod na// rang sems yeng med ltos shig gsungs// rgyud kyi mthar thug bsdus pa'i don// rnal 'byor drug ldan sgoms shig gsungs// gdams ngag mthar thug bsdus pa'i don// gsang sngags thabs lam sgoms shig gsungs// rnyed dang bkur sti grags 'dod na// bdud kyi kha ru tshud do gsungs// bdag bstod gzhan la smod pa na// 'jigs pa'i g.yang sar lhung ngo gsungs// sems kyi glang po ma btul na// gdams ngag mkhan gyis bslu'o gsungs// bsod nams sems bskyed che'o gsungs// lta ba skye med bzang ngo gsungs// nyams len thabs lam bzang ngo gsungs// lag len rtsa rlung gyis shig gsungs// lhan skyes ngo yis zungs shig gsungs// dam pa rje dang spyod cig gsungs// mi tshe phan pa ma zad gsungs// rang sems skye med ltos shig gsungs// 'khor bar bde ba ma re gsungs// sdug bsngal skyon du ma lta gsungs// sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin no gsungs// mang du spros pa mi dgos gsungs// don de las zab pa med do gsungs// gnad de che'o bla mas gsungs// yang gsungs pa/

snod ngan gdams ngag byin pa 'phangs// nyams myong glu ru len pa 'phangs// rnal 'byor grong du 'khyams pa 'phangs// 'di ni 'phangs pa rnam gsum yin// gcig tu mkhas pa'i zhabs tog dgos// gnyis su bla ma'i gdams ngag dgos// gsum du sgom la bsran tshugs dgos// 'di ni dgos pa rnam gsum lags// dam tshig ldan pa grogs su gces// bde stong dbyer med sems la gces// 'di ni gces pa rnam gsum lags// 'phangs gsum gces gsum dgos gsum dgu// rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs/ yang gsungs pa/ 'du 'dzi spangs pa'i dben gnas med// na tsha med pa'i lus po bde// grang dro med pa'i ras gos bde// gtum mo sbar na yang yang bde// rlung 'gro 'ong me na yang yang bde// dhu tir tshud na yang yang bde// lus la bde ba phebs na bde// sems la 'od gsal shar na bde// gnyis med rtogs na yang yang bde// rlung gnyis nang du zhugs na bde// smad na gtum mo sbar te bde/ stod na byang sems phebs te bde// lus la bde ba rgyas te bde// sems la 'od gsal shar te bde// nyams myong chos nyid 'dres te bde// zhes gsungs/ yang rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba kun spangs nas// dal 'byor thob pa'i mi lus dka'// 'khor ba'i chos la yid 'byung bas// mya ngan 'das la dad pa dka'// lung rigs man ngag ldan pa yi// thugs rje ldan pa'i bla ma dka'// dad pa skyo ngal med pa yi// nyams su len pa'i slob ma dka'// 'jigs dang 'tshe ba spangs pa yi// phun sum tshogs pa'i dgon pa dka'// lta spyod mthun par gyur pa yi// bsam pa mthun pa'i grogs po dka'// na dang tsha ba spangs pa yi// bkol tu gtub pa'i phung po dka'// de rnams thams cad kun 'dzom yang*// rtse gcig pa yi bsam gtan dka'// 'di ni dka' ba'i chos brgyad de// dka' yang dka' ste spyad kyang 'tshal/ gsung skad/ yang gsungs pa lta ba rang ngo shes tsam na// gzhan snang mtshan ma rang sar grol// bdag gzhan gnyis su yod re kan// lta ba'i phyogs su gza' gtad bral// sgom pa rang so zin tsam na// dge sdig mtshan ma rang sar grol// bde sdug gnyis su yod re kan// sgom pa'i phyogs su nyams myong bral// spyod pa rang rgyud zin tsam na// dgra zun ma rang sar grol// chags sdang gnyis su yod re kan// spyod pa'i phyogs su zhen pa bral/

'bras bu rang sar grol tsam na// 'khor 'das mtshan ma rang sar grol// blang dor phyogs su re dogs bral/ yang gsungs pa/ dam pa'i brgyud pa zin pa dang*// 'khrul pa dbyings su dag pa dang*// bya ba gnas su theng ba dang*// 'di gsum ldan na rnal 'byor yin// phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la// mtshan ma'i sems 'dzin dgos rgyu med// spros bral nang nas shar ba la// sgra dang tshad ma dgos rgyu med// ces gsungs/ yang gsungs pa/ las dang skal par 'dzom pa rnams// bdud bzhi'i dgra yis mi tshugs shing*// snang ba had por grol bar nges// phyi rol yul ni rtag mi thub// rang rig rang gsal ngang la gnas// bum pa'i nang gi mar med bzhin// shes pa rang gsal tsam du gnas// tha snyad tshig tu brjod tsa na// 'od gsal bya rar ming du btags// bde stong bya bar ming du btags// rig stong bya mar ming du btags// snang stong bya bar ming du btags// btags pa tsam de tshig tu zad// tshig la blo bzhag ma nyams na// bogs dang goms stobs las byung ba// kye ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi thugs// dgongs pa'i brdar sha bcad pa la// thugs 'byung nyid kyis ma bcad na// thos pa mang pos ga la phan// zhes gsungs/ yang gsungs pa/ lta ba 'phang tshig tu shor// sems su 'dres su ma 'tshal na// sgom pa btang snyoms pa ru shor// sgom nyams skye ru ma 'tshal na// spyod pa tshul 'chos tho cor shor// zhen pa log tu ma 'tshal na// 'bras bu re dogs gnyis su shor// rtogs pa shar du ma 'tshal na// rnal 'byor pa yi shor bzhi lags// zhes gsungs/ yang gsung pa/ rnam shes rlung gi man ngag gis// mi rtog lding pos dgra gzhom 'tshal// snang ba chos sku'i man ngag gis// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dgra gzhom 'tshal// rig pa rang gsal man ngag gis// sgom pa skye med dgra gzhom 'tshal// zhes gsungs/ yang gsungs pa/ yang sgom chen kha lta ba rnams la gsungs pa/

sgom chen man ngag med pa de// shul ring mgron po lam stor 'dra// sgom chen zhen pa ma spangs pa// bya chen thod la 'khor ba 'dra// sgom chen thos pa chung ba de/ bod phrug rtod la mnan pa 'dra// sgom chen spyod pa nyes pa de// byis pa gces phrug bslab nyes 'dra// sgom chen 'tsho bas ma 'byongs pa// khyi rgan grong rgyug byed pa 'dra// zhes gsungs/ yang gsungs pa/ rje byin rlabs can la phyag 'tshal lo// lta ba'i zung 'jug blo re bde// sgom pa'i zung 'jug nyams re dga'// spyod pa'i zung 'jug dang re spros// zung 'jug gsum po ngo mtshar che// lta ba'i zung 'jug ma shes na// snang srid chos su ga la shes// sgom pa'i zung 'jug ma shes na// sdug bsngal bde ba ci la sel// spyod pa'i zung 'jug ma shes na// zhen pa rang grol ga la shes/ 'gro drug gnas pa'i sems can dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i ye shes gnyis// dbyer med ngang du ngo bo gcig /lta ba'i zung 'jug de la mdzod// sna tshogs snang ba dkar dmar dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes gnyis/ dbyer med chos skur ngo bo gcig /sgom pa'i zung 'jug de la mdzod// chu zla bzhin du kun la khyab// 'ja' tshon bzhin du ngos bzung med// mar me bzhin du kun la gsal// spyod pa'i zung 'jug de la mdzod// de phyir sems can yongs la 'dud// rje yi zung 'jug rnam gsum lags// zhes gsungs/ yang rje btsun gyis bkra shis mgur du gsungs so// rdo rje 'chang gi byin gyis rlobs// rang don mthar phyin gdul bya rnams// bde legs sa la 'god mdzad pa// te lo pa yi bkra shis shog /mi phyed dad brtson ldan pas// sdug bsngal khyad bsad bka' bzhin bsgrubs// tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ dpal nā ro pa yi bkra shis shog /dka' ba spyad pas bla ma mchog /bsten nas gdams ngag bdud rtsi 'thungs// gdong dmar yul du gsal byed sgron// sgra bsgyur lo tsā'i bkra shis shog

/brtson pa'i dam bcas ri khrod brten// mkha' 'gros byin brlabs 'od gsal shar// rnam 'phrul mdzad nas 'gro ba 'dul// rje btsun ras pa'i bkra shis shog /'od gsal skye med ngang las mi g.yo bas/ chos dbyings mkha' la chags sdang gti mug sprin// ye shes rlung gis rnam par stor gyur cing*// snang med mkha' la 'od zer rab 'phro ba'i// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ri dang sa gzhi thams cad snum zhing gshin// ljon shing 'bras bu me tog khur chen khyer// char rnams dus su lo tog skyed la mkhas// 'di ni bkra shis mtshan ma dang po'o// lo dang zla ba dus rnams thams cad bzang*// gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad dge bar gyur// phyogs rnams skyong ba thams cad dpal dang ldan// 'di ni bkra shis mtshan ma gnyis pa'o// skye bo thams cad dad pa'i sems dang ldan// byams pa ldan nas sdug la phrag dog med// lo 'dab bzhin du dge ba ngang gis 'phel// 'di ni bkra shis mtshan ma gsum pa'o// lha rnams thams cad mkha' la me tog 'thor// dri za rnams kyis snyan pa'i glu dbyangs len// rgyal chen bzhi rnams rin chen char du 'bebs// 'di ni bkra shis mtshan ma bzhi pa'o// u dum wa ra'i me tog 'jig rten 'byon// byang chub ljon shing rin chen me tog rgyas// gsal ba'i 'od kyis 'jig rten kun tu khyab// 'di ni 'jig rten bkra shis mtshan ma lnga pa'o// 'jig rten du ni chos rje bla ma byon// srid pa gsum la rgyal bar dam bca' mdzad// 'gro ba'i ded dpon nyid du zhal gyis bzhes// 'di ni bkra shis mtshan ma drug pa'o// bshes gnyen dam pa byang chub shing drung bzhugs// sangs rgyas yod tan ma lus mngon du gyur// bsam pa ji bzhin dam chos bdud rtsi 'gyed// 'di ni bkra shis mtshan ma bdun pa'o// bkra shis mtshan ma 'di bdun brjod pa yi// skye bo thams cad tshe ring nad med dang*// dpal dang 'byor pa shin tu rgyas pa dang*// sangs rgyas yon tan ma lus thob par shog

/ces gsungs so// de thams cad brag steng rta sgo la sogs pa'i skor ro// ༈ de nas rje btsun yab sras dom lung bya ba'i brag gseb cig tu byon nas bzhugs pa la/ ras chung pas/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal bskor ba byas te/ rje btsun chen po nyid lho brag pa chen po'i spyan sngar byon pa la/ gdams ngag ji lta bu zhus/ khong gis kyang ji ltar gnang*/ bdag la gsung bar zhu zhus pa/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas/ spros med chos sku'i nam mkha' la// 'gags med thugs rjes sprin bsdus te// lus can skyabs gyur 'gro ba'i mgon// rje sku drin can skyabs su mchi// dpal dri ma med pa'i zhing khams su// mi nga po zer ba mtha' yas kyang*// yul rgya gar dbus na sgra che ba// 'od nyi zla lta bur gsal ba de/ rje nā ro mai tri rnam gnyis lags/ pha grub thob gnyis kyi thugs kyi sras// dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyi bcud bsdus pa// mtshan lho brag mar pa zhes su grags// gnas nyis shu rtsa ba'i ngo bo gcig /yon tan gter chen 'byung ba'i sa// mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dben gnas su// mtshan snyan pa'i 'brug sgra kun nas chems// sgra de thos kho bo ma bzod de// slar 'bad rtsol drag po'i spyan sngar phyin// sku mthong bas ba spu gting nas g.yos/ khong tshe sngon gyi bla ma yin par nges// gsung thos pa tsam gyis sdig sgrib zad// spyir ka chen bzhi la khung phyung nas// ltas ngan g.yang du blangs nas kyang*// mtshon ngar ma lta bu'i rno bzhin du// lam srid pa gsum po gcod byed cing*/ tshe gcig byang chub 'grub pa cig /pha sangs rgyas de la gda'o zer// de dman pa bdag la gnang 'tshal zhus// pha sangs rgyas de yi zhal nas kyang*// shāka thub bstan pa rgud la nye// snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs rag /tshe thung nad med longs spyod dbul// mi thar pa sgrub pa nyin skar tsam// khyod shes bya'i gshis la mi 'chor zhing*/

mi nga la gdams ngag yod do gsungs// gser zhun ma lta bu'i gdams ngag bstan/ khyod le lo lto phyir ma 'brang bar// rtse gcig sgrub pa byas pa na// rig pa mtha' sangs nyams myong dang*// don 'bad rtsol sgom pa'i ting 'dzin dang*// sems gzhi rtsa chod pa'i rtogs pa gsum/ dus gcig mnyam pa nyid du 'ong*// gnad de la 'dris shing 'jag gyur pas// 'gyur med brtan por dag go gsungs// mi ngas zer gcig pur byed pa na// bu dpa' bo khrom shog cig 'ong ngo gsungs// ma nged la 'dris shing zhe sdang tshig 'di yod// khyod da rung nyon cig skal ldan bu// bya lo'i mchod rdzas bzhin rnying pas// bzhin legs kyang nga rgyal ma che bar// snying rus rdo la yi ge bris// zhi gnas rdengs pa'i gnyid ma log /gzer gsum rig pa gso yis thob// ye shes me stag chu ris la// dran pa'i me gsos myur du rnon// 'khor ba'i btson ra sgrol 'dod cing*// myang ngan 'das par mngon dga' na// mi ngas zer ma nyan ci byed ltos/ lar ngas zer nyon la nga phyir 'brong*// tshe 'di la ma dga' phyi ma som// snying nas grub pa bgyis tsam na// dus gsum sangs rgyas gting nas mnyes// rje lo tsā chen po'i sku drin 'khor// mi nga yang dga' zhing brod par 'ong*// tshe 'di bas phyi ma shin tu bde// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas bla ma lags/ pha yul spangs nas chos phyed rdzogs zer ba cig 'dug pa e bden zhus pas/ de la nges pa mi 'dug /chos spyod la de skad zer lo zer yang pha yul ji ltar spangs la rag las te gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rigs kyi bdag po'i ngo bo nyid// spyi gtsug bde chen pho brang nas// skyon gyi ma gos bla ma de// yon tan tshogs kyis rab brgyan te// sku lta bas mi ngom rje la bstod// pha yul spangs pa'i mi lus yang*// ngo srung lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos// grags dang snyan pa che na dka'// der yang 'jig rten chos kyi slebs// zas bkur sti spangs pa'i sprang zas de// tshogs gsog lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos// de yang zhim la mngar la dga'// der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb// gos ther phrug spangs pa'i dug po yang*// tshem drubs lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos// de yang dro la yang na dga'// der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb// mkhar khyim spangs pa'i sa phug yang*// thig tshags lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos// de yang btsan la rub na dga'// der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb// zhing chen spangs pa'i zhing chung yang*// so nam lugs dang tshul bzhin dgos// lo thog bzang la mang na dga'// der yang 'jig rten chos kyis sleb// 'khor ba'i chos nyid gzhi bral de// brtags na ngos bzung med pa la// rtogs na mya ngan 'das pa yin// thams cad stong pa chos nyid la// rnal 'byor rtogs pas ma 'dzin cig

/ces gsungs pas ras chung pas/ lags de la go rgyu bzang po cig byung*/ chos spyi la bshad pa de la go rgyu ye nas ma byung zin zhus pas/ 'o bu de bzhin rang yin/ don dang tshig 'brel pa dka' mo rang yod/ nges shes sems la ma skyes na/ kha la lab rgyu mang yang 'chal gtam yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// chos snying rus nus par thugs rjes zungs// phyi rabs gang zag thams cad nga la nyon// yon tan thams cad rab ldan pa'i/ dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma de// chos sku rang la yid ches dgos// blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung pa// zhal nas gsungs pa'i gdams ngag la// dug lnga bcom pa'i sman mchog de// bdud rtsi rang du yid ches dgos// blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung pa// bla ma'i mdzad spyod rnam thar la// mngon spyod las rnams bsgrub pa la// sprul sku ngang du yid ches dgos// blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung pa// sems mi 'gyu dgu 'gyu'i dran rtog 'di// sems kyang skye med rtsa ba bral// dran pa yengs med du yid ches dgos// blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung pa// nyon mongs dug mtsho'i kha rlangs de// shing thag me yis bsregs pa bzhin/ nyon mongs 'ching med du yid ches dgos// blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung pa// 'dod khams lha yi bde ba yang*// nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog bzhin// 'khor bar skyid med yid ches dgos// blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung pa// mi rtag nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra// 'bab chu dang ni spos rgya bzhin// tshe 'di la longs med yid ches dgos/ blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung pa// snying gtam du rang gzhan thams cad 'chi/ cis kyang mi sdod 'chi ba la// 'chi chos bsgrub pas yid ches dgos// blo la nges shes chud dam ras chung pa// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa dang 'bri sgom gnyis snang ba mtho ling nge song nas chos gtam byas te/

ras chung pas/ nā ro pas bsgoms pa'i steng nas lta ba rtogs pas bzhed pa legs zer/ 'bri sgom gling kha bas me tri pa'i lta ba'i steng nas bsgoms pas rtogs par bzhed pa legs zer nas rtsod pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyed rang gnyis nga yi glu 'di la nyon la da gzod rtsod cig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o na skyid do de ring dga'// drin chen gyi bla ma gtsug na bzhugs// 'bral med kyi rtogs pa rgyud la skyes// khyod gcod khams can gyi ston sgom gnyis// nyer len nang nas ma 'phrod na// ku co 'debs pa nga rgyal yin/ lar sgro 'dogs nang nas chod pa la// mtha' bral lta ba mi zer ram/ nyams myong dang 'brel pa rgyan du che// bde stong nyams myong skyes pa la// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag mi zer ram// dbang bzhi dang 'brel pa rgyan du che// stong nyid kyi gsal rig phyed pa la// sa lam gyi rim pa mi zer ram// lam rtags dang 'brel pa rgyan du che// rang sems zad sar skyel ba la// tshe gcig gi sangs rgyas mi zer ram// sku bzhi dang 'brel pa rgyan du che// lung rigs dang man ngag ldan pa la// rgyud ldan gyi bla ma yin nam zer// thugs rje dang 'brel pa rgyan du che// dad ldan snying rje che ba la// snod ldan gyi slob la mi zer ram// mos gus dang 'brel pa rgyan du che// lar sems thag lta bas gcod pa yin// nyams su sgom pas len pa yin// spyod pas mtha' ru 'don pa yin// grogs su gdams ngag 'khyer ba yin// mngon du sku bzhi byed pa yin// 'bras bu sems su 'dod pa yin// thams cad gcig tu rtsi ba yin// zhes gsungs pas khong gnyis rang zhi la song ste/ chos mang po shes pas ci la phan bla ma'i mgur re re'i snang ba ling ling 'gyur zhing 'dug zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ngas byas pas phan na legs te ngas ni da rung sgom rang 'dod gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// lung rigs rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa la// lta ba'i mdo 'gag ma nor cig

/brgya la mdo 'gag nor ba na// sgom chen slob gnyer dran dogs yod// nyams zang zing lang ling mang ba na/ sgom chen the tshom ma za zhig /brgya la the tshom zos pa na// nyams la 'dre rdung byed nyes yod// snying rus sdug bsran 'bad dus su// sdig slong na tsha 'ong nyen yod// brgya la na tsha byung ba na// log pa'i rim gro byed nyen yod// 'bras bu sangs rgyas thob 'dod na// nyams lang ling mtho dman mang po yongs// de la rang sor ma bzhag na// spang blang byas pas sgom chen 'khrul// bla ma'i ngo sprod ma mchis pa'i/ sgom lo byas kyang don mi rtogs// mang po bshad kyang go rgyu med// man ngag gnad 'gag zin pa gyis// mi med lung pa stong pa na// mi la ras pa nyams myong skyong*// mi la sgom bsran ma chung cig /brgya la sgom bsran chung ba na// sems le lo'i 'dam du bying nyen yod// 'dir kha bshad chos gtam ma rtsod par// sems sgom 'dod yeng ba med par brtson// zhes gsungs so// yang rang sems gros 'debs kyi mgur 'di gsungs pa/ na mo gu ru/ dben pa'i ri khrod mi 'grim nas// da grong yul g.yang chags cig byed pa// srad ma can khyod la dgos pa lags so// da rung rje gong ma'i mdzad spyod ma mthong bar 'dug pa// da mno bsam cig thong la snying rus shig bskyed dang*// ras gos rkyang pa tsam res mi gon pa ni// da rung snal ma'i dug po mi 'tshem pa// le lo can khyod la dgos pa cig lags so// da rung lus la gtum mo me sbar bar 'dug pa/ da mno bsam cig thong la snying rus shig bskyed dang*// zas su ting 'dzin mi gsol bar ni// da rung zhim bcu mngar dgu 'dod pa// zhim lto can khyod la dgos pa cig lags so// da rung zas ni sred pa ma spangs par 'dug pa// da mno bsam cig thong la snying rus shig bskyed dang*// sprang po'i dman sa cig mi 'dzin par ni// da rung gzhan gyi phye gtor 'gam pa// tshul 'chos can khyod la dgos pa lags so// da mno bsam zhig thong la snying rus shig bskyed dang*// zhen med kyi ldom bu mi byed par ni// da rung rnyed pa bkur sti 'tshol ba/

log sred can khyed la dgos pa cig lags so// da rung zhen pa nang nas ma log par 'dug pa// da mno bsam zhig thong la snying rus zhig bskyed dang*// skye med nyams su mi len par ni// da rung mthun 'jug gi pho zo cig bskyed par// sgrig ka can khyod la dgos pa cig lags so// da rung sngar gyi spyod pa ma 'gyur bar 'dug pa// da mno bsam zhig thong la snying rus shig bskyed dang*// gnyen med bshes med kyi yul du mi 'khyams par ni// da rung sngar 'dris kyi yul du 'dug pa/ gdung sems can khyod la dgos pa cig lags so// da rung dgra gnyen ma shes par 'dug pa// da mno bsam zhig thong la snying rus shig bskyed dang*// brjed med kyi don la mi lta bar ni// da rung yig nag gi dpe cha cig gsog pa// zin bris can khyod la dgos pa cig lags so// da rung snang ba dpe char ma shar bar 'dug pa// da mno bsam zhig thong la snying rus shig bskyed dang*// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad dom lung brag gseb kyi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun brin gyi spro bde phug bya ba na bzhugs dus/ slob ma ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug yon bdag 'ga' byung nas nged tsho'i nyams len gang la byed zhus pa'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// sems las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas med// lam rtsa dang rlung las myur ba med// nyams bde stong gnyis las bzang ba med// lha dkon mtshog gsum las gnyan pa med// drin bla ma rje las che ba med// de 'gro ba kun gyi spyi bor bkur// ma nor lam sna myur du 'dren// yid ches drod rtags 'bral ba med// de ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin// drod tshad nang nas shar ba yin// re dogs gnyis po mi gda' na// rang gi sems thag chod pa yin// the tshom yid gnyis mi gda' na// brgyud pa'i gdams pa theb pa yin// snang srid sgyu mar 'byongs pa yin// snang ba byin gyis rlobs pa yin// sems can snying rjes zin pa yin// byams pa rgyud la skyes pa yin// bla ma sangs rgyas su shes pa yin// byin rlabs lag bcang du thag pa yin// zur sdebs tshig rkang gcod pa yin// go bas bsam na chos su 'dug

/ma go stong 'gyur dbyangs su mthong*// zhes gsus te gdams ngag gnang nas bsgom du bcug pas/ slob ma de rnams la nyams rtogs pa skyes nas khong rnams na re/ bla ma'i bzhugs gnas gang du yod// dngos grub dang thugs dam gang bzang*// bde skyid dang spro ba ji lta bu skyes// zhes zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// nga yi brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen yin// yang mes te lo bzang po yin// mes po nā ro paṇa chen yin// pha rgan mar pa lo tswa yin// nga rang mi la ras pa yin// gdams ngag 'od gsal rgyun chags yin/ de ni yin pa rnam drug yin// drug pa 'di dang ma bral na// mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// glu de yang bde ste 'di yang bde// da lan mi la'i rdzun drug 'chad/ gnas chu shing 'dzom pa'i dgon pa na// 'khor nye gnas zer ba rdzun du gda'// za rogs ngan pa dgos rgyu med// gtam ngan mang po rna ba tsha// lus la gtum mo 'bar tsa na/ ther phrug mang po rdzun du gda'// dug hrul khres po bya rgyu med// shi dus grogs mchod zhen pa med// sgom ting 'dzin rang sa zin tsam na/ sha chang zhim lto rdzun du gda'/ bral brel mang pos snang ba spun// nyal dus yi mug dge sbyor 'khrugs// zhen pa nang nas log tsa na// nor rdzas mang po rdzun du gda'// khe tshong mang po'i dgos pa med// ces kyang sdig pa'i rnam smin 'go /snying rus sgom bsran bskyed dus su// 'khor slob zer ba rdzun du gda'// mjal 'phrad mang pos dgos pa med// cis kyang dge sbyor 'chag pa yin// mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud bsgom dus na// chos bshad mang po rdzun du gda'// bshad pa mang po'i dgos pa med// cis kyang nga rgyal sus kyang 'dod/ rdzun drug man ngag rdo rje'i mgur// shes par gyis la go ba long*// zhes gsungs pas/ yang khong rnams kyis gnas gang spro dang thugs dam gang 'phel zhig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/

da res pha rgan gyi rjes su slob dgos pas/ nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// mi la mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchi// lar yang bde ste 'di yang bde// nga mi la ras pa'i che drug 'chad// mi la'i che drug 'chad tsam na/ bla ma dkon mchog bka' drin che// yi dam mkha' 'gro byin rlabs che// chos skyong mgon po mthu rtsal che// snyan brgyud gdams ngag zab tig che// mi la ras pa sgom bsran che// grwa dang bu slon dad pa che// mi la'i che drug 'di dang ma bral na// mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// glu de yang bde ste 'di yang bde// da res mi la'i bde drug 'chad// mi med lung par snang ba bde// bla ma'i gdams ngag sems la bde/ 'bol chung dron mo 'og na bde// dben khang bde mo steng na bde// 'grang ltogs ran pa'i sgyu lus bde// 'khrul 'khor lus kyi bca' thabs bde// mi la bde drug 'di dang ma bral na// mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// glu de yang bde ste 'di yang bde/ da res mi la'i 'dus drug 'chad// mi la'i 'dus drug 'chad tsam na// rtsa rlung dbu ma'i nang du 'dus// nyin par mi yi tshogs rnams 'dus// byang sems 'khor lo srog la 'dus// nub mo mkha' 'gro tshogs su 'dus// rang sems snying rje'i yul du 'dus// nang nub zas nor tshogs su 'dus// mi la 'dus drug 'di dang ma bral na// mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// glu de yang bde ste 'di yang bde// da res mi la'i rdzong drug 'chad// mi la'i rdzong drug 'chad tsam na// rag ma byang chub sgrub pa'i rdzong*// spo ri spo mtho nam mkha' rdzong*// brag dmar mchong gling khyung gi rdzong*// mon gyi skyid phug nyi ma rdzong*// ka te'i shel phug chu shing rdzong*// brag dkar rta so dbu ma'i rdzong*// mi la rdzong drug 'di dang ma bra la na// mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// glu de yang bde ste 'di yang bde// da res mi la'i rdzong drug 'chad/

mi la'i rdzong drug 'chad tsa na// phyag rgya chen po lta ba'i rdzong*// nā ro chos drug sgom pa'i rdzong*// thabs lam zab mo spyod pa'i rdzong*/ sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu'i rdzong*// mi la ras pa dbyangs kyi rdzong*// brag dkar spo mtho gnas kyi rdzong*// mi la rdzong drug 'di dang ma bral na// mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// glu de yang bde ste 'di yang bde// da res mi la'i bzang drug 'chad tsam na// phyag rgya chen po lta ba bzang*// nā ro chos drug sgom pa bzang*// thabs lam zab mo spyod pa bzang*// sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu bzang*// bka' brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs bzang*// mi la'i bzang drug 'di dang ma bral na// mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// khyed 'dir bzhugs yon bdag bu slob rnams/ phan pa'i chos la byed mkhan med// gnod pa'i sdig la hab thob byed// sdug bsngal sdig pa'i 'bras bu yin// sdug pa rang gis byas pa yin// bde ba dge ba'i 'bras bu yin// bde skyid rang gi rang la gyis// zhal yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal// zhes gsungs so// yang gsungs pa// dus gsum sangs rgyas rtsa ba de// brgyud ldan bla ma rin chen yin// dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba la// mos gus mi byed snying med po// dal 'byor bde ldan lus po 'di// gtan gyi so nam mi byed par// lus rdza chag bzhin du bor ba la// rtag tu re ba'i snying med po// dam chos 'di kun spyi nor la// mi dad ldan kun so so rang rang gis// 'dod mos bgo bsha' byed tsam na/ skal pa mi len snying med po// dam chos 'di kun gyi spyi nor la// mi dad ldan kun so so rang rang gis// 'di mos bgo bsha' byed tsam na// skal pa mi len snying med po// yi dam lha yi snying po la// ma yengs thun bzhir mi zla bar// zad pa med pa'i long gtam gyis// dus 'da' bar byed pa'i snying med po// rang sems yid bzhin nor bu 'di// 'bral med sku gsum du mi bsgom par// ri dwags smig rgyu snyegs pa bzhin// tshig phyir 'brang ba'i snying med po// zang zing zas nor bsags pa de// rang gzhan don du mi gtong bar/

sngar 'dris ser sna gar phyin gyis// sbyin mi phod pa'i snying med po// tshe yongs su zad pa'i lhag ma la// long med brtson 'grus mi rtsom par/ mgu ba med pa'i phan sems kyis// tshe long med du skyel ba'i snying med po// zhes gsungs pas der bzhugs pa thams cad snang ba 'gyur zhing chos la spro bar gyur to// de thams cad brag dkar rta so'i skor ro// ༈ de nas thong la'i phar ngos na dam pa rgya gar/ tshur ngos na mi la ras pa bzhugs/ gcig las gcig mjal spro bas/ dam pa la yi phar ngos nas yar byon/ rje btsun tshur ngos nas yar byon/ gcig gi gcig 'byon pa ni mkhyen te/ mi las ngas sprul pa zhig byas nas e shes yin dgongs nas/ la kha cig na shing srad ma'i phung po gcig tu sprul nas bzhugs tsa/ dam pas shing de la rdog sub cig byas nas/ khyod rnal 'byor pa'i grub rtags kyang khyi lud gsog gi me tog 'di rang yin zer nas byon song bas/ mi las dam pa'i bal thul gyi mthu ba nas bzung bas/ dam pas/ mi la zer le khyod mkha' 'gro'i srog snying glur blangs/ bon du gyer bas mkha' 'gro 'khrugs nas/ da lta sha za'i mkha' 'gro mas khyod kyi don snying dmar tse re re khyer byung ba dang 'phrad/ da zhag bdun nas khyed 'chi gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so// sems mtha' bral chen po'i seng chen la// blo ya nga med pa'i g.yu ral rgyas// 'khyags zhu med pa'i gangs la nyal// rnal 'byor lta ba mkhan de shi na yang shi// shi na yang rang dga' bde ba'i rgyu// shi na rnal 'byor shin tu skyid// ang nge dam pa rje btsun pa// sems mi g.yo rgyud kyi sha pho la// nyams du ma ro gcig gi ru bcu rgyas// bde gsal chen po'i spang la nal// rnal 'byor sgom pa mkhan de shi na'ang shi// shi na yang dga' bde ba'i rgyu// shi na rnal 'byor shin tu skyid// a nge dam pa rje btsun pa// rang don lhur len stag mo la// gzhan don lhur len ri mo rgyas// bde gsal chen po'i nags la nyal// rnal 'byor spyod pa mkhan de shi na'ang shi// shi na'ang rang dga' bde ba'i rgyu// shi na rnal 'byor shin tu skyid// ang nge dam pa rje btsun pa// dge bcu 'bral med kyi nya mo la// sdig bcus ma gos gser mig 'khyil// rgyun chad med par chu bo'i gzhung la 'phyo// rnal 'byor dam tshig can de shi na'ang skyid// shi na'ang rang dga' bde ba'i rgyu// shi na'ang rnal 'byor shin tu skyid// ang nge dam pa rje btsun pa/

phyi snang ba dkar dmar gyi shog bu la// nang rig pa sems kyi yi ge bri// 'gyur med brtan por nyams su blangs// rnal 'byor dam chos mkhan de shi na'ang shi// shi na'ang rang dga' bde ba'i rgyu// shi na rnal 'byor shin tu skyid// ang nge dam pa rje btsun pa/ sems 'gyu ba dang sangs kyi khyung chen la// blo re dogs med pa'i gshog drug rgyas/ 'dus ma byas nam mkha'i dbyings su 'phur// rnal 'byor 'bras bu mkhan de shi na'ang shi// shi na'ang rang dga' bde ba'i rgyu// shi na rnal 'byor shin tu skyid// ang nge dam pa rje btsun pa// rgyud la theb pa'i gdams ngag la// 'phel 'grib med pa'i snang ba rgyas// de lta bu yi rtogs pa 'khrungs// gdams ngag mkhan de shi na'ang bde/ shi na yang rang dga' bde ba'i rgyu// shi na rnal 'byor shin tu skyid// ang nge dam pa rje btsun pa// nga rbab tu 'dril bas bde sar chags// chu yis khyer bas skam sar thon/ rlung gis khyer bas dgung dang mnyam// mgo bo gtum pas rgyang mig gsal// kha rje log pas zas dang 'phrad// dngos grub mkhan de shi na'ang bde// shi na yang rang dga' bde ba'i rgyu// shi na rnal 'byor shin tu skyid// ang nge dam pa rje btsun pa// zhes shi ba bde drug gi mgur 'di phul bas/ dam pa'i zhal nas/ khyed rnal 'byor pa'i nyams la rgya mtsho la snag tsha byas/ rtsi shing la myu gu byas/ yul dang thel la shog bu byas nas/ sems can thams cad bri mkhan byas kyang bri ba dang brjod pas mi lang*/ khyod skye 'chi gnyis la mi 'jigs pa thag chod pa cig dgos pa yin gsungs pas/ de'i lan du thag chod drug gi mgur 'di gsungs so// lta ba skye med kyi ngang la 'chi med 'phyo// skye 'chi'i mtshan ma rang sar grol// lta ba thag chod blo re bde// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// sgom med ngang la yeng med 'phyo// bying rgod kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// sgom pa'i thag chod blo re bde// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// spyod pa 'gags med ngang la shugs 'phyung 'phyo// tshul 'chos kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// spyod pa'i thag chod blo re bde// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// dbang bskur med ngang la thob med 'phyo// lha sku'i mtshan ma rang sar grol// dbang bskur gyi thag chod blo re bde// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// dam tshig bsrung med ngang la nyams med 'phro// srung sdom gyi mtshan ma rang sar grol// dam tshig thag chod blo re bde// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'/

'bras bu re med ngang la dogs med 'phyo// re dogs kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol/ 'bras bu'i thag chod blo re bde// sems ma bcos pa 'di bde mor gda'// zhes gsungs pas dam pa mnyes te/ bod kyi rnal 'byor pa la thag chod mo 'dug gsungs pas/ rje btsun gyis zhus pa/ pha dam pa khyed la dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed bya ba/ kha nang du log nas sems la bltas pas/ sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa cig chod du rtogs pa'i gdams ngag zab mo yod pa de bdag la gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ pha dam pa'i zhal nas mgur 'di gsungs so// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di// gdon gnod sbyin pho 'dus tsam na// brtul zhugs 'khrul 'khor bca' ba yin// lus la na tsha byung tsam na// dbyings rig gcig tu bsre ba yin// rnam rtog phra mo skyes tsam na// nyon mongs 'bur 'joms byed pa yin// gcig pur lkog tu nyal tsam na// rig pa ljen par 'jog pa yin// mang po'i nang du sdod tsam na// gang shar rang ngo lta ba yin// bying ba phaṭa kyis bsring ba yin// 'phro na rtsa ba gcod pa yin// rgod na dbyings su 'jog pa yin// shes pa yul phyir 'phreng tsam na// de nyid don la lta ba yin// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di// ltas ngan byung na g.yang du len// rnam rtog ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// na tsha byung na bogs su 'don// 'byung bzhi ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// 'chi ba byung na lam du slong*// 'chi bdag ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed 'di// dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin/ rdo rje 'chang gi gsang tshig yin// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i srog snying yin// rgyud sde bzhi yi gdams pa yin// snyan brgyud gnad kyi man ngag yin// man ngag thabs kyi lde'u mig yin// dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed lags// zhes gsungs nas rtsa 'jag gi steng du skyil krung bcas nas bzhugs pa dang*/

rje btsun yang rtswa 'jag ma gcig tshal ba brgyad du btang ba cig gi steng du skyil krung bcas nas bzhugs pas/ dam pa sangs rgyas ngo mtshar skyes nas spyan zim me/ dbu zil pa phrom me song 'dug pas/ rje btsun la khyed ci mdzad pa yin zhus pas/ dam pa'i zhal nas rnal 'byor pa khyed ci mdzad pa ngo mtshar ba'i gtam snyan rgya gar du skyel song bas/ rgya gar du mkha' 'gro ma re res kyang tshogs kyi dga' ston re re byed par yod/ bod la rnal 'byor pa khyed 'dra ba 'ong ba ang*/ nga la yang khyed mi dgos/ khyed la yang nga mi dgos par 'dug gsungs nas byon song ngo*// yang dus re zhig gi tshe na rje btsun dang dam pa rin po che gnyis thong la na mjal bas/ rje btsun gyis smyo brdzu mdzad pas/ dam pas brin pa'i glu mkhan smyos sam gsungs pas/ lan du mgur gsungs pa/ brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen smyo// pha smyo bu smyo mes po smyo// yang mes te lo bzang po smyo// chos phyag rgya chen po'i gdon gyis brlabs// mes po nā ro paṇa chen smyo// chos rig pa brtul zhugs kyi gdon gyis brlabs// pha rgan mar pa lo tsā smyo// chos rgyud sde bzhi yi gdon gyis brlabs// nga rang mi la ras pa smyo// chos rlung sems gnyis kyi gdon gyis brlabs/ lhun grub 'gyur med kyi lta ba smyo// stong gsal 'dzin med kyi sgom pa smyo// shugs 'byung 'gags med kyi spyod pa smyo// rang sems zag med kyi dam tshig smyo// sku gsum lhun grub 'bras bu smyo// gdams pa nā ro chos drug smyo// gsungs pas/ smyo lugs dag dga' mo yin/ gdon lugs shod gsungs pas/ yang rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ nga smyo nas mi chog 'dre cig gdon// pha gdon bla ma'i gdams ngag gdon// mo gdon ḍā ki'i byin rlabs gdon// bdud du lhag mthong ye shes gnas// blo bde'i 'gong po snying la gnas// rtogs pa'i 'dre mo rgyun par gnas// rgyab brten dkon mchog gsum gyis byas/

gsungs pas/ gdon lugs dga' mo yin/ na lugs shod gsungs pas/ nga stod du phyag chen gyi tshad pas na// smad du chos nyid kyi grang bas na/ rgyab na ye shes rlung dmar 'bud// chos nyid bde chen gyi byang khog rgyas// snying la dam chos chu rgyun 'brub// sems la 'od gsal rgyun par gnas// lus la gtum mo me ltar 'bar// kha nas gdams ngag khrag ltar skyugs/ snying rlung byams dang snying rje zhugs// nad 'tsho bar dka' ba'i rtogs pa zhugs/ gsungs pas// na lugs dga' mo yin/ 'chi lugs shod gsungs pas/ yang gsungs pa/ da na yang mi chog 'chi yang 'chi// don dam ngang du kun rdzob 'chi// chos sku'i ngang du rnam rtog 'chi// myang 'das kyi ngang du 'khor ba 'chi// lta ba'i ngang du phyogs ris 'chi// sgom pa'i ngang du bying rgod 'chi// spyod pa'i ngang du tshul 'chos 'chi// 'bras bu'i ngang du re dogs 'chi/ lhag mthong ngang du zhi gnas 'chi// mnyam bzhag gi ngang du rjes thob 'chi// sku gsum ngang du rnal 'byor 'chi/ gsungs pas/ 'chi lugs dga' mo yin/ ro legs po cig 'ong ba 'di sus skyel gsung pas/ yang gsungs pa/ nga rnal 'byor 'chi ba'i nang pa der// las ngan bza' rogs ma lags pa'i// rig pa'i khye'u chung yar bzhengs la// nga rnal 'byor shi ba'i ro de khur// ras gos rkyang gcig ma lags pa'i// phyi snang ba khra bo'i ras la dril// rtsā thag dres ma ma lags pa'i// rtsa dbu ma ro rkyang gi thag pas dril/ rtsa phran brgyad cu'i dra bar bcug /shid skyog skas khri ma lags pa'i/ theg pa chen po'i khri la theg /sa lam skya mo ma lags pa'i// byang chub rgyud lam dkar po drongs// gangs ri dang g.ya' ri ma lags pa'i// chos nyid chen po'i ri la skyol// dur khrod wa spyang ma lags pa'i// thabs shes gnyis med ce spyang rol// sha de gnyis su med par zos// khrag de rdzogs pa chen por 'thung*// ro de bde ba chen pos myong*// rus pa'i tshogs drug lhug par zhog

/rtsis mkhan mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gyis// ro sna bka' brgyud bla mas drongs// kun tu bzang po'i ri kha la// rdo rje 'chang gi dur sar skyol// phyir mi ldog pa'i dur gcig thob// dus gtan gyi so nam zin du chug /ces gsungs pas/ dam pas de'i len du za ba mo bzhi mgur du gsungs nas dam pa yar gshegs par gda'/ de thams cad thong la'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun gangs ti se la 'gro gsungs nas dpon g.yog byon nas/ glo bo'i mtsho bar du sleb tsam na/ sgom ma cig na brdzu byas nas 'gror ma nyan pas 'gros chag ste dbyar de glo bo'i kha stod du chos gsungs zhing bzhugs/ nam zla ston ser du song nas mar log nas byon pas/ yul pa'i nya ma pho mo rnams kyis byon skyems drangs nas/ ko ra la thog tu bskyal/ phyag 'tshal bskor ba bya nas bdag cag rnams dang phyin chad e mjal nges pa med pas/ gdams ngag zhig gsungs par zhu zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed 'dir bzhugs kyi yon bdag pho mo rnams// mi nga dang nga ste nga gcig yin// nga dang bod kyi rnal 'byor yin/ nga dang mi la ras pa yin// nga thos chung gdams ngag che ba yin// sems chung snying rus che ba yin// gnyid chung sgom bsran che ba yin// gcig shes kun la mkhas pa yin// kun shes gcig tu go ba yin// yang dag don la mkhas pa yin// mal chung brkyang bskum bde ba yin// gos srab lus po dro ba yin// zas chung lto ba 'grangs pa yin// nga sgom chen kun gyi gtugs sa yin// dad pa can gyi 'tshogs sa yin// skye 'chi'i 'jigs pa'i 'khrid sa yin// nga yul la phyogs ris med pa yin// gnas la nges pa med pa yin// spyod pa gza' gtad med pa yin// rdzas la 'dzin chags med pa yin// zas la rme gtsang med pa yin// nyon mongs zug rngu chung ba yin// chog shes 'dod pa chung ba yin// gzung 'dzin chags zhen chung ba yin// myang 'das sa bdun bar chad yin// rgan rgon rnams kyi skyo rogs yin// byis pa rnams kyi rtse rogs yin// nga rnal 'byor rgyal khams yongs su 'grims// khyed lha mi sku khams ci bder bzhugs// zhes gsungs pas/

yang khong rnams na re/ rje btsun khyed kyi mdzad spyod de ltar lags na/ nged rnams ji ltar bgyi zhus pas/ yang 'di gsungs so// pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed nya skyes 'brog gi lha mi rnams// nan tan lha chos bgyid mi bgyid// dad pa snying nas skyes ma skyes// snying nas dam chos bgyid snyam na/ dad pa 'gyur ldog mi bdog na// dpe de kun kun rdzob 'khor mo'i mtshon// don de rang gi sems la dris// phyi snang ba dpe ru bsten mi bsten// gser lo thang dkar de dang gcig /g.yu lo me tog de dang gnyis/ phu yi she'u chung de dang gsum// mda' yi 'bras drug de dang bzhi// za 'og dri bse de dang lnga// nor bu rin chen de dang drug /tshes gsum zla ba de dang bdun// mi'u rin chen de dang brgyad// sngon chad glu la skyol ma myong*/ glu de phyir la ma log na// tshig de don gyi brda mi 'byor// tshig de don la sbyor tsam na// gser lo thang dkar dgung la yal// des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon/ de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'// don de la som la lha chos mdzod// g.yu lo me tog sad kyis khyer// des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon// de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'// don de la som la lha chos mdzod// phu yi she'u chung mda' yi bsad// des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe zhig mtshon// de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'// don de la som la lha chos mdzod// mda' yi 'bras drug zor bas brngas// des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon// de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'// don de la som la lha chos mdzod/ za 'og dri bse bzong gis dras// des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon// de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'// don de la som la lha chos mdzod// nor bu rin chen rnyed nas stor// des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon// de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'// don de la sems shing lha chos mdzod// tshes gsum zla ba shar nas 'grib// des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon// don de la som la lha chos mdzod// mi'u rin chen skye nas 'chi// des kyang sgyu ma'i dpe cig mtshon// de yang mi rtag tshul du gda'// don de la sems shing lha chos mdzod// ngo mtshar can gyi dpe brgyad po// khyed skyel mi rnams kyis 'gro chos mdzod// lar byas pa'i las la zin pa med// gar dgar zhog la lha chos mdzod// longs spyod snyam pa mi mdzad 'tshal// tshod yod las la mi tshe zad// ces mi rtag dpe brgyad kyi mgur de gsungs pas/

thams cad dad pa skyes nas phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar 'tshal/ mchi ma lud par byung bas de rnams kyi nang nas skyes pa gzhon pa gsum/ nged bla ma'i chag phyir khrid par zhu zer ba la yang mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phan sems med pa'i chos pa yi// mi nag 'dul bar dka' bar gda'// chos rgyud la ma skyes ston pa des// sku bsod re ba dka' bar gda'// snying rus med pa'i sgom chen la// drod rtags skye ba dka' bar gda'// 'dul khrims med pa'i rab byung la// bsnyen bkur zhabs tog dka' bar gda'// dam tshig med pa'i sngags pa la// sku mthu byin rlabs dka' bar gda'// ser snas bcings pa'i yon bdag la// gtam snyan grags pa dka' bar gda'// tho co byed pa'i rnal 'byor la// rten 'brel nus pa dka' bar gda'// las rgyu 'bras ma bsam nya ma yis// stong nyid go ba dka' bar gda'// chos dang 'khon pa'i chos pa la// dngos grub 'byung ba dka' bar gda'// khyod dang mgon pa'i bu med la// khyim thabs rnyed pa dka' bar gda'// khyod gces phrug dad pa skyes mod kyang*// rang dbang thob pa dka' mor gda'// nga da lta long med rgyud la skyes// bu khyod kyang byon pas 'gyod pa che// dus lan gcig 'dzom pa'i smon lam 'tshal// las 'bras dbang gi 'phrad de mchi// de yang ma 'dzom bar du yang*// rnal 'byor nga yang ngag btsun zhing*// yon bdag khyed kyang bkra shis la// lus la nad dang rma med cing*// tshe la bar chad rkyen med do// pha dang bu rgyud 'phrad par shog /nga rnal 'byor dbyar khams snyoms te mchi// khyed gces phrug yul du log pa bzhud// ces dga' ba'i mdo bcu mgur du gsungs nas skyel thung pa rnams yul du song ngo*// de nas dpon slob la stod du byon cing*/ tshong pa tshan pa cig dang 'phrad pas ras chung pas mgur cig mdzad de bsod snyoms bslangs pas/ tshong pa de rnams shin tu dad de dro legs po drangs/

de nas drod sman bsdus nas phul bas ma bzhed de/ rje btsun gyis mgur gsungs pa/ bla ma rnams la phya 'tshal lo// nga mi la ras pa zhes pa yin// deng sang nor la 'dod pa med// zang zing tshogs su ma 'tshal te// dang po gsog brun sdug bsngal med// bar du srung skyobs sdug bsngal med// tha ma chags zhen sdug bsngal med// bar du zang zing med de legs// deng sang gnyen grogs kyi 'dod pa med// byams sdug 'khor du ma 'tshal te// dang po 'dzin gyi sdug bsngal bral// bar du lan chags kyi sdug bsngal bral// tha mal 'bral ba'i sdug bsngal med// byams sdug med pa med de bde// de sang khe grags kyi 'dod pa med/ gtam snyan 'khor du ma mtshar te// dang po rtsol sgrub sdug la bral// bar du phyar kha'i 'jigs pa med// tha mal nyams kyi dogs pa med// gtam snyan med pa med de bde// deng sang yul la 'dod pa med// sdod pa nges su ma 'tshal te// dang po phyogs 'dzin sdug bsngal med// bar du yul srid sdug bsngal med// tha ma ngo srung sdug bsngal med// sdod pa med de med de lags// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad ko ra la thog gi skor ro/// /de nas khu byug dben pa rdzong la byon pa'i lam du yon bdag rgan po gcig gshis ngan pa/ nor che ba 'khor mang po'i dbus su bsdad nas thams cad smra ba cig sbra chen po cig gi nang du 'dug pa la/ rje btsun chen po dpon slob gnyis kyi bsod snyoms zhus pas rgad po de na re/ yud cig sdod nga yi kha brda ma tshar zer/ yang zhus pas/ ras pa 'di las 'dod thag nye ba ring stabs che ba/ khyod cig de tsam ci la red/ brel ba de tsam 'ong ba zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis/ nyon cig gson cig bgres po ba// nga brel tshab che ba bden par yod// nga mi la ras pa 'chi bar yod// de yang myur du myur du 'chi// yon bdag khyod dag ma 'chi ste// khyod kyang rtag tu rtag tu 'chi/

khyod sdod pas sdod pa'i chos la 'bungs// chos thog tu pheb na nga yis len// zhes gsungs pas rgad po na re/ rnal 'byor pa kha gcol mkhan zer bas/ yang gsungs pa/ nga dad kha bcol mi 'chad de// yon bdag kha bcol rke yi bskyed// nga dang rdzun po'i mi smra ste// bgres po rdzun po'i mi smra ste// bgres po rdzun gyi 'khor gyis bskor// kho de yon bdag bgres po ba// khyod kyis 'chi ba ma gzigs na// pha ma la sogs ga na bzhugs// yang na bgres pos tshe bun btang*// tshe yi bun skyed len pa ran// ran pa las kyang 'phyis pa tsam/ 'phyis sam ma 'phyis dbu la gzigs// sho med kyang bre mo bgyis pa lags// yon bdag bgres po ga la 'chi// mar me rlung gis ga la bskyod// chu yi sbu ba ga la yal// chu shing snying po lcags las mkhregs// de go bar gda'am blo bde'o// mkhyen par gda'am phyi chos can// zhes gsungs nas khu byug dben pa rdzong la byon/ der lo hril ba gcig bzhugs pas/ bu slob bzang dag cog rnams kyang der byung ste ras pa dpon g.yog sum cu tsam byung de rnams dbyar der bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi bum dbang dang 'brel pas thun mong yid bzhin nor bu/ gsang dbang dang 'brel pa steng sgo rnam grol gyi chos drug /gsum pa dang 'brel ba 'og sgo bde ba chen po/ tshig dbang dang 'brel ba phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed gnang ba'i rjes su gsungs pa/ byin rlabs sgrub pa'i rtsal dang ldan// nyams dang rtogs pa'i mchog dang ldan// mos gus gdams pa'i snod dang ldan// bu cig ras chung rdo rje grags// nga yi gdams pa khyad 'phags 'di// mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung nas ni// dad gus snod dang ldan pa'i phyir// rin chen gser gyi ga bu ru// nor bus bkang ba 'dra ba 'di/ ras chung lag tu gtad pa yin// yid ches gyis la sems la chongs// kun gyi thun mong ma yin pas// dkon nod rgyal khams mi la dris// bden rdzun lag tu long la ltos// 'bras bu phyi dus 'gyang gyur na// rnal 'byor nga yis bslus pa yin// sems bskyed chung ba ma yin te// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ko long dom// bla ma brgyud pa'i bka' rgya yod// chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig yod// nga yi tshe la khar mi 'don/
