nyams kyi drod tshad spel ba dang*// dus phyis 'gro don dar ba'i phyir// gcig brgyud gnad du shes par bya// drin dang ldan pa'i slob dpon dang*// brtse gdung can gyi mched lcam dang*// zas nor can gyi 'phan po dang*// khe grags can gyi btsan po dang*// byas yus can gyi'ang mi sbyin pa// gzhan ma rnams la smos ci dgos// mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan byung ba yi// rang la dad cing gus par ldan// snod ldan sprang po yin kyang byin// kye ho ras chung rdo rje grags// dper na nor bu rin chen ni// tshogs ma bsags dang 'phrad pa med// bsod nams ldan pa'i spyod yul yin// des na snyan brgyud gdams pa 'di/ gdul bya bsags pa dman pa yi// skal med rnams dang 'phrad par dka'// las can 'ga' yi spyod yul yin// dad med skye bo ru shing rag /skal med rgyud ngan log rtog skyed// go med chos la gshe skur 'debs// de phyir kun la shin tu gsang*// dbang khrid gdams pa bzhi po 'di// khrid du rdzogs par ma thob bar// dpe thob lung thob byed pa'i mis// bla ma ltas ngan mthong bzhin gsang*// chos 'di mthong na gzhog ngom byed// nyams su mi len 'chad sems can// dam nyams slob ma byung srid na// nag po chen pos chad pa chod// za byed mkha' 'gros bka' chad phob// las can gus ldan slob ma yi// chos 'di gtso bor 'dzin gyur na/ lus dang grib bzhin sdong grogs mdzod// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// bla ma bde mchog mkha' 'gro dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// mi la ras pa mi rdzun pas// 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs par// chos 'di dar zhing rgyas par shog /de sogs dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// nag po'i phyogs rnams pham par shog /mkha' mnyam rdo rje 'dzin thob shog /snyan brgyud yi ge med pa 'di// bla ma mkha' 'gros gsung bzhin du// snye nam drod phug dgon pa ru// rdo rje rgyal mtshan brtse bas bris// phyogs yul bde legs ldan gyur cig

/rje btsun mi la ras chen gyis// ras chung khyod la gtad do rgya// na mo gu ru/ rgyud sde mi shes tshogs 'khor dka'// grub mtha' mi shes lta ba dka'// nus pa ma thob spyod pa dka'// brgyud pa mi ldan gdams ngag dka'// sgom sgrub ma byas dngos grub dka'// phyogs cha ma spangs rnal 'byor dka'// nyon mongs ma spangs chos pa dka'// rgyud la ma brten 'bras bu dka'// rlan la ma brten me tog dka'// gnad du ma phog sems 'dzin dka'// de ni mi la'i dka' bcu lags// zhes gsungs/ yang rje btsun gyis gding rnyed bzhi'i mgur gsungs pa/ ngas skye ba med pa'i gding cig rnyed// tshe snga phyi gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag /rigs drug snang ba rdzun du gda'// skye 'chi gnyis kyi sgro 'dogs chod// gnyis su med pa'i gding cig rnyed// yul sems gnyis su 'dzin pa dag /tshogs drug gi nyams snang rdzun du thal// dngos por 'dzin pa'i sgro 'dogs chod// mnyam pa nyid kyi gding cig rnyed/ bde sdug gnyis su 'dzin pa dag /'khor ba'i nyams myong rdzun du thal// spang blang med par sgro 'dogs chod// dbye ru med pa'i gding cig rnyed// 'khor 'das gnyis su 'dzin pa dag /sa lam skyong ba rdzun du gda'// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad khu byug dben pa rdzong gi skor ro// ༈ de nas rje btsun chen po skyi shang gi brag skyid phug nyi ma rdzong du gcig pur byon nas bzhugs tsa nyi ma phyed sgra chen po cig byung ba la gzigs tsa/ sha ba pho gcig rdul rdzab se byung bas/ bzod glag med pa'i snying rje skyes te/ spyir sems can thams cad snying re rje/ khyad par du sems can glan pa 'di snying re rje/ de'i nang nas sha ba 'dis su la nyes byas pa med pa la 'jigs snang can/ mi thams cad kyis sdang ba cig 'dug dgongs nas/ sha ba'i rngul sel ba'i don du skyo shas snying rje'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// sha ba'i lus la tsher ma'i mgo

/sha lus tsher mgo nga la tshur nyon dang*// phyi snang ba'i yul la bros bros nas// 'khrul snang ma rig nang nas thar dus med// phyi lus sems spangs pas mi spangs pas// 'khrul snang ma rig spangs pa'i dus la bab// las rnam smin bden pa mgyogs drag pas// khyod bros pas thar ba ga la srid// sngon las ngan sdig pa bsags bsags pas// da lus sems 'jigs skrag sdug bsngal spyod// da bros pas thar 'dod 'khrul pa yin// sems 'khrul pa shig la 'di na sdod// ces skyo shas snying rje'i dbyangs snyan tshor bas nyan pa'i tshul du g.yas phyogs der nyal nas bsdad de/ mig nas mchi ma phrul le byung nas na bza' la mtshur pa gtad nas nyal lo// rje btsun gyis snying re rje sems can 'di la gnod pa byed pa mkhan cig 'dug dgongs tsa/ khyi mo dmar mo rnga ma dkar dmar gyis brgyan pa cig byung bas de la snying rje rang dbang med par skyes nas dbyangs snyan pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// rje lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud// sems zhe sdang zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// khyi yi lus la spyang ki'i kha// khyi lus spyang kha ba khyod nga la nyon// khyod snang ba gang mthong dgrar len pa'i// zhe sdang gi bsam ngan yid la zug /sdig pa can khyi yi lus la skyes// sdug bsngal ltogs pa'i ngang du sdod// da gzung 'dzin lcags sgrogs ma grol na// ngan song 'jigs las thar dus med// lus sems dad pas mi zin te// nang rang sems rang gis 'dzin re ran// zhes gsungs pas khyi mo de g.yon phyogs su mtshur pa gtad nas rna ba phab// rnga ma bsnyal nas nyal nas bsdad de mchi ma sngo khral le song nas/ sha ba dang khyi gnyis ni ma bu'i tshul dang 'dra bar byung bas/ bla ma'i thugs dgongs la khyi 'di'i bdag po mi gcig 'ong bas bsam shes pas drag dgongs tsa/ mi sngon po ras sked la dkris pa/ zhags pa dang rgya khres khur ba/ mda' lnga dang gzhu gcig bzung nas byung ba la mgur 'di gsungs so// rje grub thob rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dug lnga zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// khyod mi yi lus la gshin rje'i mgo

/mi lus gshin mgo ba khyod nga la nyon// mi lus rin chen dkon gsungs te// khyod 'dra mthong na dkon rgyu med// srin po'i gzugs kyi sdig pa can// sdug bsngal ngan song khyod e 'tshol// sdig pa 'dod pas mi 'grub ste// nang zhen pa log na dngos grub 'thob// phyi snang ba btul bas mi thul te// nang sdig sems 'dul ba'i dus la bab// khyod sha ba bsad pas mi brgyags te// nang dug lnga bsad na ci bsam 'grub// phyi dgra bo btul bas je mang 'gro// nang rang rgyud btul na dgra bo med// mi tshe sdug la ma skyel bar// dam pa'i chos shig byas na bzang*// zhes gsungs pas/ mdun du bltas nas bsdad de kho yi bsam pa la/ mgur la nges pa med de khyi 'di'i sngar ngas ma sleb na sha ba'i phyed de zos nas song ba la de ring ma bu 'dra bar snang bas sha ba'i srog phul na 'thad de/ bu smad kyang ltogs grir mang e 'chi/ 'on kyang bsdig mo zhig byed dgos bsam nas mda' bkang ste/ rnal 'byor pa rgad po nga yi khyi dang sha ba thong*/ khyod kyi ras gos kyi nga yis mda' mi rten zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// khyon nyon dang gson dang khyi ra ba// 'brug 'ur sgra che yang stong sgra yin// 'ja' kha dog legs kyang yal rgyu yin// 'jig rten nyams dga' 'dra yang rmi lam tsam// 'khor ba dga' dga' 'dra yang sdod dbang med// 'dus byas 'di ni mi rtag pa// rdza khar song yod kyang de ring chag /mi na ning skyes pa da lo 'chi// nor rang la yod pa dgra la 'chor// zas phan par zos pa dug tu na// grogs bzang po yod pa dgra la ldangs// drin bzang pos bskyangs las kha po byed// sdig pa rang byas rang la sdig /dmod mo len med rang la 'khor// khyod mgo brgya'i nang nas rang mgo gces// phyag sor mo bcu las gang bcad tsha// bza' tshang mi lnga'i nang nas rang mgo gces// rang mgo rang gis 'don pa'i dus la bab// tshe 'di mi rtag myur du 'jig

/rang sems 'od gsal bsgom pa'i dus la bab// 'grogs pa'i gnyen gyis 'khor bar 'phen// dpal ldan bla ma brten pa'i dus la bab// lar cig song gnyis song sdod dbang med// thams cad 'gro zhing 'dug pa ma mthong ngam/ tshe 'di yang bde la phyi ma skyid// 'di phyi gnyis ka skyid pa dam pa'i chos// dam pa'i lha chos byed pa'i dus la bab// ces gsungs pas/ kho dad pa skyes te/ a re bden/ nga las lod pa mi 'dug snyam ste/ mda' gzhu thang la bzhag nas phyag phul ste/ sha ba'i srog dang khyi dang bya dang mda' dang gzhu thams cad phul nas bro ma dbyangs 'di phul lo// rje btsun chen po snyan gson dang*/ sprul sku ras chen thugs gtad 'tshal// nga yis lag g.yas na thogs pa nyag phran mda'// nyag phran mda' mo sgro mtshal kha rgyan can/ mde'u ngar ma btsan dug ngar mas byugs// lag pa g.yon na bzung ba mchog dkar gzhu// hor gzhu ngar ma sing rgyud kha rgyan can// dro ba dkar mo mdzes pa'i gsal gdongs can/ zhags pa nag po a long sngon po'i kha rgyan can// 'dam drug bshal bdun bshal cing phra la dril// rgya khros khra bo snal chu ser po'i kha rgyan can// khyi mo dmar mo rnga ma dkar dmar gyi la tshom can// glogs lcam 'phar ma nam mkha'i bya zin ma// sha ba smug po dung ru dkar po'i kha rgyan can// 'bul ba sna drug bla ma khyed la 'bul// khyi mo dmar mo thar pa'i lam la thong*// sha ba smug po byang chub lam la chug /nga khyi ra ba mgon po rdo rje dmyal ba mi gtong 'tshal// ngas sngar byas sdig pa 'gyod sems skyes// da phyin chad mi byed dam bca' 'bul// zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun mnyes ste/ kho'i brod pa bskyed pa'i don du mgur 'di gsungs so// mi nga ngo khyed kyis ma shes na// gung thang mi la ras pa yin// chos lta ba gang yin zer tsa na// lta ba snang stong mtha' bral yin// de lung rig gnyis kyis bar na rnyed// bu skye shis 'jigs na yar la ltos// skye shi 'jigs na nga phyir 'brang*// sgom pa gang yin zer tsa na// sgom pa 'od gsal gnyis med yin// bde stong gnyis kyis bar na rnyed// bu skye shi 'jigs na yar la ltos// skye shis 'jigs na nga phyir 'brong*// spyod pa gang yin zer tsa na// spyod pa ma bkag lhun grub yin// de rten 'brel gnyis kyis bar na rnyed// bu skye shis 'jigs na yar la ltos// skye shi 'jigs na nga phyis 'brong*// 'bras bu gang yin zer tsa na// de 'khor 'das gnyis kyi bar nas rnyed// bu skye 'chi'i 'jigs na yar la ltos// skye 'chi'i 'jigs na nga phyir 'brong*// chos lta sgom spyod 'bras rdo rje'i dbyangs// khyod sgom par nus na rtogs pa 'char// bza' tsho drug gi khyim thabs rnams/

spangs par nus na ngo mtshar che// rang nyid gcig pur 'chi ba la// chos shig nus na so nam tshar// zhes gsungs pas kho shin tu dad de/ bla ma lags/ khyed gar bzhugs/ grogs ci 'dra yod/ 'tsho ba ci 'dra gsol/ nga yang chags phyi la 'gro ba lags/ bu smad yang ci red red ces zhus/ de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma dang rang sems sangs rgyas gsum// 'du 'bral med par gsol ba 'debs// gnas g.ya' ri dang gangs ri rdza ri gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor nga yi sgrub gnas yin/ gnas de gsum la spro na nga phyir gshegs// sha ba dang gna' ba dgo ba gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor nga'i dkor nor yin// nor de gsum la dga' na nga phyir gshegs// bya gong mo dang 'jol mo kri ka gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor nga yi khyim mtshes yin// khyim mtshes de gsum dang 'grogs na nga phyir gshegs// sngo zwa dang rug pa thul pa gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor nga'i chos brgyags yin// zas 'di gsum gyi 'grangs na nga phyir gshegs// rdza chu dang g.ya' chu gangs chu gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor nga yi btung chu yin// skom 'di gsum gyi chog na nga phyir gshegs// pha bla ma dang yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum// 'di gsum nged kyi rgyab brten yin// 'di gsum la dad na nga phyir gshegs// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor nga yi skyabs gnas yin// khyod 'di gsum la dad na nga phyir gshegs// ces gsungs/ nor yod nas zas med pa yi dwags su skye 'dod yin/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram na yi dwags skom zer tsa// deng sang nas byed pa rgyu mthun gyi snga mas sleb 'ong ba yin/ da don dang gnyen thams cad la the tshom ma bskyed par nyon cig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// pho ya ma can ri khrod ras pa nga*// dbyar zla gsum ri khrod kyi gangs la bsgoms// khams smug pa bzang ba'i bsil ngad bzang*// ston zla gsum ro snyoms kyi ldom bu byed// lus 'byung bzhi gso ba'i 'bru rtsam med// dgun zla gsum nag ma'i phugs su bsgoms// rlung gdug can ngar ma'i sgrib g.yeng yin// dpyid zla gsum g.ya' dag gangs la bsgoms// rlung bad kan mkhris pa'i bcag pa yin// dbyar dgun med par bsgom la brtson// lus 'byung bzhi 'jig pa'i sdug chos yin// dus rgyun du yengs med bya ba btang*// nyon mongs dug lnga'i dmag dogs yin// 'tsho ba gang byung za ba de/

'dod sred chung ba'i skyid rtags yin// dus rgyun du chos la 'bad pa yin// rang rgyud dkar po'i rnam thar yin// bu chos brgyags la sems khral ma byed dang*// chos pa ltogs grir mi 'chi ba// sangs rgyas kun gyi dgongs pa yin// grub thob rnams kyi snying gtam yin// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i mdzad pa yin// rnal 'byor nga yi rtogs pa yin// chos skyong spyi yi dam tshig yin// zhes gsungs pas/ 'o na sla nas 'dug bsam nas/ da nga la khrid gnang bar zhu zhus pa mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma dam pa mnyes pa de// yang dang yang du gsol ba thob// yi dam mkha' 'gro bsgom pa de// yang yang dran zhing gnas par gyis// 'chi ba mi rtag bsgom pa de// yang nas yang du dran par gyis// phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa de// chung ngu chung ngu yang yang sgom// sems can pha mar gyur pa de// yang yang sems la dran par gyis// snyan brgyud zab mo bsgom pa de// snying la rus pa thon par gyis// dam chos mtha' ru 'don pa de// mtho dman med par na re skyong*// chos dang e mthun lta ba de// rtsab rtsub med par gcig la dril// so nam lha chos byed pa de// khyim pa'i 'bral 'bril gting la byed// chos brgyags lha yis sprod pa la// sdug gsog byas pas phan gnod med// gsog mis spyod du mi 'jug pa// mkha' 'gro spyi yi gdams ngag yin// zhes gsungs te snyan brgyud kyi khrid gnang nas bsgoms pas nyams dang rtogs pa skyes nas gnya' shang sgang khyi ra ras pa bya ba 'jig rten gyi bya ba thong ba thugs kyi sras brgyad yod pa'i ya ba gcig byung ste/ bu smad dang yang de nyin nas ma 'phrad/ de sngar bas kyang je brgyags je skyid la sogs te bsam pa chos dang mthun pa byung ngo*// khyi dang sha ba gnyis kyang rje btsun yab sras gar 'byon pa'i sar chags phyi la 'gro ba dang*/ phyis kyang rdza phug de nyid du khyi dang sha ba'i rtsing khog dang*/

mda' chag dang gzhu chag rnams da rung ngo mtshar ba'i ltas la yod do// yang lo rgyus gcig la khyi ra bas mda' gzhu sogs phul ba rnams tshar nas sdig pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' zhing nyid gar 'byon du chags phyir 'brangs lags/ tshe gcig gi grol ba'i gdams ngag cig thugs rjes bzung zhes zhus nas/ rje btsun gyi drung du pus mo btsugs thal mo sbyar nas 'dug pa'i tshe/ khyi ra ba'i bud med des sked du st+wa re gcig bcug /rgyab tu sil po zhig khur/ lag tu thag zhags gcig bzung nas byung ste/ rnal 'byor pa rtog 'byor pa 'di tshos gar yang sleb 'dug /lung phug na yang 'di tshos sleb 'dug /khyed kyis nga yi mi khyi gnyis de bzung nas 'dug pa ci yin/ nged bza' mi bdun yod pa de khyod kyi gso ches e yin/ rke de la thag pa 'dis btags te mgo la st+wa re 'dis gcig brgyab na nyo bar 'dug zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis mo la mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod nag mo'i lus la srin mo'i gdong*// nag lus srin gdong ma nga la tshur nyon dang*// khyod re ba sha ba chos kyi re// dogs pa sha ba shor kyi dogs// re dogs kyi bar der 'khor bar 'khyams// khyod sha ba bsad kyis mi gsod de// nang sems nyid 'dzin pa'i dus la bab// sgom 'od gsal bsgom pa'i dus la// nag mo tshe 'di skyid la phyi ma bde// gnyis ka bde ba'i lha chos mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ mo na re/ khyod chos kun ci cha yod// khyed lha chos bya bas sprang po cig grub nas snang*// nged kyi khyi sha ba 'di gnyis khyod kyis 'phrog zer ba e yin zer nas mo rang gis mi la khyod chos nyan pa phar zhog /byed zer na sha ba 'di sod la sha rnams khur la 'ong zer zhing*/ sha ba'i mgo la thag pa btags te shing phung la bkor bas bzhag /mo rang gi mi la rdog tho brgyab nas khyod sha ba gsod pa 'dam mam/ ngas khyod kyi mgo la sta re 'dis brgyab pa 'dam zer ba la/

yang rje btsun gyis mo la mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod nag mo'i lus la bdud mo'i sems// las ngan ma bdag la tshur nyon dang*// 'o skol 'gro ba 'jig rten pa// 'jig rten pa la phar bltas pas// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi// chu bzhi sdug bsngal gyi rba la g.yeng*// dus gtan du g.yeng ba ma tshor ram// bde ba'i gnas skabs mi gda' na// skye ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsam na// bar do kun gzhi 'khyams pa de// ma yi mngal du zhugs tsam na// khrag dang chu ser nang du nyal// mi gtsang ba la sngas stan byas// las ngan dbang gis lus ngan len// gnas ngan nang du sdug bsngal myong*/ tshe snga phyi dran yang smra ma shes// sdug bsngal che yang skad ma thon// tsha grang gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs skyes// zla ba dgu la dmyal bar sreg /mngal na skyes pa'i dus tsam na// lus po tsher ma'i nang du bsgyur ba 'dra// ma yi pang du blangs tsam na// byi'u khra yis khyer ba 'dra// ma yis rkan mar byin pa'i dus// btsan dug ngar ma zos pa 'dra// tshem me nang du bzhag pa'i tshe// btson dongs nang du btsug pa 'dra// lar skye med don gcig ma rtogs na// skye ba'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab// rgas pa'i sdug bsngal bshad tsam na// yan lan gtso bo mgo bo 'khor// rna ba sgra yi rgyal po 'on// pags pa'i lo ma skra yang dkar// mdzes pa'i bzhin yang gnyer ma byung*// dbang po'i dngas ma mig kyang 'grib// byad kyi rgyal po sna yang zhom// mkhur tshos khrag gi rgya mtsho skem// rus pa'i rgyal po so yang bud// bden la 'thad pa'i gtam smras kyang*// bcol gtam zer nas nyan mkhan med// ro la yang pa'i gos bgos kyang*// grang la lci ba'i dug po dkon// drang por skyed pa'i lus po rgud// brtan por spos pa'i gom pa 'khyor// shig dang bu lon bsad kyang 'du// zas dang gnyen 'dun btu yang gyes// na ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsam na// khyod lan gcig na ba'i dus byung tshe// lhan cig skyes pa'i sha rus kyang*// zug gzer byed pa'i dgra ru lang*// rlung mkhris bad kan bdud du bab// khrag dang chu ser rgyun du babs// lus na tsha'i dbang du song ba'i tshe// stan 'bol po bting yang 'og nas mkhrang*// sngas mthon po bzhag kyang mjing pa na// zhim la mngar ba'i zas bsten kyang*// mthong ba tsam gyi skyugs su bro// byams pa'i gnyen gyis mtha' bskor yang*// na tsha zug gzer bgo blo med// mgo bo mi yi dpang du bzhag

/zas rnams thur mas kha la snyod// skom rnams sbu gu'i rgyud nas 'jib/ de yi nad la phan thabs med// brgya 'gro stong 'gro mthong ba med// khri 'bod stong 'bod thos pa med// na ba'i sdug bsngal de tsam mo// khyod lan gcig shi ba'i dus byung tshe// phyug po'i nor gyi bslu sa med// lce bdes lo rgyus bkrol thabs med// dpa' bo'i stag 'thab byed sa med/ sdar ma wa bros byed sa med// ngan pas u tshug byed sa med// mdzangs mas zas kyis bslu sa med// ngan pas rno gcod byed sa med// 'phyor mos byad kyis 'brid sa med/ yan lag rtsa rnams mtha' nas sdud// khur thag lam gyi mtha' nas bres// gces par bskyangs pa'i sha rus kyang*// bya khyi kun gyi gzan du 'gyur// khyod de 'dra yi dus shig byung tsa na// nor zang zing mang yang gzhan gyis spyad// gnyen bu mang yang gcig pur 'gro// mkhar khang khyim mang yang sgo ru 'phud// de bzod par gda'am skal ldan kun// gces pas gsos pa'i lus po yang*// la la me yi nang du bsreg /la la chu yi nang du skyur// la la dong du sa dang bsre/ la la bya dang spyang kis za// bsam blo thong dang skal ldan kun/ 'dzam gling nor la dbang mod kyang*// tshe la zhing bslu yang ma nus pas// ser sna byas pas ci la phan// rang gcig pur 'gro ba'i dus la bab// zla bo su dang 'grogs nas 'gro/ dmigs gtad su la byed nas 'gro// rgyab tu ci zhig 'khyer nas 'gro// 'gro rogs zla rogs su zhig yod// bsam mno med dam blo re bde// dam pa'i lha chos ma lags pa'i// sus kyang phan par mi gda' na// las kyi me long gsal ba dang*// las dge sdig gang byas de la gnas// gshin rje chos rgyal zhe re gnag /a wa glang mgo snying rje med// zangs dmar kha sbyor yangs shong che// lus la thig nag 'debs su 'ong*// gdug pa'i sog les 'dra nas 'ong*// khro chu 'khol ma 'thung dgos 'ong*// me ma mur la 'bog dgos 'ong*// gshin rje chos rgyal dmag tshogs kyis// lus la mtshon cha btab nas 'ong*// da lta shi yang da lta sos// khyod la de lta bu yi dus byung tshe// mi bdag bu yi phan pa med// nor longs spyod mang yang 'khyer dbang med// de bas da lta bde dus 'dir// lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// bla ma rje la gsol ba thob// lha bskyed rdzogs gnyis la nan tan mdzod// rjes thob byams dang snying rje bsgom// rang shi dus gding dang ldan par mdzod// ces gsungs pas mo yang dad pa thob ste bza' pa bdun pos chos zhus nas grub pa thob par gyur skad do// de thams cad khyi ra ras pa'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa de nyid gsang ste bkra shis sgang du thugs nyams skyong zhing bzhugs pa'i dus su/

deng ma ba'i ra rdzi de byung nas rnal 'byor pa glu zhig long dang zer ba la/ khong gis ma gsan pa ltar mdzad pas kho khros te ra thul gyi thu ba sprugs nas rnal 'byor khyod kyi glu zhig long dang byas pa ma nyan/ mi dgos pa'i dus su lung stong col gyis bkang*/ da phyin chad srus shog dang ngas rdo ded ma byas na zer bas/ rje btsun gyis khong gi ra thul gyi thu ba 'gyus te mgur 'di gsungs so// phyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la// yid skyo ba skye ba'i chos bshad kyang*// blo zhen pa log pa'i mi re nyung*// de la glu blang phan pa mi gda' na// des phan na glu chung cis mi len// nor rdzas 'di sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra// nor rang gis bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyad// rang gis spyad na ser snas 'ching*// gzhan gyis spyan na chags sdang skye// chags med sbyin pa gtong ba'i mi re nyung*// de la glu zhig blang bas phan pa mi gda' na// des phan glu chung cis ma len// dam chos phyag rgya chen po yang*// ngo sprod dmar khrid bgyis lags kyang*// sems ngo shes pa'i mi re nyung*// de la glu blangs pas phan pa mi gda' na// des phan na glu chung cis mi len// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag zab mo rnams// 'phangs sems med par bstan lags kyang*// don nyams su len pa'i mi re nyung*// de la glu blangs pas phan pa mi gda' na// des phan na glu chung cis mi phan// rje gong ma'i bzhugs gnas ri khrod la// dus rtag tu spro ba bskyed lags kyang*// 'dug tshugs thub pa'i mi re nyung*// de la glu blangs pas phan pa mi gda' na// des phan na glu chung cis mi len/ dal 'byor mi lus thob dus 'dir// gtan khrims bsrung ba dka' lags kyang*// nyin re'i bsnyen gnas mi srung na// de la glu blangs pas phan pa mi gda' na/ des phan na glu chung cis mi len// tshe yongs su zad pa'i lhag ma la// sdod long med par bgyis lags kyang*// chos sgor zhugs pa'i mi re nyung*// de la glu blangs pas phan pa mi gda' na// des phan na glu chung cis mi len// khyed shan pa rnams la phar bltas pas// drang don dge ba'i chos bshad kyang*// sdig la 'dzem pa'i mi re nyung*// de la glu blangs pas phan pa mi gda' na// des phan na glu chung cis mi phan// tshe 'di yi 'dun ma ling ste thong*// lto gos gnyis zhen pa dor// skyid sdug gnyis la ro snyoms mdzod// legs nyes bla ma mkhyen la gtugs// dmigs rtse lam zas 'di la gtod// chos snying nas byed na 'di rnams mtshar// zhes gsungs pas kho dad pa skyes nas phyag mang du 'tshal/

bskor ba byas nyin phyed la ra dum khyim du ded nas bdag po rnams la 'o khyed rang rnam pa'i ra gtad/ nga ni rnal 'byor pa gcig gi rgyab tu 'gro ba yin zer nas 'ong ste/ rje btsun gyi chags phyir 'brang bar bya ba yin btang ba la ra rdzi ras pa bya ba grub pa thob pa cig byung ngo*// de thams cad ra rdzi ras pa'i skor ro/// /de nas yang rje btsun dpon slob gsum lho brag mkhar chu'i yul khar ldom bu la byon pa'i dus su lug rdzi rgan po cig gis lug 'tsho ba dang phrad do// lug rdzi des rnal 'byor pa khyed rnams glu 'dra ba shes sam zer ba'i dus su/ rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so// 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin la// yid skyo ba skye ba'i chos bshad kyang*// blo zhen pa log pa de nyung bar gda'// glu blangs pas kyang phan par mi gda' na// phan na glu chung cis ma len// mi tshe rtswa kha'i zil pa dang 'dra// tshe skad cig kyang sdod long med lags kyang*// blo chos la 'gro ba de nyung bar gda'// glu blangs pas kyang phan par mi gda' na// phan na glu chung ces mi len/ zas nor 'di sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi 'dra// nor rang gis bsags kyang gzhan gyis spyad// rang gis spyad na ser snas bcings// gzhan gyis spyad na chags sdang skye// chags med kyi sbyin pa gtong mi nyung*// glu blangs pas kyang phan par mi gda' na// phan na lta glu dag cis mi len// don mthar thug phyag rgya chen po la// ngo sprod dang dmar khrid bgyid lags kyang*// nyams su len pa 'di nyung bar gda'// glu blangs pas kyang phan pa mi gda' na// phan na lta glu dag cis mi len// rje gong ma'i sgrub gnas ri khrod 'dir// dus gtan du spro ba skye lags kyang*// 'dug tshugs thub pa 'di nyung bar gda'// glu blangs pas kyang phan pa mi gda' na// phan na lta glu dag cis mi len// pha yul lho brag gi yul kha na// khyod lug rdzi rgad pos glu long zer// ngag snyan pas dpe don sprad na yang*// don gnas lugs go ba 'di nyung bar gda'// glu blangs pas phan par mi gda' na// phan na lta glu dag cis mi len// zhes gsungs pas lug rdzi rgan po de rje btsun la dad pa skyes nas phyi dro kha lug ded nas khyim du phyin pa la/

lug bdag kun na re khyod la ci red pa yin zer bas/ kho na re/ ci red la ci red rgyu med zer nas lug slas la mar rgyab/ phyid pa la phye shal byas nas gla yang ma bsnyags nas rje btsun gyi chags phyir 'brangs nas sgrub pa byas pas/ rje btsun mnyes pa'i ras pa gsha' ma cig byung skad do// de ni lug rdzi ras pa'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun dpon slob gtsang ra kha che'i mgron khang du bsod snyoms la byon pas tshong dpon zla ba nor bu dang*/ dge bshes g.yag ru thang pa dang*/ mi mang po 'tshogs nas 'dug pas/ g.yag ru thang pas chos gsung zhing yod pa la/ rje btsun 'gol pa cig gzims nas bzhugs pas/ dge bshes g.yag ru thang pa na re/ rnal 'byor pa'i nyal lugs la/ mi lus thob pa chud zos la song bar 'dug /chos mi nyan pa mgo gtum nas ltos dang zer bas/ rje btsun yar bzhengs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// yul dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// rje bla mas byin rlabs thugs rjes zung*// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos 'chad mkhan// nang rang rgyud sems nyid ma thul ba'i// phyi sems can dmu rgod ga la thul// gdung dang rma bya lding khang rnams// mi rtag nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// grong ltag gi dgon pa'i ja thab de// mgo g.yog phung ba'i g.yab mo 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// mgo nag mi yi 'du 'dzi de// sdang ba dgra yi skor rgyug 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// rta nor lug gsum 'tsho skyong de// rtswa thog zil pa'i rlung dmar 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// sgyu lus nyon mongs phung po de// mi ro gser chus byugs pa 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// ma jo mo sgom ma'i tshogs dpon de// ya tshul zad pa'i ma rab 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// kha za 'dod tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'di/

khral 'u lag sdud pa'i hor 'dra 'dra// de e 'dra dge bshes rang som// mo bon rtsis gsum grong chog 'di// hab rdzis theb pa'i trang sa 'dra// de e 'dra dge bshes rang som// nya ma mgo skor glu chung de// 'dod ldan byi la'i gsung ngag 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// pha yul zhing khang bdag po de// 'ja' la byis pas bltas pa 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// khram pa 'dus pa'i bu slob de// dpon po mang po'i g.yog po 'dra// de e 'dra dge ba'i bshes rang som// don 'dzin pa med pa'i chos bshad de// dbang chung kha ta byed pa 'dra// de e 'dra dge bshes rang som// lar rang don so nam ma grub pa'i// gzhan don 'grub pa dka' mo yin// zhes gsungs pas dge bshes g.yag ru thang pa khri las bab nas/ rje btsun la phyag 'tshal nas mchi ma lhug par byung nas/ khyed re bden zer te gdams ngag zhus pas byin rlabs zhugs te/ ston sgom khyad par du 'phags pa'i ras pa bzang po cig byung ngo*// de nas de nub der rje btsun gzims nas bzhugs tsa/ ston pa mang po 'dus nas kha thon dang chos spyod mang po nam stod la byas/ phyi nang tsha ba ran dus ston pa gcig na re/ rnal 'byor pa 'di la sdus la byin/ dge sbyor byed rgyu ni mi 'dug /zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje kun nas grub pa'i dkon mchog gsum// rten grub med rig pa'i ngang du grol// de la skyabs 'gro byed sa ma rnyed na// ngag smra brjod bral ba'i rnal 'byor skyid// mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa yi// yi dam lha srung 'od gsal ngang du grol// de la bskyed rim bsgom yang ma dgos lags// yid spro bsdu dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor skyid/ rkyen bar chad sel ba mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// mkha' 'gro rang bzhin gnyug ma'i ngang du shar// de la gsol ba gdab yang ma dgos so// tshogs drug rang sar grol ba'i rnal 'byor skyid// 'dre nga bdag bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs// 'dre dogs med chos nyid gzugs su shar// de la dza rdung byed kyang ma dgos so// rnam rtog chos skur shar ba'i rnal 'byor skyid// khyod ston pa tshig gi tha snyad mkhan// tshig ldab ldib nyams myong ngang du grol// de la slob gnyer byed thabs ma rnyed do// tshig tha snyad bral ba'i rnal 'byor skyid// ces gsungs pas/

ston pa de rnams kyi nang nas se ban ston chung bya ba cig dad pa skyes nas/ snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag gnang nas bsgoms pas rtogs pa skyes te thugs sras bzhi yi ya bar gyur pa/ mdo bkra'i se ban ras pa bya ba cig byung ngo*// de nas yon bdag 'bro chos bzang bya ba cig gi mdang zhag khams cig ma bde bas/ yid skyo shas drag po skyes te snying ma dga' bas/ bsgom kyang yon tan ma byung zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// yul pha gi'i ri khrod dgon pa na// bla ma lta spyod ldan pa'i rin po che// de la dad cing gus pas gsol ba thob// don ma nor nyams su len pa kun// blo rgod tsa lta ba'i thog rdzis thong*// sems mtshan ma rang grol 'di ngo mtshar che// sems ma bde ro snyoms ldom bu mdzod// yul sna tshogs rang grol 'di ngo mtshar che// nyams mi dga' nyams chen go bsdur mdzod// bu nyams chen go bsdur sems la phan// yid ma skyes rgyal ba'i bka' la gzigs// bka' bden pa'i tshig la nges shes bskyed// snying ma dga' rje la gsob ba 'debs// pha bla ma'i gdams ngag sems la phan// lar mi dad med cig la phar bltas tsa// gzhi 'khor ba'i 'dam du lus po nyal// nad de la phan pa'i sman pa tshol// sgo gsum mos gus phyag rten thong*// bla ma'i sman la bzang drug mang*// sku gsum ngo sprod sman sbyor mdzad// nyon mongs nad kyi dug lnga sod// ces gsungs te yon bdag la gdams ngag bstan pas/ nyams bzang po skyes pas ngo mtshar ba cig byung ngo*// de nas tshong dpon zla ba nor bus/ bdag la yang mi rtag pa'i chos shig gnang bar zhus pas/ dran ne brgyad kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod da lta mkhar khang zhol khyim 'dzom pa dga' ste// rang shi tsa na rang shul stong pa 'gro ba 'di dran ne// khyod da lta khas grags dpung pa 'dzoms pa dga' ste// rang shi tsa na mgon med skyabs dang bral ba 'di dran ne// khyod da lta pha tshan dang nye 'khor mang ba la dga' ste// rang shi tsa na nye med bshes dang bral ba 'di dran ne// khyod da lta 'khor g.yog bu nor 'dzom pa la dga' ste// rang shi tsa na grogs med gci pur 'gro ba 'di dran ne// khyod da lta gos zas gser g.yu 'dzom pa la dga' ste// rang shi tsa na nor med gcer pur 'gro ba 'di dran ne// khyod da lta rgyud shed dpa' rtsal 'dzoms pa la dga' ste/

rang shi tsa na lus po gsum lteb byed pa 'di dran ne// khyed da lta dbang po dang sha bkrag gsal ba la dga' ste// rang shi tsa na rig pa rang dbang med pa 'di dran ne// khyod da lta kha zas zhim mngar 'dzom pa la dga' ste// rang shi tsa na kha ru chu las mi 'gro ba 'di dran ne// dran ne brgyad kyi mgur ma 'di// gtsang kha rag kha che'i mgron khang du// dbang phyug mi la nga yis blangs// nyams dge bskul gyi mchod dbyangs de la mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ kho dad pa skyes te dngos po thams cad tshogs su btang*/ gdams ngag zhus pas chos pa bzang po cig byung ngo*// de thams cad gtsang g.yas ru'i skor ro/// /de nas bcu bzhi pa che ba'i yon tan ni/ bring gi phug pa cig na sgom chen su bsdad gshegs nas 'gro che zer nas mi su 'gro mi phod pa cig tu/ ras chung pa dpon slob gnyis byon nas bla ma zad par chu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs tsa nam srod la bud med chen mo cig byung nas nga yi 'di na su yod zer ba la/ bla mas snying rje bsgom tsa/ sme ba can 'dra ba g.yo che ba zhig zer nas log song ngo*// de nas nam phyed na yang bud med cig 'ong nas bla ma'i gzims mal chu de'i nang du rde'u zhig 'phang nas song zhus pas/ 'o na khyod kyis thon gsungs nas chu'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas/ ras chung pas rde'u bton nas phan par 'dug go /de'i phyi nub mo de la rgyal po gnyis kyi sna drangs te 'dre'i dmag mang po byung nas/ 'dir su yod na khyod rang gi yul du mgyogs par song zhig /mi 'gro na 'dre dmag gis khyod la ba thob pa 'dra ba cig byed zer bas/ bla mas de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje 'gro ba'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ bsam ngan zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// 'o na rgyal ngan snying re rje// 'dre mo'i dmag tshogs nyon re mongs// khyod bsam ngan gdug rtsub goms goms nas// sems can yongs la 'chi ba byed// sha dang khrag la zos zos nas/

srog gcod dbugs len shin tu brod// lus ngan 'dre mor skyes skyes nas// las ngan spyad spyad dmyal bar skye// da thar pa'i sa bon mi dran pas// thar thabs med pas snying re rje// nga stong nyid snying rje'i gdan la bzhugs// khyod song cig byas pas chas thabs med// rdzu 'phrul lus kyi bkod pa la// khyod 'khyer rgyu rnyed na dga' ba yin// byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid la// 'dre mang po'i 'tshogs na nga yang dga'// zhes gsungs pas/ la la na re song zer/ gcig na re mi 'gro na 'dre mo 'di la gnas shig byin zer/ de'i nang nas zhe nag pa 'gas gdug rtsub byas nas da mi 'gro bar 'dug zer nas/ thog dang ser ba 'bab la khad byung bas bla mas mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod legs par nyon dang rgyal po gnyis// 'dre mo zhe nag gdug rtsub can// 'byung po yi dwags thams cad la/ rang gis rang byas rang la smin// gdug sems skyes shing sdug bsngal skyed// bsam ngan skyes shing bsod nams 'dzad// za 'dod lang zhing za rgyu dkon/ ltogs pa che bas rang skal 'chad/ 'gro 'dug mang bas gnas mal 'chor// byed rgyu mang bas tshar dus med// las ngan bsags zhing don mi 'grub// kha so che ba'i dgra mi thub// khyod yid ngan 'dre mo cho 'phrul la// nga rnal 'byor shin tu dgod snying 'dod// cho 'phrul rdzun kyi hra hri la// nga rnal 'byor shin tu rgyu mtshan zhib// khyod gnas mal 'dod na stabs kyis sprad// gsung gleng yod na mos kyi byed// gnas 'dir sgom chen mang po bor// nga de yi tsa rar byed du 'ong*// gnas 'di bdag khyed tsho yin pa la// ngas ma rnyed pa de khyed tsho yin// 'dre 'dir 'tshogs gcig kyang ma 'gro bar// gzhan 'dre srin yod tshad bos la shog /ces gsungs pas/ rgyal po gcig na re/ 'di la stong nyid kyi go cha yod pa'i blo gding can cig 'dug /dngos po la dngos po'i mtshon gyis thub pa yin/

stong nyid la dngos po'i mtshon gyis phan gnod med pas/ da dum bya dgos zer/ 'dre dmag bying gis 'dir 'ong rgyu gcig la re tsa zer nas/ thams cad kyis phyag dang bskor ba byas pas/ bla mas da rung 'di rnams la nges shes med dgongs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod legs par nyon dang 'dre mo ngan// khyod las ngan 'dre yi dmag dpung de// las ngan bsags pa'i sdig pa yin// nga snang srid chos skur shar ba la// 'dre yi dmag tshogs rgyan du bzang*// da legs par nyon dang rgyal po 'dre// khyod skyabs dkon mchog gsum la gnas pa na// gnas bzang po 'chug med rnyed pa yin// sha khrag zas su ma zos na// mtho ris thar lam thob pa yin// 'gro la 'tshe ba spangs pa na// byang chub lam sna myur du zin// mi dge bcu po spangs pa na// rgyal bas rjes su 'dzin pa yin// dge ba bcu po sgrub nus na// bla ma'i gdams ngag go ba yin// gdug sems 'khrug pa zhi nus na/ rig 'dzin gral du phyin pa yin// dam bca' sdom pa byed nus na// 'o skol 'dun ma 'cham pa yin// sdom pa dam tshig len nus na// ngas kyang dam la 'bebs pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ khong rnams dad nas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed zhus nas dam bca' mi res re re phul/ la las nya sdom srung zer/ la las bla ma'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i zhabs tog byed zer/ srog 'bul mi yang mang po byung ste/ de phyin dgon pa der su bsdad la gnod pa mi byed pa'i dam bca' drag po byas/ de phyin nas dgon pa der bkra shis pa bring gi la so lha mo phug tu btags so// de nas snye nam du byon pa la yon bdag dang grwa pa rnams kyis 'dre e thub lags// zhes zhus pa'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// bring gi la so dgon pa der// sgyu ma lus kyi skyil krung bcas// gnyis su med par mnyam par bzhag /skye ba med pa'i dmigs pa la// yeng ba med par blo bzhag nas// bdud mo'i gnod sems byang chub bsgyur/

ma rung sems phral slob ma byas// da ni su 'gro nyam nga med// gang sdod thugs dam yar la 'phel// gnas ni bkra shis lha mo phug /gnas po dge bsnyen bla ma skyabs// nged rang tsho dang grogs mched yin/ de bzhin dgongs la su 'gro song*// tshe ring nad med dngos grub 'thob// ces gsungs so// de thams cad bring gi la so'i skor ro/// /dus der lo stong dgon par rje btsun gyi grwa pa rnams nad drag pos na ba la/ rje btsun der byon te/ zhabs skyil krung mdzad nas yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag pas/ nad pa thams cad zhag gsum nas legs par sos/ de'i dus su gsungs pa/ brin gyi long stong dgon pa ru// sgyu ma lus kyi skyil krung bcas// gnyis su med pa'i mnyam bzhag byas// skye ba med pa'i dmigs pa la// yeng ba med par blo bzhag nas// ma rung sems phral slob mar byas// zhi khro gnyis kyi dgug gzhug la/ byams dang snying rjes blo bzhag pas// ma rungs stong phrag brgyad cu yi// gdon bsal nas nad pa yo nas bslangs// tha ma lus kyi nad pa la// yi dam lha yi sman sbyor gyis/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi nad rnams gsal/ gnyis su med pa'i sman sbyor gyis// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams bsal// phyag rgya chen po'i ro snyoms byas// bsal na nad kyang sos sos 'dra// zhes gsungs so// der rje btsun la yul zhing dgon pa dang*/ ri khrod dang*/ yul zhing la sogs pa 'bul ba mang po byung yang de 'dra dgos pa med/ 'di 'dra kho na dga' zer nas rna ba btsir ba cig byung dgos/ lar so so'i skye bo yin pa'i sa la gnas 'di tsho bas gsar 'grogs la dga' ba/ phyi thag thung ba/ 'gras rkyen pa med gsungs nas/ mchong gling brag la byon pas/ de ston pa bho dhi rā dza zhes bya ba khong rang gis slob ma ston sgom bzang po sngar khong rang ging pa brag la yod dus byon pa/ tshad ma dang*/ bslab btus dang*/

rgyud bla ma la sogs pa byams pa'i chos lnga la shin tu mkhas pa yul lcim lung pa gcig dang*/ 'khor gyi gtso bo ston pa chos rdor gnyis kyis ngo chen bya nas mnga' ris pa'i rgyu ston bya ba/ phar tshad la sogs pa slob dpon bcu gcig dang mang yul dang la stod gnyis ka nas 'bangs mang du yod pa'i btsad po khu mtshan gnyis/ lha btsun mngon pa dang*/ 'dul ba shes pa'i dpon g.yog bdun rnams byung ste/ ras dang zangs dang mdzo dang*/ drel la sogs pa phyag rten du phul nas/ chos bshad pa sgom pa gnyis gal che/ sngar nged tsho'i chos de lam du song ngam sogs sbyin pa la sogs pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug po'i don gang lags nges don gang lags zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis ma bzhes par len du glu zhig bya'o gsungs nas/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed ston sgom gnyis kyis zhu sna mdzad// che lung gsum gyi che dgu byung*// gdams ngag lam du 'jig par zhu/ zhu chen dang zhu mkhan gnyis ka bzung*// nga gung thang mi la mthu chen// sangs rgyas mar pa'i gces ming lags// nges tshig g.yem rgyug thos blo ma yin par// rang 'dod dang zur za ma yin pa'i// gting nas snying la bab pa'i tshig /go bas sla zhing don la bden// rig pas brtags na 'thad du 'gro// nga mi rgan gyi kha bshad legs par nyon// rang gi nyams su ma blangs na// mkha' la rgyu ba'i yid dwags yal// rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya khong gi shes/ gang 'brel rig pa khong yang mkhas// sgra tshad tha snyad khong yang dag /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul khong la mnga'// 'byor pa longs spyod khong yang bzang*// blo gros rig pa khong rno ste// chos rang gis nyams su ma blangs nas// rgyu 'bras phra la ma 'dzem la// cher rlom 'jig rten blos ma theng*// rang 'dod rnam rtog ma zad pas// nges pa'i don la rtogs dus med// 'khor ba'i chu las thar dus med// sdug bsngal gyi myu gu skem dus med// shes bya mkhas dang mngon shes myur// 'gal 'brel rnam rtog rag pa des// rang rgyud bsreg pa'i me shing yin/

slar la rang skyon rang la 'khor// dam chos nyams su blang rgyu yin// de bas nyams su blangs kyang 'tshal// 'chi sos sman gyi bdud rtsi yin// nad pa rang gis ma myong na// bdud rtsi yod pas ci la phan// nad las myur du thar 'dod na// lha 'chi sos sman de za yang 'tshal// sman mchog de la longs spyod 'tshal// 'chi med lha yi bdud rtsi de// lha min lha lag tu mang yod de// rang gis myong bar ma nus pas// lha min phal cher dus min 'chi/ 'chi med bdud rtsis ci la phan// dus min 'chi las thar 'dod na// 'chi med rgyal po 'thung yang 'tshal// bdud rtsi rang gis spyad kyang 'tshal// ro brgya ldan pa'i zas mchog de// gshin rje'i mdzod na mang yod de/ rang gis za bar ma nus pas// gshin rje phal cher bkres nas 'chi// kha zas mchog des ci la phan// bkres pa'i nad las thar 'dod na/ kha zas rang gi za yang 'tshal// ro brgya rang gi myong yang 'tshal// lar dang ngas ni mi shes ang*// bshad ral mkhan po yin kyang min// min kyang da res zhu mkhan bzang*// phar phyin drug la chos kun 'dus// sbyin pa rgyal po'i chos lugs yin// bdog pa ci yod sbyin pas na/ mthong chos lha mi rgyal srid 'thob// de chos mdzad rnams kyi g.yeng ba'i rgyu/ tshul khrims thar pa'i phyi skas yin// sangs rgyas bstan par zhugs pa yin// skyes bu kun la med thabs med/ bstan pa zungs shig 'dir 'dus rnams// bzod pa drang srong khyad chos yin// drang srong shākya'i rjes 'brangs nas// kun gyis gyon pas dka' ba'i gos// bzod pa'i g.yang lugs legs par gyon// brtson 'grus thar pa'i nye lam yin// dam chos spyi la dgos pa'i lam// lam de dang bral na re thag chad// lam de yi gzhung la zhugs la rgyug /chos bzhi de kun bsod nams tshogs// rnal 'byor kun la med thabs med// da ni ye shes phyogs kyi chos// bsam gtan tshogs gnyis sa mtshams yin// sa mtshams rtag tu sdod dgos pas// g.yeng ba byung ba bsrung ba'i thabs// tshogs gnyis kun la sbyar yang 'tshal// shes rab nges pa'i don gyi chos// sangs rgyas kun gyi mdzod gcig pu// spyad pas mi 'dzad rgyun la rgyug

/'jig rten sems can ma lus la// gya nom dbul ba 'dor ba'i nor// mi khom mtha' dag spangs nas ni// dal ba'i mchog de sbyin par mdzad// ye shes tshogs de rin chen yin// rim gyis khyad par 'phags su song*// khyed rnams kun gyi mgron de mdzod// thugs dgyes pas dgongs la nyams su longs// zhes gsungs pas thams cad dad nas gdams ngag zhus pas nyams rtogs khyad par du 'phags pa 'khrungs pa lags so// bring gi lo stong dgon pa'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun gung thang grong mo che yi srang sgo gcig na phar la byon tsa bud med rdzong mang po btags pa gcig chu khur nas byung ba la/ yon bdag mo song po cig slong*/ de med na chu zhig slong gsungs pas/ mo na re/ khyod rnal 'byor pa gces rgan cig 'dug /chu dgos na chu khar song*/ khyod nga la bsnyad tshol nas g.yu 'brag 'dod zin te/ ngas bu dang skud po rnams bkod na khyod bsad 'dod zer bas/ 'di dang 'brel pa med par 'dug dgongs nas grong smad cig tu phar song bas/ rgan mo zhig 'dug pa la rgan mo nga la sing po cig slong*/ de med na chu zhig slong gsungs pas nang du 'byon par zhu zer nas/ ra ba zhig tu bzhugs bcug nas chang mang po drangs te rgan mo na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyed 'dra ba mthong tsa nga glu dang bro 'khrab snying 'dod ste/ bu dang tsha bo kun gyi a ma smyos 'dug zer nas 'ong zer ba'i lan du rje btsun gyis khyod rgan mo smyo lugs ji ltar smyo/ nga rnal 'byor pa smyo lugs gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos bka' drin can gyis byin gyis rlobs// mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad sol// mthun pa'i lam sna chos la drongs// nga pha smyo bu smyo mes po smyo// yang mes te lo bzang po smyo// mes po nā ro paṇa chen smyo// pha rgan mar pa lo tsā smyo// nga rang mi la ras pa smyo// smyo ba'i smyo lugs bshad tsam na// yang me te lo bzang po de// phyag rgya chen po'i gdon gyis smyo// mes po nā ro paṇa che de// rig pa brtul zhugs gdon gyis smyo// pha rgan mar pa lo tsā de// rgyud sde bzhi yi gdon gyis smyo// nga rang mi la ras pa 'di// rtsa rlung gnyis kyi gdon gyis smyo// phyogs ris med pa'i lta ba smyo// dmigs med rang gsal sgom pa smyo// 'dzin med rang grol spyod pa smyo// zol zog med pa'i dam tshig smyo// smyo bas mi tshad 'dre yang gdon// pho gdon bla ma'i gdams ngag gdon// mo gdon mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs gdon// blo bde 'khong po phug zhugs gdon// de ltar smyo ba'i rnal 'byor la// dus gtan du bde skyid rgyun chad med// ces gsungs pas mo na re/

nged yul 'di na 'dre red zer rdung btags byed lugs yod pas/ ma phod pa yin zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rtogs pa'i rgyal po snying la zhugs// nyams rtsal 'dre mos yang nyul byas// 'dre gdon bas mi tshad na yang na// phyag rgya chen pos rgyab nas gzer// rdzogs pa chen pos mdun nas gzer// lus la gtum mo me ltar 'bar// kha nas gdams ngag khrag ltar skyugs// chos nyid bden pas byang khog rgyas// na bas ma tshad 'chi yang 'chi/ lta ba'i klong du phyogs ris 'chi// sgom pa'i klong du bying rgod 'chi// spyod pa'i klong du tshul 'chos 'chi// dam tshig klong du zol zog 'chi// 'bras bu'i klong du re dogs 'chi// sku gsum ngang du rnal 'byor 'chi// rnal 'byor shi ba'i nang pa der// snam bu rkyang pa ma lags pa'i// phyi snang ba khra bor re thum thong*// rtswa dres ma'i thag pa ma lags pa'i// rtswa a wa dhu ti'i thag pas sgrog /snab bshal bu tsha ma lags pa'i// rig pa'i khye'u chung mar long la/ nga rnal 'byor shi ba'i ro 'di khur// sa lam skya mo ma lags pa'i// byang chub chen po'i lam la drongs// sa mkhan mkha' 'gro sde bzhis mdzod// ro sna bka' brgyud bla mas drongs// gangs ri spang ri ma lags pa'i/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i sa la skyel// wa dang spyang ki ma lags pa'i// thabs shes gnyis kyi wa spyang rol// rdo rje 'chang gi dur du sbos// zhes gsungs pas/ mo na re/ khyed de 'dra smyo ba'i rnal 'byor pa red pas zhal mthong ba nas snang ba 'gyur zhing dga'/ da rung sems la phan pa'i skyabs 'gro tshig gsum thugs la thogs zhes zhus pas yang gdams ngag 'di mgur du gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum// 'di gsum phyi yi skyabs 'gro yin// mi nged kyang khong la bskyabs pas 'tshing*// khyed kyang khong la skyabs na 'tshing*// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum// 'di gsum nang gi skyabs 'gro yin// mi nged kyang khong la bskyabs pas 'tshing*// khyed kyang khong la skyabs pas 'tshing*// rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum// 'di gsum gsang ba'i skyabs 'gro yin// mi kyang khong la bskyabs pas 'tshing*// khyed kyang khong la bskyabs na bzang*// snang dang stong dang dbyer med gsum// 'di gsum de kho na nyid kyi skyabs 'gro yin// mi nged kyang khong la bskyabs pas 'tshing*// khyed kyang khong la skyabs na bzang*// khyod sgyu ma lus kyi khang rul// zhag dang za ma'i char pa babs/

lo dang zla ba'i thigs pa byung*// sgyu lus khang rgan 'jig las che// 'chi bro thigs tshag 'phyis pa tsam// dpe ni nyi ma'i rgas grib bzhin// phar phar bros kyang tshur tshur 'ded/ bros pas thar pa ngas ma mthong*// chos pa 'chi ba mthong tsa na// dge sbyor bskul ba'i slob dpon yin// sdig can 'chi ba mthong tsa na// sdig sdug bskul ba'i slob dpon yin/ de la 'gyod pa ci gda' lta yang lta// phyug po 'chi ba mthong tsa na// nor sgyu mar ston pa'i slob dpon yin// de la gtong phod ci 'dug lta yang lta// rgas pa 'chi ba mthong tsa na// de mi rtag ston pa'i slob dpon yin// de la skyo shas ci 'dug lta yang lta// gzhon pa 'chi ba mthong tsa na// chos long med ston pa'i slob dpon yin// de la brtson 'grus ci 'dug lta yang lta// bde skyid pha ma'i gan na yod// dwa phrug sdug la ci cha yod// so nam 'bras bu mang du smin// las mi nus pa la ci cha yod// dro 'jam lu gu'i lpags la yod// gyon ma myong ba la ci cha yod// mgyogs pa gyi ling rta la yod// zhon ma myong pa la ci ca yod// chos byed mi tshe skyid la skyel// chos ma nus pa la ci cha yod// lto kha nas phri la sbyin par thong*// gnyid kha nas phri la dge sbyor mdzod// 'chi ba snying nas som la lha chos gyis// zhes gsungs pas rgan mo dad pa skyes nas dga' ba'i glu mang po yang byas/ skyid skyid kyi gar mang po yang byas/ bla mas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed gnang bas rang yang chos la gnas shing*/ bu tsha bo yang dge ba la bsgyur nus pa cig byung ngo*// ༈ rje btsun mi la ras pa dpon slob yul ya mtshan can gyi ding ma brin gyi shar phyogs su ldom bu la byon pa'i dus su/ yul pas bsnyen bkur spungs pa'i dus su rgan mo tha ga ma cig bsod snyoms kyis mnar bas snying rje bar dgongs nas/ a phyi ras pa 'di tsho la bsod snyoms shig zhu gsungs pas/

rgan mo nga la ster rgyu med zer nas bros pa'i tshe/ mo yi thu ba nas bzung nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yar mtho ris thar pa'i lam sna dang gcig /mar ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal dang gnyis// bar gar 'gro rang dbang mi che dang gsum// 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod der// a phyi chos dang 'khon pa'i snying med ma de min nam// ma rgan lta rtog de rang gi sems la gyis dang*// nang nub snga phyi'i sdug zer dang gcig /bu lon 'khor med kyi g.yo gtam dang gnyis// mgu ba med pa'i gsos btang gsum/ 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod 'dir// a phyi spyang la don chung gi snying med ma de yin nam// ma rgan lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis// thob tshad rku ba'i rkun ma dang gcig /ma mthong 'phrog pa'i jag pa dang gnyis/ shi rmas byed pa'i 'khrug pa dang gsum// 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod der// a phyi go kha slong ba'i snying med ma de min nam// ma rgan lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis dang*// rang gzhan skyes pa'i mal sa dang gcig /phan zhing ral po'i dug hrul dang gnyis// ma bkrus lta phor sre mo dang gsum// 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod der// a phyi za thang gi rgud pa'i snying med ma de min nam// ma rgan lta rtog de rang gi sems la gyis dang*// phyi pags pa bsdus pa'i gnyer ma dang gcig /nang sha khrag skam pa'i rus pa gnyis// bar dbang po 'on long gi tho yol dang gsum// 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod der// a phyi 'byung bzhi rgud pa'i snying med ma de min nam// ma rgan lta rtog de rang gi sems la gyis dang*// yar mtho ris rin chen gser bas dkon// mar ngan song gsum gzung sha bas kyang 'brim// bar dbang po gar 'gro cha med dang gsum// 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i dus tshod 'dir// a phyi ngan song gsum 'gro ba'i snying med ma de min nam// ma rgan lta rtog de rang gi sems la gyis dang*// zhes gsungs nas bzhud de/

rgan mos phyag 'tshal thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ thugs la brtags te ma rang gi zhing them btsongs nas bsgoms pas sgom ma bzang mo byung skad do// yang rje btsun dang ras chung pa dpon slob gnyis/ rgya lcags ri gong bya ba chu chen po 'babs pa'i 'gram na phyir byon pa las/ pha ri na bu mo gnyis phyir thal nas khrus byas me long la blta zhing 'dug pas/ bu mo chung ba de na re/ rnal 'byor pa pha ri gnyis 'dra bas rgyal khams 'grim nas ci 'dod pa yin zer ba la/ che ba de na re/ nged rang gnyis 'dra ba la pha phyug gi bu mo gzugs legs pa gos nor 'dzom pa re 'dod nas 'gro ba e ma yin zer bas/ chung ba de na re/ de e yin tshe phyi ma sangs rgyas 'dod nas 'gro ba e ma yin zer skad/ de nas chu de'i zam sngas su 'phrad pa dang*/ rje btsun gyis ras chung pa la bu mo gnyis kyi thu ba la 'gyus shig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// mi kun gyis mi lus mi lus zer// mi lus rtswa kha'i zil pa 'dra// snga dro chags kyang phyi dro 'jig /chags 'jig mthong bas blo ba bde// chags 'jig med pa'i sems la ltos/ yang ltos yang ltos sems la ltos// lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis// bsam mno rang gi sems la thong*// mi kun gyis mi tshe mi tshe zer// mi tshe brag la chu 'bab 'dra// tshe dal cig 'gying long mi gda' na// tshe 'gying long med pa'i sems la ltos// yang ltos yang ltos sems la ltos// lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis// bsam mno rang gi sems la thong*/ mi kun gyis nor rdzas nor rdzas zer// nor rdzas sbrang mas rtsi gsog 'dra// nor bdag pos bsags pa gzhan gyis spyad/ bdag gsog gzhan gyis spyad pas blo ma bde// yang ltos yang ltos sems la ltos// lta rtog rang gi sems la gyis// bsam mno rang gi sems la thong*// khyod gzhon nu kun gyi snying lam na// na ba 'ong snyam mi gda' ste/

nad thog bab tshul du 'ong nyan gda'// rgas pa 'ong snyam mi gda' ste// rgas sgo nyal thabs su 'ong nyan gda'// 'chi ba 'ong snyam mi gda' ste// 'chi ba glo bur du 'ong nyan gda'// nga na dang rgas dang 'chi dang gsum/ nyi ma thal ka'i grib so bzhin// phar phar bros kyang tshur tshur 'dod// bros kyang thar ba ngas ma mthong*// sang nyin 'chi ba'i dus byung tshe// dpa' bos ral kha sprad du med/ glang snying can la ci cha yod// phyug po'i nor gyis bslus pa med// sdug sogs mkhan la ci cha yod// mdzangs pas zas kyis bslus sa med// ser sna can la ci cha yod// skye yag bzhin gyis bslu sa med// nga chu khrus mkhan la ci cha yod// byis pas gces skad byed sa med// sdug yul mkhan la ci cha yod// dam tshig sa mdo'i mkhar khang 'dra// gang bsrung bsrung tsho de rgyal nas gda'// zhes gsungs pas/ bu mo chung ba de'i nor g.yu kun rje btsun la phul nas chos byed par khas blangs pas// rje btsun gyis gtum mo'i khrid gnang nas bsgoms pas/ lo sar sgang la ras rkyang gis chog pa'i ras ma ngo mtshar can cig byung skad do// yang dus der bande mkhas btsun ldan pa yin zer ba dpon slob gsum pa cig byung nas mar ril gcig phyag rten byas te/ rje btsun lags nyams len sla ba don lta ba la khams che ba'i gdams ngag cig zhu zhus pas// gson dang dge bshes chos mdzad kun// med thabs med pa'i gtam zhig 'chad// dad dang mkhas dang btsun dang gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi srog shing la// btsugs na brtan la 'gyu na bde/ srog shing mdzad na de la mdzod// chags med rmongs med sdang med gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi go cha lags// gyon la yang la mtshon khar sra// go cha mdzad na de la mdzod// sgom dang brtson dang bsran tshugs gsum// 'di gsum sems kyi rta pho lags// bros na thar la bdas na zin// rta pho mdzad na de la mdzod// rang rig rang gsal rtog med gsum// 'di gsum sems gyi 'bras bu lags/

btab na sman la bza' na dug /'bras bu mdzad na de la mdzod// sems don bcu gnyis bya ba yin// nga shes rab mtshon chen khong nas 'phye// lar chos mdzad rnams la 'di rnams gces// 'di rnams 'dzoms pa brgya la 'ga'// de phyir yon tan thob pa dka'// zhes sems don bcu gnyis bya ba de gsungs pas ston pa dad nas gdams ngag zhus te bsgoms pas nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la 'khrungs pa lags so// de thams cad a phyi snang ma la sogs pa'i skor ro// de nas yang rje btsun dang se ban ras pa dpon slob bsod snyoms la lcim lu nga chu mtha' mkhar bu la byon pa'i dus su/ ngan rdzong byang chub 'bar zhing rmo zhing 'dug pa la yon bdag khyod phyug po zhig yin zer bas/ rnal 'byor pa nged gnyis la de ring nyin skor gyi 'tsho ba zhig slong dgos gsungs pas/ kho na re/ bzhes pa drang bas chog /nyid rnal 'byor pa bzang po yin na snang ba dper rgyu 'dren shes pa yin pas/ nga yi zhing rmo ba 'di bstun pa'i mgur cig gsungs bar zhu zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje sgra bsgyur rgyal po rin po che// sgom gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'o na yon bdag khe grags can// khyod ngan rdzong phyug po tshur nyon dang*// yang dpyid ka sos ka'i zla ba la// bod mi res zhing re rmo tsam na// rnal 'byor ngas kyang zhing cig rmo// nyon mongs thal ba'i zhing sa la// gnyis med glang po dor sdeb nas// shes rab ldan pa'i thong gshol btags// dam tshig ldan pas sna khrid de// yeng ba med par thong btsugs nas// brtson 'grus myur ba'i lcag gis brab// tha ba sra yang phed de mchi// byang chub myu gu 'khrungs te mchi// 'bras bu myur du smin te mchi// khyed 'jig rten 'di yi so nam mkhan// nga skye ba gtan gyi so nam mkhan// ston thog su mang lta yang lta// nam phug su skyid lta yang lta// de snang ba dpe ru drangs pa yin// so nam dbyangs su blangs pa yin/

thugs dgyes par mdzod cig khe grags can// khyed rang don lags so tshogs gsog mdzod// ces zhing sa dang bstun pa'i mgur 'di gsungs pas/ yon bdag na re// 'o na rnal 'byor pa khyed rang gi phyag na bsnams pa'i sba lcag de'i brda don ci lags/ de la dgos pa ci 'dug zhus pas yang rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o na yon bdag dri rtog mkhan/ khyod sbyin shugs can de tshur nyon dang*// mi nga ngo khyod kyis shes ma shes// kho bo mi la ras pa yin// dka' ba spyad pa'i gang zag yin// snying rus byas pa'i sgom chen yin// phyogs 'dzin spangs pa'i rnal 'byor yin// 'khrul rtog med pa'i ras pa yin// nga yi lag na bzung ba'i sba dkar 'di// dang po rgya brag logs la skyes// bar du rgya zor 'gug mos brngas// tha ma sha breng mnyen la drangs// 'ong ni lho kha'i mon nas 'ong*// bkal ni theg chen mdzo la bkal// 'grim ni tshong 'dus rnams sus 'grims// phul ni dad pa can gyis phul// da lta nga yi ber ma lcag /'di don khyod kyi go ma go /'di don khyed kyis ma go na// 'di don bshad kyis legs par nyon/ sba ma thog rtsa ba bcad pa de// 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa gcod pa'i rtags// sba ya thog rtse mo bcad pa de// the tshom gol sa bcad pa'i rtags// nga khru do tshad du bor ba de// chos pa'i tshad rdo bor ba'i rtags// sba rgyu bzang zhing mnyan pa de// gzhi sems bskyed ye nas bzang ba'i rtags// sba rtsi 'jam kha dog legs pa de// sems gnyug ma'i don la sbyangs pa'i rtags// sba drang la ldem par 'dug pa de// don ma nor nyams su len pa'i rtags// sba la lung sul 'dug pa de// byang chub lam du 'khrid pa'i rtags// sba dum bu bzhi ru 'dug pa de// tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtags// sba tshigs pa gsum 'dug pa de// gzhi la sku gsum tshang ba'i rtags/ sba kha dog bsgyur du med pa de// chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags// sba snum la 'dril ba 'dug pa de// chos nyid spros dang bral ba'i rtags// sba ye nas dkar zhing 'tsher ba de// chos sku dri ma med pa'i rtags// sba la sbu gu 'dug pa de// chos rnams thams cad stong pa'i rtags// sba la sme ba 'dug pa de// chos thig le nyag cig go ba'i rtags// nag po rtsag rtsig 'dug pa de// bod kyi rnal 'byor ras pa la// rnam rtog phra mo yod pa'i rtags// sba cho rigs ye nas btsun pa de// chos tshul bzhin nyams su len pa'i rtags// sba gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba de// 'gro ba dad cing 'dun pa'i rtags// sba zhabs lcags kyis bkor ba de// rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grim pa'i rtags// chang zung zangs kyis dril ba de// ḍā ki dbang du 'du ba'i rtags// sba la lcags 'dzer btab pa de// rnal 'byor snying rus che ba'i rtags// ra gan gser long btags pa de// nang gi yon tan rgyas pa'i rtags// de la sha bring btags pa de// rnal 'byor shes pa mnyen pa'i rtags// lcag 'bras gnyis su sgril ba de// zung 'jug lam du khyer ba'i rtags// rus pa'i a long btags pa de// rnal 'byor rgyal khams 'grim pa'i rtags// me cha khug ma btags pa de// cir snang grogs su shar ba'i rtags// dung long ya ko btags pa de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rtags// gcan gzan ras mo btags pa de// nyam nga bag tsha med pa'i rtags// me long spu gri btags pa de// rtogs tshad nang nas shar ba dang*// nyon mongs zug rngu gcod pa'i rtags// shel sgong nyag gcig btags pa de// bag chags dri ma spangs pa'i rtags// ba so'i phreng ba btags pa de// bla ma yid la 'phreng ba'i rtags// dril bu g.yer kha btags pa de// snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrogs pa'i rtags// snam ras dkar dmar btags pa de// bu slob mang po 'khor ba'i rtags/

lcag 'bras ma bu 'dzom pa de// sku gsum ma dang mjal ba'i/ rtags// rnal 'byor lag na mdzes pa de// mi nag thabs kyis 'dul ba'i rtags// de don gang lags 'dri ba yang*/ mos gus bag chags yod pa'i rtags// khyod dang nga gnyis 'phrad pa yang*// sngon chad smon lam btab pa'i rtags// sba lcag dkar po rtags kyi glu// brda go bar 'dug gam lha mi kun// don chos su gda'o dad gus can// khyod yun du skyid kyi lha chos mdzod// ces sba lcag dkar po chos dang bstun pa'i mgur de gsungs pas yon bdag kho lhag par dad pa skyes te bdag ma shi'i bar du mchod gnas la gdan phab nas bzhugs par zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ zhag bdun las bzhugs par ma bzhed de// bzhud kar rje btsun cis kyang gshegs na khyed rang gi thugs nyams su 'khrungs pa'i sgom nyams tshig gsum gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// e ma yon bdag dad pa can// khyod phyug po mdo med tshur nyon dang*// chos kha la sla ste don la dka'// khyed cag phyi ltar 'jig rten pa// yod du re la nam bla 'das// lar ni dam chos bgyis na legs// g.ya' yi chu mig bsil gsum po// nad mkhris pa sel bar cha mchis te// lha bya gong mo ma lags pa'i// ri dwags dman la btung dbang med// gnam lcags thog gi ral gri de// g.yul ngo zlog par cha mchis te// glang chen sa srung ma lags pa'i/ glang phran gzhan la btags dbang med// 'chi med lha yi bdud rtsi de// bcud len grub par cha mchis te// slob dpon klu sgrub ma lags pa'i// phal pa gzhan la spyod dbang med// rgya mtsho'i gting gi rin po che/ dgos 'dod 'byung bar cha mchis te// klu dga' bo 'jog po ma lags pa'i// 'dzam gling mi la spyod dbang med// dga' ldan lha yi pho brang de// gzigs mo che bar cha mchis te/ slob dpon thogs med ma lags pa'i// gang zag gzhan gyis mthong dbang med// bzang drug sman gyi nus pa de// nad tsha grang 'joms par cha mchis kyang*// shing tsan dan sdong po ma lags pa'i// shing phal pa rnams la yongs mi smin// las rgyu 'bras dkar po'i dge ba bcus// mtho ris 'thob par cha mchis te// mi dad pa can cig ma lags pa'i// sdig po che la spyad dbang med// bka' brgyud lung dang man ngag gsum// byang chub thob par cha mchis te/

mi las 'phro can cig ma lags pa'i// skal med rnams la spyad dbang med// snyan brgyud gdams ngag rin po che// mngon sangs rgyas par cha mchis te// mi snying rus can cig ma lags pa'i// g.yeng ba can la bsgom dbang med/ bza' btung zas kyi tshogs 'khor de// bkres skom sel bar cha mchis te// khyod skyor mo 'dren ne ma lags pa'i// ser sna can la spyod dbang med// zang zing nor gyi gtong phod de// rang brgyags yin par cha mchis te// khyod ngan rdzong phyug po ma lags pa'i// nor yod dgu cig gi gtong mi phod// nga gung thang gi rnal 'byor mi la dang*/ nye gnas se ban ras pa gnyis// khyod lcim lung gi ngan rdzong phyug po gsum// zhag bdun bar du mal sa gcig /de smon lam 'brel ba bzhag pa yin// da ni mi sdod 'khyam du 'gro// khyod yon bdag bza' bran 'khor bcas rnams// tshe ring nad med smon lam 'tshal// zhes g.ya' yi chu mig bsil gsum ma bya ba de gsungs nas yon bdag khyod kyis nga la zas byin/ ngas khyod la chos bshad/ nyal ba'i gnas byas pa dang gsum po de gal che ba yin/ lar mos pa'i sems kyi sa bon bya ba dus rtag tu dad pa byas tshe phyi mar lhan cig skye ba'i rgyu yin/ smon lam gyi 'brel pa bzhag pa chos mang po bshad mi dgos/ yun ring por 'grogs mi dgos/ dmigs pa yul gyi rkyen dang mos pa sems kyi sa bon 'dzom na dal cig bsnon yang smon lam gyi stobs 'joms nas 'ong ba yin pas/ sems 'phrod cing 'dun pa gal che/ dus deng sang bsod nams ma bsags pas/ nang du yon tan mang po yod pa mi mthong*/ phyi yi skyon bag re yod pa de mthong ba yin/ mos pa byed pa la nga dang thag nye ring med/ thag nye ring ha cang mdzad ches na/ mjug tu 'khon shugs can 'gro ba yin/ khyod kyi chos byed pa mi 'ong*/ bag kyi slob dgos ngas kyang khyed la smon lam gdab/ khyed kyang nga la gsol ba thob/

mos gus bskyed/ dus da lta'i spyod lam 'di las ma 'gyur na/ tshe phyi ma yang skye gnas khyad par can dang*/ longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa la gdon mi za/ chos byed pa la rgyal khams mang po 'grim mi dgos/ slar yang ngan spyod mang po mthong tsa na shes pa sgrin du 'gro ba yin/ khyod mi chos pa'i chos de rang yul na bzang ba yin/ tshogs zhor la bsags/ sems bskyed kyis zin na sprang po la yon myur du byin pa gcig pus chog /chos rang 'di yin bya ba bzang po cig log na med/ nged cag gi lad mo khyod kyis mi 'ong*/ seng ge mchong sa na wa mchongs pas rked pa 'chag /chos pa phal cher gyis mi 'ong bar gda'/ de bas khyed rang khyim pas ga gi /de las ma 'gyur gsungs nas bzhud do// yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pas ri sna'i nyag gcig tu skyes thung byas te/ khyed ri khrod phyogs med du bzhud par 'dug pas/ da e mjal yang mi shes nges rnams la gdams ngag smon lam dang bcas pa zhig gnang bar zhu zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can gyis bskyab tu gsol// mtho la yangs pa'i dgung sngon dang gcig /de la 'khor ba'i khri gdugs dang gnyis// gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yang yud tsam// nyi zla gling bzhi bskor du 'gro// dgung sngon sku khams ci bder bzhugs// nga nyi zla gza' yis ma zin cing*// dgung sngon sprin gyis ma sgrib na// yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal// pha ri logs kyi spang rgyan dang gcig /de la 'khor ba'i bung ba dang gnyis/ gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yang yud tsam// nga bung ba rtsi bcud len du 'gro// me tog sku khams ci bder bzhugs// nga bung ba ser bas ma brdung zhing*// me tog sad kyis ma khyer bar// yang yang mjal ba'i smon ma 'tshal// phu gsum brag ri gzar po dang*// de la 'khor ba'i bya rgyal gnyis// gnas skabs 'brel pa yang yud tsam// nga bya rgyal nam 'phang bskyod du 'gro// brag ri sku khams ci bder bzhugs// bya rgyal rnyi yis ma zin cing*/

brag ri thog gis ma bshig par// yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal// rgyun du 'bab pa'i gtsang chab dang gcig /de la 'phyo ba'i nya mo dang gnyis// gnas skabs kyi 'brel pa yang yud tsam// nya mo chu mtha' bskor du 'gro// gtsang chab sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ gtsang chab than pas ma bskam zhing*// nya mo dol gyis ma zin par// yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal// 'dir bzhugs yon bdag pho mo dang gcig /nga rgyal khams mi la ras pa gnyis// gnas skabs kyi 'brel ba yang yud tsam// rnal 'byor khyi yis ma phug cing*/ yon bdag gum chad ma byung bar// yang yang mjal ba'i smon lam 'tshal// zhes pa'i mgur smon lam zhal gdams dang bcas pa de gsungs/ de nas rje btsun bzhud khar ngan rdzong phyug po la ga la lang bcu drug ma 'di gsungs so// ngo srung thag pa ma bcad na/ mi sems bzung bas ga la lang*// zhen med ldom bu ma byas na// bsnyen bkur sgrub pas ga la lang*// chog shes 'phral phyid ma byas na// zas nor gsog pas ga la lang*/ brjod med don cig ma rtogs na// tha snyad brjod pas ga la lang*// dpe med don cig ma rtogs na// yig nag bris pas ga la lang*// rkyen ngan grogs su ma shar na// sdug bsngal spangs pas ga la lang*// dug lnga lam du ma slong na// gnyen po brten pas ga la lang*// rnam rtog chos skur ma shes na// dran snang bkag pas ga la lang*// las bya bsam rgyab tu ma bskyur na// dgos 'dod sgrub pas ga la lang*// byar med zhen thag ma bcad na// sems bya blo sgrub pas ga la lang*// da lta rbad chod ma byas na// las 'phro bsgugs pas ga la lang*// rang nyid dam chos ma sgrub na// gzhan gyis sgrub pas ga la lang*// da lta btsan grol ma byas na/ shugs grol re bas ga la lang*// da lta sems rtsal ma sbyangs na// shugs 'byung re bas ga la lang*// da lta thog chod ma byas na// byang sems byas pas ga la lang*// da lta brdar sha ma chod na// phyis chod du re bas ga la lang*// zhes gsungs so// yang gsungs pa// 'du ba rnam bzhi 'dres pa yi// lus la na tsha med na bde// gtum mo me ltar 'bar ba yi// 'khyag pa'i bsam pa med de bde// sems la 'od gsal shar ba yis// skye med ngo bo mthong ste bde// khams kyi zas dang ma bral yang*// dad pa can gyis btegs te bde// dpon med g.yog med ngang gis bde// 'di zhes bya ba'i hang spyod bde// 'di las bde ba log na med// ces bde ba drug gi mgur gsungs so// de thams cad sba mgur skor gyi ro/// /de nas rje btsun chen po dpon slob gnyis rtsibs ri la byon te/

sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus su rje btsun chen po'i thugs dgongs la/ ngas sgrub pa byas pa'i gnas mang du yod kyang 'di'i rtogs pa tsam ye ma byung bas 'di la bstod pa cig byed dgos gsungs nas/ rje bla'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas byin rlabs can gyi rtsibs ri na// sngon dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bzhugs sa yod// da lta mi la ras pa'i sgom g.yas yod// gnas byin rlabs can gyi rtsibs ri na// gnas chu thag ring ste lam thag nye// shing phung dkon yang gdams ngag mod// gnas byin rlabs can gyi rtsibs ri na// 'tsho ba dkon te bsam gtan 'phel// yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog bzhugs// de mchog gi dngos grub ster ba'i lha// gnas byin rlabs can gyi rtsibs ri na// chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral bzhugs// de bar chad sel ba'i chos skyong yin// dus ngan gyi gnas dgon chags sdang rgyu// nga mi la sgom chen bsgom du 'gro// gnas rdzong drug la bsgom du 'gro// zhes gsungs so/// /de nas bco lnga pa byin rlabs che ba'i yon tan ni/ rje lo tsā chen po'i thugs kyi sras// sgrub pa mthar phyin dngos grub brnyes// skal ldan gdung ba sel mdzad pa// rje ras pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun chen po de nyid dbyar rgyal gyi rtsibs ri'i lho phyogs su bsgom zhing bzhugs/ de nas khu byug dben pa dang*/ skyid pa nyi ma rdzong la 'byon dgongs nas ston btsas ma'i dus su ldom bu la byon te/ grong po thang gi gnas der gzims nas bzhugs pa'i rmi lam du bud med sngo sangs la sma ra se khyug ge ba yod pa gcig gis khye'u lo nyi shu lon pa cig khrid de byung nas/ rnal 'byor pa khyod la snying tshal pa brgyad yod pa cig 'di'i dbang ba yin pas 'di la byin cig zer nas mi snang bar gyur to// der rje btsun mnal sad pa dang*/ thugs dgongs la bud med de ḍā ki mar 'dug

/spyir nga la las can gyi slob ma mthar phyin pa brgyad 'ong ba'i ltas yin pa la/ khyad par du de ring gi nyi ma la las sad pa'i gang zag dbang po yang rab gcig dang 'phrad de 'ong*/ de la nges par phan btags dgos snyam pa cig byung bas lam bong shod ngos nas mar byon te/ chu mig dngul 'bum gyi rtsar phyin nas gzims nas bzhugs tsa/ khye'u chung lo nyi shu lon pa rta 'ol ba zhon pa cig byung nas/ rnal 'byor pa khyod der nyal nas ci byed zer/ der rje btsun gyis yon bdag khyed gang du 'gro gsungs pas/ kho na re/ chu phar khar brgal nas ding ri khog sna ru 'gro zer/ 'o na rnal 'byor pa rgad po chu la ma thar pa yin/ yon bdag gis rta rgyab tu bskyon dgos gsungs pa/ kho na re/ nga shar phyogs su ltad mo bsnyags reng par yod/ khyed kyis zhon pas nga yi rta la gnod zer nas/ rje btsun bsgugs su ma nyan pas sngon la song bas/ rje btsun gyis mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang la rlung bzung nas byon pas/ chu yi thog nas phar la yal le gshegs skad/ phyi mig cig gzigs pas kho sngon la song ba de gzod chu yis dkyil na rba skya pha la la 'ong zhing snang*/ yon bdag gis bltas pas rjes btsun chu la mi bying bar gshegs pa mthong yang da rung yid ma ches nas/ nga mig 'khrul pa yin nam khong snying thag pa nas chu la mi bying bas yin nam snyam nas chu khar phyin pa dang*/ bla mar der bzhugs dang byas nas drung du phyin te zhabs la bltas pas/ zhabs kyi mthe'u chung yang chung la ma reg par 'dug skad/ der kho dad pa dung nge ba cig skyes te/ bla ma grub thob 'dug pa ngo ma shes nas/ da ci rta la ma bskyon pa bzod par bzhes 'tshal zer nas/ da gzod rje btsun la khos phyag mang po 'tshal/ zhabs spyi bor blangs/ mos gus skyes nas bla ma la zhus pas/ bla ma lags/ khyed kyi yul phyogs ni gang lags/ slob gnyer ni gang bgyis/ bla ma ni ji skad bya ba lags/

dgon pa ni gang su bdog /thugs nyams ni ji lta bus bzhes/ da nang gang nas byon/ do nub gang du 'byon zer bas rgyu mtshan zhib tu dris pas/ rje btsun gyis kho yi lo rgyus zhib tu dris pa la rje btsun gyis kho yi lo rgyus kyi lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o na khye'u chung bzhin legs po// bu rtog 'dod can de tshur nyon dang*// mi nga ngo khyod kyis shes ma shes// mi nga ngo khyod kyis ma shes na// mi nga rang mi la ras pa yin// lte ba gung thang smad la bcad// slob gnyer dbus gtsang stod du bgyis// rga mi dang dgyes ston dbu mdzad pa'i// rong ston lha dga' yan chad du// drin chen bla ma bcu tsam bzhugs// khong lta sgom gyi phyogs la mkhyen pa mtho// chos ni rgyud sems sngags 'gyur nyan// khyad par lha rje gnubs chung la// drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag zhus// khong bsnyen sgrub phyag len mkhas lags kyang*// mi kho bo'i spros pa cung ma chod// rje nā ro me tris byin rlabs pa'i// sems sku gsum ma dang ngo sprod cing*// lus rten 'brel gnad du bsnun pa cig /lho chus khyer kha na bzhugs so skad// rje lo tsā'i snyan pa rgyang nas khum// mtshan thos pa tsam gyi ba spu g.yos// lam dka' ba spyad de spyan sngar phyin// zhal mthong ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur// khong tshe rabs kyi bla ma yin par nges// rje 'gran gyi do med lho brag pa// pha bka' drin can gyi bla ma la/ nor zang zing bsnyen bkur bdag la med// lus ngag gi zhabs tog rdul du brlag /rgyud zab mo ston pa'i kyai rdor nyan// khyad par nā ro'i chos drug zhus// byin rlabs can gyi bde mchog la// smin lam dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob// chos phyag rgya chen po la ngo sprod byas// don gnyug ma sems kyi ngo bor mthong*// gzhi chos nyid skye ba med par rtogs// spyir snyan brgyud chu bo rnam bzhi la// gdams ngag zab mo spu thus byas// gnas zab dgu bcud kyi don snying phyung*// sgom ni rtsa rlung thig le bsgoms// rlung sems gnyis la rang dbang thob// nad 'du ba rnam bzhi gcig tu 'dres// phyi 'byung ba chu la nyam nga med// mi khyed la nyams tshad byas pa tsam// sgom pa rgyal gyi rtsibs ri yin// gdugs da nang gung thang stod nas yong*// do nub gar 'gro nges pa med// nga rnal 'byor gyi byung tshul de ltar lags// bu khye'u skyid do ci bder gshegs// zhes gsungs pas/

kho lhag par dad pa skyes nas phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas/ zhabs spyi bor blangs nas rta yi mthur mda' rje btsun gyi phyag tu phul nas/ nga yi rta 'di yang khyed la 'bul/ bka' drin chos shig kyang zhu zer nas zhu don glu ru blangs pa/ yang sngar ma mthong ba'i grub thob cig /mi las 'das pa'i skyes bu zhig /zhal mjal bar dka' ba'i grub thob cig /gsungs thos par dka' ba sangs rgyas shig /mtshan yang de'u thos de'u ma thos// zhal yang de'u mjal de'u ma mjal// phyag kyang de'u 'tshal de'u ma 'tshal/ lam yang de'u bzung de'u ma bzung*// bsnyun yang de'u dris de'u ma dres// lar dri'o 'gyod kyang re 'gyod na// rje thugs kyis khrel te bzod par gsol// rta 'ol ba rlung gi gshog pa can// mgul don g.yer kha'i gzeng bstod nas// cho ris can gyi g.yang shun dang*// dro la 'bol ba'i rtsid stan gtad// btsun po be gar sga bkra gtad// mdo ma lcag kyi chab mas mnan// gong smed breng dmar pho long mdud// grod tshem 'phrul gyi srab mgo la// stag ras 'dzum gyis smin khyug btang*// ra gan 'dzer gyi 'bur mgo btab// 'bu chen skar chen shar ba 'dra// srab skyong blon po kha bsgyur te// sba lcag dkar pos bka' nan phab// nged btsad po'i pha shig byed tsa na// rta gyi ling mgyogs dar btsugs pa'i dus// dkyus dar thag chod pa'i rta pho yin// bdas na dgung gi bya yang sleb// bros na 'chi bdag bdud las thar// nged 'jig rten pa yi che rtags yin// de ring rje btsun khyed la 'bul// bdag gri bo dmyal bar mi gtong 'tshal// de skad zhus nas rta phul bas rje btsun gyi rta ma bzhes te/ khyod kyi rta ngas mi 'dod/ de bas lhag pa'i rta 'di 'dra yod/ de bas khyed rang nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu yon bdag phyug po tshur nyon dang*// ngas rnam shes rlung gi rta pho la// mnyam bzhag dar gyi gzer bstod nas// rjes thob sgyu ma'i g.yang shun dang*// rang rig gsal ba'i sga gtad nas// gzer dmigs pa gsum gyi glo yis mnan// sgom gsum man ngag gong smed byas// srog rtsol rlung gi srab mgo la// dus sna rtse gsum gyi smin khyug btang*// gnad zhi rba rlabs 'bur mgo btab// 'khrul 'khor las kyi kha bsgyur te// nyams chu bo'i rgyun gyi lcag gis brab/

rtsa dbu ma'i thang la dkyus thag bcad// bros na 'khor ba'i 'dam las thar// bsnyags na byang chub skam sar snyegs// de rnal 'byor nga yi rta pho yin// bu khyod kyi 'ol ba ngas mi 'dod// khye'u chung skyid do ci bder gshegs// zhes gsungs nas rta ma bzhes nas/ yang kho yis bsam pa la rta mi bzhed na yang zhabs rjen par snang bas/ lham e mi bzhes bsam nas rje btsun rta mi bzhed na/ yang lham 'di bzhes par zhu zhes lham phud nas zhu ba phul ba/ 'o na skyes mchog rin po che// yul la zhen pa ma mchis pas// rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims pa la// mtshon kha na thogs pa'i zhe sdang can/ dud 'gro khyi yis zhabs la sdang*// gcong rong tsher ma zhabs la gzan// zhabs rjen par bzhugs pa 'o re brgyal// rkyang lham sngon mo'i nyel phran can// rin thang can gyi sag lham la// spyan sngar mdzes pa'i skud ris btang*// ra gan 'bur gyi 'dzer mgo btab/ rgyu gung thang stod kyi kha sha dang*// khu mi 'brong gi smad ko gnyis// bzo bo mkhas pa'i mtshams sbyar nas// 'bur span thag can gyi lham sgrog la// seng thod chu ris 'phar ma non// de khye'u chung nga yi rkang lham yin// pha rje btsun zhabs la 'di 'bul gyis// bdag la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol// zhes zhus pas kyang lham ma bzhed de/ rje btsun gyis/ bu khyod kyi lham ngas mi 'dod/ de bas lhag pa'i lham 'di lta bu nga rang la yod gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/ bu khye'u chung nyon dang lce bde po// spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i pha yul na// ma rig mun pa'i smag rum 'thibs// 'dod chags nel thang 'dam rdzab che// phrag dog gram rong tsher mas rtsub// zhe sdang khyi rgan zug cing za// nga rgyal brag ri gzar la mtho// da chu bo bzhi las phyir brgal nas// bde chen thar la 'bros kyang 'tshal// rgyu mi rtag sgyu ma'i kha sha dang*// 'khor ba glo log ko ba gnyis/ rgyu 'bras yid ches mtshams sbyar nas// 'dod yon sna tshogs sngon bran btang*// rang snang zhan med za 'og la// sgrub pa nyams len rag 'bur btab// zab gnad kyi chab mas bcing*// de rnal 'byor nga yi rkang lham yin// bu khyod kyi 'bur ma ngas mi 'dod// bu khye'u chung skyid do rang 'gros snyogs// zhes gsungs pa/

kho yi bsam pa la/ lham mi bzhes pa'ang na bza' ras rkyang gcig las mi snang bas/ ma gos kyi ke tse dmar ljang 'di 'bul bas cis kyang bzhes par zhu zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/ rje grub thob rnal 'byor rin po che// gnas la nges pa ma mchis pas// gza' gtad med par des// res 'ga' ri bo'i rtse la gzims// res 'ga' grong khyer srang mdor gzims// ras rkyang na bza' med dang 'dra// pha rje btsun 'o brgyal bsil te mchis// bdag khye'u chung lus la gon pa 'di// rgyu srin chu me ti dmar ljang la/ bzo bo mkhas kyis dras su sdebs// nang srin dkar rdel sna'i nang tshang can// thang dkar za 'og gzer dras la// gong skor pho long legs par mdzes// gu lang dar gyi dpung kheb can// rma chu sri yis cha ga btang*/ 'di gyon na yang la dpa' brjid che// skyid ser rlung la nyam nga med// spyir zhang blon dra ma'i na bza' yin// pha rje btsun sku la 'di gsol bas// bu bdag la bka' drin gnang bar zhu// zhes zhus pas ber ma bzhes te/ khyed kyi de bas lhag pa'i ber 'di lta bu nga rang la yod gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pas/ 'o na khye'u dad pa can// spyir rigs drug 'khor ba'i grong khyer na// las ngan rlung gi bdas bdas nas// rang dbang med par rnam shes 'khor// skye 'chi bar do'i thang la 'khyams// rmi lam bar do'i ri rtser phyin// srid pa bar do'i srang mdor nyal// da gnyug ma'i gtan yul bsnyags kyang 'tshal// rgyu rnam dag dkar po'i srin chu la/ dam tshig sdom pa'i dar gyis g.yogs// dra dang se bzhin bzo bos drub// dbyibs rnal 'byor gsum gyi thang ka la// gnad ba gsum gyi 'phar non btang*// 'da' ka 'od gsal dpung ka can// dag pa sgyu lus gong ba btags// bar do ngos spyod cha ga btang*// de rnal 'byor nga yi ke tse yin// bu khyod kyi dmar ljang ngas mi 'dod// bu yon bdag skyid do ci bder gshegs// zhes gsungs nas ber ma bzhes/

yang khos sher gyi steng g.yogs re'u phrug 'di bzhes pas zhu zer nas zhu don glu ru blangs pa/ 'o na skyes mchog rin po che// dbyar zla gsum drod kyi rgyal mo 'char// bya khu byug gsung snyan sgrogs pa'i dus// sku gcer bur bzhugs kyang cung mi bsil// dgun zla gsum sa gzhi drod dang bral// ras rkyang na bza' dar bas srab// lor sar lhag pa mda' bas tsha// rje btsun 'o brgyal bsil te mchi// dmar ljang ke tse'i stod g.yogs 'di// rgyu cho ris can gyi ras dkar la// mon dar smug po'i cha ga btang*// thong kha za 'og gzong dras la// dar tshon lnga yi srub mas btum// gor skor pho long sen thabs ris// 'di khye'u chung nga yi chas gos yin// rje khyed kyi na bzar 'bul lags kyis// mi bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol// zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis ma bzhes te/ bu khyod kyi de bas lhag pa'i gos nga rang la yod/ de bas khyed rang nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas/ khyod pha drin can de tshur nyon dang*// nga ma rig 'khrul pas khrid khrid nas// ma mthong 'jigs pa'i g.yang sar phyin// nyon mongs rlung dmar tsha grang che// las ngan rnam smin char bzhin 'bab// de thar pa'i grong du 'bros kyang 'tshal// sgyu ma a shad gtum mo'i ras dkar la// rtsa 'khor lo bzhi yi thang ka can// rlung sems kha sbyor cha ga btang*// thig le 'bar 'jag za 'og la// bde stong zung 'jug srub mas bde// lhan cig skyes pa gtum mo yi// gtum mo'i gos la dbyar dgun med// phyi ltar bal po ras gos mdzes// ras gos rkyang gcig yang la bde// khyed kyi chas gos ngas mi 'dod// de bas yon bdag khyim du bzhud// zhes gsungs nas ma bzhes pas/ khye'u chung gis yang zhu don phul ba/ rje btsun lags/ khyed kyi na bza' ma bzhes na'ang khar sang snga mo nas yun ring nas sgrub pa mdzad gda' bas/ sku khams zhan nas yod de mchi bas/

bdag gi byang thod 'di 'bul bas skrubs cig la bsgyur la sku khams gso bar zhu zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba/ 'o na skyes mchog rnal 'byor pa// khyed 'khor ba'i chos la skyo ba skyes// lam skye 'chi gnyis las sgrol ba de// rtse gcig sangs rgyas mdzad dgongs te// dka' ba nyams su len len nas// 'o brgyal bsil ma skyes te mchi// bdag gi mgo la gyon pa 'di// byang thod rgya skar zil pa can// ya mtshan can gyi lcags kar la// 'phrul mgar mkhas kyi bzo rlabs kyis// 'bur sen thabs chu srin phya ma nang dang*// bya rgod thang dkar ldem 'phru btsugs// chu srin sram gyi mgul rgyan can/ btsun po shel phan mgul 'ching byas// 'di btsong na che rgod g.yag cig re/ rje sprul sku khyed la 'bul lags kyi// bcud khra bo skrubs la bsgyur mdzod la// pha rje btsun sku khams gso bar zhu// dbyar dgun chag phyir bdag 'brang zhu// zhes gsol ba btab pas rje btsun gis ma bzhes te/ bu khyod kyi byang thod ngas mi 'dod// de bas lhag pa'i bya thod 'di lta bu nga rang la yod gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs pa/ bu khye'u chung nyon dang mig ma 'phrul/ nged nā ro pan chen bu brgyud 'di// lam rten 'brel gnas la mnga' brnyes shing*// thabs zab mo'i sgom pa mthar phyin pas// 'byung ba rlung la nga mi 'jigs// bcud khra bo sha la rag las med// grang rlung ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// mi bdag gi spyi gtsug cod pan la// rgyan nyi zla ltar gsal mdzes pa 'di// rje yid bzhin nor bu sprul pa'i sku// mtshan yongs su grags pa'i lo tsā ba// khong dur khrod rgyan gyis mdzes bar bzhugs/ khyod gus pa'i mig gis lta shes na// dpal rdo rje 'chang dang zhal yang mjal// thugs brtse bas bu bzhin skyong bar nges// de sbas pa nang gi dbu rgyan yin// phyi ltar rgya gar paṇa zhu mdzes/ des yal 'bor nga yi byang thod yin// mi khyod kyi byang thod nga mi 'dod// bu khye'u chung skyid do 'gro sa snyogs// zhes gsungs pas/
