yang kho yi bsam pa la/ rje btsun 'di bka' dogs shing chos mi gnang ba 'di nga bsnyen bkur chung ba yin nam snyam nas/ rke la g.yu rdog bzang po cig yod pa de bkrol nas zhu don glu ru phul ba/ 'o na skyes mchog ngo mtshar can// khyed zhen med nyams su len nas// cir snang sgyu mar gzigs pa'i phyir// nor zang zing 'dod pa mi mnga' yang*// nga rang dbang med pa'i dad pa skyes/ pha bsags pa can gyi zas nor de// bu gtong phod can gyi mi 'bul na// sang phan chad mi blo 'dre yis bsgyur// lha mi mngon dbyings nas thugs kyis khrel// rje de phyir mi bzhed mi gsung 'tshal// g.yu drug dkar mtsho rog 'od po che// zhug yas kyi sgron me 'od po che// gla 'brong gnyen gyi mched la bskyas// ba dan dmar gyi gdan la blangs/ le brgan dar gyis mgul du btags// 'di btsong na 'jig rten dbul ba bral// rje dam pa'i mgul du 'bul lags kyis// bka' drin lha chos gnang bar zhu// zhes de skad zhus nas g.yu phul bas rje btsun gyis ma bzhed do// khyod kyi g.yu ngas mi 'dod/ de bas lhag pa'i nor rin po che 'di lta bu nga rang la yod gsungs nas mgur gsungs pa/ bu yon bdag nyon dang pha drin can// spyir rgyal khams yangs pa'i sa phyogs su/ shul thag ring po'i rnal 'byor 'khyams// grong khyer 'thug po'i gsang sgo ru// 'tsho ba za tshol kham zas slong*// zas zhim mngar zhen pa log nas gda'// zang zing nor la chog shes med// nor bsags shing lus po mthong tsam na// khyod phyug po'i nor la smon rgyu med// nga chog shes rgyal po'i dkor mdzod na// snyan brgyud nor bu rin po che// nyams su myong ba'i phra bkod de// dran pa brjed med byi dor byas// thun bzhi rnal 'byor mig la brgyus// rig pa khye'u chung rgyan du che// de rnal 'byor nga yi rke g.yu yin// khyed kyi rke g.yu ngas mi 'dod// bu khye'u chung skyid do lam du bzhud// zhes rje btsun gyis de skad gsungs pas/

yang kho yi bsam pa la/ rje btsun sprul sku 'dis nga sdig spyod du gzigs nas thugs la mi 'dod pa yin snyam nas/ skyes bu dam pa khyed sgyu ma'i nor la mi gzigs na'ang da res 'khor gsum 'di khyed la 'bul/ da phyin chad mtshon cha spangs nas srog mi gcod pa'i sdom pa len/ cis kyang bka' drin gyis bskyab par zhu zhes mdo drug stag chas krol te phul nas zhu don glu ru phul ba/ 'o na skyes mchog rin po che// ngas sngon chad dgra la dgra ru bzung*// dgra gnya' ring yan par gtong ma myong*// ngas sngon chad gnyen la gnyen du bzung*// gnyen byams pa'i gnya' ru gcog ma myong*// g.yas stag dang khro bo me lce ris// de nyag phran mda' yi skungs sa yin// yon gzig shub 'dzum phran thig le can// mchog dkar gzhu yi skungs sa yin// ral thag mdo lung sen thabs ris// de dgra bla mtshon gyi so pa yin// ngas mdo drug sked la btags tsam na// hor yan thub jag pa chas pa 'dra// sdang dgra bos mthong na glo snying 'dar// 'brong rtsi thog yan pa rdza mkhar bsnyags// de phyir bsam zhing 'gyod pa skyes// ngas snga byas sdig la 'gyod pa bgyid/ phyin chad mi byed sdom pa len// dus da res 'khor gsum khyed la 'bul// da phyin chad dam bca' yar gyis 'bul// rje gar 'byon chag phyir 'brong bar zhu// zhes de skad zhus pa/ yang rje btsun gyis ma bzhes te/ bu khyod kyi dam bca' yang thub ste mi 'ong*/ 'khor gsum yang ngas mi 'dod/ khyod kyi bas lhag pa'i stag chas nga rang la yod gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/ bu gyad pa don med tshur nyon dang*// yul log par dka' ba'i sa mkhar du// dgra dug lnga'i jag pas shar sgug byed// dus da res pham rgyal ma bgos na// phyis thar med btson rar tshud nyen yod// nga rnal 'byor dgra la g.yul ngo 'gyed// phyi snang ba khra bo'i stag ras la// nang 'dzin pa rang grol gzig shub can// shes rab chen po'i ral gri la// zung 'jug yangs pa'i ral thag btags// drod rtags yon tan sen thabs can// skye med stong pa'i gzhu mo la// byang chub sems kyi ltong sbyar nas// tshad med bzhi yi mda' 'phangs pas// dgra dug lnga'i g.yul ngo zlog ste mchi/

de sbas pa nang gi mdo drug yin// las nyon mongs dmag tshogs zlog ste mchi// de rnal 'byor nga yi dgra 'thab yin// bu khyod kyi stag chas ngas mi 'dod// bu yon bdag skyid do ci bder gshegs// zhes rje btsun gyis mgur de skad gsungs pas/ yang khos zhus pas/ rje btsun dam pa lags khyed kyis 'khor gsum mi bzhed na yang*/ sku drin mi zhu ba'i thabs med pas/ ska rags 'di dang gri sag 'di gnyis bzhes par zhu zhes zhu don glu ru blangs pa/ rje sprul sku gson dang rin po che// spyir chos shes pa mang la sgrub pa nyung*/ grub rtags thon pa brgya la 'ga'// pha sprul sku ras pa ma lags pa'i// bod rna ltag tsam na mthong ma myong*// chos mkhyen no cog la ngas mi zhu// khyed dka' ba spyad pa'i dam chos la// ngas cang med stong pas zhu ma phod// bal yul mthil gyi khru bcu la/ cho ris srin gyi ka ba can// rnon po'i gri chung bse mgo la// lcags shub dngul dkar dra ba can// mdo mang lcags kyi nyag thag dang*// mi nga yi sked skabs 'gying la mdzes// spyir stag shar tsam gyi rgyan du che// bdag mos pa'i zhu rten 'di bzhes la// sgom nyams tshig gsum ces kyang zhu/ de skad zhu don glu ru phul ska rags dang gri sag phul bas/ rje btsun gyis nga yi sgom nyams dang lta spyod khyod la da lta bstan du mi nyan/ khyed kyi zhu rten yang yang ngas mi 'dod/ gri dang ska rags nga rang la de bas lhag pa yod gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/ bu stag shar don med tshur nyon dang*// gangs dkar 'grim pa'i seng lcam la// bcud bdud rtsi lta bu'i 'o ma yod// de rin chen gser skyogs ma lags pa'i// snod ngan phal du blugs mi gtub// snod ngan phal du blugs gyur na// snod kyang 'chag la bcud kyang 'bo// de bzhin gsang sngags zab mo'i don// bu skal ldan gcig tsam ma gtogs pa// skal med rnams la yongs mi sbyin// skal med rnams la sbyin gyur na// dam tshig nyams nas dmyal bar 'gro// de phyir chos sgo'i rgya mdud bsdams/

nga g.yo med drang po'i skad skabs la// 'dun pa drag po'i ras yug bcings// sems zol zog med pa'i chu ris btang*// shes rab rnon po'i gri sag la// gding tshad gsum gyi lcags shub can// dad pa lcags kyi nyag thag dang*// brtson 'grus gser gyi nyag thag gnyis// spyir chos mdzad yongs kyi rgyan du che// sgos rnal 'byor nga yi sked skabs mdzes// mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'jigs 'jigs nas/ sngar yang nor phyir chos ma btsongs// da yang zhu rten yang mi 'tshal/ bu khye'u chung skyid do log na bzhud// rje btsun gyis de skad ces gsungs/ yang khye'u chung gis zhus pa/ rje btsun dam pa khyed kyis zang zing gi nor gang yang mi bzhed na/ dgon pa dben pa cig yod pa'i 'bul bas thugs dgongs pa klod de gdan phab nas bzhugs 'tshal// zhes zhus ru phul ba/ rje spyod pa'i rnal 'byor brtul zhugs can// khyed byar med zhen pa log pa'i phyir/ pha yul btson ra rgyab tu bskyur// sa phyogs ris med pa'i mi yul bskor// skyid sdug gi spros pa chod de mchi// gzhi gcig tu bzhugs na thugs dam 'phel// dgon pa ri thang mtshams su brtsegs/ gzhi rang byung dag pa'i khang pa la// snang gsal nam mkha'i rgya skar can// rgya nag mthing gi sa gzhi la// rdo rgyus mtshal gyi ri mo bris// ha lo me tog tshom bu bkod// phyi ni btsan po 'obs kyis bskor// gnyan po shing gi kha bad btags// rtsa brgyad mchod rten rgyan gyis mdzes// nged 'jig rten pa rnams mos pa'i rten// pha rje btsun gdan sar 'bul lags pas// thugs ma rig dgongs pa klod la bzhugs// zhes don glu ru phul bas/ rje btsun gyis ma bzhes te gzhi bdag tu bzung pa'i dgon pa ngas mi 'dod/ mthun 'jug gi mi chos ngas mi shes/ de bas nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas kho yi lan du mgur bzhengs pa/ 'o na stag shar 'phrul gyi rgyud// bu sems stobs can de tshur nyon dang*// tshe 'di kun mi rtag sgyu ma tsam// sang 'chi bdag gshin rje sleb tsa na// dpa' bo'i ral kha sprad du med// dus de ka tsam na ya re nga*/

ngas de ltar rtogs nas btsan sa bzung*// nang skye med sems kyi dgon pa la// bar g.yo med rlung gi kha bad btags// gzhi 'gyur med don gyi ka ba btsugs// lam bskyed rdzogs nyi zla'i rgyu skar can// zhi gnas drod kyi sa bzhi la// lhag mthong mtshal gyi maṇḍal bris// bde gsal mi rtog tshom bu bkod// dge bcu mdzes pa'i rtsa brgyad la// btsan po stong nyid 'obs kyis bskor// de rnal 'byor nga yi yang rdzong yin// mi khyod kyi dgon pa ngas mi 'dod// bu yon bdag skyid do khyim du bzhud/ de skad gsungs nas dgon pa ma bzhed pas/ yang khye'u chung gis zhus/ khyed dgon pa mi bzhed na yang lus sgyu ma lags pas bsnyung ba 'dra byung na sha tsha bas grogs dgos pas// bdag la sring mo dad pa can zhig yod pa de kyang 'bul bas ko long mi mdzad par bzhes par zhu zhes zhu don glu ru blangs pa/ rje ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor pa// khyed bud med skyon yon rig pa des// chags sems 'dod pa mi mnga' yang*// lus sgyu ma lags pas bsnyung gzhi mchi// sha tsha snying rje'i grogs shig 'tshal// nged ming po gsum gyi sring gcig ma// pha bzang gi bu mo cho rigs can/ ma bzang gi bu mo sman ma 'phrul// khrom lha mi 'tshogs pa'i yid 'phrog ma// rje sa bdag rgyal po'i btsun mo rgyu// gos re'u phrug ste dar ma ling*// dar 'ja' tshon khug kyi chu ris can// mgo bo gser g.yu'i lan tshar can// gzi mchong byi ru'i do shal can// mtshar sdug 'od ldan bris pa 'dra// 'jig rten pa rnams phar bltas pas// sman 'phyor mi yul gyi me tog yin// bu mo'i ming ni zhu yas rin chen sgron// 'di slong mi mang ste kha shor med/ dus de ring sprul sku khyed la 'bul// thugs ko long mi mdzad bzhes par zhu// zhes zhus don phul bas/ rje btsun gyis ma bzhes ste ha ha de skad ma zer/

ngas 'khor ba'i khyim thabs blos btang*/ bdag 'dzin gyi chung ma ngas mi 'dod/ bu khyod kyi da ltar gyi dad pa glo bur ba yin/ nga pha tshan dang sde ris med pa'i sprang rgan gcig la sring mo byin pas yul mi khyim mtshes kun gyis kyang 'phya/ bu khyod rang yang 'gyod de 'ong*/ khyod kyi mag pa ngas mi 'ong*/ de bas lhag pa'i chung ma nga rang la yod gsungs nas kho yi len du mgur gsungs pa/ pha myes ya rabs mdzangs kyi rgyud// blo rgya can de tshur nyon dang*// spyir yang bud med chags pa'i rgyu/ tshan ldan rig ma shin tu dkon// lam pho nyas bgrod pa ngo mtshar yang*// khyed skye bos phyar ka sgro skur yangs// yang de phyir phyag rgya bsten pa dka'// ngas chags bral stong pa'i bud med la// snying rje'i mdangs can bzhin bzang ma// byams pa'i stobs kyi yid 'phrog ma// sna tshogs dkar dmar ras gos la// gnyis med thug phrad dar gyis brgyan// ro snyoms spyod pa'i ga zha la// nyams dga' ba yi lan tshar la// du ma ro gcig do shal can// gnyug ma'i don rtogs mtshar sdug ldan// de rnal 'byor nga yi grogs mo yin// lta na sdug la 'bral mi phod// mi 'bral yun du 'grogs te mchi/ khyed 'khor ba'i khyim thabs ngas mi 'dod// bdag 'dzin gyi chung ma ngas mi 'dod// yon bdag rang khyim log la bzhud// ces gsungs pas/ khye'u chung gis/ rje btsun lags/ rtogs pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i gang zag la/ ngo tsha ba dang mi tsha ba'i rnam rtog mi mnga' yang*/ nged 'jig rten rnams la mi dad pa'i rtog pa skye bas byang rkyang 'di ces kyang bzhes par zhu 'tshal zhes zhu don glu ru blangs pa/ rje sba gsang med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i gcer nyal mkhan// 'dom stong nor bu gang dgar ston// khyed 'khrul pa nang nas zhig pa de// nyam nga bag tsha mi bdog ste// nged 'jig rten pa rnam ngo tshar byed// thugs dgongs pa sangs rgyas las kyang mtho// mdzad spyod mi dang bstun na legs// khye'u chung gyon pa'i byang rkyang 'di// g.yang mo lug gi 'jam bal la// ma sring gnyis kyi nyags su drangs// mna' ma mdzangs kyis thag bran byas// khyim mtshes bu mos chags su bcag

/pha khu byams gyi bzo bo drub// nged 'jig rten pa yi ngo tsha'i gos// na bzar byang rkyang 'di 'bul bas// rje mi 'dod mi gsung bzhes par zhu/ de skad zhu don glu ru phul ba la/ rje btsun gi zhal nas/ ngo tsha ba dang mi tsha ba'i rgyu mtshan khyed 'jig rten pas mi shes/ nga cha lugs lhug pas bsdad pa la khyed bzhad gad byed de/ nga dang po ma yi khog pa nas 'ong dus gos med gcer bur 'ong*/ tha ma 'di yang gcer bur 'gro ba yin/ da lta yang bcas bcos mi byed/ spyod pa rang so 'di ka rang la 'jog /bcos ma'i spyod pa ngas mi shes/ de bas bu khyod rang nga yi glu la nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o na khye'u chung bzhin legs po// khyod ngo mi tsha la ngo tshar byed// 'di rang byung pho rtags yin// bcos ma'i spyod pa ngas mi byed// ngo tsha rnams la khyed mi 'dzem// sdig dang g.yo rgyu rku ba dang*// spyod ngan zhe ngan log lta dang*// sdig dang mna' za khrel med rnams// khrel med ngo tsha yin te bsrung ba med// mi nga yi bya rkyang 'di ltar gda'// smon 'jug sems bskyed 'jam bal la// dam tshig sdom pa'i nyags su drangs// smin lam dbang bzhi'i thags su bran// grol lam ting 'dzin chu tshad bzhag /dag pa smon lam chags su bcag /byams pa shes bzhin bzos bos drub// khrel yod ngo tsha'i byang rkyang btsems// gzhan don mthar phyin ngo tsha'i gos// mi khyod kyi byang rkyang ngas mi 'dod// yon bdag rang khyim log la bzhud/ de skad gsungs pas khye'u chung gi bsam pa la/ skyes bu chen po 'di'i zhabs tog gang yang mi bzhed par 'dug kyang*/ gar gshegs dang gar bzhugs kyi rtsad bcad la gdan 'dren dgos snyam nas/ rje btsun dam pa lags/ khyed kyi zhabs tog gang yang mi bzhed par da lta 'di na phar 'byon nas 'dir sdod kyi thugs gtad pa cig yod nges pas/ bdag la cis kyang mi gsung bar gsungs 'tshal zhus pas/

de bden bu la gsang rgyu med de nga btsas ma'i bar ding rir ldom bu byed/ dbyar gyi dus su snye nam na phar 'gro/ dgun la phyi bya ba'i lung stong gcig yod pa der sdod de 'ong gsungs pa dang*/ yang khye'u chung gi bsam pa la 'o na zhag 'ga' la bshol btab nas nged can du byon na dgun brgyags sprad chos shig kyang zhu dgos snyam nas/ cis kyang nged can du 'byon par zhu zhes zhu don glu ru blangs pa/ rje 'gran gyi do med sprul pa'i sku// yul snye nam ding ri'i sa phyogs su// ro snyoms ldom bu mdzad dgongs nas// yul de la yon tan cang ma mchis// gnam kha zhing can gyi ding ri der// dge sems yung dkar 'bru bas chung*// lag pa lha khang sgo bas dam// rtsam pa rin chen gser bas dkon// brgya la rnyed kyang nad khams slong*// mu ge'i rgyun gyi grong khyer yin// la thong la sngon po 'jigs pa che// mi ser gyi jag pa 'grim pa yin// mdze bos mtshan 'gros dgos pa yin// grogs brgya re min pas mgo mi thon// 'gro gom gsum tsa la skyel ma dgos// skungs sa bgrang na zad pa med// bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams yin// stod ni kha ba can gyi yul// nyin mtshan med par lhag pa che// dbyar dgun med par kha ba 'bab// mi ni byol song phyugs bas blun// chu ni mon kha'i lho nas 'bab// smad ni rong khung tshad pa che// gcan 'phrang zam pa srog la gzan// bal nad tshad pas tshe la gnod// mi rnams lho bal skad mi gcig /shing sdong po mi ro rengs pa 'dra// rje khyed kyi gshegs sa de na med// da res mi gshegs bshol bar zhu// gtan gyi mchod gnas mi gnang yang*// dgun zla gsum bzhes pa 'dren lags pas// bdag gi yul du 'byon par zhu// sprul sku gdan spyod gshegs par zhu// thugs rjes dgongs la gshegs par zhu// ces kyang mas kyang gshegs par zhu/ khos de skad zhus pas/

rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ spyir ngar 'dzin can gyi yon bdag ngas mi 'dod/ ngo srung dang mthun 'jug gi spyod pa ngas mi shes/ bu khyod kyi yul du nga mi 'gro/ yul snye nam dang ding ri'i lo rgyus bu khyod bas nga rang mkhas/ de bas glu 'di la nyon cig gsungs nas kho yi len gyi mgur gsungs pa/ 'o na khye'u chung 'dun pa can// bu dad pa 'gyur med tshur nyon dang*/ spyir yul la dge bcu tshang ba dang*// mi skyon med yon tan tshang ba dang*// shing 'dzer med drang du skyes pa rnams// dus kyi bsgyur nas dka' bar gda'// nga rnal 'byor sems la gang byung byed// dbang gros ka mi la 'khyor ma myong*// yul ding ri rtsam pa dkon mod kyang*// nga rnal 'byor zas la rme gtsang med// phyi ltar bdud rtsi lnga la spyod// zas zhim mngar gyi zhen pa log nas gda'// nga de phyir lto la zhen pa chung*// nang mi rtog ting 'dzin zas su za// nga de phyir gdol pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mu ge kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// la thong la 'jigs pa che lags kyang*// rje byin rlabs can la gsol ba 'debs/ skyabs dkon mchog gsum po rgyab brten bzang*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i skyel ma yod// grogs byang chub sems dang 'grogs nas 'gro// bsu ma lha srin sde brgyad yod// lar yang nor med dgra dang bral/ jag pa kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// snye nam lung nag zer lags kyang*// mi ni ma bcos sngon gyi mi// gtam ni ma bcos drang po smra// spyod pa ma bcos lhod lhod po// bza' btung ma bcos sba sri med// yul ni ma bcos nags tshal can// nor longs spyod zang zing ngas mi 'dod// bza' btung gi zas la khang chags bzang*// nga rnal 'byor gyi shes pa de na bde// 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba de na chung*// mnyam bzhag gi ting 'dzin de na 'phel// nga de phyir snye nam phyogs su 'gro// ngas gtum mo'i drod la rang dbang thob// rlung tsha grang gnyis kyi 'jigs dang bral// kha ba ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// da res kyi lam la bshol thabs med// bu khyod kyi yul du nga mi 'gro// khe grags yon bdag ngas mi 'dod// ngo srung gi spyod pa ngas mi shes// yang nyi ma zer chung la la thal// khye'u chung skyid do rang 'gros snyogs// tshe ring nad med smon lam 'tshal// zhes gsungs nas 'byon par ma gnang ba la kho yi chad nas/

bla ma lags khyed kyi zhabs tog ci phul yang mi gnang*/ chos yang mi gnang ba de bdag sgrib pa che ba yin te 'ong*/ da smon lam 'debs khyed kyi drung du lcebs pa min pa gar yang mi 'gro// zhes smre sngags 'don zhing zhu don glu ru blangs pa/ rje rnal 'byor ras chen snyan gson dang*// da nang gdugs kyi snga dro la// chu mig dngul 'bum rtsa ba na// gcer nyal byed pa'i mi zhig mthong*/ 'o na rnal 'byor smyon pa cig /spyod pa tho cog byed pa cig /cha lugs gang dgar ston pa cig /mi khyed la gtad ra med do snyam// yid kyang ma mos skur pa shor// lam yang ma 'grogs bzur bas song*// de rnams rje btsun thugs kyis mkhyen// 'bangs dbyar ngo tsha ste shi dang 'dra// de nas khri gdugs rtse 'jam la// chu bong chu sngon mo brgal tsam na// chab la bya ltar lding ba mthong*// mkha' la rlung ltar lding ba mthong*// rdzu 'phrul lus kyi gshegs pa mthong*// gtsang chab phar kar phyin tsam na// rje grub thob cig dang 'jal lugs kyi// bdag nyon mongs sgrib pa chung ngo snyam// kha rje bsod nams che'o snyam/ las 'phro smon lam dag go snyam// lha chos skal pa yod do snyam/ dus de ring tsam nas dga' ba de// chung ma la btsas nas 'ong ma myong*// sgyu ma nor gyi zhabs tog la// mi dgos mi 'dod zer ba de// khyed rnal 'byor ras pa ma lags pa// bod rna ltag tsam la tshor ma myong*// mi khyed la ngo mtshar che ba de// chos mdzad yongs la ngas ma mthong*// khyed de tsam ngo mtshar che lags kyang*// de ring gdugs kyi nyin skor la// mi bdag gi zhu don phul ba la// rje dam pa'i thugs kyis mi gzigs pa// bdag las ngan sgrib pa che ba 'dra// bdag dbyar ngo bsod nams chung chung 'dra// lha chos skal pa med med 'dra// da ni yi chad blo ni rmongs// sems ni mi dga' phya ma phyo// lam yang mi shes phyi ma nang*// sprul sku cig dang mjal nas kyang*// bka' drin tshig gsum ma thos pas// ma mjal ba dang ci ma 'dra// rgyal khams mi la ci skad smras// slar log yul du dbyar ngo tsha/

de bas rang srog rang gis gcod// sems can skyes nas 'chi ba la// dus da lta tsam du shi na rung*// rje grub thob cig gi spyan sngar gum// yid dam pa'i chos la gtad nas gum/ gtam de las snyan pa ci yod pa// rje mngon shes can gyi thugs kyis mkhyen// lar yang khye'u chung bsod nams chung*// de ring lha chos skal pa chad// pha khyed kyi thugs kyi nga ma brjed// ces gsol ba btab cing bcud bor bas/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la kho nga la 'di tsam zhig dad cing gdung sems che lugs kyi smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod par nges mdang sum rmi lam du byung ba de yin te 'ong*/ da rjes su bzung dgos dgongs nas kho yi lan mgur du bzhengs pa/ bu yon bdag khye'u chung tshur nyon dang*// dge sems 'dun pa che lugs kyi// las ngan sdig sgrib chung bar nges// zhu don spobs pa che lugs kyi// le lo snyom las chung bar nges// gtong phod 'bul snying che lugs kyi// ser sna 'dzin chags chung bar nges// snying rje shes rab che lugs kyi// gti mug zhe sdang chung bar nges// nga la lhag par dad lugs kyi// sngon yang dam pa bsten par nges// bu de phyir yid chad ma byed dang*/ khyed rgyal phrom smad nas 'ong ba dang*// nga gung thang stod nas 'ong ba gnyis// da nang gdugs kyi snga dro la// bong chu sngon mo'i 'gram du 'phrad// chu mig dngul 'bum rtsa bar 'dzom// de sngon chad smon lam btab pa 'dra// sbyangs pa'i las 'phro yod pa 'dra// kun gzhi bag chags sad pa 'dra// de yan chad smon lam 'dzom pa'i glu// da yang don la gtug tsa na// bu snying nas dam chos byed bsam na// dad pa snying nas skyes pa na/ tshe 'dir phyi mig mi lta na// nges par nga phyir 'brangs pa na// gnyen 'dun bdud kyi shom 'debs yin// bden no ma bsam 'khri ba chod// zas nor bdud kyi so pa yin// 'dres shing ngan no 'dzin chags spangs/

'dod yon bdud kyi zhags pa yin// 'chi bar nges so zhen pa thong*// gzhon grogs bdud kyi bu mo yin// bslu bar nges so khong zon gyis// pha yul bdud kyi btson ra yin// thar bar dka'o myur du bros// thams cad bzhag nas 'gro dgos pas// da lta bzhag na don chen 'grub// sgyu lus tho yol ces kyang 'gyel// da lta rten 'brel bsgrigs na legs// sems kyi bya rgyal ces kyang 'phur// da lta nam 'phang bcad na legs// mi ngas zer de rnams nyan spyod na// bu khyod la lha chos skal pa yod// 'jug sgo dbang dang byin rlabs bya// zab mo snyan brgyud gdams ngag sbyin// bu khyod kyang lam sna zin te mchi/ rnal 'byor nga yang shes pa dga'// khye'u chung sems la de ltar zhog /bu khyod kyi bsam pa 'grub pa yin// zhes rje btsun gyis de skad gsungs pas kho brod pa skyes te shin tu dga' nas rje btsun gyi zhabs spyi bor blangs te/ phyag mang du 'tshal nas bskor ba byas smon lam btab nas song skad do// de thams cad chu mig dngul 'bum gyi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun sman lung gi brin na bzhugs/ zhi ba 'od kyi zhing khang rnams btsong nas chos phyogs su btang*/ zhang po dang 'grogs nas 'ong ste gser dang g.yu yod pa bla ma la phul bas bla ma ma bzhed de ba ri ba la phul la dbang bskur zhus gsungs pas/ ba ri ba la phul nas gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi tshe dbang 'phags pa don yod zhags pa dang*/ nang gi bde mchog dang*/ lha mo'i skor rnams gnang*/ de nas rje btsun gyi drung du lo lnga lhag par sdad nas snyan brgyud kyi dbang dang*/ chos drug bsgom pas nyams/ bzang po skyes nas bla ma mnyes te mgur 'di gsungs so// snyan brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sgrub brgyud thugs rje can 'di byin rlabs che// mi la ras pa'i gdams ngag nus pa che// khye'u chung zhi ba 'od 'di sgom bsran che// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rtogs pa myur du skye// bu nyams len mtha' ru 'don pa la// kha lta skam po ma labs par// chos la phyogs ris med par mdzod// mi sngon gyi jo bzang ma sems par/

mi med lung par dben par bsgom// grogs ngan g.yog dang ma 'grogs par// rgyun du gcig pur zug par gyis// bla mas ca bzhed ma bsam par// ci gsung tshad mar sgom sgrub gyis// myur du grub rtags ma 'dod par// sgom yun shi dang mnyam par gyis// tshig dang tha snyad ma slob par// snyan brgyud gdams ngag yeng med sgom// rang la e phan bsam pa la// bshad pa bas kyang sgom pas phan// ces gsungs pas/ zhi ba 'od kyis sngon la shes ma bslab nas sgom la gol sa 'ong zer bas/ de ji ltar lags zhes zhus pas/ bla mas de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// a mtshar po ci 'dra 'ong bar 'dug /tshig gi sbos pa'i ston pa de// rtsod dus khram pas bsnyon bsnyon byed// lab dus dred mas lab lab byed// nyal dus mi chen nyal nyal byed// 'gro dus hor 'dra 'grim 'grim byed// des gegs dang gol sa e chod lags// spyir khams gsum sems can so sor gol// so so skye bo las la gol// nyan thos zhi ba'i lam la gol// dge bshes za ba'i thabs la gol// ston pa tshig gi rdzong la gol// dge slong bzang brdzu'i nang du gol// rnal 'byor smyon pa'i gseb tu gol// sgom chen stong lta had por gol// de bzhin thams cad gol tshab che// bu snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs la// gol sa yod snyam bdud yin te// ras chen drung du zhi ba 'od// gegs la shor na bslus pa yin// dmar khrid lag len mngon sum la// gol sa byung na bden pa med// bu gol dogs slob gnyer ma sems par// rtse gcig bsgom dang myur du gsal// zhes gsungs pas slob 'dod med par bsgom zhing yod pa la/ brgyags chad pas nyin ldom bu mdzad/ nub mo grong du mi nyal ba'i dam bca' yod pas bla ma'i drung du 'ong ba la sngar gyi grogs po cig yod pa de sleb 'dug pas/ kho na re/ zas nor thams cad med par byas nas// nga kun sprang rgan cig byas nas zer bas de'i len du zhi ba 'od kyis mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma rje btsun sangs rgyas kyi ngang*// pha ma gnyis po dge sbyor mchod gnas rten// spun zla phan chad 'khor ba'i rgyu// bdag des kyang pha yul spangs pa lags// rang nyid gcig pu sangs rgyas ngang*// chos mthun grogs po dge sbyor rten// gsum bzhi phan chad long gtam rgyu// bdag des kyang gcig pur sdod pa lags// gdams ngag tshig bzhi sangs rgyas ngang*// gsol 'debs dpe bum dge sbyor rten// dpe cha mang po nga rgyal rgyu// bdag des kyang zin bris spangs pa lags// ri khrod dben pa sangs rgyas ngang*// 'tsho ba zwa tshod dge sbyor rten// rdzas dang yo byad chags pa'i rgyu// bdag des kyang zhing khang spangs pa lags// rgyal khams phyogs med sangs rgyas ngang*/

dad pa can gyi dge sbyor bsod snyoms rten// 'khor g.yog mang po nyon mongs rgyu// bdag nges kyang 'khor g.yog spangs pa lags// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma yang mnyes/ kho grogs po yang dad/ ka cha mang du phul/ de nas sngar kho la dar ma dbang phyug bya ba yin pa la/ phyis ras pa zhi ba 'od zer ba'i yongs su grags pa cig byung ngo*// de thams cad ras pa zhi ba 'od kyi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun lho sgo nas phar byon tsa/ mi mang po rtse sna la 'tshogs 'dug pa'i nang nas nya ma btsun seng nge ba cig 'dug pas/ rnal 'byor pa khyod kyi yul dang pha ma nye 'brel rnams gang yin zer ba'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// yab ni kun tu bzang po yin// yum ni 'gro ba bzang mo yin// pho bo thos pa rgyal po yin// a ne snang gsal sgron me yin// sring mo dad pa brtan po yin// grogs mo rang byung ye shes yin// bu ni rig pa'i khye'u chung yin// dpe cha snang srid gzhi bzhag yin// rta pho rnam shes rlung zhon yin// yon bdag dbus gtsang ru bzhi yin// nga rang mchod rten dkar chung yin// zhes gsungs pas/ a la la ngo mtshar che ba yod par 'dug ste nged 'jig rten pas mi go bar 'dug pas 'di ltar yin gsal ba cig gsung bar zhu zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// sngon chad dbyangs la bskyar ma myong*// da res tshig la gsal cig 'debs// yab gcig kun tu bzang po 'dis// gdams ngag nu mar smed pa la// nyams len mu ge 'ong ma myong*// yum gcig 'gro ba bzang mo des// rang sems ma bu spro bsdu la// sems 'khrul pa'i chad lta 'ong ma myong*// pho bo thos pa'i rgyal po des// thabs shes ral gri lag tu gtad// phyi nang sgro 'dogs bcad nas bzhag /a ne snang gsal sgron me des// rang sems me long yang yang lta// bag chags bya yis gos ma myong*// sring mo dad pa'i lcam mo des// ser sna'i mdud pa bkrol nas bzhag

/zas nor sdug btsir byed ma myong*// grogs mo rang byung ye shes des// gnyis su med par 'grogs 'grogs nas// gshis ngan sdug 'thab byed ma myong*// bu cig rig pa'i khye'u chung des// sangs rgyas gdung rgyud sems sems nas// snabs bshal bu tsha gso ma myong*// dpe cha snang srid gzhir bzhag de// mtshan pa'i go yul ston ston nas/ yig nag dpe cha lta ma myong*// rta pho rnam shes rlung zhon des// gar 'dod gnas su bskyal ba la// khrag chags rkang bzhi'i g.yog ma myong*// yon bdag dbus gtsang ru bzhi des// 'tsho ba gang 'dod sbyor ba la// phye rkyal gag btsir byed ma myong*// nga rang mchod rten dkar chung 'di// mchod pa dkon mchog mchod par yin// brten pa bla ma bsten pa yin// dkar ba chos la dkar ba yin// chung ba nyon mongs chung ba yin// nga de phyir mchod dkar chung yin// zhes gsungs pas/ a la la de shin tu bzang ba rang cig 'dug nged ni bu nor med na sprang po yin/ khyed nged tsho'i nang du 'byon dus 'khor ba'i snang ba med las che zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// ngas 'khor ba 'di la phar bltas pas// dang po 'khor ba nyams dga' po// bar du snang ba brid mkhas po// tha ma btson dong thar med do// 'khor ba'i mtha' la zhen pa log /de nas grogs la phar bltas pas// grogs dang po lha mo 'dzum kha ma// bar du mi mo gdong dmar ma// tha ma bdud mo ngo nag ma// than grogs de la chags pas phung*// de nas bu la phar bltas pas// bu dang po lha phrug kha 'jam po// bar du khyim tshes snying ring po// tha ma dgra bo lan chags po// dgra len med gsos pas blo nyes che// de nas nor la phar bltas pas// nor dang po nor bu rin po che// bar du med thabs med pas bzung*// tha ma sbrang rtsi bsags pa bzhin// sdug sogs byas tshad mi yis spyad// de la som la lha chos mdzod// 'chi kar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod// ces gsungs pas nya ma dad pa skyes nas/

rnal 'byor pa khyed la chos brgyud bzang po e yod ces zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// chos sku kun la khyab pa de kun tu bzang po// longs sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyi brgyan pa de rdo rje 'chang chen// sprul sku 'gro don phyogs med du mdzad pa de shākya thub pa// brgyud pa de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags// brgyud pa de gsum la dad pa'i nya ma 'dra bdog gam// zhes gsungs pas/ yang nya ma de na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyed brgyud pa bzang bar 'dug /brgyud pa bzang ba'i zhal po yang che bar 'dug pa ngo mtshar che/ brgyud pa de lta bu yod pa'i steng du bla ma ngo mtshar can yod de 'ong bla ma ji skad bya ba yod zer ba/ yang rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsungs so// chos dpe thog na 'chad pa de phyi yi bla ma/ don thog na go ba nang gi bla ma// go thog na 'jog pa de don gyi bla ma// bla ma de gsum ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags so// bla ma nga gsum bsten pa'i nya 'dra bdog gam/ gsungs pas/ yang nya ma de na re/ khyod bla ma yang bzang bar 'dug /bla ma bzang ba'i zhal yang che bar 'dug pa ngo mtshar che/ bla ma de lta bu bsten pa'i steng du dbang thob dgos pa yin pas/ dbang thob bam ma thob zer bas/ yang rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ bum pa mgo thog tu bzhag pa de phyi yi dbang bskur// nang lus lha skur bsgom pa de nang gi dbang bskur// sems la bde ba brnyed pa de don gyi dbang bskur// dbang bskur de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags// dbang bskur de gsum zhu ba'i nya ma 'dra bdog gam/ gsungs pas/ yang nya ma de na re/ dbang bskur zab mo yang thob par 'dug /dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i zhal po yang che bar 'dug pa ngo mtshar che/ dbang bskur zab mo de lta bu thob pa'i steng du ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang thob nas/ smin pa grol bar byed pa la lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi khrid bya ba tshar ram ma tshar zer bas/

yang rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ phyi yul gyi 'khri ba chod pa de phyi yi khrid// nang rig pa srang du 'dzud pa de nang gi khrid// cir snang chos skur go ba de don gyi khrid// khrid de gsum tshar ba'i rnal 'byor pa lags so// khrid de gsum bsgom pa'i nya ma 'dra yod dam/ gsungs pas/ yang nya ma de na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyed kyi khrid zab mo yang tshang bar 'dug /khrid zab mo tshar ba'i zhal yang che bar 'dug pa ngo mtshar che/ khrid zab mo de lta bu tshar ba'i steng la gcod dgos pas/ gcod kyi gdams pa yod dam med ces zer bas/ yang rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim pa de phyi yi gcod// phung po gzan du bskyur ba de nang gi gcod// nyag cig rtsad nas gcod pa de don gyi gcod// gcod de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags so// gcod de gsum dang ldan pa'i nya ma 'dra bdog gam/ gsungs pas/ yang nya ma de na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyed kyi gcod kyi gdams pa yang zab par 'dug pa ngo mtshar che/ gcod de lta bu yod pa'i steng la lta sgom spyod pa'i gding thob dgos pa yin pas/ gdings de thob bam ma thob zer bas/ yang gsungs pa/ lha med 'dre med lta ba'i gding*// bsgom med yengs med sgom pa'i gding*// chags med zhen med spyod pa'i gding*// gding de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa lags so// gding de gsum dang ldan pa'i nya ma 'dra bdog gam/ gsungs pas/ mo na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyed lta sgom gyi gding dang ldan par 'dug /gding dang ldan pa'i zhal po yang che bar 'dug pa ngo mtshar che/ gding de gsum dang ldan pa'i steng la gzhi lam 'bras gsum grub dgos pas/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum grub bam ma grub zer bas/ rje btsun gyis/ gzhi dngos po ru ma grub khyab bdal chen por shar/ lam dngos po ru ma grub zang thal chen por shar// 'bras bu dngos po ru ma grub chos kyi sku ru shar// 'char tshul de gsum dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa/

lags so// 'char tshul de gsum dang ldan pa'i nya ma 'dra bdog gam// zhes gsungs pas nya ma de shin tu dad nas phyag la 'gyus te nang du gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur bzang po byas te/ sgom cig zhu zer nas gsol 'debs 'di rje btsun gyi drung du phul lo// 'o na rje btsun rin po che// nyin par bya ba'i las kyis brel// nub mo gti mug gnyid du song*// nang nub lto rgyab khol por song*// dam chos byed pa'i longs ma byung*// da sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i chos shig zhu// byang chub 'thob pa'i chos shig zhu/ zer ba'i len du rje btsun gyis dpe bzhi don lnga'i ma'i mgur 'di gsungs so// a nge nya ma dad pa can// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// khyed nam mkha' 'di la yar ltos la// mtha' dbus med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// nyi zla gnyis la yar ltos la// gsal 'grib med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// ri bo 'di la yar ltos la// 'pho 'gyur med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// rgya mtsho 'di la mar ltos la// rba rlabs med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// rang sems 'di la tshur ltos la// rnam rtog med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// zhes gsungs pas/ nya mas de nub mtshan dkar yal le bsgom pas/ phyir nang bla ma mjal du phyin nas sems dpyod 'di phul lo// 'o na skyes mchog rin po che// nam mkha' bsgom du gtub lags te// lho sprin byung na ji ltar bsgom// nyi zla bsgom du gtub lags te// gza' skar 'khrugs na ji ltar bsgom// ri bo bsgom du gtub lags na// rtsi shing rgyas na ji ltar bsgom// rgya mtsho bsgom du gtub lags na// rba rlabs 'khrugs na ji ltar bsgom// rang sems bsgom du gtub lags na// rnam rtog 'phro na ji ltar bsgom// zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis gegs sel gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// ang nge nya ma dpa' dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// nam mkha' bsgom du gtub lags na// lho sprin nam mkha'i cho 'phrul yin/

da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// nyi zla bsgom du gtub lags na// gza' skar nyi zla'i cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// rgya mtsho bsgom du gtub lags na// rba rlabs rgya mtsho'i cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// da rung sems nyis gtan la phob// ri bo sgom du gtub lags na// rtsi shing ri bo'i cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// rang sems bsgom du btub lags na// rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul yin// da rung rnam rtog bdar sha chod// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// ces gsungs te bla mas gdams ngag bstan pas nyams bzang po skyes te/ bla mas zhal ta rgyab skyor bzhi ma 'di mgur du gsungs so// ang nge nya ma dpa' dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// tshe 'di las phyi ma shul thag ring*// de la brgyags phye grabs su tshud lags sam// brgyags phye sbyin pa yin pas btags lags sam// dgra ser sna zer ba'i gag ching mkhan// 'dis phan phan byas kyang gnod pa bskyal// ser sna dgra bo yin pas shes lags sam// shes na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// ang nge nyam pa dpa' dar 'bum// gson dang phyug po dad pa can// tshe 'di las phyi ma mun pa nag /gsal me grabs su tshud lags sam// gsal me 'od gsal yin pas bsgom lags sam// dgra gti mug zer ba'i ro nyal mkhan// 'dis phan bzhin byas pas gnod pa bskyal// gti mug dgra bo yin pas shes lags sam/ shes na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// ang nge nya ma dpa' dar 'bum// gson dang phyug mo dad pa can/ tshe 'di las phyi ma 'jigs pa che// de las skyel ma grabs sun tshud lags sam// skyel ma lha chos yin pas byas lags sam// dgra gnyen 'brel zer ba'i bshol 'debs mkhan/ 'dis phan bzhin byas pas gnod pa skyel// nye 'brel dgra bo yin pas shes lags sam/

shes na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// ang nge nya ma dpa' dar 'bum/ gson dang phyug mo dad pa can// tshe 'di las phyi ma lam thag ring*// de la rta pho grabs su tshud lags sam// rta pho brtson 'grus yin pas brtsams lags sam// dgra le lo zer ba'i bslu brid mkhan/ 'dis phan bzhin byas nas gnod pa bskyal// le lo dgra bo yin pas shes lags sam// shes na rgyab tu skyur la thong*// zhes gsungs nas khyod chos la dpa' 'khor ba la sdar bas dpa' sdar 'bum yin gsungs nas gdams ngag bsgoms pas/ snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ngo mtshar can g.yer du thon pa cig byung ngo*// de thams cad gung thang lho sgo'i skor ro/// /der nas rje btsun gung thang yangs pa'i grong du byon pa la mi mang po mkhar len byed cing 'dug pa nged kyi mkhar len 'di'i dod cig khyed la byed rgyu e yod zer ba'i len du mgur 'ang gsungs so// nged dad pa'i sa gzhi brtan pa dang*// brtson 'grus kyi rtsig pa mtho ba dang*// bsam gtan gyi gyang zhing che ba dang*// shes rab kyi ba gam mtho ba dang*// de bzhi bsdebs pa'i mkhar len de// nam zhig gtan gyi sa mkhar yin// khyed 'jig rten mkhar gyis bslu bslu 'dra// sa mkhar bdud kyi btson ra de shol la thong*// zhes gsungs pas nged kyi zhing gi dod gang yin zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// nged kun gzhi'i zhing sa bzang po la// gdams ngag gi sa bon 'debs pa dang*// nyams rtogs kyi smyu gu skyes pa dang*// sku gsum kyi 'bras bu smin pa ste// 'di bzhi bsdebs pa'i so nam la// nam zhig gtan gyi so nam yin// khyed 'jig rten so nam gyis bslu bslu 'dra// lto rgyab kyi khol po de skyur la thong*// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma lags/ nged kyi zas nor gyi dod gang yin zer ba'i len du mgur 'di gsungs so// nged stong nyid kyi gter kha bzang ba dang*// 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug pa dang*// dge bcu spyad nas bde ba dang*/

zag med gter la spyod pa ste// 'di bzhi bsdebs pa'i zas nor de// nam zhig gtan gyi zas nor yin/ khyed 'jig rten nor gyis bslu bslu 'dra// sgyu ma'i mgo skor de shol la thong*// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma lags nged kyi pha mes kyi dod gang yin zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// nged sangs rgyas kyi spyi mes bzang ba dang*// dam chos kyi zhal ngo rang pa dang*// dge 'dun gyi tsha zhang dar ba dang*// chos skyong gi lta zur dpa' ba ste/ de bzhi bsdebs pa'i srid zla de// nam zhig gtan gyi srid zla yin// khyed 'jig rten gyi srid zlas bslu bslu 'dra// gnas skabs kyi za rogs de shol la thong*// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma lags/ nged kyi chung ma'i dod gang yin zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// nged bde gshegs kyi pha ming bzang ba dang*// bde gsum kyi g.yo sbyor mkhas pa dang*// gsal stong gi sha bkrag dwangs pa dang*/ nyams rtogs kyi rgyan cha mang ba ste// yang 'di bzhi bsdebs pa'i chung ma de// nam zhig gtan gyi grogs mo yin// khyed 'jig rten gyi chung mas bslu bslu 'dra// gnas skabs kyi 'thab rogs de shol la thong*// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma lags nged kyi bu yi dod gang yin zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// nged rig pa rang grol gyi bu chung 'khrungs pa dang*// byin rlabs rang 'bar gyi tshar skyed che ba dang*// nyams rtogs kyi smra lce bde ba dang*// sangs rgyas kyi gdung brgyud 'dzin pa ste// yang de bzhi bsdebs pa'i bu tsha ste// nam zhig gtan gyi sngas bu ste// khyed 'jig rten gyi bu yis bslu bslu 'dra// da 'khor ba'i bshul thag de chod la thong*// khyed mang yul yon bdag rgan gzhon dang*// nga gung thang gi mi la ras pa rnams// glu phar dri tshul dri'i bag chags des// dpal o rgyan yul du mjal bar shog /ces gsungs pas/

yon bdag de rnams dad pa skyes skye te chos gnas pa mang po byung ngo*// de thams cad gung thang gi skor ro/// / ༈ de nas rje btsun mang yul gung thang gi yang pa can gyi tshong 'dus su byon pa la/ rtse sna mang po byed cing 'dug pa'i nang nas bu mo sha sngo la dngas pa/ rnam rig bkra zhing shes pa gsal ba cig 'dug pas rnal 'byor pa gang nas byon/ yul dang pha tshan la ci zer zhes zer ba'i lan du rigs brgyud byon tshul gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// yul ni bde chen kun bzang yin// zhing ni 'dun pa bzang po yin// khong pa snying rje drag po yin// pha tshan bde gshegs rigs bzang yin// pha spun phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad yin// yab mes te lo nā ro yin// pha ni thabs kyi rgyal po yin// ma ni shes rab bzang mo yin// pho bo dam tshig gtsang ma yin// nu bo brtson 'grus drag po yin// sring mo dad pa brtan po yin// nga rang rang byung thol skyes yin// rang gi gnas lugs rtogs pa yin// byung ba yon tan 'byung ba yin// tol ni lha dang mjal ba yin// skyes pa chos skur skyes pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ mo na re/ khyed yab thos pa se ba bya ba la// sras mi la ras pa bya ba cig byung zer nas yod zer ba de yin las che/ nang du dro mdzad pa la byon par zhu zhus pas/ ngas them pa spangs nas yod gsungs pas/ mos khang pa'i rgyab tu skas shig btsugs nas dpon slob gnyis spyan drangs te dro drangs nas lo gsum bzhugs nas zhabs tog byed zhus pas/ zhag bdun du bzhugs par gnang ngo*// nyin gcig mchod rten chen po cig yod zer nas/ mo yi gos ngan pa rnams phud/ bzang po rnams gyon nas/ rnal 'byor pa khyed gzigs mo la 'byon nam zhus pas/ ngas ni sems la lta bas chog gsungs pas/ mo na re/ 'o na bu chung ngur ma 'jug /res lug mi yi zhing du ma gtong sdong bu 'ga' dang tshwa tshwa 'ga' yang mdzod/

khyed rnal 'byor pa gzhon pas khang pa la phyag bdar gyis/ phor sder gtsang ma gyis zer nas bud song ngo*// der khong dpon slob gnyis kyis las zer ba rnams gcig kyang ma 'grub pas/ byis pa ngus shing ras dang tsha tsha rgyu yi sa yang gtor/ re'u lug mi yi zhing khar song nas sug ge bcag /phor sder ma bkrus/ phyag bdar ma byas pas yod pa lags/ mo sleb byung nas rnal 'byor pa khye da them pa spangs zer tsa/ re'u lug dang bu chung la snying rje ma skyes zin// zhes zer ba'i lan du so nam dpe drug ma 'di mgur du gsungs so// gnas bde chen chos sku'i spang kha yangs pa 'dir// gzhi 'gyur med re'u lug bskyang bskyangs nas// rkang bzhi re'i lug bskyong ba'i long ma byung*// re'u lug skyong mkhan legs se 'bum mes mdzod// ngas byams dang snying rje'i a ma des// gnyug ma ngo sprod bu chung bskyangs bskyangs nas// snabs bshal bu chung 'khrid pa'i long ma byung*// snabs bshal 'brid mkhan legs se 'bum mes mdzod// sgom mi 'gyur ri bo brtan po la// dran pa yeng med kyi tsha tsha btab btab nas// tsha tsha 'bi 'bi byed pa'i long ma byung*// tsha tsha 'bi 'bi byed mkhan legs se 'bum mes mdzod// ngas byang khog stod kyi mchod khang du// 'od gsal gyi mar me phul phul nas// ras dkar sdong bu dkri ba'i long ma byung*// ras dkar sdong bu dkri mkhan legs se 'bum mes mdzod// nga sgyu ma lus kyi khang rgan la// 'gag ngan lang gi sa rdo phyag phyag nas// khang pa phyag bdar byed pa'i long ma byung*// khang pa phyag bdar legs se 'bum mes mdzod// ngas sna tshogs srid pa'i spyad cha la// sgyu ma'i rtsal sbyangs byas byas nas// phor sder 'khrud pa'i long ma byung*// spyad cha 'khrud mkhan legs se 'bum mes mdzod// ces gsungs nas khang pa'i phyi rol tu phar 'phur te byon pas/ mo sgor brgyugs te bla ma la 'jus nas/

bla ma lags nged 'jig rten pa'i snang ba la phyi yi rtse sna yang longs spyod du byed/ nang gi tsha tsha mar me'i chos spyod kyang phyi ma'i don du sems pas/ 'di rnams khyad du mi gsod par zhu zhus pas de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// khyed mi nag pa yi lha rten 'di// las rnam smin gsog pa'i rtsa ba yin// ser snas bcings pa'i mar me 'di// mi dpon mdun gyi pho me 'dra// be'u lug mang po bdag po 'di// sha za so la chas pa 'dra// bu phrug mang po'i pha ma 'di// khrel med lag gi sha btson 'dra// khang rgan gog po'i phyag bdar 'di// gyang ra stong pa'i yi dwags 'dra// spyod pa mang po bdag po 'di// lta log dkor bdag srung ma 'dra// sho dar gor ma mda' la sogs// lha min 'khrugs pa rtsod pa 'dra// mig ming 'grig dang rgyal blon sogs// rgyal ring ngan pa'i 'khrug gzhi 'dra/ chab dang cho lo gzhi 'deng rnams// 'byung po gtor ma rtsod pa 'dra// so nam brel mo'i bka' thag de// rtsa shing 'og gi ba dang 'dra// glu gar rol mo'i rtse sna 'di// bdud kyi pho nya'i mgo g.yogs 'dra// de la ltad mo lta ba rnams// ri dwags smig rgyu rnyogs pa 'dra// de la kha gtogs 'jal ba rnams// lag mgo me la bus pa 'dra// de la 'dod pas g.yeng ba rnams// dri za ltogs rdzis theb pa 'dra// zhes gsungs pas/ mo na re/ bla ma lags de skad ma gsungs/ nged tshos kyang bla mchod 'jog myong*/ sbyin pa dang tshogs gsog kyang byed myong bas khyad du mi gsod par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas yang cha bcu ma'i mgur 'di gsungs so// bla mchod snying rje med pa de/ the'u rang lha rang mchod pa 'dra// bdag gzhan phung bas ya re cha// sems bskyed med pa'i chos spyod de// blun po mgo skor ra ba 'dra// 'dod pa 'bar bas ya re cha// phyogs ris can gyi dge ba de// kha len ston mo'i ri mo 'dra// re khong mang bas ya re cha// zhing sa med pa'i 'bul ba de// khram par spyi nor gtad pa 'dra// 'khrug pa 'ong bas ya re cha// snying rje med pa'i sbyin pa de// ka ba breng pas brab pa 'dra// rang la 'khrus pas ya re cha// rang rgyud ma dul lta ba de// 'ud sgo rbad gtam byed pa 'dra// rgyu 'bras gsod pas ya re cha// gnad du ma song sgom pa de/

rdzun mas zol khang dbub pa 'dra// yod lo byas pas ya re cha// rten 'brel ma shar spyod pa de// smyon pas tsha chu 'thung ba 'dra// rang mgo g.yogs pas ya re cha// chos brgyad bsgrigs pa'i dam tshig de// mi gtsang dar gyi gtum pa 'dra// nang du rtul pas ya re cha// rang 'dod ma spangs 'bras bu de// rdzab la mi gzugs bzos pa 'dra// rkyen ngan mi thub ya re cha// zhes gsungs pas dad pa skyes nas mgo la g.yu phung po cig yod pa maṇḍal byas te phul nas tshe gcig la sangs rgyas pa'i chos shig nyan nas bsgom 'dod pas/ zab mo'i chos shig thugs la thogs zhus pas bla mas rdo rje'i rkang bzhi pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod nyon dang phyug mo legs se 'bum// rnam rig bkra ba'i dad pa can/ khyed rang gi lus la tshur ltos la// skyid 'dod med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// rang gi ngag la tshur ltos la// smra 'dod med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// rang gi sems la tshur ltos la// rnam rtog med pa'i sgom zhig gyis// lus ngag yid gsum ma yengs la// sgom rgyu yod pa'i sgom zhig gyis// zhes gsungs pas zhag bdun ma yengs par bsgoms pas zhag bdun nas bla ma la dad pa skyes te gser gyi phud cig yod pa de maṇḍal byas te phul nas gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa 'di glu ru phul lo// rje ngo mtshar ras kyi na bza' can// gtad pa med pa'i kheng sems can// ya nga med pa'i zhe dogs can// chags pa med pa'i blo gdeng can// brtul zhugs ras la phyag 'tshal lo// brtul zhugs ras la mchod pa 'bul// brtul zhugs ras la sdig pa bshags// bla ma khyed la rjes yi rang*// brtul zhugs ras la gsol ba 'debs// brtul zhugs ras pas byin gyis rlobs// bdag 'gro ba'i don la thugs rjes zungs// ngas rang gi lus la tshur bltas nas// skyid 'dod med pa'i sgom zhig byas lags kyang*// da rung skyid 'dod 'ong zhing 'dug

/rang gi ngag la tshur bltas nas// smra 'dod med pa'i sgo zhig byas lags kyang*// da rung smra 'dod cig 'ong zhig 'dug /rang gi sems la tshur bltas nas// rnam rtog med pa'i sgom zhig byas lags kyang*/ da rung rnam rtog 'ong zhig 'dug /lus ngag yid gsum la bltas nas// bsgom rgyu med pa'i sgom zhig byas lags kyang*// da rung sgom zhig byed snying 'dod// zhes zhus pas/ de'i lan du gegs sel dang ngo sprod kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod nyon dang phyug mo legs se 'bum// rnam rig bkra ba'i dad pa can// khyod lus la skyid 'dod 'dug pa na// 'dus pa'i gnyan la gson bral rgyob// bsags pa'i nor rdzas chos la thong*// zhen chags med pa'i ngang du sdod// khyod ngag la smra 'dod 'dug pa na// 'jig rten chos brgyad chu la thob// 'phyor dang rang mtho rlung la skur// nga rgyal med pa'i ngang du sdod// khyod sems la rnam rtog 'dug pa na// rnam rtog dran pa'i thag pas zungs// mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang la sbos// gang shar rjes med ngang la skyongs// khyod da rung sgom zhig 'dod pa na// sems can rna mas la snying rje sgom// rang lus thugs rje chen por bsgom// spyir bor rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom// stong pa nyid la sgom yun srings// rjes la bsngo ba rgya yis thob// de go bar gyis la lha chos gyis// zhes gsungs pa legs par bsgoms pas khrid dang gdams ngag ston nus pa'i rnal 'byor ma cig tu grol te/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo brgya 'dren pa'i dam bca' yang phul/ dbul phongs yongs la zas nor yang bkyes te ngo mtshar ba cig byung ngo*// de thams cad legs se 'bum me'i skor ro// na mo gu ru rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid bsod snyoms du phyir bzhud pa la/ yon bdag legs se 'bum me bya bas/ rje btsun chen po khyed rgyal khams phyogs med 'grims pa la 'phral gyi skyabs gnas re sa mthar thug gi gtug sgo ji lta bu zhig yod zhus pas de'i lan du mgur bzhengs pa/

bla ma byin rlabs gyi rtsa ba can// yi dam dngos grub gyi rtsa ba can// mkha' 'gro byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba can// chos skyong dpal mgon gyi rtsa ba can/ bdag mos pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi// phyi nas bar chad sol// nang nas dngos grub ster// bar do'i lam sna drongs// sems 'khrul pa 'gag par byed pas// mi bdag la re sa skyabs gnas de las med/ yang yon bdag gis zhus pa/ rje btsun khyed la re sa gtug sgo de 'dra ba gcig yod par 'dug pas da pha yul ji lta bu zhig yod zhus pas/ gzhi stong nyid kyi phu lung yang dang gcig /ye shes kyi chu rgyun 'bras bu gnyis// mtha' bral gyi rtsi thog rgyas dang gsum// gdams ngag gi sa 'phrang dogs dang bzhi// don de bzhi dang ldan pa'i pha yul la// ngas skye ba gtan gyi so nam ma byas na// 'jig rten gyi yul gyis bslu bslu 'dra/ yod pas 'tsho skyong ma thub// med pas btsal gyis mi rnyed pa'i sdug bsngal// sdang ba'i dgra dang 'phrad dogs// gnyen byams pa dang 'bral dogs/ de bdag rnal 'byor pa thang rang bas pha yul 'di la zhen pa chung bar thal lo// yang yon bdag gis zhus pa/ khyed pha yul yag po de 'dra zhig yod par 'dug /srog mkhar yang ci 'dra ba zhig yod zhus pas/ yang rje btsun gyis mgur bzhengs pa/ gzhi dad pa'i gting rdo brtan dang gcig /bsam tan gyi gyang zhing che dang gnyis// brtson 'grus kyi mgo 'phang mtho dang gsum// shes rab kyi ba gam btags dang bzhi// don de bzhi dang ldan pa'i skur mkhar la// ngas skye ba gtan gyi skur mkhar ma byas na// khyed 'jig rten gyi mkhar gyis slu bslu 'dra// 'jig par ni sla// rtsigs par dka'// zas nor thams cad kyi phung 'dre// pha spun thams cad kyi sdang 'dre// phung mkhar ri bo 'di'i bden rdzun la ltos dang*// de bas bdag rnal 'byor pa thang rang bas sku mkhar 'di la zhen pa chung bar thal lo// yang zhus pa/

khyed la sku mkhar yag po de 'dra ba yod par 'dug pas/ srid sde ci 'dra yod zhus pas yang mgur gsungs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi gtso bo bzang dang gcig /dam chos kyi zhal ngo rags dang gnyis// dge 'dun gyi tsha zhang dar dang gsum/ chos skyong gi stag shar dpa' dang bzhi// don de bzhi bsdebs pa'i srid sde la// ngas skye ba gtan gyi srid sde ma byas na// khyed 'jig rten gyi srid sde bslus bslus 'dra// gong ma rnams la phrag dog /bar ma rnams la ni 'gran// tha ma rnams la ni khyad gsod// gnyen nye du khyi shig spar ba gang po 'di'i bden rdzun la ltos dang*// de bas bdag rnal 'byor pa thang rang bas srid sde la zhen pa chung bar thal lo// yang yon bdag gis zhus pa/ khyed la srid sde yag pa de 'dra ba yod par 'dug pas/ 'o na khyed la zhing ji lta bu yod zhus pas/ yang rje btsun gyis mgur bzhengs pa/ kun gzhi'i zhing sa bzang ba dang gcig /byang chub kyi myu gu 'khrungs pa dang gnyis// dge bcu'i me tog mdzes dang gsum// sku bzhi'i 'bras bu smin dang bzhi// don de bzhi bsdebs pa'i zhing sa la// ngas skye ba gtan gyi zhing sa ma byas na/ 'jig rten gyi zhing sa 'dis bslu bslu 'dra// so nam ni dka'// 'bras ni chung*// kor so yod tsa rang 'gro ba'i zhing sa 'di'i bden rdzun la ltos dang*// de bas bdag rnal 'byor pa thang rang bas zhing sa 'di la zhen pa chung bar thal lo// yang zhus pa/ khyed la zhing sa yag po de 'dra ba zhig yod par 'dug pas/ da khyed la chung ma ji lta bu zhig yod zhus pas/ yang rje btsun gyis mgur gsungs pa/ gzhi stong nyid kyi chung ma bzang dang gcig /stong gsal gyi cho ris btsun dang gnyis// bde stong gi mnyam sbyor mkhas dang gsum// dkon mchog gi pha ming bzang dang bzhi// don de bzhi ldan pa'i chung ma la// skye ba gtan gyi chung ma ma byas na// khyed 'jig rten gyi chung mas bslu bslu 'dra// kha ni yar za// snying ni phyir bsam// lkog snyogs ni rkyen/

bdud mi lce bde ma 'di'i bden rdzun la ltos dang*/ de bas bdag rnal 'byor pa thang rang bas chung ma la zhen pa chung bar thal lo// yang yon bdag gis zhus pa/ khyed la chung ma yag po de 'dra bar yod par 'dug pas sras bu ji lta bu yod zhus pas/ yang rje btsun gyis mgur gsungs pa/ rig pa rang grol gyi sras bu 'khrungs dang gcig /byin rlabs rang chas kyi gshog pa rgyas dang gnyis// nyams rtogs rto mnyen gyi smra lce bde dang gsum// bde gshegs kyi gdung brgyud 'dzin dang bzhi// don de bzhi ldan pa'i sras bu la// ngas skye ba gtan gyi sras bu ma byas na// khyed 'jig rten gyi sras bu 'dis kyang bslu bslu 'dra// chung dus nas sos dka'/ che tsa na yar rgol du 'ong*// 'chi khar 'phreng rdo byed pa'i sdug phrug kha dmar po 'di'i bden rdzun la ltos dang*// de bas rnal 'byor pa thang rang bas kyang sras bu la zhan pa thal lo// yang yon bdag gis zhus pa/ khyed la sras yag po de 'dra bar yod par 'dus pas/ 'o na khyed la mthar thug gi gtug sgo ji lta bu zhig yod zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs pa/ snang ba la zhen pa log pa dang gcig /'khor ba la skyo ba skyes pa dang gnyis// yin min gyi sgro 'dogs chod pa dang gsum/ gdams ngag gi rang ngo shes pa bzhi// nga rnal 'byor pa'i mthar thug pa'i gtug sgo de la byed// khyed 'jig rten gyi bya ba de 'khor ba'i rgyu// dge bshes rang byung rnams kyi sde 'khrugs byed// sngags pa rnams kyi nang rgyal byed// nya ma rnams kyis shab shub byed/ khyed 'jig rten gyi bya ba de 'khor ba'i rgyu// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad 'bum me'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun yab sras mang yul rong na mar byon nas ldom bu la bzhud pa la/ bud med gcig gis rnal 'byor pa khyod pha yul e yod zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis pha yul gcig kyang yod gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// stong nyid kyi lung pa yangs dang gcig

/mnyam nyid kyi rtsi thog rgyas dang gnyis// gnad kyi sa 'gag dom dang gsum// 'di gsum 'dzom pa'i pha yul la// 'khrul pa'i yul shugs ma byung na// nga rnal 'byor gyi yul skal de la bya// chags sdang gi pha yul med kyang nyan// mi tshe rgyal khams 'grim pas chog /yang mo na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyed la pha zhing e yod zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas pha zhing gcig kyang yod gsungs nas mgus 'di bzhengs pa/ kun gzhi'i zhing sa bzang dang gcig /gdams ngag sa bon theb dang gnyis// dge sbyor gyi rmo rko yag dang gsum// de gsum 'dzom pa'i zhing sa la// rnam rtog gi sad ser ma byung na// nga rnal 'byor gyi zhing skal de la bya// srib zhing rlog pa med kyang nyan// gtan du ldom bu byas pas chog /yang mo na re/ 'o na rnal 'byor pa khyod la sku mkhar e yod zer ba la/ rje btsun kyi zhal nas/ mkhar cig kyang yod gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/ dad pa'i rmi rdo brtan dang gcig /thos bsam gyi sgo mo mkhrigs dang gnyis// lta ba'i yang thog mtho dang gsum// de gsum 'dzom pa'i sa mkhar la// 'khrul pa'i sgyogs kyis ma bshig na// nga rnal 'byor gyi mkhar skal de la bya// sa mkhar skya mo med kyang rung*// nyal sa brag la byas pas chog /yang mo na re/ 'o na rnal 'byor pa khyed la phyam tshe e yod zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis phyam tshe cig kyang yod gsungs nas mgur gsungs pa/ byin rlabs kyi so pa bzang dang gcig /gtum mo'i rde'u sna chu blug dang gnyis// dge sbyor gyi tshem po yag dang gsum// de gsum 'dzom pa'i bar phyam la// chos brgyad kyi zad ral ma byung na// nga rnal 'byor gyi ber skal de la bya// chos brgyad kyi ber phyam med kyang nyan// mi tshe ras kyi skyel bas chog /yang mo na re/ 'o na khyed rnal 'byor pa la chung ma e yod zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis chung ma cig kyang yod gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/

bka' brgyud kyi cho rigs btsun dang gcig /nyams myong gi skye gzugs bzang dang gnyis// dam tshig gi brtse gdung che dang gsum// de gsum gcig pus bskyal bas chog /phrag dog gi bor skyur ma byung na// nga rnal 'byor gyi grogs skal de la bya// khong khro'i chung ma med kyang nyan// mi tshe gcig pus bskyal bas chog /yang mo na re/ 'o na rnal 'byor pa khyed la de tsho kun yod na rta e yod zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi rta cig kyang yod gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/ brtson 'grus kyi rta pho bzang dang gcig /mnyam bzhag gi sga stan bde dang gnyis// shes rab kyi snang ba rno dang gsum// de gsum 'dzom pa'i rta pho la// le lo'i sgrog tu ma tshud na// nga rnal 'byor gyi rta skal de la bya// khrag chags rta pho med kyang nyan// mi tshe rkang thang gi skyel bas chog /ces gsungs so// yang rje btsun yab sras mang yul rong na byon pa'i dus su/ rabs chad rgan rgon gnyis 'dug pa la/ nged rnal 'byor pa gnyis la 'tsho ba slong gsungs pas/ khong gnyis na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyed la yul e yod/ med na nged gnyis kyi bu dod e byed nged la yul bzang po'ang yod zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// yul dang po nyams dga' skyid skyid po// lus ngag yid gsum gzad pa'i sag bdar yin// bar du rmo rko 'o re brgyal// sa bon phar btab tshur mi 'byung*// yul ngan tsa ma'i mug grong de// mgon med dri za'i grong khyer 'dra// tha mal skyur nas 'gro rgyu yin/ de 'dra'i yul med 'gyod rgyu med// 'gyod med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba de bla ma'i bka' drin yin// pha gsol ba 'debs so lo tsā ba// sprang pos ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas khong gnyis na re/ der ma gsungs nged kyi pha bzang gi bu mo bzhin legs ma zhig kyang len zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// gnyen dang po 'phrad dga' mthong sdug po// a rku dang ngo brid kyi lung pa 'geng*/

bar du sha chang gi za len can// phar gcig byin na tshur gcig ston// tha mar chags sdang gyod gzhi can// dme shi gyod rtsa'i gnyen med 'gyod rgyu med// 'gyod med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba 'di bla ma'i bka' drin yin// pha gsol ba 'debs so lo tsā ba// sprang pos ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas khong gnyis na re/ bla ma lags pha bzang gi bu mo 'di la ni mtho dman med par chags pa 'dra ba cig 'dug zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// grogs dang po lha mo bzhad kha ma// phar lta ba'i gdong la chog shes med// bar du srin mo ru mig ma// phar gcig bzlas na tshur gnyis zlo// skra la 'gyus na rgyud pa 'phyang*// dbyug pa brgyab nas gzar bu khur// tha mal ba rgan sos med ma// srin mo'i sdang mig sems la gzan// de 'dra'i grogs med 'gyod rgyu med// 'gyod med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// pha gsol ba 'debs so lo tsā ba// sprang pos ri khrod thub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ de ma gsung shi rgas kyi gtug tsa/ bu med pa 'di sems pham po cig 'dug zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// bu dang po lha bu chung chung po// snying brtse bas sems la bzod blag med// bar du bu lon gdos drag po// yod tshad byin yang mgu rgyu med// mi yi bu mo khyim du 'dzud// drin chen pha ma rgyab tu 'phud// pha yis bos kyang len mi khug /ma yis bos kyang a mi khug /tha mar khyim mtshes snying ring po// grong pa'i kha ches byas pas phung*// de 'dra'i bud med 'gyod rgyu med// 'gyod med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba 'di bla ma'i bka' drin yin// pha gsol ba 'debs so lo tsā ba// zhes gsungs pas khong gnyis na re/ bla ma lags nged tsho la ni bu mo re med zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// bu mo dang po lha phrug 'dzum kha ma// nor gang dmar 'khyer ba'i dbang mo che// bar du lan chags 'khor med ma// pha la ngos nas slong zhing 'khyer// ma la lkog tu rku zhing 'khyer// byin pa ngo sor mi 'khyer zhing*// drin chen gyi pha ma snying stong 'jug

/tha mar mi mo gdong dmar ma// yag na mi yi dpal skye ma// nyes na rang gi sdug byur ma// de 'dra'i bu mo med kyang 'gyod rgyu med// 'gyod med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba 'di bla ma'i bka' drin yin// pha gsol ba 'debs so lo tsā// ces gsungs pas/ bla ma lags/ de ma gsungs nged gnyis la zas nor bzang po yod pas skyid nas 'ong zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// nor dang po bdag skyid gzhan smon po// ci tsam yod kyang chog shes med// bar du ser sna'i mdud pas bsdams// dam pa'i chos la gtong mi phod// dgra 'dre gnyis kyi g.yab shing yin// rang gis bsag zhing gzhan gyis spyad// tha mal rang srog skyel ba'i rgyu// de 'dra'i nor med 'gyod rgyu med// 'gyod med kyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// blo bde ba bla ma'i bka' drin yin// pha gsol ba 'debs so lo tsā ba// lar zang zing bdud kyi phung gzhi ma// nga mi la ras pa ga la chags// khyod skyi rong gi rabs chad rgan rgon dang*// nga gung thang gi mi la ras pa gnyis// smon lam gyi 'brel pa bzhag pa yin// tshe 'di la mjal bar ma mchis kyang*/ tshe phyi mar ces kyang 'phrad par nges// 'chi khar lha chos byed nus na// bu dang tsha bo de ka yin// zhes gsus pas rabs chad rgan rgon dad pa skyes nas nor thams cad chos la btang zhing*/ gdams ngag 'pho ba zhus pas 'chi dus 'pho ba zin nas mkha' spyod du 'gro nus pa byung ngo*// de thams cad mang yul gyi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun gtsang gi snye nam du byon pa la/ yon bdag gshin rdor mo dang mjal bas/ kho rgas zin nas bla ma'i drung du mchi ma phru le byung bas/ bla mas yon bdag khyed ci yin gsungs pas nga rgas zer bas/ rgas pa khyed min skye 'gro thams cad la 'ong*/ de bas nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o skol 'gro ba 'jig rten pa// skye rga na 'chi chu bo bzhi// gcig la mi zad yongs la 'ong*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal du yang yang 'khor// mi shes rgya mtsho'i rba la g.yeng*// bde ba skad cig mi gda' na// sdug gi dogs pas sdug bsngal byas// skyid la re zhing sdug bsngal byas// dus da lta sdug bsngal spang len dang*// da yang sdug bsngal ma byed par// 'chi khar lha chos byas na 'thad// ces gsungs pas/

kho na re/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal ji lta bu lags// zhes zer ba'i len du skye ba'i sdug bsngal yod tshul gyi mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o na yon bdag gzhung bzang po/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsam na// kun gzhi bar dor 'khyams po de// chags spyod mthong dus rnam shes 'khrugs// pha ma'i chags spyod mngal du zhugs// ma yi mngal du zhugs tsam na// nya mo rgya la 'khris pa bzhin// khrag dang chu ser nang su nyal// mi gtsang ba la sngas stan byas// las ngan dbang gis lus ngan grub// gnas ngan nang du sdug bsngal spyod// tshe snga phyi dran yang skad mi thon// tsha grang sdug bsngal sna tshogs spyad// zla ba bcu la dmyal bar sreg /ma la skyes pa'i dus su yang*// zub ma'i mig nas 'grim pa bzhin// ma la skyes nas sgor thon tsa// tsher ma'i dong du bskyur ba 'dra// ma yi lag pas blangs tsam la// byis phrug khra yis khyer ba 'dra// mi gtsang phru ma phyes tsam na/ sha lpags so sor phyes pa 'dra// lte ba'i thag pa bcad tsam na// khog pa'i srog rtsa bcad pa 'dra/ tshem me nang du bzhag tsam na// btson dong nang du 'phang pa 'dra// skye med don cig ma rtogs na// skye ba'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das// 'chi khar dgos pa'i lha chos la// phyi bshol byas na skal pa chad// 'bung ba yod tshad sbyin par thong*// zhes gsungs pas/ kho na re/ bla ma lags rgas pa'i rgyus nga rang yang zhib ste de yang gcig gsungs pas zhu zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o skol 'gro ba 'jig rten pa// 'jig rten pa la phar bltas tsa// rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yid chad mang*// drang por skyes pa'i lus po sgur/ brtan por bzhag pa'i gom pa 'khyor// sems kyi lo ma skra yang dkar// dbang po'i dwangs ma mig kyang 'grib// yan lag gtso bo mgo bo 'khor// sgra yi rgyal po rna ba 'on// mkhur tshos khrag gi rgya mtsho skem// byad kyi brgyang shing sna yang zhom// rus pa'i rgyal po so yang bud// smra ba'i rgyal po lce yang dig

/shig dang bu lon bsad cing mang*// zas dang gnyen 'dun btung yang 'bros// bden par smras kyang nyan mi med// gces par gsos pa'i bu tshas sdang*// gsos tshad byin la drin bzo med// shi 'phyis zer zhing bsdig mo mang*/ rgas med don cig ma rtogs na// rgas pa'i sdug bsngal bsam las 'das// rgas nas lha chos ma dran na// sngon gyi las kyi rnam smin yin// lha chos kha dbugs yod rigs gyis// zhes gsungs pas/ a mtshar po rgas pa nga bas khyed zhib par 'dug /na ba'i sdug bsngal ci 'dra zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o skol 'gro ba 'jig rten pa// na ba'i sdug bsngal bshad tsam na// glo bur nyid la nad kyis sleb// zug gzer yin la med par langs// rlung mkhris bad kan bdud du babs// khrag dang chu ser khol zhing gzer/ gzer dang nad kyi dbang song bas/ stan 'thug po bting yang srab pa 'dra// sngas mtho bo bzhag kyang dma' ba 'dra// yi gar 'ong ba chu las med// sngon ser sna byas pa'i rnam smin yin// zas zhim po byin yang dang kha log /gnas bsil bar bzhag kyang me bas tsha// gos dron po bkon yang chu bas grang*// mal bde mor nyal yang 'gre ldog mang*// gnyen bshes rnams kyi mtha' bskyor yang*// na ba'i sdug bsngal bsal thabs med// mo bon sman pa thabs mang yang*// las ngan nad de sel bar dka'// nad med don cig ma rtogs na// na ba'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab// las nad nam 'phog mi shes pa'i// sdug chis lha chos byas na 'thad// ces gsungs pas/ kho na re/ 'chi ba 'di ji ltar 'ong ye nas ma shes pas/ de gcig gsungs bar zhu zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o na yon bdag bzang rgan po// 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal skyi re bung*// lan gcig 'chi ba'i dus byung tsa// gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la// phyug po'i nor gyis bslu thabs med// dpa' bo'i gom gsum btud sa med// mdzangs pas lo rgyus bkrol sa med// 'phongs pas zhu ba byed sa med// ngan pas smyon rdol byed sa med// sdar mas wa bros byed sa med// yan lag rtsa rnams mtha' nas sdud// phung po ri bos non pa 'dra// brgya 'gro stong 'gro mthong ba med// khri bos stong bos tshor rgyu med// phan du re ba'i sman pas bor// skyabs su re ba'i mo bon bros// bsnyen sgrub byas pa'i lha srung yal// ngo e shes byas kyang mgo bo bsgril// gtam smra bar 'dod kyang smra ma nus// dbugs phyi nang rgyu ba ma chad kyang*// lus la gshin po'i dri ma bro// drod me stag tsam de mtha' nas sdud// la las gza' dang skar ma rtsi// la las sdug bsngal 'o dod 'bod// la las zas dang nor la dmigs// nor rang gis sdug gsog gzhan gyis spyod// nor bdag bsags gzhan spyod kyi sdug bsngal spyod// sems brtse ba mang ste gcig pur 'gro// grogs bzang po yod kyang skyugs bro lta// shul du rdzas la gang thob lta// gces pa'i lus la gsum khug byed// phung po rgyang du skyur nas 'bros// mer bsregs chur bskyur dong du bcug

/med par zin tsa kho thag chod// de bzod par 'dug gam skal ldan kun// dbugs 'gyu ba chad pa'i nang pa der// 'dzam gling nor gis mi phan ang*// da ser sna byed mi ci bsam na// byams pa'i gnyen gyis mtha' bskor yang*// phan pa skad cig sgrub thabs med// thams cad bral ba mthong tsa na// brtse gdung che yang ci phan ang*// de 'dra'i dus shig byung tsa na// dam pa'i lha chos ma lags pa'i// gang gis phan pa ma yin pas// rgas dus mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod// 'chi dus mi 'tsher tsam re mdzod// ces gsungs pas rang dbang med par zhen pa log nas bsags tshad chos la btang ngo*// rang yang dad pa'i ngang nas 'pho ba zin nas thar pa'i gnas su skyes so// de thams cad gshin rdor mo'i skor ro// ༈ na mo gu ru/ rje btsun mi la ras pa de nyid bu slob du ma dang bcas pu rang nas ti se la byon pa las/ la tog tu ti se dang ma sang gi gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pas bsu ba byas/ phyag btsal mchod pa ngo mtshar can rgya chen phul/ ti se dang ma sang rje btsun slob brgyud dang bcas pa'i sgrub gnas su phul/ gzhan yang rje btsun gyi chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i gang zag rnams skyong bar khas blangs nas rang gnas su song ngo*// rje btsun dpon slob kyis kyang tsho ma phang gi 'gram du phyag phebs pa'i tshe/ nā ro bon chung ming sring gis kyang rje btsun dpon slob kyi snyan grags dang*/ ti se la 'byon pa'i lo rgyus sngar nas tshor bas mtsho ma phang gi 'gram du gdong bsu ru byung ste/ ngo shes rung ma shes pa ltar byas nas/ rje btsun dpon slob la khyed rnams gang nas yin gang du 'gro zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis nged rnams la phyi bya ba'i ri khrod cig nas yin/ ti se la bsgom du 'ong ba yin gsungs pas/ kho na re/ su ji skad bya ba yin zer bas/ rje btsun gyis nga mi la ras pa bya ba yin gsungs pas/ yang kho na re/ 'o na gangs ti se dang mtsho ma phang 'di khyod rang dang 'dra ste/

rgyang nas grags pa che ba ma gtogs de tsam ya mtshan che rgyu med/ ya mtshan che rung nged bon por dbang ba'i ri yin pas/ 'dir sdod na nga'i lugs kyi bon byed dgos zer nas/ rje btsun gyis/ ri 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan 'dzin spyi la thub pas lung bstan pa'i ri yin/ sgos nga mi la ras pa la mar pas lung bstan pa'i gnas yin pas/ khyed rang bon po rnams sngar bsdad pa rgyal du chug /nga 'dir sdod na nged kyi lugs kyi chos byed na rung mi byed na gzhan du song zhig gsungs pas/ kho na re/ khyed gnyis 'dra bar 'dug /rgyang nas grags che la 'gram du don chung ba zhig 'dug /khyod ngo mtshar can zhig yin na/ khyod dang rdzu 'phrul gyi rtsal zhig 'gran nas su rgyal ba de gnas 'di dbang ba yin zer/ bon pos ma phang gi 'gram tshun du rkang pa bzhag nas 'di skad du/ gangs dkar ti se sgra che yang*// ri mgo kha bas g.yogs pa cig /ma phang g.yu mtsho sgra che yang*// chu nyid chu yis gshag pa cig /mi la ras pa sgra che yang*// mi rgan gcer nyal byed pa cig /kha nas glu chung len pa cig /lag na ber lcag bzung ba cig /de la ya mtshan che rgyu med// nged bon po mi 'gyur g.yung drung sku// yi gshin gtsug phud kyi lha tshogs dang*// khro rgyal khrag 'thung kha 'gying ba// dbu dgu pa la phyag bco brgyad// de nyid sprul pa ge khod ni// mgo dgu rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs mnga'// de yi sring mo srid rgyal ma// de yi rjes bzung bon chung nga*// rdzu 'phrul ston na 'di ltar ston/ zer byung bas/ rje btsun gyi sku cher ma song ma phang chung du ma song ba steng nas bkab ste bzhugs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// kye kye nyon dang lha mi tsho// bya rgod phung po'i ri bo na// mi 'jigs brgyad kyi khri steng na// rgyal ba shākya thub pa bzhugs// de dang ye shes gnyis med sku// 'og min chos kyi pho brang na// drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen de// yum chen bdag med lha mo dang*// lhan skyes ngang du rol pa yi// ti lo zhes bya sprul sku dang*// paṇa chen sgo skyong nā ro pa// sgra sgyur sangs rgyas mar pa de// de rnams byin rlabs zhugs pa yi// ming yongs su grags pa'i mi la ngas// lho brag mar pa'i bka' bsgrub phyir// ti se'i gangs la bsgom du 'gro// rang gzhan don gnyis bsgrub pa'i tshe// khyod lta log can gyi bon po la// bka' mchid gtam len glu yis 'jal// gangs dkar ti se sgra che ba// ri mgo kha bas g.yogs pa de// sangs rgyas bstan pa dkar ba yin// ma phang g.yu mtsho sgra che ba// chu nyid chu yis bshags pa de/

chos rnams zad sar skyol ba yin// nga mi la ras pa sgra che ba// mi rgan gcer nyal byed pa de// gzung 'dzin sbubs nas thon pa yin// kha ru glu chung len pa de// snang ba de dpe char shar ba yin// lag na ber lcag bzung ba de// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho brgal ba yin// nga snang sems gnyis la dbang bsgyur bas// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul ston pa la// 'jig rten lha la rag ma lus// 'dzam gling ri rgyal ti se 'di// spyir sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin thams cad dbang*// sgos mi la brgyud par bcas pa dbang*// khyed lta log can gi bon po rnams/ dam chos byed na kun la phan// mi byed rdzu 'phrul nga che bas// yul phyogs sa cha gzhan du song*// slar yang rdzu 'phrul 'di la ltos// zhes gsungs nas/ slar yang ma phang phyag sor gyi rtse la blangs te// chu la gnas pa'i srog chags rnams la gnod pa med par mdzad pas/ na ro bon chung na re/ da lan gyi rdzu 'phrul khyod ngo mtshar che ba tsam byung ste/ nga sleb par snga bas mnyam por thong la rdzu 'phrul gyi rtsal 'gran te nus su che ba lta zer bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga rdzas kyi bslad nas pha rol gyi mig 'phrul du 'jug pa'i sgyu ma mkhan dang rdzu 'phrul mi 'gran/ khyod rang nga'i chos mi byed na/ gnas gzhan du song gsungs nas/ kho na re/ nga g.yung drung gus blos btang ba mi 'ong*/ rdzu 'phrul 'gran nas khyod rang rgyal na nga rang blos blangs nas 'gro/ de min na khyod chos pas nga gsod pa dang brdung ba byas na ni chos kyi dam tshig dang 'gal bas chos par mi rung*/ de min nga mi 'gro bas rdzu 'phrul 'gran no zer/ kho ti se bon skor du song rje btsun dpon slob chos skor la byon pas/ ti se byang shar rdzong gi lung pa'i nang na pha bong chen po zhig gi khar mjal bas/ kho na re/ khyed rnams bskor ba byed pa legs/ da lan nga'i lugs su 'gro zer rje btsun gyi phyag nas 'then lo byed du byung bas/

rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga lam log pa la zhugs nas skor log la mi 'gro/ chos log mi byed/ de nas khyod rang nga'i phyi bzhin chos dang bskor ba la shog gsungs/ bon po'i lag pa nas bzung ste phar 'then tshur 'then pa'i bar der/ pha bong gi steng na gnyis ka'i zhabs rjes byung ste/ de'i tshe rje btsun gyi thugs dam gyi nus pas/ bon po chos skor la khrid nas/ ti se'i byang rgyab tu sleb tshe/ kho na re/ rting sor yang bon skor la 'gro dgos song zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod rang gi nus pa la rag las gsungs pas/ kho na re/ da lan khyod nus pa che che 'dra ba zhig byung ste/ da dung gyad kyi rtsal 'gran zer/ pha bong chen po zhig gi khar pha bong g.yag ro tsam zhig bskyal byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis kyang bon po'i gyad rdo'i khar khong rang gi de'i nyis 'gyur tsam zhig bskyal bas/ yang kho na re/ da lan yang khyod rgyal te lan gnyis rgyal bas rgyal go mi chod da dung yang rtsal 'gran zer ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nyi zla dang rgyu skar 'od 'gran rung gling bzhi'i mun pa nyi zlas sel/ khyod dang rtsal 'gran rung khyod kyis nga mi do bas/ ti se nga'i dbang ba yin/ khyod 'phral nyams dga' ba tsam dang*/ nged rang chos pa'i sgrub brgyud kyi che ba kun gyis mthong phyir/ rdzu 'phrul bstan pas chog gsungs/ rje btsun ti se'i nub phyogs rdzong lung gi padma phug na bzhugs/ bon po de'i bar phyogs na yod pa las/ rje btsun gyi zhabs nub ri nas kho rang gi sgrub khang gi brag gi ngos la brkyang ste zhabs rjes zhag nas/ khyed kyis kyang 'di bzhin gyis shig gsungs nas/ khos kyang nub phyogs la rkang pa brkyangs pas chu kha las ma sleb pa las/ nam mkhar mi ma yin rnams kyi bzhad gad thog pa cig byung bas/ bon po cung zad kha skyengs rung da rung yang rdzu 'phrul 'gran no zer zhing bon po kho chos skor la song*/

rje btsun gyis chos skor kho na la phebs nas/ yang ti se'i lho phyogs su mjal ba'i tshe char zhig bab pa las/ rje btsun gyis char yib byed sa dgos par 'dug pas/ khyod khang 'og 'gram pa rtsig gam/ steng gi thog dbubs gsungs pas khyod rang 'gram rtsigs shig /ngas thog 'bub pa yin zer ba las/ pha bong chen po mi gsum tsam gyen du lang pa zhig la phyag mdzub gtad de/ 'o na pha gi zhog cig gsungs pas byed zer song*/ rje btsun gyis 'gram bslang nas gzigs pas/ khos pha bong de las rngams khye'u lo brgyad tsam lon pa'i gzugs tsam pha bong rang ji lta bur gshags tshar 'dug pa/ lta stangs mdzad sdigs mdzub phyar bas/ khos gshags pa'i rdo de sked pa nas chag pa/ da khyer chog gsungs pas/ nga'i de khyod kyis bcag zer bas rdzu 'phrul gyi 'gran na mi chog pa byed pa yin mod/ ngas gshog tu 'jug cing chags pa'i lta stangs mi byed/ shogs la khyer shog gsungs pas/ yang khos sngar gyi de lta bu zhig gshags nas 'degs par brtsams pa las/ yang rje btsun gyis mi theg pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas/ kho na re/ ngas gshags yod khyod kyis khol cig zer bas/ rje btsun gyis 'gram slong bar byas/ khyod kyis thog 'gel bar byas pa yin pas khyod rang gi e thog ltos la shog cig gsungs pas/ khos slar yang 'degs par brtsams pa las ma theg par mig rig rig lus pas rje btsun gyi zhal nas nga mchog thun mong gnyis ka'i dngos grub thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i rtsal dang rdzu 'phrul khyod thun mong gi rdzu 'phrul thob pa tsam gyi mi thub/ ngas lta stangs byas zil gyis mnan na khyod kyis gshog kyang mi thub par 'dug ste/ ngas lta stangs ma byas rung shogs pa yang gang zag gzhan ma la ltos na dga' ba yin/ da byed na 'di ltar byed gsungs phyag ya gcig gis blangs te dkal bas/ rdo la phyag rjes shig byung*/ mtho 'dug gsungs nas brdzis pas zhabs rjes byung*/

dmas 'dug gsungs 'og nas btegs pas yang dbu dang phyag rjes byung ba de la rdzu 'phrul phug tu grags/ de'i tshe yang bon pos rje btsun rgyal bar khas blangs so// gzhan yang rje btsun dang na ro bon chung gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rtsal mang du 'gran pa las/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa rnams ngo mtshar che ba kho na byung ba'i mthar/ na ro bon chung na re/ khyod nga la sgyu ma mkhan zer te/ ngas bltas tshe khyod rang sgyu ma mkhan du 'dug /khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul de rnams nga yid mi ches pas/ da rang re gnyis zla ba 'di'i tshes bco lnga la gangs ti se rtse mor sus sleb par mgyogs pa de ti se dbang bar byed cing mchog gi dngos grub sus thob 'dug blta'o zer bas rje btsun gyis de skad byas pas chog ste/ khyod rang nyams ban bun gyi snang ba la mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la sems kyi rang zhal mthong dgos te/ de mthong ba la nged kyi sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa la zhugs nas bsgom dgos gsungs pas/ kho na re/ khyod kyi sems dang nga'i sems la bzang ngan ci yod/ bon dang chos la khyad ci yod/ sgrub pa byas mnyam du 'dug na'ang*/ mig 'khrul yin nam sngar gyi rdzu 'phrul rnams khyod kyi de kha mtho ba tsam byung*/ da ti se'i rtse mor su mgyogs pa thag chod pa byed do zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis de ltar zhal gyis bzhes te thag bcad do// de'i tshe na ro bon chung ni sngo thul gyon nas gshang 'khrol zhing rnga la zhon te nam mkha' la 'gro ba rje btsun gyi bu slob rnams kyis gzigs te/ rje btsun gzims nas 'dug pa la ras chung pas/ rje btsun lags/ na ro bon chung ni sngon mor rta la zhon nas 'phur te ti se'i rked pa nas yar song*/ rje btsun yang da dung bzhugs nas bon po la gnas skyel ba lags sam zhes zhu ba nan gyis phul ba ltar bu slob kun phul bas/ rje btsun gyi lta stangs shig mdzad nas/ da ltos dang gsungs/

bltas pas kho gyen la 'gro ma nus pas bskor ba la song 'dug /de nas nyi ma 'char du cha ba dang*/ rje btsun chen pos yang se gol gtog pa gcig dang*/ na bza' ras 'ga'i gshog brgyang mdzad nas 'phur byon pas/ skad cig la ti se'i rtser phebs pa dang nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam du byung*/ de'i tshe rje btsun gyis brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa dges pa'i tshul du khra lam mer bzhugs 'dug pa mngon sum du gzigs pas/ ngo bo mnyam pa nyid na'ang rnam pa shin tu dges shing spro bar gyur te/ de tshe na ro bon chung yang ti se'i mgul nas sleb byung ba las/ rje btsun gyi thugs rje'i zil ma bzod nas nam mkha' nas lhung ste 'og gi rnga ti se'i lho phyogs na mar la rbab tu shor bas/ kho'i nga rgyal dang dregs pa nyams te/ dam na sa bzung ba'i ngang nas da khyod rdzu 'phrul dang nus pa che bar song bas/ ti se khyod kyis thob zin/ nga la gnas 'di mthong sa zhig tu sdod sa dgos zer byung bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod la 'jig rten 'di'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i thun mong gi rdzu 'phrul cung zad 'dug na'ang*/ nga rang byung ye shes mngon du gyur pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i gang zag rnams dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran rung mi do snga gong nas byas nas/ ti se'i rtse mo'i rdo rje'i ra ba yan ye shes kyi lha dpal 'khor lo sdo pa'i bzhugs gnas yin pas/ khyod kyis bgrod pa'i skabs mi rung*/ da lan ngas kho na chos pa'i che ba bstan phyir rgyal ba gong ma rnams la gnang ba zhus nas skabs phye ba yin/ nam mkha' nas lhung ba dang rnga rbab tu shor ba de khyod la nga rgyal chen po 'dug pa de bcag pa'i phyir ngas byas pa yin/ da gnas 'di'i rtsa bar 'gro ba yang nga'i nus pa la brten nas 'gro dgos/ nga la rtsal 'di yod pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di rnams yod pas nyon cig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// drin chen mar pa'i zhal la 'dud// sgra sgyur pa yi bka' drin dang*/

rgyal ba gong ma'i thugs rje yis// sngon grong khyer chen po mnyan yod du/ bcom ldan shākya thub pa des// mu stegs ston pa drug po de// 'khor bcas chos kyis pham byas te// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad ltar// 'dzam gling ri rgyal ti se 'dir// bod kyi rnal 'byor ras pas kyang*// bon po chos kyis pham byas te// thub bstan sgrub brgyud nyin mor byas// rdzu 'phrul gyad kyi rtsal las byung*// rnal 'byor mi la ras pa la// rtsal 'di byung ba'i rgyu rkyen mang*// byin rlabs brgyud par ldan pas na// brgyud pa 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// rdo rje 'chang gi rtsal zhig byung*// mkhyen brtse gdams ngag kun ldan pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rtsal zhig byung*// mar pa lo tsā'i rtsal zhig byung*// mtha' bral blo las 'das pa yi// lta ba 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// gdod nas dag pa'i rtsal zhig byung*// yengs med dmigs pa bral bas na// sgom pa 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// 'od gsal chen po'i rtsal zhig byung*// gang shar lhug par skyong bas na// spyod pa 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// shugs 'byung lhug pa'i rtsal zhig byung*// chos nyid rang ngo 'phrod pas na// 'bras bu 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// sna tshogs rang grol rtsal zhig byung*// bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pas na/ dam tshig 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// nyes ltung med pa'i rtsal zhig byung*// rkyen dang bsres nas bsgoms pas na/ nyams len 'di yi rtsal cig byung*// snang ba grogs shar rtsal zhig byung*// dka' thub snying rus mthar bskyal bas/ rnal 'byor rang gi rtsal zhig byung*// mi la ras pa'i rtsal zhig byung*/ rtsal des chos log tshar bcad nas// gangs dkar ti se nga dbang phyir// gnas 'dir dam chos bstan pa dar// de rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' drin yin// gsol lo mchod do ye shes lha// zhes gsungs pas/ kho na re/ khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul dang nus pa la yid ches/
