da nga la gnas 'di mthong sa zhig tu bsdad sa yod pa cig khyed shes zer bas/ rje btsun gyis 'o na khyed rang pha gir sdod cig gsungs phyag ya gcig gis gangs chag spar gang shar phyogs kyi ri stag lo'i rtser 'phangs pa ri de'i rtse mor gangs cung zad cig chags so// de nas rje btsun gyi nus pa la brten nas gnyis ka ti se'i mgul du phebs pa'i tshe/ yang kho na re/ nga ti se la skabs su bskor ba byed rgyu yod pa dang*/ de dus sdod sa zhig khyed shes zer bas/ rje btsun gyis 'o na khyod rang bskor ba yang gyis/ de dus 'dir sdod cig gsungs ti se'i mdun gyi ri zhabs shig tu bka' gnang bas/ mchod rten khong seng can du chags nas bon po rnams skor ba byed tshe 'dir sdod sa cig byung*/ rje btsun gyis slob rgyud rnams ni gangs ri mtsho gsum kun la dus rgyun du bsgyur ba yin no// gangs ti se na ro bon chung btul ba'i skor ro/// /de nas yang dpon slob gangs ti se la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rje btsun mi las ras pas spyang gi srog gi dgon par bu slob rnams la bde ba bcu gnyis mgur du gsungs pa/ mi btson chen dong nas thar ba bzhin// pha yul spangs pa'i rnal 'byor bde// rta bzang po sgrog las grol ba bzhin// gzung 'dzin grol ba'i rnal 'byor bde// ri dwags rmas ma sdod pa bzhin// gcig pur gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bde// bya rgod po'i nam 'phang bskyod pa bzhin// lta ba thag chod kyi rnal 'byor bde// mkha' la rgyu ba'i skyi ser bzhin/ thogs rdug med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// lug g.yang dkar skyong ba'i rdzi bo bzhin// rang nyams skyong ba'i rnal 'byor bde// dbus kyi ri bo lhun po bzhin// 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// chu bo chen po'i gzhung bzhin du// nyams rgyun chad med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// dur khrod nang gi mi ro bzhin// bya ba theng pa'i rnal 'byor bde// rgya mtsho nang du rdo bskyur bzhin// phyir mi ldog pa'i rnal 'byor bde// mkha' la shar ba'i nyi zla bzhin// 'od nang nas shar ba'i rnal 'byor bde// shing ta la'i lo ma bcad pa bzhin// phyis skye ba med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// dbyangs rnal 'byor bde ba bcu gnyis 'di/

khyed slob ma rnams kyi lam 'khyer mdzod// ces gsungs so// yang rje btsun chen po gnas de nyid du bzhugs pa'i dus su dgong mo'i chos thun tshar nas/ yon bdag gcig gis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gi chos zhu zhus pa mgur 'di gsungs pa lags skad/ rang sems la skye 'chi ma mchis te// rang sems 'khrul nas 'khor bar 'khyams// las kyi srid par 'khor bar sbyar// dang por skyes pa 'di re ma dga'// da mi lus rin chen thob nas kyang*// tshe phyi ma'i byang chub mi 'tshol bar// bdag 'dzin khe grags rtag tu 'dzin// 'chi khar 'gyod pa 'di re ma dga'// rtag par bzung nas nor rdzas bsags// sbyin par 'phongs nas ser snas bcings/ glo bur na tsha byung tsa na// gtong bar 'dod kyang 'dod mi med// bor nas 'gro ba 'di re ma dga'// gzhon pa'i mdangs dang dar ba'i mdog /rgas shing rgud pas g.yar po bzhag /mi sdug skra dkar gnyer ma spungs/ lang tsho yol ba 'di re ma dga'// rlung mkhris bad kan la sogs pa'i// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kyang*// rang gi lus la rten bcas nas// rang la gnod pa 'di re ma dga'// 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa'i// chad du byas shing rang rgyud bsreg /'khor ba 'khyams pa 'di re ma dga'// bu tsha las kyi 'khor ba la// las kyi gdung sems nyon re mongs// sems kyi bag chags thang re chad// bden par bzung ste 'khor bar 'khyams/ sgyu mar shes pa 'di re ma dga'// gces pa'i lus dang 'phangs pa'i srog /gnyen 'dun pha ma la sogs pa'i// bde skyid 'dzom du ma ster ba'i// las kyi 'chi ba brda mi 'phrod/ rang gcig pur 'gro ba 'di re ma dga'// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo 'di// kun la yod do ngo ma shes// ngo ma shes par bden par snang*// nges par brtags na sdug bsngal yin// de yang khyod kyis ma go'am// don de ltar dgongs la lha chos mdzod// ces re ma dga' brgyad kyi mgur 'di gsungs pas yon bdag de shin tu dad par gyur te/

yang rje btsun dpon slob yon bdag gsar rnying mang du 'tshogs nas khong tsho'i chos kyi lo rgyus thor pa cig lab pas/ rje btsun ma mnyes nas gdan las kag gis bzhengs te ma re mdzod kyi mgur bzhengs pa/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lo tsā chen pos byin gyis rlobs/ las dang rkyen du ma 'dzom pa'i// sdug bsngal gyi byang chub ma re mdzod// rang blo rtse chos la mi gtad pa'i// tshur thugs la 'dogs pa 'di ma re mdzod// rang rgyud slob mar mi gtub pa'i// gzhan gyi slob dpon 'di ma re mdzod// rang blo rang gis mi thub pa'i// gzhan blo gtad sa 'di ma re mdzod// brgyud pa rnal mas ma zin pa'i// grub rtags kyi dngos grub 'di ma re mdzod// sgom sgrub drag pos ma gcun pa'i// yid smon gyi byang chub 'di ma re mdzod// tshogs gnyis kyi rtse sprod ma song ba'i// rtol chos kyi byang chu ba 'di ma re mdzod// ngar 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dang ma bral ba'i// phyogs med kyi thugs rje 'di ma re mdzod// dngos 'dzin gyi 'ching ba ma grol ba'i/ mtha' bral lta ba 'di ma re mdzod// gcer mthong gi ngo sprod mi mnga' ba'i// sems ngo mthong ba 'di ma re mdzod// dri ma sel thabs mi shes pa'i// sgom rgyun chad med pa 'di ma re mdzod// 'khri ba nang nas ma chod pa'i// tshogs drug lhug pa 'di ma re mdzod// ting 'dzin gyi rtsad bdar mi chod pa'i// ye shes chen po 'di ma re mdzod// re dogs phra mo ma chod pa'i// 'bras bu sku gsum 'di ma re mdzod// rgyu 'bras rnal mas ma zin pa'i// gnas skabs bde 'gro 'di ma re mdzod// bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin ma nyan pa'i// mched lcam mnyes pa 'di ma re mdzod// snang ba dbang du ma 'dus pa'i// lha med 'dre med 'di ma re mdzod/ rang sems dbang du ma 'dus pa'i// bag med smyo spyod 'di ma re mdzod// rang rgyud tha mal las ma 'phags pa'i// las dge sdig med pa 'di ma re mdzod// dgon pa 'dzin cing sgrub pa po/

chos brgyad snyan pa 'di ma re mdzod// ri khrod 'dzin pa'i dam chos kun// 'phral dga' skyid chos 'di ma re mdzod// rang sems dkar por mi lta ba'i// mi ngo dkar nag srung ba 'di ma re mdzod// nyams rtogs drod tshad mi ldan pa'i// bar dor grol ba 'di ma re mdzod// gdams ngag dang sbyar bar mi ldan pa'i// skal ldan mgo skor 'di ma re mdzod// bslab sdom tshul bzhin mi bsrung ba'i// gyur shog gi smon lam 'di ma re mdzod// dam tshig gtsang ma mi srung ba'i// mkha' 'gro 'du ba 'di ma re mdzod// lung rigs gdams ngag mi ldan pa'i// tha snyad chu las ma brgal mdzod// mngon shes lnga dang mi ldan pa'i// kha phyir bltas zhal lce ma bcad mdzod// sgom yengs su med par ma rtogs pa'i// rang rgyud yan pa 'di ma re mdzod// ces pa dang*/ yang lan gcig tsa na/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir gson dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams// rang sems rang gi ma dag na/ phyi rol bkrus pas ci la phan// zhen pa rang log ma byung na// sgom nyams bzang bas ci la phan// rang 'dzin ngar 'dzin zhen 'dzin gsum// 'di gsum 'ching ba'i 'ching thag yin// 'ching thag bcad na mi sems sam// rang dang bdag dang sems dang gsum// 'di gsum ri khrod dgon pa lags// dgon pa de bzung na legs par mchi// zhes gsungs so// yang rje btsun mi las rnal 'byor bzhi yi mgur gsungs pa ni/ sems dngos por 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i rgyu// gsal la 'dzin med rang rig de// lhun grub yin par ngo shes nas// rtse gcig mtha' ru phyin pa yin// rim 'jug zer zhing mtshan bcas bsgom// rgyu 'bras zer zhing log 'tsho sgrub// rmongs pa kun 'byung bsgom pa la// rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor khong la med// gsal la 'dzin med rang sems de// ngo bo mkha' ltar gsal tsam na// spros bral mtha' ru phyin pa yin// spros bral zer zhing tha snyad mang*// rmongs pa gnyis 'dzin bsgom pa la// spros bral gyi rnal 'byor khong la med// snang sems gnyis med chos sku la/

'khor 'das ro gcig nyams su myong*// sangs rgyas sems can 'dren pa la// ro gcig mtha' ru phyin pa yin// ro gcig zer zhing du ma smra// cig char zer zhing thun du bcod/ rmongs pas yang rmongs bsgom pa la// ro gcig rnal 'byor khong la med// rnam rtog ye shes snying po can// lhun grub rgyu 'bras gnyis su med// sku gsum rang la tshang tsam na/ bsgoms med mtha' ru phyin pa yin// bsgoms med zer zhing yid la byed// 'od gsal zer zhing gti mug bsgoms// rmongs pas kha lta smra ba la// bsgom med kyi rnal 'byor khong la med// ces gsung so/ rje mi las 'phyo sa drug gi mgur 'di gsungs pa ni/ shar gyi ri bo rtse mtho ba// khu 'phang bab yun ring ring ba// mtho mtho gangs dkar gyi ldongs su gyur// de seng lcam dkar mo'i 'phyo sa mdzod// nub kyi rdza ri smug po la// char zal zim 'bab yun ring ring bas// lung chung gtsang po'i klung du gyur// lto dkar nya mo'i 'phyo sa yin// lho yi ri bo brgyud ring la// shing ljon pa skye yun ring ring bas// mtho mtho de tsan dan sdong du gyur// de rgya stag khra bo'i 'phyo sa mdzod// byang gi bre gu za zo la// gad pa chad yun ring ring bas// mtho mtho de brag dmar ldongs su gyur/ de bya rgyal rgod po'i 'phyo sa mdzod// dbus kyi gong bu bde bde ru/ so nam byed yun ring ring bas// sa grang dro med pa'i ldongs su gyur// de dbu nag mi yi 'phyo sa mdzod// rje sgra bsgyur mar pa'i zhabs drung du// nga mi la sgom yun ring ring bas// rnam rtog chos sku'i ngang du thim// de snod ldan slob ma'i 'phyo sa mdzod// ces gsungs so// yang rje btsun mi la ras pas blo bde bdun gyi mgur gsungs pa ni/ las dang skal par ldan pa yi// grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ dad gus rgyun chad ma mchis pas// steng nas rje yis byin gyis rlobs// grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma ni// mu tig rtsar la brgyus pa 'dra// mchog thun rtsa ba bla ma yin// pha bla ma'i byin rlabs bag re dro// rgyab brten dkon mchog gsum la byed// dus yeng ba med par skyob pa de// mdzangs mas bu gcig skyong ba 'dra// 'gal 'khrul med pas blo re bde/

g.yas nas dpa' bos byin gyis brlabs// bar chad bdud dpung bzlog pa de// mtshon rnon po klad la bskor ba 'dra// 'gal rkyen med pas blo re bde// g.yon nas dpa' mos byin gyis rlobs// mchog thun mong dngos grub ster ba de// ma sring byas pas bskor ba 'dra// dgos 'dod 'byung bas blo re bde// thabs shes gshog pa nang nas rgyas// chos nyid mkha' la ldigs ba der// rgod pos nam 'phang bskyod pa 'dra// lhung dogs med pas blo re bde// sems la stong nyid rtsal chen rdzogs// gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa de// seng ge gangs la 'gying ba 'dra// nyam nga med pas blo re bde// khong dgos pa'i las tshogs sgrub pa de// bran khol po las la mngag pa 'dra// da ci bsgo nyan pas blo re bde// nged skabs su nyams smyong glu ru len// blo dman zil gyis gnon pa de// g.yu 'brug mkha' la sgra sgrog 'dra// re dogs med pas blo re bde// nged de ltar thal ba'i rang bzhin gyis// mi bde ma mchis bde mor gda'// bde ru re nas bgyis pa lags// bde ru re nas khyed kyang mdzod// nged skyid du re nas bgyis pa lags// skyid skyid 'dra na khyed kyang mdzod// ces gsungs so// yang rje btsun gyis yon bdag pho mo rnams la thams cad mi rtag pas tshe la long med pas 'chi brod kyi chos bya ran gsungs nas mgur gsungs pa/ e ma khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ thar pa'i lam la tshur ltos dang*// 'khor bar brgyud pa'i lam 'phrang ring*// dug lnga dgra yi jag pa mang*// rig pa'i khye'u chung 'khyer las che// ye shes kyi skyel ma btsal re ran// las kyi sgrib pa'i mun pa nag /rnam par rtog pa'i rkun ma mang*// rin chen sems 'di 'chor las che// yengs med mel tshe byed re ran// ma mthong rgya mtsho gting re zab// rig pa'i nya chung rkyal re ran// skyon gyi ri bo zur re mtho// 'khrul rtog rngon pa khyer re bzang*// ting 'dzin gyi ri dwags gsod las che// yang dag gi mtha' la 'bros re ran// ma mthong rgya mtsho gting re zab// rig pa'i nya chung rkyal re ran// 'gro drug gi rba la 'byams klas che// da shes rab kyi gru gzings bca' re ran// skye rga na 'dir nol thang la// khyim thabs dug lnga'i 'dam rdzab tsam// rang sems glang po chud las che// da thar pa'i skam sa bsnyags re ran/

theg dman gyi lta ba g.yang sa che// blo dman gyi byi ba bya byed mang*// rigs drug gi g.yang la 'byams las che// da bde chen gyi thang la 'bros re ran// ran gyi mi tshad 'phyis kyang 'phyis// rje btsun mi la ras pa'i ran bdun ma'o// bla ma mi la ri khrod gcig tu bzhugs pa'i dus su slob ma gcig gis bsnyun 'dri byas pa'i lan btab pa/ bdag nye du dang rgyang thag bsrings te bde// gnyen 'brel gyi kho thag bcad de bde// pha yul chags pa spangs pas bde// bdag 'dzin mngon zhen med pas bde// gnas la ngos bzung med pas bde// sde ris phyogs cha spangs pas bde// sde dgon gnyer pa ma byas bde// dge 'dun rdzas la ma 'bag bde// khang khyim bdag tu ma bzung bde// 'di la 'di dgos med pas bde// 'jig rten nor rdzas med pas bde// 'phags pa'i nor bdun yod pas bde// 'tsho skyong sdug bsngal mi dgos bde// bor stor dogs pa med pas bde// zad pa'i 'jigs pa med pas bde// sems kyi ngal dub spangs pas bde// yon bdag ngo srung med pas bde// skyo ngal sun pa med pas bde// tshul 'chos ma byas spyod pa bde// ci byas chos su song bas bde// 'bros 'ded ngal dub spangs pas bde// gsad khyer 'jigs pa mi 'ong bde// rku 'phrog sbyor ba spangs pas bde// rgyu mthun longs spyod 'byung ba bde// sdig pa'i las rnams ma byas bde// bsod nams las la 'bad de bde// zhe sdang chos su song bas bde// 'bros 'ded phan sems byas pas bde// nga rgyal phrag dog chung bas bde// de yang 'gran sems med pas bde// 'dod yon la zhen pa med pas bde// de yang gdung sems chung bas bde// chos brgyad nyes dmigs bltas pas bde// de yang btang snyoms bzhag pas bde// sems kyis sems la bltas pas bde// de yang re dogs med pas bde// skye med 'od gsal klong na bde// mi rtog ye shes dbyings na bde// shugs 'byung gnyug ma'i ngang du bde/

tshogs drug rang sar bzhag pas bde// sgo lnga'i rnam shes gsal bas bde// yid kyi rtog pas ma gcun bde// bde ba 'di la bde lugs mang*// bdag skyid kyi rting la sdug rgyu chung*// skyid pa rnams la nga mi smon// shi yang bde ste sdig ma byas// gson yang bde ste dge sbyor 'phel// zas gos yon bdag grwa pas sbyor// de rnams bla ma dkon mchog drin// ban sprang bde ba'i tshad la dga'// nyid kyang shin tu bde lags sam// zhes gsungs skad/ rje btsun gyis gdings tshad drug mgur du bzhengs pa/ ngas 'khor ba'i chos la yid dbyung nas// dad pa drag pos mtshams sbyar te// yul gyi zhen pa spangs dka' bas// pha yul spangs pas zhe sdang zhi// gnyen gyi gdungs sems ldog dka' ba// nye du spangs pas gdung sems bral// nor la chog shes ma mchis pas// ras gos gyon pas zhen pa log /'jig rten g.yeng ba spong dka' ba// dman sa bzung bas nga rgyal chags// bdag 'dzin khe grags spong dka' bas// ri dwags bzhin du ri khrod 'grim// khyed dad ldan rnams kyi tshogs kyang bsags// 'di ni snying rus gdings tshad lags// chos sku nam mkha' lta bu de// 'gro drug yongs la khyab lags kyang*// sngar ma rig pa yi 'khor ba 'khyams// tshig tsam shes pas brtan pa dka'// de nyid brtan por ma gyur pas// skabs su dug lnga rang rgyud shor// des don med byis pa'i nang du 'khyams// de nyid brtan por ma gyur pas/ tshogs drug zhen med rgyun du 'char// sku gsum 'bral med rgyun du gnas// de ni rtogs pa'i gdings tshad lags// mnyam bzhag rjes thob rnam gnyis kyang*// las dang po pa la snang ba lags// rtogs pa'i sems la gnyis snang med// yengs ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la/ zhen pa med par grol ba'i klong*// yid 'ong yon tan kun gyi gnas// mkhas pa nam mkha' lta bur sgom// 'di sgom pa'i gdings tshad lags// spyod lam rnam bzhi ma zhan pas// mdzes pa'i gzugs dang chags pa'i nor/

cir snang na bun ltar shes pas// 'gro ba 'don pa'i bsam pa yang*// tha mal lus rnams sgyu ma dang*// chu zla lta bur 'dzin med par// yul gyi 'dzin pas mi gos te// de ni 'dam skyes padma 'dra// 'di ni spyod pa'i gdings tshad lags// sems khyab pa nam mkha' lta bu ste// rkyen snang chos skur gsal ma dag /rnam pa kun mkhyen stong pa nyid// shel gong lag mthil bzhag pa 'dra// dang po gang nas 'ong ba med// bar du gar yang gnas pa med// tha ma gar yang song ba med// dus gsum mnyam pa nyid gnas pas// skyes la skye 'chi'i rgyu ma mchis// gdod nas dag pa'i nam mkha' la// dkar dmar sprin phung rang yal nas// 'byung ba bzhi yi rjes mi chod// sems kyang nam mkha' lta bu la// skye med rgyun dang ma bral bas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rjes mi chod// 'di 'chi bas mi 'jigs gdings tshad lags// de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// nam zhig sgyu lus bor ba'i tshe// yon tan rdzogs kyi bar do des/ gdams ngag zab mo'i ngo sprod pas// sems ma dang bu ru mjal te mchi// gal te de ru ma mjal na// yang dag nyer len sgyu lus de// lhan cig byed pa'i gdams ngag gis// dag pa'i sgyu lus longs skur shar// de me long gzugs brnyan ltar shes pas// lam la nor gyi dogs ma mchis// 'di bar dor mi 'khrul gdings tshad lags// bla ma mi la'i gdings tshad drug lags so// yang gsungs pa/ 'khrul pa rtsad nas bcad lags pas// ma rig 'khrul pa brjed nas thal// snyan brgyud gdams ngag sems sems nas// yig nag zin bris brjed nas thal// sku gsum 'bral med bsgoms bsgoms nas// bsgom blo'i shes pa brjed nas thal// rang sems gtan la 'bebs 'bebs nas// rgyud 'grel tha snyad brjed nas thal// zhen med nyams su blangs blangs nas// log 'tsho long gtam brjed nas thal// sgyu lus dgon pa byas byas nas// bde 'jam dgon pa brjed nas thal// dmigs su med par 'khyams 'khyams nas// thel zug sdod pa brjed nas thal// dman pa'i spyod pa byed byed nas// mi chen re ba brjed nas thal// gcig pur nyams su blangs blangs nas// 'khor mang ngo srung brjed nas thal// 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// mnyam pa nyid du bsgoms bsgoms nas/

'chi ba'i 'jigs pa brjed nas thal// brjed pa rnam bcu bya ba yin// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad ti se la sogs pa'i skor ro/// /rje btsun mi la ras pa de gung thang gi brag dmar spo mthon du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bu slob rnams kyis grub mtha' sna tshogs gleng bas rje btsun gyis mgur bzhengs pa yin skad/ chos kyi dbyings nas dbyangs shig len// brjod du med pa'i tshig gcig brjod// don la bsam brjod ma mchis kyang*// nyon mongs rta rgod thul thabs med// rje gong ma rnams kyi ma bskyon cig /chos snying po don med kyi bshad gzhung dang*// rdo rje 'chang gi rtogs tshad dang*// dngos po gshis kyi 'dug tshul gsum// ma bcos rnal ma'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems khyab brdal du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos phyag rgya chen po'i bshad gzhung dang*/ bram ze chen po'i rtogs tshad dang*// rang bzhin gnyug ma'i 'dug tshul gsum// yid bya byed bral ba'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems lhug par zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos rdzogs pa chen po'i bshad gzhung dang*// kun tu bzang po'i rtogs tshad dang*// rang byung ye shes 'dug tshul gsum// lhun grub phyogs med mkha' la 'dzom// sems rang grol du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa dang*// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos phyag rgya chen po'i bshad gzhung dang*// rdo rje sems dpa'i rtogs tshad dang*// smin grol gnyis kyi 'dug tshul gsum/ thabs shes dbyer med mkha' la 'dzom// sems rang grol du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos pha rol phyin pa'i bshad gzhung dang*/ shākya thub pa'i rtogs tshad dang*// rang bzhin stong pa'i 'dug tshul gsum// rnam dag chen po'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems dmigs med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos dbu ma chen po'i bshad gzhung dang*// 'phags pa klu sgrub rtogs tshad dang*// mtha' bral chen po'i 'dug tshul gsum// khas len med pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems yul med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos sdug bsngal zhi byed bshad gzhung dang*// rje dam pa sangs rgyas rtogs tshad dang*/

rig pa rten med 'dug tshul gsum// lhag mthong rjen pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems rang sor zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos nā ro chos drug gi bshad gzhung dang*// lho brag mar pa'i rtogs tshad dang*// rtsa rlung thig le'i 'dug tshul gsum// rtsal gsum 'dus pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems nyid bde gsal du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos bdud kyi spyod yul bshad gzhung dang*// ma jo mo lab sgron rtogs tshad dang*// lus sems 'bral med 'dug tshul gsum// bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems 'phrig med ngang du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob/ rje bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros dang*// bka' rgyud sde rnams kyi dgongs pa dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi rtogs tshad gsum// chos nyid so ma'i mkha' la 'jom// sems thog babs su zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// lta ba'i zhe 'dod zad pa dang*// sgom pa gzung 'dzin rang grol dang*// spyod pa byar med lhug pa gsum// nyams myong 'gyur med mkha' la 'dzoms/ sems rtsol med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// 'jig rten gyi bya ba btang ba dang*// thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*// 'dod yon la zhen pa log pa gsum// dal 'byor rnyed dka'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems blo bral du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// snang ba 'di dpe char shar ba dang*/ grub mtha' la zhe 'dod med pa dang*// gcig pur nyams su len dang gsum// ri khrod dgon pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems don la ltos dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// go log brda yi mtshon pa dang*// ming med brda yi lta stangs dang*// ming can brda yi tha snyad gsum// skal ldan bdag gi sems la 'dzom// don byar med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun/

da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// sprang po'i ri khrod 'grim pa dang*// skal ldan las 'phro sad pa dang*// sngon sbyangs smon lam btab pa dang*// brag dmar spo mthon mkha' la 'dzom// de dga' bar sems dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// ces 'dzom pa bco lnga'i dbyangs chung 'di/ brag dmar spo mthon gyi mkha' la bzhengs skad/ yang ras chud pa dang khong gi zla bo gcig dang sgro gleng dum pa gcig byas pas/ yang rje btsun gyis/ lab be lob be mang bar gda' yis// nged zha chen po mkhas par gda' yi// su la bsdig pa'i deng zha yin no// gshin rje yi pho nya byung dus dang*// mi med 'chi ba byung dus dang*// rgyus med mun par lhung dus dang*// ngas lus rdo bzhin du skyur dus dang*// nye du'i re thag chad dus dang*// dbang med dus la bab dus su// ngus pas mi phan nor gyis ci// dmag gis mi phan dbang gis ci// gnyen gyis mi phan mnga' thang ci// tha snyad mi phan sgrogs gleng ci// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ 'o na mkhas pas mi phan nam/ zhus pas/ kha mig gsal por yod bzhin du/ g.yang sar mchong ba ches cher blun// rang la bdog pa yod bzhin du// dur mtshor nor len ches cher blun// dam chos nyer len shes bzhin du// nyams su mi len ches cher blun// zhes pa dang*/ rang gi nyams su mi lon pa'i// blo kha rno bas ci la phan// slar la phrag dog skye ba'i rgyu// rang gis spyod par mi nus pa'i// 'byor pa che bas ci la phan// slar la yi dwags skye ba'i rgyu// byang chub sems dang mi ldan pa'i// bsam rgya che bas ci la phan// slar la 'khor ba'i sa bon rgyu// bsod nams tshogs chen mi gsog pa'i// mnga' thang che bas ci la phan// slar la bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu// dge ba tshul bzhin mi sgrub pa'i// shes rgya chen pos ci la phan// slar la shes pas 'phyo ba'i rgyu// dkon mchog tshul bzhin mi mchod pa'i// sde dgon 'bangs kyis ci la phan// slar la ngan song skye ba'i rgyu// chags pa'i zhen pa ma log pa'i// btsun khyad chen pos ci la phan// slar la dad zas ngan song rgyu// rang sems 'gong po mi thul ba'i// pha rol tshig chom ci la phan// slar la ngan song skye ba'i rgyu// rgyu 'bras las la mi rtogs par// gzhal bya btags pas ci la phan// slar la sna tshogs 'tshub pa'i rgyu// zhes gsungs pas/

zla bo ston pa de cung ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mthong nas yang rje btsun chen po kags kyis bzhengs nas/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed legs par nyon dang rab byung rnams// sho med kyang bre mod bgyis pa lags// rtsa ba so thar gyi tshul khrims de// bstan pa khang chen ka ba ste// g.yo med drang por srong cig ang*// lung rigs gnyis kyi nyan bshad de// bstan pa nor bu'i dor lags// ma rig g.ya' dang phrol cig ang*// bslab pa gsum gyi rgyu mtshan de// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bshes gcig lags// bshes gcig dgra ru ma len ang*// lung rigs sgrogs gleng theg chen de// phyir rgol blun po'i klad 'joms lags// mi nag snang ba bsgyur cig ang*// zhes gsungs pas/ ston pa des/ rgya gar nas paṇḍi ta bstan pa'i so mtshams srung mi yin// zhes zhus pas/ spyir rgyal ba mi yi dbang po des/ chos rnams chos brgyad 'joms phyir gsungs// da lta'i mkhas par bslab pa rnams// chos brgyad che ru ma song ngam// rgyal ba'i tshul khrims bsrung ba de// 'jig rten bya bral ched du gsungs// da lta tshul khrims bsrung ba rnams// bya bzhag mkhas su ma song ngam// sngon du drang srong cha lugs de// nye du'i 'brel thag chod pa ste// da lta'i drang srong chas 'dzin rnams// gnyen skyong che ru ma song ngam// zhes gsungs pas ston pa de slar dad nas ras pa bzang po cig byung ngo*// yang gsung pa/ gnam mtsho chen po'i do gling la/ sprang po nged kyang ser ba bsgrubs// dad pa rnams gsum dkyil 'khor du// shes rab rnam gsum gta' gsum bcas// lta sgom zung 'brel thun gyis brab// zhi gnas lhag mthong mtshan ma brtags// mnyam bzhag rjes thob mtshan ma brtsigs// bsam gtan kun gzhi'i phyir/ rdzu 'phrul bstan pas chog gsungs/ rje btsun ti se'i nub phyogs rdzong lung gi padma phug na bzhugs/ bon po de'i bar phyogs na yod pa las/

rje btsun gyi zhabs nub ri nas kho rang gi sgrub khang gi brag gi ngos la brkyang ste zhabs rjes zhag nas/ khyed kyis kyang 'di bzhin gyis shig gsungs nas/ khos kyang nub phyogs la rkang pa brkyangs pas chu kha las ma sleb pa las/ nam mkhar mi ma yin rnams kyi bzhad gad thog pa cig byung bas/ bon po cung zad kha skyengs rung da rung yang rdzu 'phrul 'gran no zer zhing bon po kho chos skor la song*/ rje btsun gyis chos skor kho na la phebs nas/ yang ti se'i lho phyogs su mjal ba'i tshe char zhig bab pa las/ rje btsun gyis char yib byed sa dgos par 'dug pas/ khyod khang 'og 'gram pa rtsig gam/ steng gi thog dbubs gsungs pas khyod rang 'gram rtsigs shig /ngas thog 'bub pa yin zer ba las/ pha bong chen po mi gsum tsam gyen du lang pa zhig la phyag mdzub gtad de/ 'o na pha gi zhog cig gsungs pas byed zer song*/ rje btsun gyis 'gram bslang nas gzigs pas/ khos pha bong de las rngams khye'u lo brgyad tsam lon pa'i gzugs tsam pha bong ra nga ji lta bur gshags tshar 'dug pa/ lta stangs mdzad sdigs mdzub phyar bas/ khos gshags pa'i rdo de sked pa nas chag pa/ da khyer chog gsungs pas/ nga'i de khyod kyis bcag zer bas rdzu 'phrul gyi 'gran na mi chog pa byed pa yin mod/ ngas gshog tu 'jug cing chags pa'i lta stangs mi byed/ shogs la khyer shog gsungs pas/ yang khos sngar gyi de lta bu zhig gshags nas 'degs par brtsams pa las/ yang rje btsun gyis mi theg pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas/ kho na re/ ngas gshags yod khyod kyis khol cig zer bas/ rje btsun gyis 'gram slong bar byas/ khyod kyis thog 'gel bar byas pa yin pas khyod rang gi e thog ltos la shog cig gsungs pas/ khos slar yang 'degs par brtsams pa las ma theg par mig rig rig lus pas rje btsun gyi zhal nas nga mchog thun mong gnyis ka'i dngos grub thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i rtsal dang rdzu 'phrul khyod thun mong gi rdzu 'phrul thob pa tsam gyi mi thub/

ngas lta stangs byas zil gyis mnan na khyod kyis gshog kyang mi thub par 'dug ste/ ngas lta stangs ma byas rung shogs pa yang gang zag gzhan ma la ltos na dga' ba yin/ da byed na 'di ltar byed gsungs phyag ya gcig gis blangs te dkal bas/ rdo la phyag rjes shig byung*/ mtho 'dug gsungs nas brdzis pas zhabs rjes byung*/ dmas 'dug gsungs 'og nas btegs pas yang dbu dang phyag rjes byung ba de la rdzu 'phrul phug tu grags/ de'i tshe yang bon pos rje btsun rgyal bar khas blangs so// gzhan yang rje btsun dang na ro bon chung gnyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rtsal mang du 'gran pa las/ rje btsun gyis mdzad pa rnams ngo mtshar che ba kho na byung ba'i mthar/ na ro bon chung na re/ khyod nga la sgyu ma mkhan zer te/ ngas bltas tshe khyod rang sgyu ma mkhan du 'dug /khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul de rnams nga yid mi ches pas/ da rang re gnyis zla ba 'di'i tshes bco lnga la gangs ti se rtse mor sus sleb par mgyogs pa de ti se dbang bar byed cing mchog gi dngos grub sus thob 'dug blta'o zer bas rje btsun gyis de skad byas pas chog ste/ khyod rang nyams ban bun gyi snang ba la mchog gi dngos grub thob pa la sems kyi rang zhal mthong dgos te/ de mthong ba la nged kyi sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa la zhugs nas bsgom dgos gsungs pas/ kho na re/ khyod kyi sems dang nga'i sems la bzang ngan ci yod/ bon dang chos la khyad ci yod/ sgrub pa byas mnyam du 'dug na'ang*/ mig 'khrul yin nam sngar gyi rdzu 'phrul rnams khyod kyi de kha mtho ba tsam byung*/ da ti se'i rtse mor su mgyogs pa thag chod pa byed do zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis de ltar zhal gyis bzhes te thag bcad do// de'i tshe na ro bon chung ni sngo thul gyon nas gshang 'khrol zhing rnga la zhon te nam mkha' la 'gro ba rje btsun gyi bu slob rnams kyis gzigs te/ rje btsun gzims nas 'dug pa la ras chung pas/

rje btsun lags/ na ro bon chung ni sngon mor rta la zhon nas 'phur te ti se'i rked pa nas yar song*/ rje btsun yang da dung bzhugs nas bon po la gnas skyel ba lags sam zhes zhu ba nan gyis phul ba ltar bu slob kun phul bas/ rje btsun gyi lta stangs shig mdzad nas/ da ltos dang gsungs/ bltas pas kho gyen la 'gro ma nus pas bskor ba la song 'dug /de nas nyi ma 'char du cha ba dang*/ rje btsun chen pos yang se gol gtog pa gcig dang*/ na bza' ras 'ga'i gshog brgyang mdzad nas 'phur byon pas/ skad cig la ti se'i rtser phebs pa dang nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam du byung*/ de'i tshe rje btsun gyis brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa dges pa'i tshul du khra lam mer bzhugs 'dug pa mngon sum du gzigs pas/ ngo bo mnyam pa nyid na'ang rnam pa shin tu dges shing spro bar gyur te/ de tshe na ro bon chung yang ti se'i mgul nas sleb byung ba las/ rje btsun gyi thugs rje'i zil ma bzod nas nam mkha' nas lhung ste 'og gi rnga ti se'i lho phyogs na mar la rbab tu shor bas/ kho'i nga rgyal dang dregs pa nyams te/ dam na sa bzung ba'i ngang nas da khyod rdzu 'phrul dang nus pa che bar song bas/ ti se khyod kyis thob zin/ nga la gnas 'di mthong sa zhig tu sdod sa dgos zer byung bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas khyod la 'jig rten 'di'i lhas rjes su bzung ba'i thun mong gi rdzu 'phrul cung zad 'dug na'ang*/ nga rang byung ye shes mngon du gyur pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob pa'i gang zag rnams dang rdzu 'phrul 'gran rung mi do snga gong nas byas nas/ ti se'i rtse mo'i rdo rje'i ra ba yan ye shes kyi lha dpal 'khor lo sdo pa'i bzhugs gnas yin pas/ khyod kyis bgrod pa'i skabs mi rung*/ da lan ngas kho na chos pa'i che ba bstan phyir rgyal ba gong ma rnams la gnang ba zhus nas skabs phye ba yin/

nam mkha' nas lhung ba dang rnga rbab tu shor ba de khyod la nga rgyal chen po 'dug pa de bcag pa'i phyir ngas byas pa yin/ da gnas 'di'i rtsa bar 'gro ba yang nga'i nus pa la brten nas 'gro dgos/ nga la rtsal 'di yod pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di rnams yod pas nyon cig gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// drin chen mar pa'i zhal la 'dud// sgra sgyur pa yi bka' drin dang*/ rgyal ba gong ma'i thugs rje yis// sngon grong khyer chen po mnyan yod du/ bcom ldan shākya thub pa des// mu stegs ston pa drug po de// 'khor bcas chos kyis pham byas te// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad ltar// 'dzam gling ri rgyal ti se 'dir// bod kyi rnal 'byor ras pas kyang*// bon po chos kyis pham byas te// thub bstan sgrub brgyud nyin mor byas// rdzu 'phrul gyad kyi rtsal las byung*// rnal 'byor mi la ras pa la// rtsal 'di byung ba'i rgyu rkyen mang*// byin rlabs brgyud par ldan pas na// brgyud pa 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// rdo rje 'chang gi rtsal zhig byung*// mkhyen brtse gdams ngag kun ldan pa'i// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i rtsal zhig byung*// mar pa lo tsā'i rtsal zhig byung*// mtha' bral blo las 'das pa yi// lta ba 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// gdod nas dag pa'i rtsal zhig byung*// yengs med dmigs pa bral bas na// sgom pa 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// 'od gsal chen po'i rtsal zhig byung*// gang shar lhug par skyong bas na// spyod pa 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// shugs 'byung lhug pa'i rtsal zhig byung*// chos nyid rang ngo 'phrod pas na// 'bras bu 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// sna tshogs rang grol rtsal zhig byung*// bla ma'i bka' bzhin sgrub pas na/ dam tshig 'di yi rtsal zhig byung*// nyes ltung med pa'i rtsal zhig byung*// rkyen dang bsres nas bsgoms pas na/ nyams len 'di yi rtsal cig byung*// snang ba grogs shar rtsal zhig byung*// dka' thub snying rus mthar bskyal bas/

rnal 'byor rang gi rtsal zhig byung*// mi la ras pa'i rtsal zhig byung*/ rtsal des chos log tshar bcad nas// gangs dkar ti se nga dbang phyir// gnas 'dir dam chos bstan pa dar// de rgyal ba gong ma'i bka' drin yin// gsol lo mchod do ye shes lha// zhes gsungs pas/ kho na re/ khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul dang nus pa la yid ches/ da nga la gnas 'di mthong sa zhig tu bsdad sa yod pa cig khyed shes zer bas/ rje btsun gyis 'o na khyed rang pha gir sdod cig gsungs phyag ya gcig gis gangs chag spar gang shar phyogs kyi ri stag lo'i rtser 'phangs pa ri de'i rtse mor gangs cung zad cig chags so// de nas rje btsun gyi nus pa la brten nas gnyis ka ti se'i mgul du phebs pa'i tshe/ yang kho na re/ nga ti se la skabs su bskor ba byed rgyu yod pa dang*/ de dus sdod sa zhig khyed shes zer bas/ rje btsun gyis 'o na khyod rang bskor ba yang gyis/ de dus 'dir sdod cig gsungs ti se'i mdun gyi ri zhabs shig tu bka' gnang bas/ mchod rten khong seng can du chags nas bon po rnams skor ba byed tshe 'dir sdod sa cig byung*/ rje btsun gyis slob rgyud rnams ni gangs ri mtsho gsum kun la dus rgyun du bsgyur ba yin no// gangs ti se na ro bon chung btul ba'i skor ro/// /de nas yang dpon slob gangs ti se la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ rje btsun mi las ras pas spyang gi srog gi dgon par bu slob rnams la bde ba bcu gnyis mgur du gsungs pa/ mi btson chen dong nas thar ba bzhin// pha yul spangs pa'i rnal 'byor bde// rta bzang po sgrog las grol ba bzhin// gzung 'dzin grol ba'i rnal 'byor bde// ri dwags rmas ma sdod pa bzhin// gcig pur gnas pa'i rnal 'byor bde// bya rgod po'i nam 'phang bskyod pa bzhin// lta ba thag chod kyi rnal 'byor bde// mkha' la rgyu ba'i skyi ser bzhin/

thogs rdug med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// lug g.yang dkar skyong ba'i rdzi bo bzhin// rang nyams skyong ba'i rnal 'byor bde// dbus kyi ri bo lhun po bzhin// 'pho 'gyur med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// chu bo chen po'i gzhung bzhin du// nyams rgyun chad med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// dur khrod nang gi mi ro bzhin// bya ba theng pa'i rnal 'byor bde// rgya mtsho nang du rdo bskyur bzhin// phyir mi ldog pa'i rnal 'byor bde// mkha' la shar ba'i nyi zla bzhin// 'od nang nas shar ba'i rnal 'byor bde// shing ta la'i lo ma bcad pa bzhin// phyis skye ba med pa'i rnal 'byor bde// dbyangs rnal 'byor bde ba bcu gnyis 'di/ khyed slob ma rnams kyi lam 'khyer mdzod// ces gsungs so// yang rje btsun chen po gnas de nyid du bzhugs pa'i dus su dgong mo'i chos thun tshar nas/ yon bdag gcig gis 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs gi chos zhu zhus pa mgur 'di gsungs pa lags skad/ rang sems la skye 'chi ma mchis te// rang sems 'khrul nas 'khor bar 'khyams// las kyi srid par 'khor bar sbyar// dang por skyes pa 'di re ma dga'// da mi lus rin chen thob nas kyang*// tshe phyi ma'i byang chub mi 'tshol bar// bdag 'dzin khe grags rtag tu 'dzin// 'chi khar 'gyod pa 'di re ma dga'// rtag par bzung nas nor rdzas bsags// sbyin par 'phongs nas ser snas bcings/ glo bur na tsha byung tsa na// gtong bar 'dod kyang 'dod mi med// bor nas 'gro ba 'di re ma dga'// gzhon pa'i mdangs dang dar ba'i mdog /rgas shing rgud pas g.yar po bzhag /mi sdug skra dkar gnyer ma spungs/ lang tsho yol ba 'di re ma dga'// rlung mkhris bad kan la sogs pa'i// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams kyang*// rang gi lus la rten bcas nas// rang la gnod pa 'di re ma dga'// 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa'i// chad du byas shing rang rgyud bsreg

/'khor ba 'khyams pa 'di re ma dga'// bu tsha las kyi 'khor ba la// las kyi gdung sems nyon re mongs// sems kyi bag chags thang re chad// bden par bzung ste 'khor bar 'khyams/ sgyu mar shes pa 'di re ma dga'// gces pa'i lus dang 'phangs pa'i srog /gnyen 'dun pha ma la sogs pa'i// bde skyid 'dzom du ma ster ba'i// las kyi 'chi ba brda mi 'phrod/ rang gcig pur 'gro ba 'di re ma dga'// skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo 'di// kun la yod do ngo ma shes// ngo ma shes par bden par snang*// nges par brtags na sdug bsngal yin// de yang khyod kyis ma go'am// don de ltar dgongs la lha chos mdzod// ces re ma dga' brgyad kyi mgur 'di gsungs pas yon bdag de shin tu dad par gyur te/ yang rje btsun dpon slob yon bdag gsar rnying mang du 'tshogs nas khong tsho'i chos kyi lo rgyus thor pa cig lab pas/ rje btsun ma mnyes nas gdan las kag gis bzhengs te ma re mdzod kyi mgur bzhengs pa/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lo tsā chen pos byin gyis rlobs/ las dang rkyen du ma 'dzom pa'i// sdug bsngal gyi byang chub ma re mdzod// rang blo rtse chos la mi gtad pa'i// tshur thugs la 'dogs pa 'di ma re mdzod// rang rgyud slob mar mi gtub pa'i// gzhan gyi slob dpon 'di ma re mdzod// rang blo rang gis mi thub pa'i// gzhan blo gtad sa 'di ma re mdzod// brgyud pa rnal mas ma zin pa'i// grub rtags kyi dngos grub 'di ma re mdzod// sgom sgrub drag pos ma gcun pa'i// yid smon gyi byang chub 'di ma re mdzod// tshogs gnyis kyi rtse sprod ma song ba'i// rtol chos kyi byang chu ba 'di ma re mdzod// ngar 'dzin gyi 'ching ba dang ma bral ba'i// phyogs med kyi thugs rje 'di ma re mdzod// dngos 'dzin gyi 'ching ba ma grol ba'i/ mtha' bral lta ba 'di ma re mdzod// gcer mthong gi ngo sprod mi mnga' ba'i// sems ngo mthong ba 'di ma re mdzod// dri ma sel thabs mi shes pa'i// sgom rgyun chad med pa 'di ma re mdzod// 'khri ba nang nas ma chod pa'i// tshogs drug lhug pa 'di ma re mdzod// ting 'dzin gyi rtsad bdar mi chod pa'i// ye shes chen po 'di ma re mdzod// re dogs phra mo ma chod pa'i// 'bras bu sku gsum 'di ma re mdzod// rgyu 'bras rnal mas ma zin pa'i// gnas skabs bde 'gro 'di ma re mdzod// bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin ma nyan pa'i// mched lcam mnyes pa 'di ma re mdzod// snang ba dbang du ma 'dus pa'i// lha med 'dre med 'di ma re mdzod/

rang sems dbang du ma 'dus pa'i// bag med smyo spyod 'di ma re mdzod// rang rgyud tha mal las ma 'phags pa'i// las dge sdig med pa 'di ma re mdzod// dgon pa 'dzin cing sgrub pa po/ chos brgyad snyan pa 'di ma re mdzod// ri khrod 'dzin pa'i dam chos kun// 'phral dga' skyid chos 'di ma re mdzod// rang sems dkar por mi lta ba'i// mi ngo dkar nag srung ba 'di ma re mdzod// nyams rtogs drod tshad mi ldan pa'i// bar dor grol ba 'di ma re mdzod// gdams ngag dang sbyar bar mi ldan pa'i// skal ldan mgo skor 'di ma re mdzod// bslab sdom tshul bzhin mi bsrung ba'i// gyur shog gi smon lam 'di ma re mdzod// dam tshig gtsang ma mi srung ba'i// mkha' 'gro 'du ba 'di ma re mdzod// lung rigs gdams ngag mi ldan pa'i// tha snyad chu las ma brgal mdzod// mngon shes lnga dang mi ldan pa'i// kha phyir bltas zhal lce ma bcad mdzod// sgom yengs su med par ma rtogs pa'i// rang rgyud yan pa 'di ma re mdzod// ces pa dang*/ yang lan gcig tsa na/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir gson dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag rnams// rang sems rang gi ma dag na/ phyi rol bkrus pas ci la phan// zhen pa rang log ma byung na// sgom nyams bzang bas ci la phan// rang 'dzin ngar 'dzin zhen 'dzin gsum// 'di gsum 'ching ba'i 'ching thag yin// 'ching thag bcad na mi sems sam// rang dang bdag dang sems dang gsum// 'di gsum ri khrod dgon pa lags// dgon pa de bzung na legs par mchi// zhes gsungs so// yang rje btsun mi las rnal 'byor bzhi yi mgur gsungs pa ni/ sems dngos por 'dzin pa 'khor ba'i rgyu// gsal la 'dzin med rang rig de// lhun grub yin par ngo shes nas// rtse gcig mtha' ru phyin pa yin// rim 'jug zer zhing mtshan bcas bsgom// rgyu 'bras zer zhing log 'tsho sgrub// rmongs pa kun 'byung bsgom pa la// rtse gcig gi rnal 'byor khong la med// gsal la 'dzin med rang sems de// ngo bo mkha' ltar gsal tsam na// spros bral mtha' ru phyin pa yin// spros bral zer zhing tha snyad mang*// rmongs pa gnyis 'dzin bsgom pa la// spros bral gyi rnal 'byor khong la med// snang sems gnyis med chos sku la/

'khor 'das ro gcig nyams su myong*// sangs rgyas sems can 'dren pa la// ro gcig mtha' ru phyin pa yin// ro gcig zer zhing du ma smra// cig char zer zhing thun du bcod/ rmongs pas yang rmongs bsgom pa la// ro gcig rnal 'byor khong la med// rnam rtog ye shes snying po can// lhun grub rgyu 'bras gnyis su med// sku gsum rang la tshang tsam na/ bsgoms med mtha' ru phyin pa yin// bsgoms med zer zhing yid la byed// 'od gsal zer zhing gti mug bsgoms// rmongs pas kha lta smra ba la// bsgom med kyi rnal 'byor khong la med// ces gsung so/ rje mi las 'phyo sa drug gi mgur 'di gsungs pa ni/ shar gyi ri bo rtse mtho ba// khu 'phang bab yun ring ring ba// mtho mtho gangs dkar gyi ldongs su gyur// de seng lcam dkar mo'i 'phyo sa mdzod// nub kyi rdza ri smug po la// char zal zim 'bab yun ring ring bas// lung chung gtsang po'i klung du gyur// lto dkar nya mo'i 'phyo sa yin// lho yi ri bo brgyud ring la// shing ljon pa skye yun ring ring bas// mtho mtho de tsan dan sdong du gyur// de rgya stag khra bo'i 'phyo sa mdzod// byang gi bre gu za zo la// gad pa chad yun ring ring bas// mtho mtho de brag dmar ldongs su gyur/ de bya rgyal rgod po'i 'phyo sa mdzod// dbus kyi gong bu bde bde ru/ so nam byed yun ring ring bas// sa grang dro med pa'i ldongs su gyur// de dbu nag mi yi 'phyo sa mdzod// rje sgra bsgyur mar pa'i zhabs drung du// nga mi la sgom yun ring ring bas// rnam rtog chos sku'i ngang du thim// de snod ldan slob ma'i 'phyo sa mdzod// ces gsungs so// yang rje btsun mi la ras pas blo bde bdun gyi mgur gsungs pa ni/ las dang skal par ldan pa yi// grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ dad gus rgyun chad ma mchis pas// steng nas rje yis byin gyis rlobs// grub thob brgyud pa'i bla ma ni// mu tig rtsar la brgyus pa 'dra// mchog thun rtsa ba bla ma yin// pha bla ma'i byin rlabs bag re dro// rgyab brten dkon mchog gsum la byed// dus yeng ba med par skyob pa de// mdzangs mas bu gcig skyong ba 'dra// 'gal 'khrul med pas blo re bde/

g.yas nas dpa' bos byin gyis brlabs// bar chad bdud dpung bzlog pa de// mtshon rnon po klad la bskor ba 'dra// 'gal rkyen med pas blo re bde// g.yon nas dpa' mos byin gyis rlobs// mchog thun mong dngos grub ster ba de// ma sring byas pas bskor ba 'dra// dgos 'dod 'byung bas blo re bde// thabs shes gshog pa nang nas rgyas// chos nyid mkha' la ldigs ba der// rgod pos nam 'phang bskyod pa 'dra// lhung dogs med pas blo re bde// sems la stong nyid rtsal chen rdzogs// gzhan snang zil gyis gnon pa de// seng ge gangs la 'gying ba 'dra// nyam nga med pas blo re bde// khong dgos pa'i las tshogs sgrub pa de// bran khol po las la mngag pa 'dra// da ci bsgo nyan pas blo re bde// nged skabs su nyams smyong glu ru len// blo dman zil gyis gnon pa de// g.yu 'brug mkha' la sgra sgrog 'dra// re dogs med pas blo re bde// nged de ltar thal ba'i rang bzhin gyis// mi bde ma mchis bde mor gda'// bde ru re nas bgyis pa lags// bde ru re nas khyed kyang mdzod// nged skyid du re nas bgyis pa lags// skyid skyid 'dra na khyed kyang mdzod// ces gsungs so// yang rje btsun gyis yon bdag pho mo rnams la thams cad mi rtag pas tshe la long med pas 'chi brod kyi chos bya ran gsungs nas mgur gsungs pa/ e ma khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams/ thar pa'i lam la tshur ltos dang*// 'khor bar brgyud pa'i lam 'phrang ring*// dug lnga dgra yi jag pa mang*// rig pa'i khye'u chung 'khyer las che// ye shes kyi skyel ma btsal re ran// las kyi sgrib pa'i mun pa nag /rnam par rtog pa'i rkun ma mang*// rin chen sems 'di 'chor las che// yengs med mel tshe byed re ran// ma mthong rgya mtsho gting re zab// rig pa'i nya chung rkyal re ran// skyon gyi ri bo zur re mtho// 'khrul rtog rngon pa khyer re bzang*// ting 'dzin gyi ri dwags gsod las che// yang dag gi mtha' la 'bros re ran// ma mthong rgya mtsho gting re zab// rig pa'i nya chung rkyal re ran// 'gro drug gi rba la 'byams klas che// da shes rab kyi gru gzings bca' re ran// skye rga na 'dir nol thang la// khyim thabs dug lnga'i 'dam rdzab tsam// rang sems glang po chud las che// da thar pa'i skam sa bsnyags re ran/

theg dman gyi lta ba g.yang sa che// blo dman gyi byi ba bya byed mang*// rigs drug gi g.yang la 'byams las che// da bde chen gyi thang la 'bros re ran// ran gyi mi tshad 'phyis kyang 'phyis// rje btsun mi la ras pa'i ran bdun ma'o// bla ma mi la ri khrod gcig tu bzhugs pa'i dus su slob ma gcig gis bsnyun 'dri byas pa'i lan btab pa/ bdag nye du dang rgyang thag bsrings te bde// gnyen 'brel gyi kho thag bcad de bde// pha yul chags pa spangs pas bde// bdag 'dzin mngon zhen med pas bde// gnas la ngos bzung med pas bde// sde ris phyogs cha spangs pas bde// sde dgon gnyer pa ma byas bde// dge 'dun rdzas la ma 'bag bde// khang khyim bdag tu ma bzung bde// 'di la 'di dgos med pas bde// 'jig rten nor rdzas med pas bde// 'phags pa'i nor bdun yod pas bde// 'tsho skyong sdug bsngal mi dgos bde// bor stor dogs pa med pas bde// zad pa'i 'jigs pa med pas bde// sems kyi ngal dub spangs pas bde// yon bdag ngo srung med pas bde// skyo ngal sun pa med pas bde// tshul 'chos ma byas spyod pa bde// ci byas chos su song bas bde// 'bros 'ded ngal dub spangs pas bde// gsad khyer 'jigs pa mi 'ong bde// rku 'phrog sbyor ba spangs pas bde// rgyu mthun longs spyod 'byung ba bde// sdig pa'i las rnams ma byas bde// bsod nams las la 'bad de bde// zhe sdang chos su song bas bde// 'bros 'ded phan sems byas pas bde// nga rgyal phrag dog chung bas bde// de yang 'gran sems med pas bde// 'dod yon la zhen pa med pas bde// de yang gdung sems chung bas bde// chos brgyad nyes dmigs bltas pas bde// de yang btang snyoms bzhag pas bde// sems kyis sems la bltas pas bde// de yang re dogs med pas bde// skye med 'od gsal klong na bde// mi rtog ye shes dbyings na bde// shugs 'byung gnyug ma'i ngang du bde/

tshogs drug rang sar bzhag pas bde// sgo lnga'i rnam shes gsal bas bde// yid kyi rtog pas ma gcun bde// bde ba 'di la bde lugs mang*// bdag skyid kyi rting la sdug rgyu chung*// skyid pa rnams la nga mi smon// shi yang bde ste sdig ma byas// gson yang bde ste dge sbyor 'phel// zas gos yon bdag grwa pas sbyor// de rnams bla ma dkon mchog drin// ban sprang bde ba'i tshad la dga'// nyid kyang shin tu bde lags sam// zhes gsungs skad/ rje btsun gyis gdings tshad drug mgur du bzhengs pa/ ngas 'khor ba'i chos la yid dbyung nas// dad pa drag pos mtshams sbyar te// yul gyi zhen pa spangs dka' bas// pha yul spangs pas zhe sdang zhi// gnyen gyi gdungs sems ldog dka' ba// nye du spangs pas gdung sems bral// nor la chog shes ma mchis pas// ras gos gyon pas zhen pa log /'jig rten g.yeng ba spong dka' ba// dman sa bzung bas nga rgyal chags// bdag 'dzin khe grags spong dka' bas// ri dwags bzhin du ri khrod 'grim// khyed dad ldan rnams kyi tshogs kyang bsags// 'di ni snying rus gdings tshad lags// chos sku nam mkha' lta bu de// 'gro drug yongs la khyab lags kyang*// sngar ma rig pa yi 'khor ba 'khyams// tshig tsam shes pas brtan pa dka'// de nyid brtan por ma gyur pas// skabs su dug lnga rang rgyud shor// des don med byis pa'i nang du 'khyams// de nyid brtan por ma gyur pas/ tshogs drug zhen med rgyun du 'char// sku gsum 'bral med rgyun du gnas// de ni rtogs pa'i gdings tshad lags// mnyam bzhag rjes thob rnam gnyis kyang*// las dang po pa la snang ba lags// rtogs pa'i sems la gnyis snang med// yengs ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la/ zhen pa med par grol ba'i klong*// yid 'ong yon tan kun gyi gnas// mkhas pa nam mkha' lta bur sgom// 'di sgom pa'i gdings tshad lags// spyod lam rnam bzhi ma zhan pas// mdzes pa'i gzugs dang chags pa'i nor/

cir snang na bun ltar shes pas// 'gro ba 'don pa'i bsam pa yang*// tha mal lus rnams sgyu ma dang*// chu zla lta bur 'dzin med par// yul gyi 'dzin pas mi gos te// de ni 'dam skyes padma 'dra// 'di ni spyod pa'i gdings tshad lags// sems khyab pa nam mkha' lta bu ste// rkyen snang chos skur gsal ma dag /rnam pa kun mkhyen stong pa nyid// shel gong lag mthil bzhag pa 'dra// dang po gang nas 'ong ba med// bar du gar yang gnas pa med// tha ma gar yang song ba med// dus gsum mnyam pa nyid gnas pas// skyes la skye 'chi'i rgyu ma mchis// gdod nas dag pa'i nam mkha' la// dkar dmar sprin phung rang yal nas// 'byung ba bzhi yi rjes mi chod// sems kyang nam mkha' lta bu la// skye med rgyun dang ma bral bas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rjes mi chod// 'di 'chi bas mi 'jigs gdings tshad lags// de ltar rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// nam zhig sgyu lus bor ba'i tshe// yon tan rdzogs kyi bar do des/ gdams ngag zab mo'i ngo sprod pas// sems ma dang bu ru mjal te mchi// gal te de ru ma mjal na// yang dag nyer len sgyu lus de// lhan cig byed pa'i gdams ngag gis// dag pa'i sgyu lus longs skur shar// de me long gzugs brnyan ltar shes pas// lam la nor gyi dogs ma mchis// 'di bar dor mi 'khrul gdings tshad lags// bla ma mi la'i gdings tshad drug lags so// yang gsungs pa/ 'khrul pa rtsad nas bcad lags pas// ma rig 'khrul pa brjed nas thal// snyan brgyud gdams ngag sems sems nas// yig nag zin bris brjed nas thal// sku gsum 'bral med bsgoms bsgoms nas// bsgom blo'i shes pa brjed nas thal// rang sems gtan la 'bebs 'bebs nas// rgyud 'grel tha snyad brjed nas thal// zhen med nyams su blangs blangs nas// log 'tsho long gtam brjed nas thal// sgyu lus dgon pa byas byas nas// bde 'jam dgon pa brjed nas thal// dmigs su med par 'khyams 'khyams nas// thel zug sdod pa brjed nas thal// dman pa'i spyod pa byed byed nas// mi chen re ba brjed nas thal// gcig pur nyams su blangs blangs nas// 'khor mang ngo srung brjed nas thal// 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// mnyam pa nyid du bsgoms bsgoms nas/

'chi ba'i 'jigs pa brjed nas thal// brjed pa rnam bcu bya ba yin// zhes gsungs so// de thams cad ti se la sogs pa'i skor ro/// /rje btsun mi la ras pa de gung thang gi brag dmar spo mthon du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ bu slob rnams kyis grub mtha' sna tshogs gleng bas rje btsun gyis mgur bzhengs pa yin skad/ chos kyi dbyings nas dbyangs shig len// brjod du med pa'i tshig gcig brjod// don la bsam brjod ma mchis kyang*// nyon mongs rta rgod thul thabs med// rje gong ma rnams kyi ma bskyon cig /chos snying po don med kyi bshad gzhung dang*// rdo rje 'chang gi rtogs tshad dang*// dngos po gshis kyi 'dug tshul gsum// ma bcos rnal ma'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems khyab brdal du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos phyag rgya chen po'i bshad gzhung dang*/ bram ze chen po'i rtogs tshad dang*// rang bzhin gnyug ma'i 'dug tshul gsum// yid bya byed bral ba'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems lhug par zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos rdzogs pa chen po'i bshad gzhung dang*// kun tu bzang po'i rtogs tshad dang*// rang byung ye shes 'dug tshul gsum// lhun grub phyogs med mkha' la 'dzom// sems rang grol du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa dang*// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos phyag rgya chen po'i bshad gzhung dang*// rdo rje sems dpa'i rtogs tshad dang*// smin grol gnyis kyi 'dug tshul gsum/ thabs shes dbyer med mkha' la 'dzom// sems rang grol du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos pha rol phyin pa'i bshad gzhung dang*/ shākya thub pa'i rtogs tshad dang*// rang bzhin stong pa'i 'dug tshul gsum// rnam dag chen po'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems dmigs med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos dbu ma chen po'i bshad gzhung dang*// 'phags pa klu sgrub rtogs tshad dang*// mtha' bral chen po'i 'dug tshul gsum// khas len med pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems yul med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos sdug bsngal zhi byed bshad gzhung dang*// rje dam pa sangs rgyas rtogs tshad dang*/

rig pa rten med 'dug tshul gsum// lhag mthong rjen pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems rang sor zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos nā ro chos drug gi bshad gzhung dang*// lho brag mar pa'i rtogs tshad dang*// rtsa rlung thig le'i 'dug tshul gsum// rtsal gsum 'dus pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems nyid bde gsal du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// chos bdud kyi spyod yul bshad gzhung dang*// ma jo mo lab sgron rtogs tshad dang*// lus sems 'bral med 'dug tshul gsum// bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems 'phrig med ngang du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob/ rje bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros dang*// bka' rgyud sde rnams kyi dgongs pa dang*// rnal 'byor bdag gi rtogs tshad gsum// chos nyid so ma'i mkha' la 'jom// sems thog babs su zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// lta ba'i zhe 'dod zad pa dang*// sgom pa gzung 'dzin rang grol dang*// spyod pa byar med lhug pa gsum// nyams myong 'gyur med mkha' la 'dzoms/ sems rtsol med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// 'jig rten gyi bya ba btang ba dang*// thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod pa dang*// 'dod yon la zhen pa log pa gsum// dal 'byor rnyed dka'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems blo bral du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da rung sems nyid gtan la phob// snang ba 'di dpe char shar ba dang*/ grub mtha' la zhe 'dod med pa dang*// gcig pur nyams su len dang gsum// ri khrod dgon pa'i mkha' la 'dzom// sems don la ltos dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// go log brda yi mtshon pa dang*// ming med brda yi lta stangs dang*// ming can brda yi tha snyad gsum// skal ldan bdag gi sems la 'dzom// don byar med du zhog dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun/

da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// sprang po'i ri khrod 'grim pa dang*// skal ldan las 'phro sad pa dang*// sngon sbyangs smon lam btab pa dang*// brag dmar spo mthon mkha' la 'dzom// de dga' bar sems dang rnal 'byor pa// de sems la 'thad dam skal ldan kun// da dung sems nyid gtan la phob// ces 'dzom pa bco lnga'i dbyangs chung 'di/ brag dmar spo mthon gyi mkha' la bzhengs skad/ yang ras chud pa dang khong gi zla bo gcig dang sgro gleng dum pa gcig byas pas/ yang rje btsun gyis/ lab be lob be mang bar gda' yis// nged zha chen po mkhas par gda' yi// su la bsdig pa'i deng zha yin no// gshin rje yi pho nya byung dus dang*// mi med 'chi ba byung dus dang*// rgyus med mun par lhung dus dang*// ngas lus rdo bzhin du skyur dus dang*// nye du'i re thag chad dus dang*// dbang med dus la bab dus su// ngus pas mi phan nor gyis ci// dmag gis mi phan dbang gis ci// gnyen gyis mi phan mnga' thang ci// tha snyad mi phan sgrogs gleng ci// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ 'o na mkhas pas mi phan nam/ zhus pas/ kha mig gsal por yod bzhin du/ g.yang sar mchong ba ches cher blun// rang la bdog pa yod bzhin du// dur mtshor nor len ches cher blun// dam chos nyer len shes bzhin du// nyams su mi len ches cher blun// zhes pa dang*/ rang gi nyams su mi lon pa'i// blo kha rno bas ci la phan// slar la phrag dog skye ba'i rgyu// rang gis spyod par mi nus pa'i// 'byor pa che bas ci la phan// slar la yi dwags skye ba'i rgyu// byang chub sems dang mi ldan pa'i// bsam rgya che bas ci la phan// slar la 'khor ba'i sa bon rgyu// bsod nams tshogs chen mi gsog pa'i// mnga' thang che bas ci la phan// slar la bsod nams 'dzad pa'i rgyu// dge ba tshul bzhin mi sgrub pa'i// shes rgya chen pos ci la phan// slar la shes pas 'phyo ba'i rgyu// dkon mchog tshul bzhin mi mchod pa'i// sde dgon 'bangs kyis ci la phan// slar la ngan song skye ba'i rgyu// chags pa'i zhen pa ma log pa'i// btsun khyad chen pos ci la phan// slar la dad zas ngan song rgyu// rang sems 'gong po mi thul ba'i// pha rol tshig chom ci la phan// slar la ngan song skye ba'i rgyu// rgyu 'bras las la mi rtogs par// gzhal bya btags pas ci la phan// slar la sna tshogs 'tshub pa'i rgyu// zhes gsungs pas/

zla bo ston pa de cung ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur mthong nas yang rje btsun chen po kags kyis bzhengs nas/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed legs par nyon dang rab byung rnams// sho med kyang bre mod bgyis pa lags// rtsa ba so thar gyi tshul khrims de// bstan pa khang chen ka ba ste// g.yo med drang por srong cig ang*// lung rigs gnyis kyi nyan bshad de// bstan pa nor bu'i dor lags// ma rig g.ya' dang phrol cig ang*// bslab pa gsum gyi rgyu mtshan de// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bshes gcig lags// bshes gcig dgra ru ma len ang*// lung rigs sgrogs gleng theg chen de// phyir rgol blun po'i klad 'joms lags// mi nag snang ba bsgyur cig ang*// zhes gsungs pas/ ston pa des/ rgya gar nas paṇḍi ta bstan pa'i so mtshams srung mi yin// zhes zhus pas/ spyir rgyal ba mi yi dbang po des/ chos rnams chos brgyad 'joms phyir gsungs// da lta'i mkhas par bslab pa rnams// chos brgyad che ru ma song ngam// rgyal ba'i tshul khrims bsrung ba de// 'jig rten bya bral ched du gsungs// da lta tshul khrims bsrung ba rnams// bya bzhag mkhas su ma song ngam// sngon du drang srong cha lugs de// nye du'i 'brel thag chod pa ste// da lta'i drang srong chas 'dzin rnams// gnyen skyong che ru ma song ngam// zhes gsungs pas ston pa de slar dad nas ras pa bzang po cig byung ngo*// yang gsungs pa/ gnam mtsho chen po'i do gling la/ sprang po nged kyang ser ba bsgrubs// dad pa rnams gsum dkyil 'khor du// shes rab rnam gsum gta' gsum bcas// lta sgom zung 'brel thun gyis brab// zhi gnas lhag mthong mtshan ma brtags// mnyam bzhag rjes thob mtshan ma brtsigs// bsam gtan kun gzhi'i g.yang chags pa der ma brin// zong 'dod dgu 'byung ba rin po che'i tshong 'dus// klu yi rgyal po dung sgra gnas pa'i pho brang*// nor longs spyod rang bzhin gyis 'phel ba'i sa gzhi/

brag srin mo seng ge 'gying 'dra'i shar phyogs// jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma'i g.yon zur// gangs lha gnyan sher gyi ra bas bskor ba'i dbus// 'brog rma g.yang 'bab pa'i sman lung*// chu bo lo han yi klung 'gram/ gnas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sman lung chu bar gyi dben gnas na/ rje ras pa chen po chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu bzhugs la/ chu pho 'brug gi lo dbyar zla ra ba'i yar ngo*// dgung tshes brgyad kyi nam gung yol tsam na/ gdon chen bco brgyad kyi gtso byas pa'i snang srid kyi lha ma srin ma 'tshogs pa gcig kyang med de/ gnam 'gyur ba dang*/ sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas dang*/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston du byung*/ de rnams kyi nang nas shin tu 'jigs pa'i mi bsrun pa'i sha za chen lngas/ mi sdug pa'i gzugs sna tshogs ston cing bsam gtan la bog brten byed du byung ba la/ de'i dus su rje btsun gyis lha dang mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs pa'i mgur 'di bzhengs pa yin gsungs so// rje sum ldan gyi bla ma rin po che// mtshan yongs su grags pa'i lho brag pa/ skal ldan gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// pha mi mngon dbyings nas thugs dgongs 'tshal// yang dben pa brin gyi chu bar na// nga bod kyi rnal 'byor ras pa yin// rtse gcig bsam gtan bsgom du 'ongs// khams 'dus pa nyams kyi snang ba la// ngo mtshar ltad mo mtshar dgu mthong*/ spyir snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la// 'dir ma 'tshogs pa ni gcig kyang med// khyad par sprul pa bud med lnga// mi sdug sprul pa'i gzugs 'chang ba// mi bdag la thod 'tshams glag tshol nas// bar chad thog rgyug byed du byung*// keng rus bzhad pa'i bud med gcig /ri rab pang gis 'debs pa mthong*// dmar mo khrag 'dzag ce spyang gdong*// rgya mtsho hub kyis 'debs pa mthong*// rab 'jigs gshin rje'i gzugs can ma/ nyi zla cha lang sdebs pa mthong*// sol ba'i bud med gad rgyang can// gza' skar thang la 'bebs pa mthong*// shin tu sgeg pa lha mo'i gzugs// lta bas mi ngom bud med gcig

/'dzum zhing bslu brid byed pa mthong*/ gzhan yang sprul pa'i gnod sbyin rnams// gzugs med lag pa brkyang ba mthong*// rtse shing nags tshal 'gul ba mthong*// phyogs bzhi 'obs kyis bskor ba mthong*// mtshams bzhi gyad kyis bsrung ba mthong*// nam mkha' me yis 'khrigs pa mthong*// sa gzhi chu yis khengs pa mthong*// bar snang gang ba'i mi ma yin// skad ni mi snyan 'dzer bag can// gdug pa'i nga ro sgrogs pa rnams// khyod 'di ru ma 'dug song cig skad// lus la nad kyi char 'bebs shing*// rig pa rten dang phral lo skad// de 'dra'i bar chad byung ba'i tshe// khyed byin rlabs can gyi bla ma dang*// dngos grub ster ba'i yi dam lha// rang bzhin grub pa'i dpa' bo dang*// dbyings nas bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// bar chad bsrung ba'i chos skyong rnams// mi kho bo'i rgyab brten dmag tu sbran// khyed mthu dang rdzu 'phrul dpung bskyed la// nga rnal 'byor lus ngag byin gyis rlobs// drang srong khros pa'i cha byad can/ mche ba gtsigs shing rngams pa'i zhal// gtum chen mi 'gyur pho mo dag /la la gshin rje'i gzugs can de// shin tu dregs shing 'gying ba'i sku// nam mkha' gang ba'i khro tshogs rnams// zhal nas me lce glog 'gyu zhing*// 'brug sgra sngags kyi nga ro can// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi char 'bebs shing*// bzhad pa'i gad rgyang bcu gnyis kyis// bar chad dgra bgegs g.yul ngo zlog /phyi lus kyi bar chad phyi ru zlog /nang sems kyi bar chad nang du zlog /rkyen ngan byang chub grogs su sgyur// gdon ngan chu bo'i gzhung du skyur// de gsan nam yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// khyed gong ma rnams la zhu ba lags// zhes rje btsun gyis mgur de skad bzhengs nas bla ma dang ṭā ki la gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ yang gdon chen po de rnams kyi bsam pa la/ yang rnal 'byor pa 'di'i bsam pa zer lugs kyi kho yi yid la khu 'phrig gi rtogs pa skyes nas yod par 'dug pas/

nged cag rnams kyis glags rnyed nas 'ong bsam snyam nas cung zad dga' zhing*/ 'on kyang da rung kho la bsgom pa'i nyams sam/ nang gi rtogs pa ci yod mi shes pas 'jigs shing ya nga ba mi snyan pa brjod cing*/ kho yi sems kyi dpa' bkong la mi 'jigs pa lta ba'i gdings ci 'dug lta dgos snyam du bsam nas der 'tshogs pa'i lha 'dre rnams kyis bar chod lung bstan gyi glu 'di rje btsun gyi snyan du btab bo// khyed de nas lhang lhang glu len pa// rig byed glu yi gsal 'debs shing*// lha dang mkha' 'gro'i dmag sbran nas// de spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ri khrod pa// brtul zhugs ras chen ma lags sam// lus bem rig rten dang 'bral ba'i phyir// yid 'jigs shing skrag pa bden yang bden// blo ya nga za bar cha mchis kyang*// snyan legs par gtod la glu 'di nyon// yang gnam lo rgyal por mtshan gsol ba/ g.yu 'brug gser gyi gshog pa can// dgung mkha' la lding ba'i 'og rol na// dogs sa bkra shis nang ma ljongs// lha sman gangs kyi 'dab rol pa// 'brog rma g.yang 'babs pa'i sman lung nas// zla mtshan dbang po yar gyi ngo*// dus khyad par can gyi tshes brgyad la// dgung smag tu 'thib pa'i gong rol na// stong phrag brgyad cu bgegs kyi tshogs// nged snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre la// nam mkha'i lha bran man chad nas// sa 'og lto 'phye yan chod du// mi sdug sprul pa'i gzugs 'chang rnams// rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dir lhags ste// zhe sdang gdug pa'i sems ldan zhing*// sna tshogs g.yo sgyu ngan spyod pa// gtso bo gdon chen bco brgyad yod// byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga yod// khyad par sha za chen mo lngas// mi sha khrag gi dri tshor nas// rkan rdebs bzod pa'i glags med ma// 'jig rten las kyi srin mo yod// nged 'dir 'tshogs lha 'dre bgros bgros nas// rtsis shing rde'u dkar nag spungs// byad khram kha btab pa khyed la bab// mtho rgyan bzhi bting bas khyod la zin// bskor kha dmar thengs pas 'chor mi srid// mi khyod la rang dbang med pa'i phyir// bla dang tshe srog 'phrog tu 'ong*// dbugs rgyu ba phyi nang gcod du 'ong*// yid rnam shes rten dang phral du 'ong*// lus sha khrag gi phung po za ru 'ongs// lar mi khyod kyi tshe dang dbang thang zad/

'chi bdag bdud kyi kha ru tshud// las kyi zhags pa nag pos thebs// do nub nam gyi cha smad la// 'di nas pha rol 'gro dgos pas// khyod sngon chad byas pa'i las rnams la// dus da lta 'gyod pa yod dam med/ khyod gshin rje'i pho nyas bzung ba la// 'chi bros kyi 'gro sa yod dam med// mi 'jigs gdings dang ldan mi ldan// de rnal 'byor khyed la 'dri ba yin// lar da res nged phyir 'brang dgos te// gshin rje'i las mkhan yod pa la/ bar do snang mun 'jigs pa che// ma mthong yul du 'gro dgos pas/ skyabs gnas skyel ma btsal re ran// smon lam gyi rta la zhon re ngan// yid grong khyer gzhan du 'pho re ran// kye hud kyi hud rnal 'byor pa// khyed la gnyen med bshes kyang med// skyes bu ya nga med pa'i sa// dgon pa'i gnas nas bgrod dka' bas// grogs med gcig pur 'gro dgos pas// khyod ma 'dug ma 'dug la mo 'dong*// zhes lha 'dre rnams kyis glu de skad blangs pas/ rje btsun gyis thugs dgongs btang ba la/ 'dre khyed bas snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad kyang rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul gcig ma gtogs pa don log na med par bka' mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas gsungs/ sems kyi ngo bo rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal zhing*/ spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi ngo sprod pa 'di rang yin/ sems kyi rang bzhin skye 'gags med pa 'di la ni gshin rje'i skyes bu bye ba dung phyur gyi dmag gis bskor nas/ mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab kyang bsad cing bcad pa dang ngan par bsgyur du med la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od zer gyi phung po bye ba dung phyur bsdus shing yon tan gyi mthu sdom kyang kha dog dang dngos por grub pa med pas bzang por bcos su med/ des na gshis ma bcos pa 'di rang yin/

da ltar gyi lus gzung 'dzin las dang zhen pa las grub pa/ 'byung ba bzhis bsdus pa/ gdos bcas can gyi phung po 'di/ skyes pa'i tha ma 'chi ba las ma 'das pa'ang khyed cag lha 'dre rnams la dgos na sbyin pas chog lar dngos po thams cad mi rtag cing 'gyur ba'i chos can la/ dus da lta rang dbang yod bzhin du sems kyis btang na don chen po lus kyi sbyin par 'gyur la/ da lta gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rtog pa la/ lha 'dre'i gzugs brnyan du mthong*/ gnod bya gnod byed du mthong ba 'di nas rab rib can gyi mi skra shad 'dzings pa mthong ba ltar/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas rgyu ma rig pa'i dbang gis las ngan pa'i rgyun goms pa las byung ba'i sgrib g.yogs glo bur gyi rnam par rtog pa sprin dang na bun lta bu yin gyi/ de la 'jigs shing skrag pa'am/ ya nga ba'am yod snyam du dgongs te/ gzhi ngo bo gnas lugs kyi ngang gi rgyu la bzhag nas/ mi 'jigs pa khong du chud nas rtogs pa gdings su gyur pa'i mgur 'di bzhengs pa yin no gsungs so// yul la mtshan gsol ding ma brin// khe tshong 'dus pa'i tshong 'dus yin// mi rgya bod gnyis kyi 'du sa yin// gangs mtho la gnyan po tshe ring ma// bkra shis shel gyi zur phud can/ lha sman rgyal mo'i thu ba la// 'brog dbyar sa sman lung mi zer ro// sa khol du bris pa'i chu bar na// khyed stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs// lha gnas gzhan 'phrul man chad nas// sa 'og lto 'phye yan chad la// lkugs pa'i klu dang nam mkha' lding*// dri za srul po mi'am ci// lto 'phye gru bum srin po'i gdon/ ro langs gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs// re re'i ming nas brjod mi lang*// bsam gyis mi khyab mang po 'tshogs par 'dug /khyad par 'jigs pa'i srin mo lnga// mi nga la mi snyan ngag tu brjod// tshe 'di pha rol 'gro dgos zer// nga 'chi ba kho nas 'jigs 'jigs nas// sems 'chi med gnyug ma'i ngang du sbyangs// 'khor ba rang grol gzhi yi gnas/

snying po'i don la ngo sprod gyis// nang rig pa gtan med gcer bu de// 'gyur ba dngas sang lta ba'i gdings// 'od gsal stong par blo thag chod// da skye 'chi gnyis la nyam nga med// nga mi khom brgyad la 'jigs 'jigs nas// mi rtag 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom// skyabs dkon mchog gsum la blo phug gtad// las rgyu 'bras chos la nan tan bskyed// thabs byang chub sems kyi rgyud sbyangs pas// bag chags sgrib pa'i rgyun lam bcad// gang snang cir snang sgyu mar rtogs// da ngan song gsum la nyam nga med// nga glo bur tshe la 'jigs 'jigs nas// lam rtsa dang rlung la rten 'brel bsgrigs// gnad bsre ba gsum la sbyangs pa'i phyir// tshogs drug gi snang ba 'gags pa'i tshe// chos sku ngo sprod kyi gdings yod de// shes rgyud tshangs pa'i lam nas 'don// sems skye med chos kyi dbyings su 'pho/ dus da lta shi yang nyam nga med// khyed cag 'dir 'tshogs lha ma srin// skye 'gro'i tshe srog nyul ba rnams// sgyu ma gzugs kyi phung po 'di// mi rtag 'jig pa'i chos can te// lar ces kyang mi rtag 'gyur ba la// de khyod la dgos na su dgos khyer// spyir 'gro drug yongs kyi glud du gtong*// sgos drin can pha ma'i don du bsngo// lus sha khrag mchod sbyin 'di bsngos pas// khyed dga' mgu yi rang tshim gyur nas// sngon chad 'khor ba thog med kyi// bu lon 'brel thag chod par gyis// lan chags sha 'khon bral bar gyis// sems 'gyu ba dngos med stong pa de// 'dre khyed bas ngas kyang mthong ba med// dmyal khams bco brgyad dgrar langs kyang*// 'jigs so snyam na nga la sdig /nga stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pas// 'khrul pa'i de nyid shes pa'i phyir// 'dre khyed la nyam nga rdul tsam med// lar thams cad sems kyi cho 'phrul te// e ma khams gsum 'khor ba'i chos// med bzhin snang ba ngo mtshar che// zhes rje btsun gyis mi 'jigs pa khong du chud pa'i mgur de skad bzhengs/

gsung ngag bden pa'i tshig gis bgrol ba/ yang 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta yan chod du grangs brjod kyis mi langs shing mi rdzogs pa/ rdul phra rab kyi mtha' las 'das pa'i lus ci tsam pa cig blangs kyang*/ sdug bsngal 'du byed kyi phung po 'ba' zhig bsags shing don med par yal ba dor ba la/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu'i don du gyur pa skad cig tsam yang med do// dus da res lus 'byung bzhi 'dus pa'i zag bcas kyi phung po/ mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa gnyis las grub pa 'di/ khyed 'dir tshogs pa'i lha 'dre rnams la dgos na ci'i phyir mi ster te/ nang 'gro drug bcud kyi sems can la/ mi nga yi pha mar ma gyur pa gcig kyang med pas de rnams la lan chags shing sha 'khon gnyer ba rnams kyi glud du da lta kho bo'i lus 'di gtong ba la/ ya ki spyi bo'i gtsug nas ma ki rkang pa'i mthil yan la lhu bcu gnyis/ mgo dang bcu gsum/ dbang po rnam pa lnga/ don snying rnam pa lnga sha dang rus pa/ rkang dang tshil bu/ klad pa klad rgya/ zhag dang khong khrag /skra dang sen mo/ pags pa dang dri ma/ dbugs dang tshe srog /mdangs dang bkrag la sogs pa rang rang so so yid la gang 'dod pa rnams da lta nyid du khyer la tshim zhing dgyes pa kho nar gyur cig /gzhan yang sha khrag lus kyi mchod sbyin 'di la brten nas/ da phyin chad gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs khyed rnams kyi zhe sdang gdug rtsub kyi bsam ngan thams cad slar zhi nas/ rgyud zag pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'i yongs su gang ba kho nar gyur cig /snying rje chen po des nye bar len pa'i rgyu dang rkyen byas te/ de phyin chad skye 'gro sems can du gyur pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba mi byed de/ gnod cing 'tshe ba las slar log nas shin tu brtse ba'i sems dang ldan te/ byams pa dang dga' ba'i bsam pa du mas phan 'dogs shing thams cad kyang bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'i 'byor pa dang ldan par gyur cig

/ces rje btsun gyis bden pa'i stobs brjod de smon lam de skad btab pa la/ der tshogs pa'i lha 'dre rnams slar mos shing 'dun par gyur te/ ltas dang cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa slar bsdus te zhi ba chen po'i ngang la gnas par gyur te/ de rnams kyi nang nas mi bsrun cing shin tu 'jigs pa'i cha byad ston pa'i sha za ba'i mkha' 'gro ma lnga po de rnams na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyed lus zhen chags dang 'phang sems med par sha khrag mchod sbyin du gtong ba ngo mtshar shin tu che na'ang*/ nged snying thag pa nas khyed la gnod cing 'tshe bar mi byed do// bsgom pa'i nyams sam/ mi 'jigs pa'i gdings ci yod lta ru 'ong ba yin/ spyir yang 'khrul snang gdon gyi bar chad thams cad nang rnam par rtog pa'i nyer len las byung ba yin te/ da ci nged cag 'ong ma thag khyed skyi bun byed cing lha dang mkha' 'gro'i dmag sbran pa de las rjes su dpag nas khyed kyi yid la khu 'phrig gi ya nga ba yod par shes nas/ mi snyan pa sna tshogs ngag tu brjod cing tho mtshams pa yin gyi/ da lta ngag bden pa'i tshig gis bshad pa ltar na kho mo cag 'dir lhag pa rnams kyang shin tu gnong zhing 'gyod par gyur to// da yang rnal 'byor pa khyed yid 'gyu ba phyi nang gi phreng rnams chod la sems nyid ma bcos pa'i ngang la mnyam par zhog dang*/ bar chad de las che ba gzhan tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad g.yo 'gul byung yang khyed dpa' bkong zhing rdzi mi nus so// zhes snying gtam gros su btab pa'i rjes la/ 'jig rten gyi khams na mi bsrun pa'i srin mo lnga po de rnams mgrin gcig tu bsdebs nas rje btsun gyi nyan du glu 'di phul ba yin skad/ kye gson dang las can rnal 'byor pa// khyed bsod nams bsags pa mi yi lus// dal 'byor 'dzom pa'i skal pa can// smon lam mthar phyin chos dang mjal// sbyangs pa'i las 'phro bsam gtan mdzad// de phyir skyes mchog rigs kyi bu// nged skal pa dman pa'i 'jig rten pa// blo gros dman pa'i rab rib can// skye ba dman pa'i bud med lus// tshogs ma bsags pa'i gnod sems can// las ngan bsags pas mkha' la rgyu// de 'dra rmongs pa'i sems can gyis// gzhan rgyud kyi rtogs pa mi shes pas// ngag brjod pa'i tshig gi dpes mtshon nas// don rjes dpag gtan la 'bebs kyang 'tshal// blo ya nga za bar cha mchis kyang*// sku phyag rgya brtan par glu la gson// shar rgya yi ti shi khri sgo nas// rgya mo'i dar 'thag rlabs kyis 'thag

/spun nang len gyi skar mda' ma log na// phyi dus kyi rlung gis mi g.yo yi// yid gzhung par thogs shing 'gu ling dar// byang gyim shang hor gyi rgyal khams na// gyad dam len g.yul du 'jug pa na/ nang srid log ku yis ma btab na// khrom ge sar dmag gis mi 'jigs kyi// srid zhi bar skyongs shig mdzangs kyi 'phrul// nub rta zig rgyal po'i 'phrang sgo na// dpa' stag sha dung gi sgo mo la// nang khro chu'i gzer mgo ma log na// phyi 'khrul 'khor sgyogs kyis mi 'jigs kyi// nang 'phrul 'dzer sdoms shig 'phrul yi sgo// lho bal po rdo 'bigs kyi yul khams na// tsan dan sman gyi sdong po la// shing st+wa yu nang nas ma shor na/ phyi mon pa st+wa thogs mi 'ong gis// shing nang srid sdoms shig nags ma ljongs// dben pa brin gyi chu bar na// khyed mi la ras pa sgom bzang ba// rnam rtog 'dre ru ma lang na// phyi bar chad bgegs kyis mi 'jigs na/ nang sems rgyud sbyongs shig rnal 'byor pa// yid khu 'phrig ma byed brtul zhugs can/ khyed stong nyid rtogs pa'i brag ri la// ting 'dzin mi g.yo'i rdzong bzung nas// thabs byang chub sems kyi go 'byed cing*// shes rab snying rje'i mtshon bdar nas// bdud bzhi'i dmag gis mtha' bskor yang*// gzung 'dzin gyi grong du mi pheb cing*// gshin rje'i 'jig rten dgrar langs kyang*// khyed g.yul ngo mi pham rgyal bar nges// phyi 'dod yon gyi lta ba ltad mo che// nang zhi gnas kyi bsam gtan bying rgod mang*// yul dga' gdung gi zhen pa 'grogs yun ring*// lhag mthong gi ye shes rgyun bya tsam// rnam rtog gi lha 'dre dgra thabs mkhas// re dogs kyi 'phrang la bsgugs bsgugs nas// nga bdag gi zhags pas 'dzin nyen yod// khyed dran dang shes bzhin mer tshe gyis// rdzong legs par zungs shig rnal 'byor pa// glu mtshon pa'i dpe bzhi don dang lnga// tshig snyan dngags mu tig rtswar la brgyus// don gsal byed me long thugs la bkra// tshig phyir ma 'brangs don rjes chod// de mkhyen par gyis shig skal pa can// zhes mtshon pa'i glu dpe don dang bcas pa rnams rje btsun gyi snyan du phul ba la/

yang rje btsun gyis len gsungs pa/ phyi rol bdud rigs kyi lha 'dres bar du gcod pa de thams cad rnam par mi rtog pa'i nyer len las byung bas na khyed cag lha 'dre zer ba ltar bden na'ang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i lugs kyi bar chad ci byung yang skyon du mi lta zhing*/ ltas dang cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa ci byung yang de nyid sku drin can rnams 'dod thog tu khyer te/ ltas ngan g.yangs su 'khyer ba'i gzer gyis/ las dang po pa'i gang zag le lo can rnams brtson 'grus kyi lcags 'debs shing*/ gnyen po glo bur du skye bas rig pa'i ngar 'don/ de nyid kyi lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor la bskul nas bsam gtan myur du skye ba'i rgyu yin la/ lam cung zad goms shing brtan pa thob pa rnams la ni/ dran pa ye shes kyi gsal 'debs par byed pas/ rig pa 'od gsal gyi mdangs 'don cing*/ nang ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong*/ de la brten nas byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing*/ lam gyi bogs gong nas gong du sbyin par byed do// de'i gnas skabs na bdud rigs chos skyong du zhal 'gyur zhing*/ chos skyod sprul skur mthong bas/ rkyen dngos grub tu 'bab/ bar chad lam du slong*/ ltas ngan g.yang du len/ rnam rtog chos skur shar/ gol sa lam du chod/ skyon yon tan du grol te/ thun mong lam gyi mthun rkyen khyed cag gis sgrub par byed do// mthar thug shes bya'i gshis la lha 'dre gnyis ka ma grub ste/ re dogs spang blang gi mtshan ma rang sar grol bas/ 'khrul pa gzhi med du rtogs shing 'khor ba ma hā mu drar shes pa de/ glo bur rnam rtog dbyings su thim pas/ chos sku 'du 'bral med pa zhes ming du btags pa yin gsungs nas tshigs su bcad de mgur du gsungs pa/ rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'dzam gling 'di// sangs rgyas gnyis pa ltar grags shing*/ mi nub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// cod pan gtsug gi nor bu ltar// kun gyis bkur zhing mchod pa'i gnas// snyan pa'i ba dan sgra dbyangs kyis// phyogs bcu kun tu khyab pa de// mnga' bdag mai tri ma lags sam// de nyid zhabs kyi padmo la// gus pas btud cing bcud 'thungs pas// lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che// mtha' bral gnyug ma'i don rtogs shing*// yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs te// skyon rnams kun gyis ma gos pa// bde gshegs sprul pa mi gzugs can// skyes mchog mar pas 'di skad gsungs// phyi snang ba ji ltar snang lags kyang*// ma rtogs dus na 'khrul snang ste// phyi yul gi zhen pas 'ching bar byed// rtogs pa rnams la sgyu mar snang*// yul snang ba sems kyi grogs su shar// mthar thug don la snang ma myong*// skye med chos sku dag go gsungs// nang 'gyu ba yid kyi rnam shes 'di// ma rtogs dus na ma rig pa// las nyon yid kun gyi rtsa ba ste/

rtogs na rang rig ye shes te/ dkar po'i yon tan rdzogs par 'gyur// mthar thug don la ye shes med// chos rnams zad sar skyel lo gsungs// nyer len gzugs kyi phung po 'di// ma rtogs dus na 'byung bzhi'i lus// na tsha sdug bsngal de las byung*// rtogs na lha sku zung 'jug ste// tha mal zhen pa ldog par byed// mthar thug don la lus med de// sprin bral mkha' ltar dag go gsungs// gdon gnod sbyin pho mo'i snang ba 'di// ma rtogs dus na bdud yin te// tho mtshams bar du gcod par byed// rtogs na bgegs rnams chos skyong ste// sna tshogs dngos grub de las 'byung*// mthar thug don la lha 'dre med// rnam rtog zad sar phyin no gsungs// theg pa'i mthar thug gsang sngags kyi// rnal 'byor bla med rgyud las kyang*/ khams 'dus pa yi ge'i rten 'brel gyis// phyi rol 'dre gzugs mthong bar gsungs// de rang snang rdzun du ma shes par// bden na snyam na shin tu rmongs// nga sngon chad rmongs pas mgo bo 'khor// ma rig 'khrul ba'i nang du 'jug /phan gnod lha 'dre bden par bzung*// da grub thob rjes yi bka' drin gyis// 'khor 'das dgag sgrub med par go /cir snang phyag rgya chen por shar// 'khrul pa gzhi med du rtogs pa des// rig pa chu zla rnyog ma dwangs// 'od gsal nyi ma sprin dang bral// ma rig mun pa mtha' nas sangs// rmongs pa'i mgo 'khor yal nas thal// yin lugs nang nas 'char zhing gda'// 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam rtog drin po che// gzhi skye med gsal 'debs ngo mtshar che// zhes bla ma'i gsung la tshad mar 'dzin cing gdams ngag la nges shes skyes pa'i mgur ma de rnams rje btsun gyis bzhengs pa la/ yang gdon chen po bco brgyad kyi gtso byas pa'i der 'tshogs pa'i lha 'dre rnams na re/ khyed brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor par 'dug pas nged kyis de ltar ma shes pas sngon chad tho mtshams shing bar chad byas pa rnams gnong zhing 'gyod pas bzod par bzhes la/

slan chad kyi bka' ci gsungs pa nyan cing 'bangs su mchi bas/ bka' bsgo ba'i las dang bya ba gang yod pa de rnams nged cag lha 'dre rnams kyi bsgrub par bgyi'o// zhes khas blangs nas der 'tshogs pa'i lha 'dre rnams kyis phyag gyang 'gyel ba ltar 'tshal/ so so rang rang gi gnas su gyes nas mi snang bar song skad do// rje rin po che mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i dpal bzhad pa rdo rje/ 'jig rten mig bsgyur gyi mkha' 'gro ma lnga yi zhus len mgur du bzhengs pa rnams ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi ra dzas mi brjed pa'i gzungs su bkod pa'o// rje nor bu rin chen sku drin can// dngos grub brnyes pa'i ras pa dang*// 'jig rten mig bsgyur gdol pa mo// sman sha lags pa'i mkha' 'gro ma// dris pa lan dang bcas pa'i drin// yid 'phrog snyan gyi glu blangs pa// me tog phreng bar brgyus pa'i tshig /thod rgal nyams kyi skyugs pa 'di// yi ger bkod pa mi rig kyang*/ bdag nyid brjed pas 'jigs pa dang*// ma 'ongs gdung brgyud 'dzin pa rnams// mos shing spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir// bla ma'i gsung bzhin yi ger bris// lan gsum bar du zhu phul nas// dgyes bzhin gnang ba ma lags pa// mkha' 'gro'i ko long sdom pa'i phyir/ gzu lum ras chod ngas ma byas// slad nas 'byon pa'i sgom chen la// dmar khrid nyams tshad ma byas par// dpe rgyud yi ge ma bstan gsungs// bla ma rje yi bka' rgyas btab/ gal te bka' las 'das gyur na// mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung ba'i phyir// yi ge mi spel sba bar zhu/ rje spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa mtshan yongs su grags pa mi la zhes bya ba de nyid kyi zhabs kyi padmo'i rdul la reg pa/ ngan rdzong ston pas bla ma rje btsun la lan gsum zhus nas gnang ba yi ger bkod pa dris pa'i lan snyan ngag gi glu mu tig gi phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /bde gshegs sprul sku gtsug gi rgyan// skyes mchog mar pa lo tsā yi// zhal nas bab pa'i bdud rtsi dang*// snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i don// thugs las khrungs pa'i ye shes kyi// byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mtshan ras pa zhes byar grags pa yi// rje mi la zhes byar gus phyag 'tshal// yul ya mtshan che ba bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams// gangs rgyal mo na bun 'thib pa'i g.yas mgul// sprin a wa gser mdog lding ba'i 'og rol// steng mdo shod shel gyi ra bas bskor ba'i dbus// dngos grub kyi chu bo lo hanta'i klung 'gram// gnas
