byin gyis brlabs pa'i sman lung chu bar gyi dben gnas na/

rje ras pa chen po mtshan yongs su grags pa'i mi la rnal 'byor pa zhes bya ba/ bka' gsang ba bla na med pa theg pa mchog gi don la thugs kyi snang ba phyogs med du shar bas/ tshad med pa'i snying rje byang chub kyi sems kyi nang gi rgyud yongs su sbyangs pa'i skyes bu/ mas brtan pa'i dga' bzhi mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor phyin pas rdo rje glu yi mdzod rang byung gis rdol ba/ sgrub brgyud kyi man ngag byin gyis brlabs kyi rgyud ma chad pas/ tha mal gyi snang ba ye shes su bsgyur bar mkhyen la/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bstan pa la ma dad pa'i bdud dang log 'dren tshar gcod par nus pa'i dpa' bo chen po des/ thugs chos nyid gnyug ma'i ngang las ma g.yos shing*/ brtse ba chen po'i gzhan gyi don la gzigs nas/ zad par 'byung ba'i skye mched/ snang zhing mi snang bar zil gyi gnon pa dang*/ bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas/ dkar po'i phyogs la dad pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa 'ga' dang 'ga' yi don mdzad cing bzhugs pa la/ dbyar zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub mo mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa'i bud med bzang mo lnga mdun du byung nas bskor ba mang du byas/ phyag zung du bsdebs pa theb brgyad 'tshal/ ba men gyi zho yin zer ba mu men gyi skyogs gang phyag tu drangs nas g.yon phyogs ngos su gral la 'khod de/ nged cag bud med lnga po 'di rje btsun la sems bskyed zhu ru mchis pas/ thugs la 'dogs 'tshal zer nas zhu ba 'bul du byung ba la/ rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs btang bas/ 'di lta bu'i skyogs rin po che'i snod khyad par can dang*/ bcud ya mtshan can sngar mthong ma myong ba'i kha zas 'di 'dra ba yang mi yi mi rnyed la/ phyag dang bskor ba go zlog byed lugs kyi/ 'di kun lha 'dre yin par 'dug dgongs nas thugs kyis mkhyen yang*/ cung zhig spyod lam gyi rnam 'gyur lta ba dang*/

ngag drang por zlo'i mi zlo brtags pa'i phyir mi mkhyen pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ khyed cag su yin gang nas 'ong zhes snyan ngags mgur du bzhengs nas dris pa/ rje sku bzhi'i ngo bo rdo rje 'chang*// rtsod ldan bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// skal ldan 'ga' yi don gzigs nas// 'dzam gling byang phyogs parta shir// ri bo gangs can rgyud 'di ru// sgra sgyur lo tsā sku 'khrungs pa// mi mchog seng ge'i nga ro can// bla med theg chen sgra sgrogs shing*// sgra de thos pa tsam gyis kyang*// ngan 'gro log par mi ltung skad/ de yi phyir na zhu ba'i don// mi nga la ltos pas 'gro rgyud rnams// byin rlabs dngos grub rje la re// pha khyed kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// rang dbang med par sems g.yo zhing*// rtogs pa'i myu gu bskyed du gsol/ de rjes snyan du gsol ba yang*// dag pa'i nam mkha'i zhing khams na// rgyal ba sras bcas bzhugs pa rnams// nga theg chen lam gyi rnal 'byor pa// gdul bya pad mo'i kha 'byed nas// lha khyed kyi thugs kyi nyi ma 'dis// 'char ka 'od kyi dra ba yis// blo gros padmo 'dab rgyas shing*/ tshad med bzhi ldan ze'u 'bru'i tshogs// de ring nyid du 'khrungs par mdzod// gral g.yon na 'khod pa'i bzhin bzang ma// sring mo khyod la 'dri rgyu yod// dri ba gzhan ni ma lags te/ khyed mi'am lha 'dre ngo ma shes// bud med lus la ya mtshan can// sngar ma mthong ba yi ni btsun lnga// mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa lnga// 'od 'phro lha yi bu mo lnga// khyod dang po rgyang nas mthong tsam na// bud med sder chags 'khor du 'tshogs// smag rum 'thib pa'i na bun bzhin// brtags na mi brtan yal yol byed// 'jo sgeg bzhad 'gros ltad mor che// da lta drung du lhag tsam na// nam tho rangs shar ba'i skar rgyan bzhin// rim gyis je chung je chung thal// du mar 'gyed cing sdod lugs kyi// srid pa'i lha 'dre yin nam snyam// brtags na mi bzod shin tu 'dzum// phan tshun lta zhing mig bsgyur ma// phra men mkha' 'gro yin nam ci// chos skor g.yas nas byed rgyu la// bskor ba go ldog g.yon nas byed/

'dis kyang lha 'dre yin nam snyam// spyan phyag go ldog g.yas nas byas// des kyang ya mtshan lha 'drer shes// dgu phrug phyag cha bsnyun 'dri gsum// nem nem zhom zhom spyan phyag gsum// ne btsun khyed kyi phyag bab yin// 'dra la mi mthun khyed kyi lugs// phyag brgyad bar du bsnyun 'dri gnyis// pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs// phyag bab skyes pa'i lugs su byas// gzhan yang mi mthun lha 'dre'i phyag /mi nga la drangs pa'i phyag rten 'di/ mu men yol go'i zhal skyogs la// rin chen sna tshogs phra bkod la// 'di mi yi mi rnyed lha 'dre'i nor// nga mi rgan lce thag ring ba 'dis// rgyal khams phyogs med bltas bltas nas// ngo mtshar can gyi mthong rgya dang*// thos pa'i gtam rgya bshad mi long*// lce le brgan zas kyi ro myong ba// mi gzhan las mi nyung lhag na yang*// spyan gzigs ba men rgod kyi zho// 'di 'dra sngon chad mthong ma myong*// ya mtshan che ba'i kha zas myong*// 'di mi la ma mchis lha 'dre'i zas// gtam mi la bzlas na ngo mtshar che// khyad par sems bskyed zhu'o skad/ khyod dkar po'i phyogs kyi mi ma yin// bstan la rab dga' mi ma yin// sngon sbyangs bag chags yod par nges// mi nga yang dga' zhing spro ba skyes// khyod da rung nyon dang bzhin legs ma/ mi ngas kyang mi shes 'dri ba mod// gtam rdzun gyi ma lab drang por smros/ khyod da nang 'ong ba gang nas 'ong*// do nub 'gro ba gang du 'gro// pho brang brten sa gang du yod// rigs kyi sde tshan gang du gtogs// dbang bsgyur las ni ci dang ci// dngos grub ji ltar ster bar nus// mi nga dang sngon chad gang du 'phrad// gtam su las thos sam ji ltar shes// bka' mchid ma 'khyogs drang du smros// zhes pa'i mgur bzhengs te 'dri ba mdzad pa la/ ya mtshan rdzu 'phrul can gyi bud med de rnams kyis ched du bskyar zhing slar zhus pa/

rje btsun skyes bu dam pa khyed skye ba snga ma la bsod nams bsags pa'i stobs kyis tshe 'dir grub pa thob/ brgyud pa'i bla ma khyad par can dang mjal/ bdud rtsi gsung gi 'od zer thugs la bab pas/ 'jig rten chos brgyad 'dod pa'i yon tan sgyu ma lta bur gzigs shing brtse ba chen pos gzhan don khong du chud cing*/ srid pa'i chu klung rba rlabs chen po rab tu 'khrugs pa 'di las myur du brgal bar bzhed de/ dka' ba drag po sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sgrub pa la nan tan gtso bor mdzad pa'i phyir/ rang rig pa'i ye shes ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal 'byongs te/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po dang ldan pas/ lkog tu gyur pa gzhan rgyud kyi rtogs pa me long lta bur gzigs te/ nged cag rnams kyi rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang la sogs pa ji lta ba mkhyen na'ang*/ mi mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis 'dri zhing rmed pa mdzad pa la/ kho mo cag gi ci yi phyir mi smra ste tshul ji lta ba bzhin brjod par bya'o// rje btsun chen po snyan cung zad gsan 'tshal// zhes ngag tshig tu bkrol te brda sbyar ba'i rjes la/ rdzu 'phrul can gyi bud med lnga po de rnams mgrin gcig tu bsdebs te snyan ngag glu ru bsgyur te bla mar lan btab pa/ gdong dmar srin po bod kyi yul// kha ba can ljongs paksha'i yul// gnod sbyin gangs kyi ra ba 'dir// lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la// 'khrungs dka' skyes bu byon pa de// mi la rnal 'byor ma lags sam// khyed sngon yang bsod nams bsags pa'i phyir// dus 'dir bla ma dge ba'i bshes// dngos grub brgyud pas yongs su bzung*// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas// khyod kyi rnam shes g.yos gyur te// snang grags sgyu mar thugs la shar// spong dka' 'jig rten blo yis btang*/ dka' spyad snying rus drag po yis// skad cig ma yengs bsgoms pa'i phyir// da lta nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// don dam chos sku'i ngo bor bzhugs// spros bral ngang las ma g.yos par// zad par 'byung ba'i skye mched de// mi snang zil gyis gnon pa dang*/

sprul pa du mar 'gyed la sogs// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul bstan nas kyang*// khyed la dad pa'i skyes bu rnams// rab tu dga' zhing ngo mtshar bas// ba spu bskyod cing mchi ma 'khrugs/ de phyir rje btsun gtsug gi nor// kun gyis bkur zhing mchod par 'os// dpal ldan rje btsun 'gro ba'i mgon// rgyal sras bzhad pa khyed nyid la// zhu ba gzhan don ma mchis te// nged cag bsod nams dman pa'i rigs// mkha' la rgyu ba'i mi ma yin// da lta spyan sngar 'khod pa yi// bud med lnga po 'di rnams la// brtse ba chen po'i khyed nyid kyis// thugs rje bsil ba'i sprin phung las// byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i char babs pas/ gdul bya nyon mongs thal ba'i rgyud// rab tu zhi zhing brlan gyur pas// bla med theg pa mchog gi sems// rin chen myu gu bskyed du gsol// rje brtul zhugs spyod pa'i gzi mdangs can// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed nyid kyis// ting 'dzin rig pa'i rgyud sbyangs pas// gzhan rgyud khams dang dbang po dang*// rigs dang rgyud dang cho 'brang rnams// ma 'dres gsal bar gzigs na yang*// mi mkhyen tshul du 'dri zhing rmed// khyed cag su yin ma shes gsungs// nged cag 'jig rten gnod sbyin mo// rigs ni a dzi dha ri te// dur khrod nyul ba'i sme sha can// 'jig rten mig bsgyur mkha' 'gro yin// dbang bsgyur las ni sna tshogs byed// 'jig rten dngos grub cir yang ster// nged da nang nam mkha'i mthongs nas 'ong*// sprin gyi go bar phyes nas 'ongs// zla zer mdangs ma zhon nas 'ong*// do nub rgya gar yul du 'gro// bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du// tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor du 'gro// nged kyi pho brang brten sa yang*// steng mdo shod 'di yi g.yas logs na// gangs zur gsum gung du rtse mtho ba// cod pan shel gyi zur phud la// 'od gsal nyi zla ta ler 'char// mgul chu bum pa man chad la// sprin dkar lding ba'i go cog mdzes// rked pa man chad rming gzhi la// na bun skyi bun 'thib pa de// gangs mthon mthing rgyal mo zhes su grags// de bud med nged kyi pho brang yin// rje btsun khyed dang mjal ba yang*// na ning dbyar zla ra ba la// tho mtshams bar chad brtsam du 'ong*// nyon mongs khong khro khyed la med// spyir yang dkar po'i chos char phab// kun kyang 'gyod cing bzod gsol phul// de ring drung du lhags pa mang*// mi mchog skyob pa khyod nyid kyis/

zhal nas bab pa'i bdud rtsi'i char// btung ba 'thung zhing skom lags pas// dag pa bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis// btung ba stsol zhig skyes bu mchog /ces pa'i don de rnams snyan ngag glu ru blangs te lan 'debs su byung ba la/ yang rje btsun gyis lan gsungs pa/ bzhin bzang ma rnams khyed sngon chad mi bsrun zhing thod rgal che bas rnal 'byor pa nga la yang mi sdug pa'i gzugs sna chogs kyis gnod cing 'tshe ba dang*/ tho mtshams pa yang dang yang du byas te/ ngas snang ba sems kyi cho 'phrul du ngo shes shing*/ sems nyid 'od gsal stong par thag chod pas/ 'khrul snang gdon gyi bar chad la ya nga ba dang*/ bag tsha ba rdul tsam yang med de/ don 'di las rjes su dpag nas gang zag gzhan sgrub pa lhur len pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig dang 'gro ba gzhan phal pa du ma la gnod cing 'tshe ba byas par shes te/ sngon chad byas pa'i las kyi rnam grangs la/ gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems bskyed de/ mthol zhing bshags par bya ba dang*/ da phyin chad srog gi phyir yang 'tshe ba mi byed par khas len cing dam bca' na/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed sbyin par rung gi de lta ma yin na ni phung sna gyod kyis 'dren/ mdzo dril g.yang la lhung bas// theg pa mchog gi sems bskyed kyi sdom pa sbyin pa dang*// zab mo bshad pa'i snod du mi rung gis/ mi rgan nga yi glu 'di'i don go bar gyis la/ yid ma yengs par rna ba cung zad gtod la nyon cig ces gsungs lhug par bkrol nas/ dris lan glu yi snyan ngag mgur du bzhengs te gdams pa ni/ dpal do nub srod kyi dgong mo la// phyogs shar nas 'od cig mdangs gsal bas// smag khri 'dun mtha' nas sangs pa de// chu shel zla ba ma lags sam// zla zer mdangs kyi rta bzhon nas// lus 'od du 'khyil zhing 'ong ba de// khyod 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma lags sam// chu bo lo hanta'i klung 'gram du// rang byung dben gnas nyams dga' bar// chu bar dpal gyi pho brang du// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i smyon pa cig

/'byung ba'i lus la tsha grang med// ngo tsha ma shes gcer nyal mkhan// yid la mi bsam snying po'i don// skad cig ma yengs bsgom du med// nam mkha'i mtshan nyid lta bu de// mi la sgom chen ma lags sam// nga spyod pa'i rnal 'byor ma lags sam// rdzu 'phrul can gyi bud med lnga// glu phar len tshur len byed pa de// sngon chad smon lam btab par nges// khyed da lta phan chad ngo ma shes// na ning sos kyi dus tsam na// srid pa'i bud med dbang mo che// gtso mo khyod kyis g.yos g.yos nas// 'jig rten srid pa'i lha 'dre tshogs// bdud bzhi'i dmag gi ru dar phyar// 'thab rtsod g.yul ngo bros nas kyang*// gdug rtsub mtshon gyi char 'bebs shing*// mi nga la bar chad ci ma byas// nga snang ba sems su thag chod cing*// sems nyid stong par shes pa'i phyir// 'khrul snang sems kyi cho 'phrul la// ya nga bag tsha byed ma myong*// spyir yang khyed mthong tsam gyis kyang*// kho bo shin tu ma bzod par// rang dbang med pa'i snying rje skyes// dkar po'i chos kyi 'jam char phab// khyed slar yang mos shing dad par gyur// do cig dus kyi da tsam na// mtshar sdug ldan pa'i bud med lnga/ bskor zhing bskor zhing phyag 'tshal nas// ya mtshan che ba'i spyan gzigs drangs// rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal nas// ngag snyan pa'i tshig gis zhu phul ba/ byang chub sems kyi sprin phung las// bdud rtsi'i chos char phob cig skad// khyod de tsam gus pa'i sems yod na// mi nga yi cod pan nor bu la// rtsa gsum padma'i gdan steng du// rje 'gran gyi do med sku drin can// sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsa de// dag pa longs sku'i tshul du bzhugs// khong thugs rje sprin bral zla ba la// dri med dkar po'i 'od 'phros pas// gdul bya'i snying gi ku mu da// mdzes pa'i me tog kha phye nas// rtogs pa'i ze'u 'bru g.yo bar byed// de mthong ngam 'jig med mig bsgyur ma// ma mthong sgrib pa che ba'i phyir// sngon chad 'khor ba thog med kyi// kha na ma tho lci ba rnams// mthol zhing bshags pa ma byas na// zab mo bshad pa'i snod mi rung*/

khyod sngon chad mi srun thod rgal che// ngan spyod g.yo rgyu gom pa'i phyir// phyin chad gcig la bab pa yod// khas blangs dam bca' bden spyod dam// bstan pa gzhan don ma lags pa// dge dang mi dge'i las rnams la/ rgyu 'bras dag par ma bsam na// ngan song sdug bsngal mi bzod pas// phra zhing phra ba'i las rnams la// bag yod dran pas 'dzin yang 'tshal// 'dod yon skyon du ma bltas shing*// zhen pa nang nas ma lo ga na/ 'khor ba'i btson rar mi grol bas// thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i blos// kun gnyen po bsten yang 'tshal// 'gro drug sems can pha ma la// byas pa drin du mi bzo na/ theg pa dman pa gol ba'i skyon/ de phyir brtse ba chen po yis// byang chub sems la bslab kyang 'tshal// legs spyad de tsho nyan bcug na// theg chen lam gyi rnal 'byor pa// 'o skol ming sring lta spyod mthun// gnas skabs bgrod pa lam yang gcig /yon tan 'phrin las mthar phyin nas// dag pa mngon dga'i zhing khams der// lhan cig skye bar gdon mi za// zhes pa'i don de rnams rje btsun gyis mgur du bzhengs te bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma rnams dus snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs pa shin tu rags pa yin pas/ gcig char du yang gnyen po skye ba dka' yi/ rang rang rigs so so'i rtogs pa'i rgyud tshod dang sbyor la ci rigs pa'i dam bca' khas longs shig /ces gsungs pas/ bzhin bzang ma rnams kyis slar gsol pa/ rje btsun lags/ khyed thugs brtse ba chen pos mi bzod pa'i phyir/ las rgyu 'bras kyi chos la ched du bskyar zhing nan tan du gsungs pa ngo mtshar che na'ang*/ nged cag rnams kyi sngon dur khrod chen po he la sidha zhes bya ba der/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dang*/ ta ma la ri khrod ma dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ sngo sangs ma la sogs pa'i zhing skyong gi grub pa mo rnams dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bhi ma badzra la sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i rje btsun ma 'ga' zhig la/

byang chub sems kyi phan yon brjod pa dang las rnam par dkar ba dang*/ rnam par gnag pa'i don bshad pa mang du thos so// de tsam gsung mi 'tshal gyis/ da lta ltas dang cho 'phrul gyi rnam pa mi sdug pa'i tshul ston pa ltar snang na'ang*/ khyed ri khrod 'grim pa'i bsam gtan pa rnams la nyams kyi gdings ci 'dug lta zhing*/ rtogs pa'i bogs dbyung ba'i phyir dang*/ bka' yi bstan pa spyi yi bya ra gtong ba'i slad du bstan pa ma lags pa/ zhe thag pa nas gnod 'gyur gyi las cung zad kyang mi bgyid par 'tshal bas/ ci nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed gnang bar zhu 'tshal// zhes zhu ba 'bul du byung bas/ rje btsun gyis gnang ba mdzad de bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma rnams khyed 'di tsam du bskyar zhing nan tan du zhu ba la/ ci'i phyir mi gnang ste da ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa dang*/ maṇḍal shom la phyag dang bskor ba gyis shig /kho bo la yang sems bskyed pa'i yan du zang zing gi dngos po gzhan mi 'dod pas 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub re re phul la so so rang rang gi ming nas brjod cig /ces gsungs pas/ khong rnams shin tu spro bzhin du bka' bsgo ba ltar bsgrubs te gral du 'khod nas/ rab tu gus pa dang bcas pas thal mo spyi gtsug tu sbyar nas/ mdongs gsol pa/ lnga tshig gi dbus ma gtso mor mnga' gsol ba cig na re/ bdag 'di rnams kyi gtso mo lags te/ bdag gi ming ni bkra shis tshe ring ma zhes bgyi/ srid srung rigs rgyud 'phel ba'i dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ gtso mo'i g.yas ngos kyi bud med gcig na re/ bdag gi ming ni mthing gi zhal bzang ma zhes bgyi/ snang gsal pra yi dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ de'i yang g.yon logs na 'khod pa'i bu med gcig na re/ bdag gi ming ni cod pan mgrin bzang ma zhes bgyi/ bang mdzod 'bru nor gyi dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ gtso mo'i g.yon ngos kyi bud med gcig na re/

bdag gi ming ni mi g.yo blo bzang ma zhes bgyi/ rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ de'i yang g.yon na 'khod pa'i bud med gcig na re/ bdag gi ming ni gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma zhes bgyi/ rkang bzhi dud 'gro 'phel ba'i dngos grub 'bul ba lags so zer skad/ der rje btsun gyis khong cag rnams la go rim bzhin skyabs 'gro sdom pa dang so sor thar pa'i bsnyen gnas/ theg pa chen po'i smon lam/ 'jug gi sems bskyed tshul bzhin du phog nas sdom pa spyi yi cho ga dang*/ bslab bya rnams legs par bshad pas/ 'jig rten mi bsgyur gyi mkha' 'gro ma de rnams rab tu dga' zhing ngo mtshar ba la/ khong cag rnams na re/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas gsungs pa lta rngo ma thogs kyang rjes su mthun par slob cing bka' las mi 'da' bar bgyid pa dang*/ sku drin nam yang mi brjed par 'tshal lo// zhes drin du bzo ba'i tshig gi gtang rag btang nas rje btsun gyi zhabs spyi bor blangs nas phyag dang skor ba lan grangs mang du byas nas cung zhig ma mthong gi bar du rdzu 'phrul gyi nam mkha' la 'phur te de nas rgyang ring du song ba dang*/ 'od du yal nas song skad do// de nas yang zla ba de'i phyi mar song ba'i tshes bcu gcig gi nub mo sngon chad tho mtshams pa la dgongs ba'i lha ma srin sde brgyad dregs pa can gyi sde dpon du gyur pa de rnams so so rang rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i 'khor dang dpung gi tshogs dang bcas pa dang sme sha can 'jig rten mig bsgyur gyi mkha' 'gro ma de rnams sgeg cing mdzes pa dang*/ mi mo gzhon nu'i cha byad du bsgyur nas lhab lhub dar gyi cod pan gos dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang*/ utpa la yi do shal dang*/ 'phreng ba sil sil dang*/ se mo do la sogs pa'i chas kyis rab tu brgyan te/ bran dang g.yog 'khor du ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la lhag nas lha ma srin de rnams kyis rje btsun la me tog sna tshogs kyi char phab/

spos dang rol mo sna tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul bza' ba gya nom pa sna tshogs kyis spyan gzigs drangs nas/ rje btsun khyed rang gi thugs nyams su myong ba'i rtogs tshad dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa mthar thug pa lam gyis skyel sa 'di las med ces pa nges don gyi chos shig nged 'dir tshogs pa'i lha srin rnams la gsung 'tshal zhus pas de'i dus su rje btsun gyis rtogs tshad lta ba'i mgur gnas lugs nges don 'ba' zhig 'di gsungs so// yang bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams na// yul ya mtshan can gyi ding ma brin// zong 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i tshong 'dus na// lha sman btsun mo dpal mgo ma// dpa' brjid gangs kyi rgyal mo la// tshe g.yu drung brtan pa'i zur phud can// de mtshan snyan bkra shis tshe ring ma// ri na bun 'thibs pa'i g.yon zur na// 'brog rma g.yang gangs kyi bskor ba de// sman lung chu bar ma lags sam// gnas de nas tsam cig nyams len pa// nga mi la rna la 'byor ma lags sam// mi la sngon chad tho 'tshams pa/ co 'dri bzhad gad byed pa de// khyed bas 'jig rten lha ma srin// shin tu sgeg cing mi srun pa// rnal 'byor yongs kyi drod nyul ba// de ring 'dir tshogs ma lags sam// de bar dgun zla snga ma la// yid 'phrog bu mo mdzes ma lnga// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de// ci 'dod dngos grub khas blangs nas// mi snang mkha' la 'phur nas thal// de yang ngo mtshar khyed cag lnga// dgung do nub dkar gsal zla dngas la// sprul pa'i bu med bzhin bzang ma// gar bsgyur sgegs pa'i cha byad can// lhab lhub dar gyis nam bza' can// do shal rgyan gyis mdzes pa yi// gtso mo khyod kyis mdangs gsol nas/ sde brgyad dregs pa'i lha ma srin// sde dang dpung dang dmag mi dang*// rigs mthun 'khor pa rnams// nam mkha' khengs pa'i mchod sprin dang*// ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas dang*// sna tshogs rol mo 'phul nas kyang*/

nges don dgongs pa zhu ba de// khyed snang srid lha 'dre ma lags sam/ tshig de skad zlo ba rna ba snyan// ngag bden par bkrol na kun kyang nyan// da ca co ma zer glu 'di nyon// spyir khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// 'dod pa'i byang chub sna tshogs yod// ngar 'dzin lta ba tha dad yod// re dogs spyod pa sna tshogs yod// gzhi bdag tu lta ba shin tu mang*// khyed blo dman rnams kyis bsam ngo dang*// bstun nas sangs rgyas kun mkhyen gyis// thams cad yod par gsungs pa yin// don dam bden pa'i dbang gis ni/ bgegs las sangs rgyas nyid kyang med// sgom pa po med bsgom bya med// bgrod bya sa dang lam rtags med// 'bras bu sku dang ye shes med// de phyir mya ngan 'das pa med// ming dang tshig gi grags pa tsam// khams gsum brtan dang g.yo bar bcas// gdod nas ma grub skye ba med// gzhi med lhan cig skyes pa med// las dang las kyi rnam smin med// de phyir 'khor ba'i ming yang med// mthar thug don la de ltar gda'// e ma sems can med gyur na// dus gsum sangs rgyas ci las 'byung*// rgyu med 'bras bu mi srid pas/ kun rdzob bden pa'i dbang du na// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// thams cad yod ces thub pas gsungs// yod pa dngos por snang ba dang*// med pa stong pa'i chos nyid gnyis// ngo bor dbyer med ro gcig pas// rang rig gzhan rig yod min te// thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin// de ltar rtogs pa'i mkhas pa yis// rnam shes ma mthong ye shes mthong*// sems can ma mthong sangs rgyas mthong*// chos can ma mthong chos nyid mthong*/ de las snying rje shugs 'byung ste// stobs dang mi 'jigs gzungs la sogs// sangs rgyas yon tan gang yin pas// nor bu rin chen tshul du 'byung*// de rnal 'byor nga yi rtogs tshul yin// khyed 'dir 'tshogs lha 'dre'i rna lam du// chos bden pa bas kyang bon sgra nyan// a bi ra yi rgyal khams su// mkhas pa bas kyang smyo ba 'brim// dur khrod nyul ba'i wa spyang rnams// seng ge'i nga ro'i 'jigs shing skrag

/'ga' zhig skal ldan yod srid na// 'di thos pas ni grol 'gyur shog /lar mi nga la dga' ba'i nyams shig shar// bso re dga' re skyid thol le rgyal// zhes pa'i mgur bzhengs te de rnams kyang don bshad pa la/ spyir ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa de rnams thams cad gdul bya gang zag gi bsam ngo dang bstun nas gsungs pa yin/ theg pa sna tshogs su bstan pa yin gyi/ mthar thug gi skyel sa gcig las med/ gcig po de gzhi chos nyid ma bcos pa yin/ de yin lugs shes pa tsam gyis mi grol te/ lam sbyangs pa mngon du gyur dgos la/ de la lam gyi ngo bor stong pa dang nying rje zung 'jug yin/ lam gyi bgrod lugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa ji snyed cig yod kyang mdo hril gyis dril ba la/ thabs shes zung 'jug gam bden gnyis dbyer med du 'khyer 'tshal// zhes gsungs pas/ lha ma srin de rnams kyi nang nas/ sngar sems bskyed byas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma lnga po de rnams stan las langs nas g.yon phyogs su 'khod de/ mgrin gcig bsdebs nas yon tan mthong tshul gyi bstod pa brjod pa// dgung mkha' la 'od gsal shar gyi ngogs// ri byang phyogs sha ba can gyi rgyud// dogs sa rin chen gser gyi gdan// 'brog rma g.yang 'bab pa'i sman lung na// sa byin gyis brlabs pa'i chu bar na// da dus bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// dka' ba spyad pa'i ngo mtshar can// rtog med bdud rtsi'i zas za zhing*// rang byung dri chu skom du 'thung*// rme gtsang ngo tsha med pa cig /smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa byed// mi khyod la nyams tshad byed pa'i phyir// lo gzhi ning dbyar gyi zla ba la// la phyi sna yon chu mdor phyin// khyod seng ldeng tsher ma'i nags 'dab na// bag med gcer bu'i cha byad kyis// rigs ngan bu mo longs spyod cing*// dngul dkar me long lta ba mthong*// bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis// zad par skye mched bstan nas kyang*// lus med nam mkhar thim pa mthong*// de la ngo mtshar log nas phyin// de rjes ston zla 'bring po la// khyod mchong lung brag la bsgom pa'i che// mnyam bzhag bsam gtan nyul du phyin// khyed nyi ma zla ba'i gos gyon cing*// mgo la me tog phreng bas brgyan// lus la thal chen raktas byug

/lag na gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs/ gcan gzan rgyal po zhon nas kyang*// nam mkha'i dbyings su 'gro ba mthong*// de nas mi snang yal ba mthong*// de la bar chad skabs ma rnyed// dus na ning dbyar zla bring po la// khyod rnal 'byor sems kyi dpa' bkong zhing*// ting 'dzin bar chad bya snyam pas// khyod rgya mtsho chen po'i klong dkyil na// me dpung 'bar ba'i gos gyon cing*// mgo la dug sbrul thod du bcings// ral gri'i so la rgyab gtad de// mdung rtse'i kha la skyil krung bcas// yid bzhin nor bu sgang du rtsegs// ri bo gyur mid za ba mthong*// 'di la ya mtshan the tshom skyes/ khyed rig pa sems la dbang bsgyur bas// snang zhing mi snang sprul pa'i gzugs// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul bstan pa'i phyir// brgya byin lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// blo ya nga med cing snyems dang bral// sems nyid re dogs bral ba'i phyir// seng ge lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ mi skrag mi dngangs zhum pa med// bar chad rgol bas mi 'jigs pa// zhal mthong nas dga' zhing ba spu g.yo// bltas shing rig pa tsam gyis kyang*// gzhan don bar chad sel ba'i phyir// yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// rje nam mkha'i mtshon pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ mtshan ma'i g.yeng bas mi bskyod cing*// yi ge med pa'i don rtogs shing*// bar chad bdud kyi skabs ma rnyed// nged sngon chad ma shes tho 'tshams pas// gnod sems bar chod bzlog pa'i phyir// rtags dang cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa// ngo mtshar sna tshogs bstan nas kyang*// gsung ngag bden pa'i chos bshad de// thams cad zhi ba'i lam la bkod// bkra shis dgun zla snga ma la// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu yi gzhi// rin chen myu gu bskyed pa gnang*// ma nor lam ston dge ba'i bshes// 'gro ba'i dpal mgon rje btsun khyed// phyi ma'i dus na shar phyogs kyi// mngon dga' zhes bya'i zhing khams der// pho brang gtso bo mi bskyod pa'i// thugs kyi sras su spyan 'dren tshe// sa bla sa spyod sa 'og gi

/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*// gtsang ma ris kyi lha rnams kyis// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra// mchod sprin mdzes pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// sngun nas bsu zhing shul mtshon te// mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs pa'i tshe// khyed kyi zhal mthong gsung thos pa'i// snang ba mi dang mi ma yin// khyed cag 'khor du gtogs pa rnams// phyi bzhin zhabs 'bring byed par shog /ces khyad par gyi yon tan mthong tshul rnams dang*/ dag pa smon lam gyi mjug sdud pa'i glu de rnams bstsal bas/ rje btsun gyi dgongs pa la/ 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma 'di rnams shin tu mi srun cing gdul dka' bas/ da rung dam la btags shing gtseg la dbab dgos dgongs pas bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma khyed rnams la 'di tsam dad cing gus pa dang*/ dus phyi ma la smon lam 'debs pa tshun chod kyi gdung sems yod pa ngo mtshar che bas/ da ci gong du bstan pa yan chod rig pa mchog tu gyur pa byang chub sems kyi sdom pas thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam bgrod par bstan pa yin la/ da khyad par du lam sla zhing thabs mang dka' ba med par ston pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi dam tshig dang lung sbyin par bya yi/ khyed rang rnams kyi srog gi snying po nga la phul la rnal 'byor pa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma shoms shig gsungs pas/ khong rnams dga' zhing spro bar gyur te mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams/ phyag dang bskor ba lan mang du byas nas rang rang gi srog gi snying po re re mdongs gsol du phul nas/ rje btsun gyi spyan lam du rim par 'khod pa la/ rje btsun gyis khong cag rnams la jo mo sgrol ma'i rig pa gtad pa'i cho ga mdzad/ lha mo ku ru kulle ma yi dam du phog /snying po zla ba'i lung rjes su gnang nas/ yang nan tan du gdams te bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma rnams da phyin chad 'o skol 'dir 'tshogs pa rnams dam tshig gcig gis bsdus pa'i slob 'bangs yin pas/

spyod lam rnam bzhi bya ba ci dang ci byed kyang*/ dus rtag tu bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ legs nyes ci byung yang skyabs dkon mchog gsum ma gtogs pa'i jo bo gzhan nas ma tshol cig /phyi snod rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud sems can yi dam gyi lha yin pas/ 'gro ba gang dang gang mthong yang mos shing 'dun par byed dgos kyi/ gnod cing 'tshe ba dang gshe zhing smad pa skad cig kyang mi rung bas/ dus rnam pa thams cad du lha yi nga rgyal dang ma bral bar gyis shig /gsungs pas mig bsgyur ma rnams kyi slar yang gsol pa/ rje btsun lags/ rig pa 'dzin pa sngags kyi dus myur du lam bgrod par sla zhing*/ thabs mang dka' ba med par 'grub pa dang*/ khyad par gyi dam tshig gnang ba sku drin shin tu che ba lags/ nged cag ma dag pa'i 'gro rgyud 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bag chags goms pa'i rgyun 'thug pa dang*/ khyad par du yang bud med skye ba dman zhing blo gros zhan pas rje btsun gyis gsungs pa'i don de ltar cung zad rgyud la mi skye yang*/ bag chags kyis gzhol zhing bslab par bgyi'o// gzhan 'gro drug sems can du gyur pa la/ yi dam lhar lta ba ma byung yang*/ gnod cing 'tshe ba las zlog pa dang*/ yul nye bar gyur pa rnams la ni/ phan pa dang bde ba'i dngos po ci rigs pa'i sgo nas sdong grogs bgyid cing*/ khyad par du yang rje btsun gyi bka' 'khor rigs rgyud du gtogs pa thams cad la srung zhing bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su sba bar bgyid de/ sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen ci dang ci dgos pa thams cad kho mo cag 'bangs rnams kyis bsgrub par bgyi'o// zhes khas blangs nas zhabs la phyag 'tshal/ bskor ba lan mang du byas nas bar snang du yang 'phur nas song skad do// ras pa chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba dpal bzhad pa rdo rje dang*/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring mas dbu mdzad pa'i 'jig rten mig bsgyur gyi mkha' 'gro ma lnga yis/

theg pa mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i dris lan mgur du bzhengs pa'o// tshong 'dus ding ma brin gyi g.yon zur// bkra shis dpal gyi thang ri rtse na/ skal ldan sbyangs pa can gyi dpal zhi ba 'od kyi sring mo bkra shis tshe ring ma nyid la dngos su nyams bsdur zhing dri rmed yang dang yang du byas pa la/ phyis rje btsun chen po nyid kyi zhal sngar lan gsum btugs nas/ dgyes bzhin du gnang ba la gtogs pa rang 'ga' ma yin pa'i gsung don rnams dben gnas nyams dga' 'om chung dpal gyi nags 'dab tu ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dza dang*/ rnal 'byor pa zhi ba 'od gnyis kyis bka' bgros pa mdzad nas/ gsung sgros la lhag chad dang phri bsnan med par nan tan du byas te/ ngag brjod pa'i tshig gi phreng ba bsdebs legs yi ger bkod pa bdud rtsi 'od kyi phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so// na mo gu ru/ drin chen brgyud pa'i bla dang*// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug lha yi lha// byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtsug gi nor// sgra sgyur lo tsā chen po yis// mdzes pa'i chu skyes ze'u 'bru can// phyag mthil mgo la reg mdzad de/ dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag gis// smin cing grol mdzad skal pa can// sgrub pa mthar phyin ras pa rje// dpal ldan bzhad pa'i zhabs la 'du// de rjes mdzes mas zhus pa'i lan// 'phrang sgrol gnad kyi bar do la/ mi 'gyur gsal byed tshig gis bzung*// blo dman brjed pa gso phyir 'god// rje mi las 'das pa'i grub thob chen po// thog mar dbang bzhi bskur ba'i dus su// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor nang gi lha tshogs dang*// phyi zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma sum cu rtsa gnyis// rig ma bcu drug mchod pa'i lha mo dang bcas pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa skad cig yud tsam du zhal gzigs shing*/ de nyid kyi dus na bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i rjes su gnang ba'i gsang mtshan dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba rje lo tsā ba chen po'i gsung gi sgrub pa la nan gyis bskul ba'i phyir/

lus dka' thub kyi gdung ba sna tshogs dang bcas pas/ gsang sngags bsgrubs pa'i yon tan rten 'brel gyi che ba sna tshogs mthar phyungs te/ zad pa dang zil gnon gyi rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa bstan nas dkar po'i phyogs la dad pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa mang po smin par mdzad nas/ mas brtan pa'i dga' ba bzhi mgrin pa longs spyod kyi gnas su phyin pas/ dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i khams kyi lus 'di nyid la brten nas/ 'ja' tshon lta bu sgyu ma'i sku phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'i rje btsun chen po de yul ya mtshan che ba'i ding ma brin gyi shar phyogs/ kha bkra mon gyi sa mtshams/ sman shod khu shu'i nub phyogs/ sprin sna 'dzing mthing nag 'khrigs pa'i 'og /lha khyab 'jug chen po rgyu ba'i sra sgo/ gangs khyung mgo bkra shis sprin ltar lding ba'i g.yon mgul/ 'brog sman g.yu yi spang po ngos bzang la/ yul sman gyi dong ra pho long ris su btab pa/ bkra shis pa'i chu bo dang*/ bdud rtsi dngos grub kyi chu bo gnyis dal gyi 'bab pa'i klung ngogs/ dpal rang byung gi byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas dpal gyi pho brang na/ chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ 'od gsal 'gro 'ong med pa'i ngang la thugs g.yo ba med par bzhugs pa la/ ston zla ra ba skar ma khrum stod gung la bab pa'i mar ngo ru song tsa na/ tshong 'dus ding ma brin der rims dal chen po babs te/ nad kyi rigs su gyur pa 'brum bu dkar nag dang rgyu rims khrag 'khru dang*/ tsha ba mun 'thib dang*/ arnya pa li dang*/ bhi dhanpa li dang*/ kṣa sardza li dang*/ mun dha dza la la sogs pa'i rims nad sna tshogs pa byung nas mi phyugs mang po gum pa la/ zla ba de'i phyi la ston zla 'bring por song ba'i tshes bcu gcig gi dgong mo nyi ma dmar thag chad tsam na mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa'i bud med cig /dar dkar gyi gos zung la mtshal gyi thig phran me lce ris ha thabs su bris pa/

mu men rin po che sna lnga'i cha ga btags pa/ gong kheb stod la mu tig dhar gyis chun 'phyangs ris su spras pa/ gong skor g.yu yi rdo rje pho long ris su 'phar non du btab pa/ gong mched gser gyi rma bya 'jing bsnol ris su btab pa cig 'ongs nas/ rje btsun gyi zhabs spyi bor blangs/ bskor ba lan bdun byas/ phyag dgu phrugs su 'tshal nas/ rje btsun lags/ kho mo cag gi jo mo shin tu bro 'tshal bar gyur pas gangs ya ki'i mgul du gshegs 'tshal/ zer nas spyan 'dren yong skad/ der rje btsun gyis de ring phyi mor 'dug pas mi phyin/ do nub khyod rang yang 'dir nyol/ sang snga dro rang cag gnyis 'grogs nas 'ong gsungs pas/ yang mo na re/ sa manta rā dza'i rdzu 'phrul 'od kyi lam la gshegs tshegs mi mchi/ de ring cis kyang gshegs 'tshal zer skad/ der rje btsun gyis de 'dra ba'i lam gang na yod pa yin/ nga mi rgan yin pa la sngon chad de 'dra'i lam thos kyang ma myong na/ phyogs gang nas phar 'gro ba yin/ khyed kyis mtshon par gyis shig gsungs pas/ mo yi 'dab nas snam bu dkar po cig bton nas/ bar snang la yar brkyangs te 'di'i kha nas phar gshegs par 'tshal zer skad/ der rje btsun gyi zhabs bzhag pa tsam gyi skad cig yud tsam las ma lon par phyin nas gda' ba la/ gangs mtho lding rgyal mo'i g.yas mgul na/ dar dkar gyi gur la gser gyi yol ba bris pa/ mu men gyi chon thag brgyangs pa/ dung gi tshugs shing btsugs pa/ byi ru'i chon phur btab pa cig gi nang du bud med bzang mo ral pa'i zal bu phyi rting du zag la khad du lus g.yogs pa/ mig rtsa dmar tsig ge ba gcig 'dug pa de'i mgo sngas nas cung zad btegs ste/ rje btsun lags/ kho mo shin tu bro 'tshal bar gyur pa phyag bka' yi gnang 'tshal skad/ der rje btsun gyis mo la/ khyed rkyen ci'i phyir na/ dus nam gyi tshe na ma bde/ da lta na lugs ji ltar na zhes zhib tu dris pas/

mo na re/ kho mo bro 'tshal ba'i rkyen ni/ yul pa 'di'i phyugs rdzis na nyin dbyar kha dmar thabs chen po shor nas/ thabs kyi rlangs pa kho mo la phog pa'i rkyen gyis kho mo bro 'tshal bar gyur to// dus ni khar nyin ston zla ra ba'i mar ngo nas cung zhig ma bde la/ de bar ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bcu gcig la na nas ma bde/ rje btsun chen po'i spyan drangs pa lags/ kho mo'i kha rlangs phog pas yul 'di na yang mi nad sna tshogs byung zhing*/ rims nad sna tshogs rdol zhing 'khrugs pa'ang de ltar lags zer skad/ der rje btsun gyi dgongs pa la/ na ning nas nad bdag ma de 'di yin 'dug pas/ da lta snga gong nas chad mdo byed dgos dgongs nas/ slar mo la gsungs pa/ bzhin bzang ma khyod la ngas sngon chad byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ yi dam gyi bzlas lung phog /las rgyu 'bras kyi chos de tsam zhig bstan pa la/ khyod dam la mi gnas/ chad la mi btsan par ma bde ba bag tsam la bzod pa mi byed par/ ma nyes pa'i 'gro ba mang po la 'di tsam du gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa/ da res kyang yul 'di'i dal yams chen po 'di gcod par khas len na/ ngas cung zad phan nam lta/ khas mi len na da lta nyid du phar ldog la/ dam dred ma khyod la yang dam tshig gi rdeg par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas mo rab tu skrag cing ha las par gyur te/ rje btsun gyi zhabs 'jus te/ sems can ma rig pa'i rang bzhin la 'khrul pa'i bag chags zhad tsam 'byung du re bas de yang mi gsung bar zhu/ spyir yang 'jig rten gtsang ris kyi lha 'dre rigs mtho ba phal cher ni/ phar la gnod pa mi bgyid na tshur la gnod pa mi bgyid cing*/ sgos kyang kho mo'i bsam bzhin du/ rje btsun gyi bkal brnyas pa'am/ ched du dmigs te 'gro ba la gnod par bgyid pa'am/ bgyid du stsal ba ma mchis te/ dper bgyis na/ dbyar zla tha chung la bkod ma'i chu bo g.yos pas/ dogs sa thams cad brlan par 'gyur ba de bzhin du/

kho mo cag gi rigs su sde tshan du gtogs pa'i 'khor dang yang g.yog sha za srin mor gyur pa/ sha la dga' zhing khrag la rol pa brgya phrag mang po yod pas de rnams kyis 'tshe bar byed du bsam gyis/ da yang kho mo bde bar gyur pa na/ rje btsun gyi bka' la nyan pas 'gro ba de rnams kyi bro nad bsal bar bgyi pas/ ci nas kyang da res kho mo la thugs rjes gzigs 'tshal// zhes zhu ba nan tan gyis 'bul du byung bas/ rje btsun gyis de ka'i nub mo nas yi ge brgya pa'i khrus chog nas bton bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba mang du btab/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i tshe bsring ba'i cho ga mdzad pas/ de'i phyi de nang par nas langs shing phyag 'tshal shes pa tsal du gyur to// de nas zhag bdun du rig pa gtad cing byin rlabs byas pas mo shin tu bde nas/ sngar las kyang mdangs gsal zhing bkrag phun sum tshogs par 'gyur to// yang rje btsun gyis bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma khyod bde ba 'dam ka rang yin pas/ nga yul phyogs kyi mi rnams la phan gdags su 'gro bas/ khyed rnams kyi so so'i rdzas gang yin pa dang*/ rim gro byed lugs rnams zhib tu smros shig ces dris pas/ mo na re/ rje btsun lags/ rten 'brel gyi che ba yin pa'i phyir/ kho mo bde ba rang gi mi rnams bde bar 'gyur la/ 'on kyang myur du bde bar bzhed na/ nged cag 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi dam tshig yin pas/ gcig ma bde na kun mi bde zhing 'khrugs par 'gyur la/ de'i steng la srid pa'i lha 'dre thams cad kyang gting nas g.yo zhing rgyab brten byed pa yin pas/ rim gro byed lugs ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i snying po can gyi gzungs mang du 'don pa dang*/ theg pa chen po'i mdo sde zab mo'i gsung bsgrags pa dang*/ bum pa'i chus bkru zhing grong khyer gyi khor yug tu mtshams bcad pa dang dkar phud dang dmar phud kyi tshogs dang*/

gtor ma rgya chen po la kha zas kyi rnam pa ci 'byor pas brgyan zhing bsngo bar mdzod cig dang*/ mi nad de rnams myur du 'chad par 'gyur ro// zhes zer ba dang*/ rje btsun brin gyi brag mkhar du byon nas yul mi rnams la nga yi rmi lam du byung ba la/ khyed rang gis jo mo la thabs rlangs shor nas ma dgyes par yod pa 'dra/ de'i g.yon mgul nas srid pa'i lha 'dre mang po 'khrugs nas yod par 'dug pas/ rim gro'i rigs 'di ltar gyis la nga can du yang phye phud rnam pa sna tshogs pa la mchod pa dang gtor ma rgya chen po bshams te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba btab/ chos skyong rnams la gtor ma phul/ bsngo ba mdzad/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa tsam gyi ring por ma thog par dal yams chen po de chad par gyur to// de nas zla ba de zad pa'i nyi shu dgu ru song ba'i nyin par bkra shis tshe ring ma dpon g.yog lnga la 'khor sman dang yul lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mang po zhig rje btsun gyi drung du lhags te/ bza' ba dang bca' ba gya nom pa ro phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i spyan gzigs mang pos/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i skyogs bkang ba rje btsun la drangs te/ phyag dang bskor ba grangs med byas nas mdun drang por spyan lam na phar 'khod de/ 'jig rte mig bsgyur gyi ḍā ki ma lnga po de rnams na re/ da res kho mo shi ba bslangs/ na ba gsos na chag pa sbyar/ chad pa mthud/ rje btsun khyed las sku drin che ba med do// zhes ngag snyan pa'i gtang rag glu ru blangs te phul ba lags skad/ ya ki nam mkha'i mthong shed na// sprin sna 'dzing mthing nag 'khrigs pa de// rnga sgra klu yi rgyal po yin// skye 'gro bcud kyi g.yo ba'i phyir// bdud rtsi'i sprin char 'bebs pa'i rtags/ char zam zim dal gyi 'bab pa de/ sa gzhi drod gsher snyoms pa'i rtags// 'brug sgra chem chem sgrogs pa de// 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa'i rtags// sprin de yi mtshon pa'i 'og shed na/

gangs zur gsum dgung du rtse mtho ba// mgul chu chu shel cod pan la// gza' skar 'od kyi phra bkod de// nyi zla shar gyi gzi mdangs can// de sman btsun nged kyi pho brang yin// gangs de las 'khres kyi g.yon mgul na// stong mdo shod de yi 'og rol du// 'ja' tshon gur yol bres pa de// 'brog ya mtshan che ba'i sman lung yin// 'bras bu rtsi thog 'khrungs pa'i sa// me tog sna tshogs bkra ba'i gling*// sman gyi dong ra gzigs mo che// yul lha de yi rtsed 'jo dang re spro// khyad par sa gzhi byin chags pa// chu bar sprul sku'i pho brang na// mi ya mtshan can cig bzhugs pa de/ mi la rnal 'byor ma lags sam// khyed sku tshe snga ma tshogs bsags pas/ da lta mi lus rin chen thob/ cung zad le lo ma mdzad de// 'bral med bsam gtan bsgoms pa'i phyir// skye med sems kyi don rtogs shing*// 'khrul 'khor lus la rang dbang thob// bar chad g.yeng bas mi 'jigs pa'i// ri bo lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// rlung gi yon tan mthar phyin pas// gcer bu'i lus la gzi mdangs can// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor can// 'gro don rdzogs mdzad skyes bu de// deng sang dus kyi snyigs ma la// gdong dmar yul du byon pa de// spyir bod khams yongs kyi rgyan du che// sgos bud med bdag gi dpal du shar// dus da res dgung tshes bcu gcig la// mi gtsang thabs kyis nyes langs nas/ 'byung bzhi nad kyis thib non byung*// nyon mongs gdug rtsub khong nas 'khrugs// sdug bsngal tshor ba nyams su myong*// lus 'du ba rten dang des bral byas// de 'dra'i nyam thag gyur pa'i tshe// rje khyed kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyu yis// byin rlabs 'pho ba'i rjes gnang mdzad// dag pa sngags kyi khrus nas bton// skye 'chi med pa'i sems ngo bstan// nges shes rtogs pa 'phral la skyes// nad 'du ba rnam bzhi sprin ltar deng*// lus ni bal ltar yang zhing bde// sems la rtogs pa sna tshogs shar// tshe dus min 'chi ba'i bar chad zlog

/drod mtha' nas yal ba rang sor chud// dbugs phyi nang chad pa slar la mthud// gshin rje'i pho nya skyengs su bcug /rje sku drin chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// 'bangs skye gnas dman pa'i sgrib g.yogs can// snying brjed dran pa ngan na yang*// dus da res tshe srog mthud pa de// tshe 'di la brjed thabs yang ma mchis// sku skyabs drin len bsab pa yin// ci dgyes dngos grub 'bul ba dang*// ci gsung bka' las mi 'da' la// dus 'di nas bzung ste mthar thug gi /bla med byang chub ma thob bar// smon lam dag pa'i chu rgyun gyis/ lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du// skad cig mi 'bral 'grogs 'gyur zhing*// khyed mngon par sangs rgyas gyur pa'i tshe// gzugs sku'i 'dul ba'i zhing khams der// lnga sde bzang po ji bzhin du// 'khor gyi dang por gyur nas kyang*// thog ma'i bdud rtsi 'thung bar shog /de 'thung bdud rtsi'i yon tan gyis// chos kyi rgyal srid thob nas kyang*// mi shes rmongs pa'i 'gro rnams la// bsdu ba rnam bzhi'i sprin tshogs las/ sna tshogs bdud rtsi'i char phab nas// 'gro kun rab tu tshim byed shog /ces sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring mas dbu mdzad mig bsgyur gyi ḍā ki ma lngas/ rje btsun gyi snyan du de skad gsol te/ dag pa'i smon lam btab pas/ yang rje btsun gyi dgongs pa la/ gnod sbyin ma 'di kun gyis res kyi nad sos pa tsam gyis drin du bzo ba byed lugs kyis/ gsang sngags kyi lam bskyed rdzogs kyi lam sna 'ga' tsam bstan na bsgom par nus sam snyam nas/ bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma rnams khyed da res kyi nad gsos pa tsam la yang de skad zer nas gsang sngags mngon sum gyi lam yin pas dus da res la tshang tshing srid pa'i gnas nas thon cig /skye 'chi 'khor ba'i lam 'phrang brgal nas phyin chad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gtan nas mi myong ba'i gdams ngag yod na khyed rnams kyi bsgom par nus sam// zhes brod pa bskyed pa'i mgur 'di skad du bzhengs pa yin no// shar khri gdugs nyi ma'i 'og shed na// sman lha ri bkra shis tshe ring ma// khyung mgo shel gyi zur phud la/

dmar thag gser gyi 'od 'phro zhing*// stod sprin dkar lding ba'i go cog la// smad 'ja' tshon 'od kyi cha ga btab// bar g.ya' spang g.yu yi smin khyug btang*// na bun dang skyi bun 'thib pa de// gangs mtho lding rgyal mo ma lags sam// gangs de la pho brang rten bcas pa// bud med lus la ya mtshan can// ne btsun rgyal mo bzhin bzang ma/ yid 'phrog snyan pa'i glu len cing*/ mtshar sdug 'od du chags pa de// sman bkra shis tshe ring ma lags sam// khyed da res 'jigs shing skrag ma myong*// yos khong nas rdol ba shin tu bden// lus la 'byung ba'i nad kyis gzir// sems la sdug bsngal bzod thabs med// dbugs na bun lta bu yal la khad// srog mi brtan g.yo ba des chad tsam// de sngon chad las ngan bsags pa'i phyir// da ltar rnam smin de ltar myong*// da ngan spyod de las ma log na// na rag dmyal ba de las 'jigs// dus da res ma shi tho le rgyal// khyod dad pa'i sa bon g.yos pa las// mi ngas kyang snying rjes kun bslangs nas// gsang sngags bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'chi bdag bdud kyi mgo bo bskor// las kyi gshin rje'i kha nas 'phrog /ltas ngan 'jigs pa'i g.yangs su bslangs// rkyen ngan bar chad tshe ru bsgyur/ khyod dga' ru tshor ram bzhin bzang ma// las byas pa shes pa dga' na yang*// rje sku drin shin tu che'o zhes// ngag snyan pa'i tshig gi gtang rag gtong*// glu de la nga yang brod pa skyes// da phyin chad ngas zer nyan spyod na// thar med sdug bsngal chen po'i lam// rba rlabs can gyi chu bzhi dang*// bgrod dka' mi khom brgyad kyi gnas// tshang tshing srid pa'i nags tshal dang*// bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa bsgugs pa'i sa// zur med bar do gsum gyi 'phrang*// ya nga med par bsgral nas kyang*// rtag tu bde 'thob yangs pa'i lam// zhi ba rin chen gling de ru// phyin par khas len gdon mi za// mi ngas zer ya mtshan mi che ste// nga yi brgyud pa ngo mtshar che// drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen nas// sgra sgyur lo tsā yan chad du// bde gshegs sprul pa ma lags pa// gdams ngag brgyud pas bar ma chad// de phyir ngas zer gtsigs su che/

dbus rgya gar yul du sgra che ba/ dpal nā ro mai tri skad cing gda'// khong snyan pas phyogs rnams khyab pa'i phyir// mtshan sngon chad khyod kyis thos te mchi// rje grub thob gnyis kyis byin brlabs pa'i// lho brag mar pa lo tsā yin// pha sprul sku de yi zhabs drung du// lo drug zla mthong brgyad du bsdad// lus sku dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs// rjes gsungs pa'i bka' la tshad mar bzung*// thugs gting nas mnyes pa'i gnad ka des// rgyud zab mor grags pa'i dgyes rdor dang*/ byin rlabs can gyi bde mchog dang*// snying po ma hā ma ya'i rgyud// dpal nam mkha' lta bu'i gsang 'dus dang*// bka' srung can gyi gdan bzhi dang*/ sprul pa sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud// don mthar thug ston pa snying po'i skor// bka' rgya mtsho ltar zab rgyud 'grel las// bcud nor bu rin chen gting nas blangs// gnad zab dgu'i don snying phyung ba rnams// gser zhun ma lta bur dril nas kyang*// phri bsnan lhag chad yod re zhes/ mkha' 'gro dpang bzhag dbu bsnyung bzhes// snyan brgyud gdams ngag rdzogs pa gnang*// pha sku drin che bas sems la 'phreng*// drin len du sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul// sgoms yun du bsring ba'i gnad ka des// rlung 'byung ba bzhi la rang dbang thob// ro snyoms kyi spyod pa gdings su gyur// nad 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i 'jigs pa med/ bu khyod kyi bde ba bzhed pa na// ngas zer nyon la nga phyir 'brong*// ngo sprod ltos la rang bzhin bsgoms// dus 'di la lam sna zin par 'tshal// tshe phyi ma phan chad rtag tu bde// da lta lus la nad mang zhing*// sems kyi sdug bsngal myong ba yang*// nyon mongs rgyu yi nyer len dang*// glo bur rkyen gyis mtshams sbyar nas// sngar byas las kyi rnam smin gyis// rang snang sgrib pa de ltar 'byung*// 'di yang rmi lam skad cig tsam// de la 'bum 'gyur bye ba yi// gnyug ring shin tu bzod dka' bas/

na rag dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mang*// don du snang ba yod ma myong*// sdig sems bag chags 'khrul pa las// phyi rol sdug bsngal myong zhes pa// ston pa shākya thub pa la// rdo rje snying pos zhus pa'i lan// nges pa don gyi mdo las gsungs// de phyir kun brtag 'khrul pa'i gzhi// thams cad sems su ma shes na// tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dbang bsgyur yang*// de la bden pa yod ma yin/ mnyam bzhag gzhi yi bsam gtan la// bskal par gnas kyang dman pa'i lam// thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob mi srid// de bas las dang nyon mongs kyis// sgrib g.yog bag chags sbyong ba'i phyir// byang chub sems kyi rgyun bsgom zhing*// don myur du sgrubs shig skal bzang ma// zhes btsun mo sman btsun bzhin bzang ma rnams don zhib tu bsnyad pa'i glu de rnams go bar gyis la khyad par du bstan pa'i don de rnams myur du sgrubs shig /ces gdams pa/ khyed kyi snying lam na 'bras bu sku bzhi bya ba cig /log nas btsal du yod snyam na'ang*/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i tha dad cig log nas gzhan du btsal du med de/ 'o skol skye 'gro sems can du gyur pa la/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ bar do dag pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ skye ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku/ sku gsum rang bzhin tha mi dad pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku de bzhin rang cag rnams la rang chas su yod pa ngo ma shes/ de ngo sprod par byed pa la grub thob brgyud pa'i bar ma chad pa'i gdams ngag zab mo dgos pa yin gsungs pas/ khong cag rnams na re/ rje btsun lags/ kho mo cag gi sngon/ slob dpon padma 'byung gnas bod la byon pa'i dus su kha la rong sgo ru sngun bsus nas tho 'tshams su phyin pa la/ slar phyag rgya chen po'i zil 'og tu mnan nas/ bka' 'bangs bgyid par gtsigs su la dbab rang sngags srog gi snying po mdongs gsol du phul/ de'i dus su mdo sde rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang du thos/

yang rgya gar gyi dur khrod chen po mun pa sgra sgrog zhes bya bar slob dpon phyogs kyi glang po dang*/ brtul zhugs spyod pa nag po zhabs la dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos mang du thos pas de'i phyir bka' gsang bstan pa'i snod kyang rung la/ da res kyi bro nad chen po 'di la kho mo shin tu 'jigs shing skrag pa nyams su myong ba'i phyir na sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal skad cig tsam yang bzod par mi nus pas/ de bas gong du bstan pa'i yang nga ba de rnams las bskyab cing dag pa'i sku/ mngon du ngo sprod byed pa'i gdams ngag 'di nyid thugs la 'dogs 'tshal// zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba lags skad do// dpal nam mkha' 'od kyi zhing khams na// sprin a wa gser mdog lding ba de// klu rgyal rigs gtsug na rin chen gyis// ya mtshan rdzu 'phrul bkod pa yin/ sprin de yi 'og nas 'phyo lding ba// bar snang lha srin mi'am ci// lha srin sde brgyad bu mo rnams// sna tshogs 'dod yon longs spyod cing*// glu gar rtsed 'jo shin tu dga'/ sprin a wa lding gi 'og rol na// sman dong pa bkra shis ding ma shod// phu ni lha brag gangs kyis bskor// mda' ni gtsang chab lu ma gnyan// bar g.yu yi spang po bting ba la// sman g.yul pa'i rtse bro ltad mor che// sman lung shel gyi dogs sa de// 'og klu yi bang mdzod yin pa'i phyir// rtsi bcud longs spyod 'byung ba'i gnas// rkang bzhi dud 'gro 'phel ba'i sa// 'brog de na dben gnas nyams dga' ba// chu bar sprul sku'i pho brang yod// gnas de nas skyes mchog ya mtshan can// mdzes pa'i sku lus rin po che// mthong dang thos pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'gro drug sgrib pa sbyong mdzad cing*// phyag rgya sku yi bkod pa yi// sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul ston mdzad de// kun mkhyen sems nyid don rtogs pa'i// chos nyid mkha' la dbang bsgyur zhing*// rnam dag byams pa'i gsung gis ni// chos nyid stong pa'i sgra sgrogs pas// nged snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre rnams// dad pa'i sa bon gsos btab nas// bka' bzhin nyan cing gus pa bgyid// ci bsam 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor// nor bu rin chen rgyal ba sras// khyed la rtag tu mchis gyur pa'i// 'jig rten mig bsgyur mkha' 'gro ma// bud med gzugs bzang kho mo cag

/sngon chad 'khor ba thog med kyis// ma rig 'khrul pa'i rigs rgyud dang*// las srid pa'i nying mtshams sbyor ba des// dang por mi skye'i thabs ma mchis/ da cung zhig sdod do snyam pa la// 'chi bdag gshin rje skad pa de// 'thib non gyi mun pa gtsug na 'khyil// 'chor med kyi zhong pa lag na thogs// dus nam zhig tshe na rang dbang med/ 'byung bzhi lus kyi mdangs 'phrog cing*/ nang srog gi dbang po 'gag par byed// de nas bar do'i snang ba 'char// snang mun 'od kyi lam srang der// brtse med gshed po phyi bzhin 'brang*// nyam thag dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong*// de rjes ming gzhi 'khyams po de// las ngan rlung dang bag chags kyis// cha med yul du rgyus med 'khrid// rang dbang med par skye gnas 'tshol// 'khor ba zo chu'i 'khyud mo ru// skye rga na 'chi srid pa'i mtsho// g.yo 'khrugs rba rlabs bskyod pa las/ sngon chad bying ba skyabs med na// da res ded dpon khyed kyi mthus// byang chub sems kyi gzengs bcas nas// 'jigs shing lta ba'i rlung log dang*// 'dod yon g.yo ba srin mo'i gling*// las kyi chu srin 'tshe ba che/ mi 'jigs bde bar skyabs nas kyang*// pha mthar son pa nor bu'i gling*// sna tshogs rin chen sa gzhi la// lam ring dub pa'i tshong pa rnams// ngal gsos ngal bar gnyid log cing*// ci bsam dgos 'dod len par zhu// 'khor ba'i ri sul nyam nga bar// 'jigs bcas mi khom brgyad kyi gnas// sgrib g.yog mun pa cher gnas shing*// nyon mongs gcan gzan ma rungs pa// mthong bas 'jigs pa'i mche ba bdar// skyon gyi zug rngu mche ba can// sdug bsngal brgyad kyi nags khrod du// lam stor smag rum 'thom pa rnams// khyod gsung dri ma dang bral ba// cha shas yongs rdzogs ston ka yi// zla ba ltar dkar sprin med cing*// 'od 'phro snang ba 'gyur ba des// ma rig mun pa bsal nas kyang*// rnam dag spangs pa'i lam bstan zhu// lam 'jigs pa can gyi bar do ru// 'phrang 'dzul med gsum la skungs ston cing*// de sngon chad bdud kyi jag pas khyer// las kyi lcags sgrog dam pos bcings/

thar med khri mun dong du bskyur// dus da res skyabs gnas bla ma rje// rgol ba sus kyang mi spobs pa// dpung gnyen khyed kyi mthu stobs kyis// 'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang bsgral ba'i phyir// 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku// chos sku ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag zhu// bar do dag pa'i sgyu lus la// longs sku ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag zhu// skye gnas gar skyes rang dbang yod// sprul sku ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag zhu// 'phrang de gsum sgrol ba'i pha rol na// bar chad bdud las grol ba yi// mi 'jigs snyems dang bral ba'i sa// phyir mi ldog pa gtan gyi yul// dga' bde spangs pa'i zhing khams shig /yod pa skad do kho mos thos/ sngon chad ma phyin mthong ma myong*// 'gro mgon bla ma thugs rje can// skyob pa khyod kyi shul mtshon te// ma mthong yul de bstan par zhu// ya nga'i gnas su nyam thag cing*// mgon med smre sngags 'don pa rnams// dus gzhan ma yin 'di nyid la// 'bras bu sku bzhi mngon gyur zhu// zhes gsol ba btab ste dngul dkar gyi me long la gser gyi padma rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra bkod pa gcig gis brgyan pa'i maṇḍal phul nas/ yang rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ bzhin bzang ma khyod nga la de tsam du mos shing 'dun pas chos nan tan du zhu ba la nga rang gi lugs kyi byin rlabs byed dgos pas tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor du bsham dgos gsungs pas/ kho bo cag rnams kyi de'i nub mo rang la zas sna drug cu tsam tshogs pa'i kha zas bshams te/ me tog gi tshom bu'i maṇḍal bkod pa la brten nas/ rje btsun chen pos kho mo cag lnga la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i snyan brgyud lhan cig skyes ma'i lugs su dbang bskur ba'i byin rlabs mdzad/ de'i dus su bar do'i 'phrang sgrol ba'i lugs su ngo sprod kyi gdams ngag dag pa bde chen gyi zhing khams lugs 'di rnams mgur du bzhengs pa/

'dzam gling rgyal po rgya gar yul// gtsug lag khang chen bhi ka ma// rig pa'i 'byung gnas de nyid kyis// byang sgo srung ba'i paṇḍi ta// mi yi seng ge 'gran zla med// rgol ba ngan pa'i klad 'gems phyir// gyad stobs po che yi dpe dang mtshungs// bka' rgyud sde bzhi la ma rmongs pa// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes pa de// rje nā ro paṇa chen ma lags sam// de nyid sras kyi mchog gyur pa// dka' ba spyad pa'i thugs rus can// lho brag mar pa lo tsā zhes// mtshan yongs su grags so 'brug sgra ltar// rje sku drin can gyi spyan snga nas// shāka thub bstan pa'i snyigs ma la// mi rnams tshe thung longs spyod dbul// bdud rigs bar chad mang ba'i phyir// dus yun ring sdod pa'i long med kyis// shes bya'i mtha' la chod dus med// rgyud sde'i mkhyen rgya mi 'tshal bar/ bu sgrub pa snying por longs shig gsungs// mi ngas kyang le lo ma bgyis te// rjes gsungs pa'i bka' bzhin rjes su nyan// ri khrod bas mtha' bsnyags nas kyang*// lus dka' thub spyad de bsgoms pa las// nyams cung zad rgyud la skyes pa yod// sems lhan ne gtod cig skal bzang ma// spyir 'o skol 'gro drug sems can la// gzhi bar do'i chos drug shes kyang 'tshal// lam srid pa gsum gyi 'byung 'jug gis// gnas khams gsum 'khor ba yang ldog /'phrang 'dzugs med gsum gyi so mtshams su// shul ring mgron gyi mi rnams la// mdza' bshes gnyen gyi bya ra bas// dga' brod gdang nas bsu ba yod// sun ma de dang ma mjal na/ dgra snang gshed ma'i chas brnyes pas// bya lta shul du 'ong ste mchi// dpung ded dpon gsum dang ma 'grogs na// dga' brod rgyus med 'jigs bcas tshogs pa rnams// ma mthong 'jigs pa'i skungs sa nas// lung ston bdud kyi pho nya gsum// thar med jag pas 'dam na bsgrugs// 'dra min sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis// bslu ba'i tshig gis yid bsgyur te// lam gol log par khrid nas su// bdun phrag bdun pa yan chod du// snang mun srid pa'i bar do ru// tsha grang sdug bsngal nyams su myong*// de nas las kyi rjes 'brang ste// slar yang 'khor ba'i btson rar 'dzud// btson ra de las thar 'dod na// da res 'khor 'das bar do ru/

gnas lugs ngo sprod phyag rgya che// gzhi lta ba gtan la dbab kyang 'tshal// snang ba skye shi'i bar do ru// rig pa sems kyi rtsal sbyangs pa/ lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la 'bad kyang 'tshal// rang bzhin lam gyi bar do ru// gnyug ma'i ye shes ngos bzung phyir// snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag bsgom yang 'tshal// rmi lam gnyid kyi bar ro ru// bag chags lam du bslang ba'i phyir// 'od gsal sgyu lus sbyang yang 'tshal// tha mal srid pa'i bar do ru// sku gsum mngon du 'gyur ba'i phyir// zhing khams gsum du bgrod kyang 'tshal// gal te mngon du ma gyur na// skye gnas brgyud pa'i bar do ru// smon lam dag pa'i mtshams sbyar nas// rgyu 'bras mi bslu'i rten 'brel gyis// dal 'byor 'dzom pa'i lus thob cing*// snga ma'i las 'phro sad nas kyang*// lam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin te// ring por mi thog de nyid dang*// grol bar 'gyur bar the tshom med// khyad par ya mtshan che ba'i bud med lnga// rtse gcig gus pas bka' nyan cing*// don ched du bskyar te zhu ba la// mi kho bos bar do'i gdams ngag bshad// rje lho brag mar pa'i thugs phyung yang*// don 'di las zab pa yod re kan// zhes mgur du bzhengs pa la/ yang bzhin bzang ma de rnams langs nas phyag dang bskor ba lan bdun bdun byas nas rin po che'i phra bkod pa'i maṇḍal phul nas/ rje btsun gyi sku gsung thugs che ba'i yon tan la bstod cing lus snyoms par 'jug pa'i dga' bzhi'i ye shes bde stong gi mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ bar do ngo sprod kyi chos de rnams tshig zhib rgyas su bsnyad cing don mdor 'dus pa nyams su blangs ba cig gnang 'tshal// zhes zhu don glu ru phul ba 'di skad do// rje 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bka' drin can// lcags la gser 'gyur btab pa bzhin// snyan brgyud dag pa'i bdud rtsi yis/ sdug bsngal bde bar bsgyur mdzad pa// pha sangs rgyas khyed la phyag 'tshal gyis// thugs brtse bas mi 'bral rtag skyong dang*// rgyud sbyangs pa can gyi snang ba la// zhing yongs su dag pa chos kyi dbyings// bde chen spros bral gyi pho brang de// rje bla ma'i gdan sa ma lags sam// ḍā ki sprin tshogs 'du ba'i dbus// gdon rig stong dbyer med seng ge'i khri// srid pa'i skyon spangs padma can// sna tshogs rtog pa'i sprin bral ba// 'od gsal nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la// pha bla ma rje btsun bzhugs pa de// sku lta bas mi ngom gzi mdangs can// zhal lhan ne lha nge shin tu mdzes// yon tan tshogs kyis rab brgyan te// dpe byad mtshan gyis spras pa'i phyir/

rgyal sras gzhon nu nyid dang mtshungs// sku mthong nas dga' ba'i rje la bstod// gsung sgra dbyangs snyan pa dri za'i glu// sgra rang snang stong pa chos kyi sgra// bde chen seng ge sgra sgrogs pa// bdud dang mu stegs skrag mdzad cing*// skal ldan gdung ba sel mdzad pa// gsung de la snyan pas phyogs bcur bstod// thugs mi byed rdo rje'i snying po ltar// shes bya'i mthar thug kun la mkhas// lta ba kun yangs nam mkha' la// byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis// gdul bya'i mun pa sel mdzad pa// thugs mi 'gyur ba yi rje la bstod// rje sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo sku gsung thugs// sna tshogs siddhi sbyin pa'i phyir// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu khyod// rgyal mtshan rtse mo spyi gtsug gis// cod pan gdan la rab bzhugs nas// bsam pa dag pas byi dor byas// g.yel ba med par nyin mtshan du// phyag byas mchod cing gsol btab nas// ci 'dod re ba skong mdzad cing*/ 'dod pa'i don rnams sgrub mdzad pa// dbang gi rgyal po lta bu yi// rje rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed kyi thugs rje'i sprin tshogs las// byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsi yi// char babs 'o ma'i rgyun de las// skal ldan 'ga' zhig 'thung byed pa// skye gnas 'di nyid kho na la// nyon mongs tha ba btul nas kyang*// rtogs pa'i myu gu 'khrungs gyur cing*// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa// sku dang ye shes 'phrin las kyi// lo 'bras me tog phun sum tshogs// 'khor kun rab tu tshim mdzad pa// ring por mi thogs bskrun par shog /de ma thob kyi bar du yang*// pho nyas bgrod pa'i lam gyi rten// zag bcas lus kyi bde ba yang*/ zag med ting 'dzin cher skyed pa// dga' ba rnam bzhi'i ye shes kyi// bde stong ting 'dzin la gnas shing*// dbu ma'i lam la 'jug pa'i phyir// yongs su sbyangs pa'i shes rab la// kho mos bgyid par 'tshal lags pas// dgyes bzhin khyed kyis gnang bar mdzod// de rjes slad nas zhu ba'i don// chos 'di bar do 'phrang sgrol la// phyogs snyan tshig gi brda yi mjal// dmar khrid zhib tu bsnyad pa dang*// sku bzhi ngo sprod don gyi gnad// mngon gyur dus dang sa mtshams kyi// mdor bsdus 'di las med ces pa// zhal khrid lag len bsdus pa zhu// gzhan yang khyed kyi mthu yis kyang*// chab 'og 'bangs su gyur pa las// sna tshogs gdams pa'i bcud bstan pa// rgyud dang dbang po tshim gyur nas// sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyungs te// tshe 'di'i snang ba kho na la// rtags dang yon tan sna tshogs rnams// rje btsun khyed dang mnyam par shog

/ces mjug dag pa smon lam dang bcas pa'i glu rje btsun gyi snyan du phul bas/ yang rje btsun gyis bka' stsal pa/ bzhin bzang ma rnams gzhi khams gsum na mi khom pa brgyad kyi 'du byed kyi thang chad cing lam srid pa gsum na yun ring du gshegs pas/ lus ngal du gyur pa'i shul ring gi mgron po gsum yod de/ gsum po de gang zhe na/ gdams ngag kyang yod la nyams su blangs pa'i gang zag dang*/ gdams ngag kyang yod la nyams su ma blangs pa'i gang zag dang*/ gdams ngag med la nyams su ma blangs pa'i gang zag rnams so// snga ma de la ni srid pa'i lam dang*/ 'jigs pa'i 'phrang dang*/ bdud kyis bsgugs pa la sogs pa'i ya nga ba gang yang med do// sgom pa'i gnad kyi grol ba'i phyir ro// phyi ma ni skye ba tha mal pa dang mtshungs te ya nga ba dang bcas pa'i lam 'phrang de rnams su zhugs nas rang bzhin gyis bdud kyi gnas su khrid de/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su skye shi bar ma chad zo chu'i 'khyud mo ltar longs spyod pa'o// bar ma de la yang sngar bstan pa ltar ya nga ba dang bcas pa'i lam 'phrang gi dogs pa de rnams bsal zhing*/ bar chad bdud kyi chas brnyen de rnams gtan nas dag pa'i gdams ngag yod de/ khyod la mi 'gyur ba'i dad pa dang*/ zab mo la mos pa'i shes rab dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa'i brtson 'grus kyi go cha yod na khams dang dbang po'i dus tshod la sbyar la khad kyis bsnyad par bya'o// da res chos sku mngon gyur gyi sa mtshams lag len du bstan nas/ lam 'chi ba'i srid pa dang*/ 'gyu ba gnad gcod kyi 'phrang*/ phyi nang 'byung ba'i skye mched rim gyis thim pa'i rjes la nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba mtha' dag las grol ba/ nam mkha' dngas pa la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba ngo bo stong pa nyid kyi gnas lugs ma bcos pa ji lta bu cig dus der 'char bas/ de ka 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku yin te/

de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta bla ma dam pas ngo sprad pa'i gnas lugs lta ba'i don go ba dang*/ mtshon byed lam gyi 'od gsal dang*/ gnyid kyi 'od gsal sbyang 'tshal/ lam srid pa bar do la sngon byung yid kyi gzugs can las kyi gshin rje 'tshe ba'i 'phrang*/ snang mun 'od kyi bar do rgyu/ dbang po kun tshang thogs pa med cing las kyi rdzu 'phrul 'od dang ldan pa'i lus cig yod pa de ka longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te/ zung 'jug lha yi sku sgyu ma lta bur bzhengs nas bag chags snga ma'i lhag lus sbyangs pa yin pas/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta bskyed rim lha yi sku la dmigs pa gsal ba dang*/ mtshon byed lam gyi sgyu ma rmi lam zin par sbyong 'tshal/ lam srid pa tha mal/ rig pa las kyi rlung gis rang dbang med par bskyed pa'i 'phrang*/ dri za mngal gyi skye gnas tshol ba'i dus der/ pho mo sbyor ba byed pa la chags sdang skye bas/ sngar gyi gdams ngag dran pa'i gnad kyi rang nyid bde stong gi nyams dang mi 'bral bar/ gnyen po'i rtsal mthar phyung bas las kyi snang ba 'char/ dus phyis bsam bzhin skye ba len pa de ka skye ba sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku yin te/ de yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos/ de ngo shes par byed pa la da lta grol lam gtum mo drod kyi ye shes skyed pa dang*/ chags lam las kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gsum pa'i don nyams su myong bas/ phrag dog dang mig ser sbyong 'tshal/ mdor hril gyis dril ba la 'bras bu gsum mngon du 'gyur lugs kyi dus dang sa mtshams de ltar shes par byed 'tshal/ rje lho brag mar pa'i thugs kyi bcud phyung ba snyan don gyi ngo sprod thabs lam rang gnad kyi mthar thug kyang de las med do// rnal 'byor nga yi dgos pa'i zhe phug blo yid ches kyi gdings/

'phral nyams su blang rgyu 'di las med pas bzhin bzang ma khyed de ltar shes par nyams su longs shig /ces gsungs pas mig bsgyur ma de rnams kyi nang nas gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma thabs lam zab mo'i gnad kyi ngo sprod la shin tu dad par gyur pa des/ yang zhabs spyi bor blangs nas rje btsun lags/ dus 'di nas bzung ste skye gnas thams cad du kho mo khyed phyi bzhin 'brang zhing las kyi phyag rgya bgyid par ngo sprod kyi gnad de rnams kyi rtogs pa mthar phyin gyi bar du thugs la btags 'tshal zhes zhu ba nan tan du gsol ba btab nas phyag dang bskor ba lan grangs du byas te slar mo rang gi gnas su song skad do// rje ras pa chen po mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jig rten mig bsgyur gyi mkha' 'gro ma lnga yi 'phrang sgrol gnad kyi bar do la dris pa lan dang bcas pa'i brda don glu blangs pa rnams ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dza dang*/ zhu yas nges pa zhi ba 'od gnyis kyi mi brjed pa'i tshig gis bzung nas gsal byed yi ger btab pa rdzogs so/// /na mo gu ru/ bya zla ba'i tshes brgyad yol tsam na dben gnas sman lung chu bar du rje btsun dgongs pa la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ 'od dkar ba cig dkar lhag ge byung skad/ de nas mi snang bar sgra snyan pa cig sang sang byung nas in tsam na dri zhim po sngon chad bro ma myong ba bro ru byung tsam na/ bkra shis tshe ring ma rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas 'khor bzhi po gcig gis sgra yi bye brag rol mo'i rigs mang po thogs/ gcig gis dri zhim mang po bsregs pa'i dud pa thogs/ gcig gis bza' ba dang bca' ba gya nom pa sna tshogs thogs/ gcig gis na ba shin tu mang po dang me tog sna tshogs pa thogs te khong lngas phyag /bskor ba byas nas 'dod yon gyi mchod pa sna tshogs phul nas/ mgrin gcig tu sdebs nas 'di skad bskul ba/

rje mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che// dkyil 'khor lha yis mtshan btags pa// bzhad pa rdo rje mi zer ram// yab dang yum gyis mtshan gsol ba// mi la thos dga' mi zer ram// rgyal khams yongs kyi mtshan btags pa// grub thob ras pa mi zer bar// mtshan gsum ya mtshan ldan pa de// gangs mtho lding rgyal mo'i g.yas zur na/ chu bo lo hanta'i klung 'gram na// yul ya mtshan sman lung chu bar na/ sgrub pa snying por lhur len cing*// 'jig rten chos brgyad yal bar dor// srid pa'i dgon pa nang nas phyung*// ngo mtshar chen po'i rnal 'byor pa// bdag cag bud med lnga po 'di// rdzu 'phrul lus kyis 'dir lhags te// snyan pa'i tshig dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs// ci bder rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul// pad can dung can ri mo can// glang po che dang dkon pa bzhin// bdag cag rnams la ldan mi ldan// las rgya zhu ba bka' gnang ngo*// dbab dang zlog dang skyil ba bkram// bkram pa'i sbyor ba mkhyen lags sam// de ltar mkhyen na mgyogs byed kyi// pho nya'i lam pa yin par nges// bka' rgyud sde bla na med pa nas// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin gyis// bu mo 'gugs ces gsungs pas na// bsnyen bkur rnams kyi nang nas kyang*// phyag rgya mtshan ldan che'o skad// de phyir bdag cag 'dir lhags mchis// de mkhyen par mdzod cig skal pa can// gcer bu'i lus la gzi mdangs can// zhes de skad glu yis bskul pa dang*/ rje btsun gyis de yi len gsungs pa/ do nub nam gyi cha stod la// lhang lhang glu yis brda sbyar ba// gangs khyung mgo shel gyi zur phud la// lho sprin smug po'i bla re bris// rgyu skar mang po'i phra bkod de// sman btsun khyed kyi pho brang yin// tshe ring dbang che skal par gnas// de srog gcod spangs pa'i rnam smin yin// khyed rnam thos bu dang longs spyod mnyam// de ser sna spangs pa'i rnam smin yin// 'khor bzang bka' bsgo nyan pa de// bzod la nan tan byas pa yin/

de nas dga' bar spro ba de// brtson 'grus le lo med pa yin// da lta nga dang 'phrad pa de// smon lam bzang po btab pa yin// de don bzang la nye ba'i glu// de don la sbyar te bgyid 'tshal na// rje nā ro paṇa chen brgyud pa 'di// lam rtsa dang rlung la rten 'brel bsgrigs// mchod pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang*// phyag rgya mtshan ldan 'bul ba de// khyad par 'phags pa'i 'bul ba yin// phyag rgya bzhi dang mtshan nyid 'tshal// pad can mdangs ldan bde ba rgyas// dung can nyams dga' bde ba myur// ri mo'i gting zab zag pa med// glang po dngos po'i gnas lugs rtogs// nyes pa'i skyon dang bral ba de// sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring ma// snyoms 'jug gsang ba'i bha ga la// e yig baṃ gyis mtshan pa yod// de yi nor bu hūm̐ sngon po// phaṭa kyis gnyis ka'i thig le bsdams// thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor bas// zung 'jug bde ba'i mchod pa yin// dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig bzhi// sku bzhi ngo bo nyid kyi ngang*// 'bebs pa rus sbal 'gros su 'bebs// bzlog pa dud 'gro'i mchur bzhin zlog /bskyil ba a wa dhu tir bskyil// bkram pa rnam rgyal phyag rgyar bkram// thig ni mya ngan 'das pa'i lam// le ni mya ngan 'das pa'i yin// las ni rnam pa sna tshogs la// las ni sdom sbyor mtshams sbyor cig /phyag ni de dang de ru mjal// rgya ni 'khor 'das gnyis su med// las ni gang dang gang byed do// de yi grogs ni thams cad byed// phyag ni bde stong thams cad la// mi 'da'i phyir ni phyag yin no// snyoms 'jug mgyogs byed pho nya'i lam// zag bcas bde bas gang ba'i lam// gsal stong dngos grub 'byung ba'i lam// mi rtogs chos sku spros bral lam// bde stong longs spyod rdzogs pa'i lam// gsal stong sprul pa sku yi lam// mi gsal mi rtogs bde chen lam// mgyogs byed lam zhes de la bya// de phyir chags lam sbyor ba yin// khyed rang nges par thar pa 'thob// rnal 'byor ngas kyang btsan sa zin// skal par ldan no bzhin bzang ma// zhes mgur de skad bzhengs nas de phyin chad nas las kyi phyag rgya mdzad de/

bza' btung gya nom pa'i yon bdag mdzad/ sgo gnyis kyi thugs tshim par byas so// lha ma yin gyi bu mo mnyes bzhin du phyag rgya mdzad do// spyir bkra shis tshe ring ma dang*/ la phyi'i 'brog sman zu le ma dang*/ sa la mang ba'i sman btsun ma dang*/ ling shing brag gi sman btsun ma lnga la phyag rgya mdzad de/ gcig las khyad par du lhag pa bkra shis tshe ring ma yin no// mi ma yin gyi bu mo las kyi phyag rgya 'gugs nus pa'i skyes bu chen po nus pa can dpal bzhad pa rdo rje dang*/ ljongs kyi bdag mo bkra shis tshe ring ma gnyis phyag rgya'i dris lan gyi mgur bde stong ye shes sprin gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi ra dza dang*/ ras pa zhi ba 'od ces bya ba'i skal ldan gnyis kyis tshogs dang maṇḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab ste yi ger bkod pa'o// de thams cad bkra shis tshe ring ma'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun chen po cog ro 'bri mtshams su byon pa la/ mdo bkra dpal brtsegs bya ba na bud med bu chung 'tsho ba cig 'dug pas/ cho yi bu 'tshos pas las ma zin/ las byas pas bu ngus pas mo na re/ rnal 'byor pa dal por bsdad kyang tshil bu yang mi skye/ nga yi bu 'di 'tshos la dro sbyin zer bas/ rje btsun gyis khyod kyi bltas pas nga dal dal 'dra ste nged la dal ba'i long skabs med gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/ rje bka' drin can la phyag 'tshal lo// gangs stod kyi seng lcam dkar mo nga*// seng dal yang dal la brel yang brel// lus dal te gangs stod phyogs su 'phyo// sems brel te skad cig yengs pa med// dgra bu yug 'di la khong zon 'tshal// nags stod kyi rgya stag khra chung nga*/ stag dal yang dal la brel yang brel// lus dal te nags khrod kun tu 'phyo// sems brel te skad cig yengs mi khom// dgra sa mda' 'di la khong zon 'tshal// brag stod kyi thang dkar rgod po nga*/

dal yang dal la brel yang brel// lus dal te ri gsum rtse la 'phyo// sems brel te skad cig yengs mi khom// dgra thag rnyi 'di la khong zon 'tshangs// mtsho stod kyi nya mo gser mig nga*// dal yang dal la brel yang brel// lus dal te rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim// sems brel te skad cig yengs khom med// dgra lcags kyu 'di la khong zon 'tshal// gung thang gi mi la ras pa dang*// dal yang dal la brel yang brel// lus dal te rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim// sems brel ste skad cig yengs khem med// dgra 'khor ba 'di la khong zon 'tshal// khyod bu dang po nor bu rin chen 'dra/ mig tu bcug kyang rtsub pa med// bar du bu lon ded drag po// ci yod byin yang mgu ba med// tha ma khyim mtshes snying ring po// ltogs grir shi yang tshor ba med// de 'dra'i bu 'tsho ngas mi khom// zhes dal brel lnga'i mgur gsungs pas yon bdag mo na re/ khyed dal brel gyi bshad pa mang po 'dug gi khyod zan slong du shog dang kham gcig kyang mi ster zer nas mo khros de rnams khong rnams dro za ba'i dus su mi gcig gis rnal 'byor pa bzang po gang na yod mi shes pas de bos dang zer bas/ rje btsun yang byon pas/ mi cig na re/ rnal 'byor pa khyod las bcol ba dum pa byed thang*/ nyal bas tshil bu yang mi skye zer bas/ rje btsun gyis/ yon bdag nga nyal bas tshil gsog pa ma lags/ da nga dal ba'i long skabs skad cig kyang med gsungs nas mgur bzhengs pa/ bla ma yi dam rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ dpal rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas// rang rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod du// sku yon tan rgya mtsho lta bur bzhugs// byin rlabs kyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'gyed// rnal 'byor las ma nus la byin gyis rlobs// 'dzam gling yangs pa'i lha mi gson// sgos 'dir bzhugs yon bdag pho mo gson// spyan ci ri bltas pa'i gcen long gson// sangs rgyas rang la yod pa mthong lags sam// snyan lhan ne nyan pa'i 'on pa tsho gson dang*// 'chi ba 'di kun la 'ong ba tshor lags sam// sems bskyed du re ba'i gcol chung tsho gson dang*// rgas pa 'di kun la 'ong ba dran lags sam// yod du re ba'i phyug po tsho gson dang*// tshe phyi ma'i brgyags phye thog lags sam// dpa' rtsal snying rus can tsho gson dang*// dgra 'khor ba'i g.yul ngo zlog lags sam// sho med kyang bre mo bgyis pa lags// nged rnal 'byor dal snyam brel ba lags// brel ba'i brel lugs bshad tsam na// tshe nges med yur ba'i nya'u chung 'dra// 'chi bdag bdud 'di so byas nya bsgugs 'dra// nges med kyi nya chung bzung dogs nas// chos skye med kyi rgya mtshor bros bros nas// nged kyang dal ba'i long ma byung*// na so gzhon pa 'di sos ka'i me tog 'dra// rkyen ngan pa 'di dus kyi ba mo 'dra// me tog sad kyi 'khyer dogs nas// tshe long med rgyud la 'gel 'gel nas// des kyang dal ba'i long ma byung*// gnas bar do'i sa 'phrang dogs mo la/

dgra dug lnga'i jag pas sha bsgugs byed// yid bzhin nor bu shor dogs nas// bsam gtan gyi dpe'u brtsegs brtsegs nas// bdag des kyang dal ba'i long ma byung*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho na// nyon mongs kyi rba rlabs phyogs bcur 'phro// sdug bsngal gyi rba la g.yeng dogs nas// myang 'das kyi skam la bsnyags bsnyags nas// bdag des kyang dal ba'i long ma byung*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i pha yul na// gti mug mun pa smag tu 'thib// gti mug gi mun pas non dogs nas// 'od gsal gyi mar me sbar sbar nas/ bdag des kyang dal ba'i long ma byung*// spyir 'dus byas 'di chu yi lbu ba 'dra// skye rga na 'chi rba rlabs chen po 'dra// 'dus byas kyi mkhar dpe zhig dogs nas// 'chi med gnyug ma'i ngang du klod klod nas// bdag des kyang dal ba'i long ma byung*// 'khor ba 'di zo chus 'khyud mo 'dra// 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying dogs nas/ brtson 'grus kyi zam pa 'dzugs 'dzugs nas// bdag des kyang dal ba'i long ma byung*// da mi chos shul ka'i mgron po 'dra// gnas ngan song gsum 'di g.yang sa che// ngan song gi g.yang la lhung dogs nas// thar pa'i them skas 'dzug 'dzug nas// bdag des kyang dal ba'i long ma byung*// zhes gsungs pas yul de'i mi thams cad kyis 'di mi la ras pa de yin pa 'dra zhes gleng ba de gsan nas/ dpon slob gnyis mtsho rnga del chung bya bar byon/ yul de'i skyes pa dang bud med thams cad 'dus/ sha chang la sogs bsnyen bkur gyi yo byad mang po khyer nas zhal ltar phyin/ de rnams kyi nang nas bu mo gzhon nu ma lnga gral bsgrigs te mgrin gcig tu ras pa rnam gnyis la rtogs pa ci 'dug nyams tshad pa'i phyir zhu don glur blangs pa/ lha dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// thugs rje can gyis byin gyis rlobs// khyed yar byon ras pa rnam gnyis po/

sku snyan pa che bas ras pa 'khum// khyed 'dir 'tshogs dad ldan pho mo kun// gleng brjod ma mang dal cig gson// nged rang gzhon rig bu mo lnga// ngag gre 'gyur snyan pa'i mchod pa 'bul// tshig sdebs sbyor dpe yi mtshon pa yin// don dgos ched ci gda' sems la zhog /khyed ras pa gnyis la zhu ba lags// gangs dkar ti se skad pa de// ma mthong rgyang nas sgra che ba// gangs shel gyi mchod rten 'dra'o skad// mthong nas drung du gtugs tsam na// ri mgo kha bas g.yogs pa cig /de mtha' g.ya' yis bskor ba cig /de la ngo mtshar che rgyu med// de la ya mtshan ci che'ang*// mtsho mo ma phang skad pa de// ma mthong rgyang nas sgra che ba// mtsho g.yu yi maṇḍal 'dra'o skad// mthong nas drung du gtugs tsam na/ ko mog chab kyis bskor ba cig /de la chu thig btab pa cig /de mtha' brag ris rgyan pa cig /de la ngo mtshar che rgyu med// de la ya mtshan ci che ang*// brag dmar spo mthon skad pa de// ma mthong gong nas sgra che ba// brag rin chen spungs pa 'dra'o skad// mthong nas drung du gtugs tsam na// spang la brag ri 'bur ba cig /de la nags tshal skyes pa cig /de mtha' chu yis bskor ba cig /de la ngo mtshar che rgyu med// de la ya mtshan ci che ang*// khyed ras chen ras chung skad pa de// ma mthong gong nas sgra che ba// grub thob rnal 'byor lags so skad// mthong nas drung du gtugs tsam na// mi chen ngo tsha med pa gnyis// kha nas glu chung len pa gnyis// lus la ras gos gyon pa gnyis// 'tsho ba sprang zas za ba gnyis// spyod pa ci dga' byed pa gnyis// de la ngo mtshar che rgyu med// de la ngo mtshar ci che ang*/ sngon ma bskor ba cig med pa la// da nang bskor ba don re chung*// sngon ma phyin pa cig med pa la// da nang 'ong ba rkang tshag che// sngon ma mthong ba cig med pa la// de ring mthong ba rgan byis gnyis// sngon ma thos pa cig med pa la// de ring thos pa cal col gtam// khyed yang na rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob gnyis// yang na bdud kyi bar chad byung*// lam 'di gnyis gcig las 'gro sa med// de yang bdud kyi bar chad byung*// glu de la shes na lan cig thob// mi shes rnal 'byor yul du bzhud// ces zhu don glu ru phul bas/

rje btsun gyis bu ras chung pa ram bu theg gsungs nas glu yi lan mgur du bzhengs pa/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed 'dir 'tshogs kyi dad ldan nya ma dang*// glu gre 'gyur mthun pa'i gzhon pa rnams// tshig sdeb sbyor legs pa'i bu mo lnga// don dmigs nas 'dren no dbus na mo// mi nga ngo khyod kyi shes ma shes// ras chen ras chung bya ba yin// nga rgad po g.yas nas glu len pa// mi la rnal 'byor bya ba yin// khong gzhon pa g.yon nas ram 'degs pa// gung thang ras chung bya ba yin// rnal 'byor snyan tshig zung du sdebs// dris pa'i dpe don dngos rang 'chad// nyams rtogs khong nas rdol ba'i glu// don dgos ched cig gda'o sems la zhog /gangs dkar ti se skad pa de// ma mthong rgyang nas sgra che ba// gangs shel gyi mchod rten 'dra'o skad// mthong nas drung du gtugs tsam na// ri mgo kha bas g.yogs pa cig /ri mgo kha bas g.yogs pa de// sngon bde gshegs nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i// ri bo gangs can bya ba yin// spyir 'dzam bu gling gi lte ba yin// seng ge dkar mo'i 'gying ba yin// gangs shel gyi mchod rten bgyi ba de// lha dbang phyug chen po'i pho brang yin// sde brgyad kun gyis mchod pa'i gnas// de mtha' g.ya' ris bskor ba de// dgra bcom lnga brgya'i bzhugs sa yin// de mtha' spang ris brgyan pa de// ri spos ngad ldan pa'i ri bo yin// sman shi sos bdud rtsi 'khrungs pa yin// grub pa thob pa'i gnas chen yin// zag med ting 'dzin brnyes sa yin// ngo mtshar de las che ba med// ya mtshan de las che ba med// mtsho mo ma phang skad pa de// ma mthong rgyang sgra che ba de// mtsho g.yu yi maṇḍal 'dra'o skad// mthong nas drung du gtugs tsam na// ko mog chab kyis gang ba cig /ko mog chab kyis gang ba de/ sngon bde gshegs nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i// mtsho ma dros pa zhes bya ba yin// chu bo bzhi 'dus kyi mgo bo yin// kyur sram gnyis kyi 'phyo sa yin// mtsho g.yu yi maṇḍal 'dra ba de/

dbus klu chen brgyad kyi pho brang yin// de la chu thig btab pa de// bdud rtsi 'o ma'i chu rgyun yin// de mchod sbyin brgya pa'i khrus chu yin// chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa yin// de mtha' spang
