gis brgyan pa de// klu bran rnams kyi bang mdzod yin// shing kham bu tri sha'i skye gnas yin// lho 'dzam bu'i gling zhes de la grags// ngo mtshar de las che ba med// ya mtshan de las che ba med/ brag dmar spo mthon skad pa de// ma mthong rgyang nas sgra che ba// brag rin chen spungs pa 'dra'o skad// mthong nas drung du gtugs tsam na// spang la brag ri 'bur ba cig /sngon bde gshegs nyid kyis lung bstan pa'i/ ri nag po dpang byed bya ba yin// yul dbus 'gyur tshal gyi byang phyogs yin// spyir rgya bod gnyis kyi so mtshams yin// rgya stag khra bo 'grim sa yin// de la nags tshal skyes pa de// tsan dan dmar po'i sdong po yin/ bzang drug sman gyi ljon pa yin// brag rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba de// lha drang srong rnams kyi pho brang yin// mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dben gnas yin// sngar 'das kyi grub thob bzhugs sa yin// de mtha' chu yis bskor ba de// kun gyis bgrod par dka' ba yin// ngo mtshar de las che ba med// ya mtshan de las che ba med// der ras chen ras chung skad pa de// ma mthong rgyang nas sgra che ba// grub thob rnal 'byor lags so skad/ mthong nas drung du gtugs tsam na// mi chen ngo tsha med pa gnyis// mi chen ngo tsha med pa de// mtshan ma'i rnam rtog zad pa yin// mi rgan gcer nyal byed pa de// gzung 'dzin gos dang bral ba yin// kha nas glu chung len pa de// nyams myong khong nas shar ba yin// lus la ras gos gyon pa de// gtum mo me ltar 'bar ba yin// 'tsho ba kham zan slong ba de// 'dod yon sred pa skyur ba yin// spyod pa ci dga' byed pa de// tshogs drug lhug par 'jog pa yin// nged skal ldan 'dren pa'i lcags kyu yin// dad can gdams ngag zhu sa yin// khong yon bdag pho mo'i 'khor sa yin// mkhas btsun rnams kyi gtug sa yin// sgom chen nyams rtogs 'bul sa yin// sgro 'dogs nang nas gcod sa yin// gzhi gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs sa yin// don skye med khong du chud pa yin// sems gnyug ma rang so tshud pa yin// lam drod rtags rgyud la skyes pa yin/

rang don chos skur rtogs sa yin// thugs rje gzhan don byed sa yin// ngo mtshar de las che ba med// ya mtshan de las che ba med// khyed 'dir 'tshogs yon bdag dad 'dun rnams/ khyed ma bskor sa cig med pa la// sngon chad bskor ba don med yin// da skor na 'phags pa wa ti skor// khyed ma phyin pa cig med pa la// sngon chad phyin pa rkang tshag yin// da 'gro na rdo rje gdan du song*// sngon chad mthong ba don med yin// da lta ra sa 'phrul snang ltos// khyod ma thos pa cig med pa la// sngon chad thos pa cal col gtam// da nyan na snyan brgyud gdams ngag nyon// khyed ma bsten pa cig med pa la// sngon chad bsten pa nye du yin// da bsten na bla ma dam pa bsten// khyod ma byas pa cig med pa la// sngon chad byas pa don med yin// da byed na dam pa'i lha chos byed// mi rgan gyi kha nas gtam rgan byung*// de go bar bsam na/ gdams ngag yin// ma go ba yi glu chung yin// nged rnal 'byor spyod pa gang bde yin/ khyed nya ma rnams khyim du bzhud// ces gsungs pas bu mo dbus ma des mgron thod dang*/ gos dang rke g.yu la sogs pa thams cad bla ma la phul te/ chags phyir 'brang bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis khrid de brin gyi lo stong dgon par gtum mo'i gdams pa gnang bas/ zhag gsum nas bde drod 'bar te ras thub pa cig byung*/ de nas zla ba bdun du mchong lung ri khrod du khrid nas chos drug ma lus pa gnang bas/ rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ der rje btsun gyis ras chung pa khyod slob ma skyong ba la mkhas pa yin pas/ 'di skyongs shig gsungs nas ras chung pa'i rjes su btang*/ der ras chung ma de zhag 'ga' khams ma bde bas/ ras chung pas rlung brtags pas/ cang ma nyes par 'dug pa dang*/ 'di la dad pa gting nas yod dam med brtags snyam nas mo rang gang dgar bzhag /ras chung pa ri la bzhugs/

phyir yar lung gi gad pa steng bya bar yon bdag gcig gis tshogs gsog byas pa'i sar mjal bas/ bla ma ras chung pas khyod na yang gang dgar bzhag nas nga ri la song bas khyod dad pa ma log gam gsungs nas der 'tshogs pa kun la tshig don bdun ma'i mgur gsungs pa/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi// khyed 'dir 'tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo kun// 'jig rten chos brgyad ma spangs par// dad pa can yin ma zer dang*// dad pa rkyen gyis bsgyur nyen gda'// mi dge las lam ma log na// tshul khrims can yin ma zer dang*// ngan song gi rgyu ru 'gro nyen gda'// rang sems g.yo sgyu ma spangs par// nga dam tshig can yin ma zer dang*/ rdo rje dmyal bar 'gro nyen gda'// thos pa phyogs med ma byas par// theg pa gzhan la ma smod dang*// chos spong gi rgyu ru 'gro nyen gda'// sgyu ma lta bur ma rtogs pa'i// las dge sdig khyad du ma gsod dang*// ngan song gsum du 'gro nyen gda'// pha rol gyi sems shes ma byung na// gdams ngag gzhan la ma smod dang*// rlom sems ltung ba phog nyen gda'/ sems dang chos su ma 'dres par// nyams len mkhan yin ma zer dang*// bdud kyi bar chad 'ong nyan gda'// brjod med dbyings su ma slob par// lta ba mkhan yin ma zer dang dang*// 'bras bu yid smon du 'chor nyen gda'// zhes gsungs pas de tsho'i nang nas ras chung mas go ba blangs nas zhu don bco lnga'i zhu ba slar phul ba/ rje dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// pha gcig bla ma rje btsun la// dad gus rgyun chad mi bgyid 'tshal// lha gcig dkon mchog gsum po la// rgyab brten spang blang mi bgyid 'tshal// bla ma'i snyan brgyud gdams ngag la// tha snyad lhan pa mi gdab 'tshal// yi dam rje btsun rnal 'byor la// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor mi gcod 'tshal// snang ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin la// mngon zhan bag chags mi bzhag 'tshal// sems nyid rang rig 'od gsal la// rnam rtog slad kyis mi bslad 'tshal/

shes bya dngos po'i gnas lugs la// gzung 'dzin dri mas mi bcing 'tshal// gnyug ma'i sems kyi ngo bo la// bag chags brtan pa mi bgyid 'tshal// sems chos sku stong pa'i rang bzhin la// mtshan ma'i dri mas ma gos 'tshal// lus 'byung ba'i nad gzhi 'thab pa la// gzhan la 'gyod kha mi bgyid 'tshal// gdon bgegs dge sbyor grogs po la// log rtog gi mo pra mi gdab 'tshal// rmi lam bag chags 'khrul pa la// bden zhen rtog pa mi bzung 'tshal// dgra sdang bzod pa'i bla ma la// gnod sems ngan len mi bgyid 'tshal// bla ma grub thob kyi mdzad spyod la// rtog dpyod sgro skur mi bgyid 'tshal// rang shar lhun grub sangs rgyas la/ 'bras bu gzhan nas mi btsal 'tshal// rjes 'jug snod ldan slob ma la// thugs rje'i chu rgyun mi gcod 'tshal// bla ma dam pa sku drin can// bdag snod ldan slob ma drang du gsol// thugs rje'i zhags pas drang du gsol// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma ras chung pa yang shin tu mnyes nas spyod pa po thub pa'i slob ma snod ldan du gzigs nas/ de phyin chad snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag thabs lam la sogs pa ma lus par gnang nas/ gnam mtsho phyug mo'i ma chags se mo do bya ba na lo brgyad ngag bcad nas bsgoms pas/ rtags lnga dang yon tan brgyad la sogs pa'i rtags thams cad tshang nas/ tha ma 'dir gshegs bya ba'am 'dir bzhugs bya ba'am/ 'dis mthong bya ba ma byung bas/ bla ma ras chung pas mkha' spyod du gshegs pa yin gsungs skad/ de thams cad mtsho rnga del chung gi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun chu bar sprul sku'i pho brang du byon nas bzhugs pa la/ dbyar po cig char pa rgyun ma chad par babs pas/ bla ma yang gzims rgyu rang la 'tsho ba yang gsol ma dgos pa byung ste/ nyin gcig nyi ma tsha mo zhig byug bas/ jo bo bon ri'i rtse spang la khar dpon slob brgyad byon pa la/ nub phyogs su gangs dkar po cig rgyang nge gsal bas/

gangs ya ki bla mas mkhyen nam zhus pas/ bla mas khyod gangs ya ki nga la e shes 'dri'am gsungs pas gangs dkar po'i che brjod mgur du gsungs pa/ ri mtho lding lha btsun rgyal mo'i mgul// brag bon ri gnyan gyi rtse mo na// bya ba btang ba'i mi brgyad 'tshogs// pha nga ni nyams dga' shes pa bde// khyed skyid du tshor ram bu slob rnams// bu rje 'bangs bde skyid 'dzom dus 'dir// nga mi rgan skyid rtags glu zhig len// nga mi rgan glu rgan len pa de// bkra rgan bcu gsum shis pa'i rtags// bu zhi ba 'od dang bde ba skyong*// bu tshur shog pha yi ram bu theg /de rjes ras pa glu la nyon// gdan gang bzhugs pa'i ras pa rnams// gangs ya ki khyod kyi shes ma shes// gangs ya ki khyod kyis ma shes nas// lha sman btsun bkra shis tshe ring yin/ rked pa yan chad rtse mo mtho// zur gsum dung gi bshos bzang 'dra// mgul chu dngul gyi ka ba la// nyi 'od 'char ba gzhan bas snga// cod pan shel gyi zur phud la// rgyal mo'i sprin dkar lding ba la// rked pa man chad rming gzhi la// na bun skyi bun rgyun du 'thibs// char mi drag dal bar rgyun du 'babs// skabs su 'ja' 'od 'ja' tshon bkra// de phyug gi ma g.yang 'dzom pa'i rtags// ri dwags mang po rgyun du 'khor// me tog spang rgyan sna tshogs bkra// sman nus pa can rnams de na skye// de lha sman gangs kyi che brjod yin// mi nga yi sgrub gnas che shos yin// khyod ngo e shes zer ba de// dbyangs de ltar thugs la 'jog par zhu// zhes gsungs pas ras pa rnams spro ba skyes te/ bla ma lags/ gangs ya ki la yul lha bzang po e gnas zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// lha bzang po tshe ring spun lnga de// brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo yin// 'jig rten dbang bsgyur ḍā ki ma// bal bod gnyis kyi skad bsgyur ma// chu bar sprin gyi bdag mo ste// lha ru mchod na mgon skyabs byed// chos mdzad yongs kyi sdong grogs mdzad// sgos rnal 'byor nga yi srung ma yin// khyed bu slob rnams la 'go ste mchi// mi dang lhan cig 'grogs 'grogs nas// spyir bod khams dkar po'i lam la bkod// sgos sgrub brgyud 'di la dngos grub shar// zhes gsungs pas/

bla ma lags/ khyed kyis de la chos bshad dam zhus pas/ de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// gangs de yi mgul du chos bshad pa// nga mi la ras pa mi zer ram// 'khor sman dang yul lha'i grwa pa rnams// las dkar nag nges par 'byed pa'i chos// drang don mdo sde'i rgyu 'bras bshad// zhe ring gdug pa byol song rigs// rigs bzhi klu la chos kyang bshad// gnyan chen spun lngas chos ston 'dren// btsan rol pa mched brgyad yon bdag byed// sman btsun mang pos bskor ba byed// lha 'dre yongs kyi 'tsho ba 'dren// yul phyogs dkar po'i chos la bkod// bdag sku mthu che ba ma lags te/ byams dang snying rje bsgoms bsgoms pas// ngag zhi bas bkrol te chos bshad pas// gzugs med lha 'dre thabs kyis btul// ngas sngar byas las la mi 'gyod pas// da ni rgas kyang ci la 'gyod// shi na mi 'jigs brod pa skye// khyed 'dir bzhugs bya btang ras pa brgyad// 'chi brod sgom la snying rus mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ bla ma lags/ de na lha 'dre rang la chos bshad na 'gro don e che zhus pas/ lha 'dre kho rang tsho min pa'i gzhan la phan pa chung mi la chos bshad pas rang gi mi tshad gzhan la phan/ lar dam tshig lha 'dre brtan/ mis dam tshig srung thub pa nyung*/ thub na thub chog mi dam tshig srung thub cig dang lha 'dre dam tshig yod pas rang dam tshig yod pa brgya gnyis mi gcig pu rang 'gro don la nus pa che/ tshad mar byas na mi yin yang nus pa su la yang med gsungs so// bla ma lags/ de dus thams cad bzang po e yong zhus pas/ de'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// bdag bla ma'i byin rlabs sngar nas byung*// nye du gzung 'dzin 'brel thag bcad// phyogs med kyi rgyal khams bskor bskor nas// bka' drin can dang las kyis mjal// 'jig rten bya ba btang lags pas// rjes thob kyi rkyen ngan lam du slong*// dman sa bzung nas gcig pur bsgoms// nyams len shi rgas gnyis la gtug

/nyams myong brod pa nang nas skyes// bdag rnal 'byor bsod nams mi 'dod pas// 'jig rten gyi bde skyid rgyab tu bsgyur// ngan song gi sdug bsngal sems la bzhag /yon bdag gi ngo srung ma byas par/ ri khrod 'grim zhing nyams su blangs// bka' drin can gyis byin gyis brlabs// 'bangs rlung gis khyer ba dgung dang mnyam// mtha' ru lus pa dbus su phyin// 'bangs su sleb pa dpon du sleb// dman sa bzung nas gcig pur bsgoms// bas rgyal sa zin// mi nas bud pa lha dang mjal// sdug bsngal spyod pas bde ba 'thob// snying rus byas pas snying rje skyes// gcig pur bsdad pas bu slob mang*// snyan brgyud bsgoms pas chos rgyud dar// rje btsun mar pa sku drin can// 'bangs spyi bo'i gtsug tu rgyan du bzhugs// da nga ni rgas kyang stag rgas yin// 'chi bas mi 'jigs brod dbyangs yin// khyed 'dir 'tshogs kyi ras pa bu brgyad po// mi tshe yang yengs ma byed sgom la 'bungs// zhes gsungs nas phug tu byon pa la/ ras chung pas bla ma lags sang tshes bcu'i mchod pa tshar nas/ ras pa la las ti se la 'gro zer/ la las stag tshang la 'gro zer/ la las seng ge phug tu 'gro zer/ la las ldom bu la 'gro zer/ la las bla ma'i drung du sdod zer bas 'di rnams la zhal lta 'dra gnang rgyu e yod zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// bu gsan rgya can gyi ston pa dang*// snying rus can gyi ras chung pa// khyod ston sgom gnyis kyi dbu mdzad pa'i// gdan gang bzhugs pa'i ras pa rnams// ngag ched du bskyar nas zhu bul ba// mi rgan zer nyan na mdzangs pa yin// bya gshog drug rgyas na dus tshod mkhas// nor chog shes zin na phyug po yin// dpa' rang tshod zin na rang srog brtan// de yan chad dpe la drangs pa yin// da dgos don mod la thal tsam na// sang tshes bcu'i mchod pa phan chad la/ khyed la la rgyal khams lta'o skad// la la dben pa bsnyags so skad// la la nga phyir 'brang ngo skad/

sgom chen kha grab byed pa de// bdud kyis myur du 'khyer 'dod yin// bu pha yis bskyangs na mdzangs pa yin// mi kha la nyan na rgyal po yin// mi rang la gdams ngag yod pa'i dus// phyi rna nyan thos pa ma yin pa'i// de ma brjed snying gi dkyil du zhog /thig le tshad du ma 'byongs pa'i// pho nya'i rig ma rtsal sbyangs yang*// mtshan ldan rig ma ma lags pa'i// las kyi phyag rgya ma bsten ang*// shal ma ri la 'jig nyen gda'/ bsnyen sgrub tshang du skyol bas kyang*// snying rje chen po'i kun slong dang*// yi dam gsal ba'i ting 'dzin gyis// bstan pa'i spyi don ma lags pa'i// mthu dang ngan sngags ma sgrub ang*// las kyi srin por skye nyen yod// rtsa rlung sems su ma 'dus pa'i// bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis// gcan gzan sprul pa'i gzugs bstan nas// lta stangs rol pa ma lags pa'i/ dur khrod kyi bam ro ma len ang*// sha za mkha' 'gro 'khrugs nyen yod// sum ldan la sogs bla ma dang*// rdo rje spun grogs ma gtogs pa'i// chos spyod grub mtha' mi gcig pa'i// chos mdzad dgongs pa ci mthong yang*/ sgom nyams dang rtogs pa ma brjod ang*/ sgrub brgyud kyi byin rlabs yal nyen yod// dam tshig snod dang mi ldan pa'i// mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ltas ma byung bar// zang zing nor gyi ngor bltas nas// chos zhu ngos dga' slob ma la// snya brgyud kyi gdams ngag ma ston ang*// nyams kyi grib mas phog nyen yod/ ri khrod dben pa ma lags pa'i// mi nag grong pa'i nye 'khor du// dad log gi snang bsgyur mi nus pa'i// zab mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang*// brtul zhugs spyod pa ma mdzad ang*/ 'jig rten skye bo'i ya ga 'jigs// ang drug nyams len glu chung 'di// spyir chos mdzad yongs kyi spyi nor yin// sgos bu slob rnams kyi sems la zhog /ces gsungs pas der bzhugs pa'i ras pa rnams kyang nyams rtogs pa yar 'phel zhing bya ba thengs pas mtshams dang smra bcad dang*/

sgoms rang la brtson pa byung ngo*// de thams cad jo bo bon ri'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun la yon bdag brin pa rdo rje smon lam bya bas/ brin du 'byon du re nas spro ba bskyed cing la phyi gong zhes bya ba dben la yid du 'ong bar bzhugs sa yod/ 'tsho ba yang 'bad mi 'tshal bar nged yon bdag rnams kyi 'bul zhus pas/ 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes nas brin du byon dus/ pha gcig sgra sgyur rin po che// mi 'bral spyi gtsugs rgyan du bzhugs// khyed 'dir 'tshogs lha mi thams cad nyon// da deng sang dus kyi sngon rol du// snyan grags ro la chags pa yi// khe dang grags par shor shor nas// sdig dang tshogs la dga' ba yis// 'jig rten bya bzhag sems sems nas// snying po'i don la 'jol nas thal// bla ma'i sku la bzod par gsol// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// da deng sang dus kyi sngon rol du// 'dod yon ro la chags pa yi/ rnyed dang bkur stir shor shor nas// 'khor dang g.yog la dga' ba yis// tha snyad tshig la sems sems nas// gnyug ma'i don la nyams nas thal// lhag pa'i lha la bzod par gsol// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// deng sang dus kyi sngon rol du// sgyu lus rten la chags pa yis// zag bcas bde ba nyams te thal// mi chen tshul 'chos byed byed nas// ngo srung phyogs su shor ba yis// bye brag gi dam tshig nyams te thal// mkha' 'gro'i sku la bzod par gsol// skal ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes bzod gsol gsum po gsungs/ de nas brin du yon bdag rdor smon la sogs kyis zhabs tog byed cing yod pa'i dus su ri khrod la 'gro gsungs nas/ se ban ras pa dang dpon slob gnyis gsang ste phugs su bzhugs/ dbus nas sne'u zur pa'i slob ma gcig chos zhu ba dang*/ spyan snga ba'i slob ma la sger 'gro ba dang 'grogs nas byung*/

der rje btsun dang mjal/ dbus na grub thob ci 'dra ba yod gsungs pas spyan snga bas yi dam zhal gzigs zer/ se ras kyi/ rje btsun gyis gzigs sam zhus pas// ma rig mun pa sang gyur cig /skye ba med pa'i don mthong na// zhal dang mkha' 'gro mas kyang ston// chos nyid klong la lta bsam med// ces gsungs/ se ras pas spyan snga ba la yon tan ci tsam mnga' dris pas/ yi dam gyi chos gsungs zer/ rje btsun la gsung ngam dris pas/ gang yang skye ba med pa yi// sems nyid skye med don mthong nas// chos dang mkha' 'gro mas kyang gsungs/ brjod med ngang la nyan sems med/ yang dris pas/ thang lhas bshos drangs zer/ rje btsun gyis/ lha 'dres bshos 'dren pa la grub thob du byed dam gsungs/ rje btsun la drangs sam zhus pas/ mi zad nam mkha' lta bu'i mdzod// ting 'dzin sems kyi g.yo bskol gyi// bkres skom zas kyi 'dun pa'ang*// bral bar mkha' 'gro mas kyang byed// de yang grub thob yin snyam med// ces gsungs/ yang dris pas/ dngos grub thob zer/ rje btsun la thob bam zhus pas/ yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// dgos pa thams cad tshe 'di ru// grub ces mkha' 'gro mas lung bstan// zhes gsungs/ yang nyin gcig se ban ras pa la/ kho de de ring nged rang gnyis skyo bsang la 'dong gsungs nas/ kho na re/ deng sang skyo bsang la bzhud pa bas bsod snyoms thog cig byas te/ rje btsun rang la phyi gangs la bzhugs pa'i chos brgyags btsal na 'thad pa 'dra lags/ brin pa tshos so nam yang byed bdo bas skyo bsang rang 'thad dam zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ ngas bsod snyoms mi byed/ khong tshos so nam byed bdo ste/ ngas kyang so nam byed cing yod/ nga yis so nam 'di ltar byed pas khyed rang nyon ang gsungs nas/ pha mi bskyod zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mi gzhan rnams zhing la so nam byed/

bdag ni so nam lha chos byed// chos nyid stong pa'i zhing sa la// gdams ngag zab mo'i sa bon btab// thabs shes gnyis kyi rmon pa sa rmos// dran pa rgyun chags chu zhig gcus// rang rig rang gsal ljang bu skyes// yur ma rnam par rtog pas yur// 'bras bu byang chub sems su smin// de 'dra ba yi ston thog la// shes rab rnon pos zor bas brngas// gnyis su med pa'i thag pas drangs// theg pa chen po'i glang la bkal// bde ba chen po'i g.yul du spungs// snying rje chen po'i nyi mas skam// mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyug pas rdungs// yongs su dag pa'i rlung la phyar// dang po chos sku si li li// de 'og longs sku si li li// de 'og sprul sku si li li// lha chos kyi so nam de ltar gda'// zhes gsungs/ yang rje btsun gnas de nyid du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ jo mo gsal le sgron zhes bya ba'i nyams khrid zab mo zhus nas bsgoms pas nyams dang rtogs pa khyad par can skyes/ bla ma la gus shing sgrub pa la brtson pas/ ri dang mtshams dang 'dags char gyi dus 'da' ba cig yod pa la/ mi gzhan rnams kyi mo zhi gnas dang*/ gzhan gyis sdig sogs mi 'ong bas yid ches nas sgrub pa la yang brtson par 'ong dgongs nas gsal le sgron gyi rtsar byon nas mgur gsungs pa/ kye brin snye nam nam mkha' gsal le khyod// thog mar mos gus bla ma bsten// byin rlabs dbang gis rgyud smin byas// thar lam bdud rtsi'i ro mchog nyid// gdams pa'i chos la nges shes thob// lam gong ma'i drod rtags nang du skyes// ri brag dgon pa yun ring brten// ting 'dzin thang lhod ma shor bas// mi mthun 'gal rkyen bgegs rnams sel// da dri rgyu med pas legs kyang legs// zas dug gcan 'dra ba nga rgyal yin// chos 'bad pas byas kyang mi grol te// brag yul yun ring gla bas bzung*// bya nag rdo rje bzlas pa mang*// srog rtsol kyur sram lto dkar bzung*// bcud len dom bu thugs kar mkhas// 'gog pa snyoms 'jug phyi bas bsgom// kha bshad 'don pa ne tshos byed// dka' thub yun ring bram zes byed// grol cha sems la ma shar na// 'dod pas thar lam btsal mi rnyed// sems rdzing chu bzhin du skyil ba de// rtogs pa'i kha sna bkag pa tsam// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho des mi sgrol// phyag mtshan bsgom pa'i tsaṇḍa līs// shes rab phyogs med ral pa dgos// sems nam mkhar bzhag pa'i tsaṇḍa lis// bar do rig pa'i ngos 'dzin dgos// gnyug ma don gyi tsaṇḍa lis// skye 'gags yod pa'i don rtogs dgos/

thig le na dā'i tsaṇḍa lis// dngos po'i chos dang bral ba dgos// spros bral dbu ma dhu ti'i rtse// nang ma bcos rang byung gdod nas dag /gnyis bral gzung 'dzin rang bzhin 'di/ ngo bo phyag rgya chen po'i don// rtogs par ldan nam gsal le sgron// zhes gsungs pas/ jo mo gsal le sgron gyis de'i lan du mgur gsol pa/ bla ma khyod kyi bka' drin gyis// mi bdag tu mi zad skal ldan kun// rtogs dpyod kha lo chos la bsgyur// phyin ci ma log lam la bkod// bdag ma smin dbang gis smin par byas// smin pa brda yi don rnams mthong*// phyi 'khrul pa 'khor lo'i snang ba 'di// sgyu ma lta bu nyer mtshon nas// nang rig pa'i srang la mang du bzhag /'gyu ba sems kyi cho 'phrul de// rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin rang sar thim// 'jig rten lam gyi gol sa rnams// sbyor ba 'phen pa stobs ldan gyis// de rnams sgro 'dogs thad kar chod// lam ma skyes rgyud la skyed byed pa// gsang sngags thabs lam don gyi gong*// lam gong nas gong du 'khrul pa med// zhib mo yang yang 'thag mi nus// rgyab brten bzang po'i gdams ngag la// dang po'i dus nas nan tan byed// mtshungs ldan gyi mched grong khyad par can// ngan rdzong ras pas nyams rtogs dris// mo gru mo shi ching snying la khur// zog gi bslu brid blo la byas// gti mug gnyid la phyi thag bstungs// zhi gnas steng du rang srid bsring*// grogs cho ga rnams la thag chod byas// 'bol sngas bskyur nas lo bdun lon// don phyag rgya chen po thog bab la// ma yengs rtse gcig ngang la bzhag /khyed gsod brnyas pa byas pa la// mya ngan 'das pa'i bsam pa des// byams snying rje gnyis dang ma bral lags// chos dri med dri rgyu ma bde med// rdo rje 'chang gi brgyud pa 'dzin// mkha' 'gro sde bzhis lung bstan thob// rgyal sras klu sgrub mar gum pa// te mo nā ro'i skyes rabs la// rgyud sde gus pas mnga' brnyes pas// rje mar pa lo tsā rin po che/

thugs rje'i me tog phyogs bcur rgyas// dag pa'i 'bras bu so sor smin// 'bras bu spyi bor len mdzad pa// gung thang gi ras chen thugs rje can// snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur khyab// rje gtsug gi nor bu rin chen la// gdung bar bya ba'i mos gus dang*// yon tan mthong ba'i nges shes kyis// glu mchod pa 'bul lo thugs rje can// tshogs byang chub bsngo'o mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// zhes pa'i mgur bzhengs pa la/ bla ma rje btsun yang dgyes/ gzhan grogs po rnams kun yid ches te/ des bskul pa ltar thams cad sgrub pa la brtson par song skad do// yong dus der yon bdag bkra shis brtsegs pas bsnyen bkur la gdan drangs nas chos zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ yon bdag lar chos snying nas byed par 'dod cing nyams su len par 'dod na/ bla ma'i gdams ngag rang gi bsgom pa'i nyams/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes gsal la/ rang rig pa gnyug ma'i shes pa de sems can thams cad la khyab par gnas te/ sangs rgyas gsal bar snang*/ rnal 'byor pas thabs lam dpag tu med pas mtshon nas rang bzhin gyi ngang gi 'byung ste/ de'i dus na lta ba rang shugs kyis rtogs te/ tha snyad gang du yang mi thog /sems la nyams su myong yang ngag tu brjod du mi gtub pa/ dper na gzhon nu mas bde ba nyams su myong ba'i lkugs pa'i rmi lam bzhin no// gzhi de nyid sems can kun la yod kyang ngo ma shes/ brgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa bsten pa gal che/ de ltar yin yang ma bsgom na nyams su myong bas/ las dang po pas 'bad rtsol bskyed de bsgom/ ngag smra ba mang na bla ma sun 'byin cing dge sbyor la gnod pas/ dgos pa'i gtam kha yar tsam ma gtogs pa mi smra ba cig dgos/ lar khyed 'jig rten 'di la mig cer re bltas pa'i mis gang yang mi 'ong*/ snying nas chos rang bya snyam na las dang bya ba thams cad phyal gyis gtong dgos/ sdug bsngal mi shes pa bzhin dus gcig la 'dres na 'ong ba yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// lar ma bsgom bshad pa'i chos 'di nga rgyal yin// ma bsos rnyed pa'i bu tsha phung 'dre yin// ma zhus dpe rdul gyi khres po 'di// lung med khram pa'i gnya' shing ci la phan// drang don theg pa'i mgo skor nyan tshe skyid// nges don bla ma'i gsung la nyan mkhan med// dad ldan yon bdag bu slob lha chos gyis// khrel med khram pa'i kha 'dzin ma byed pas// nyes med gnyom chung gi bden tshig drang por ston// ces gsungs te nges par chos byed na/

mang po slob pa nas/ don thog gcig tu bzhag na phan/ smra ba mang na gong mas 'og ma bsgribs nas yid la mi zin pas/ yag yag mang po'i mgo 'khor du 'jug /'jig rten la zhen pa che na chos byas nas kyang kha chos yin/ yang chos pa la las khengs spyod dang yon tan sna re la bltas nas kheng sems skye zhing du bla ma gong ma'i yon tan mi len cing*/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs 'jug mi srid pas/ nga rgyal bcag nas mos gus zhe thag pa nas bya dgos pa yin/ nga rgas kha 'dir sgrub pa rem par bya snyam nas da lta long yod bsdad pas/ tshe 'di la bar chad nam 'ong cha med pas 'chi kar 'gyod pa dang bcas te long med la shi na ci byed/ shes tshad kyi kha nang du bltas nas nyams len byed dgos/ bshad pa dang sgom pa gnyis gang rung cig la nan tan byas na gcig gis gcig mgo smad nas gang gi yang sa mi zin pas sems gang mos pa cig mgo thon bya dgos/ rang gi chos de nyams su ma blangs pa'i chos de slob ma la bstan yang dga' la ri dang zhor byung gi chos pa phan mi thog pa yin/ dang por rang rtags thon thon du bsgom 'tshal chos gting phyin pa cig bslab/ de nas sgrub pa bya snyam pa'i tshe/ shes bya'i mtha' la chod dus med pa yin/ sgrub pa lo dang zla bar 'das 'gro bas gdams ngag zab tu re ba mang snod du bsag kyang gang sgrub cha med kyi bar la mi tshe bar ma dor zad pa stong log yin/ chos sna re la 'phral gyi nyams su long mdzod/ jo bo chos phyug po smra ba la dga' ba kha cig dang bla bo btang na yi dgos pa rnams sna gcig kyang gdams ngag zab mo mang na gang sgrub ngo mi shes/ bsgom kyang 'di la rtags ma byung bas gzhan e drag bsam pas 'grub dus med pas/ so ma gcig slob ring la de gong shes pa de brjed nas/ byis pa lag gi me tog dang 'dra// zhes gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// nyon dang yon bdag dad pa can// las bden pa'i don de mi shes par// sdig can thar pa 'thob tu re// lo zla zhag song tshe la gzan// mi skyid lo zla song na dga'// nam zla e song e song e song zlo// mi tshe song bar ma shes par// blun po mi yi rnam dpyod yin// khyod nges par chos dpyod mdzad dgongs na// mchod pa zhing sa bzang por skyel// 'bul ba dkon mchog gsum la gyis/

zhabs tog bla ma rje la gyis// zhe sa pha dang ma la gyis// sbyin pa len mo med par thong*/ phan 'dogs ma nus pa la gyis// rang rgyud chos dang bstun la gyis// chos nyams len byed na mang mi dgos/ khas len mang na rdzun so yin// de bzhin rgyud la e 'byor ltos// zhes gsungs pas/ yon bdag dad nas da rung khyed kyi mgur legs pa cig gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ legs pa'i mdo bcu mgur du gsungs pa/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos sgra bsgyur rgyal pos byin gyi rlobs// 'o na yon bdag pho mo rnams// khyed gtan gyi so nam bgyid mi bgyi// nga mi mi rgan kha la cang mi nyan// brgya la so nam bgyid pa'am/ dus mar song yar log nyan srid na// mi'u rin chen skyes nas 'chi// de phyir dam chos mdzad na legs// sgyu ma'i nor rdzas bsags kyang lus// de phyir sbyin pa btang na legs// khams kyi bza' btung bsres kyang 'dzad// de phyir tshogs gsog byas na legs// 'jig rten gnyen 'dun 'dus na 'phral// de phyir gnyis med bsgom na legs// mal sa mkhar brtsigs kyang 'jig /de bas dben pa bsnyags na legs// 'dus byas las la zad pa med// de bas bya ba bzhag na legs// bre mo'i gtam la zad pa med// de phyir smra ba bcad na legs// gdams ngag pags la snum bkus 'dra// bla ma mkhas pa bsten na legs// nyams myong mun la zla shar 'dra// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bsgom na legs/ legs pa'i gros kyi mdo don bcu// rnal 'byor pa yi blo la shar// khyed brin pa pho mo'i chos skal mdzod// e ma sems can snying re rje// khams gsum 'khor ba gting mtha' med// 'chi khar mi 'gyod tsam re mdzod// zhes legs pa'i mdo bcu mgur du gsungs pas/ yon bdag rnams kyis zhu ba phul ba/ nged cag yul pa 'di rnams rje btsun nyid ma lags pa/ sangs rgyas mngon sum du byon yang 'di tsam gyi mos gus mi skye/

slob dpon mang po'i ngo srung dang zhabs tog mi bgyi bar/ ci nas thugs rje 'dzin par zhu zhus pas/ yang rje btsun gyis de'i lan du dgos rgyu chung gsum mgur du gsungs pa/ gnyen dang yon bdag slob ma gsum// khyed 'jig rten pa yi theg chen yin// nga rnal 'byor pa la dgos rgyu chung*// phyag dang zhe sa ya tshul gsum// khyed 'jig rten pa yi 'dra chos yin// nga rnal 'byor pa la dgos rgyu chung*// rdzas dang longs spyod 'du 'dzi gsum// khyed 'jig rten pa yi che thabs min// nga rnal 'byor pa la dgos rgyu chung*// zhes gsungs nas yon bdag bkra shis brtsegs la sogs pa rnams la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed pa bsngo ba smon lam gnang nas thams cad chos la snang ba 'gyur nas/ de rnams kyi nangs nas sgom byed mkhan yang mang po byung ngo*// nyams skyes pa yang re re tsam byung ngo*// de thams cad brin gyi lha grong gi skor ro/// /de nas ras chung pa rje btsun gyi drung du thugs dam mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i dus su nub gcig rmi lam na khyi mo nag mo gcig la bal bkal// khas dung 'bud yi ge klog kus 'debs/ mi gsum gyi gcig nas gcig tu bskyal ba yin zer ba cig rmis pas ma shes nas zhus pas/ rje ras pa'i zhal nas/ khyi ni grong dang ldan pa de/ rgyud ni bal bas 'jam pa yin/ dung ni snyan pa phyogs bcur sgrogs/ yi ge tha snyad don la mkhas/ kus 'debs nyams myong glu ru len/ skyel bsu brgyad cu gsum las 'byung*// zhes lung bstan to// yang nub gcig rmi lam na/ mi gcig gis gos phud/ mi gcig gis khrus byas/ gshog pa gnyis btags nas shing span spung yod pa cig tu sleb ste/ bud med gcig gis me long gcig bstan pa rmis// zhes zhus pas/ rje ras pa'i zhal nas/ chos brgyad tshe 'di'i gos phud de// gdams ngag dri med chus bkrus nas// rgyu 'bras kyi bya lus la// byams dang snying rje gshog btags pa// tshogs gnyis dag pa'i lam bcad de/

mthong khom shing gi rtsar babs nas/ me long mkha' 'gro brda bstan byung*// zhes lung bstan yang nub gcig rmi lam na/ bong bu ga pa cig kha phyi log tu bstan te zhon nas chu chen po cig brgal ba rmis zhus las/ rje btsun gyis theg chen bong bu la zhon nas// 'khor ba dag la rgyab phyogs nas// bong bu theg chen brda yin te// phyir phyogs dbang bskur go zlog brda// chu ni 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// sgrol ba'i brda yin mkha' 'gros gsungs// zhes lung bstan to/ ras chung pas/ bla ma la rtogs pa cig zhu byas nas mchod pa cig byas pa'i dus su/ gling kha ras pas/ rje btsun la rtogs pa nam mkha' ltar yangs pa/ snang ba la thog rdug med pa yod zer ba de dag gnang bar zhu byas pa la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// bdud rtsi lta bu'i gdams pa 'di// lkugs pa'i gzhon nu'i bde ba bzhin// ma bsgom bstan rgyu nga la med// ces gsungs pas/ ras chung pas phyag 'tshal nas zhus pa/ bla ma ljon shing lta bu yi// skye med sku yi me tog zhu// bla ma chu rgyun lta bu yi// brjod med gsung gi bdud rtsi zhu// bla ma nam mkha' lta bu yi// rtogs med thugs kyi sgron ma zhu/ zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sku yi me tog bdud rtsi srungs// gsung gi bdud rtsi spyod pa skyong*// thugs kyi sgrol ma smin grol sgom// gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ bdag cag mi shes gti mug pas// sku yi dam tshig ji ltar srung*// gsung gi spyod pa ji ltar skyong*// thugs kyi sgron me ji ltar bsgom// zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rnal 'byor dam tshig gsum dang ldan// sdom gsum bslab sdom gsum du srung*// spyod pa sgo gsum ma he skyongs// smin grol mtshan nyid skye med ltos/ gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ go bas de rnams kyi don bkrol ba ni/ chos sku lhan skyes rnal 'byor la// longs sku rtogs pa rang sar grol// sprul sku dngos 'dzin med de bsrung*/

sdom pa gsum las// gzhan so thar sdom pa la// lam ni byang sems bslab pa ste/ 'bras bu gsang sngags dam tshig srungs// blo ldog gsum las// tshul 'chos chos brgyad blo ldog la// 'dod pa gsog 'jog spang bya zhing*// g.yo rgyu log 'tsho spangs te srungs/ spyod pa ma he skyong ba la// lus ni spyod pa rtog med la// ngag ni lkugs ma mi smra zhing*/ sems ni bu chung zhen med spyod// smin grol skye med ngang du sgom// bla ma'i mtshan nyid brgyud par ldan// slob dpon mtshan nyid dam tshig ldan// grogs kyi mtshan nyid lta spyod mthun// snang ba'i mtshan nyid skye ba med/ 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid gzhi rtsa bral// dpe yi mtshan nyid don ston byed// nyams myong mtshan nyid rtogs par ldan/ zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ legs pa de la 'grel pa cig gdegs sam gsungs nas/ ma bral byang chub 'thor mi 'dus// ma grol dar mdud lhod cing dam// dngos 'dzin dmus long thang la 'khyams// so thar med na nges 'byung med// gsang sngags med na 'bras bu med// byang sems med na gzhan don med// chos brgyad tshe 'di'i g.yab mo yin// gsog 'jog dge 'joms ser ba yin// g.yo sgyu thar pa'i g.yang sa yin// rtog pas 'khor bar skye bar byed// smras pas tha snyad rjes mi chod// zhen pas 'khor bar 'khyams par byed// dngos 'dzin byung na 'khrul pa yin// brgyud pa med na bka' chad yin// dam tshig med na gshin rje yin// mi mthun dgra zun spel ma yin// skye ba byung na dngos po yin// gzhi rtsa byung na spang blang yin// don ston mi nus don med yin// rtog pa med na yid smon yin/ gsungs so// gsungs bzhin bsgrubs pa'i yon tan ni/ de de yin te de nyid min/ sngar gyi de rnams bsgoms pas sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag yin/ thos pas sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag de yod pa yin/ gsungs nas snyan brgyud rnams tshar bar gsungs so// de rnams ras chung pa'i rmi lam lung bstan gyi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun dang ras chung pa dpon slob la phyi gangs la bzhud pa la/

ras chen pa bas ras chung po ngo mtshar che/ rgya gar du song*/ ras chen pa la med pa'i gdams ngag mang po yod zer nas/ nya ma tshos sha tsho ba dang*/ chang zhim pa/ rtsam pa zhib pa/ thud bzang ba rnams ras chung pa la phul/ rje btsun la sha rid pa/ chang skyur po/ rtsam pa rtsing pa/ thud ngan pa rnams bskyal lo// der ras chung pas nga la tshogs gsog 'di tsam byung bas/ bla ma la ci tsam byung na dgongs pas/ bla ma'i drung du mjal ba la phyin te phyag phul nas/ nya mas 'dir tshogs gsog ci tsam byung zhus pas/ bla mas 'dir bzang po byung*/ nya ma'i tshogs gsog la dro drongs shig gsungs pas/ g.yam pa'i 'og tu sha rid dang*/ chang skyur dang*/ thud ngan dang*/ rtsam rtsing dum pa gcig dang de rnams 'dug pas/ ras chung pa snying mi dga' ting nge song*/ bla ma zhim pa ltar mdzad na gsol zhing 'dug /ras chung pa khams log pa cig byung bas ras chung pa'i dgongs pa la/ bla ma'i yon tan cha gcig kyang med pa la nya ma tshos tshogs gsog legs po ma red dgongs nas/ bla ma bsam na bla ma'i drung du sdod nas gdams ngag mthar 'don/ zhabs tog snying tshim pa cig byed bsam nas/ zhabs tog tu mi 'gro zhabs 'dren du 'gro bar 'dug bsam nas bla ma la mgur 'di phul lo// nga rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim pa dang*/ chos 'khor lha sa lta ba dang*// dpal gyi bsam yas bskor ba dang*// jo shāka mched la phyag 'tshal dang*// g.yu ru'i khra 'brug lta ba dang*// mar rngog gi gdan sa bskor ba dang*// ro snyoms ldom bu byed pa dang*// cis kyang dbus su 'gro bar zhu/ zhus pas/ bla mas dbu gtum nas ci yang mi gsung ba dang*/ yang ras chung pas mgur 'di phul lo// yul gangs stod kyi seng ge dkar mo nga*// gangs stod yangs la mi 'phyo rgyus// g.yu ral legs po rgyas dus med// ras chung mi sdod ldom bur 'gro / da res bla mas bka' gnang zhu// nags gseb kyi rgya stag ri bkra ngas// nags gseb yangs la mi 'grim rgyus// khong 'dzum drug legs la rgyas dus med// ras chung mi sdod ldom bur 'gro// da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu// mtsho stod kyi nya mo gser mig nga*// mtsho mtha' yangs la mi 'grim rgyus// nya mo gser mig legs la rgyas dus med// ras chung mi sdod ldom bur 'gro// da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu// gung thang gi ras chung rdor grags nga*// rgyal khams yangs la mi 'grim rgyus// nga yi nyams rtogs legs la rgyas dus med// ras chung mi sdod ldom bur 'gro// da res bla ma'i bka' gnang zhu// zhes zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas ras chung pa/ dben gnas ri khrod 'grim dus su// rgyal khams 'grim pas phan pa chung*// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgom dus su/ lha sa'i ltad mo'i phan pa chung*// ltad mo sems la lta ba'i tshe// bsam yas gzigs mos phan pa chung*// sgro 'dogs nang nas chod dus su// g.yu ru'i khra 'brug bskor bas phan pa chung*// zhes gsungs nas sha tsha gros 'debs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// gangs stod kyi seng ge dkar mo khong*// seng rong du ma 'babs gangs stod zung*// brgya la rong du babs pa na// g.yu ral legs la 'bral nyen yod// g.yu ral legs po ngom zhig gangs stod zung*// bu da res bla ma'i bka' la nyon// phu ri gsum gyi bya rgyal rgod po khong*// khyed shod du ma 'bab brag la bzhugs// brgya la shod du bab pa na// gshog drug legs la 'bral nyen yod// gshog drug legs po ngom zhing brag stod zung*// bu da res bla ma'i bka' la nyon// nags gseb kyi stag mo ri bkra khong*// sa mtha' ma skor nags gseb zung*// brgya la sa 'phrang 'grim pa na// 'dzum drug legs dang 'bral nyen yod// 'dzum drug legs po ngom zhing nags gseb zung*// bu da res bla ma'i bka' la nyon// mtsho stod kyi nya mo gser mig khong*/ mtsho mtha' ma skor mtsho stod zung*// brgya la mtsho mtha' bskor ba na/ gser mig legs dang 'bral nyen yod// gser mig legs po ngom zhing mtsho stod zung*// bu da res bla ma'i bka' la nyon// gung thang gi ras chung rdor grags khyod// rgyal khams ma 'grim ri khrod zung*// brgya la rgyal khams 'grim pa na// nyams rtogs legs po 'bral nyen yod// nyams rtogs legs po skyong zhing ri khrod zung*// bu ras chung bla ma'i bka' la nyon// zhes gsungs pas/ yang ras chung pas zhus pa/ bla ma'i drung du lo sum cu rtsa gsum bzhi red pas/ lta sgom spyod pa'i gding dum pa yod/

de cis kyang 'gro zhus nas 'gro lugs kyi mgur ma 'di phul lo// ngas dam chos lta ba dper bzhag nas/ snang stong zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// rtag chad cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// 'gyur med lam du slong zhing 'gro// lta ba zhan yang nga mi 'gyod// dam chos sgom pa dper bzhag nas// bde gsal zur kha 'grem zhing 'gro/ bying rgod cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// 'od gsal lam du slong zhing 'gro// sgom pa zhan yang nga mi 'gyod// dam chos spyod pa dper bzhag nas// brtul zhugs zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// the tshom cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// spyod pa zhan yang nga mi 'gro// dam chos dam tshig dper bzhag nas// rnam dag zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// g.yo sgyu cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// rang sems dpang por 'jog cing 'gro// dam tshig zhan yang nga mi 'gyod// dam chos 'bras bu dper bzhag nas// lhun grub zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// re dogs cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// sku bzhi lam du slong zhing 'gro// 'bras bu zhan yang nga mi 'gyod// rje mar pa tsam zhig dper bzhag nas// snyan brgyud zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// tha snyad cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// gdams ngag lam du slong zhing 'gro// chos lam khyer zhan yang nga mi 'gyod// bla ma mi la tsam zhig dper bzhag nas/ snying rus zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// le lo cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// brtson 'grus zhan yang nga mi 'gyod// nga ras chung tsam zhig dper bzhag nas// skal ldan zur kha 'grim zhing 'gro// log rtog cham la 'bebs shing 'gro// mos gus lam du slong zhing 'gro// gsol 'debs zhan yang nga mi 'gyod// ces zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bu ras chung pa kha lta ma che/ chos kha la rgyal le byed pa'i mi mang po rma dbab pa thams cad yin/ lar nyams len med pa'i mi cig kha lta mtho// sdom pa mi thub pa cig chos bshad mang*// mos gus med pa'i mi cig khas len mang*// shes rab chung ba'i mi cig drung du che// phan mi thog nges pa cig mngon mtshan che/

sdod ma tshugs pa'i mi cig byed rgyu mang*// nang na yon tan med pa cig ku co che// rang rgyud ngan pa cig rogs la gzan// lar chos dang spyod lam 'dres pa cig shin tu dka'// kho bos 'jig rten gyi bya ba spangs nas yun ring bas chos dang spyod lam 'dres pa yin gsungs nas spyod lam rnam bzhi'i mgur 'di gsungs so// kho bo mi la ras pa dang*// res 'ga' nyal zhing nyal zhing bsgom// nyal zhing nyal zhing bsgom tsam na// gti mug 'od gsal du shes pa'i gdams ngag yod// mi nga la yod de gzhan la med// kun gyis nga ltar shes na dga' ba la// sgos ras chung pas shes na skyid pa la// kho bo mi la ras pa ngas// res 'ga' 'gro zhing 'gro zhing bsgom// 'gro zhing 'gro zhing bsgom tsam na// 'gro 'dug bskor bar shes pa gdams ngag yod// mi nga la yod de gzhan la med// kun gyis nga ltar shes na dga' ba la// sgos ras chung pas shes na skyid pa la// kho bo mi la ras pa ngas// res 'ga' za zhing za zhing bsgom// za zhing za zhing bsgom tsam na// bza' btung tshogs 'khor du shes pa'i gdams ngag yod// mi nga la yod de gzhan la med// kun gyis nga ltar shes na dga' ba la// sgos ras chung pas shes na skyid pa la// kho bo mi la ras pa ngas// res 'ga' spyad cing spyad cing bsgom// spyad cing spyad cing bsgom tsa na// 'khor ba mu dra shes pa'i gdams ngag yod// mi nga la yod de gzhan la med/ kun gyis nga ltar shes na dga' ba la// sgos ras chung pas shes na skyid pa la// zhes gsungs te/ ras chung pa/ rkang rkyang dang*/ tho cho dang*/ bzhad gad dang*/ ku re dang*/ sha tsha dang*/ gros 'debs dang*/ pho rus dang*/ a rgu dang*/ gzhung bzang dang*/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad thams cad sgrub pa po yi bdud yin/ kha ma mang sgom gsungs pas/ yang ras chung pas/ bla ma dang mched grogs ma mnyes kyang 'gyod pa med zhus nas 'gyod med drug gi mgur 'di phul lo// nga phyogs med rang sar ma grol yang*// phyogs cha dang phyogs ris ngas ma byas// lta ba'i phyogs nas 'gyod pa chung*/

mngon shes dang grub rtags ma thon yang*// le lo dang snyoms las ngas ma byas// sgom pa'i phyogs nas nga mi 'gyod// shugs 'byung rang sar ma grol yang*// chos brgyad dang tshul 'chos ngas ma byas// spyod pa'i phyogs nas nga mi 'gyod// g.yo rgyu dang zol zog ngas ma byas// dam tshig gi phyogs nas nga mi 'gyod// sku bzhi'i steng du ma sleb kyang*// the tshom dang yid smon ngas ma byas// 'bras bu'i phyogs nas nga mi 'gyod// bka' sde snod kyi bshad rgya mi shes kyang*// gzu lum dang ras chod ngas ma byas// slob gnyer gyi phyogs nas nga mi 'gyod// zhes zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas ras chung pa/ skye ba ngo sprod pa 'di tsam zhig la 'pho bar bsdad bsdad nas 'gyod pa med pa khong du chud pa ngo mtshar che ste/ 'gyod med kyi lus dang rang mthong gi nga rgyal dang*/ nga bden gyi u tshugs dang gsum 'dzom pa'i mi de lad sa bcos med cig min pas rkyen gyis 'gyod pa la yud tsam cig yin/ da rung legs po cig byed na nga yi kha ta 'di tsho yid la zungs gsungs nas zhal ta bcu gsum mgur du gsungs pa ni/ na mo/ gsang mchog theg chen rigs las 'khrungs// chos bka' bzhi'i ngo bo sku bzhi'i rje// sbas pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can// mtshan ldan lho brag mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud// de ring yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la// gdugs me shel gyi nyi ma 'od re 'jam// nga mi rgan shes pa bde mor gda'// khyod dmag brgya'i nang nas dar mdangs can// bu brgya'i nang nas bzhin legs po// tshig yang yang bskyar zhing zhus pa de// sngar nas dran nam de ring dran// don chung zhu ba mang po de// bka' tshig dkrugs pa'i phung 'dre yin// da ma yengs snyan gyi dbang po gtod// thugs kyi me long dri phyis la// nga mi rgan glu la lhan ne gson// gdan gang thugs la 'jog par zhu// e ma phyogs bcu'i chos mdzad rnams// thos bsam sgom la ma sbyangs pa'i// ma shes shes so ma zer cig

/chos 'dod kyi dad pa ma skyes par// kha za 'dod kyi ldom bu ma byed cig /gnas lugs 'dug pa mi shes par// lta ba kha por ma smra zhig /rig pa'i 'char tshul mi shes pa'i// gti mug blun sgom ma byed cig /snang ba sprul bsgyur mi shes pa'i// tho co gcer rgyug ma byed cig /nyams len gcig rkya mi pher ba'i// bla ma'i drung nas ma 'phags shig /zab mo'i ston lugs ma shes pa'i// thos chung gi mgo bo ma bskor cig /rang rdo rje 'chang dang mi mnyam pa'i// khrom la dbang bskur ma byed cig /gdams ngag gi 'tsho skyong mi shes pa'i// yig nag la yar chod ma byed cig /bsod nams kyi spel lugs mi shes par// dad zas khrel med ma za zhig /zhen pa nang nas ma log pa'i// mi nor la hab sha ma byed cig /bla med mngon du ma gyur par// mi nag gi bla mchod ma byed cig /bag chags kyi snang rgya ma dag pa'i// 'ol tshod kyi mngon shes ma bshad cig /gzhan rgyud kyi rtogs pa mi shes pa'i// bzang ngan gyi skur pa ma 'debs shig /nga mi rgan gyi kha nas legs bshad babs// lam sna dkon mchog gsum pos drangs// dngos grub bla ma mkha' 'gros byin// bar chad chos skyong srung mas sel// bso re dga' re skyid dge sbyor mdzod// khyod 'bri sgom ma nyams phyi skyo skol/ bso re dga' re skye de ring tsam// zhes gsungs nas ras chung kha la mi nyan pa'i kha ta dang*/ dad pa med pa'i chos bshad des/ ko ba skam po mar skud bku ba dang 'dra/ kha na la gyong che/ lar bu yi rtsar bsdad na skyid che/ sgo nga ma drod la glan na rdol sla/ ras chung ri khrod du bsgom na blo thon/ seng ge ma yi khog pa na rtsal rdzogs/ khyung sgo nga'i nang du gshog drug rgyas/ sgom chen bla ma'i drung du gol sa med/ bla mas ci gsung byas na bsam pa'i don 'grub/ ras chung pha yi kha la nyan na zhabs tog yin/ khyod dbus su ma 'gro dang pha bu gnyis gros 'cham// zhes gsungs pas yang ras chung pas bla ma la/

khyed la ngas khyod dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes rgyun chad med par yod/ da yang nga dbus su 'gro ba'i re sa skyel ma mdzad dgos zhus nas skyel ma re sa lnga yi mgur 'di phul lo// bla ma sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa thugs rje che// bdag ras chung pa la skyel ma mdzod// nga lta ba'i lam la 'gro bsam pas// rtag chad skungs sa mang ba dang*// phyogs ris jag pa rgod pa dang*// gzung 'dzin la ltong che ba yi// yang dag rdzogs pa'i lam la ma phyin pas// bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che// 'jigs pa sol cig sprul pa'i sku// bdag sgom pa'i thang la 'gro bsam ste// bying rgod kyi skungs sa mang ba dang*// dmigs gtad kyi sa 'phrang dam pa dang*// rnam rtog gi 'gong po rgod pa yi/ skye med spros bral thang la ma phyin bar// bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che// 'jigs pa sol cig sprul pa'i sku/ bdag spyod pa'i thang la 'gro bsam ste// zhan pa 'grogs yun ring ba dang*// tshul 'chos kyi sa 'phrang dog pa dang*// tho co'i jag pa rgod pa yi// shugs 'byung zhen med thang la ma phyin bar// bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che// 'jigs pa sol cig sprul pa'i sku/ bdag dam tshig sa mkhar ba rtsigs bsam ste// thos pa'i go rgya chung ba dang*// gnyan po'i zhol khyim dma' ba dang*// ngos lkog gi khyim sgo che ba ste// skye med dag pa'i 'bos kyis ma 'khor bar// bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che// 'jigs pa sol cig sprul pa'i sku/ bdag 'bras bu'i tshong cig len bsam ste// 'khor 'das shul thag ring ba dang*// myang 'das sa 'phrang dam pa dang*// 'dod chags kyi jag pa rgod pa dang*// sku bzhi yongs rdzogs kyi khyim du ma phyin par// bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che// 'jigs pa sgrol cig sprul pa'i sku// bdag ras chung rgyal khams 'grim bsam ste// sgyu lus skyid 'dod che ba dang*// dbu ru bod 'di dad pa chung ba dang*// khram pa'i jag pa rgod pa yi// bu pha yi drung du ma phyin par// bu la skyel ma mdzod cig rin po che// 'jigs pa sgrol cig sprul pa'i sku// zhes zhus pas/

bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyed rab kyi ma 'gro/ spus kyi 'gro na yang nga yi gling chung 'di la phyag rgya/ skor ba brgya/ maṇḍal brgya/ gtor ma brgya/ chu sbyin brgya/ tsha tsha brgya/ bshags pa brgya de rnams mdzod la 'byon// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pa dga' bas phyir nang phyag la sogs pa mdzad nas byon song ngo*// de thams cad ras chung dbus bzhud kyi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun gyi dgongs pa la/ nga yi bu des bla ma la dad pa thob sam ma thob/ bar chad kyis tshugs sam mi tshugs las ngan gyi dbang du 'gro'am mi 'gro dgongs nas ras chung pa'i phyir la byon te/ ras chung pa sil ma la yi la thog slebs pa dang sbur gog shi la khad pa cig tu sprul nas bzhugs tsa/ ras chung pas kho rang gi sha las bcad cing byin pas/ nga yi bu la snying rje bzang po 'dug dgongs/ de nas chu bo pha long gru kha na sleb pa dang*/ rje btsun khram pa mi bdun du sprul nas 'ong bas/ ras chung pa la zog po 'di sod sod rgyob rgyob byas gro phye gos log 'phrog pa las/ ras chung pas ngas da nang phyag dang bskor ba brjed pas lan bsam nas/ spyan zim me bla ma yid la bsgom gda'/ yang sang gi song nyi nas mig phyes tsa/ ngo mi shes pa'i ras pa bdun red 'dug pas mgrin cig tu sdeb nas mgur 'di gsungs so// khyod 'dir 'gro'i btsun chung gzhon nu gcig /khyod da nang gang nas 'ong ba yin// do nub gang du 'gro ba yin// brgyud pa gang nas brgyud pa yin// bla ma su la gtugs pa yin// yi dam gang la byed pa yin// dam chos ci skad zer ba yin// chos skyong ci 'dra bsnyen sgrub byas// nyams len ci 'dra bsgrub rgyu yod// ri 'di la ji skad zer ba yin// brag 'di la ji skad zer ba yin// bka' mchid ma yo drang du smros// zhes gsungs pas/ ras chung pas 'di rnams ngo ni mi shes/ bla ma'i sprul pa 'dra e ma yin bsam nas len mgur 'di phul lo// nged da nang snye nam lung nas 'ong*// do nub gar 'gro nges pa med// brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen yin// bla ma mi la ras pa yin// yi dam 'khor lo bde mchog yin// chos skyong mgon po nag po yin// nyams len rtsa rlung bsgom pa yin// nga rang ras chung rdor grags yin// ri 'di snye nam drod phug yin// chu 'di la pho lang gru kha zer// brag 'di seng ge 'gying 'dra zer/

'gro ba ras chung rdor grags 'gro// songs shig bla ma rje yis gsungs// 'gro ba dbus kyi phyogs su 'gro// spyod lam mngon lkog med par 'gro// de ltar 'gro yi byin gyis rlobs// rje sbas pa'i sangs rgyas rnal 'byor pa// sprang 'jigs dang bral bar thugs rjes zungs// zhes phul bas/ bla ma rje btsun nyid du krong nger gyur byung bas/ bu khyod la bla ma la dad pa'i dad pa dang*/ snying rje dum pa cig dang gnyis 'dug pa cung e drag /lar khyed la rkyen ngan gyi bar chad kyis 'jigs 'dug pas/ nang 'dod pa'i blo dang ma bral bar du rkyen gyis gnod pa yin/ da cis kyang 'gro na nga yi ras kyi sag le 'di'i steng du sdod dang bkra shis shig brjod gsungs pas/ ras chung pas/ bla ma'i grib ma tsam yang 'gom mi rung ba la/ na bza'i steng du sdod pa e rung zhus pas/ bla mas bka' gnang bas nyes pa med gsungs nas na bza'i steng du bzhag nas bkra shis dgu brtsegs kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// nga yi brgyud pa gang yin zer tsam na/ brgyud pa mi ngan brgyud pa bzang*/ brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen yin/ brgyud pa bzang po'i bkra shis shog /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /bla ma gang yin zer tsam na// bla ma mi ngan bla ma bzang*// bla ma mar rngog rnam gnyis yin// bla ma bzang po'i bkra shis shog /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /dam chos gang yin zer tsam na// dam chos mi ngan dam chos bzang*// dam chos phyag rgya chen po yin// dam chos bzang po'i bkra shis shog /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /yi dam gang yin zer tsam na// yi dam mi ngan yi dam bzang*// yi dam phag mo dmar chung yin// yi dam bzang po'i bkra shis shog /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /chos skyong gang yin zer tsam na// chos skyong mi ngan chos skyong bzang*/ chos skyong ma mgon lcam dral yin// chos skyong bzang po'i bkra shis shog

/bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /lta ba sgom pa spyod pa gsum// bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le gsum// bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /bde dang gsal dang mi rtog gsum// bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum// bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /sangs rgyas bden la chos kyang bden// de bzhin dge 'dun bden pa yis// bkra shis mi 'gyur brtan par shog /nga rang gang yin zer tsam na/ nga rang mi la ras pa yin/ mi la ras pa'i bkra shis shog /bu ras chung pa la bkra shis shog /bu pha bas lhag pa'i bkra shis shog /ces gsungs nas ras chung pa khyod dbus su 'gro ba la/ 'jig rten pa'i khyi mo cig gis rkang pa nas 'dzin par 'dug pas/ de'i dus su bla ma dang nyams len ma brjed par gyis shig gsungs so// yang ras chung pas zhus pa/ nga rgya gar du song dus phyag rgya chen po la bla ma bal po mkhas zer bas nga der 'gro zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'o na zhus/ nga rang gi chos bas zab par 'dug na nyams len gyis/ mi zab par 'dug na rang gi chos la nges shes dang snying rus cher 'gro ba yin gsungs so// de nas ras chung pa dbus su song ngo*// bla ma yar byon 'ongs so// de thams cad dbus gtad bar ma'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun dbus su yar byon nas phug pa'i nang du bzhugs nas yod tsa/ snye nam pa'i nya ma rnams kyis bsnyen bkur khyer 'ong nas/ nya ma rnams na re/ kha ba'i gses mar mi gnyis 'ong nas gcig yar log /gcig mar song 'dug /ras chung pa dbus su bzhud pa 'dra na/ bla ma rje btsun dang nam yang mjal bas chog log la 'ong zer/ rgan shos gcig na re/ log 'gro ba mi 'thad/ bsnyen bkur snga lugs su thong zer nas/ bsnyen bkur gsum gnyis rdza gtsib tu sbas/ gsum cha khyer nas rje btsun gyi spyan sngar phyin/ rje btsun khri yi khar byams pa'i bzhugs stangs kyis bzhugs 'dug pa la/

bsnyen bkur rnams phyag tu phul nas ras chung pa gar bzhud/ ci skad zer nas bzhud zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ gzhan gyi don dang kho la med de chos 'khor lha sa bskor du 'gro zer/ dpal gyi bsam yas lta zer/ mar rngog gi gdan sa lta zer/ dbus gtsang gi rgyal khams lta zer/ ro snyoms kyi ldom bu byed zer gsungs pas/ nya ma rnams kyis/ khyed kyis bshol ma btab bam zhus pas/ ngas khong la 'di skad byas te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bzhugs dus su// jo shāka bskor bas cang phan nam// lta rtogs sems la gtong dus su// bsam yas bskor bas cang phan nam/ ri khrod dgon pa 'grim dus su// rgyal khams 'grim pas cang phan nam// dri med sems la lta dus su// mar rngog gdan sas cang phan nam// dka' thub chu 'thung byed dus su// ro snyoms ldom bus cang phan nam// byas nas ngas dag kho la de skad byas te// lar gdong pa chung ba'i bu tsa de// pha ma'i kha la cang nyan nam/ dam tshig chung ba'i slob ma de// bla ma'i kha la cang nyan nam// kho rang gi ched du ma bab pa'i// mi rgan gyi kha la khong mi nyan/ khyed tsho yod na nyan tshod gda' ste// zhes gsungs pas/ khong thag ring po nas mar bzhud pa des blo ma bde/ khong la brgyags dang*/ gos dang*/ rta dang*/ grogs ci lta bu yod zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ ras chung mi 'dug dbus su song*// khong grogs bzang po cig dang 'grogs nas thal// gzhan gyi grogs dang 'grogs nas thal// gzhan gyi grogs dang khong mi 'dra// gzhan gyi grogs la 'du 'bral yod// ras chung grogs la 'dus 'bral med// rang byung ye shes grogs mchog dang*// ras chung pa gnyis 'grogs nas thal// rta bzang po cig dang 'grogs nas thal/ gzhan gyi rta dang de mi 'dra// gzhan gyi rta la mgyogs bul yod// ras chung rta la mgyogs bul med// rnam shes rlung gi rta pho dang*// ras chung pa gnyis 'grogs nas thal// brgyags bzang po cig dang 'grogs nas thal// gzhan gyi brgyags dang de mi 'dra// gzhan gyi brgyags la 'dzad pa yod// ras chung brgyags la 'dzad pa med// ting 'dzin zas kyi ro mchog dang*// ras chung pa gnyis 'grogs nas thal// gos bzang po cig dang 'grogs nas thal// gzhan gyi gos la dro grang yod// ras chung gos la dro grang med// gtum mo me 'bar bde drod dang*// ras chung pa gnyis 'grogs nas thal// zhes gsungs pas/

nya ma rnams na re/ brgyags dang gos bzang po dang 'grogs lugs kyis thugs khral mdzad mi dgos par 'dug zhus pas rje btsun gyi zhal nas gung thang gi gnyan chung ras pa dang lcim lung gi ngan rdzong bde ba skyong mdo bkra yi se pan bkra shis 'bar/ stag mo'i rnal 'byor gling kha ba/ khong snying dang 'dra ba'i bu bzhi yin/ lar chung 'grogs sems kyi tsher ma ste/ ras chung song bas dran pa 'phyo// zhes gsungs pas/ nya ma rnams kyis rje btsun la thugs khrel mi mdzad zhu dang*/ ras chung pa yang myur du 'byon mchi/ brgya la phebs na snye nam drod phug na ras pa 'di tsam zhig yod pa des/ de tsho'i nang du ras chung pa 'dra ba cig kyang med dam zer nas sems gso zhing chos bshad gyen gyam du gtong bar byung bas/ de'i tshe khong tsho la gces pa tshul du rdzun khung rdib pa'i phyir mgur 'di gsungs so// nga yi bu ras chung nyi ma dang 'dra ba de dbus su song*// pha rgan 'khar rnga gog po 'dra ba de shul du lus// nga yi bu gsung snyan dril bu dang 'dra ba dbus su songs// pha rgan zangs rnga gog po dang 'dra ba de shul du lus// nga yi bu seng ge dang 'dra ba de dbus su song*// pha rgan gangs ri 'dra ba de shul du lus/ g.yu ral legs po ngom zhing dbus su song*// nga yi bu stag mo dang 'dra ba de dbus su song*// pha rgan nags gseb dang 'dra ba de shul du lus// 'dzum drug legs po ngom zhing dbus su song*// nga yi bu rgod po 'dra ba de dbus su song*/ pha rgan brag ri dang 'dra ba de shul du lus// gshog drug legs po ngom zhing dbus su song*// nga yi bu skya bkra dang 'dra ba de dbus su song*// pha rgan go rgan dang 'dra ba de shul du lus// spyan mig skar rgyan dang 'dra ba de ngom zhing du song*// ngag rgya dar bas 'jam pa de ngom zhing song*// gsung dril bu bas snyan pa de ngom zhing songs// bzhin rma bya bas sdug pa de dbus su song*// smra ne tsho las mkhas pa de dbus su song*// sha gangs las dkar ba de dbus su song*// lus sba dkar las ldem pa de dbus su song*// zhes gsungs pas/

'o na bshol mi 'debs pa ci yin zer bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyed nya ma gzhon pa tsho yod na shol bar byung tsam gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// blo phug dkon mchog gsum la gtad cing song*// snying la bla ma rje btsun bsgom zhing song*// zas su zag med ting 'dzin za zhing song*// gos su gtum mo'i bde drod gyon zhing song*// rnam shes rlung gi rta pho bcibs shing song*// re sa dkar po'i chos la bca' zhing song*// dogs pa nag po'i sdig la 'dzem zhing song*// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma lags nged tshos shol bar 'dug na da song na sleb sar e yod zer bas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// nga yi bu de nam mkha' dang 'dra ba la// nga yi bu de e khug bsam na ni// nam mkha' phying pa bzhin du dril la shog /nga yi bu de rlung dmar dang 'dra ba la// nga yi bu de e khug bsam pa na// rlung dum spar bar zung la shog /nga yi bu de nyi zla dang 'dra ba la// nga yi bu de e khug bsam pa na// nyi zla gnyis po khug mar chug la shog /nga yi bu de ri bo dang 'dra ba la// nga yi bu de e khug bsam pa na// ri rab pang pas thob la shog /nga yi bu la khug thabs ga la yod// re 'khrul re 'khrul nya ma 'khrul// re sdug re sdug bsam rlag sdug /re 'jigs re 'jigs nya ma 'jigs// 'dir 'ong gi nya ma sad sid rnams// dam pa'i lha chos la gtong ba// sems 'du shes ngan pa las ngan yin// zhes gsungs pas/ khong rnams na re/ dka' las de tsam yod na thugs srel byas ma byas mi 'dug pas/ nged rnams la bu lo bcu lon pa dang*/ bco lnga dang*/ brgyad lon pa gang yang yod pa 'bul bas chog gis/ khyed kyis ras chung pa la 'dra ba re mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ bla mas mgur 'di gsungs so// ya ki gangs dkar gyi ltongs shed na// seng ge brgya 'tshogs stong 'tshogs kyang*// g.yu ral can de mi gda' na// ma ki tsan dan gyi nags gseb na// stag mo brgya 'tshogs stong 'tshogs kyang*// khong 'dzum can de mi gda' na// pha ki brag dmar gyi logs shed na// rgod po brgya 'tshogs stong 'tshogs kyang*// rgod rtse bro can de mi gda' na// ma ki mtsho mtha' mar mer na// nya mo brgya 'tshogs stong 'tshogs kyang*// gser mig can de mi gda' na// ya ki snye nam gyi drod phug na// ras pa brgya tshogs stong tshogs kyang*// bu ras chung pa de mi gda' na// lar yon tan yod pa dkon pa yin// de bas dad pa yod pa dkon// 'bul ba thams cad kha 'bul yin// tshogs gsog thams cad kha len yin// dad pa thams cad 'dod dad yin// skyabs gnas thams cad 'jigs ngo yin// snying rje zer yang nyon mongs yin// bzang po thams cad blun po yin// rgod po thams cad ngan pa yin// mdzangs pa thams cad ser sna yin// 'tshogs pa thams cad khram pa yin// phan pa'i chos la ngo tshar byed// gnod pa'i sdig la rgod por 'dod// bsam zhing rgod bro mtshar du che/

khyed sman btsun nya ma khyim du bzhud// nga rnal 'byor dge sbyor byed pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma lags/ nged rnams kyis kyang bka' gdams pa'i btsun pa mang po la zhabs tog byas te/ khyed kyi 'di skad mi gsungs/ nged tsho la yang dad pa bzang po yod lags pas/ da bka' ma bkyon par chos shig gsungs dang zer bas/ bla mas mgur 'di gsungs so// tshig tha snyad btags pa'i lta ba de/ ming lta ba byas kyang kha lta yin// gzung 'dzin g.yeng ba che ba'am/ sems rtse gcig 'jog pa'i mi re nyung*// blo la yar skyed med pa'i bsgom pa de// ming sgom pa byas kyang zhi gnas yin// lhag mthong zung du ma 'brel pa'i// sems gnad du bsnun pa'i mi re nyung*// blo nyin srib byed pa'i spyod pa de// ming spyod pa byas kyang brel snon yin// chos brgyad zil gyis mi gnon pa'i// chos mtha' ru skyel ba'i mi re nyung*// ngo lkog dang bcas pa'i dam tshig de// ming dam tshig byas kyang zog po yin// khas blangs dam bcas nyams pa'am// rang sems dpang por 'jog pa'i mi re nyung*// 'dod pas gdung ba'i 'bras bu de/ ming 'bras bur btags kyang mgo skor yin// chos nyid rdo rus ma 'phrod pa'i// lam sna zin pa'i mi re nyung*// tshe 'di'i bcings pa'i slob dpon de// ming slob dpon byas kyang brel snon yin// gang zag tsho mos gus chung ba'am// mtshan ldan bla ma bsten pa'i mi re nyung*// grong ltag gi dgon chung khra mo de// ming dgon pa byas kyang grong yul yin// gang zag tsho g.yeng ba ches pa'am// gnas ri khrod 'grim pa'i mi re nyung*// bka' gdams kyi btsun chung sran rdog mgo /ming btsun pa byas kyang lus bsgyur yin// gang zag tsho snying rus chung ba'am// 'dul khrims sna re srung ba'i mi re nyung*// snyan chung gi nya ma 'phyor mgo ma// ming yon bdag byas kyang 'dod bslu yin// bud med tsho snying rtsal chung ba dang*// tshogs gsog sbyin pa gtong ba'i mi re nyung*// spyir mgo nag gi dad pa kha la yod// khyod nya ma'i dad pa 'phongs la yod// nga rnal 'byor dad pa sems la yod// khyed nya ma tsho mar la bzhud re ran// mgo chung nya ma'i sbyin pa de// tshogs sogs wa sbres bzhes pa 'dra// sha khog spyang kis 'dred cing gda'// phye rkyal pho rog gtor cing gda'// chang bel wa mos 'pho zhing gda'// zhes gsungs pas/

nya ma rnams kyi bltas tsa/ wa sbres dum pa gtor 'dug pas kho rnams skyengs nas/ bla ma la phul te dbang bskur zhig zhu zer nas/ bla mas ma bzhes te mgur 'di gsungs so// nyon dang nya ma ser sna can// grags snyan 'dod pa'i tshogs gsog dang*// tshe 'di'i 'jigs skyob skyabs gnas dang*// lan re ba 'dod pa'i sbyin pa dang*// ngas byas rang 'dod kyi 'bul ba bzhi// de bzhi la nam phug yod pa min// kha za 'dod kyi tshogs 'khor bshams khyer dang*// chos mkhas 'dod rang bzo pho sgo dang*// sems g.yeng 'dod glu dbyangs tho co dang*// rang che 'dod dbang bskur ngo srung bzhi// de bzhis byin rlabs 'jug pa min// chos bshad 'dod yi ge lung med bsgrubs// nga rgyal 'dod phyag dang zhe sa dga'// bsgom du bcug tsa bshad pa 'dod// che thabs 'jig rten gyi las dang bzhi// de bzhis thar pa 'thob pa nyung*// bzhi bzhi bzhi ru sdebs pa'i dbyangs// khyod nya ma'i thugs dam de la mdzod// ces gsungs pas tshogs gsog ma bzhes pas/ 'bri sgom gyis ras chung pa'i ras phyam zhig yod pa de mnab nas chung ba'i spyi la por song tsa/ nya ma tshos ras chung pa red bsam nas tshogs gsog rgyu rnams 'bri sgom gyi rtsar khyer song ba la ras chung pa ma red pa dang skyengs nas/ 'bri sgom la 'bul zer nas/ 'brir sgom bla ma'i drung du 'ong pa nas 'di la bsngo log ma mdzad par bzhes par zhu zhus pas/ bla mas mgur 'di gsungs so// ya ki tshe ring drang srong de// gang shar gyi ngo bo mi shes par// thol skyes kyi shes pa dgra bor 'dzin// snyoms 'jug dran med bsgom du 'dod// las 'di 'dra byed cing zag med skyes// ma ki yi dwags bse ru ba// rang sems bse bar ma shes par// gzhan la phrag dog ser sna byed// las ngan dbang gis bkres skom spyod// bar 'dzam gling mi dbul sdug mkhun can// sa 'og gser sbram mi shes par// yul mi grong la rku rdzun byed// rdzun zol zog mang zhing je sdug 'gro// snye nam gyi nya ma spral sprul can// rje btsun la tshogs gsog ma 'dod par// tshogs gsog 'phyor po'i ras la byed// ras la phul zhing skyengs su song*// da 'dre mo'i spral sprul ma mang bar// lha mo'i tshogs gsog lha la phul// zhes gsungs pas/

nya ma gcig dad pa skyes nas ngus pas/ des rkyen byas te der 'ongs pa'i nya ma rnams 'gyod pa chen po skyes nas/ bla ma lags/ yul lung ngan pa'i dbang du song bas tshogs gang che ma shes lags zer zhing ngus pas/ rje btsun gyis chos bshad pas/ sgom byed pa yang gsum bzhi byung gzhan thams cad kyang chos la snang bar 'gyur ro// de thams cad dbus gtad 'og ma dang nya ma'i skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun ras chung pa bya phul nas 'on gyi la la byon/ bya pa'i gru la byon nas khra 'brug tu phyag phebs/ mchod rten 'og lnga'i rtsar gzims nas bsdad cing*/ btsad po bye'u chung pa'i bu mo lha gcig ldem bu bskor ba la 'ong bas mthong nas/ ma nyal bar yar long la dge sbyor 'dra ba gyis byas pas rje btsun ci yang mi gsungs par yang bskor nas 'ong dus su yang sngar bzhin 'dug /rnal 'byor pa khyed kyi brgyud pa gang la 'dod/ spyi bo bla ma du bzhugs/ bla ma'i gtso bo gang la byed/ chos ci mnyan/ nyams su gang len/ yul gang nas byon/ da gar bzhugs dris pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen yin/ mes po ti lo nā ro yin// bla ma rgya gar ti pu dang*// wa la tsand+ra rnam gnyis bzhugs// bod na mi la ras pa yin// dam chos phyag rgya chen po yin// yang snying mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud yin// bsgom ni rtsa rlung thig le bsgom// nga rang gung thang ras chung yin// phyogs med kyi ldom bu pa nga la/ 'dir 'gro 'dir 'dug gi gtad so med/ gsungs pas/ mo yab kyi rtsar phyin pas/ 'o skol gyi bla mchod du rung pa cig khra 'brug la bzhugs nas snang zhus pas/ nga yi bla mchod 'ong mi 'ong khyod kyi ngo mi shes/ 'on kyang brtags su 'gro gsungs nas rgyal po 'khor bcas rje btsun gyi drung du yar byon nas/ brgyud pa gang yin snga ma bzhin du btsad pos dris rgyal po thugs chos kyang mtha' brtags pa'i phyir/

brgyud pa bzang zhing bla ma'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar che ang*/ khyed rang la yon tan ci yod/ chos thams cad tshad ma'i rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa yin pas/ chos can me yod de du ba 'byung ba'i phyir zhes rjes dpag tshad ma bkod pa la/ rje btsun gyis bum dbang mtha' bral gyi rigs pa/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos can/ ngo bo tshad ma'i rang bzhin du grub ste/ mtha' dang bral ba'i phyir ro// dper na nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhes pa'i lan gyis bkag pas/ rgyal po thugs dgyes par gyur/ de ring bsnyen bkur gyi dro zhig 'dren pas bdag gi gnas su 'byon par zhu zhes gsungs pas/ pho brang du spyan drangs der zhabs tog bzang po mdzad nas/ brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen nas da lta khyed rang yan chad du sangs rgyas kyi brgyud pa zam pa ma chad cing*/ dbang bzhi'i don la nyams kyi sel ma zhugs pas/ nyams dang rtogs pa la glo bur gyi dri mas ma gos pas/ sprul pa'i sku 'ba' zhig tu byon pa ngo mtshar che/ bdag gi bla mchod du bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ bu mo 'di yang dad pa can gyi dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro bar yod pas/ zhabs tog la 'bul bas ko long mi mdzad par zhu// zhes zhu ba phul bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ nga sde tshan dang pha tshan med pa'i rnal 'byor pas khyed btsad po'i bla mchod mi 'ong ba/ bu mo'i zhabs tog kyang dgos rgyu med ces zhal gyis ma bzhes kyang*/ don gyis btsad pos ma bkrol bar bzhugs dgos par byung*/ btsad po'i bu mo dang yang yab yum du gyur/ de'i dus na btsad pa'i khyim mtsher rgan rgog gnyis la bu dang bu mo gang yang med/ zas nor ni che bar yod/ de'i sgo mdun na char mi 'phog pa'i phug pa cig yod pa de rje btsun gyis mkhyen te/ sprul pa'i sprang po mu lto ba cig nyal nas yod tsa/ rgan mo des rgad po la/ 'o skol bza' mi gnyis la bu dang bu mo ni med/

zas nor ni che/ rang gi skal bas ston mo ni tshar/ na so ni 'chi khar song*/ rang la dbang yod pa'i dus su g.yu bzang po 'di yis rje btsun ras chung pa'i phyag tu 'bul/ bsnyen bkur gyi dro yang 'dren/ phyi ma'i brgyags phye zhu na mi 'thad dam// zhes dris pas rgad po na re/ blo gros de shin tu 'thad/ de kho na bzhin byed zer/ dge ba la phyi bshol byed na bdud las yin/ gnang gi nyi ma la dro drangs g.yu 'bul chos zhu zer/ de sprang pos tshor nas/ rje btsun rin po che'i phyag tu rgan rgog gnyis kyi 'bul ba che chung gang phul yang*/ de nga la ma ṇi 'dren pa'i cha rkyen du gnang bar zhu zhes zhu ba phul bas gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes/ de'i sang nyin rje btsun dpon slob gdan drangs/ g.yu phul/ chos zhus/ 'o skol gnyis kyi g.yu 'di btsad po 'khor bcas kyis ma mthong bar bzhes par zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis g.yu phying khug tu bcug ste su la ma bstan/ nyin gcig phying khug gyang la gzar dpon slob ri la skyo bsang la byon/ der lha gcig gis g.yu 'dug pa mthong*/ ma bltas pa'i tshul du yang mal du bkal nas bzhag /gnang nyin gyi dus su song cing*/ sprang po de rje btsun gyi drung du 'ong nas khar sang zhus pa de ldan nam zer ba la/ rje btsun gyis g.yu gsang nas byin/ ma rig dang g.yu rig bya ba yin khyod la 'di mkho ba yin/ 'di khyer la ma ṇi 'dren pa'i cha rkyen mdzod/ btsad po 'khor bcas kyis mthong na 'phog /khyad par du bud med rgyu yi rang bzhin pas/ lha cig gis tshor na ser sna che bas chud zos la 'gro dgongs nas zan rdog nang du bcug nas byin no// khra 'brug na ltad mo bzang po yod pa'i dus su lha cig rje btsun gyi drung du phyin nas 'o skol bza' mi gnyis ltad mo la chas par zhu/ da res pho thog mo thog gcod dgos pa yin zer ba la/ nga sde ris dang pha tshan med pa'i rnal 'byor pa la thog gcod kyi don med/

khyed rang cho ris dang khung btsun pas mo thog gcod pa legs zhes gsungs/ bla ma mi bzhud na da bu ltad mor 'gro/ bla ma'i phyag na g.yu bzang po cig yod par 'dug /de ring nga la g.yar bar zhu zer/ rje btsun gyis g.yu sprang po la byin nas med gsungs/ mo khros nas mi ngan pa brgyags pa yin/ bra zan gyi khengs pa yin/ sprang po mir khur bcug pa cha med par/ khyed dang po ci 'dra zhig byung ba cha yod/ da snum pa 'di ngas byas pa yin/ g.yu rdo sgong 'dra ba cig yod pa nyin gcig nga la mi g.yar zer nas/ mdun na lcang ma'i dbyug pa cig snang ba des/ rje btsun gyi sku la the le le brgyab/ de'i dus su rje btsun gyi thugs dgongs la/ nga yi bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ khyod dbus kyi rgya khams su ma chas/ phyi nas khyi mo nag mo gcig gis bar du gcod par snang gsungs pa'i khyi mo de 'di rang la zer bar snang dgongs nas/ thugs skyo ba skyes nas mgur 'di gsungs so// pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sku drin can la skyabs su mchi// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// ri khrod dgon pa bzhag nas bla brang bzung*// rgyal po'i bla brang bzung bas nga re 'khrul// dus da re'i bla brang bzung re shi// ma mkha' 'gro yod pa shul du lus// khong gyos rgyug rgan rgog dang du blangs/ gyos rgyug dang du blangs pas nga re 'khrul// da ni gyos rgyug bsten re shi// rang byung ye shes yod pa shul du bzhag /khong btsad po'i bu mo dang du blangs// lha cig dang du blangs pas nga re 'khrul// da ni lha cig bsten re shi/ khyi stan dmar chung yod pa shul du bzhag /khong btsad po'i dar 'bol dang du blangs// dar 'bol dang du blangs pas nga re 'khrul// da ni dar 'bol bting re shi// ras gos rkyang gcig yod pa shul du bzhag /khong lha cig gi tshar slag dang du blangs// tshar slag dang du blangs pas nga re 'khrul// da ni tshar slag gyon re shi// thod phor yod pa shul du bzhag

/khong btsad po'i dkar yol dang du blangs/ zhal bu dkar yol bzung ba nga re 'khrul// da ni dkar yol bzung re shi// dpe'u bum yod pa shul du bzhag /bdag zer ba cig yod de rin chen grags// ces gsungs pas/ yang glang ma'i ber rges brdung*/ dpung sbud byas pas phyi rgan du 'gyel bar gyur/ 'di nga rang len pa yin/ bla ma dpang du btsugs te 'gro bsam nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma yi dam chos skyong rnams// mthong thos dran no ras chung pa// bsam zhing yi mug mchi ma 'khrugs// bla ma spangs nas bdud dang 'grogs// 'grogs pas nga ri 'gyod cig byung*// da yang bdud dang mi 'grogs 'gro/ sgrub phug spangs nas bla brang bzung*// bzung bas nga re 'gyod cig byung*// da yang blang brang mi bzung 'gro// ras gos spangs nas tshar thul gyon// gyon pas nga re 'gyod cig byung*// da yang tshar thul mi gyon 'gro// glang 'khar spangs nas sba ber bzung*// bzung bas nga re 'gyod cig byung*// da yang sba ber mi bzung 'gro// snyan brgyud spangs nas dpe bum bzung*// bzung bas nga re 'gyod cig byung*// da yang dpe bum mi bzung 'gro// zhes gsungs pas/ der nye gnas byar pa rin chen grags yod pas/ sgom chen pa blo sna ring dgos/ lhan du bsdad na phor sder yang 'khrog /zhus pas yang mgur 'di gsungs so// phu gangs dkar rtse la bltas bltas nas// mda' gtsang chab rgyas pa ngas ma tshor// mtho ri gsum rtse la bltas bltas nas// mda' sngo thog rgyas pa ngas ma tshor// rgyal po yab yum la bltas bltas nas// ma mkha' 'gro brjed pa ngas ma tshor// rgyal po'i mkhar la bltas bltas nas// gnas ri khrod brjed pa ngas ma tshor// lham sna legs la bltas bltas nas// phyi rting shor ba ngas ma tshor// lha lcam gdong la bltas bltas nas// rang byung ye shes brjed pa ngas ma tshor// 'jam phrug gos la bltas bltas nas// ras gos rkyang cig brjed pa ngas ma tshor// ska rags rgya ma'i ngos la bltas bltas nas// sgom thag 'khor mo brjed pa ngas ma tshor// dar 'bol ngos la bltas bltas nas// khyi stan dmar chung brjed pa ngas mtshor// zhal bu dkar yol ngos la bltas bltas nas// thod phor bhandha brjed pa ngas ma tshor// las byas pa yo de bdud mo 'di// gtam zer ba mi bden bdud mo'i tshig

/bdag zer ba nyon dang rin chen grags// bu nga ni skyo bas kho thag chod// rin chen grags gshegs da dam pa'i lha chos byed// ces gsungs pas/ mo na re/ sprang nag 'gro na gar 'gror gdod// shel mi 'ong pa'i mi rigs min// yud tsam sdod dang za ma sbyin zer nas tsha ba bskol ba la 'og tu song ba'i tshe/ rin chen grags na re/ de tsam re la bzod pa bsgom mi nus chos pa yin yang rgyu mtshan ci yod byas pa la/ ras chung pas bla ma dran pa cig byung gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bka' drin can gyi bla ma la// gsol ba snying nas drag tu 'debs// sho a tsa ma bla ma dran pa byung*// ji ltar bsam zhing rje btsun dran pa byung*// ma ki mdo smad kyi phyogs su phar bltas pas// rta rgod ma gcig la te'u chung brgya// phyed tsam dbyar gyi ci thob yab// phyed tsam ma yi phyi la 'brang*// te'u bsod zad nga hor gyi lag tu tshud// hor 'ja' mo'i lag tu 'o re brgyal// sho a tsa ma bla ma dran pa byung*/ rdzun ku re min no bla ma dran par byung*// shar kong po'i phyogs su phar bltas pas// sprel a ma gcig la sprel phrug brgya// phyed tsam yar gyi rtsi thog nyab// phyed tsam ma yi phyi la 'brang*// sprel bsod zad nga ya po'i lag tu tshud// ya po gshis ngan lag tu 'o re brgyal/ sho a tsa ma bla ma dran par byung*// rdzun ku re min no bla ma dran par byung*// pha ki lho brag gi phyogs su phar bltas pas// byi'u a ma gcig la byis phrug brgya// phyed tsam yar gyi nam 'phang bskyod// phyed tsam ma dang yang rtsal sbyangs// byi'u bsod zad nga byis pa'i lag tu tshud// byis pa ngan byed kyi lag tu 'o re brgyal// sho a tsa ma bla ma dran par byung*// rdzun ku re min no bla ma dran par byung*// ya ki spang kha'i phyogs su phar bltas pas// sha ba yu mo gcig la she'u chung brgya// she'u phyed tsam spang kha'i rtsi thog nyab// she'u phyed tsam ma dang bang kha bkye// she'u bsod zad nga rngon pa'i lag tu tshud// rngon pa sdig can gyi lag tu 'o re brgyal// sho a tsa ma bla ma dran par byung*// rdzun ku re min no bla ma dran par byung*// ya ki snye nam gyi phyogs su yar bltas pas// bla ma rjes btsun gcig la ras phrug brgya/

ras pa phyed tsam yar gyi dben pa bsnyags// phyed tsam bla ma'i chags phyir 'brang*// ras chung bsod zad nga lha lcam lag tu tshud// bdud mo lha lcam lag tu 'o re brgyal// sho a tsa ma bla ma dran par byung*/ rdzun ku re min no bla ma dran par byung*// zhes gsungs nas dpon slob gnyis chas te lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos khug de mchan du bcug /cang te'u snang ba khra chung de phyag g.yas su bzung*/ glang ma'i ber rga de g.yon du bzung*/ khyi lpags dmar chung de rked la dkris/ ras kha gsum bre lnga ma sku la gsol/ rgya gar gyi paṇa zhu de dbu la gsol nas byon pa'i dus su/ mo yi 'og nas tsha ba bskol nas byung nas khros pa'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ sbang zan rdog po tsha bar brdzis/ lo tshod tshwa med rdol med phor gang thogs na/ sing po phor gang g.yog mo la bzung bcug nas/ mos khyod sprang sgo phug 'grim pa'i dus su bsgom dran/ nga rgyal gzhi'i steng du bzhag pa dang gzod bsgom dran zin zer nas sbang zan thugs kar brgyab/ lo tshod dbu thog tu phos/ lo ma dbu yi steng du chags par gyur/ sing po zhal du gtor/ de'i dus su mgur 'di gsungs so// bka' drin can gyi bla ma la// gsol ba snying nas drag tu 'debs// sho a tsa ma bla ma dran par byung*// ji ltar bsam zhing bla ma dran par byung*/ bla ma la ma bsten dgu bsten mang*// bdud mo'i bla ma bsten ma myong*// dbang bskur ma zhus dgu zhus la// lo tshod phor ba'i dbang bskur zhu ma myong*// me tog ma 'thor dgu 'thor yang*// thal ba'i me tog 'thor ma myong*// cod pan ma btags dgu btags la// lo ma'i cod pan btags ma myong*// tshogs 'khor ma byas dgu byas kyang*// sbang zan gyi tshogs 'khor byed ma myong*// sku khrus ma gsol dgu gsol la// sing po'i sku khrus gsol ma myong*// gos la ma gyon dgu gyon la/ lo tshan gyi sngo thul gyon ma myong*// las spyad cing ngan no 'khor ba pa// gzhung 'grogs shing ngan no khyim thabs pa/

las byas shing lus po so nam mkhan// phan btags shing ngan no dus ngan mi// ngan bsam zhing bsam zhing rin chen grags// byed spyod 'di la ltos dang bdud mo 'di// nga yang na rgya gar yul du 'gro// yang na bal po'i yul du 'gro// yang na sham po'i gangs la 'gro// bdag zer ba nyon dang rin chen grags/ gsungs pa dang mo khang pa shod du song*/ khong dpon slob gnyis mar skas la byon/ mo mo go la bsdad nas 'og mig cer cer byas/ shod khang gi skas mgor phyin nas mo na re/ khyod rang 'dir bsdad pas dga'/ 'di las skyid pa khyed la gar yang mi 'dug zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i mgon la skyabs su mchi// thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzung du gsol// gri mo tshod med ma khros pa'i rang bzhin gyis// glang ber dbyug pa'i rgyab brdung gis// rgyus mgo mtho mtho rma yis bkang*// gri mo tshod med ma khros pa'i rang bzhin gyis// tshar slag la kha'i bya spu bzhin// thed thed long long stor nas thal// gri mo tshod med ma khros pa'i rang bzhin gyis// snang sems thugs kyi sha'u snang*// gri mo tshod med ma khros pa'i rang bzhin gyis// bdag gtso bo'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor snang*// nga yang na rgya gar yul du 'gro// yang na bal po'i mthil du 'gro// bdag zer ba nyon dang rin chen grags/ gsungs nas phyir byon/ de nas lha lcam gyis rje btsun gyi na bza'i thu ba la 'gyus nas/ da ci bya ba de za ma bud med kyi blor song bas ma shes pa yin/ da khyed rang gis cig gsungs pa'i bka' la nyan cing 'bangs su mchi bas bzhugs par zhu// zhes bshol 'debs su byung ba'i dus su mgur 'di gsungs so// sems sangs rgyas 'dod pas dka' thub byas/ nyon mongs kyi dbang du des shor byas// lus la bde drod 'dod pas ras gos gyon// thel phrug gi dbang du des shor byas// ma mkha' 'gro 'dod pas lha cig bsten// 'dod chags kyi dbang du des shor byas// nga bya rgyal khyung gi bu rgyud 'di// sgo nga'i nang du gshog drug rgyas// da nam 'phang bskyod kyang nyam nga med// bu mo 'then 'then ma byed ras gos ral// ras gos shing las byas pas ral dogs yod// nga nya chen nyer mo'i bu rgyud 'di// nya chung gi ring nas mtsho mtha' bskor// nga rba rgod gshag kyang nyam nga med// bu mo 'then 'then ma byed ras gos ral// ras gos shing la byas pas ral dogs yod// nga mi la ras pa'i bu rgyud 'di// sgom gsar ring nas nyams myong rdzogs// da ri khrod 'grim yang nyam nga med// bu mo 'then 'then ma byed ras gos ral// ras gos shing las byas pas ral dogs yod// nga blos bcad kyi mi la bshol 'debs sdug

/khyed bdud mo sku khams ci bder bzhugs// nga ras chung gi spyod pa gang bde yin// zhes gsungs/ de nas mos dpe'u bum mar bzung nas/ da 'dres khyer ba yin/ bzod par gsol bas/ yang 'di gsungs so// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams// mthong thos dran no ras chung pa// bsam zhing yi mug mchi ma 'khrugs// zer ba nyon cig bdud mo 'di// bdud mo spangs nas glang dkar gyi// rta la zhon nas rgyal khams 'gro// tshar thul spangs nas ras gos dag /gyon nas gangs dkar rtse la 'gro// rdza spyad spangs nas shing la yi// rkya rkyang snod dang brten nas 'gro// dpe'u bum spangs nas snyan brgyud kyi// yid bzhin nor bu bsgom zhing 'gro// g.yo sgyus bsgrub pa'i bzod gsol dag /spangs nas dam tshig bsrung zhing 'gro/ gsungs pas mos byar pa rin chen grags sbran pas zlog tu ma byung ba la mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rkyen bar tshad sel bar thugs rjes zungs// nyon dang yon bdag pho mo rnams// las byas pa yod do bdud mo 'dis// zer ba yod do phung mo 'dis// byung ba yod do rin chen grags// lha cig ngo la bltas bltas nas// bdud mo cig gis des bslus sam// slob ma'i dam tshig re re nas// rin chen srog dang des bral byas// glang dkar dbyug pa'i rgyab brdung gis// rus mgo mtho mtho rma yi bkang*// zhe sdang dred kyi sbar shad kyis// tshar thul bya spu lta bu gtor// gti mug dom gyi mthur 'gros kyis// 'gro long med par phul rgyag byas// thug pa rdor med na bza' dag /rnal 'byor gos med lus la bkon// dka' bas bsgrubs pa'i dpe bum dag /zhe sdang phrag dog dgra yis 'phrog /tshig rtsub mtsho cha rnon po yis// bdag pos snying gi sha'u snang*// len med bya rgyu'i dam tshig nyams// mi tshe 'di bas phyi ma ring*// snga ma shi ba'i ro mthong na// phyi ma skyo ba skye ba'i rgyu// sngar byas las kyi ro tshor nas// da yang rnal 'byor mi ldog 'gro// dang po lha mo 'dzum kha ma// bar du srin mo sdang mig ma/
