tha mal bdud mo ngo nag ma// las byas pa yod de bya thabs med// nga rnal 'byor ri khrod gnas su 'gro// nga ci la thugs kyang rgya gar du 'gro// 'chi ba srog la bab kyang bal por 'gro/ gsungs pas mo na re/ rgya gar du 'byon pa'i lam na dpal mo dpal thang bya ba'i thang chen po yod/ kha la bya ba'i la mthon po yod/ gcan 'phrang gi zam pa dang*/ mi rgod kyi jag pa mang po yod/ bal nad kyi tshad pa tshe la gnod/ chu bo gang gā sgrol ba'i zam pa med/ rgya gar yul du mu ge che bas khyed kyi bzhugs sa med/ sham po'i gangs la bzhugs par gyur na sgom gnas bzang zhing nyams rtogs 'phel/ thag nye zhabs tog kyang nga rang gis 'o mi brgyal bar byed// ces kyang bal yul dang rgya gar du mu ge che bas mi 'byon par zhu zhes ras gos la 'jus nas bshol 'debs byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis de rnams kyi rgyus khyod bas nga rang che/ sangs rgyas 'od ko re byon yang khyod kyis rtsar mi sdod gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// thang dpal mo dpal thang che lags kyang*/ rkang mgyogs dngos grub gdams ngag yod// sha khrag phal gyi do zla min// sho pha ba'i grogs cig lha lcam ma// gcan 'phrang 'jigs pa che lags kyang*// mi rgod jag ching gdams ngag yod// zla skyel phal gyi do zla min// bu mo 'then 'then ma byed ras gos ral// ras gos shing las byas pas ral dogs yod// kha la bya ba mtho na yang*// rnam shes bya 'phur gyi gdams ngag yod// 'dab chags phal gyi do zla min// sho pha ta'i grogs cig lha lcam ma// bal yul tshad pa che lags kyang*// rig pa gangs bsil gyi gdams ngag yod// bzang drug bsil sman gyi do zla min// sho pha ta'i grogs cig lha lcam ma// chu bo gaṅga che lags kyang*// rnam shes gru sgrol gyi gdams ngag yod// ko gru sdong gru phal gyi do zla min// sho pha ta'i grogs cig lha lcam ma// zhes gsungs pas lha lcam na re/

bla ma rin po che/ 'o skol bza' mi 'thab mo yin/ de tsam ko long bya rgyu med/ bzod pa'i nyams len mdzod la ces kyang bzhugs par zhu// zhes bskyar nas bshol 'debs byung ba la/ rje btsun gyis 'di mgo bskor ba'i thabs shig bya dgos par dgongs nas lha lcam la mgo skor lnga yi mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams kyi thugs rjes zungs/ sgos bka' drin can dang mjal bar shog /nga grogs la gzhung med ma yin pas// mi nga 'gro gangs dkar gyi rtse la 'gro// skyid skyid 'dra na lha lcam bsu ru 'ong*// sdug sdug 'dra na ras chung log nas 'ong*// bu mo 'then 'then ma byed ras gos ral// ras gos shing las byas pas ral dogs yod// mi nga la rna med ma zer cig /mdza' la gzhung med mi srid do// mi nga 'gro lho brag gi ngos la 'gro// bya rgyal rgod po'i skyid sdug lta yi 'gro// skyid skyid 'dra na lha lcam bsu ru 'ong*// sdug sdug 'dra na ras chung log nas 'ong*// mi nga 'gro lho kha'i nags la 'gro// rgya stag khra bo'i skyid sdug lta ru 'gro// skyi skyid 'dra na lha lcam bsu ru 'ong*// sdug sdug 'dra na ras chung log nas 'ong*// mi nga 'gro byang kha'i spang la 'gro// rkyang bu kha dkar skyid sdug lta ru 'gro// skyid skyid 'dra na lha lcam bsu ru 'ong*// sdug sdug 'dra na ras chung log nas 'ong*// mi nga 'gro ma phang mtsho la 'gro// nya chung gser mig skyid sdug lta ru 'gro// skyid skyid 'dra na lha lcam bsu ru 'ong*// sdug sdug 'dra na ras chung log nas 'ong*// mi nga 'gro lho brag phyogs su 'gro// dom bu thugs kar skyid sdug lta ru 'gro// skyid skyid 'dra na lha lcam bsu ru 'ong*// sdug bsngal 'dra na ras chung log nas 'ong*// mi nga 'gro snye nam gyi phyogs su 'gro// pha bla ma'i sku khams lta ru 'gro// sku khams bzang na lha lcam bsu ru 'ong*// sdug sdug 'dra na ras chung log nas 'ong*// bu mo 'then 'then ma byed ras gos ral// ras gos shing las byas pas ral dogs yod// ras gos rkyang cig bla ma'i na bza' yin// khyod dang nga gnyis las kyis 'brel// da ni 'bral thabs ga la yod// nga ni grogs la gzhung yod yin// khrel ngo tsha yod na ras gos thong*// las 'brel med kyi chos spyod stabs su byed// ces gsungs pas mos bsam mno cig btang nas/

'di la bla ma cig yod nges yin/ zas kham gang zos na bla ma mchod zer zhing 'dug /skyabs 'gro tshig re byed na'ang bla ma mkhyen zer/ dus ma yin pa la bla ma zer zhing 'o dod byed pa cig 'dug /bla ma de kun gdan drangs nas byung na nga la chos e gnang bsam nas gos btang nas bzhag cing*/ mgyogs par bzhud song ba la mo yid ma ches nas phyir ded nas song tsa/ mos ma sleb pa dang nyang po'i gru chod zer ba byas pas gru la ma btang ste/ ras chung pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor la mnyam par bzhag nas ras gos gru yi tshul du byas/ ber ma lcag la rkya ba'i tshul byas nas byon pa la/ sngar 'byon dus ras la chu mi 'go zhing yod tsa de'i nyin par grib kyis ras dang khog smad chu nang du song nas chus des khyer la dpon slob gnyis rgyangs shig chu khar phebs/ lha lcam yang ngu zhing rjes su ded pas lam du 'grim pa mang po byung ba la/ ras chung pa mthong ngam dris pas/ cha lugs ci 'dra yod zer bas mos smras pa/ dbu skra lcang lo can gyi bla ma ras pa cig e mthong*// snyan la shog dril brgyus pa'i bla ma ras pa cig e mthong*// khyi lpags khra chung rked la dkris pa'i bla ma ras pa cig e mthong*// ba man dkar chung khur ba'i bla ma ras pa cig e mthong*/ btsos ru nag chung khur pa'i bla ma ras pa cig e mthong*// snyan brgyud pu ti ga shal du khur ba'i bla ma ras pa cig e mthong*// zhes dris pas gtsang po phar khar sleb nas 'dug zer/ mo tshur khar sleb tsa na rje ras chung pas/ snying tshim drug gi mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// sprang thar pa thob par byin gyis rlobs// snying med khrel med kyi bud med khyod// zhe 'gyod dam bdag gi glu la nyon// gong gsum 'grim pa'i ri khyi sngo chung la// lha lcam tshod med ma yi sgo khyir re// lcags thag bstan tsa sgo khyi 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// gangs dkar stod kyi seng ge la// lha lcam tshod med ma yi sgo bzhon re// gser zo bstan tsa sgo bzhon 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// brag dkar stod kyi rgod po la// lha lcam tshod med ma yi khyim bya re// nam tshod 'dzin khar khyim bya 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// byang na dmar gzhung gi rkyang chung la// lha lcam tshod med ma yi rkang khal re// gser srab bstan tsa rkang khal 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// rdza khra yag mgul gyi bre sngon la// lha lcam tshod med ma yis gra khal re// sga stan bstan tshe gra khal 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// rgya gar glang chen sa srung la// lha lcam tshod med ma yis rmon glang re// gnya' shing 'jog khar glang chen 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// spang kha'i dgo pho sa le la// bshas lug re ba'i snying med ma// zhags pa 'debs khar dgo pho 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// mtsho nang gi nya mo gser mig ma// bcud 'dzin re ba'i snying med ma// bcud 'dzin byed khar nya mo 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// gung thang gis ras chung rdor grags nga*// lha lcam tshod med ma yis tshe rogs re// rgyal gzhis 'dzin bdor tshe rogs 'gyur// lha lcam tshod med ma la snying re tshim// zhes gsungs pas/

rin chen grags kyis/ sems can mgu byas ma gtogs pa/ rgyal ba dgyes pa'i thabs gzhan med/ bya ba yin pas mi drag gam gsungs pas/ des shor brgyad kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// pha rje btsun mi la sku drin can// bdag la thugs rje'i spyan rgyang srid// bdag snying med po'i las dang spyod la gzigs// bdag 'khor ba'i 'dam nas drang du gsol// khyi stan bzhag nas 'bol stan bting*// ras chung nga 'bol stan gyi dbang du des shor byas// thod phor bzhag nas dkar mol bzung*// ras chung nga rgyal po'i chas su des shor byas// sgom thag bzhag nas rgya ma bcings/ ras chung nga 'phyor po'i dbang du des shor byas// ras gos bzhag nas thel phrug gyon// ras chung nga btsun mo'i dbang du des shor byas// shog dril bzhag nas g.yu rna btags// ras chung nga gces phrug dbang du des shor byas// pha rje btsun bzhag nas btsad po bsten// ras chung nga ngo srung gi dbang du des shor byas// ri khrod bzhag nas rgyal mkhar bzung*// ras chung nga g.yeng ba'i dbang du des shor byas// ma mkha' 'gro bzhag nas lha lcam bsten// ras chung nga bdud mo'i dbang du des shor byas// las byas pa yod do phung mo 'dis// gtam zer ba mi bden bdud mo'i tshig /ces gsungs so// yang ras chung pa'i zhal nas/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sprang thar pa thob par byin gyis rlobs// snying med khrel med kyi bud med la// zhe 'gyod dam bdag gi glu la nyon// nged seṅge dkar mo'i bu rgyud 'di/ chung ma la skyes nas da lta'i bar// gnas gangs dkar min pa 'grim ma myong*// seng g.yu ral rgyas pa shod na bab// dgra bu yug gi steng der tsang de phog /che ba rin chen srog dang des bral byas// de 'og g.yu ral des shor byas// she a ba gangs dkar bsnyags re ran// nged rgya stag khra bo'i bu rgyud 'di// chung ma la skyes nas da lta'i bar// gnas nags tshal min pa 'grim ma myong*// stag 'dzum drug rgyas tsa shod du bab// dgra sa mda'i kha der tsang nge phog

/che ba rin chen srog dang des bral byas// de 'og 'dzum drug des shor byas// she a ba nags tshal bsnyags re ran// nged thang dkar rgod po'i bu rgyud 'di// chung ma la skyes nas da lta'i bar// gnas brag dkar min pa sdod ma myong*// gshog drug rgyas tsa shod na bab// dgra thag rnyi'i kha der tsang nge phog /che ba rin chen srog dang des bral byas// de 'og thel gshog des shol byas// she a ba brag dkar bsnyags re ran/ nged mi la ras pa'i bu rgyud 'di// chung ma la skyes nas da lta'i bar// gnas ri khrod min par sdod ma myong*// sgom nyams myong rgyas tsa shod du bab// dgra bdud mo'i kha dogs tsang nge phog /che ba rin chen srog dang des bral byas// de 'og ka dpe des shor byas// she a ba ri khrod bsnyags re ran// zhes gsungs nas byon song ngo*// der mo gru la bud nas btsal ba na lam du su byung la dris pas/ gcig na re/ rdzu 'phrul shugs kyi 'gro ba'i rnal 'byor pa cig 'dug pa sus kyang sleb sa med/ gtsang gi phyogs su rtas kyang mi sleb par thal zer bas/ der mo yid ches de log nas 'ong ba la/ rgyal pos mo la nag chod zer ba la/ blon po tshos nag bcad pas mer 'gro/ nang par nged rang gi sgor su snga ba zhig la byin byas pas/ da nang pha bzang gi bu cig e yong byas tsa/ las kyi dbang gis zhang gi mdze pho dga' le bya ba cig byu ba de la byin no// de thams cad lcam ldem bu'i skor ro/// /de nas ras chung pa lha cig la bros nas song ste bla ma'i drung du sleb pa la/ zhag bco lnga la mjal sa ma byung*/ nyin gcig tshogs dang gtor ma rgyu mang po khyer la shog gsungs nas/ ras pa rnams 'byon cing 'dug pa'i zla la ras chung pas yang mjal ba la/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gcig bzhengs nas ras chung pa la dbang bskur gnang ba yin gsungs/ de tsa na sngar sprang po la byin pa'i g.yu de maṇḍal cig gi steng du ngo shes lhag ge 'dug pas ras chung pa lus sbrid chil le song bas des rkyen byas te/

'khor ba la zhen pa nag log ge log nas thal bas de phyin chad nas skyid 'dod kyi 'dun pa zad de/ der bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyod ras chung pa nga yi 'khor dang po yin pas ji ltar byas kyang blos klod ma nus/ khyed 'gro 'dug mang bas yang sems spun du bcug /da res khyod la snying rje dum pa cig dang bla ma la dad pa cig dang gnyis snang bas rang la yang brtan pa byung*/ khyed kyang brtan pa byung*/ lar nga min na khyed kyi bla chen po 'tshong cher byas/ gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// pha mar pa'i byin rlabs nus pa che// mi la'i rdzu 'phrul gnad 'gag che// ras chung snying rje gtong phod che// g.yu sprang la byin pa mi las thob// do nub bde mchog dbang yon mdzod// snying rje ma nus pa la byas pa de// dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod dang 'dra// snying rjes sprang la byin pa de// mi la ras pa mchod pa yin// khams gsum sems can ma yin pas// de la sel 'byed byed pa rnams// mi shes btsan dug za ba 'dra/ mkhas btsun thugs mthun ma byas par// pho rgyus chags sdang byed pa rnams// bslab tshad chu la btab pa yin// chos la dkar nag med pa la// grub mtha'i kha 'dzin chos la smod// thar pa'i 'gyu thag bcad pa yin// rang bde thams cad gzhan las byung*// gzhan bde thams cad rang bde'i rgyu// gnod pa thams cad rang la sdig /de bas phan pa'i sems bskyed la// dkyil 'khor lha yi drung du byon// sdig pa ltung ba thams cad shogs// sdom pa dam bca' drag tu gyis// zhes gsungs pa de gong ras chung pa gnong bas kha 'bug ma phod/ bla mas de gsungs pa dang*/ bla ma dang mched grogs dkyil 'khor rnams kyi drung du bshags pa 'di phul lo// lus kyi skyid 'dod g.yeng ba'i las// snang ba brid mkhan phyir 'brang nas// g.yo sgyu'i ngan song las bsags pa// pha bla ma'i sku la mthol lo bshags// ngag gi bshad 'dod khram pa'i dpon// zhal lce pher pher dmyal ba'i rgyu// sha chang mang po yi dwags kyi gnas// khrel med brjod pa mi dag pas// pha bla ma'i gsung la mthol lo bshags// skyid 'dod bsam pa ngan pa'i rgyu// grags 'dod spyod pa mi gtsang gzhi// khe 'dod sdig pa'i las bsags pa// pha bla ma'i thugs la mthol lo bshags// yul ngan grong du 'khyams pa la// dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i sgrub mchod chags// 'dre brdung mang po'i phrin las kyi// zab mo sngags kyi nus pa shor// bya ba mang po'i bsam bzhag gis/

ting 'dzin zab mo'i sgom 'phro chag /dkyil 'khor lha yi drung du mthol lo bshags/ gnas mal mang po'i 'dug sa de// bdag dang gzhan las khyad par che// rang pham khur du ma nus pa'i// mched grogs spun la mthol lo bshags// zhes zhus pas bla ma mnyes te/ mkhas pa'i ltung ba lji lji 'dra yang yang zer ba la khyed lta bu la zer ba yin gsungs nas dbang bskur ras pa lnga bcu tsam la gnang nas do nub skyid pa yin gsungs/ der ras pa zhi ba 'od kyi mi yi rnal 'byor pho mo mang po lhan cig tu sdod cing 'dug /rang re dpon slob la bshags pas/ 'di tsam dgongs pa ci lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas chos la dus tshod mi shes na thams cad 'chal pa yin/ chos la dus tshod dgos gsungs nas zhal ta 'di mgur du gsungs so// drin chen mar pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ rang rgyud mal du phebs par byin gyis rlobs// slob ma'i rgud tshod zin par thugs rjes zungs// chos la dus tshod med na rnal 'byor 'chal pa yin// gtam zlos dus med na mi rgan 'chal pa yin// dgra dang 'phrad dus med na dpa' bo 'chal pa yin// rkyen dang 'phrad dus med na btsun po 'chal pa yin// sdug bsngal byung dus med na phan 'dogs 'chal pa yin// sgom la snying rus med na ri phug 'chal pa yin// gcig phan gcig la med na mched grogs 'chal pa yin// ci gsung tshad mar mi 'dzin dpon slob 'chal pa yin// lar 'chal lugs bshad na bsam mi khyab// ci gsung nyams su longs shig bu slob rnams// zhes gsungs pas bla ma lags/ rang re'i brgyud 'di la tshod shes pa cig dgos zin/ tshod med rnams la ni bu dang bu mo mang po 'dug zhus pas/ yang mgur 'di gsungs so// bu dang chung ma ngo srung gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor 'ching ba yin// rdzas dang yo byad khe grags gsum// 'di gsum rnal 'byor bar chad yin// gnyen dang yon bdag slob ma gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor shol 'debs yin// chang dang gnyid dang ngal dub gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor chom po yin// gtam dang lad mo gad mo gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor g.yeng ba yin// bla ma dang gdams ngag dad pa gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gzhi ma yin// dben gnas dang grogs mchog 'tsho ba gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor mkhar po yin// ma yengs mi rtogs bde ba gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gtan grogs yin/

lhug pa dang rang byung shugs 'byung gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gyi 'khyer lugs yin/ chags med sdang med rmongs med gsum// de gsum rnal 'byor gyi lam rtags yin// zhes gsungs pas ras chung pa yang mnyes/ gzhan ras pa rnams la phan pa'i dbyangs dang byin rlabs mdzad do// de thams cad mchod khang zhal mjal gyi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun dang ras chung pa dpon slob drug brag dkar rta so'i phug la byon nas nga 'dir sdod pa yin/ rnal 'byor pa rtsa rlung bsgom pa'i dus su ba spu re re'i rtsa ba na yang mkha' 'gro ma bsam gyis mi khyab par yod par mdo rgyud kun nas gsungs pas dro drongs shig gsungs pas/ dro drangs nas yang ras chung pas zhus pa/ lho brag pa'i drung nas rang re la sku snyan pa che ba'i thugs rtsis mdzad zin pas/ nged rang gi chos brgyud 'di la khrid dang tshogs pa skyong ba e yong*/ khong yang bla ma dang mjal snga bas bka' gnang 'dra e yod/ 'o na gzhan 'dra ma mchis sam zhus pas/ thugs chad pa cig byung nas ras chung pa la de skad ma zer/ lho brag mar pas nga yi snying khar phyag mdzub gtad nas nga yi brgyud pa 'di khyod la gtad pa yin gsungs/ gzhan slob ma bzang la mang ba yod de nga thugs brtse ba ma yin te/ brgyud pa 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel zhig shar ba red/ da nga yang brgyud pa 'dzin mkhan zhig zhag mang po mi 'gor bar yong bar yod gsungs so// de yi dus su skyid pa brgyad kyi mgur 'di gsungs so// rje yid bzhin nor bu sprul pa'i sku// 'khor los sgyur rgyal rin po che// dug gsum mun pa sel mdzad pa'i// phun sum tshogs pa'i lho brag pa// mun sel sgron me khyed la bstod// brag dkar rta so dbu ma'i rdzong*// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi 'du ba'i gnas// mi rgan spro ba skyes pa'i nyams// dga' spro gnas lugs glu zhig len// blo gros shes rab sgom sran can// 'dir bzhugs ras pa mched rnams nyon// gnas phyogs ris med pa'i ri khrod 'di// ting 'dzin skye ba'i lam mkhan yin// lam de dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam// rang lus dgon par shes pa'i mi re skyid// sems nyid mkha' ltar dag pa 'di e ma ho// 'gyur med dad pa brtan lo 'di// 'khor ba spangs pa'i lam mkhan yin// lam de dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam// 'khor 'das rang sar grol ba'i mi re skyid// so nam phugs su skyel ba 'di e ma ho// tshogs drug snang ba thug phrad de// rnam rtog gcod pa'i lam mkhan yin// lam de dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam// 'dod sred zhen pa med pa'i mi re skyid// rnam shes yul 'brel chod pa 'di e ma ho/

brgyud ldan bla ma dam pa 'di// ma rig sel ba'i lam mkhan yin// lam de dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam// bla ma sangs rgyas bsten pa'i mi re skyid// sems nyid chos skur rtogs pa 'di e ma ho// grang dro med pa'i ras gos 'di/ gangs khrod brten pa'i lam mkhan yin// lam de dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam// tsha grang 'jigs pa sel ba'i mi re skyid// gangs la gcer nyal byed pa 'di e ma ho// bsre 'pho mtshams sbyor gdams ngag 'di// bar do 'jigs pa'i lam mkhan yin/ lam de dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam// tshe 'di phyi bde ba'i mi re skyid// chos nyid dbyings su sleb pa 'di e ma ho// snyan brgyud thabs lam zab mo 'di/ sems lam du byed pa'i lam mkhan yin// lam de dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam// lus sems bde ba rgyas pa'i mi re skyid/ srog rtsol dbu mar tshud pa 'di e ma ho// stong nyid snying rje 'dres pa 'di// rtsod ldan spros pa gcod pa'i lam mkhan yin// lam de dang ldan pa'i mi yod dam// rtogs ldan 'khor gyis bskor ba'i mi re skyid// 'khor du sprul sku 'du ba 'di e ma ho// spyir mi rgan glu len mi mtshar yang*// nyams myong dbyangs chung skyid pa brgyad// dpal de ring len pa'i gnad cig mchi// khyed 'di na bzhugs pa'i grwa pa dang*// phyogs nas byon pa'i bu slob dang*// kho bos dmar khrid bskyangs pa rnams// don dmigs nas bsal lo ras chung pa// phyin chad e bden gtan la phob// dbyangs mchod par bzhes shig sku drin can// sgra tshogs su 'bul lo mkha' 'gro ma// rkyen bar chad sol cig chos skyong rnams// rje dngos grub can gyi bla ma dang*// lam sna khrid pa'i yi dam lha// byin gyis rlobs pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ bka' srung mdzad pa'i chos skyong rnams// mi bdag la thugs kyis ma bkyon par// mchog thun mong dngos grub pung bskyed cig

/ces gsungs nas zla ba phyed red pa dang*/ rje btsun gyi drung du dwags po lha rje sleb byung ngo*// de thams cad ni dwags po 'byon pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan gyi skor ro/// /de nas sgam po pa de nyid sku 'khrungs pa'i yul ni dbus/ sa yi ming ni gnyal gyi se ba lung*/ gdung rus ni gnyi ba/ skye ba ni shin tu mtho ste gnyi ba la g.yu gnyis/ rgya gnyi dang bod gnyi gsum yod pa las g.yu gnyi/ yab gnyi ba lha rje rgyal ba dang*/ yum ya ngal bza' gnyis la sras gnyis yod pa las/ gcen po'i mtshan ni gnyi ba kun dga' bya ba yin/ 'jig rten mi chos kyi yon tan thams cad tshang ba/ dang po sman shin tu mkhas pa lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la khyim byas te bu mo gcig dang gnyis yod pa la/ lo sum cu rtsa gsum lo na bu de shi/ de'i ro bskyal nas 'ong tsa/ bu mo yang shi nas 'dug de'i ro bskyal nas zhag 'ga' red tsa/ bud med kyang nad kyis theb/ der bud med de lha rje la chags nas nga ni 'chi/ de tsa khyed kyi bud med cig len ang zer zhing mchi ma phrum phrum byed/ der lha rjes ngas bud med mi len/ chos la 'gro ba yin byas pas de na bud med ma len cig zer nas shi'o// der 'khor ba la skyo ba skyes te chos gsha' ma cig bya snyam nas/ dang por dge bshes sha ba gling la rab tu byung*/ mtshan yang dge slong bsod nams rin chen du btags/ bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa gnyis la gsan pa mang du mdzad/ dge bshes mang yul blo ldan la pha rgyud ma rgyud la sogs pa'i gsang sngags mang du gsan/ dbang dang byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa dang*/ snyan brgyud mang po dang*/ sgrub brgyud kyi bshad pa mang po mnga' ba rnams mkhyen par mdzad/ chos thams cad kyi nang na nyams su len pa kho na gtso che bar bshad nas 'dug pas/ dbu ru byang phyogs bka' gdams pa byon/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen snyug rum pa dang*/ rgya lcags ri gong ka ba dang*/

dge bshes bya yul pa gsum bsten nas/ jo bo'i gdams pa ma lus pa mkhyen par mdzad/ da ni sgrub pa cig bya dgos dgongs nas rang gi pha mes kyi brtsegs pa'i ser ka bya ba'i gtsug lag cig yod pa der/ brang khang bde mo zhig brtsegs pha zhing la yon bdag byas nas zhag bcu gsum la mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po yang byung*/ chags sdang rab 'bring rnams zhi nas gnyid thun chung re las mi 'byung zhing*/ rmi lam du yang mdo sde gser 'od dam pa dang*/ mdo sde sa bcu pa nas bshad pa'i sa bcu thob pa'i ltas kyi rmi lam de tsho kho na rmis/ nga la 'di tsho rmis ma thag pa sems rmis yin nam/ 'dre yi cho 'phrul yin nam snyam pa byung gsungs/ lus la shig dang srin bu yang ye nas med/ zhag lnga lnga tsam du ye ma gsol yang ltogs pa'i snang ba ye med de/ lus bde nyams dang ldan pa byung gsungs/ rje btsun gyi snyan pa rgyang nas 'khrungs pa'i tshul ni nam zla dpyid gcig gi dus su mtshams thon pa dang*/ lcags ri'i lho phyogs su skyo bsang la byon tsa/ sprang po gsum shig sreg cing gtam mang po byed cing 'dug /kho bo'i sems rgyud ting nge 'dzin song*/ phyag gis yi dwags la chu sbyin mdzad cing yod sprang po cig na re/ 'o skol gsum 'dra ba'i bsod nams chung ba 'ong ba rtsol ba mi dgos par zan chen po re dang*/ lo tshod phor ba gsum re btung rgyu yod na ci lto zer/ gcig na re/ yid smon byed na de 'dra la ma byed mnga' bdag rtse lde 'dra ba re yin na dga' mod zer/ gcig na re/ mnga' bdag rtse lde la 'chi ba yod skyid med/ mi la ras pa 'dra ba'i grub thob lus la gos mi dgos pa/ bza' med na mkha' 'gro mas bdud rtsi 'dren pa/ seng ge la zhon nas nam mkha' la 'gro ba skye shi'i 'jigs pa med pa de 'dra ba yin na dga' mod zer zhing 'dug pa de/ bla ma rin po ches gsan pas/ lus kyi ba spu gzing ste song*/

mig la mchi ma 'khrugs pa byung*/ sngar gyi de ma yin pa'i dad pas kun nas bslangs pa'i bsam pa'i sems shig skyes nas 'dug pa/ bla ma na re/ rab cig 'gro yang ma shes/ der brang khang na dge sbyong gtso bo yan lag bdun pa yin byas tsa/ 'phro stor zhing stor zhing song*/ da ci byung ba yin snyam nas mal du bsdad nas bsgom tsa na// khang pa la sogs pa phyi rol gyi yul rnams ye nas med par song nas stong phyam gyi song*/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yid kyi yul du byung ba'am/ sems can thams cad kyis sems shes pa snyam byed pa cig byung*/ khams dang dbang po'i bye brag rnams kyang shes snyam byed/ der dgong thun thon pa dang*/ sprang po de rnams gang na snang bltas pas mgron khang gcig tu nyal nas 'dug /gcig la khyed kyi gleng ba'i grub thob de gang na bzhugs byas pas/ de na re/ mang yul gung thang na yod/ mi la ras pa bya ba yin zer/ de'i bla ma gong ma rnams ci skad bya ba yin gsungs pas/ de'i bla ma mar pa lo tsā bya ba yin zer/ de'i bla ma nā ro paṇa chen bya ba yin zer/ chos ci gsung byas pas/ chos de nā ro'i chos drug bya ba kyai rdor gyi gdams ngag yin zer nged kyi zhal ma mthong mi mang po de'i drung du 'gro zhing 'dug /bla ma de la yon tan ci lta bu yod gsungs pas/ mi phal gyis mi rnyed/ rnyed kyang la las mchod rten dkar po cig tu mthong*/ la las shākya thub par mthong*/ sprul pa sna tshogs ston nus par 'dug zer/ gzhi ga na bzhugs par 'dug byas/ brin dang snye nam gnyis kyi ri khang na bzhugs zer/ nga der 'gro 'dod pas khyed kyis grogs i byed byas pas de nyan te/ khyed gzhon nu cig 'dug pas nged khyed kyi rjes mi sleb/ khyed rang song dang la stod rang nas shes te 'ong*/ khong grags pa che ba yin/ der nang du byon nas zan chen po byas/ lo tshod mang po bskol nas de gsum la byin/

der de nub dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa bshams nas phul/ gsol ba btab nas nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ rag dung ring po cig 'dug pa bus pas skad 'dzam bu'i gling du thos pa rmis/ de yang dbus gtsang gnyis na 'di bas skad che ba'i rag dung med byas pa rmis/ yang nam mkha' rten med pa la rnga bo che gcig btags nas brdung bas/ skad yang dag pa byung*/ ri dwags mang pos nyan cing 'dug /mi dpag tu med pa yang 'dug /mon mo 'dra ba'i bud med cig na re/ mi 'di tsho la rnga 'di rdung*/ ri dwags 'di tsho la 'di byin cig zer nas/ 'o ma thod phor gang byin pa rmis/ 'dis ri dwags 'di tsho mi khyed byas pas/ khyod rang 'thung dang ri dwags 'di rnams las 'gro ba rigs drug la sems can yang khyed nas 'ong zer te/ nga ni nyi ma nub phyogs su 'gro ba yin zer nas song ba rmis/ da lta snod dang mi ldan pa rnams rim gyis skye ste rnga la nyan pa'i mi de tsho yin par 'dug bka' gdams kyi bla ma de tsho drin re che gsungs/ ri dwags de tsho ni nga yi ri khrod 'grim pa 'di rnams yin par 'dug /bla ma mi la'i gdams ngag thabs lam dang*/ phyag rgya chen po kho na sbyangs pa las byung ste/ sngon gyi rmi lam gyi ltas de kar song gsungs/ der zhing bzang po cig yod pa gser srang do/ ja sil po zho gang rnams btsong nas/ dge bshes lcang ri ba dang bya yul ba gnyis kyi spyan sngar phyin phyag la byon par/ khyed rnal 'byor pa khyi thul can gyi rtsar ma 'gro/ spus kyi 'gro na nged kyi rtags ma dor bar shog /ser ka la phan na khyi tshil 'tshol na yang tshol/ zangs ngas brdungs nas zangs skad mi 'dis 'don pa cig 'ong bar 'dug ste thabs med gsungs/ snyug rum pa'i zhal nas khyed kyis nga rgas khar ma 'bor de nas bod 'gros pa'i zla ba phyed gnyis kyi lam bcad nas byon te/ nyi ma phyed kyis sleb pa'i sar mgo yam bya ba'i nad drag po cig byung nas nyin zhag bdun lus pa la/

rje btsun bzhugs pa'i gangs la dbu gtad nas gsol ba btab pas bsnyun de las de ma thag grol bar gyur te/ de nas sang ste bkra shis sgang du byon nas bud med cig thags 'thag cing 'dug pa la/ rje btsun mi la ras pa bdag gzhan rgyud kyi bsam pa mkhyen cing sprul pa sna tshogs ston nus pa cig bzhugs zer ba de gang na bzhugs gsungs pas/ de'i rgyus yod pa'i nya mo cig yod pa ston zer nas/ bud med rgan mo ras kyi steng na rgya lhod bcings pa cig 'dug pa 'di la dris zer/ de la dris pas rgan mo de na re/ do nub sleb sa med/ nga yi khang pa'i steng bzhugs zer nas steng khang du gdan drangs nas/ khar sang nga rje btsun chen po'i drung du phyin pa la/ bla mas dbus nas bka' gdams pa'i ston pa cig nga la 'phrad du 'ong ba de dang nga gnyis mjal sna sus byas pa de la ngan song gsum gyi 'jigs pa las skyobs gsungs pas/ nga yi bu mo sgom ma gcig rje btsun gyi drung du yod pas mo la mjal sna 'tshol ba yin zer/ phyi de nang par bla ma'i spyan sngar byon pa la/ rin po che'i dgongs pa la nga yong ba mkhyen lugs des nga snod ldan zhig yin par 'dug /gdams ngag dka' tshegs mi 'ong snyam pa'i nga rgyal cig skyes pa de mkhyen nas/ zla ba phyed du mjal ba ma byung*/ se ban ras pas phru ba gcig dang shing phun cig byin nas gad 'og gcig tu bskyal te/ dbus pa ston pa khyed 'ong pa bla mas mkhyen 'dug /gdams ngag kyang gnang bar 'dug gi ngang ma thung bar bzhugs zer/ de nas zla ba phyed song tsa bkra shis sgang du bla ma dang mjal na shog zer bas byon song tsa/ bla ma rje btsun rdo leb chen po cig gi steng du bzhugs te 'khor rnams kyis mtha' bskor nas 'dug /der gser g.yu dang ja sil po zho gang phul/ phyag byas tsa/ bla mas gser dang nga mi mthun/ ja bkol ba'i thab cha med/ khyod rang sgrub pa byed pa'i brgyags gyis/

khyed kyi ming ci yin gsungs/ bsod nams rin chen bya ba lags zhus pas/ bsod nams bsod nams bsod nams bya ba lan gsum gsungs pas/ bsod nams tshogs chen bsags las 'khrungs/ 'gro ba kun gyi rin po che/ bya ba lan gsum gsungs nas chang thod phor gang gsol 'phro 'dug pa de blangs te gnang nas 'di 'thung gsungs pas rten dge slong yin pa dang 'khor mang bas len ma nus pas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rnam rtog ma mang 'di 'thung gsungs pas/ bla mas mkhyen nam snyam nas lhag ma tsam yang ma lus par gsol bas/ brgyud pa zin cing gdams ngag ma lus pa'i snod du rung bar mkhyen no// de nas se ban dang ras chung pa gnyis 'dir shog dang*/ 'o skol pha spad kyis ston pa la mgur cig bya'o gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shar seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma de// bcud dang ldan par cha mchis kyang*// lha dbang brgya byin khong gis gsol nas song*// lho rgya stag khra bo'i dpa' rtsal de// yang rtsal che ba cha mchis kyang*// ḍom bi he ru ka yis bcibs nas song*// byang ltang dkar nya mo'i mkhris pa de// ro kha'o snyam par cha mchis kyang*// klu gtsug na rin chen gyis gsol nas song*// steng dga' ldan lha yi pho brang de// gzigs mo che bar cha mchis kyang*// 'phags pa thogs med khong gis gzigs nas song*/ nā ro snyan brgyud zab mo 'di// lam thag nye bar cha mchis kyang*// rje mar pa lo tsā gshegs nas blangs// mar pa'i snyan brgyud zab mo 'di// nyams rtogs che bar cha mchis kyang*// rnal 'byor mi la nga yis rtogs nas yongs// nga mi la'i nyams myong tshig gsum po// don gnad du zab par cha mchis kyang*// bu ston pa khyod byung 'chad pa yin// gser dang mi rgan lo mi mthun// ja bzang po bskol ba'i thab cha med// ngas zas nor spangs nas ring zhig 'das// bu snying nas dam chos bya snyam nas// tshe 'di la ma dga' phyi ma som// bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa 'dzin 'dod na// tshig la ma dga' don la ltos/

khyod dge slong gi thugs la de ltar zhog /de ston pa khyed kyi sna len mdzod// ces gsungs nas gser dang ja ma bzhes nas/ ja zho gang po de se ban ras pas khyer nas song ba la/ rje btsun gyis khyod kyis de ci byed gsungs/ se ban gyis 'di yang btsun pa cig 'dug /'o skol la yang mis phul/ rdo yi steng du zhib par brdungs nas bskol te 'dren pa yin zhus pas/ phyis rin po che yis gsungs nas se ban ras pa de pho rgod po gsal po rang cig 'dug gsungs/ de nas pha wong 'og der 'khan pa dang zwa shing dang ri sho khog mo bsdus te phyed skyil zhig byas te khrid zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod la dbang bskur gyi bka' yod dam gsungs/ dge bshes mang yul blo ldan shes rab la gsang 'dus dbang bskur rdzogs par zhus/ bde dgyes gnyis/ bdag med ma'i byin rlabs gsum/ bde mchog lū yi pa'i bka'/ phag mo rin chen rgyan drug ma'i byin rlabs dang*/ gzhan yang bla ma mang po la dbang bskur mang po thob lags/ nga la zhag bcu gsum tsam la mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po yod zhus pas/ ha ha gsungs nas gad mo chen po zhig mdzad nas legs po 'dug ste/ legs par bskyang kyang 'bras bu gzugs med lha/ gsungs nas bye ma btsir ba la mar mi 'ong nyung dkar btsir na mar khu 'ong ba yin/ de 'dra ba la dgos pa med/ nga yi gtum mo'i srog rtsol bsgom dang*/ sang da gzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas 'ong gi gsungs/ lar bod kyi snying la 'dre zhugs nas/ a ti sha la sngags bshad ma bcug pa/ mi mang po phung du bcug gsungs/ bka' gdams pa la yang gsang sngags kyi gdams ngag mang po yod zhus pas/ de tsho gsang sngags yin te man ngag min/ sgrub thabs rkyang pa re re rdzogs rim snod bcud bsdus pa re re bshad nas 'dug /rtog dpyod kyi ting nge 'dzin bya ba yin/ lam rim gyi bdag med sgom pa don spyi rkyang pa yin/

kha rog par thabs lam sgom gsungs/ dus phyis dwags po'i zhal nas/ bla ma rje btsun gyis sngon la shes bya'i sgrib pa sbyangs pas nyon mongs pa rang dag la 'gro gsungs/ bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams kyis ni nyon mongs pa ma spangs par sangs mi rgyas gsungs te/ de gsungs pa gnyis ka med par 'dug gsungs/ de nas rje btsun bal yul du 'gro gsungs te/ nye gnas la ras chung pa/ khyi ras pa/ sgom stag /jo dar/ se ban/ ston pa/ kong rgur/ mes sgom dang bdun 'dug pa bal yul du phyin pas tshad pa 'ong zer zhing sems srel chen po byed cing 'dug /rin po che'i thugs dgongs la/ nga dag kun tshad pas shi na'ang 'gro ba yin dgongs tsa/ brin pas bla ma 'byon pa thos nas phyar ba chen po cig bting ste/ phyag rten gser zho gsum/ mar 'bras mang yar spungs nas phul bas ma bzhes te/ de rnams rang rang bgos nas gnang ngo*// de'i nang par brag gcig gi rtsa bar bzhud pas/ bud med gos nag po gyon pa/ ngam nag pa/ mig rtsa dmar pa cig gis bla ma'i zhal la 'bur tshugs su bltas te gar 'gro gtong mkhan su yin zer/ de'i nub mo nas bla ma thugs 'gyur nas ma byon no// bud med de mkha' 'gro mar 'dug bya ba yang gsungs so// de nas sman lung chu bar du bzhugs nas chos zhus pas/ bla ma rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ sngar gyi dbang bskur gyi go mi chod pa min te/ rten 'brel yin pas nga rang gi lugs kyi byin rlabs chung ngu zhig mdzad dgongs nas/ sindhu ra'i maṇḍal la brten nas snyan brgyud kyi byin rlabs mdzad do// de nub bla ma rje btsun gyi spyan sngar nyal gsung gleng kho thag chod pa cig bya dgos dgongs nas brag nang du byon no// bla ma rje btsun rin po che lags/ tshogs bsags pa'i stobs gang che lags/ bdag gis dge bshes rgya la zhus pas/ rgya yi zhal nas/ pu to pas ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas mchod pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i khung mchod mchog

/ces gsungs pas/ de de ka ltar yin/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ gdan bzhi pa nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun mchod pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i khung bu mchod pas mchog /ces gsungs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa rin po che'i phung po ri rab tsam spungs nas phul ba bas bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod pa bsod nams che gsungs/ de bas zab pa'i tshogs bsags thabs yod dam zhus pas/ gcig yod gsungs/ de bdag la zhu zhus pas/ bla mas bstan pa'i gdams ngag de chud ma zos par nyams su blangs na de kas dga' gsungs/ bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen snyug rum pa la tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa srid dam zhus pas/ tshe 'di la ltos pa spud tsam cig kyang med dgos pa yin gsungs/ dge bshes gnyen yar lung pa la zhus pas/ gsung de nges pa can yin/ dgongs pa can yin gsungs/ sman ril bu bsgrub pa/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa/ skye ba bdun pa yin/ yi dam lha yi zhal mthong ba/ mkha' spyod du 'gro nus pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ de ltar du lags sam zhus pas gsung de dgongs pa can yin/ nges pa can yin/ tshe 'di ka la ltos pa med pa dgos/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa cig la slob ma snod dang ldan pa cig gis gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang rdzogs pa zhig zhu nas bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi gdams ngag bar ma chad pa bsgom pas rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas/ 'bring 'chi kha'i bar dor 'grub/ shin tu le lo can yang skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad du 'grub/ de la ma grub na dam tshig la sel zhugs pa yin pas re zhig ngan song du skye dogs yod/ lar lha rje kha la skur ba'i mi dang blo ma bstun/ de'i ngag la ma nyan/ rjes su ma 'brang*/ sgom pa nyams su len pa'i mi dang blo bstun/ de'i ngag la nyon/ rjes su 'brang dgos pa yin/ blo phug tshe 'di blos btang ba'i skyes bu rnams la gtad dgos/ tshe 'dis mig brid pa'i gang zag kha cig gis chos brgyad slob tu 'ong ba yin/

lar stong nyid la shor sa mang ba yin/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba dang*/ shes bya'i gshis la shor ba dang*/ stong nyid gnyan por shor ba dang*/ chags par shor ba dang bzhi yin/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor bya ba na/ 'di ltar gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i blo yul du gyur pa'i chos thams cad stong par bsgom pa yin zer ba yod/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor bya ba ni/ 'di ltar 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad stong pa yin zer ba yod/ stong nyid gnyen por shor bya ba/ nyon mongs pa rnam par rtog pa gang skyes pa la bltas pas de ka stong pa yin mod zer ba yod/ stong nyid chags par shor bya ba/ nga la bsgom rgyu med/ ci bsgom thams cad stong pa yin zer ba yod/ de rnams lam yang dag pa ma yin/ 'on kyang blo yi bden zhen ldog pa la phan rgyu tsam yin/ sems kyi gzhi rtsa ma chod na bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum gyi nyams myong yod kyang srid pa gsum las ma 'das so// rtsa ba ma chod pa'i nyams bya ba yin/ 'o na lam yang dag pa gang yin na/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gcig gis slob ma snod dang ldan pa cig la ngo sprad de khrid pas/ gnyug ma'i sems la khyab par gnas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la chos sku'i snang bar gsal/ rnal 'byor pas thabs dpag tu med pas mtshon nas bsgoms pas/ lta ba shugs la rtogs/ nyon mongs pa ngang gi 'gags/ rnam rtog rang shugs kyi chod ye shes shugs la 'char/ de'i dus su nyams su myong ba'i rtogs pa dang de ngag tu smra mi btub/ brjod kyang zur las mtshon par mi nus/ dper na gzhon nu ma'i bde ba'i lkugs pa'i rmi lam bzhin de ni sems can kun la yod kyang ngo ma shes/ des na brgyud ldan gyi bla ma bsten pa gal che/ de yang gnyug ma'i shes pa de phug gar yang ma gtad/ sgo gar yang ma 'gags/ dpe gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus/ brjod pa gang gi yang thog tu mi pheb/ tha snyad gang gis kyang mtshon par mi nus te de na bcas bcos mi bya/

rang kha ma bcos pa'i ngang du lhod de klod la zhog gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// lta ba yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la ltos// rang gi sems las lta ba gzhan du btsal ba na// gyad kyi bor tshol 'dra'o ang nge ston pa ba// sgom pa yin par nges kyi bying rgod skyon ma gsal// sgom pa bying rgod la sogs rkyen bsal na// nyin par mar me 'degs pa 'dra'o ang nge ston pa ba// spyod pa yin par nges kyi blang dor res ma byed/ spyod pa blang dor la sogs res byas na// sbrang ma rgyar tshud pa 'dra'o ang nge ston pa ba// 'bras bu yin par nges kyi sems la nges shes bskyed// thob med 'bras bu gzhan nas thob 'dod btsal ba na// sbal bu gnam mchong 'dra'o ang nge ston pa ba// bla ma yin par nges kyi rang gi sems la dris// de las gzhan pa'i bla ma logs su btsal ba na// de yi rang sems spangs pa 'dra'o ang nge ston pa ba/ des na 'khor 'das snang ba sems su 'dus/ de ltar gda'o ang nge lha rje ston pa ba// zhes gsungs so// de je 'jigs je 'jigs la song nas sku yi gzi brjid ma bzod pas/ bzhugs gdan phyir khyer nas ma zad gcig tu byon nas gzims so// de'i dus su nub gcig thugs dgongs btang ba la brin dang snye nam gyi mtshams su yun ring sdod la gdams ngag rtsad chod pa cig byas te/ sgrub pa mthar thon pa cig byed dgos dgongs pa la/ nga yi brgyags 'di nyung nas 'dug pas yul 'di'i mi che ba cig na na de bcos nas yon drag pa cig blangs la/ 'tsho bas 'tsher ba med pa cig bya dgos dgongs nas/ de'i nang par se ban ston pa 'bod du byung ste/ dbus pa ston pa khyod la/ rje btsun gyi spyan sngar byon shog gsungs zer ba dang*/ rje btsun gyis spyan sngar byon nas phyag 'tshal ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas/ dbus pa ston pa khyod kyi chos gsha' ma zhig byed bsam na yon tan 'tshong ba dang*/

dge sbyor byed pa gnyis rgyab bsnol yin pas/ ston brin dang snye nam pa gnyis la bsod snyoms gyis la/ nub mo grong gseb tu ma sdod pa/ spro bde phug tu dge sbyor la snyegs gsungs pas/ der rje btsun mad snyam nas bsod snyoms mdzad/ gtum mo'i khrid zhus nas bsgom pas/ nub dang po la lung pa'i mda' na gcer bur bsgoms pas bde drod rang 'bar du song*/ nam langs pa nas gnyid sad tsa lus rdo ltar song nas 'dug /de nas zhag bdun bsgoms pas bde drod rang 'bar du song nas/ zhag bdun gyi nang par rgyal ba rigs lnga zhal mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ mig btsir nas bltas pas zla ba gnyis su mthong ba dang*/ 'byung ba lnga yi rlung zin pa yin/ skyon yon gang yang min gsungs/ yon tan min gsungs yang brod pa bskyed nas bsgoms pas zla ba gsum song ba'i tho rangs kha zhig la/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di 'khor lo bskor ba ltar 'khor zhing 'dug pas stong skyugs byas nas 'gyel/ yun ring zhig brgyal nas 'dug /bla ma la zhus pas/ ro rkyar gnyis kyi rlung dhu tir tshud pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ yang nyi ma snga dro cig la mdun gyi nam mkha' la thugs rje chen po them 'gag nem 'gag tu bzhugs 'dug pa la/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re rnams kyi dbu thog tu yod pa cig mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i thig le 'phel ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min sgoms shig gsungs/ yang dgong mo nas srod kyi bar la dmyal ba thig nag mthong bas des rkyen byas nas snying khar 'tshang ba bzhin song nas snying rlung drag po cig byung*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ sgom thag thung bas rtsa bcing ba yin/ sgom thag cung ring ba gyis/ gyen du rgyu ba'i rlung zin pa yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ yang nyin gcig 'dod lha rigs drug gi lha rnams gsal bar mthong bas/

gong ma gong mas 'og ma 'og ma la bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs shing 'dug /lha rnams ngom zhing tshim par 'dug pa la bdag gi ma skom grir 'chi zhing 'dug pa cig mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas bdud rtsi bab pa de mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo ro rkyang gnyis kyi thig le 'phel ba yin/ a ma skom pa de dhu ti'i mar sna kha ma bye ba yin pas lus kyi 'khrul 'khor 'di rnams gyis gsungs nas/ 'khrul 'khor bca' thabs 'di gnang nas zla ba gcig bsgom tsa na/ lus 'phar/ 'dar sprugs rgod 'dod pa rgyun chad med pa 'byung*/ rang dbang med par kus 'debs 'dod pa byung bas 'dre yin nam snyam nas/ bla ma la zhus pas/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lor thig les gang ba yin 'khrul 'khor 'phro ma bcad par 'bung la sgoms/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ de nas kha zas cher mi dgos par byung*/ yang nyin gcig tsa na/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la nyi zla chen po gnyis gzas zin nas 'dug /gza' de rta rnga phra mo tsam gnyis 'dug /bla ma la zhus pas/ dhu tir ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung zhugs pa yin te skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ pho rgod rab tu 'dug /da ni da ni bya ba lan gsum gsungs/ de nas drag tu bsgoms pas/ zla ba gcig nas kyai rdo rje dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gcig zhal mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ yi dam gyi zhal mthong ba yin nam snyam nas zhus pas/ lte bar ma las thob pa'i rakta 'phel ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min shugs phyung la sgom gsungs/ de nas 'bad de bsgoms pas nyin gcig tsa na/ bde mchog lū yi pa'i keng rus kyi dkyil 'khor cig mthong bla ma la zhus pas/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo thig les gang ba yin/ skyon dang yon tan gang yang min gsungs/ de nas 'bad de bsgoms pas zhag bcu bzhi lon tsa na/ mtshan thog gcig la bdag gi lus 'di nam mkha'i khams tsam du red nas 'dug /spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad la 'gro ba rigs drug gi sems can 'dus pa la/

phal cher 'o ma 'ba' zhig 'thung zhing 'dug /'ga' zhig gis seṅge bzhos pa'i 'o ma yin zer ba 'ba' zhig 'thung zhing 'dug /'ur deng gi sgra lta bu zhig gang nas 'ong cha med par dus rgyun du 'ong zhing 'dug /nam langs nas sgom thag bkrol ba dang med nas thal/ bla ma la zhus pas/ lus kyi rtsa stong phrag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang du las kyi rlung gi thig le khrid pa yin te/ rlung de ye shes kyi rlung de bsgyur 'tshal bar gda' gsungs nas/ mchog gi gtum mo gnang nas bsgom pas/ gung thang gi lung pa thams cad dud pas gang nas 'dug /phyi dro tsa na mun nag tu red nas 'dug /der lam ma rnyed nas long ba 'gro 'gro byas nas bla ma'i spyan sngar phyin pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ci yang mi lto der sdod la sgoms dang gsungs nas steng kyi gegs sel de gnang nas bsgoms pas nam langs pa bzhin du song*/ yang nub gcig rang gi lus 'di keng rus sha med par rtsa mang po'i mgo sbrel nas 'dug pa mthong*/ bla ma la zhus pas/ rlung rtsub thal ba yin/ 'jam par gyis gsungs/ de nas nam srod la yi dam gyi lha bsgom zhing bzlas pa byas/ dgong la bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom zhing gsol ba 'ba' zhig btab/ tho rangs srog rtsol rlung bsgom/ nang par skya rengs shar tsam na gnyid thun phran tsam zhig thal ba la/ snga 'dres kyi bag chags ye med pa la/ rmi lam du rmis ltas nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba la/ der mnal sad pa dang 'di rnams dge'am mi dge snyam du rtog pa cung zhig skyes pa la/ yang dgongs pa btang bas/ bla ma rje btsun sangs rgyas mngon sum ci yang mkhyen pa la btugs te dri chog snyam na/ tsha ba ma bskol bar de ka la bzhengs nas song*/ rje btsun brag rtsa zhig tu dbu gtum nas gzims nas bzhugs gda' ba la phyag byas maṇḍal phul nas/ rje btsun lags/ kho bo la do gal che ba cig mchis pas/ mi gzims par bzhengs par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/

khyod la rnam rtog skyes 'dug pa de da nang nga yi nyams la byung*/ de bas ma bde ba'i ngo gal che ba ci yod zhus dang gsungs pas/ tho rangs rmi lam du byung ba'i mtshan ltas de rnams dge'am mi dge zhu don glu ru phul ba/ rje brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ ngo mtshar ras kyi na bza' can// yid bzhin nor bu gtsug gi rgyan// kun gyis thod bzhin bkur ba'i gnas// mtshan mi la zhes byar yongs su grags// mtshan de yi snyan pas phyogs rnams khyab// de thos kho bo spro ba skyes// shar skar ma smin drug 'og nas bsnyags// lus tsha grang yid la ma byas te// rtag tu ngu yi rnam thar bzhin// rje ras pa de dang nam mjal snyam// lam ring dka' ba sna tshogs spyad// gdung phyed dang gnyis kyi sleb pa ru// lus srog yal bar des shor byas// 'on kyang mos gus drag po'i mthus// shar phyogs spos ldan grong khyer du/ chos 'phags mngon du zhal mthong ltar// bkra shis sgang gi gdan sa ru// pha rje btsun ras pa khyed dang mjal// kho bo'i bsam pa mthar phyin snyam// shin tu spro dga' ba spu g.yos// nor sgyu ma'i 'bul rgyu ma mchis kyang*// gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la zhen pa log /lam skye shi gnyis la 'jigs shing skrag /'jig rten bya ba blo yis btangs// sgrub blo gting nas skyes pa des// pha khyed kyi thugs rje'i lcags kyus zung*// da mi brjed kho bo'i sems la bzhag /da zhu don mchi'o gu ru rje// mdang srod la yi dam bsgom bzlas byas// nam gung rje la gsol ba btab// de rjes srog rtsol rlung la 'bad// dgung da nang skya rengs tha ma la// gnyid thun phran tsam zhig thal ba la// sngar 'dris bag chags ma mchis te// ya mtshan rmi lam 'di rnams byung*// dbyar zha dar gyi cha ga can/ mtshal dmar 'ob kyi bad kyis brgyan// de la rgod kyi spu ru btsugs// kho bo'i mgo la gyon pa rmis// sum lham sngo bzhi 'gying bag can// ra gan 'bur mgo cha le btags// sgrogs dngul gyi a lo ta le mdzes// lham de 'dra zung cig gyon pa rmis// gu ling dar gyi ral ga la// gong skor gser thag a long ris// mtshal gyi thig phran 'dzum ris can// gos 'dra lus la gyon pa rmis// mon mo ras yug ska rags la// me tog tshon tshogs dkar pos brgyan// mu tig har gyi chun 'phyang can// de 'khor gsum sked la bcings pa rmis// chu rlon re dkar phying pa la// bzo dras su ma byas nya rnga ma// gong mchan dngul gyi pho lang btags// de yang phyi steng du gyon pa rmis// a smra tsandan dbyug pa la/

rin chen sna bdun phra bkod de// changs zung gser gyi dra ba can// de lag pa g.yas su thogs pa rmis/ mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā la// gser mdog bdud rtsi bcud kyis bkang*// kho bos kha phor bya snyam nas// de lag pa g.yon du khyer ba rmis// sum gal khra bo dor gcig gis// nang du 'bras dkar sa lu blugs// kho bos chos brgyags bya snyam nas// de phrag pa g.yas su bkal ba rmis// ri dwags khri snyan pags pa la// mgo dang sder bzhi ma nyams pa// 'di kho bos gdan du bya snyam nas// 'phrag pa g.yon du bkal ba rmis// de rjes g.yas su phar bltas pas// gser gyi spang po ngos bzang la// be'u lug sna lnga gzas la bkram// kho bos phyugs rdzi bya snyam rmis// de rjes g.yon du phar bltas pas// g.yu yi nel thang sil ma la// me tog snam bu'i tshogs tshogs bkra// bud med mang pos phyag byas rmis// dbus me tog ser po'i gling khams nas// shin tu 'dab rgyas gser mdog can// padma spungs pa'i khri steng du// sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas pa rmis// mdun du chu mig rdol ba rmis/ rgyab tu 'od cig 'khyil ba rmis// lus la me dpung 'bar ba rmis// snying la nyi zla shar ba rmis// ya mtshan rmi lam de rnams byung*// ltas dge'am mi dge 'chad ma shes// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'di don ma 'chal gsung bar zhu// zhes rmi lam de rnams snyan du gsol ba la/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bu lha rje ston pa thugs mi bde mi 'tshal/ shes pa lhod kyis klod la zhog mdzod/ rnam rtog gi dra bar bdag 'dzin gyi nang tshang ma gzhug /the tshom gyi mdud pa rang grol la thong*/ gnyis 'dzin gyi thag pa phra sa ru chod/ bag chags kyi sdug stan srab sa ru rdol/ sems 'du 'phro ma mang ma bcos pa'i ngang la zhog /nga sgyu lus 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas rmi lam 'chad kyang shes/ rmi lam bsgyur yang shes/

rmi lam gyi de kho na nyid rgyas 'debs pa'i gdams ngag yod de/ nga rmi lam gyi chos nyid khong du chud pa yin pas/ bu khyed kyi rmi lam rmis pa'i mtshan ltas de rnams dus da res pha rgan nga yis zhib tu go nges su bshad la/ brda don ngo sprod kyi ma yengs pa gson cig gsungs nas dris len mgur du bzhengs pa/ glu dris len 'tshal lo lha rje ba// snyan lhan ne gson la thugs gtad 'tshal// zangs dkar lugs kyi bde mchog gsan// dbu ru stod kyi bka' gdams bskyangs/ gnas pa zab mo'i chu rgyun mnga'// de kun ngo mtshar che snyam pas// rmi lam bag chags nying 'khrul la// ltas ched du bzung ste yid gtad pa/ bu gsan rgya chung ngam rdzu bag la// mdo rgyud bstan bcos ma gzigs sam// nges don pha rol phyin pa nas// rmi lam yang dag ma yin te// gsog dang gsob dang ya ma brla// snying po med ces thub pas gsungs// de bzhin sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad la// gong dang 'dra ste rgyas par gsungs// de don thugs su ma mkhyen nam// 'on kyang da res mtshan ltas de// ma 'ongs lung bstan ngo mtshar che// nga rmi lam 'byongs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sgyu ma ngo sprod 'chad kyang shes// mgo la zhwa dkar gyon pa de// theg pa yas nas 'bub pa'i brda// rgya mo dar chags btab pa de// chos nyid zab cing phra bar ston// spu sdug 'ob kyi kha dog ltar// grub mtha' ma 'dres so sor gsal// rgod kyi bya phod ldem pa de/ lta ba'i yang rtse phyag rgya che// skye med ngo bo mthong ba'i brda// ra gan 'bur mgo btab pa de// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i brda ru bstan// sgrogs dngul gyi a long gsal ba de// spyod pa'i gol sa yin pa'i phyir/ rtogs med rang khar mi spyod cing*// rgyal sras gzhon nu'i tshul bzhin du// bag yod mdzes par spyod pa'i brda// dar dkar ral ga gyon pa de// rang rgyud skyon gyis ma gos brda/

gong skor gser thag btso ma de// mi 'gyur bsam pa bzang ba'i brda// mtshal gyi thig phran 'dzum skor can// brtse bas 'gro don byed pa'i brda// mon mo ras yug ska rags kyis// 'khor gsum rked la bcings pa de// rgyud sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i brda// me tog dkar po'i rgyan mdzes shing*// mu tig chun 'phyangs spras pa yang*// bslab pa gsum gyis rab brgyan cing*// gdul bya dang ba 'dren pa'i brda// dngul gyi a long btags pa de// de don 'gyur ba med pa'i brda// a mra tsandan dbyug pa de// rang 'dod bla ma rnyed pa'i brda// rin chen sna bdun phra bkod de// de ni rje yi yon tan lags// changs zung gser gyi dra ba de// snyan brgyud gnad kyi gdams ngag gi /skal ldan rjes su 'dzin pa'i brda// lag pa g.yas su thogs pa de// bde nas bde bar lam bgrod de// sangs rgyas zhing du gshegs pa'i brda// mtshan ldan rdo rje ka pā la// ngo bo stong pa mtshon pa'i brda// bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis bkang ba de// nyams myong bde ba mtshon pa'i brda// gser mdog 'od dang bcas pa de// rnam pa gsal ba mtshon pa'i brda// kho bos kha phor bya snyam pa// de gsum gcig tu mtshon pa'i brda// lag pa g.yon du khyer ba de// nyams myong 'bral ba med pa'i brda// sum gal khra bo mdzes pa de// cir snang lam du slong ba'i brda// dor sdebs phrag la bkal ba de/ zung 'jug thabs dang shes rab kyis/ theg chen lam la bgrod pa'i brda// nang der 'bras dkar sa lu de/ sku tshe la bar chad mi 'byung brda// kho bos chos brgyags bya snyam pa// bsam gtan zas kyis 'tsho ba'i brda/ phrag g.yon khri snyan pags pa de// dran pa yeng med mtshon pa'i brda/ mgo dang sder bzhi ma nyams pa// byang chub sems kyi rgyun bsgoms zhing*// tshad med bzhi la sbyangs pa'i phyir// 'gro rgyud sdug bsngal sel ba'i brda/ kho bo'i stan bya snyam pa yang*/

stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i// rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i brda// de rjes g.yas su phar bltas pas// gser gyi spang po ngos bzang de// phyi nang yon tan rgyas pa'i brda// be'u lug gzas la bkram pa de// chos dang zang zing skyabs gnas kyi// 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i brda// kho bos phyugs rdzi bya snyam pa// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams// thugs rjes mi gtong skyong ba'i brda// de rjes g.yon du tshur bltas pas// g.yu yi nel thang sil ma de// zag med ting 'dzin rgyun bsgoms pas// dga' ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i brda// me tog sna tshogs brgyan pa de// drod rtags phyogs med rim gyis 'char/ nyams myong sna tshogs skye ba'i brda/ bud med mang pos phyag 'tshal ba// rtsa dang thig le la gnas pa'i// mkha' 'gro dbang du 'du ba'i brda// dbus me tog ser po'i zhing khams de// ting 'dzin rtogs pa dang ldan zhing*// tshul khrims gtsang mas rab brgyan pa'i// mkhas pa'i dge bshes sprin tshogs rnams// khyed kyi 'khor du 'dus pa'i brda// shin tu 'dab rgyas gser gyi mdog /padma spungs pa'i gdan de yangs// shes pas srid la mi gnas phyir// padma 'dam gyis ma gos 'dra// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos brda// sems dpa'i skyil krung bcas pa yang*// snying rje'i zhi la mi gnas phyir// byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nu ltar// 'gro drug sems can mar gyur la// sprul skus 'gro don byed pa'i brda// mdun du chu mig rdol ba de// chos kyi chab srid dar ba'i brda// rgyab tu 'od cig 'khyil ba de// bod khams dkar por gtong ba'i brda// lus la me chen 'bar ba de// gtum mo'i drod kyi ye shes kyis// rnam rtog chab rom bzhu ba'i brda// snying la nyi zla shar ba de// 'gro 'ong bral ba'i 'od gsal gyi// ngang la rtag tu gnas pa'i brda// bu rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// dus phyi mar 'byung bar lung bstan pa// ltas dge bar bstan pa'i chos kyi rje// rmi lam mngon sum gang la yang*// mtshan mar bzung na bar chad yin// sgyu mar shes na lam du 'gyur/

rmi lam mi shes 'chad mi shes// bzang ltas ngan ltas sdig par bshad// rmi lam sbyangs pa klong gyur na// ngan rmis bzang ltas dge bar bshad// lar skyon dang yon tan gang la yang*// mchog tu ma 'dzin rigs kyi bu// khyed dge slong gi thugs la de ltar zhog /bu lha rje khyed la da res byung ba'i mtshan ltas de rnams ma 'ongs pa lung bstan pa'i chos rnams rgyud la skye ba'i brda yin te/ pha rgan nga yis 'chad shes pas zhib tu bkrol te brda don ngo sprad pa de rnams ma brjed par gyis la dus phyi bden rdzun gtan la phob cig /bden par byung na bla ma nga la yang mos gus khyad par can cig da lta dang 'dra ba ma yin pa cig de dus skye ba yin/ bu khyed la yang sems kyi ngo bo ma bcos pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can cig de dus 'char/ tshe 'di rang la snang ba skye shi gnyis la ldog ste mchi/ lar bu khyod sgom chen gsha' ma cig byed na// rmi lam dang mtshan ltas gang la yang mngon zhen ma che/ bdud 'jug pa'i rgyu yin bla mas gsungs pa dang*/ rang gi zhe bcad ma gtogs pa gzhan gyi ngag gi rjes su ma 'brang*/ sems so mi zin pa'i rgyu yin// g.yas g.yon grogs kyi skyon ma brtags/ bcas bcos ma byed/ gzhan rgyud kyi sems mi shes par rlom sems kyis ltung ba 'phog pa'i rgyu yin/ 'o skol da lta skye shi'i bar do 'khrul snang la longs spyod pa 'di rmi lam chen po rmi bdo ba yin/ nyin par gang byas pa'i bag chags de nub mo gnyid log tsa na rnam shes yid kyi 'khrul pa las byung ba de/ rmi lam bar ro sgyu ma nying 'khrul bya ba yi bag chags de goms pa mthar phyin pa'i tshe las dge sdig rjes su 'brang ste/ srid pa bar dor bde sdug gi tshor ba nyams su myong ste rmi lam gcig rmi lam chen po/ sgyu ma na sgyu ma chen po/ bar do na bar do chen po yin te/ de lam du byed pa la rmi lam sgyu lus 'byongs pa'i rtsal mthar phyin par 'tshal bas shugs phyung la sgoms mdzod gsungs/

rmi lam lung bstan gyi mgur dris pa len gyi tshul du byon pa'o// yang rje btsun gyi drung du mnyam med dwags po rin po che bzhugs pa'i dus su rmi lam byung ba zhus pa/ e ma rje btsun snyan gson dang*/ mdang sum nam gyi gung phyed la// ya ki spyi bo'i gtsug rum du// g.yu 'brug sngon po 'khyil pa rmis// g.yu yi na bun 'thib pa rmis// dung gi khu 'phang 'bab pa rmis// g.yas su khyung cig lding ba rmis// g.yon du rgod cig 'khor ba rmis// dpral bar nyi ma shar ba rmis// gal rta phrag la bkal ba rmis// glang dkar lag tu bzung ba rmis// rgyab tu dgra lnga bsad pa rmis// mdun du chu mig rdol ba rmis// 'og na seng ge zhon pa rmis/ 'di don ma 'tshal gsung bar zhu// zhes zhus pa'i lan gsungs pa/ e ma skal ldan las 'phro can// rmi lam mi ngan rmi lam bzang*// skyes bu las dang skal par ldan// ya ki spyi bo'i gtsug rum na/ g.yu 'brug sngon mo 'khyil pa de// bla ma rje btsun bsten pa yin// g.yu yi na bun 'thib pa de// sangs rgyas zhing khams sleb pa yin// dung gi khu 'phang babs pa de// nyon mongs thal ba brlan pa yin// g.yas su khyung cig lding ba de// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba yin// g.yon du rgod cig lding ba de// rig 'dzin pho mo 'du ba yin// dpral bar nyi ma shar ba de// 'phags pa'i spyan gyis gzigs pa yin// gal rta phrag la bkal ba de// thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin// glang dkar phyag na bsnams pa de// bag chags dbyug pas 'ded pa yin// rgyab tu dgra lnga bsad pa de// dug lnga nyon mongs bsad pa yin// mdun du chu mig rdol ba de// rnal 'byor bsod nams skye ba yin// 'og na seng ge zhon pa de// bdud bzhi zil gyi gnon pa yin// zhes brda don bkrol nas lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// de thams cad dwags po zhal mjal gyi skor ro/// /de nas dwags pos zla ba gcig bsgoms pas dang po sman bla mched bdun zhal mthong*/

nyin gcig rlung 'gro 'ong gcig gis chog pa byung*/ rlung klod tsa yal nas thal/ phyi dro rlung bzung tsa longs sku'i zhing khams rab 'byams rnams zhal mthong*/ de la yengs nas rlung btang tsa na nub mo srod du red nas 'dug /bla ma'i ting nge 'dzin la gnod snyam nas de nub ma zhus/ maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba btab/ tho rangs nas rlung bsgoms tsa sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis kyi gtso bo shākya thub pas byas pa cig mthong*/ nam langs nas bla ma la zhur song tsa/ phyag byas te kun zhu ma khom par/ bla ma'i zhal nas da yi dam gyi zhal mthong ste longs sku sprul sku gnyis mngon gsum mthong*/ chos sku dang da gzod mjal bar 'dug gi gsungs/ yang thang cig gi tshe/ bla ma lha rje/ rje btsun gyi drung du bzhugs pa la gsungs pa/ grub thob bla ma dam pa de/ ma rig sel ba'i lam mkhan yin// dad pa skyo dub med pa de// bde 'gror 'khrid pa'i lam mkhan yin// tshogs drug snang ba thug phrad de// rnam rtog 'joms pa'i lam mkhan yin// grang ba med pa'i ras gos de// zhen pa ldog pa'i lam mkhan yin// lam mkhan bzhi yi sna drangs nas// 'gro ni ting 'dzin lam la 'gro// sleb ni mya ngan 'das par sleb// rnam rtog 'od gsal dbyings su thim// nga rnal 'byor pa yi bde skyid 'di// tshogs drug snang ba grogs su shar// 'khor 'das la nyam nga ma mchis pas// nga rang sems rgyal po yin nam snyam// rang sems rtogs pa'i rgyal po la// rin chen bdun gyi rgyan yod de// dad pa 'khor lo rin po che// nyin mtshan dge ba'i las la sbyor// tshul khrims btsun mo rin po che// rab tu mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldan// thos bsam dmag dpon rin po che/ log rtog dgra yi g.yul ngo 'joms/ brtson 'grus rta mchog rin po che// rnal 'byor bdag med dbyings su skyel// khrel yod glang po rin po che// phyin ci log gi las rnams spangs// bsam gtan blon po rin po che/

bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs// shes rab nor bu rin po che// rang gzhan gnyis kyi dgos 'dod 'byung*// khyed de ltar shes na legs lags te// deng sang skye bo dmu rgod rnams// dus da lta g.yeng ba'i dbang du song*// sang 'chi khar 'gyod pa 'di re ma dga'// bu snying nas sgrub pa dngas su legs// zhes gsungs/ yang*/ sa bdag rgyal po'i bde skyid 'di// sngon sbyin pa rnam bzhi btang lags pas// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la// rin chen bdun gyi rgyan yang 'dogs// 'khor los gang du sgyur bar 'gro// btsun mos mdzes pa'i rgyan yang 'dogs// dmag dpon phal gyi g.yul ngo 'joms// rta mchog rin chen gar 'dod phyin// glang po rin chen dmag dpung 'joms// blon pos gros kyi phul yang phyung*// nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod 'byung*// de 'phral du bde ste rtag nges med// khyed 'jig rten bde skyid bzhed pa na/ khyed 'di ltar shes na bde ste mchi// bdag rnal 'byor pa yi bde skyid 'di// tshogs drug gi snang ba grogs su shar// 'khor 'das la nyam nga ma mchis pas// rang sems rgyal po yin nam snyam// rang sems rtogs pa'i rgyal po la// rin chen bdun gyi rgyan yang 'dogs// bdag tha snyad tshig phyir ma 'brang par// zab mo'i chos la mos pa byas// nges shes blo yi gting nas skyes// de blon po gros kyi phul yang phyungs// bla ma rje yi zhal snga nas// zab mo'i gdams ngag nga rang ston// nā ro pa yi bu rgyud la// rgyud 'grel sgro 'dogs chod cig gsungs// gdams ngag che che spus thus byas// 'khor 'das sgro 'dogs chod lags pas// ma rig skye med du yal nas thal// rta mchog dug lnga dbyings su bskyal// mang po tshogs pa'i 'du 'dzi des// g.yeng bar 'dug pas ri khrod 'grim/ lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis la gzhi byas nas// rang gi sems kyi rtsal yang sbyangs// khyung phrug mkha' la gshog brkyang 'dra// de gar bsgyur 'khor lo rin po che// tshogs drug snang ba had por thal// 'dod pa'i yon tan chog shes pas// longs spyod che la dga' ru med/

bstod smad tshig gi snyan sdug med// bar chad bdud kyi cho 'phrul 'di// rang snang yin pas 'jigs rgyu med// sems rtag chad gnyis po rang yal thal// skye 'chi gnyis la skrag rgyu med// de dmag dpon gyi log rtog 'joms shing gda'// de ltar rtogs pa'i rang bzhin gyis// sems nyid gdod nas dag pa la// snang ba slob dpon du 'char zhing gda'/ 'khor ba ye shes su 'char zhing gda'// rnam rtog grogs su 'char zhing gda'// nags la me chen mched pa bzhin// de glang po me dpung bskyel ba 'dra// yeng ba med pa'i rnal 'byor la// dran rtog zhen pa rang yal thal// mkha' la bya 'phur rjes ma mchis// tshogs drug rang snang glo bur la// 'dzin pa med pa'i grogs su shar// bkag pa med pas gzigs mo che// btsun mo mdzes pa'i rgyan yang 'dogs// de ltar 'dogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// khyab pa nam mkha' lta bu la// sems kyi khyim la phyi nang med// ngos bzung med pa'i snang ba la// 'od gsal sgom la yangs dogs med// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med la// sku gsum rgyun la nyin mtshan med// 'bad med nyi zla lta bu la// 'od zer 'bar ba phyogs ris med// nor bus dgos 'dod 'byung bar go /rin chen bdun gyi nor mchog 'di// rnal 'byor pa yi rgyan du che// srog dang bral yang 'di mi 'bral/ nor gyi dam pa yin nam snyam// rgyal po'i longs spyod smon rgyu med// de shob be yin yang gum pa lags// mi na re lta ba lta ba zer// ban chung nged la lta rgyu med// lta ba lta bya'i yul dang bral// lta rgyu byung na gol ba yin// lta rgyu med na tha mal yin// rig pa mthong ba ngo mtshar che// mi na re sgom pa sgom pa zer// ban chung nged la sgom rgyu med// bsgom rgyu byung na gol ba yin// bsgom rgyu med na tha mal yin// ci med ci gsal ngo mtshar che// mi na re spyod pa spyod pa zer// ban chung nged la spyod rgyu med// spyod pa spyod pa'i yul dang bral/

spyod rgyu byung na gol ba yin// spyod rgyu med na tha mal yin// shugs 'byung spyod pa ngo mtshar che// mi na re 'bras bu 'bras bu zer// ban chung nged la 'bras bu med// 'bras bu bsgrub bya'i yul dang bral// bsgrub bya byung na gol ba yin// bsgrub rgyu med na tha mal yin// rang sems sangs rgyas ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs so// rje btsun snye nam drod phug tu bzhugs te/ ras chung pa la dbus pa ston pa 'di la chos kyi dri ba gyis dang gsungs pas/ ras chung pas lta sgom spyod 'bras kyi 'gag tu dril ba'i mgur 'di gsungs pa/ lta ba lta rgyu med par cha mchis kyang*/ stong pa don phyir shor bas don ma rtogs// 'di rtogs thabs shig 'dug gam mched grogs kun// kha lta stong mthar shor ba 'di ya cha ru gda'// sgom pa bsgom du med par cha mchis kyang*// brtson 'grus bsgom bsran chung bas ting 'dzin rtsal ma rdzogs// 'di rdzogs thabs shig 'dug gam skal ldan kun// sgom pa spom yor du shor ba 'di ya cha ru gda'// spyod pa spyod du med par cha mchis kyang*// dge sdig 'chol mar spyod pas chos brgyad mgo ma non// 'di non thabs shig 'dug gam skal ldan kun// spyod pa tshul 'chos la shor ba 'di ya cha ru gda'// 'bras bu bsgrub tu med par cha mchis kyang*// re dogs yid smon la lus pas lo thog sad la shor// 'di bsgrub pa'i thabs shig 'dug gam mched grogs kun// rang sems 'khor bar 'khyams pa 'di ya cha ru gda'// zhes dris pas/ dwags pos rje btsun nyid la lan gsung bar zhu zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis mgur 'di gsung so// snang dang stong dang dbyer med gsum// blos byas phyogs su ma shor na// lta ba tsam gyi mthar thug yin// bde dang gsal dang mi rtogs gsum// zhen pa'i phyogs su ma shor na// sgom pa tsam gyi mthar thug yin// ma bcos ma zhen lhug pa gsum// tshul 'chos phyogs su ma lhung na// spyod pa tsam gyi mthar thug yin// mi re mi dogs mi sgrub gsum// yid smon gyi phyogs su ma lhung ba/

'bras bu tsam gyi mthar thug yin// zhes gsungs so// yang nyin gcig gi tshe/ bla ma lha rje bar do'i gdams pa zhus pa la gsungs pa/ rje bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgos bka' drin can la skyabs su mchi// bu khyed kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor// ngas bar do 'di la dbyangs shig len// spyir kham gsum 'khor ba'i sems can dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis// dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs gcig /lta ba'i bar do de la mdzod// sna tshogs shar ba'i dkar dmar dang*// brjod du med pa'i sems nyid gnyis// dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang du gcig /sgom pa'i bar do de la mdzod// tshogs drug tu shar ba'i 'khrul snang dang*// rang sems skye ba med pa gnyis// gnyis med lhan cig skyes par gcig /spyod pa'i bar do de la mdzod// mdang sum rmi lam bar do dang*// sad nas rdzun du shes pa gnyis// sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du gcig /rmi lam bar do de la mdzod// ma dag phung po rnam lnga dang*// dag pa rgyal ba rigs lnga gnyis// mi rtogs rdzogs rim ngang du gcig /bskyed rdzogs kyi bar do de la mdzod// thabs las byung ba'i pha rgyud dang*// shes rab las byung ma rgyud gnyis// dbang gsum lhan cig skyes bar gcig /gdams ngag gi bar do de la mdzod// rang don chos sku 'gyur med dang*// gzhan don gzugs sku 'gyur med gnyis/ dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang du gcig /sku gsum gyi bar do de la mdzod// ma dag sgyu lus mngal sgo dang*// dag pa lha yi rnam pa gnyis// bar do 'od gsal ngang du gcig /'bras bu'i bar do de la mdzod// ces bar do brgyad kyi mgur gsungs pa'o// yang dus re zhig gi tshe/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bu dbus pa ston pa dbus su song la sgom/ sngar gyi 'phrang tsho ngas bsal ba yin/ da mngon par shes pa'i 'phrang yod/ mngon shes byung tsa lha yi bu yi bdud 'jug pa yin pas shin tu gsang ba gal che/

lar dbang po rnon po rgyu yi stobs can la bdud kyis mi tshugs pa yin/ khyed dbang po rnon po 'dug ste/ gsang sngags gsang nas 'grub pas gsang nas sgrub pa gyis shig /sems can la yang phan par 'dug pas tshogs kyang skyongs shig gsungs/ tshogs pa skyong ba'i dus nam lags zhus pas/ sems kyi ngo bo mthong nas de brtan par dang skyong ba yin/ ci zhig lta na da lta dang 'dra ba ma yin pa'i rtogs pa skye bas de yi dus su tshogs pa skyongs/ rlung lag so la drongs pa 'dug gi mi 'dug ltos/ de drongs par 'dug na rlung gi 'phrang las thar ba yin gsungs pas/ de nub rdo leb cig gi steng du thal ba blugs nas sor mo bcu nas rlung gcun tsa na nam phyed tsam nas thal ba bun bun 'dug /nang par bla ma'i spyan sngar de ltar byas tsa na/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ rtsa rlung la dbang thob bya ba ni min te rlung las rung bya ba yin pa da nga dang 'grogs mi dgos/ lus sprul pa dang bsgyur ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul dang*/ mchog thun mong gnyis ka'i dngos grub thob nas 'ong gi yang ras chung pa dang*/ se ban ras pa dang mnyam med dwags po rin po che gsum la do nub rmi lam ltos shig gsungs nas bltas pas/ ras chung pas/ thang dkyil cig tu bong bu cig la lan tshwa bkal nas ded/ dung cig 'bud cing phyin pa rmis zhus pas/ khyod kyi zer ba ltar skad cher 'ong*/ ngas gar khyab tu khyod kyi grags pas khyab par 'dug /brgyud pa 'chad/ gdams ngag la tshwa bzhin du 'grim gsungs so// se ban ras pas/ sum mdo nas me 'bar bas dbang po'i sgo thams cad myug myug byung ba zhig rmi zhus pas/ tshe 'dir 'gro don mi 'byung*/ gtum mo drod kyi ye shes kyi rnam rtog gi dri ma bsregs nas phyi mar gzugs sku'i snang ba rgya cher 'char gsungs/ mnyam med dwags po rin po ches/ brag dkar po re rgyal gyi rtser phyin/ nyi ma shar/ rgod mang pos bskor ba cig rmis zhus pas/

da 'di nas shar gyi phyogs na sgam po gdar gyi ri bya ba rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra ba rtse mo rin chen prog zhu lnga ru yod pa/ shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal gyi bkod pa lta bu/ mdun ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra ba/ ri bdun blon po phyag 'tshal ba lta bu/ de yi mgul na khyod la nga yi zhwa 'di lta bu gnas/ brag ri chen po cig gi mdun du 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'byung*/ bya rgod 'du ba bzhin skal ldan gyi slob ma mang po 'du bas da dbus su song gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bu ston pa dbus su bzhud mi bzhud// ston pa dbus su bzhud pa na// sems res 'ga' yul gyi snang ba 'char// yul gyi snang ba shar tsam na// chos nyid gtan yul ma lags pa/ yul snang sgyu mar shes gyis la// yul snang med rnal 'byor nyams su long*// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu khyed la bsgom rgyu de las med// sems res 'ga' dgra yi snang ba 'char// dgra sdang snang ba shar tsam na// dgra sdang sgyu mar shes gyis la// dgra sdang med rnal 'byor nyams su long*// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu khyed la bsgom rgyu de las med// sems res 'ga' gnyen gyi snang ba 'char// gnyen gyi snang ba shar tsam na/ gnyen 'brel sgyu mar shes gyis la// gnyen zhen med rnal 'byor nyams su long*// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu khyod la bsgom rgyu de las med// sems res 'ga' nor gyi snang ba 'char// nor gyi snang ba shar tsam na// nor zas sgyu mar shes gyis la// nor 'dzin med rnal 'byor nyams su long*// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu khyed la bsgom rgyu de las med// sems res 'ga' zas kyi snang ba 'char/ zas kyi snang ba shar tsam na// zhim mngar sgyu mar shes gyis la// zag med ting 'dzin nyams su longs// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu khyed la bsgom rgyu de las med// sems res 'ga' gos kyi snang ba 'char/

gos kyi snang ba shar tsam na// 'jam legs sgyu mar shes gyis la// gtum mo'i bde drod nyams su long*// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu khyod la bsgom rgyu de las med// sems res 'ga' grogs kyi sna ba 'char// grogs kyi snang ba shar tsam na// zla grogs sgyu mar shes gyis la// rang byung ye shes nyams su long*// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu khyed la bsgom rgyu de las med// sems res 'ga' 'chi ba'i snang ba 'char// skye 'chi'i snang ba shar tsam na// skye 'chi sgyu mar shes gyis la// sems skye med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su long*// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu khyod la bsgom rgyu de las med// sems res 'ga' bla ma'i snang ba 'char// bla ma'i snang ba shar tsam na// cir snang chos skur shes par mdzod// 'bral med kyi rnal 'byor nyams su long*// pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med/ bu khyed la bsgom rgyu de las med// bla ma yang sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra// thams cad sgyu mar shes par mdzod// shar sgam po gdar gyi ri bo 'di// rgyal po gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ rgyab ri dar dkar phyar ba 'dra// mdun ri rin chen spungs pa 'dra// rtse mo rin chen prog zhu 'dra/ ri bdun blon po 'dud pa 'dra// shing spang gser gyi maṇḍal 'dra// de yi mgul na gdul bya yod// khyod de ru song la 'gro don gyis// bu khyod kyi 'gro don 'grub ste mchi// zhes gsungs nas khyed kyi ming yang dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'dzam gling grags pa yin gsungs nas dbang dang byin rlabs gnyis ka'i bka' dang*/ chos thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas/ bla ma'i zhal nas da dbus su song la sgoms gsungs de nas shing stag ma'i nags yod pa'i lung pa cig gi chu la rdo zam chung ngu zhig yod pa'i bar la skyel ma mdzad nas/ dbus pa ston pa rten 'brel zhig gi gnad phar khar nga 'gro mi btub par 'dug pas/

'o skol pha phad kyi phrin bsgos 'dir bya yi/ khyod khres po phog la 'dir sdod gsungs/ rje btsun gyis zam sngur gyi kha la phyed skyil zhig mdzad nas bzhugs pa la/ zhabs g.yas pa gtad cing phyag mang du btsal bas/ dbu btegs tsa zhabs kyi padmo la gtug cing gsol ba btab pas de'i rten 'brel gyis shin tu gnyes nas/ a ru ra gser mdog gcig /me cha gcig /bu ram ca ko ra gcig gnang nas nga la dge sbyor skye dka' bar byung ste/ gdams ngag 'di la brten nas/ rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skyes pa yin/ khyod kyang bar skabs su dge sbyor la 'phel 'grib byung na gdams ngag 'di dgos pa yin gsungs nas/ phyag rgya chen po rlung sems gnyis med kyi ngo sprod gnang nas/ lar khyod la sgom chen mthar thug pa cig 'ong bar 'dug /bu dbus pa ston pa/ khyod pha tshan gyi khe grags spangs/ gnyen 'dun gyi thag pa chod/ tshe 'di'i gdos thag med par gyis/ ri yi bu gyis/ chos thams cad gcig tu dril la nyams su long*/ mi rgan nga la gsol ba thob/ spyir dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang 'grogs su mi rung ste de'i grib 'phog pa yin/ de gang yin na snang ba dgrar langs pa'i mi/ chos dang gang zag thams cad la ngan smras byed cing 'thab pa'i rigs yod/ de'i nang na zhe sdang me 'bar ba lta bu yod pa yin/ dper na sems can sbrul la gshog pa ni med/ rkang lag ni med/ sbrul las nyam thag pa med pa la/ kho mthong ba tsam nas mi thams cad bred cing dngangs pa de/ nang na zhe sdang yod pas na phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad dgrar lang ba yin/ yang gang zag kha cig /rdo bug pa can dang shing nya ga can tshun chad tshag byed pa yod/ rgas na rgas brgyags/ shi na dur brgyags dgos de med na chos 'chor/ gzhan don dang tshogs pa yang nor dgos zer nas/ tha na bun skyed la sogs pa log 'tsho 'ba' zhig byed pa yod de'i nang du 'dod chags tshwa chu khol ba lta bu yod pa yin/

yang gang zag kha cig yang dag pa'i don bsgom pa'i dus da lta ma yin/ tshe gcig lus gcig la sangs rgyas pa shes bya la mi srid/ tshogs ma bsags/ sgrib pa ma sbyangs/ snying rje ma bsgoms pas nyan thos su gol/ thabs khyad du bsad pas chad lta yin zer ba yod de'i nang na gti mug mun ltar 'thib pa yod pa yin/ de 'dra'i mi dang gtam byed du'ang mi rung*/ gtam byas na dang po khyod pa su yin zer nas 'ong*/ chos gang yin bla bo 'dra ba la brten nas kho zhe sdang lang ste chos dang gang zag gnyis ka la skur pa 'debs/ bdag gzhan gnyis ka ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i rgyu gsog pas des na/ thos nas blo chung de yis spong byed de/ spangs nas skyabs med gyur pa de ni mnar med 'gro/ bya ba de'i dus su 'byung bas bdag la brten nas gzhan rgyud sreg pa'i sdig pa gsog pas/ dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang 'grogs su mi rung*/ dam tshig gi chos kyi nang na/ nyan thos nang na zhag bdun 'das// zhes bya ba'i don de 'dra la zer ba yin/ spyir yang ri dwags smas ma'am bya bzhin du zon bag che bar bya/ zhi ba dul ba rtse rag chung bar bya/ bzod bag che ba thams cad dang mthun par bya/ gtsang sbra shin tu che bar bya/ ri dang mtshams dang smra bcad dang*/ 'dag char gsum gyis dus 'da' bar bya/ rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang*/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mi spong ba la bslab/ bsags sbyong gnyis po rang sar dag kyang*/ tshogs chung ngu chung ngu nas bsags/ las 'bras nam mkha' lta bur go yang*/ sdig pa phra zhing phra ba la 'dzem/ mnyam bzhag rjes thob med pa'i nyams yod kyang*/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rgyun chad med par nyams su long*/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du go yang*/ chos dang gang zag la skur pa mi gdab gsungs/ khyed bya lo rta zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la brin dang snye nam mtshams su sleb par gyis gsungs te/ de'i tshe dwags po la skyel chos zhal lta'i mgur 'di gsungs so// bu spros bral sems la 'char dus su// tha snyad tshig phyir ma 'brang cig

/don med 'bad rtsol byas nyan yod// bu nga rgyal med pa'i ngang la zhog /rang grol nang nas shar dus su// tshad ma'i sbyor ba ma 'god cig /chos brgyad sgrog tu tshud nyen yod// bu rnam rtog med pa'i ngang la zhog /rang sems ngo bo mthong dus su// chad pa'i stong par gol nyen yod// bu spros pa med pa'i ngang la zhog /gnyug ma'i ngang la 'jog dus su// lus ngag dge sbyor ma g.yeng cig /mi rtogs ye shes yal nyes yod// bu ma bcos lhug pa'i ngang la zhog /gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs dus su// rtags mtshan 'dod pa ma skyed cig /bdud kyi lung bstan 'ong nyen yod// bu khyed 'dzin med pa'i ngang la zhog /lung bstan mngon shes byung dus su// ched 'dzin zhen pa ma byed cig /dga' rlom bdud kyi 'khyer nyen yod// bu re dogs med pa'i ngang la zhog /pha nga la bstan rgyu de las med// bu go'am dbus pa ston pa ba// zhes gsungs nas lha rje ston pa/ khyod kyis sems can mang po la phan thog par 'dug gsungs nas/ lung bstan zhal lta mang du mdzad nas rje btsun yar byon te/ slob ma ras pa rnams bsags nas lha rje ston pa des sems can mang po la phan thog par 'dug /mdang nga yi rmi lam na nga yi rtsa nas bya ser po cig dbus su 'phur nas song ba ri chen po zhig gi rtse la babs pa la/ phyogs phyogs nas bya ngang pa'i tshogs mang po 'dus nas dar cig nas de rnams phyogs phyogs su 'phur nas song ba la/ ngang pa re re la yang ngang pa g.yog lnga brgya lnga brgya re tsam 'dus nas lung pa'i gshes dang phyogs thams cad ngang pa ser nyog gi gang ba cig rmis/ kho bo rnal 'byor pa yin pa la kho bo'i rjes su 'jug pa thams cad rab tu byung ba 'ba' zhig 'ong bar gda'/ kho bos kyang sangs rgyas kun gyi bstan pa la bya ba byas nas 'dug gsungs so// rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa dang mnyam med dwags po rin po che yab sras kyi zhus pa dang lan gyi skor ro/// /de nas dwags po dbus su byon te sngon bka' gdams kyi bla ma rnams kyis nged kyi rtags ma shor bar shog gsungs pas/

dbu zhwa ser tshos byas pa cig dang*/ na bza' la phrug gang btags pa cig dang*/ sku 'gags ha zlum mdzad pa gcig dang*/ chas sgyur mdzad pa la sogs pa sngar ji ltar gsungs bzhin mdzad nas/ snyug rum pa'i sar byon pas khong gi zhal nas/ khyod la rnal 'byor pa'i yon tan ci yod gsungs pas/ rlung phyi nang du mi rgyu ba'i 'od gsal nam mkha' ltar dag gsungs pas/ khyod la yon tan bzang po skyes 'dug /da sems can gyi don bya ran gsungs pas/ nga la tshe yi rten 'brel 'bring tsam las med pas/ sngon la sgrub pa rang gces nas 'ong zhus pas/ tshe bsring ba'i gdams ngag nga la yod gsungs nas khong cag gi bla ma la/ rnal 'byor pa'i thugs dam sgrol ma dkar mo dang snyung rum pa gnyis mi lab lab byed pas/ de'i sgrub thabs gnang ngo*// de nas gnyal du bzhugs pa'i tshe bla ma'i gsung dran nas rgya ba ser re la gser zho bcu gnyis la nas 'jal nas ra sgom ras pa grogs su khrid nas byon pas yar lung mdor sleb tsa gtsang nas tshong pa 'ong ba dang 'phrad de rnams la brin pa spyi dus su khams bde'am/ bla ma rje btsun sku khams bde bar bzhugs sam dris pas/ brin pa spyi dus khams bde/ bla ma rje btsun rta zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhir gshegs zer nas/ phyag 'khar dang*/ dbu zhwa dang*/ na bza' ras gcig dang de rnams mchod pa'i rten du bskur 'dug pa gtad/ de'i mod la spyan chab mang po yang shor dran med du brgyal nas song skad/ der rtsa na yod pa rnams kyi phyag zhabs la sku mnye phul/ zhal ngo la chu mang po gtor bas da cig dran pa rnyed nas/ gser srang gang kha phyes nas brin gyi phyogs su gtor nas mchod de bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa'i mgur 'di gsungs so// na mo ratna gu ru/ rje gangs dkar ltongs su gshegs pa'i tshe// seng ge dkar mo'i spyod dang mtshungs// zil gyis gnon pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje nags kyi khrod du bzhugs pa'i tshe/

rgya stag khra bo'i spyod dang mtshungs// re dogs med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje brag dmar logs la gshegs pa'i tshe// thang dkar rgod po'i spyod dang mtshungs// spyi rgya rlabs kyis gcod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje phyogs med ri khrod 'grim pa'i tshe// ri dwags yongs kyi spyod dang mtshungs// gdos thag chod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje 'khor gyi nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe// rdo rje 'chang gi spyod dang mtshungs// skal ldan 'dren pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje bu chung lta bu'i spyod pa de// spros bral nang nas shar bar nges// rje smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa de// gza' gtad nang nas bral bar nges// rje glang po lta bu'i spyod pa de// mnyam bzhag rjes thob med par nges// rje blo dang bral ba'i spyod pa de// de nyid thugs su chud par nges// rje mngon shes dag dang ldan pa de// nang gi sems nyid gsal bar nges// rje zas skom 'du shes chung ba de// ting 'dzin zas su gsol bar nges// rje skal ldan 'dren pa'i byin rlabs de// stong nyid snying rje 'dres par nges// nor bu dbang gi rgyal po bzhin// dgos 'dod rang la 'byung ba khyed// skar tshogs dbus na zla rgyas bzhin// mang po'i nang na mdzes pa khyod// 'dam gyi nang na padma bzhin// 'khor ba'i skyon dang bral ba khyod// 'gro ba yongs la drin re che// bka' brgyud rnams kyi don re bsgrubs// khyed kyi yon tan dpag med la// 'di ni cha tsam smos pa lags// bdag gis cung zad bstod pa lags/ thugs rjes yongs su bzung ba lags// dngos po'i bsnyen bkur ma mchis kyang*// sgrub pa nyams su len lags kyi// drin len chos kyi bsab lags kyi// byin rlabs chu rgyun ma bcad cig /chos sku gcig tu ma gyur bar// thugs rje'i lcags kyus ma btang cig /de ltar bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// rje btsun nyid dang mjal bar shog
