/mjal nas byin gyis brlab par shog /ces gsungs so// de nas rang yul du log nas 'ong nyi ma yang dro ran song nas 'dug pas/ se'u cig gi rtsa na bu med cig 'dug pa la dro 'dod gsungs pas/ steng du byon zer nas bud med des zhing rmos nas spar gang btab/ zhing ljang bu skyes/ nas su smin/ btsas ma byas/ de brdungs/ yos su brngos/ phye ru btags/ zan du brdzis/ tsha ba bskol nas dro drangs/ chab btang*/ mdo bton nas bzhengs tsam na se'u dang bud med gang yang mi snang*/ nga 'khrul pa yin nam snyam tsa na/ zan sgrog chil chil gda'/ lar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad snang zhing stong pa/ bden rdzun gyi mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di lta bu zhig rang yin snyam nas thugs nyams khyad par can skyes gsungs/ de nas gnyal dang 'ol kha rnams su sgrub pa mdzad/ sgam por sgrub khang btab nas rang gzhan gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad do// de thams cad ni dbus gtad zhal lta dang*/ dwags po dbus bzhud kyi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun chu bar na bzhugs pa'i drung na slob ma gcig gis bla ma'i mtshan nyid zhus pa'i lan du bla ma'i 'dra lugs lnga mgur du gsungs pa/ 'o skol ma rig mun pa 'dra// pha bla ma snang gsal sgron me 'dra// mun sangs par 'dod na bla ma bsten// 'o skol shul ring 'gron po 'dra// pha bla ma khas drag skyel ma 'dra// 'jigs las thar 'dod bla ma bsten// 'o skol nad pa nyam thag 'dra// pha bla ma 'tsho byed sman pa 'dra// nad sos par 'dod na bla ma bsten// 'o skol chu kha'i ma gron po 'dra// pha bla ma mnyan pa gru thogs 'dra// chab sgrol bar 'dod na bla ma bsten// 'o skol tshong 'dus 'gron po 'dra// pha bla ma yid bzhin nor bu 'dra// tshong legs par 'dod na bla ma bsten// 'o skol brlan bral myu gu 'dra// pha bla ma sbrang char zim bu 'dra// 'bras legs par 'dod na bla ma bsten// ces bla ma'i mtshan nyid mgur du gsungs pa'o// der 'dus pa'i 'khor rnams la rtogs pa dang go yul ci 'dug nyams tshad pa'i phyir zhag 'ga' cung gsung mi 'byon par spyan phyogs bcur yo yo gzigs shing skabs shig tu/

pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dir 'dus bu rnams legs par nyon// snang ba 'di ci yin go lags sam/ snang ba 'di ci yin ma go na// snang ba 'di ci yin snang ba cig yin// de ma rtogs pa la 'khor ba ste// rtogs pa rnams la chos skur snang*// snang ba 'di chos skur shar tsam na// lta ba gzhan la ma 'tshol cig /blo yi bzhag thabs go lags sam// blo yi bzhag thabs ma go na// sems nyid 'chos su ma gzhug par// rang sems bcas bcos ma byed cig /rang lugs bu chung lta bur zhog /rlabs med rgya mtsho lta bur zhog /gsal ba mar me lta bur zhog /'gyur med ri bo lta bur zhog /sems nyid sgron ma btags su shes pa yin// nyams kyi 'char lugs go lags sam/ nyams kyi 'char lugs ma go na// khri gdugs tsam gyi mun pa sangs// rnam rtog gzhan du spangs pa med// de gzhi med rmi lam lta bur 'char// 'dzin med chu zla lta bur 'char// dngos med 'ja' mtshon lta bur 'char/ phyogs med nam mkha' lta bur 'char// nyams kyi 'char lugs go lags sam// nyams kyi bcos thabs ma go na// skyi ser che yang nam mkha'i ngang*// rba rlabs che yang rgya mtsho'i ngang*// lho sprin thug kyang nam mkha'i ngang*// shes pa 'thor yang byar med ngang*// rig pa klong du 'dzug pa la// rnam shes rlung zhon gdams ngag thong*// rnam rtog rkun bu byung ba la// rkun ma ngos 'dzin gdams ngag yod// shes pa yul la 'chor ba la/ bya rog gzing 'phur gdams ngag thong*// spyod pa'i spyad thabs go lags sam// spyod pa'i spyad thabs ma go na// seng chen 'gying ba bzhin du spyod// 'dam skyes padma bzhin du spyod// glang chen smyon pa bzhin du spyod/ shel sgong phyes pa lta bur spyod// 'bras bu'i 'char lugs go lags sam// 'bras bu'i 'char lugs ma go na// mi rtog pa la chos sku 'byung*// bde ba nyid la longs sku 'byung*/ gsal ba nyid la sprul sku 'byung*// gnyug ma ngo bo nyid kyi sku// mi la mkhas pa'i sku gsum yod// chos kyi sku la dbye ba med// lta ba sgom pa nyams myong gsum// spyod thabs 'bras bu spyod pa drug

/rnal 'byor blo la shar nas blangs// zhes gsungs/ dus de nas glu thams cad don sdud de/ zhal chems su byon pa yin/ yang dben gnas de nyid du bzhugs pa'i dus su sngar gyi 'khor drung na yod pa rnams kyang rtag tu bzhugs/ gsar du 'ongs pa dang*/ phyogs ris ri khrod du byon pa rnams kyang 'dus nas byung ba'i dus shig na/ ras pa zhi ba 'od dang*/ ngan rdzong bho te rā dzas dbu mdzad pa'i gzhi pa rnams dang*/ skyi thang ba ras pa la sogs phyogs nas byon pa'i ras pa phal mo che dang*/ ri gong pa bkra shis brtsegs la sogs pa yon bdag rnams yod pa'i dus su tshogs 'khor cig zhus pa'i gral du phyin nas 'khod pa rnams la zhal lta dri rmed kyi phyir/ pha bla rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod phyogs nas byon pa'i jo bo rnams// ro snyoms spyod pa bla na med// chos brgyad chu bos ma khyer ram// mtha' bral lta ba zung 'jug bde// mu bzhi'i g.yang la ma lhung ngam// sgom pa yid la mi byed pa// mtshan ma'i 'jur bus ma bcings sam// bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin ni// 'dod pa'i bde bas ma bslus sam// lus ngag byin gyis mi rlob par// mtshan ma'i chos spyod mi tshor ram// snang ba bla mar ma shar ba/ rig pa yan par ma shor ram// gsang sngags brda yis ston pa la// brda don med par ma bshad dam// dam pa'i rig rgyud dag pa la// rdzun dang g.yo sgyus ma bslus sam// bla ma dam pas ma gnang bar// spyod pa rang gar ma spyad dam// yi dam lha yis gnang mod kyang*/ bdud kyi bar chad cho 'phrul rnams// bye brag gi brda yis ma spyad pas// bdud kyi dpung gis bslu bar mchi// zhes gsungs so// de ltar lta ba sgom pa spyod pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i glu dam dum gsungs pa dang*/ cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa 'dra ba mdzad de/ gzhan chos gsungs pa la sogs ni da nga rgas pas khams kyi mi pher bar gsungs/ de'i skabs su lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa'i glu/

ngas lta ba gtan la 'bebs pa na// thos pas shes rgyud ma grol na// gnas lugs rig pas ma rtogs par// lta ba tshig tu mi btang 'tshal// ji ltar snang bzhin grags pa bzhin// phan gnod 'bras bu grub bzhin du// las 'bras 'brel pa mi dgag 'tshal// theg pa'i khyad par ma rtogs par// rang sems ming la zhen pa yi// lta ba nga yir bzung nas ni// gzhan la skur pa mi gdab 'tshal// lta ba'i tshom mo// sgom nyams su len pa na// rang bzhin mngon du ma byas par// sgro 'dogs nang nas ma chod cing*// 'od gsal sems la ma shar la// nyams kyi rtsa yis ma zin par/ stong pa'i rdzong la mi zhen 'tshal// shes bya snang stong zung 'jug la/ 'dod pa rang yan mi gtong 'tshal// stong dang stong pa ma yin zhes// mtshan ma nying phur mi gtong 'tshal// zag bcas bde ba'i rba klong du// rnam rtog rag par lus pa yin// bde ba'i ro myong med par bya/ rtog med zhi gnas brtan pa la// dam pa nyid du mi bzung 'tshal// sgom pa'i tshom mo// spyod pa ro snyoms byed pa na// nyams myong khong nas ma shar bar/ snang ba byin gyis mi rlob par// yul lnga bde bar ma myong bar// spyod pa tho cor mi btang 'tshal// dbang po rang snang ma thob par// rnal 'byor grong yul mi ldom 'tshal// mdo rgyud gnyis kyi drang don la/ dgongs pa tshul bzhin ma rtogs shing*// spros pa'i rtogs pa ma zad par// log pa'i brtul zhugs mi bya zhing*// sbyor sgrol lam du mi 'khyer 'tshal// spyod pa'i tshom mo// 'bras bu mngon du byed pa na// rang sems ngo bo ma mthong bar/ gzhan spyod sangs rgyas 'tshol ba yi// re dogs mtha' ru mi gtong 'tshal// gzugs sku gdul bya'i snang ba la// sangs rgyas so sor mi zhen 'tshal// rnam rtog chos skur thim pa la// yod par dgag pa mi bzung 'tshal// yon tan 'phrin las zhing khams rnams// ye shes dag pa'i snang ba la/ phyi rol ngo bo mi bzung 'tshal// 'bras bu'i tshom mo// yang de'i dus su yon bdag bkra shis brtsegs kyis/

rab gnas 'di khyed rang la ltos nas bzhag pa lags pas 'byon par zhu zhus pa de la gsungs pa/ pha bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// snang grags brag cha rtogs pa yi// spyod pa shugs 'byung mi bkag 'tshal// mi chen tshul 'chos bor nas btang*// khe grags ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// zas nor sgyu mar yid ches pas// thob pa'i longs spyod bkyes nas btang*// bsod nams ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// 'khor g.yog sprul pa ltar shes nas/ phyogs nas byon pa'i mkhas btsun la// sems 'dzin ngo srung ma grub kyis// grwa pa ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin la// chags sdang sdug bsngal rgyur rtogs nas// gdung sems thag pa bcad nas btang*// nye ring ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// chos nyid spros dang bral ba la// bdag 'dzin 'ching ba'i rgyur rtogs nas// gzung 'dzin lcags sgrog bkrol nas btang*// sde pa ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod/ sems ni rang rig 'od gsal la// rnam rtog dri ma ma mthong nas/ rtog dpyod byed pa bor nas btang*// tha snyad ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// ces ltos med drug gi mgur de gsungs so// de ltar rje btsun chen po mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa mnga' brnyes nas/ yi dam gyi lha dang dbye ba tha dad rdul tsam yang med pa de la ras chung pa dang*/ ngan rdzong bo dhi rā dza dang*/ slob ma rnams dang*/ yon mo legs se la sogs pa bcu tsam gyi dbang bskur zhus pas mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams nas khrus dang sngon 'gro byas te/ ye shes dbab pa rang 'bar du byung*/ bum dbang bskur dus ras kyi dbu btum nas bzhugs pa la khong tshos zhu ba byas pas/ rje btsun gyis/ nga mi la ras pa rgas nas ni// dbang bskur bdag gis ma nus pas// sa na bum pa bdag gis mdzod/ der slob ma rnams kyis/ rje btsun chen po ngo mtshar che/ dbang bskur ma dgos par bum pa rang byon du byon nas dbang bskur zhus pas/

rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ snyan brgyud dri med dkyil 'khor du// zhen pa med par mchod pa bshams// sangs rgyas ye shes ngo sprad pa'i// dri med chu rgyun bum dbang bskur// dbang bskur de nyid yin nam snyam// de la ngo mtshar skyes pa bzang*// zhes gsungs so// yang ras pa zhi ba 'od la sogs pa rnams kyis rnal 'byor ma'i thang sku dang*/ tsaka li la sogs pa kha yar zhig la rab gnas zhus pas/ rab gnas kyi cho ga mdzad nas car gyis gzims pas/ der ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis rje btsun chen po khyed la me tog gtor mi mnga' yang*/ nged tsho'i snang ngo la me tog gtor ba cig mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ rang bzhin rten 'brel zab mo'i chos// gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i ngang*// nga mi la ras pa rgas nas ni// me tog 'thor bar ga la nus// dgos na lha rang me tog long*/ gsungs pas thang sku'i lha rnams byon te/ me tog snyim pa re blangs te thugs kar bzung nas bzhugs te zla ba phyed du ma gog par gnas so// de la/ mi la rgas nas ma long par/ mkha' 'gros dngos grub me tog 'thor// thub pa chos kyi sku can gyis// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rang bzhin gyis// gzugs sku zhen med me tog 'thor/ slar yang de nyid rang la thim// de la ngo mtshar skyes pa bzang*// zhes gsungs/ yang dus der skyo bsang la byon pas 'khor kun gyis/ ri rtser mthon po 'dug pas sku ngal 'gro zhus pas/ mthu chen ri rtser 'gro 'dod pas/ 'gro bar mi nus lus po sgur// mi la ras pa rgas nas gda'// glan pa'i ri khyod car gyis nyol// zhes gsungs pas/ ri de yur gyis nyal te rje btsun gyis phyogs su bsgur nas byung*/ rje btsun byon pa dang ri de mtho zang ste sngar bas ches mtho bar song ngo*// de nas rje btsun gyi drung du yon bdag bkra shis brtsegs dang legs se gnyis kyis tshogs drangs te/ yon bdag 'gas chos 'brel zhus pas mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o skol 'gro ba 'jig rten pa// skye rga na 'chi chu bo bzhi// chu bo 'di las phyi ma che// gru pa tshags su tshud lags sam// bdud dang srin po gshin rje gsum// 'jigs pa 'di las phyi ma che// skyel ma grabs su tshud lags sam// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// zhe 'dris 'di las phyi ma che// gnyen po tshags su tshud lags sam// khams gsum 'khor ba'i yul po cher// shul thag 'di las phyi ma ring*// brgyags phye grabs su tshud lags sam// zhes gsungs pas/

bla ma lags/ de rnams nged tsho'i mi shes pas gang yin zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// bla ma mkhas pa bsten pa la// 'khor 'das skyel ma zer ba yin// sbyin pa 'phangs med gtong ba la// lam gyi brgyags phye thog pa yin// nyams myong mun pa zla shar 'dra// gnyen po bzang po zer ba yin// bsags pa chos la btang ba de// gru gzings tshags su 'dzud pa yin// lta ba phyogs ris med pa yin// sgom pa yengs su med pa yin// dam tshig bla ma mnyes pa yin// 'bras bu 'chi khar 'gyod med yin// zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor rnams dad pa skyes nas lo gnyis bshos 'dren zer ba la ma gnang ste mgur 'di gsungs so// gnyen dang yon bdag slob ma gsum// rnal 'byor nga la dgos rgyu chung*// khyed 'khor ba pa la dgos pa yin// phyag dang zhe sa tshul 'chos gsum// nged rnal 'byor pa la dgos rgyu chung*/ khyed chos brgyad mkhan la dgos pa yin// rdzas dang yo byad 'du 'dzi gsum// rnal 'byor pa la dgos rgyu chung*// mi khe grags can la dgos pa yin// khrus dang gtsang sbra rtog pa gsum// nga rnal 'byor pa la dgos rgyu chung*// khyed gzhon nu ma la dgos pa yin// ma dgos bcu gnyis bya ba lags// rnal 'byor ras pa'i kha po 'di// slob ma rnams kyis blo la zung*// 'du 'dzis skyo na dben pa bsten// snying rus che na gcig pur sdod// byang chub 'dod na sgom bsran bskyed// bdud gsum dgra las rgyal bar nges// zhes gsungs pas de rnams dad pa skyes te snang ba chos la 'gyur ro// de thams cad chu bar gyi skor ro/// /de nas yon bdag lcam mes bsnyen bkur byas nas bsngo ba zhus pas/ bsngo ba 'di la zhing*/ bsam pa/ dngos po/ cho ga /blo/ dmigs pa/ smon lam dang bdun ldan pa cig dgos pas dka' gsungs pas yid la med par 'phags ma sgrol ma nam mkha' la byon nas 'di gsungs so// a la la/

skyas bu chen po 'jigs ma dgos// tshogs rnams ma lus thams cad kun// sangs rgyas 'grub par bya ba'i thabs// nga la yod pas len mo mdzod// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// dge 'dun bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis// thog med 'khor ba chen po nas// sbyin dang tshul khrims sgom pa yi// dge bgyis bgyid stsal rjes yi rang*// da ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba 'dis// sbyin pa dam pa sems kyi ni// rgyan dang yo byad rnal 'byor gyi/ tshogs su gyur te pha ma dang*// mkhan po slob dpon la sogs kyi// ched du sangs rgyas thob par shog /ma thob bar du bdag dge 'dis// theg chen bla ma dam bsten nas// sdom gsum gnas pa'i lus ldan te// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub cing*// phan tshun sdig sogs med par shog /'di yang dge 'byung bsod nams kyis// tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dang*/ 'khor dang dge sbyor la sogs pa// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyis// thar pa'i srog cod byed pa yi// bar du gcod pa zhi gyur cig /ces gsungs nas bla ma dang thams cad kyi bsngo ba dus gcig la mdzad do// de thams cad lcam me'i shol bgos ba'i skor ro/// /de nas yang rje btsun dang*/ ras chung pa dpon slob gnyis snye nam tshar ma na bzhugs pa'i dus su rje btsun dum pa cig bsnyung ba la/ ras chung pa grogs du sman dang 'o ma 'tshol du btang ba la yun ring 'gor nas da re phyi mo ma byung*/ der rje btsun gyi dgongs pa la/ khong na so gzhon pas 'dod yon la chags dgongs nas/ sku rgyab log ge bstan nas bzhugs pas/ ras chung pas nga 'dod yon la chags pa min/ nyams 'di 'dra ba skyes pa yin zhus nas mgur phul ba/ bdag bla ma'i drung du 'dug pa'i tshe// mtshon ngar ma lta bu'i nyams shig shar// sgro 'dogs chod pa'i rnal 'byor blo re bde// sems ma bcos pa 'di sangs rgyas su gda'// bdag grogs po'i nang du 'dug tsam na// snang gsal mar me lta bu'i nyams shig shar/

gdams ngag gsal bde 'ong ba'i rnal 'byor blo re bde// bdag gangs dkar rtse la 'dug pa'i tshe// seng ge dkar mo lta bu'i nyams shig shar// gzhan snang zil gyi gnon pa'i rnal 'byor blo re bde// bdag brag dmar rtse la 'dug pa'i tshe// bya rgod po lta bu'i nyams shig shar// spyi rgya rlabs kyis gcod pa'i rnal 'byor blo re bde// bdag 'khor ba'i 'dam du 'dug pa'i tshe// me tog padma lta bu'i nyams shig shar// 'khor ba'i skyon gyi ma gos rnal 'byor blo re bde// bdag mi chos gseb tu 'dug pa'i tshe// dngul chu dkar mo lta bu'i nyams shig shar// reg la ma 'byar gyi rnal 'byor blo re bde// bdag rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim pa'i tshe// stag chung bung ba lta bu'i nyams shig shar// chags la ma zhen rnal 'byor blo re bde// bdag nya ma'i nang du 'dug pa'i tshe// pha rje btsun lta bu'i nyams shig shar// gdams ngag dbyangs su len pa'i rnal 'byor blo re bde// sems ma bcos pa 'di sangs rgyas su gda'// zhes nyams shar brgyad ras chung pas phul bas/ rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ bu khyod la nyams de 'dra yod kyang*/ lta ba 'di 'dra ba med/ khyod rang nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// na mo gu ru/ dad pa gting nas skyes tsam nas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// me 'obs nang du tshud pa 'dra/ mtshon byed snyan khung brgyud pa yi// gdam ngag snying la zhan pa 'di// lan tshwa chu la thim pa 'dra// ye shes nang nas shar tsam na// yin min the tshom 'phreng ba de// snyoms byed rmi lam sangs pa 'dra// lta ba bde chen zin tsam na// 'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams kun// rang grol chab kyi lbu ba 'dra// shes bya'i gshis la pheb tsam na// gnas lugs rig pa'i ye shes 'di// sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' 'dra// 'byung ba dngas snyigs phyed tsam na// rang byung rig pa'i ye shes 'di// dngul dkar me long phyis pa 'dra// kun gzhi chos skur thim tsam na// skye gnas srid len phung po 'di// sgo nga rdog pas brdzis pa 'dra// 'dzin pa'i thag pa chad tsam na/

sa mtshams srid pa'i bar do de// sbrul las byas pa'i mdud pa 'dra// spyod pa blang dor grol tsam na// sems bya bral kyi ngang la gnas pa de// rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i seng ge 'dra/ snang gsal stong gsal ye shes gsal// gsal ba gsum dang 'grogs tsam na// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar 'dra// yul snang dbang po rtags kyang 'gyel// sems dang phung po 'ching thag chad// mi lus rin chen chud ma gsan// nga rnal 'byor so nam zin nam snyam// mi khyod la de 'dra cang yod dam// rlom sems ma che ras chung pa// zhes gsungs pa lags so// yang rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ grongs la khyam khyam rnal 'byor rnams// gnyen dang grogs kyi don gnyer zhing*// spyod pa tshul 'chos tho cor shor// rig stong dbyer med rgyang du lus// rnam rtog khrod na nyon re mongs// 'chi khar 'gyod dam mi mchi'am// sems la 'od gsal shar ba yis// skye med ngo bo rtogs te bde// 'du ba rnam bzhi 'dres pa yi// lus la na tsha med de bde// gtum mo me ltar 'bar ba yi// 'khyags pa'i bsam pa med de bde// khams kyi zas dang ma bral yang*// sangs rgyas can gyis btegs te bde/ dpon med g.yog med ngang gis bde// 'di zhes med pa'i rang spyod bde// bde bas bde ba logs na med/ yang rje btsun gyis gsungs pa/ rje bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag de// kha tshig rkyang par ma shor dam// so sor rtog pa'i shes rab de// gnyis 'dzin phyogs su ma shor ram// rtogs par byed pa'i lta ba de// gzung 'dzin dgra yis ma khyer ram// gnyis med bsam gtan bsgom pa de// zug rngu'i 'phrang la ma rdug gam// ro snyoms byed pa'i spyod pa de// the tshom yan par ma shor ram// mya ngan 'das pa'i 'bras bu de// gzhan nas thob tu mi re'am// rgyud la ma 'brel nyams myong de// lkog chab bzhin du mi bting ngam/ sems nyid gnyug ma stong pa de// sgro skur gnyis kyis ma bslad dam// ri khrod 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor kun// ngo srung bdud kyis ma khyer ram// ma rig 'khrul pa'i 'khor ba de// rdza chag bzhin du ma bor ram// zhes gsungs so// de nas rje btsun snye nam tsar ma'i ri la byon pa'i lam du yon bdag pho mo mang po 'dus pas khyed tsho 'dir ci yin gsungs pa la/

nged tsho grong stod nas nged kyi mna' ma khyer nas 'khrug pa byung bas/ bla ma la 'dun ma zhig zhu bsam zer nas/ mna' ma 'di yin zer ba'i bud med rdzong mang po btags pa cig 'dug pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ngas 'dun ma mi shes/ phung rdo ma khyod nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// mgo la rdo khur gyi rang rtsis can// rang la rtsod med kyi phung rdo ma// mi la mi shor gyi rang rtsis can// yul khams ma dkrugs rang sar sdod// phyi la dmar smug gi nang rul ma/ yid la khyo 'dod kyi gzhung ngan ma// mi la khyod med kyi gdams nga can// rgyal khams ma phung rang sar sdod// nang na snying med kyi mgo 'phags can// sems la khrel med kyi bzang 'dod la// gtam la rin med kyi sgeg sgeg can// phung gsum ma g.yo rang sar sdod// lar phung gi rtsa ba bud med yin// yul ngan gyi nad ngan mi ngan yin// yul ngan dus ngan mna' ma 'di// lod la rin thang che bar 'dug /rtsog la rtsod mi mang bar 'dug /de 'jig rten bsam rlag spyod pa yin// gzhon 'khrug pa ma byed rang srog gces// rgan g.yo sgyu ma mang rang la sdig /khrom 'dir 'tshogs kyi kha lo chos la sgyur// zhes gsungs pas 'khrug pa rang zhi la song*/ phyis kyang yul der 'khrug pa med do// der yon bdag pho mo tshos chos 'brel zhig zhu zer bas/ mgur 'di gsungs so// e ma 'gro ba 'jig rten pa// lus g.yu ljang bzhin du bskyangs bskyangs nas// rkyen sdong rgan bzhin du 'gyel zhing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod dang*// nor rdzas sbrang rtsi bzhin du bsags bsags kyang*// rkyen ba mo bzhin du 'ong zhing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod dang*// 'phyor dang khra bzhin du pur pur 'dug kyang*// rkyen 'ja' tshon bzhin du yar zhing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod dang*// gnyen ri dwags bzhin du 'grogs 'grogs kyang*/

rkyen rngon pa bzhin du sleb cing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod dang*// bu sgo nga bzhin du gsos gsos kyang*// rkyen lam rdo bzhin du 'phrad cing gda'// skabs skabs su ma yengs pa'i bya ra re mdzod dang*// byad me tog bzhin du mdzes mdzes kyang*// rkyen ser ba bzhin du 'grim zhing 'dug /skabs skabs su mi rtag skyo shas re bskyed dang*// grogs ma bu bzhin du bzang bzang yang*// rkyen dgra gnyen bzhin du 'thab cing 'dug /skabs skabs su sems can la snying rje re skyed dang*// skyid nye ba bzhin du 'od 'od yang*// rkyen rlung dmar bzhin du 'tshub cing 'dug /skabs skabs su ma nus pa la sbyin pa re thong dang*// 'dir 'tshogs kyi yon bdag pho mo rnams// dam pa'i lha chos ma nus na/ tshe ring por bsdad kyang ngan ring yin// las mang po 'bad pa sdug las yin// zhes gsungs pas khong rnams dad pa skyes te bla ma thugs mi brel na/ da rung tshogs gsog kyang 'dren/ chos kyang nyan 'dod zer bas ma bzhed de mgur 'di gsungs so// gangs stod kyi seng ge dkar mo dang*// dal yang dal la brel yang brel/ dal bas gangs dkar ltongs su 'gyings// brel bas zur kha yangs la 'grim// dal brel med par dpa' ting nge// nags gseb kyi stag mo ri bkra de// dal yang dal la brel yang brel// dal bas nags ma'i gseb tu nyal// brel bas sa 'phrang yangs la 'grim// dal brel med par 'dzum khug ge /brag dkar gyi bya rgyal rgod po nga*// dal yang dal la brel yang brel// dal bas brag dkar rdzong la nyal// brel bas nam 'phang yangs la 'phur// dal brel med par mtho ling nge// gung thang gi mi la ras pa nga*// dal yang dal la brel yang brel// dal bas 'jig rten bya ba btang*// brel bas skad cig yengs su med// dal brel med par dga' ya le// khyed 'dir bzhugs grwa pa yon bdag rnams// dal brel ma rtsir chos la 'bungs// zhes dang*/

da ni kho bo yun ring por mi sdod/ snye nam tsar ma'i ri 'di la yun ring du bsdad pas khyod yon rnams dang mjal bas dga' gsungs nas/ yon bdag rnams la chos mang po gsungs pas chos la dad pa dang*/ 'khrug pa dang nad yams la sogs pa med par gyur te/ de thams cad snye nam rtsar ma'i skor ro/// /de nas ras chung pas bla ma la nyams nges pa can yod nges pas nga la bstan par zhu zhus pas/ ngas bstan par dka' khyed rang bsgom dang shes nas 'ong gsungs da khyed lo du ma nas grongs ngas kyang de snga zhabs tog byas pas/ rtags ci 'dra 'ong zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ da khyod nga dang 'phreng mi dgos pa'i rgyu bzhi yod/ 'byung ba bzhi la dbang thob pas nad g.yog mi dgos/ shi yang mi yul du ro mi lus pas ro khur mi dgos/ gdung ring bsrel mkha' 'gro mas mkha' spyod du gdan 'dren pas ro med/ gdams ngag sgro 'dogs chod pas gsal 'debs mi dgos/ myong ba la brtan pa zin pas skyel ma mi dgos// mthong snang yang gang zag gi dbang po'i bye brag gi mthong ba yin/ nga rang la bar do med/ bar do mi mthong nges/ de snga mthong mthong bas zad nus pa yin gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// bla med theg pa mchog gi lam// shes rab snying rje ldan tsam na// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// me 'obs nang du tshud pa la// 'byung ba dngas snyigs phyed pa yi// rnal 'byor lus kyi me tog rgyas// sems can 'brel tshad drangs pa yin// khams rang bzhi rnam par dag pa 'di// chu yi nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar// zab mo skye ba med pa'i don// mtshon byed nyams kyi brgyud pa 'di// gdams ngag snying la zhen pa 'di// lan tshwa chu la thim pa 'dra// ye shes nang nas shar ba yis// sems dang phung po 'ching thag grol// the tshom chod pa'i shes pa 'di// nyams byed rmi lam sangs pa 'dra// shes bya gshis la phebs pa 'di// yul dang dbang po rtags gyes la// bden zhen 'thad pa'i snang ba 'di// gnyis med chab kyi lbu ba 'dra// rnam dag lta ba'i gdings zin pas// don dam sgrib med ye shes thob// rang byung lhun grub gnyug ma 'di// sprin thag chad pa'i nam mkha' 'dra// sgom byar med ngang la gnas pa yi// snang gsal stong gsal ye shes gsal// gnas lugs rig pa'i ye shes 'di// dngul dkar me long phyis pa 'dra// spyod pa blang dor med pa yi// thabs kyi 'khor bar mi gnas la// shes rab gsum gyis grol ba yis// rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i seng ge 'dra// kun gzhi'i chos skur thim pa yi// las kyi sa bon gting nas zad// skye gnas srid len phung po 'di// sgo nga rdog pas rji nga 'dra// gzungs 'dzin thag pa chod pa yi// sems nyid ma bu mjal dus su// so mtshams srid pa'i bar do 'dir// rang grol sbrul gyi mdud pa 'dra// yon tan rdzogs pa'i bar do 'dir// zab mo snyan brgyud mtshams sbyar nas// sems skye med 'od gsal 'phro dus su// mi nga la mthong snang sna tshogs 'ong*// khyed rnams rang snang gi mthong ba yin// zhes gsungs nas ras chung pa lho phyogs kyi zur kha/

sham po'i gangs/ byar po'i nags/ sgom gnas rdo bod kyi so mtshams su lung bstan nas ras chung pa dbus su brdzangs te/ ma 'gro bzlas dus 'gro rang zer/ da ni ma sdod song la 'gro don gyis gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// pha yi bu chen ras chung pa// dbu ru bod kyi dbus su song*// bu bzhi'i nang gi don po khyod// bla ma spyi bor bsgom zhing song*// brgyud pa nang gi sras bu khyod// dam tshig yeng med bsrung zhing song*// snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i sgron me khyod// ma rig mun pa sel zhing song*// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing khyod// skal ldan rnams la spel zhing song*// skal med rnams la gsang zhing song*// bstan pa'i sgron me 'dzugs shing song*// skal ldan thugs rjes 'dzin zhing song*// lho phyogs zur kha 'grim zhing song*// sham po'i gangs la sgom du song*// rdo bod mtshams su dgon pa thob// ces gsungs nas lung bstan pas/ ras chung pas phyag gsum 'tshal nas mgur 'di phul lo// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku// dus rgyun par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sngon 'khor ba'i btson rar 'khyams pa la// yang yang thugs rje'i lcags kyu zung*// da phyir mi ldog pa thar pa'i yul// sku gsum 'bras bu'i rgyal sar byung*// bla med mchod pa rgyun par 'bul// thugs bde chen ngang du bzhes su gsol// da snang ba a 'thas med pa dang*// rnal 'byor chags 'dzin med pa dang*/ sdod pa nges pa med pa'i phyir// phyogs med ldom bu ri khrod zhu// ras chung mi 'dug dbus su 'gro// ras pa'i bu chen ras chung nga*// bla ma spyi bor khur zhing 'gro// bu bzhi'i don po ras chung nga*// dam tshig yengs med bsrung zhing 'gro// brgyud pa'i tha chung ras chung nga*// snod ldan rnams la spel zhing 'gro// snod med rnams la gsang zhing 'gro// snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i sgron med nga*// ma rig mun pa sel zhing 'gro// bstan pa'i sgron me ras chung nga*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan phyar zhing 'gro// nga song ba'i shul du bla ma rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sku// 'gro ba'i mgon po bde bar bzhugs// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// skur gyur bla ma bde bar bzhugs// sku gsum rang bzhin rdo rje 'chang*// mnyam med bla ma bde bar bzhugs// mngon shes rig pa rdzu 'phrul can// chos kyi spyan can bde bar bzhugs// sku drin 'khor med rin po che// ma rig mun sel bde bar bzhugs/

mjal bas don ldan mthu stobs can// byang chub lam mkhan bde bar bzhugs// bdag gi bla ma kun gyi bshes// 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas bde bar bzhugs// zhes zhus te ras chung pa spyan chab phrul le byung nas yus kyi brnangs te tshig thon yang dbyangs ma thon pas/ bya 'ang cig grag pa'i skad de la dpe byas nas smon lam drug gi mgur 'di phul lo// 'gro drug gi sems dang rgyal ba'i thugs// rnam rtog gi dbang gi so so ste// chos nyid kyi ngang du gcig pa des// rtog med dbyings su mjal bar zhu// dgung sngon gyi dbyings dang nyi zla'i zer// gling bzhi'i dbang gis shar nub byung*// 'od zer dang mdangs la 'du 'bral med// dgung sngon gyi dbyings su mjal bar zhu// bod yul chu dang rgya gar chu// lung pa'i dbang gi so so ste// 'byung bzhi'i ngang du gcig pa des// rgya mtsho'i klong du mjal bar zhu// gzhi rang la yod pa'i ye shes dang*// 'phral la skyes pa'i rnam rtog gnyis// chos nyid kyi ngang du gcig pa des// rnam rtog zad tsa mjal bar zhu// gcig pur sdod pa'i ri khrod dang*/ mang po tshogs pa'i grong yul gnyis// bzhugs tshul gyi dbang gi so so ste// rang sems dben pa'i don rtogs nas// ye shes kyi dbyings su mjal bar zhu// pha rje btsun ri la bzhugs pa dang*// ras chung dbus su 'gro ba gnyis// dam tshig mngon lkog ma mchis pas// 'og min gnas su mjal bar zhu// pha rje btsun sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ sngar yang bka' drin yang yang che// da yang byin gyis brlab par zhu// zhes zhus te mig mchi mas gang bzhin zhabs la 'jus nas spyi bor bzhag ste/ rdo rje sku yis byin gyis rlobs/ tshangs pa'i gsung gis bar chad sol// rtogs med thugs kyi lam sna drongs// pha rje btsun sku khams bde bar bzhugs// bu ras chung dbus su 'gro ba la// bka' drin gyi skyel ma da dung mdzod// zhes ngu zhing zhus pas ras chung pa'i dbyangs la snyan pa des rje btsun yang thugs g.yo ba byung ngo*// de nas bla mas ras chung pa'i lag pa nas bzung ste snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag rje gnang rdzogs par gnang nas 'di gsungs so// bu lta ba phyogs ris ma byed ang*// sgom pa ri khrod zung shig ang*// spyod pa grogs ngan spongs shig ang*// dam tshig snang ba bstun cig ang*// 'bras bu 'chi ba som shig ang*/

de ltar du nus na thams cad tshur la ston mkhan gyi bla ma ni nga dang 'dra ba yang nas yang du 'ong*/ ngas yang dang yang du nyul lo gsungs pas/ ras chung pa/ da gdams ngag ma lus ang zhus pas/ gcig lus la 'gol sar chas la bstan gsungs pas ci yin bsam tsa/ bla mas ras chung pa'i mgo la phyag gis brgyab ste/ 'chi ba 'chi ba 'chi ba/ tug ge tug ge tug ge /sa na sa na sa na/ 'ong ngo 'ong ngo 'ong ngo gsungs te/ khong dang bsgoms bsgoms pa'i 'phong spre'u'i 'phong bzhin sha ro dang*/ rmen por song ba de bstan nas 'di bas zab pa med gsungs so// de nas ras chung pa kho thag chod nas dbus su song ngo*// de thams cad dbus gtad zhal ta'i skor ro/// /de nas lha cig gis mdze pho'i g.yog dang bong sna khrid cing yod pa la/ mi gcig gis ras chung pa rong sog rtse gong du bzhugs nas mdze nad brgya re phan zer bas de ma thag tu lha cig sprang zhing 'ong bas ras chung pa'i drung du sleb/ rin chen grags kyis ras chung pa la zhus pa/ mo g.yu la dga' ba cig yod gsungs nas g.yu drug dkar spar ba gang bskur bas 'di khyer la song gsungs pas/ mo la g.yu mi dgos bshags pa byed du 'ong ba yin/ bshags pa dang du mi len na gson sdug pas shi ba skyid zer ba zhus pas/ 'o na nged gnyis kyi bar du ras kyi yol ba thong la 'ong chug gsungs nas nang du 'ong ma 'ong la yus kyi brnangs te glu 'di phul lo// pha bshags pa dang du bzhes par zhu// pha bshags pa dang du mi len na// sdug gri gu sor gsum snying la 'dzug /tshe 'di yi 'du byed kyi gum pa la// gtam snyan pa'i bzang ngan ci sgrogs pa// pha ras chung pa yi thugs kyis mkhyen// lar mi shes mun pa sel ba dka'// 'gyod pa che ste bya thabs med// las ngan las kyi la yog de// tshe 'di la smin pa nus pa che// lus ngan grib ma'i mdze grogs de// sdug bsngal nad kyis gdung ba la// snying rje dang byin rlabs ma chung bar// thugs rje'i lcags kyus dam du zung*// zhes zhus pas/

ras chung pas sdig sbyong mgur 'di gsungs so// sho la tsa ma na nga re 'jigs// bla ma rdung ba'i mthu mo che// sbar shad byed pa'i sen rnon ma// dpe bum 'phrog pa'i dbang mo che// skyag kha zlo ba'i smra mkhan ma// khyod dang rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis// sngon las rkyen gyis lhan du 'dzom// rang len rang gi sdug bsngal spyod// khyod rin srog dang des bral byas// khyod bla ma bskyur nas zhang dang 'grogs// nad g.yog gi sdug bsngal ma spyad dam// rgyal mkhar bzhag la sgo zhug 'grim// mi kha'i dmag gis ma bskor ram// rta pho bzhag nas bong sna khrid// yi mug rgyun du ma skyes sam// nor gsog 'jog bzhag na rdog khams sgug /mu ge'i rdzong la ma bsdad dam// the phrug bzhag nas ra slag gyon// shig sro ma'i bu lon ma chags sam// zhes gsungs pas/ mo yis glu 'di phul lo// pha yi bu chen ras chung pa// rje ras chung pa la gsol ba 'debs// nga skye sar skyes pa'i rang rtsis dang*// sgyu ma nor gyi rang mthong dang*// bsam pa brlag pa'i spyod pa dang*// rang 'byor che ba'i rang dbang dang*// zhe sdang 'khrugs pa'i nga rgyal gyis// pha bla ma'i bu la gnong 'gyod shor// nga lha mi khros pas mtshar zlos byas// tshang zla rogs mos zhe khre la bcug /rgyal po pha yis khrims la gtad// la yog khrel gyi mdze phos sleb// sdug bsngal sprang gi tha mas bskor// ra slag dug po dgu brtsegs la/ shig sro ma'i bu lon 'khor snyam med// bong sna mdze pho'i nad g.yog la// sdug bsngal yi mug mdzad snyam med// da bshags pa dang du len par zhu// bshags pa dang du mi len na/ nam yang sdug grir 'chi ba la// pha rje btsun khyed kyi drung du 'gum// bdag lha chos snying nas bsam ste mchi// khyed ma brjed thugs rjes bzung du gsol// zhes zhus pas ras chung pa snying rje skyes pas gser mang ba zhig bla mas bskul yod pa mo la byin nas mgur 'di gsungs so// skyes mchog mi la'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// bka' drin yang yang zin par thugs rje zung*// khyed sngar dang mi 'dra bla bo bshan// nga bla ma'i drung du bros nas song*// 'o skol 'thab gzhi'i g.yu mo che// maṇḍal steng du bzhag nas 'dug

/de mthong so so ba spu g.yo// sngar dbus su ma 'gro ma 'gro gsungs// da dbus su song cig song cig gsungs// de dran zhing kho bo ngo mtshar skyes// pha rje btsun de yi rnam thar la// gser dang sa rdo khyad par med// gser 'di khyer cig khyer cig gsungs// de dran zhing kho bo yi rang skyes// pha yis gnang ba'i gser 'di// sangs rgyas sku 'dra mang du bzhengs// des lus kyi sgrib pa 'dag pa yin// gzungs sngags cho ga mang du thon// des ngag gi sgrib pa 'dag pa yin// mchod rte tshwa tshwa mang du gyis// des yid kyi sgrib pa 'dag pa yin// nang du rang sems dpang por zhog /don du snyan brgyud gdams ngag sgom// yang yang rje la gsol ba thob// skabs su 'gyod pa yang yang bskyed// de ltar mdzod dang don chen 'grub// ces gsungs pas mo dga' ste/ gsungs pa bzhin byas nas phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas te smyugs khams kyang je bde la song nas mdze pho dang lha cig gnyis ka'i mdze sos so// de nas snyan brgyud kyi khrid gnang nas bsgom du bcug pas nyams rtogs pa skyes te rang byung gi grub thob ma bzang mo zhig byung ste/ phar la khrid 'debs nus pa cig byung ngo*// ras chung pa dbus su lan gnyis byon pa'i phyi tha la bla mas lung bstan nas lha cig la sogs pa mdze pho mang po smin par mdzad cing grol nus pa'o// de thams cad rong sog rtse gong gi skor ro/// /de nas rje btsun gyis snye nam pa'i mi dang ma 'phrad pa thams cad shog gyis la skad thong*/ nga dang 'brel pa yod pa rnams kyis tshogs 'khor rgyu re khyer la shog gsungs nas/ der thams cad tshogs pa dang tshogs 'khor dang*/ dkyil 'khor dang chab gtor mang du mdzad bcug pa la/ nam mkha' nas 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang me tog mang po babs pas 'di rnams ci yin nam zer ba'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// nam mkha' chos dbyings dag pa la// lha dang lha mo'i chos nyan sleb// khyod skye bo phal pas ga la mthong*// ngas ni thams cad sa ler mthong*// 'dir tshogs khrom pa chos la nyon// sngon nas las ngan bsags bsags pas// ma la skyes nas sdig las dga'// cis kyang dge ba mi 'dod cing*// rgas kyang bsam pa mi dge ba// las kyi rnam smin du ba yin// sdig de bshags pas e 'dag pa// dge ba dran na 'dag pa yin// lar bsam pa shes la sdig spyod pa// khams zan gtam ngan rje ba yin// rang yang gar 'gro mi shes pas// rog la gnod pa sna tshogs pa// rang gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs spyod// da nges par sdug bsngal mi 'dod na// gzhan la gnod pa thams cad spangs// lha dang bla ma'i zhabs drung du// sdig pa 'gyod pas bshags pa gyis// phyin chad mi byed dam bca' na// myur du dam pa'i sdom pa yin// lar sdig can phal cher dbang po nyams// bsran tshugs med par yengs la dga'// chos kyi snang ba bral snyam na// da rung las ngan yod rtags yin// de la bshags pa yang yang gyis// zhes gsungs pas khrom pa rnams kyis bshags pa byas/

sdig pa 'bul mkhan yang mang du byung*/ nya pa cig gi nya rgya zhig phul bas/ khyod kyi nya ci tsam bsad nga la 'di 'bul nas ci byed gsungs pas/ rgya so ma zhig byas yod pas 'di 'bul ba yin zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas a mtshar po/ rgya so ma byas nas rnying pa phul bas phan pa med/ nya gting nas mi gsod par khas long gsungs pas/ des na nga ltogs grir 'chi/ nyag nyog yang mang zhus pas/ khyod ltogs grir mi 'chi ba'i khag ngas khur/ de bas nga yi glu 'di la nyon gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// ma ki rgya nag gi shan pa de// mi rang bas bzang ba mang po gsod// mi sha la dang kha mi log par// mi sha zos zos god sha rlag /lus lag khog tsam de ma sos pas// las de 'dra byed cing dmyal bar 'gro// las de'ang bsam na snying rlung ldang*/ bu nya pa sdig pa phul dang skyid// ma ki lho mon gyi sa mtha' na// ma rgan mo gsod nas mna' ma len// zhing ngan pa khyi phag zhabs tog byed// las ngan pa ma sha bu yis za// sdig chen po pha ma gsod pa'i mi/ mnar med kyi dmyal bar rgyun du bsregs// las de 'dra grub pa'i go chod po// 'di 'dra dran zhing snang ba yang yang 'khrugs// bu nya pa sdig pa phul dang brgyags// byang re'u lug skyong ba'i 'brog pa rnams// re'u lug bu phrug bzhin du gsos gsos nas// yar tshar tsa rgyab la myong myong byed// gang tsho gang tshor ngan sngags 'debs// rang bas drung ba myags se gsod// khyim ni gshin rje'i khang pa bzhin// nyin gcig bde skyid de la rag /de zho bal byin pa'i drin len yin// de dran zhing mchi ma khong nas 'khrugs// bu nya pa sdig pa phul na dga'// pha ki byang kha'i ri shi des// sems can gang mthong zas su mthong*// nyes med sems can gsod la dga'// drung drung cor cor mgo pug la// ya nga bag tsam mi skye bar/ spru zing nge khur nas pho byas snyam// kha byi khung tsam cig ma sos pas// las de 'dra byed cing dmyal bar 'gro// 'di dran cing bsam pa yang yang 'khrugs// bu nya pa sdig pa phul na dga'// nub kyi ma sang mtsho 'gram nang*// khyod nya pa rgad pos nya rgya bsgrubs// rgya rtsing zhib gsum du yod do skad// nya che chung gsum du 'dzin no skad// ngan la mgo drung bsam rlag po// nya mang du sod kyang ltogs su 'gro// kha thogs brgya brgya lto thob re// drung hrog ge za ba kha mi g.ya'// lar snying rje 'di ni gol sa che// bu smad snying rjes gso'o skad// tshang phung rdza log byung na ci ma rung*// las de 'dra spyad cing gso gso yang*// pha ma bu gsum dmyal bar 'gro// phan 'dogs gnod pas 'jigs pa'i rgyu// phan de 'dra ma byed lha chos mdzod// nga 'di 'dra dran zhing yi mug 'khrugs// bu nya pa sdig pa phul dang bzang*// zhes gsungs pas nya pa dad pa skyes nas mchi ma mang po byung nas des rkyen byas te sdig pa byed mkhan rnams snying tsha tsha zing song bas/

ri dwags khyod tshad kyis phul lo// nya pas nya rgya dang sdig pa phul/ srog sdom blangs nas pha ma bu gsum gyis ma ṇi dung phyur re re khas blangs pas nya pa skyid pa dang dar brgyags su song nas/ shi ba'i dus su yang pha ma bu gsum sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lhar skyes so// de la brten nas rje btsun dang mngon dga'i zhing du mjal lo// de nas yon bdag gcig gis nged 'di tshos sdig pa mi byed bsam yang*/ 'jig rten pa'i las 'di sdig pa re mi byed pa'i thabs ma byung*/ dpon dang rje bo dang chen po rnams kyang sdig pa la mnyes par 'dug /sdig nus tshad rgod por rtsi ba gda'/ khong mi che che dang dbang che che la zhal lta re mdzod// zhes zhus pa'i lan du mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o na yon bdag bsam pa can// bsam pa bzang po'i kha tshig legs// chen po lus ngan las kyis 'khrul// rgyal ngan mi ngan gyi kha la nyan// dpon ngan g.yog gi kha lo sgyur// mi ngan kha yi zas la gnyag /bsam ngan 'khrugs pa'i phung gzhi bskul// 'di bsam na rnal 'byor zhen pa log /bu dad can dam pa'i lha chos mdzod// lar ring por mi sdod 'chi ba la// rta brgya brgya yod kyang rkang thang 'gro// gos brgya brgya yod kyang gcer bur 'gro// 'bri brgya brgya yod kyang be'u rked bskyu// nor sdug gsog byas kyang mi yis spyod// khyed phyug po'i nor la zhen pa log /bu dad pa can yod tshad chos la thong*// dmag brgya brgya'i nang nas rang mgo thon// 'thab tshod dang 'bros tshod mi shes par// 'khrug pa'i sna la rang srog gtong*// kho shi bas phan pa yod do skad// khyed dpa' bos 'thab mo shin tu 'jigs// bu dad pa can bzod pa sgoms shig ang*// gong du chos rgyal gyi bka' khrims med// sdig pa'i tshogs dpon la blo gtad med// zas ngo'i 'dun ma la mi nag chad// khram pa'i zhal lce snying la gzan// mi dpon gyi kha ta ngas mi 'ong*// bu dad pa can rang mgo bton nam legs// mi ngan gyi g.yog pos khrel ngan bsgo// gtam nga na je zlos je mang 'gro// gzhung ngan las ngan snang ba 'khrul// kha mchu'i gzhi ma ngas mi 'dod// bu dad pa can rang rtsis chung bar mdzod// bu phrug gi skyong bran rang skal 'chad// re'u lug gi bdag po sdig pa che// chung ma'i zhabs tog phugs su lhung*// khrel ngan gyi rku rdzun gnong 'gyod che// bu dad pa can lha chos sems can gyis// zhes gsungs pas yon bdag dad pa skyes nas bsags tshad chos la btang nas sdig pa phul/

skyabs 'gro dang*/ phyag bskor dang*/ ma ṇi rang*/ brjod pas shi ba'i dus thar pa'i go 'phang thob bo// yang 'gas nged la yang zhabs tog mdzad par zhu zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ khyed rnams thams cad ngas re re nas bzlas pas mi long*/ gcig la bzlas pa de thams cad kyi skal pa gyis gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas bstod/ khyed dpon po g.yog po skyong 'dod rnams// g.yog la gzan tshor ma byed cig /g.yog pos rje bo khur 'dod rnams// rje la gzhung ngan ma byed cig /phyug po re'u lug skyong 'dod rnams/ rang ma rang gis ma gsod cig /dpa' bo'i stag 'thab byed 'dod rnams// kha mchu 'khrug pa ma bskul cig /mdzangs ma gsog 'jog byed pa rnams// ma 'o la bu skal ma byed cig /gnyen 'dun rnams dang 'grogs 'dod rnams// gshis ngan sdug 'thab ma byed cig /drin chen pha ma khur 'dod rnams/ drin len log pas ma 'jal cig /las dang bya ba byed 'dod rnams// sdig pa'i las dang ma bsgre zhig /dkon mchog la mchod pa byed 'dod rnams// yul dang zhing sa ma nor cig /chu sbyin gtor ma gtong 'dod rnams// ser sna phongs sems ma byed cig /klog dang 'don pa 'dod pa rnams// don la snyogs mo ma tshol cig /gang zhig chos la 'gro 'dod rnams// las ngan phyi bshol ma 'debs shig /tshogs dang mchod pa 'dren pa la// thar pa'i gegs shing ma byed cig /lar dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// chos dang mthun pa'i las mdzod cig /ces gsungs pas der bzhugs pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis nged tshe 'di la sdig pa byas kyang*/ shul du yod pa'i bu dang tsha bos dge ba dang dbang bskur dang*/ cho ga la mchod pa skyong ba yin zer bas bla ma thugs skyo nas mgur 'di gsungs so// khyed mi mang kha la nyan phyogs med// tshwa sgog g.yer ram thu lu lu// khyed col col mkhan rnams nga la nyon// khyed dbang po tshang ring sdig byed rnams// shi tsa ro la dbang bskur byed// mdang sum nor bu bor ba la// rkun ma'i rjes la rdo rgyag 'dra// tshe 'dir sdug gsog byed byed nas// shi tsa rjes su gtong ngo skad// sems can shi ba'i thed rul la// gcan gzan bya khyis za ba 'dra// dge bshes bzang por mtshan gsol yang*// nor gyi phyir du cho ga byed// blun po tshogs pa'i grong khyer du// 'byams pas kha bshad byed pa 'dra// bla ma bzang po'i ming btags kyang*// mi shi dga' ba'i sems skyes nas// nga yi ci 'thob bsam pa na// rngon pas ri sul 'grim pa 'dra// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa dang*// bdun tshig cho ga gang byed kyang*// sdig pa bsngos pa'i sdig spyad nas// gshin po'i thar pa'i srog rtsa bcad// dge dang sdig pa mi shes pa'i// brtson 'grus byas kyang ltung ba'i rgyu// rang gis dge la ma btang na// nye bas btang ba khyod dge min// lar kha la nye bzang ba bag chags bzang*// chos bden par brjod pa 'phags pa'i rigs// gtam drang du smra ba rgyal rigs rje// chos nus byed pa dus tshod mkhas// byams kun la phan pa rgyal ba'i sras// dus deng sang khrom pa'i lha mi rnams// kha ya kha ma 'bod lha chos mdzod// ces gsungs pas khong tsho dad pa dang*/

'gyod pa skyes te der tshogs pa'i yon bdag 'brel yod med thams cad kyis sems can mang po tshe thar la gtong ba dang*/ srog sdom len pa dang*/ bsnyen gnas dang*/ kha thon mang po'i dam bca' byed pa dang*/ gzhan yang chos min pa re med par 'dug zer ba'i nges shes skyes pa mang po byung ngo*// de nas yang bla mas khong rnams la 'di gsungs so// snye nam rtsar ma'i bu slob rnams// bdag la khyod rnams bka' drin che// bdag kyang khyed la bka' drin che// bka' drin mnyam pa'i bu slob rnams/ mngon dga'i zhing du mjal bar shog /'dir bzhugs yon bdag thams cad rnams// nad med tshe ring bsod nams ldan// bsam pa log pa mi skye zhing*// bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub par shog /yul phyogs 'dir yang bkra shis shing*// mi ngan 'khrug pa med pa dang*// lo yag 'bru 'phel skyid pa dang*/ kun tu chos la spyod par shog /bdag gi zhal mthong gsung thos dang*// rnam thar yid la dran pa dang*// mtshan ni rna bar thos tshad pa// mngon dga'i zhing du mjal bar shog /gang zhig bdag gi rnam thar la// dpyad cing sgrub pa byed pa dang*// nyan cing klog pa byed pa dang*// phyag dang skor ba mchod 'bul rnams// mngon dga'i zhing du mjal bar shog /ma 'ongs gang zag thams cad pa// gal te bsgoms par nus srid na// mi kho bos dka' ba spyad spyad pas// gegs dang gol sa med par shog /chos phyir dka' ba spyad pa la// bsod nams dpag tu med pa yod// de la 'jug cing bskul ba la// bka' drin dpag tu med pa yod// mi kho bo'i rnam thar thos pa la// byin rlabs dpag tu med pa yod// dpag med gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis// thos pa tsam gyis grol gyur nas// bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub par shog /bdag gi gnas dang gnas mal dang*// dngos po mchis pa thams cad kyis// gar song yul du bde skyid shog /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung*// nam mkha' 'byung bas gar khyab pa// de bzhin bdag gis khyab par shog

/lha klu la sogs sde brgyad dang*// de bzhin gzhi bdag 'byung po'i tshogs// gnod sems skad cig mi skye zhing*// bsam pa chos dang 'phrad par shog /srog chags srin bu yan chad la// gcig kyang 'khor bar mir lhung bar// ma lus nga yis 'dren par shog /ces gsungs te khyed rnams 'dir shog bzlas pa la 'dren rgyu med/ khyed rnams drin che bas smon lam de rnams ston mo'i dod yin pas yid la bzung*/ khyed rnams kyis sha gzugs las che ba'i dngos po ma phul bas dkor la yang ma 'dres/ dad pa yang che chung ran pas dge yang ma g.yeng*/ za rgyu kham re kham re byin pas ltogs grir ma bsad/ ngas smon lam dang 'brel ba bzang bas yul 'dir yang skyid legs po 'ong ang gsungs pas/ der 'tshogs pa thams cad kyis phyag dang bskor ba dang smon lam gsol 'debs bkra shis mang du byas nas snang ba dga' ya le byung*/ la la skyob mi rtag pa skyes nas mchi ma mang po yang byung ngo*// bla ma grongs pa ni ma shes sngar las thugs gsom pa ci yin nam/ de ring ni nye ring med par mnyes mnyes thams cad la byas zin pa ci yin zer/ la las byin rlabs kyang cher song nas 'dug zer te thams cad song ngo*// de thams cad brin gyi smon lam gyi skor ro// ༈ de nas bco brgyad pa tshe gcig gis zungs jug rdo rje'i sku 'grub cing 'ja' lus su yal ba'i tshul bstan pa'i yon tan ni/ de nas 'bri sgom dang*/ se ban ras pa la sogs pa'i ras pa rnams tshogs nas/ bla ma'i gsung de la nged tsho yid ma ches pas/ bskang ba 'dra byas na zhus pas/ a mtshar po kho bo'i 'dul skal rdzogs pa la/ bskang ba dang 'don pas ci go byed gsungs nas mgur 'di gsungs so// rnam 'byor lus kyi me tog 'di// 'chi bdag gshin rje'i ba mo 'dis// bcom ste pha rol 'gro dus su// nga la mthong snang sna tshogs 'ong*// zhes gsungs pas/ 'bri sgom gyis/

dag ma dag lags sam zhus pas/ khyed kyis go bar 'dug de ka gsungs so// de zhib tu phyes na ji ltar lags zhus pas/ nga yi slob ma bcu gnyis la/ snang ba bcu gnyis 'char te dag pa drug /ma dag pa drug go /dag pa'i lus dang ma dag pa'i lus gnyis song ste/ dag pa'i lus mkha' spyod du ma dang mkha' 'gros seng ge dang rin po che'i khri la btegs nas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas gdan 'dren pa/ dag pa'i lha dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma min pas mi mthong*/ slob ma yang grub thob re re'i mthong srid/ ma dag pa'i lus shig lus na'ang*/ lung ston ci byung ba bzhin mdzod// ces gsungs pas/ se ban gyis zhus pa/ bla ma 'das na bdun tshig dang*/ cho ga dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ gdan sa dang*/ dus dran la sogs pa ji ltar byed lags zhus pas/ bla mas mgur 'di gsungs so// rje lho brag mar pa'i bka' drin gyis// bya ba thams cad byas nas yod// mi la ras pa'i snying rus kyis// byed pa thams cad zin nas yod// brgyud ldan bla ma ma bsten pa'i// dbang bskur zhus pas ci la phan// rang rgyud don la mi bsre ba'i// rgyud sde bzung bas ci la phan// 'jig rten bya ba ma btang ba'i// gdams ngag bsgoms pas ci la phan// spyod pa chos dang mi bstun pas// cho ga byas pas ci la phan// tshig ngan gnyen pos mi zin pas// bdun tshig byas pas ci la phan// phyogs ris chags sdang ma zhi ba'i/ mchod pa phul bas ci la phan// rang 'dod rtsa ba ma spangs pa'i// sbyin pa btang bas ci la phan// 'gro drug pha mar ma shes pa'i// gdan sa bzung bas ci la phan// sems la dag snang ma skyes pa'i// mchod rten bzhengs pas ci la phan// thun bzhi rnal 'byor ma nus pa'i// tshwa tshwa btab pas ci la phan// gsol ba snying nas mi 'debs pa'i// dus dran bskyangs pas ci la phan// gdams ngag rna bar mi 'jog pas// gdung mchod byas pas ci la phan// gson tshe dad pa ma skyes pa'i// gdung zhal bltas pas ci la phan// yid rmongs skyo shas ma skyes pa'i// spong dag byas pas ci la phan// snying rje sems la ma skyes pa'i// kha bzang snying rjes ci la phan// nyon mongs 'dod pa ma spangs pa'i// zhabs tog byas pas ci la phan// ci gsung tshad mar mi 'dzin pa'i// dpon slob byas pas ci la phan// phan pa med pa byas byas pas// gnod pa med par tsog ge sdod// bya ba byas pa'i rnal 'byor la// brel ba mang po 'khrul pa'i rgyu// zhes gsungs pas bla ma la/

bya ba btang ba'i rang gis tshogs lags sam zhus pas/ bla ma rje btsun mi bsten pa'i// mos gus byas kyang byin rlabs chung*// dbang bskur zab mo ma zhus pa'i// rgyud rkyang tshig gis rang nyid 'ching*// rgyud sde mang por mi 'jog pa'i/ lag len thams cad log pa'i rgyu// man ngag zab mo mi bsgom pa'i// bya ba btang zer rang sdug yin// nyon mongs gnyen pos mi 'dzin pa'i// kha bshad skam po stong sgra yin// zab mo'i thabs lam mi shes pa'i/ brtson 'grus byas kyang snying po med// 'gag dang nya ga mi shes pa'i// snying rus byas kyang 'khrul pa'i rgyu// bsod nams mang du ma bsags pa'i// rang don gcig pu 'khor ba'i rgyu// bsags pa chos la ma btang ba'i// bsgom kyang yon tan skye ba min// chog shes nang nas ma skyes pa'i// mang po bsags kyang mi yi nor// bde skyid nang nas ma skyes pa'i// phyi yi skyid 'dod sdug bsngal yin// bde 'dod 'gong po'i dmag gis bskor// grags 'dod rang phung kha mchu 'phog /yag 'dod nyon mongs dug la 'khrugs// bzang 'dod grwa rogs grogs dang 'gras// ngas byas re 'khang mang ba'i rgyu// khyed kha rog bzhugs dang ma mchu med// lhan ne sdod dang bsam pa 'grub// ma yengs skyong dang yeng ba med// gcig pur sdod dang grogs dang mjal// dman sa bzung dang chen por phyin// dal lo skyong dang mgyogs po sleb// bya ba btang na don chen 'grub/ zab lam bsgom dang myur lam rnyed// stong nyid rtogs na snying rje rnyed// snying rje skyes na bdag gzhan med// snying rje skyes shing 'gro don 'grub// 'gro don 'grub na nga dang mjal// nga dang mjal tsa mngon sangs rgyas/ bdag dang sangs rgyas bu slob rnams// dbyer med gcig tu gsol ba thob// ces gsungs te nga yi shul du dngos po chen mo/ a ga ru nag po'i phyag 'khar 'di dang*/ ras kyi zhwa dang*/ ras kyi dum bu gcig dang de rnams dwags po lha rje la bskur/

sba ber 'di ras chung pa ma sleb na ras dum gcig dang gnyis bskur/ gri gu dang me cha 'di gnyis 'bri sgom gyis zung*/ paṇa zhwa hrul po 'di se ban ras pas zung*/ ras dum bu gyis la mi re la re re byin/ nor che ba min te dngos grub re 'ong srid/ gser dum pa cig yod de nga rang gi sgom khang gi rgyab der sbas nas yod pa la gser 'gyed gyis gsungs so// der mi la ras pa la gser mang po yod do zer ba byung bas/ legs se na re/ bla ma'i rnam thar 'di la gser e'u med/ mi ngan pa'i kha la bzod tshul tshug med der phyis gser e 'dug bltas tsa/ gser med par bur dkar rdog po gsum ras kha gang gi nang du btum pa dang*/ yi ge dang gri gu yu bas khem 'ong ba/ so yi gri yong ba ltag pas me cha yong ba/ rtse mos 'bug 'ong ba dang*/ de rnams 'dug pa la yi ge de la bltas cing*/ bu ram 'di gri gu 'dis dum dum gyis dang mi rnams khyer nas 'ong*/ ras 'di gri gu 'dis dum dum gyis dang mi rnams la khyed kyi bar du ras mi 'dzad pas thams cad mkhyen nas 'ong zer ba dang mi la ras pa la gser mang po yod zer ba'i mi 'ga' re yod zer ba'i kha la skyag pa chug cig zer ba bris nas 'dug pas/ ras pa thams cad sdug pa'i nang nas gad ti re song ngo de nas ma bsnyun pa la chos mang po gsungs pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul mang po mdzad pa la bsam gyis mi khyab pa ste yi ger bri bar ga la yong*/ der las ma dag pa'i bon po gcig gis/ bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi yul du nad yams dkon pas kho yi zwa phu tsho ma byung bas/ snying na nas dug yang yang tsam pas ma gsol bas/ da zhag la mdze pho gcig la g.yu zhig brngan pa byin nas dug zho la sbyar nas drangs pas/ rje btsun spyan gyis hrig ge mdzad nas khyod kyi g.yu thob pa'i ched du btung dgos dgongs nas gsol/ gsol tshar ba dang a re sdug khyod la sdig pa med gsungs/

de nas dum pa bsnyung ba dang*/ ras pa rnams ngus pa la/ lus drang por bsrang nas spyan nam mkha' la gzigs te gsungs so// 'khor 'das 'od gsal gyi dbyings su gsal// phyag gi rang sa zin pa la// 'od gsal ci yis rgyas btab pa'i// gnyis su med pa'i che ba po// thog rdug med pa'i spobs pa can// nad dang gdon dang sdig sgrib rnams// rnal 'byor lha yi rgyan du mdzes// rtsa thig rlung sems rnam par gnas// rgyan sogs mtshan dpe rgyan du mdzes// bon po'i bsam ngan dag par shog /mdze pho nad las thar bar shog /lus la na tsha rtswa tsam med// zas ngan cig gis khams ma snyoms// sgom chen ngu tsa skye bos khrel// nyams myong steng du lhan ne zhog /ces gsungs pas/ ras pa rnams kyis kyang dug byung ba ma rig tsa/ de nub mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad byung nas bon po shi/ der bla mas bon po'i sdig sbyong du mgur 'di gsungs so// lar bsam ngan thams cad 'di dang 'dra// bon po bsam ngan snying re rje// sbyor ba ngan pa mi 'tshal bas// nga yi mdun du bon po shi// nga yi dge ba bde skyid dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas dge ba yis// bon po'i sdig pa 'dag par shog /bon po'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyang*// bdag gis blang nas sbyong bar shog /bla ma slob dpon pha ma la// gnod par byed pa snying re rje// de yi las kyi rnam smin yang*// bdag gis blang nas sbyong bar shog /dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// sdig pa'i grogs dang bral bar shog /skye zhing skye ba thams cad du// dge ba'i grogs po rnyed par shog /bsod nams 'dzad kha'i bsam ngan de// sems can gcig la'ang mi gnas shog /bsam pa bzang po byang chub lam// sems can kun gyi 'thob par shog /ces gsungs pas/ ras pa 'bri sgom gyis de ci lags zhus pas/ bon po de'i sngar slob dpon gcig bsad zin pas de ngan 'gror gcig 'gro ba la/ yul gnyan po la bsam ngan skyes pa mnar med du 'gro mi nus pas nga la dug byin pa yin gsungs pas/

a kha 'o na mkhyen bzhin du dug mi gsol ba yin mod zhus pas/ ngas zos nas smon lam btab na e thar bsam pa yin gsungs pas/ bon e thar zhus pas/ thar srid e ma thar srid/ nga min na kho da la bsdad le min da thar pa'i smon lam song yod gsungs so// da rang re dang 'phrad pa ji ltar yin lags zhus pas/ des slob dpon cig bsgrungs de bstan pa'i gnas pa cig yin/ da bstan pa'i bdag po'i bdag po yin pas sems can blos btang thabs med gsungs so// de nas nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od dang me tog mang po babs/ nam zla dgun yin pa la char pa si li li rgyun du zim zim babs pas/ mi rnams kyis 'di ci yin nam zer/ mi la las snye nam na dbyangs snyan po grags zer/ la las snye nam na 'ja' gur 'dug zer/ la las nam mkha' 'di la 'od phreng mang po 'dug zer/ la las ri mgo la 'ja' phub pa 'dra ba 'dug zer/ la las sa rdo 'di rnams 'ja' 'od dang gur du 'dug zer/ la las rtsa dang shing tsho la 'od zer gyis bskor nas 'dug zer/ shing ji ltar yod pa bzhin 'dug zer te sku ma gshegs pa la rtags bsam gyis mi khyab bo// de nas yos bu lo dus dgun zla ra ba stag zla ba/ tshes bco lnga'i nyin nyi ma rtse shar la/ dgung lo brgyad la nga la zhag bdun bar du gcig kyang ma sprad de nas lab rgyu zhig yod gsungs pa la/ zhag lnga nas ga ler bltas tsa bla ma 'das nas 'dug /de nas khong rnams 'dug ma bzod pas/ yang zhag drug nas bltas tsa gdung chung du song nas zan bre thag tsam zhig 'od ya le 'dug pa dang*/ ras pa thams cad bsked nas gdung la blta bcug pa la/ la las he ru ka cig 'dug zer/ la las spyan ras gzigs shig 'dug zer/ la las 'od cig 'dug zer/ la las mchod rten zhig 'dug zer/ la las me ru 'dug zer/ la las chur 'dug zer/ la las rdo rjer 'dug zer/ la las rlung zhig kyi li li 'dug zer/ la las gser zhig 'dug zer/

la las bum pa cig 'dug zer/ la las dril bu cig 'dug zer nas kha ma 'cham pa dang*/ zhag bdun ma rdzogs par gdung la reg pas/ mdangs de chung du song ngo*// se ban ras pas/ zhag bdun la gdung la ma reg na gdung ye nas kyang mi 'ong bar 'dug zer bas/ ras pa bying gis des na yon bdag tshos kyang gdung ci byas zer nas lab/ nged rang tsho la yang phyag 'tshal ba'i rten med pas ma bzang zer der yul gyi gtso bo dang yon bdag rnams 'ong nas gdung bzhu ba la ras pa tsho dang yon bdag rnams kha 'cham/ bu chung lo brgyad pa ral pa kham seg ge ba cig bar snang nas gar byed cing byung bas 'di gsungs so// khyed kyi mi yul glan pa 'dir// mi la ras pa'i gdung la rtsod// brtsad pas 'thob tu mi 'jug pa/ mkha' 'gro spyi yi dam tshig yin// brkus pas rang nor ma yin pa// dpa' bo kun gyi dam tshig yin// 'phrog pas tha mar mi dge bar// chos skyong kun gyi dam tshig yin// bsags tshad bdag pos mi spyod pa// dam pa kun gyi dgongs pa yin// rang 'dod rang la mi phan pa// chos rgyal kun gyi dam tshig yin// rem pas dam chos mi nus pa// mgo nag mi yi gnas lugs yin/ 'das pas byin rlabs mi chung ba// bla ma rje yi dgongs pa yin// rje btsun chos kyi phung po de// lung pa gnyis kyi bar gdags der// bzhus na phan yon che ba'o// zhes zer nas brag thog der song nas phyag g.yug cing yod tsa med nas thal/ de nas bra sgang gi brag rtse na bzhugs pas klu dung skyong gnas pa'i thad du song bas mdze nad thams cad chad de phyin nas bod du mdze pho nyung ngo*// de nas gdung la me 'jog ma dgos par bar snang nas mkha' 'gro ma mang pos dbyangs di ri ri thams cad kyis tshor bar 'di gsungs so// rang sems gtum mo lha yi me// skyes bus rtags tu bsgoms bsgoms nas// las kyi me yis ci la phan// mtshan ma lus kyi khang bu 'di// sngar nas bshigs shing bsgoms bsgoms nas// de ring phung po ci la lus// mdzes pa lha yi dkyil 'khor de// rnal 'byor sems la rdzogs pa la// sa yi ri mo ci la phan// rlung sems dbyer med mar me de// rgyun chad med par 'char ba la// ser sna'i gong bu ci la phyir// bdud rtsi lnga yi ye shes de// rgyun chad med par gsol bar 'debs// zan gyis bshos bu su la 'dren// tshul khrims gtsang ma'i rnal 'byor de// shes bya'i sgrib pa bral ba la// de ring khrus bum su la 'cha'// bar snang mchod pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// de ring bdug spos byed rgyu med// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i mchod dbyangs mdzad// ye shes ḍā kis mchod pa 'bul// de ring cho ga ji ltar brjod// rig 'dzin kun gyi 'khor gyis bskor// dpa' bo yongs kyis zhabs tog byed// de ring gdung la reg don med// chos nyid dbyings kyi na bun la// ca bcos mi dgos bzhag pas chog

/mkha' 'gro sde bzhi mchod bstod la// bdag po mi dgos dge sbyor mdzod// lha dang bla ma'i dam tshig la// kha ta mi dgos thugs dam skyongs// rin chen gter gyi phung po la// nga bdag ma byed mnyam por zhog /bla ma sangs rgyas gsang tshig la// bshad 'dod ma mang smra bcad mdzod// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs la// sgrib kyis 'phog dogs sku mtshams sdoms// rtse gcig sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la// phrag dog mang bas gsang zhing sgrubs// ya mtshan lha yi pha 'bab la/ dngos grub 'byung ngo the chom med// bla ma rje btsun rnam thar la// snyan pa chen po bsgrags mi dgos// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i glu dbyangs la// byin rlabs 'byung ngo mos gus bskyed// mi la ras pa'i bu brgyud la// grub thob mang ngo skal pa can// yul phyogs 'di yi mi nor la// nad yams dkon no lha mi kun// de ring 'dir 'tshogs sems can la// ngan song med do 'gro ba kun// de bzhin nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la// snang sems gcig tu 'dres pa la// dge zhing skyid pa'i lha chos la// kun gyi rtag tu spyod par shog /ces gsungs pa'i dbyangs la chags nas snang ba gar song yang ma tshor te/ zla ba gsum la nam dang nyi ma ngo ma shes par nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor du 'od dkar po dkyil dkyil du nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la/ mtha' thams cad sprin mchod rten 'dra ba mang po gral bsgrigs pa ni shar lho nub byang med par 'khor rung la bsdad/ nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa'i mtha' la 'ja' 'od sna lnga dkor re yod pa'i nam mkha'i dkyil du a dkar po khru gang ba zhig gi lam lam bar snang la mar 'khor zhing zhag bdun bsdad/ spur khang steng du 'ja' 'od kyi gdung*/ zur la rgyal mtshan dang*/ gzhan yang du ba dang smug pa 'dres pa la bum pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dril bu dang*/ me lce thams cad kyang padma dang*/ phye ma dang*/ phur ma dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ nor bu dang*/

dpal be'u dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ g.yung drung dang*/ ting ting shag dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ kha ṭwaṃ ga dang*/ thod pa dang gri gug dang*/ rnga dang rnge'u dang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas sna tshogs su lam lam gyur te/ me tog thams cad kyang phreng bsang mu tig dang*/ phreng ba'i lu gu rgyud mang po dang*/ thig le dkar dmar mthing sngon ljang ser sna tshogs pas nam mkha' gang ba dang*/ nam mkha' nas me tog dkar sngo dmar ljang mthing kha khra bo la sogs pa dang*/ me tog re la 'ja' sna lnga yi gur phub pa/ me tog re la dkyil gyi padma'i kha dog dang mtshungs pa dpag tu med pa'i char ni kha ba'i 'dab bzhin bab pa kor ro ro kyi li li mi'i mgo nas yar la log nas mi zin pa dang*/ skal pa yod yod kyi mgo na rang dbang med par 'bab pa reg yod pas ma mthong ba dang*/ mthong ba lag pas zin pa dang*/ mis me tog bzung ba rnams kyang kha gsum song ba dang bdun bdun du song ba dang*/ nyi shu rtsa gcig re song ba mang po byung ngo*// la la'i lag tu yod le 'phel du ma 'dod par mdangs chung du song ngo*// nam zla dgun du yod pa la dbyar lo gsum byung ngo*// der tshogs pa rnams la yang 'jig rten gyi snang ba med par ltad mo dang sgra dbyangs kyi snang ba 'og ste ras pa rnams kyang dbyangs dang*/ gsol 'debs dang gar dang*/ phyag rgya la sogs pa rnams rang dbang med par byung ngo*// la las gsol ba 'debs pa'i bar du rje btsun sku chung chung zan cig byon nas byung bas chos drug gi gsol 'debs 'di gsungs so// 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lha sku la// zung 'jug rang bzhin stong pa gcig /'dre gdon sems kyi rnam rtog la// med snang sgyu mar shes pa gces// drin can bla ma rje btsun la// 'du 'bral med pa'i dad gus gces// las zin du med pa'i bya ba la// gdos thag chod pa'i blo rgod gces// rtsa rlung bde drod 'khor lo la// ma yengs 'bad rtsol byed pa gces// rmi lam sgyu lus bsre ba la// mtshams sbyor 'dun pa drag po gces// ngo bo 'od gsal rjen pa la// blos byas nyams su ma rtog gces// sna tshogs snang ba chos nyid la// gzhi rtsa chod pa'i gdams ngag gces// ma rtogs sems can thams cad la// byams dang snying rje rgyun thag gces// rang sems skye med chos sku la// blo re dogs med pa'i rtogs pa gces// zhes gsungs pas bar snang nas lhang lhang thos/

snang ba dag pa rnams la gdung bzhu rgyu ye ma rnyed de/ gzims mal bu ga ha re 'dug /sku gshegs shul du mkha' 'gro ma mang po/ sa rdo yan chad drangs pa mthong*/ rje btsun rang gi thugs la me 'bar ba mthong*/ nam mkha' ye shes kyi me yi nang du bde mchog /kye yi rdo rje/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor mang po lha dang bcas bkra lam me mthong ngo*// sa yi rong thams cad smug pa zho chags pa 'dra ba'i nang du 'od zer gyi dra ba dang*/ phreng ba dang mchod rdzas mang po'i gang ba byung ngo*// ri rtse thams cad la 'ja' yi mchod rten dang kor kor dang*/ gru bzhi dang*/ sog ka dang*/ chos 'byung la sogs pa dpag tu med pa dang gral khrig ge 'dug /ri de'i rked la du ba dang*/ me lce dang*/ smug pa gsum las rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i gur dang mchod rten la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi nang mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dkar mo dmar mo/ ser mo/ sngon mo ljang khu/ mthing ka la sogs pa'i rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa mang po'i bar snang gang nas gdung khang la me tog gtor zhing*/ dar dkar po bla re zhig 'then zhing 'dug pa ci yin nam snyam nas bltas pas/ gdung ring bsrel 'dus pa'i gong bu gcig la 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba cig 'dug pas/ ras pa rnams ngo mtshar che dran pas ngu ba dang brgyal ba byung ngo*// la las 'di ci yin nam zer bas de'i dus su mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gdungs dbyangs kyi bar snang nas blangs so// rje yid bzhin nor bu gshegs shul du// la la ngu zhing la la dga'// brgyal te mya ngan byed dus 'dir// rang byung me ni rang 'bar byung*// du ba 'ja' 'od mchod sprin 'khrigs// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// bkra shis dpa' be'u g.yung drung 'khyil// me sgra dung sgra cha lang sgra// pi wang gling bu ting ting sha /cang te'u ḍā ma ru sgra 'khrol// me stag skar mda' 'phros pa las// phyi nang mchod pa'i lha mor gyur/

gsang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs byed// yid 'ong mkha' 'gro mang po yis// spur sbyangs gdung ni gshegs nas khyer// phung po lhag med grub pa la// khyed rnams gdung la bzhugs sbyangs mtshar// bla ma chos sku nam mkha' las// longs sku smon lam mchod sprin gtibs// sprul sku 'phrin las me tog char// rgyun chad med par 'bab cing 'phel// gdul bya'i me tog smin par mdzad// gang yang skye ba med pa yi// chos nyid skye me stong pa nyid// stong pa nyid la skye 'gag gnas// bral bas the tshom ci byar yod// ces gsungs pas dar gyi bla re 'og tu 'od hri li li de nam mkha' la 'gro 'dod pa la/ ras pa zhi ba 'od kyis gsol 'debs 'di byas pa'i ram 'degs se ban dang 'bri sgom gnyis kyis mdzad de/ rje bla ma'i drung du bzhugs dus su// snying rus mthu stobs rin po che// grub thob mang po'i grogs dang 'phrad// gdam ngag gnad kyi lde'u mig lon/ rje 'gro ba'i don la brtse ba can// sems can yongs la thugs rje gzigs// rje gcig pur ri la bzhugs su dus su// sdug sgur skyid kyi mtha' ma 'khor// rdzu 'phrul ting 'dzin nus pa che// skal ldan bu la brtse ba can// mthong thos rnams la thugs rjes zungs// rje bu slob nang du bzhugs dus su// nye ring med pa'i rin po che// mngon shes rig pa'i ye shes rgyas// 'gro ba'i don la brtse ba can// skal ldan bu la thugs rjes zung*// rje mang po'i khrod du bzhugs tsa na// nye ring med pa'i rin po che// 'brel tshad thar pa'i lam la 'dren// sdug bsngal ldan la brtse ba can// nus pa med la thugs rjes zung*// rje sgyu ma'i lus cig 'dor ba'i dus// mkha' spyod grub pa'i rin po che// snang srid chos skur sgyur mdzad cing*// mkha' 'gro yongs kyi brtse ba can// 'dir bzhugs bu la thugs rjes zung*// zhes ngu zhing zhus pas/

thugs de la ring bsrel lcog ga'i sgo nga tsam zhig la 'od zer 'phro ba cig spur khang thog tu 'od ya le byung bas/ ras pa rnams kyis nga yi yin/ nga yi yin zer nas ci cir re btang bas/ kha gnyis su btang song nas/ ya ba gcig shel gyi mchod rten 'khyud gang ba cig la sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis sku khra shig ge ba cig bstan nas/ padma nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun sku chung chung sor bcu gnyis pa'i tshad tsam zhig tu sprul nas/ mchod rten zhig la sku rgyab gtad nas mgur 'di gsungs so// dad pa can gyi zhi ba 'od// 'dir tshogs 'dus pa'i bu slob rnams// mi bdag gi mtshan nas bos bos nas/ thugs rjes sku gsum sprul pa'i rten// mthong bas 'khor ba mi ltung ste// dad pa byas nas mngon sangs rgyas// chos sku thig le nyag gcig la// ring bsrel lcog ga'i sgo nga tsam// 'gro ba yongs kyi rten yin pas// nga yis byas na yongs kyang 'jigs// phal ba'i yul du ga la sdod// 'on kyang gsol ba btab gyur kyang*// thugs rje chung du mi 'gro bar// mkha' 'gro spyi yi dam tshig yin// thub pa chos kyi 'phrin las kyi// sprul sku sna tshogs cir yang ston// shel gyi mchod rten mkhyud gang la// sangs rgyas stong gi phra btab ste// dngos su byon pa ngo mtshar che// ma yengs gsol ba 'debs 'debs na// 'phrin las chung du mi 'gro ba// chos skyong spyi yi dam tshig yin// bla ma sku gsum dbyer med pa/ rdzu 'phrul snang ba cir yang ston// chung la 'dod pa'i sku 'bras can// dngos su byon pa ngo mtshar che/ 2mos gus gdung ba drag po yis// snying nas gsol ba 'debs 'debs na// dngos grub chung du mi 'gro ba/ grub thob yongs kyi dam tshig yin// dam tshig dam du bsrung ba na/ 2dam can yongs kyi dngos grub ster// gcig pur ri khrod zin pa na// ma dang mkha' 'gro ngang gis 'khor// chos la ngos lkog ma byas na// myur du 'grub pa'i snga ltas yin// nang du skyid 'dod mi 'dug na// nyon mongs rtsa ba bud pa yin// bdag dang dngos po mi gda' na/

2'dre bdud bar chad gsod pa yin// phyogs dang nye ring mi 'dug na// lta ba yongs su dag pa yin/ 'khor 'das stong par 'char nus na// sgom pa yongs su dag pa yin/ 2brtul zhugs khong nas rdol ba yin// spyod pa yongs su dag pa yin// bla ma'i lung bstan grub pa na// dam tshig yong su dag pa yin/ sems can kun gyi don grub na// 'bras bu yongs su dag pa yin// dpon slob thugs yid 'dres pa na// 'brel ba gong na yod pa yin// rtags dang dngos grub mthong ba 'di// snang ba yongs su dag pa yin// ces gsungs nas nam mkha'i dbyings 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams khra spungs se 'dug pa'i nang du bla ma thim nas song*/ shel gyi mchod rten de ni mkha' 'gro mas gdan 'dren par 'dug bsam nas gsol ba 'di sngar bzhin btab pa/ rje rang 'od sprul pa'i sku gzugs can// mi mngon chos kyi zhing khams khyab// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs// rje grub thob rnams dang mjal dus su// rin chen gser gyi 'bru dang 'dra// 'grim thad che ba'i rnal 'byor pa// rje sbyangs pa can la gsol ba 'debs// rje bla ma'i zhabs tog byed dus su/ g.yang dkar lug gi bal dang 'dra// kun la phan pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// rje 'jig rten bya ba btang tsam na// drang srong rig pa'i rgyal po 'dra/ 'gyur ba med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje snying stobs can la gsol ba 'debs// rje bla ma'i byin rlabs bsgom tsam na// stag mo'i mi ro za ba 'dra// the tshom med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ rje snying stobs can la gsol ba 'debs// rje mi med lung pa 'dzin tsam na/ lcags kyi rdo ba srub med 'dra// sdug bsran che ba'i rnal 'byor pa// rje bcos ma med la gsol ba 'debs// rje rtags dang cho 'phrul byung tsam na// glang chen seng ge dkar mo 'dra// nyam nga med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/

rje 'jigs pa med la gsol ba 'debs// rje nyams dang drod rtags skyes tsam na// bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas 'dra// 'dzam gling khyab pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje chad 'dzin med la gsol ba 'debs// rje skal ldan slob ma skyong tsam na// nyi ma me shel 'phrad tsa 'dra// grub thob mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje bka' drin can la gsol ba 'debs// rje zang zing nor dang phrad tsam na// dngul dkar me long mdog dang 'dra// dri ma mi gnas rnal 'byor pa// rje nyes skyon med la gsol ba 'debs// rje mang po'i tshogs pa skyong tsam na// 'dzam gling nyi ma shar ba 'dra// rje mun pa sel ba'i rnal 'byor pa// rje snying stobs can la gsol ba 'debs// rje 'dzam gling mi dang mjal tsam na// ma dang bu gnyis 'phrad pa 'dra// ci phan sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje byams pa can la gsol ba 'debs// mkha' spyod gnas su gshegs tsam na// dngos grub gter gyi bum pa 'dra// tshad bzung med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje ngo mtshar can la gsol ba 'debs// rje mngon shes lung bstan mdzad tsam na// kha dang lag pa sprod tsam na// 'chug pa med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// rje dngos grub myur du gnang tsam na// pha mas bu la nor phog 'dra// phongs pa med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi mchod rten 'di// bu slob rnams la gnang bar zhu// zhes zhus pas/ rje btsun gyi gsung lhang lhang pa cig mchod rten de'i nang du grags pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma des lo tshad dang ram 'degs mnyam du mdzad nas mgur 'di gsungs so// 'o na skal ldan dad pa can// lhang lhang skad kyis gsol 'debs pa// ya mtshan ras pa'i bu slob rnams// khyod bla ma mtshan ldan bsten pa dang*// bsod nams can la brten pa gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// stong nyid sems la shar ba dang*// mi rtogs blo yi stong pa gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// sgom gnyug ma rang sa zin pa dang*// zhi gnas yid la 'byor ba gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// rang byung lhug pa'i rang shar dang*// 'thad 'thad mang ba'i dran pa gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// sems nyid dri ma med pa dang*// bsam pa bzang po'i phan dogs gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// dngos grub rten 'brel shar ba dang*// za zing mang po'i bsod nams gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang*// sa bla 'byung pos rtag 'bod gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// chos sku dri med gong bu dang*// mtshan ma rdzas kyi ring bsrel gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// sprul pa'i dbyings kyi me tog dang*// 'od gsal lha yi me tog gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// sprul pa sku yi mchod rten dang*// sngon las skyes pa'i lhan skyes gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// snang srid 'ja' 'od gur khang dang*// 'byung ba rkyen gyi 'ja' 'od gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// sngon gyi las 'phro sad pa dang*// tshe 'di'i lto gos dad pa gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// dad pa gting nas skyes pa dang*// ngo tsha khrel la bsam pa gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// snying nas sgrub pa bsam pa dang*// bla ma'i ngo srung byed pa gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// dad pa 'tsho ba 'dren pa dang*// dad pa srung ba re ba gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dra la nor dogs mdzod// bsod nams lag tu len pa dang*// kha dog rlung la phyar ba gnyis// 'dra 'dra 'dral nor dogs mdzod// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i mchod rten 'di// dus gsum sangs rgyas zhing khams yin// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs khang yin// bla ma rje btsun sgom khang yin// da ni shar phyogs zhing khams su// mkha' 'gro mang po 'dus pa'i nang*// mngon dga' dag pa'i zhing de na// bcom ldan sangs rgyas bde mchog dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang sgrol ma'i tshogs// kun bzang bde ba'i gnas de na// mkha' 'gro mang po'i sun ma yod// khyod dad pas snying nas gsol btab pas// kha zhe med pa'i mchi ma phul// bcos ma med pa'i phyag rten legs// shes rab rnon po'i me tog 'thor// byang chub sems kyi khrus byas pas// dad pa 'gyur med bsrung ba bzang*// ye shes 'gyur med dbang zhus na// khyod mgo bo 'di yi 'og tu chug

/ces gsungs te mkha' 'gro ma de bar snang du khyer te 'ong bas ras pa bu chen tshos mgo la reg tsam re byas nas nam mkha' la gdan drangs nas song ngo*// der mkha' 'gro ma de rnams dbyangs tse re re tshor mi tshor min pa cig kyang ma mthong 'ja' tshon yang mdangs chung du song ba min/ sa gzhan gyi rtags rnams da rung ma 'gyur ro// gdung bzhu ba'i rnam pa cig byas kyang gdung rus dang*/ gdung la sha khrag gi gsur gzhob med par 'ja' yod du yal nas song bas gdung thal yang ma rnyed do// yang bar snang du mkha' 'gro ma'i mchod rdzas de rnams lo ma 'khor bar du bsdad/ dbyar lo gsum/ lo yag lo brgyad/ nad yams med par mi rabs gsum/ 'khrug pa med pa mi rabs bdun/ de la sogs pa'i ltas yi ger brir ma long ngo*// der gdung bzhus pa der bum pa chung ngu cig byas so// slob ma yon bdag der tshogs pas de bur kar de gri gu des kha gnyis su byas pas chung du ma song bar 'dra 'dra bzhi/ bzhi bzhi byas pas kyang 'dra 'dra brgyad/ brgyad brgyad byas pas bcu drug /bcu drug byas pas sum cu so gnyis/ de bzhin du zad rgyu ma byung ngo*// ras la yang kha gang gshags pas kha do/ de bzhin du bzhi brgyad bcu drug la sogs pa gong bzhin byung bas/ der tshogs pa'i tshogs pa rnams la bu ram rdog po re dang*/ ras kha re 'gyed rgyu byung ste/ thams cad kyis bu ram zos pas zad rgyu ma byung bar dang kha mer chil le ba byung zhing*/ khyim du khyer yang chung ngu ma song ste brin dang snye nam gyi mi thams cad kyis lo ma 'khor bar du ci za za byung*/ bu ram zos shing 'di rang ngo mtshar che zer zhing zos pas nam mkha' nas sgra skad 'di ltar grags so// skyes bu de ni ting 'dzin zas// mi tshe ring du zos pas// bsam gtan chen po'i dngos grub zas// de kho na song ba'i mi rnams la// yi dwags su skye ba'i sgo gcod do// ras dkar bzang po'i shes rab gos// mgur du btags pa'i mi rnams la// dmyal bar bsregs pa'i skye sgo gcod// byin rlabs thob pa'i mi rnams kun// ngan song gsum gyi gnas las thar// zhes pa'i sgra dbyangs byung ngo*// de nas spur bzhus pa'i shul du sgyid bu gsum lus 'dug pa de gtso bo mi gsum gyis phyag 'tshal ba'i rten byas so// de la sogs pa'i ltas bzang po lo ma 'khor bar du/

dus bzang thams cad la dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gros mchod dbyangs grags tsa/ yul gyi bu tsha dang bu mo rnams kyis me tog 'dzin zer nas 'gro ba/ me tog zin le 'bros nas 'ong*/ ma zin pa rnams kyis phyi de nas 'ong*/ nub mo yul pa dang*/ gzhi bdag dang*/ mi ma yin thams cad kyis me tog spar ba gang mang po thu ba dang*/ phyag dang bskor ba byas byas nas sa 'og tu song ngo*// tho rangs dang dgong mo la sha ba dang*/ rkyang dang*/ ri dwags mang pos bskor bar byed/ bud med sma ra yod pa mang po 'dug tsa yar la nye ba dang yod cing song ngo*// de la sogs pa mang po ngo mtshar de ltas bsam gyis mi khyab bo// bla ma chos skur yal/ mthong snang longs skur bzhugs/ thugs rje sprul skur bzhugs/ dpa' bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam thar mgur chos zhal gdams dang bcas pa rdzogs so/// /rnam thar 'di skal ldan sgom chen rnams kyi don du ngan rdzong ston pa bo dhi rā dza la sogs pa'i ras pa bu chen bcu gnyis kyis yi ger bkod pa'o// spyir rje btsun chen po de nyid la bzhugs pa'i ri khrod kyi gnang mang du yod na'ang yongs su grags pa'i rdzong chen po bco brgyad/ rdzong drug ni/ brag dmar ling nga rdzong*/ rta so dbu ma rdzong*/ brag dmar spo mthon rdzong*/ rkyang 'phen nam mkha' rdzong*/ rag ma bya chub rdzong*/ smin khyug grib ma rdzong*/ sku thang rdzong drug ni/ brag skya rdo rje rdzong*/ khra tshang srin po rdzong*/ skyid pa nyi ma rdzong*/ khu byug dben pa rdzong*/ shel phug nam mkha' rdzong*/ rtsig pa rkang gcig rdzong*/ dpa' mo rdzong drug ni/ rgya brag nam mkha' rdzong*/ sbas phug ma mo rdzong*/ stag phug seng ge rdzong*/ la phug padma rdzong*/ khro rgyal rdo rje rdzong*/ glang mgo klu bdud rdzong*/ rdzong chung gnyis ni/ brag dmar spo mthon nam mkha' rdzong*/ skyid phug nyi ma rdzong*/ gzhan yang lho gro bo lung*/ gangs ti si/ rtsibs ri/

khyad par gyi gnas ni/ la phyi dang chu bar rnams su sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu 'bad pas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mgrin pa longs spyod kyi dkyil khor rdzogs te 'byung bzhi'i skye mched zil gyis gnon pa'i rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung dang*/ bya dang ri dwags gcan gzan la sgom btab lha srin dregs pa can btul nas chos la bkod/ ti si'i lha btsun ma la gtum mo'i khrid btab/ jo mo bkris tshe ring ma la bar do'i gdams pa la sogs pa gnang*/ gsang sngags kyi lam mchog sgrub pa'i bka' brgyud kyi srung mar da lta'ang bzhugs/ gzhan yang slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ khyad par grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ de'i nang nas bu dgu sring bzhi zhes grags so// de la thugs kyi sras bzhi ni/ ras chung pa/ se ban ras pa/ ngan rdzong ras pa/ 'bri sgom ras pa dang bzhi'o// nye ba'i sras brgyad ni/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ ras pa sangs rgyas skyabs/ ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug /gshin sgom ras pa/ rong chung ras pa/ mkhar chung ras pa/ gnyen sgom ras pa/ khyi ra ras pa dang brgyad do// sku gshegs kha'i slob ma drug ni/ dwags po lha rje/ li skor phyag ru pa/ lo ston dge 'dun/ skyo ston shag gu dam pa rgyag phu pa/ 'bri ban bkra shis dang drug go /sring bzhi ni/ legs se 'bum/ dpa' dar 'bum/ gsal le 'od/ ras chung ma dang bzhi'o// yang lo rgyus gcig la ras pa/ mched brgyad dang thugs kyi sras bzhi/ nye ba'i sras brgyad rnams ni 'di 'dra zer bar 'dug ras chung rdor grags/ ngam rdzong ras pa/ 'bri sgom ras pa/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ bde ba skyong*/ khyi ra ras pa/ ra rdzi ras pa rnams so// mkha' spyod du bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo bdun ni/ zhi ba 'od sangs rgyas skyabs/ rong chung ras pa/ pe ta/ mdzes se/ chos kyi byang chub/ 'bri mtshams kyi pa tshab za rnams so// mchog gi rnal 'byor pho mo gsum ni/ mi rnams 'dul ba'i mchog sgam po pa/
