mi ma yin rnams 'dul ba'i mchog bkra shis tshe ring ma/ ḍā ki rnams 'dul ba'i mchog sngags skyes lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrol ma rnams so// thugs kyi sras bzhi/ nye ba'i sras brgyad/ gung thung gi gnyan chung ras pa/ ras pa tsa phu pa/ glang btsun ras pa/ ras pa rdo rje dbang phyug /gshin sgom ras pa mkhar chung ras pa/ glen sgom ras pa/ 'gon btsun ras pa dang brgyad do// sku bgres khar 'khrungs pa'i ston pa drug ni/ skye ston shākya gu 'or ston dge 'dun dam pa rgyag phu/ 'bro ban bkra shis/ lam gong phyar chung pa rnams so// 'bri sgom/ jo dar/ sgom stag sogs grub thob pho mo nyi shu rtsa lnga/ ras pa nyer gcig ston pa bcu/ ras pa bcu gnyis/ khyim pa'i tshul 'dzin pa'i grub thob pho mo drug /tho mtshams nas slar dad de grub pa la sogs pa dang dpag tu med pa smin par mdzad do// snyan brgyud 'khor lo bde mchog gi /brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu 'di// ma 'ongs gdung brgyud 'dzin pa rnams/ blo dman brjed pas 'jigs pa'i phyir// bla ma'i gsung bzhin yi ger bkod// bla ma mkha' 'gros bzod par gsol/ phyi rabs rten gang zag rnams// dbang bskur byin rlabs chos 'khor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo mchod la song*// gyis shig gnang ba ma gtogs pa// bla ma rje yi bka' rgyas btab// mkha' 'gro ko long dam pas na/ yi ge ma spel gnang la zhus/ brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bu gu ru ḍāki sa ma ya/ chos kyi rje mi pham mgon pa'i zhal nas rje btsun chen po'i mgur 'bum la mtha' med pa cig yod par grags shing phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa brgya tsam mthong ba'i nang nas kyang 'di nyid mang shos su 'dug cing*/ rje karma pa rang byung rdo rje nyid kyis phyag bris su mdzad pa yin pas khungs btsun gsungs nas thugs rtsis shin tu che bar mdzad 'dug ces yongs su grags pa'i glegs bam ni 'di yin no// 'dis kyang sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/

khyad par rlabs chen dge ba dus gsum du bsags pa rnams la brten nas sa lam gyi yon tan yongs su rdzogs/ sems can nyam thag pa rnams kyi slad du sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig /na mo gu ru maṇḍa de ba/ tshogs gnyis rgya mtshor sku bzhi'i lhun po mdzes// spangs rtogs 'chi med khang bzang gis spras te// rgyal ba sras bcas dbus su mngon mtho ba'i// bde gshegs rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs// chos dbyings mkha' la bden 'dzin 'od stong 'phro// zung 'jug rta bdun smon lam bgrod mtha' yas// rnam mang 'gro ba'i yid mun drung 'byin pa'i// rje btsun te lo pa la gsol ba 'debs// dri med bde stong 'od gsal dkyil 'khor rgyas// rnam dag sgyu ma'i ri dwags gzugs kyis mdzes// rgol ngan rgyu skar tshogs rnams zil gnon pa'i// dpal chen nā ro pa la gsol ba 'debs// gangs can sgrub brgyud du ma'i byed pa po// rig 'dzin lha brgya'i gtsug na gser gyi mngal// la lar dam chos bskul byed 'khor lo'i 'dag /skyes mchog mar pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bdag lta'i lta min ting 'dzin rdo rjes bcom// sna tshogs sprul pa'i mig stong gis mdzes shing*// theg mchog lag ldan gtso la dbang bsgyur ba'i// dbang phyug mi la'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// zhes bstod pa dang rjes su mthun pa'i rje btsun chen po mi la ras pa/ mtshan gzhan dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje de nyid kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ sngon rgya gar la sogs par skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa brgya phrag lnga la rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta kho nar skyes shing*/ khyad par rdo rje 'chang gi theg pa'i lam mtha' dag rgyud la yongs su bskrun na'ang*/ rang gi gdul bar bya ba'i gdul bya gang 'dul gzigs nas/ kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir mi'ang mi ma yin pa dpag tu med pa'i don rgya chen po 'ong bar gzigs shing*/

khyad par du yang chos rje sgam po pa de nyid kyi don dang*/ sgos sngags pa dang*/ spong ba pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ mtshan pa rnams la ma rtogs pa dang*/ log par rtogs pa dang*/ the tshom gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i sgo nas nyams su len par 'dod pa rnams kyis 'di ltar nyams su len dgos zhes bstan pa'i tshe/ gangs ri'i khrod 'di padma'i mtsho la skom pas gdung ba'i glang po che 'jug pa ltar du byang chub kyi sems kyis gzhan dbang du gyur te tha mal gyi tshul du byon pa yin// zhes yongs su grags so// de lta bu'i skyes bu dam pa de'i rnam par thar pa mdo sngags kyi lam gnad mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i glegs bam 'di ni/ de nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa'i blo gros gser gyi sa gzhi/ 'khor 'bangs rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ rigs rus cho 'brangs kyi mngon par mtho ba gtong ba sogs kyi kha bzang gis spras shing*/ yi ge 'bri mchod sogs kyi rol mtshos rnam par brgyan pa/ lha bran srid sde ris bdun gyis gus par 'dud pa/ 'phags nor bdun gyi shing yongs 'dus legs par spud pa'i ri dbang mi dpon bzhed rtsa blo gros rgya mtshos lhag bsam rnam par dag pas yang yang bskul nas cha rkyen thams cad phun sum tshogs par byas te/ gar dbang rdo rje 'chang gi rnam 'phrul/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang po'i dpon yig pa blo gros kyi nyi 'od kyis legs par bshad pa sum rtags gnyis/ dag yig gnyis/ ka la pa sogs sgra yi bstan bcos rgya mtsho lta bu rnams kyi pad tshal/ mkhas pa'i dbang po shākya ku mā ra'i bka' drin la brten nas legs par kha 'byed par gyur pa/ blo gros rgya mtshos sdebs legs nor bu'i rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan te/ lha lam shog bu'i ngos la/ rab gsal dbang zhu ba'i bdud rtsi mkho la snag gis mdzes par bkod de shar ba'o// zhu dag mkhan ni lung rig smra ba shākya'i dge slong rin chen bzang po dang*/

shākya seng ge gnyis kyis mdzad pa'o// dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis mtshon nas rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i mthu la brten nas/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs su dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams sku tshe'i rgyal mtshan rdo rje ltar brtan pa dang*/ chab srid dpa' 'byor longs spyod/ mnga' thang*/ snyan grags/ stobs la sogs rnams rgyas pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub pa dang*/ 'chi ba'i tshe na'ang dngos brgyud kyi ma rgan rnams kyi don du gnad gcod drag po mi 'byung zhing*/ dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje 'khor bcas rnams mngon sum du byon te/ shar phyogs maṅga lam shrī dza la dī pa la laska ra bha wantu/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
